variants.title: Queen of Bud - Sunstone Candle
variants.body_html:
The Queen of Bud Sunstone Candle is more than a candle. It’s an invitation to create, reset, and transform your space. Hand poured with premium soy wax and crafted from 100% natural ingredients, each candle is hand decorated with dried flowers and a genuine sunstone crystal, making every piece beautifully unique. Designed to eliminate smoke odors while filling the room with notes of tropical fruit and warm musk, it creates an atmosphere that feels bright, inspiring, and effortlessly inviting. Whether you're setting the mood for a creative session, winding down after a long day, or simply refreshing your space, this candle brings warmth, intention, and a little extra spark to every moment.

Key Features & Benefits
Smoke eliminating: Neutralizes unwanted smoke odors while leaving behind a fresh, long-lasting fragrance.
Premium soy wax: Made with 100% natural soy wax for a clean, even burn.
Tropical fruit & musk scent: A vibrant blend of juicy tropical fruit balanced with warm, earthy musk for a fragrance that's both uplifting and comforting.
Genuine sunstone crystal: Hand decorated with a real sunstone crystal, traditionally associated with creativity, confidence, and positive energy.
Hand finished details: Each candle is individually decorated with dried flowers, making every one a unique piece.
Beautiful gift-ready packaging: Custom-designed packaging makes it perfect for gifting or elevating your own self-care ritual.
Long-lasting burn: Crafted to deliver hours of fragrance and ambiance while creating a cozy, elevated atmosphere.

Light it when you're looking for fresh inspiration, a more inviting space, or simply an excuse to slow down. The Queen of Bud Sunstone Candle brings together beautiful design, meaningful intention, and a scent you'll want to enjoy again and again.

variants.title: Loud Litlz
variants.body_html: LOUD LITLZ 3.5g brings premium Dom Jackson strains into a compact everyday format. These smalls and lower buds are cultivated with under canopy lighting to ensure consistent terpene and cannabinoid development throughout the plant. Same fire same flavour just smaller buds at a sharper price.

variants.title: Loud Litlz
variants.body_html: 7g of Dom Jackson smalls and lower buds, cultivated with under-canopy lighting for consistent cannabinoid and terpene development. Same cultivar character in a value-led format.

variants.title: Tropical Storm Liquid Diamonds & Live Resin Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Tropical Storm AIO Vape hits with high-potency, mouth-watering flavours and aromas. Using premium Pink Certz flower extracts grown in-house, the result is a blend of liquid diamonds for potency, with a splash of live resin, and botanical terpene. Pineapple and cherry terps offer sweet, tropical flavours and aromas. The ceramic coil delivers clean, flavourful clouds that are discreet & clog-free. This rechargeable with 3 adjustable heat settings to dial in your hits just the way you like them.

variants.title: Zombie Breath
variants.body_html: Zombie Breath is a premium small batch indoor cultivar from Castle Rock Farms grown in a GMP certified facility in beautiful Princeton, BC. Bred by Thug Pug Genetics, this potent cross of Peanut Butter Breath and (Death Valley OG x Cherry Breath) delivers a loud, complex terpene profile bursting with pine, lemon candy, rocket fuel, wet earth, and fermenting fruit aromas. Large, dense buds showcase pale green and purple hues wrapped in a thick frosting of resin and bright orange pistils. Zombie Breath offers standout bag appeal and rich flavour from start to finish. Each harvest is hang-dried, hand-trimmed, cold cured for a minimum of 21 days and never irradiated. True BC quality from your buds at Castle Rock Farms.

variants.title: Trilogy PR 21 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: 1SPLIFF Trilogy 21×0.5g brings three 1SPLIFF experiences together in one pack. With 21 pre-rolls across a rotating selection of Indica, Sativa and Hybrid strains, there’s something for every kind of session. Three strains, 21 pre-rolls, 10.5g of craft cannabis — all in one pack.

variants.title: Rocket Fuel PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Rocket Fuel unites Jet Fuel OG and Face Off OG to deliver a potent hybrid with heavy gas and earthy depth. Expect bold aromas of diesel, skunk, and a hint of citrus wrapped in smooth herbal undertones. The buds are dense and frosty, covered in trichomes with deep amber pistils.Whole flower and hand crafted, just the way your pre-rolls should be. BOLD Craft Cannabis is indoor grown, small batch, hang dried, slow cured and hand trimmed.

variants.title: Pineapple Bang Bang
variants.body_html: Pineapple Bang Bang (aka Pineapple Bang) is an Indica strain bred from parents Pineapple Fruz and Wild Cherry. The buds are bright green with bright orange pistols, covered in frosty, milky, trichomes. The flavor explodes with vibrant tropical notes, followed by earthy, gas, tones on the backend.

variants.title: Zooted
variants.body_html: Zooted Hybrid is a bag of rotating Hybrid flower at a low price. Each batch showcases a new hand picked Hybrid strain.

variants.title: Full Send
variants.body_html:
No half measures.

Full Send is a sativa-dominant flower chosen for bright flavour and an engaging smoke. Aromas often lean citrus, fruit, or fuel-forward, delivering a clean and lively profile from first pull to finish. Smooth, expressive, and high impact, Full Send is designed for those who like to stay active and engaged without sacrificing flavour or quality. Built with consistency in mind, this sativa offers a sharp, energetic experience that keeps things moving from start to finish.

variants.title: Snack Pack Pink Lady PR 4 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: The CHUB’S Sativa Snack Pack pre-rolls are perfectly portioned with bright sativa. Our handcrafted sativa pre-roll pack features joints filled with sativa whole flower. Each pre-roll is precision rolled to deliver a smooth experience.

variants.title: Snack Pack Alien Cookies x Kush Mintz PR 4 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Small but mighty, the CHUB’S Indica Snack Pack serves up pre-rolls that are p with indica flower. These pre-rolls offer a smooth and slow burn.  Our curated indica pre-roll pack features expertly rolled joints crafted from slow cured indica flower. Each pre-roll delivers a smooth and flavourful draw.

variants.title: Dragon Punch Live Rosin Gummies
variants.body_html: Dragon Punch Live Rosin Pearls deliver 2mg THC and come in a convenient 5-pack, perfect for sharing or savouring on your own. Made with live rosin, these Pearls capture the vibrant, tropical sweetness of dragon fruit with flavour that feels fresh, bright, and thoughtfully balanced, pairing big flavour with approachable, low-THC dosing.

variants.title: I.C.C. Triple Infused PR 3 x 0.75 g
variants.body_html: This package of HIGH KEY triple infused pre rolls features rich, creamy sweetness – and irresistible dessert like flavour layered with fruity undertones for a smooth, velvety smoke. This rare indica-dominant hybrid, born from Wedding Cake and Gelato #33. The pack includes three 0.75g pre rolls, triple infused with premium cannabis flower, live resin, live resin HTE, and THC diamonds for a potent, flavour rich experience. Crafted in British Columbia with high quality craft flower, these pre-rolls provide a slow, even burn and a clean, strain forward profile. Featuring PureFlowe™ cone technology with Hollow Vortex Filtration, each pre-roll delivers a smoother, cooler draw while preserving flavour. The patented inverse cone design ensures extended airflow, and the materials are certified biodegradable and compostable. Expertly packed, they offer consistent ignition and a reliable premium experience.

variants.title: Huckleberry Pi Triple Infused PR 3 x 0.75 g
variants.body_html: Huckleberry is a true BC Strain and is a classic indica-dominant created through crossing the classic Berry Pie and Cotton Candy. The pack includes three 0.75g pre rolls, triple infused with premium cannabis flower, live resin, live resin HTE, THC diamonds for a potent, flavour rich experience. Crafted in British Columbia with high quality craft flower, these pre rolls provide a slow, even burn and a clean, strain forward profile. Featuring PureFlowe™ cone technology with Hollow Vortex Filtration, each pre roll delivers a smoother, cooler draw while preserving flavour. The patented inverse cone design ensures extended airflow, and the materials are certified biodegradable and compostable. Expertly packed, they offer consistent ignition and a reliable premium experience.

variants.title: Mango Zkittelz Og Whipped Live Resin
variants.body_html: Indulge in a premium concentrate experience with Whipped Live Resin – Mango Zkittelz, a boutique cannabis extract crafted for the discerning connoisseur. With a robust terpene profile, this whipped concentrate delivers a powerful, full-spectrum, rich, true-to-strain flavor. The consistency is light and creamy — similar to live rosin — making it easy to work with whether you're dabbing or topping your flower. This strain’s genetics bring a sweet, berry-forward aroma with earthy diesel undertones that fans of classic OGs will appreciate.

variants.title: 67 Sindicate - Gary Satan Sugar Wax
variants.body_html: 67 Sindicate Sugar Wax 1g featuring Gary Satan is a premium cold-cured concentrate crafted to preserve the cultivar’s rich terpene profile and smooth wax consistency. Extracted from carefully selected cured indoor flower, this small-batch offering delivers loud notes of sweet gas, creamy earth, and pungent funk, showcasing the quality and precision behind every 67 Sins extract.

variants.title: Strawberry Mango Cured Resin
variants.body_html: Strawberry Mango Cured Resin is a limited time concentrate from Valhalla Flwr’s ongoing pheno hunt program, featuring Strawberry Banana and Mango Kush genetics. This sativa-dominant cultivar offers bright strawberry aromas layered with tropical mango notes for a rich, flavourful experience. Crafted from premium indoor-grown BC flower cultivated under LED lighting in coco medium, this terpene-rich cured resin is produced from carefully cured flower to preserve authentic cultivar expression. Small-batch extracted and processed by Pantheon Processing using Valhalla Flwr flower grown, dried, and cured in-house. Available in a 1g format.

variants.title: Tangie 99 Whipped Live Resin
variants.body_html: Tangie 99 Whipped Live Resin (1.2g) features a velvety, easy-to-scoop texture with an undeniable profile of fresh citrus. Freshly frozen at peak harvest to lock in its rich cannabinoid and terpene profile, this concentrate is whipped to a creamy perfection. Developed focusing on aromatic purity and tactile consistency, it highlights a distinct tangerine aroma and a dense, whipped-butter texture, preserving the raw essence of the plant without additives.

variants.title: Platinum Skywalker Cured Resin Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Available for a limited time, this Country Club vape features Platinum Skywalker, grown by Kootenay's Finest and extracted by Common Roots. The cured resin extract is rich in terpenes, with notes of citrus vanilla and creamy gas. This 1g full ceramic vape cartridge is compatible with 510 batteries and performs best at a voltage between 1.8 V and 2.5 V.

variants.title: Georgia Cream PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Introducing Georgia Cream, your new favourite heavyweight. Bred from Georgia Cry and Cap Junky, this cultivar delivers sweet, creamy notes with a hint of citrus for a rich and flavourful experience. These pre-rolls are hand-finished and hand-packaged, ensuring a consistent, even roll and ready-to-use convenience the moment you open the tube.

variants.title: Sour Ranger Jar of Joints PR 14 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: There’s a new sheriff in town! Introducing SHRED Sour Ranger 30+ with a minimum potency of 30% THC. Each perfectly packed half-gram cone bursts with sour lime and diesel aromas that will leave your taste buds tingling. This sativa-leaning blend is all about smooth, flavourful pulls and classic SHRED vibes. Crack open the lid, light up, and prepare to pucker up!

variants.title: Gelato Sweet Tea
variants.body_html: A good blend starts with the right ingredients. Gelato Sweet Tea balances candied citrus and delicate herbal notes with effortless harmony. Gelato and Sweet Tea come together in this indica-dominant offering, featuring dense, forest-green flower accented by bright orange pistils, making this bag inviting to the eye and ready for teatime.

variants.title: Fruit Puncher 30+ Milled
variants.body_html: SHRED Fruit Puncher 30+ milled flower. This hybrid blend features berry and lime aromas and a minimum potency of 30% THC, all packed into a 7g bag.

variants.title: El Chivo PR 3 x  0.5 g
variants.body_html: El Chivo is a flavour-forward indica that brings together the depth of OG Kush Breath Headband with the rich, gas-driven expression of Grape Gas. This cultivar delivers dense, resin-heavy buds with a terpene profile that leans savoury, layering earthy gas, subtle grape sweetness, and a peppery herbal finish. Crafted with a focus on terpene preservation and a consistent cure, El Chivo offers a smooth, full-bodied smoking experience that emphasizes balance, structure, and flavour complexity — appealing to consumers seeking depth beyond traditional sweet or citrus-forward profiles.

variants.title: Mind Playa
variants.body_html: Mind Playa is a unique in-house creation from 67 Sins, crossing the unmistakable Gary Satan with the terpene-rich Fishy Fingers. This craft-grown cultivar features dense, crystal-coated buds bursting with notes of sweet gas, earthy funk, and subtle briny undertones, showcasing the bold flavour profiles and elite genetic selection behind the 67 Sins lineup.

variants.title: Blade Runner
variants.body_html: Blade Runner is a vibrant, hybrid that brings together the energetic brightness of Alaskan Thunder Fuck with the smooth, creamy complexity of MAC #1. This cultivar opens with expressive citrus and sweet fruit notes, layered with soft florals and a clean, balanced finish. Grown with a focus on terpene preservation and visual quality, Blade Runner produces dense, resin-rich buds and a smooth, consistent burn. Its lively, flavour-forward profile makes it an ideal entry point into the lineup.

variants.title: Kush Mints
variants.body_html: Kush Mints is a hybrid cultivar that brings together the classic lineage of Animal Mints and Bubba Kush. Its compact, frosted buds release a burst of mint and cookie sweetness layered with herbal notes of pine plus kerosene gas, creating an aroma that’s as refreshing as it is complex. Bred by Seed Junky, this well-balanced cultivar is a modern classic for those who appreciate a little luxury in their leaf.

variants.title: Tigers Bleed Liquid DIamond Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Double Diamonds! Go on, you’ve earned it. Inside I’m apple flower (Sour Apple x Animal Cookies) with a whole damn safari of botanical terps for an incredible strawberry, watermelon and coconut taste — infused with potent THCa liquid diamonds. Outside, I’m diamond coated for even more potency. I don’t purr — I roar.

variants.title: Pineapple Drift Diamond Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Surf’s up. Pineapple Drift is a riptide of bold pineapple and high THC. Get drenched in tropical flavour. G.A. infused pre-rolls are made using milled whole flower, dusted in quality kief, boosted with botanical terpenes and infused with diamonds to deliver potent pre-rolls.

variants.title: Purple Punch Mints #11 PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Complex and distinguished. Purple Punch Mints is a fruity lineage of Purple Punch and Kush Mints #11. Purple Punch Mints' terpene profile is a creamy combination of grape juice and blueberry muffins, and upon a glance, it looks as if it has candied layers due to its dense coating of trichomes. At Joi, we hang dry, hand trim and cure in stainless steel containers for at least 14 days to ensure a quality finish. Packages are filled by hand and include humidity packs inside to maintain optimal freshness.

This particular variety was phenotyped by Joi Botanicals, and was chosen in part for it's unique terpene structure bringing rich, complicated aromas of sharp orange, citrus, gas, sour candy, and earthy sandlewood. At Joi we hang dry, hand trim, and cure in stainless steel containers for at least 14 days to ensure a quality finish. Packages are filled by hand and include humdiity packs inside to maintain optimal freshness. Enjoi!

Enjoi!

variants.title: Vodka Water Pipe Prosecco Clear 14.4 bowl-10in
variants.body_html:
The Vodka Prosecco Water Pipe brings a little bubbly energy to your glass collection. Standing 10 inches tall, this borosilicate glass bong features a showerhead perc for smooth, filtered hits, plus a bent neck that adds a comfortable touch to the design. The diamond-cut bowl and mouthpiece give it an extra dose of sparkle, making this one piece that looks just as good on the shelf as it does in a session.

Key Features & Benefits
Showerhead perc: Helps diffuse smoke for smoother, more enjoyable hits
Bent neck: Adds comfort while helping keep water away from your mouth
Diamond-cut details: Faceted bowl and mouthpiece bring extra texture and style
14mm male bowl: Standard bowl size for easy compatibility with 14mm accessories
10-inch height: Compact enough for everyday use while still delivering a satisfying hit
Gift box: Comes packaged and ready to gift

A little bubbly, a little bold, and very much ready for its close-up. The Vodka Prosecco Bong makes a fun addition to any collection.

variants.title: Blue Dream PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Presented in a precision-engineered tin with a hinged lid and custom insert for effortless access, Blue Dream Pre-Rolls introduce a reborn classic through Broken Coast’s lens of modern mastery. This sativa, phenohunted and extensively tested, preserves the sweet blueberry and herbal aromas fans know and love. Grown in small batches using Broken Coast’s precise cultivation methods, the dense buds are hand-trimmed and slow-cured to protect the terpene profile of myrcene, pinene, and caryophyllene. The result is an experience that honours Blue Dream’s storied legacy with Broken Coast’s hallmark quality and purity.

variants.title: Sweet Citrus Punch Liquid Diamonds Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Take a sip of sunshine with the Spinach® Sweet Citrus Punch liquid diamonds vape. Sweet, tangy and bursting with vibrant citrus notes, this liquid diamonds infused cart delivers a smooth and potent puff. Inspired by the sweet Citrus Punch strain and infused with liquid diamonds and high THC, every inhale is a sweet moment that proves each potent puff can still be bursting with flavour.

variants.title: Creme Royale Kush Nsfw Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: The Crème Royal liquid diamond blunt cartridge is what happens when your favourite blunt gets a grown-up glow up. No wrap required. Made with diamonds from our hydrocarbon extraction process and flavoured with botanical terpenes, this cart drips with that bold true-to-flower taste you know and love. No rolling, no crumbling. This sweet and creamy vanilla cartridge is loaded with liquid diamonds for a smooth full-bodied pull. Think of it as your blunt, but bottled, boosted and ready to go. No lighter, no problem.

variants.title: Fully Charged All-Stars Mixer Pack Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: The Spinach® Fully Charged All-Stars mixer pack gathers our popular infused pre-rolls crafted for flavour and potency. High THC, infused with cannabis extract, liquid diamonds, live rosin and a confetti-like kief coating for a smooth experience. This stacked lineup hits home with Rocket Icicle and Strawberry Slurricane to bring the juicy berry flavour notes, while Blueberry Dynamite and Peach Punch deliver bold and fruity sweetness. Pink Lemon delivers zesty sweetness.

variants.title: Yocan Evolve Plus XL Vaporizer Kit - Black
variants.body_html:
The Yocan Evolve Plus XL is an innovative all-in-one dab pen, designed for both convenience and performance. Ditching traditional threading, this device features a magnetic connection for quick and hassle-free attachment of the atomizer tube. Equipped with quad coil technology, its four quartz rods deliver massive clouds and pure, flavourful vapor without sacrificing efficiency.

Built from medical-grade quartz and durable aluminum, the Evolve Plus XL withstands high heat while maintaining a clean and consistent experience. The adjustable airflow valve lets you customize your draw—whether you prefer dense clouds or rich flavour. With a powerful 1400mAh battery, this vaporizer keeps you going all day, and the micro-USB charging makes recharging simple and convenient.

To enhance portability, Yocan has integrated a dual-compartment silicone storage jar at the base of the battery, perfect for stashing your concentrates. Complete with a lanyard and dab tool, the Evolve Plus XL ensures effortless, on-the-go sessions whenever you need them.

Key Features & Benefits
Quad Coil Quartz Technology – Four quartz rods maximize vapor production and flavour for smooth, potent hits.
Magnetic Connection – Easy-to-use design eliminates threading for quick assembly and effortless maintenance.
Adjustable Airflow – Customize your experience with an airflow valve for dense clouds or optimal flavour.
Powerful 1400mAh Battery – Extended battery life keeps you vaping longer without constant recharging.
Leak-Proof Coil Caps – Prevents mess and conserves concentrate for a cleaner experience.
Built-in Silicone Storage – Dual-compartment jar at the base for convenient concentrate storage.
Micro-USB Charging – Charge anywhere with a universal micro-USB port.
Complete Kit – Includes a lanyard and dab tool for easy handling and portability.
Built for Performance, Designed for Convenience
The Yocan Evolve Plus XL Vaporizer Kit is a powerful and portable solution for concentrate enthusiasts. With quad coil heating, a long-lasting battery, and built-in storage, this vaporizer is made for smooth, hassle-free sessions anywhere you go.

variants.title: Yocan Ziva Pro Battery Cyan Blue Gradient
variants.body_html:
Sleek, smart, and seriously stealthy—the Yocan Ziva Pro is back and better than ever. Designed for ultimate discretion, this compact battery fully conceals any 510-threaded cartridge (up to 2g), making it perfect for low-key sessions wherever you go. Despite its small size, the Ziva Pro is packed with power and precision, giving you full control at your fingertips.
The crisp OLED screen displays everything you need—voltage settings, puff counter, battery life, resistance, and temperature tracking—while the automatic draw feature lets you preheat for smoother, flavour-rich hits. A single USB-C charge lasts up to two days with regular use, keeping your vape game strong without constant recharging.

Key Features & Benefits
Fits Up to 2g Carts – Fully conceals 510-threaded cartridges for total discretion.
OLED Smart Display – Monitor voltage, temp, resistance, puff count, and more.
Precision Voltage Control – Fine-tune your session exactly how you like it.
Automatic Draw & Preheat – Convenient, buttonless hits with preheat functionality.
Long-Lasting Battery – Up to 2 days of regular use per charge.
USB-C Charging – Fast, modern, and convenient power-up.
Ultra-Compact Design – Perfect for on-the-go or pocket-friendly portability.

All the power, none of the bulk. Ziva Pro is your go-to battery for discreet, dialed-in sessions anywhere.

variants.title: Yocan UNI Pro-Digital Box Mod-White
variants.body_html: The Yocan Uni Pro is a small and portable box mod that fits a wide variety of atomizers. Its OLED screen shows you battery life, so you know when it's time to charge and shows you a puff counter, temperature, preheat, and even if you forgot to add a cart. Easily switch between 2.0-4.0 volts depending on the type of hit you like and consistency of what is in your cartridge. This awesome device can also be adjusted to fit different heights and widths of carts. The innovative hanging hole lets you hook it to a lanyard and carry it around with you. This device has a 650mAh battery and recharges quickly with a USB-C cable.

variants.title: Yocan Ziva Pro Battery Gray
variants.body_html:
Sleek, smart, and seriously stealthy—the Yocan Ziva Pro is back and better than ever. Designed for ultimate discretion, this compact battery fully conceals any 510-threaded cartridge (up to 2g), making it perfect for low-key sessions wherever you go. Despite its small size, the Ziva Pro is packed with power and precision, giving you full control at your fingertips.
The crisp OLED screen displays everything you need—voltage settings, puff counter, battery life, resistance, and temperature tracking—while the automatic draw feature lets you preheat for smoother, flavour-rich hits. OLED Smart Display – Monitor voltage, temp, resistance, puff count, and more.
Precision Voltage Control – Fine-tune your session exactly how you like it.
Automatic Draw & Preheat – Convenient, buttonless hits with preheat functionality.
Long-Lasting Battery – Up to 2 days of regular use per charge.
USB-C Charging – Fast, modern, and convenient power-up.
Ultra-Compact Design – Perfect for on-the-go or pocket-friendly portability.

All the power, none of the bulk. Ziva Pro is your go-to battery for discreet, dialed-in sessions anywhere.

Designed with versatility and performance in mind, the UNI Pro is the perfect upgrade for vapers who want more from their portable setup.

Universal 510 Compatibility – Adjustable height and diameter settings accommodate most oil cartridges

Precise Voltage Control (2.0V–4.2V) – Fine-tune your experience to match your preferred potency and flavour

OLED Display – Clear, real-time feedback on voltage, battery level, and session duration

Built-in Battery (650mAh) – Rechargeable power that keeps up with your day

Compact & Ergonomic Design – Comfortable to hold, easy to carry, and discreet in any setting

Magnetic Cartridge Adapter – Snap-in connection makes swapping cartridges quick and hassle-free

Preheat Function – Warms up thicker oils for consistent hits every time

With its sleek design and customizable performance, the Yocan UNI Pro is built for users who want convenience without compromise. It’s everything you need in a portable cartridge vaporizer—refined, reliable, and ready when you are.

variants.title: Rosin Infused Raspberry Creamsicle 4 Pack
variants.body_html: This 4-pack of 355ml sodas makes it easy to keep the good vibes going. Each can features vibrant raspberry flavour layered with smooth vanilla cream, creating a bold and fresh taste that balances bright berry tartness with creamy sweetness. Crisp carbonation keeps the drink light and satisfying from the first sip to the last. Each can contains 10mg of THC and is powered by Envision Emulsions for a consistent, fast-acting experience. Infused with premium solventless rosin made from the Peanut Butter Breath strain, this drink delivers a full-spectrum cannabis profile while maintaining the smooth finish Snap Back is known for.

variants.title: OG Kush
variants.body_html: The remake is going to be better than the original. Spinach® OG Kush is our new take on a classic strain making for a super flavourful and potent cultivar. A cross between GMO #12 and SFV OG, get earthy, piney and citrusy flavours and aromas pumped up from terpenes like myrcene, limonene and caryophyllene. This powerhouse cross doesn’t only make for a flavourful strain, it pumps up the potency to high levels and makes it an OG experience you won’t want to miss.

variants.title: Kush Mints Milled
variants.body_html: Tweed Kush Mints Milled is ready when you are. With high THC and minimal CBD, Kush Mints milled flower offers convenience and a unique flavour profile. Minty meets earthy in this hybrid strain.

variants.title: Max 60'S Howler Infused PR 3 x 0.45 g
variants.body_html: Howler Max 60’s unleash a tropical blast of pineapple, citrus and jungle funk wrapped in liquid, crushed and diamond-coated potency. With high THC, this pack is a loud and potent infused pre-roll, because Max 60’s don’t whisper, they howl.

variants.title: Rotating Indica PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Keep it simple with Thumbs Up Indica Pre-Rolls—10 joints, perfectly rolled and ready when you are. Packed with potent indica-dominant flower, they’re all about getting straight to the good stuff.

variants.title: Queen of Bud Zippo - Sunstone
variants.body_html:
The Queen of Bud Sunstone Creative Spark Zippo is a reminder that every great idea begins with a single spark. Featuring the first orange design in the collection, its radiant sunstone mosaic pattern symbolizes warmth, inspiration, and the confidence to trust your imagination. Whether you're chasing your next big idea or simply enjoying a quiet moment, this timeless lighter is designed to keep your creative fire burning.
Key Features & Benefits
Sunstone-inspired design: Exclusive sunstone mosaic artwork represents creativity, warmth, and inspired thinking.
All-metal construction: Built for lasting durability with Zippo's iconic craftsmanship.
Windproof performance: Reliable flame that stands up to the elements.
Refillable design: Made for years of dependable use with replaceable flints and fuel.
Signature orange finish: The first orange design in the Queen of Bud collection, bringing bold energy to every session.
Carry a little inspiration wherever you go and let every spark remind you to create something uniquely your own.

variants.title: Jonny's Stash Rotating Indica PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: A rotating pre-roll offering of craft flower, hand-dried, hand-trimmed, sorted and milled for the perfect consistency.

variants.title: White Lotus Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: White Lotus is bred from the legendary The White x Snow Lotus. This sleek pre-roll features hand-milled flower, a potent infusion of premium kief and live resin, and enhanced botanical terpene profiles. The result is a clean, potent experience and a consistently smooth, satisfying smoke.

variants.title: Black Cherry Punch Live Rosin
variants.body_html: Greazy's Black Cherry Punch Live Rosin captures the essence of the Black Cherry Punch strain with bright cherry and berry sweetness and hints of earthy spice. Crafted to retain the plant's full spectrum terpene profile, this concentrate locks in cannabinoids and terpenes for a bright and flavourful experience that can be consumed on its own or added to any session. Get Greazy.

variants.title: Reloadable 96+ Kiwi Cactus Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Inspired by Canada's Wild West with real value, high potency and quality cannabis. Presenting the new Reloadable all-in-one, a quality reusable and rechargeable high potency liquid diamond vape set up. Kiwi Cactus botanicals and a liquid diamond formulation brings a sunny, sour and fresh flavour and serious potency with high THC.

variants.title: Sour Diesel Pure Live Resin Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: EastCann's Sour Diesel Pure Live Resin all-in-one. Extracted from fresh frozen quality flower, live resin in an all-in-one device.

variants.title: Cuban Linx
variants.body_html: You spoke — we delivered. The diverse richness of exotic terpenes found in Cuban Linx give these buds an invigorating lemony aroma that is accentuated by hints of gassy diesel and a touch of spiciness. A truly fresh strain, Cuban Linx was bred by crossing TK Skunk x Trigerian. The result is a huge bud with a shape that resembles corn on the cob.

variants.title: C4 PR 7 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: C4 by 1Spliff is an indica dominant blend of Cotton Candy and Shiskaberry, known for its exceptional resin production and dense trichome-rich flowers. It delivers a rich fruity and earthy aroma with subtle notes of pine and citrus. Grown indoors in a controlled environment, this cultivar is made to order, hang dried, hand trimmed, then ground from whole flower and precision milled to perfection before being placed into our pre-rolls, ensuring consistent burn and flavour with no stems, sticks or shake.

variants.title: Chef's Kiss Summer Edition
variants.body_html: Back by Popular Demand — Chef’s Kiss returns for our Limited Summer Season Drop. New genetics, new colours, same premium experience. Featuring four half-quarter milled flower shakers packed with curated, handcrafted B.C. whole flower from Avant. Coarsely ground and packaged in glass jars with custom-designed tops, each one lets you DIY your own custom blends by sprinkling directly into your papers or bong. Mix, match, and make it your own. A little of this, a little of that. Yes, Chef!

variants.title: Sativa PR 20 x 0.35 g

variants.title: C4

It delivers a rich fruity and earthy aroma with subtle notes of pine and citrus. Grown indoors in a controlled environment, this cultivar is made to order, hang dried and hand trimmed to ensure consistency.

variants.title: Frosted Rootbeer PR 10 x 0.75 g
variants.body_html: Rolled, packed, and ready to move, this 10-pack of 0.75g pre-rolls smokes smooth, with strain-specific flower in a classic tube. Crack open some Frosted Rootbeer, featuring a sweet-and-spicy, sativa-dominant cross of GMO Rootbeer and New England Hazy Kush. The flavour hits with smooth, nostalgic root beer sweetness up front, followed by subtle spice and a gassy kush finish that rounds out every pull. This slick tin protects your cargo and makes any session simple, easy to pocket, easy to spark and easy to share. Wherever you end up, Smokes' got you covered.

variants.body_html: Super Lemon Cherry is a sativa-dominant cross of Super Lemon Haze and Cherry Pie that brings together bright lemon citrus, earthy skunk, and subtle berry sweetness. Dense buds show off subtle purple hues beneath a thick coating of frosty trichomes. Indoor grown, small batch, hang dried, slow cured and hand trimmed to the BOLD standard.

Each pre-roll is filled with expertly milled whole flower, infused with solventless bubble hash, hand finished with a Dutch crown and tipped with a reusable glass mouthpiece for a smooth and refined draw.

variants.body_html: Jealousy Hash Infused Pre-Rolls by Truro Cannabis deliver bold flavour and elevated potency in a premium infused format. The bubble hash is produced using a gentle ice water extraction method that preserves potency and maximizes terpene retention. Grown indoors in Truro, Nova Scotia, these infused pre-rolls reflect Truro’s small-batch approach, delivering a smooth, slow burn and consistent craft quality.

variants.body_html: The soft zest of yuzu layered over dank notes. The perfect contrast that delivers potency every time.

variants.body_html: Experience a wave of flavour and a burst of potency with Nugz Flavour Bomb Atomic Peach infused pre-rolls, a multipack of THCa diamond infused pre-rolls that deliver juicy, sweet peach with every inhale. Each pre-roll is meticulously crafted with indoor grown flower, never irradiated, and infused with THCa diamonds and resin to deliver a high THC, full flavour experience.

variants.body_html: IRIS Labs' ZODA is a vivid celebration of the Umami Terps legacy, born from the dynamic pairing of London Jellyz and Zoda. Live Resin. No Distillates. No Additives.

Featuring a custom live screen display for flavour blending or selection, battery and use tracking, Boutiq's V5 is a highly potent device designed for user experience. Made with flavour bursting botanical blends Blue Crush, Chem Berry and sweet Honeycomb. Flavours are expertly blended with a liquid diamond formulation at a top shelf potency over 95% THC.

variants.title: Flavour Bomb Pineapple Punch Liquid Diamond Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: FLAVOUR BOMB 40 Pineapple Soap .95g All-In-One Vape is built for flavour chasers, potency seekers, and anyone who believes big terp energy shouldn’t require a lighter. This is pure tropical voltage — ready when you are. Crack the seal and you’re hit with juicy pineapple up front, bright and dripping with citrus sweetness. Mid-pull, sharp lemon peel and zesty citrus oil cut through with that unmistakable Pineapple Soap snap. On the exhale? A clean, slightly floral finish with a subtle gassy backbone that reminds you this isn’t just flavour — it’s fire. Inside, .95g of our high-potency diamond extract engineered for dense vapour and saturated terp expression. Outside, innovative hardware delivering consistent, flavour-forward pulls from first draw to final flash. Smooth inhale. Smooth draw. Full flavour saturation. Zero fuss. NUGZ FLAVOUR BOMB 40 Pineapple Soap .95g All-In-One Vape, for when life's a beach!

variants.title: Focus Moments (CBD:CBC:CBG)
variants.body_html: Focus Moments are RapidSense™ nano-emulsified swallowable tablets featuring CBD, CBC, CBG and our 36 terpene focus blend. These tablets are made without animal products, sugar or gluten.

variants.title: Triangle Kush 3000 PR 1 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Our in-house bred Triangle Kush 3000 is a sativa dominant cross of CSI:Humboldt and the infamous T-1000 (Triangle Kush x Purple Urkle) cut crossed with Sky Cuddler Double Kush (Meangene aka Freeborn Selections). Our Triangle Kush 3000 was bred for potency, flavour and a short flowering time. It was grown in sunny southwestern Ontario and cared for by a talented team of legacy growers and breeders. Featuring strong THC potency potential. Its aroma is pungent, sweet and spicy with slight floral funkiness and gassy notes. Bred by, selected by and grown by 7 Farms Down.

variants.title: Lavender Haze Glass Tip Blunt PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: MillRite's Lavender Haze in a new glass tipped blunt is the newest way to consume one of the fastest growing products in Ontario. It offers a smooth smoke with the flavours of this full flower pre-rolled chamomile blunt with a glass tip.

variants.title: Pure Cherry Cake PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Pure Cherry Cake is an indulgent indica that tastes like cherry-topped dessert with a creamy twist — pure comfort in every puff. Bred from Caked Up Cherries x Pure Michigan, this strain delivers sweet, fruity goodness.

variants.body_html: An exceptional flower! Bright and vibrant colours, beautiful dense buds and a terpene intensity off the charts! This hyper fragrant cultivar is a cross between the lovely Pink Hawaiian and the infamous Jack Herer. It is grown exclusively indoors, hang dried and cured to perfection

variants.title: Tropic Thunder PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Tropic Thunder is a cross between Tropicana Cookies x Banana Kush. This aromatic sativa strain offers a bright tropical citrus profile layered with sweet fruit and subtle gas. Light green buds are dense and finished with a frosty coating of trichomes. Produced on Stó:lō traditional territory, Tropic Thunder weaves Indigenous practices with intentional, craft cultivation methods.

variants.title: Grape Yogurt
variants.body_html: Grape Yogurt is an indica-dominant strain with distinct purple-coloured buds blanketed in silver trichomes. It exudes potent notes of black cherry, sour berries, and grape that transfer through when vaped or smoked.

variants.title: Blackberry Gelato
variants.body_html: Blackberry Gelato is as indica as it gets. The bud packs a fresh punch of grapes, hops and cedar, in a deep purple structure and flashy orange hairs. A cultivar for the more experienced.

variants.title: Craft Series
variants.body_html: The Craft Series is Cheers’ premium R&D rotational product. A statement of what we stand for — passion, dedication and curiosity. With over 20 different tests each year, the Craft series gives the opportunity to the customers to become a part of our R&D team. Craft series will include a wide range of indica-dominant cultivars.

variants.title: Dual 40 PR 40 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Two strain pack of cured full flower pre-rolls.

variants.title: Jungle Driver Fresh Frozen Hash Rosin
variants.body_html: Nugz fresh frozen hash rosin (FFHR) is derived from our rare genetic library and frozen at harvest to preserve the flower's natural terpene profile, flavours and aromas. Our FFHR is made by washing frozen flower and sieving the trichomes through 159µm to 73µm wash bags in ice water to produce a bubble hash. We then gently heat and press the hash through a fine micron bag until a rosin is forced out. The resulting end product being a solventless, cannabinoid- and terpene-rich extract.

variants.title: Anytime 1:1 Rainbow Glow Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Rainbow Glow features a bright and fruit forward blend of crisp green apple, ripe citrus and juicy tropical fruit punch. Containing both THC and CBD, this vape offers smooth sessions that bring fresh, vibrant flavour with every puff. Crafted with high purity distillate and infused with botanical terpenes, it delivers clean and consistent vapour. Built on trusted CCELL all-in-one hardware, Rainbow Glow is simple, reliable and ready.

variants.title: Mango Sour Pure Live Resin Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Live resin extracted from EastCann's sativa-dominant Mango Sour craft flower. This potent live resin has a distinct citrus and mango flavour profile packaged in a ready to use All-In-One device.

variants.title: Gelato Punch PR 5 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Irony Gelato Punch pre-rolls are what happens when a pie shop and a jet engine share a smoke break. The parents are Punch Pie and Jet Fuel Gelato, so expect a creamy, berry, sweet and kind of gassy flavour in all the right ways. An indica dominant flower that offers high THC and offers top terpenes of myrcene, limonene and ocimene providing a unique experience. Tastes good, burns smooth. Classic Irony, honestly.

variants.title: Pirate Milk
variants.body_html: Pirate Milk, a striking hybrid cross born from the prized lineage of Cereal Milk x Candy Rain that carries a sweet bounty of creamy vanilla and fruity cereal notes, with subtle hints of coconut and orchard fruit, giving a smooth and creamy character that fits its name.

variants.title: Mango Tango PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Mango Tango is a potent and complex cross of The True OG x Tangie x Peaches. This balanced hybrid strain boasts high THC levels from the OG lineage and is bursting with tropical smoothie notes and an earthy pine finish.

variants.title: Purple Punch PR 14 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Purple Punch is the sweet union of two indica dominant classics. It’s a delicious dessert strain with aromas of grape candy, blueberry muffins and tartness.

variants.title: True Skunk Premium Buds
variants.body_html: True Skunk is the authentic revival of a strain lost to time, Skunk #1 in its truest form. After years of searching and working with various genetic lines, FATCAT has successfully resurrected this masterpiece, bringing back its legendary profile. Known for its overpowering skunky aroma that fills any room, True Skunk is impossible to conceal and is a nostalgic tribute to its Amsterdam origins. With a high THC level and a rich terpene blend, it's a potent sativa, making it a standout offering for today’s cannabis consumers.

variants.title: Hawaiian Splash Liquid Diamond Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Dank Diner's Hawaiian Splash Liquid 1g Vape is a sativa strain noted for its sweet, fruity and topical flavours.

variants.title: Aloha White Widow Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Aloha White Widow Liquid Diamonds, a fruity burst that hits with island vibes and crystal-clean potency.

variants.title: Farmers' Market PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Each rotational Farmers' Market Pre-Roll Variety Pack features a curated selection of two of our seasonal strains. Our Slurricane cultivar combines subtle floral and hop flavours with aromas of sweet wild grass for a very smooth, crisp and clean finish. While Lollipopz offers sweet candy and lavender upfront with subtle berry and citrus hints, balanced by rich earthiness and undertones of herbal spice on the finish. Lune Rise Farms pre-rolls are crafted with strain specific, single source sun-grown whole flower, hang dried and cured to preserve its unique cannabinoid and terpene profile. Rotational drops will be communicated throughout the year. At Lune Rise Farms, we are committed to bringing the time-honoured traditions and practices of regenerative farming to the cultivation of cannabis. We truly believe that natural products are best looked after by the craftspeople of the earth: the farmers. We grow and harvest, we don’t manufacture.

variants.title: Jean Guy CBD Flower Sticks PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: A CBD-rich cross of the legendary sativa dominant Jean Guy strain. Experience the best of both worlds with Orchid CBD's Jean Guy dried flower. This strain captures the qualities of the original but tames the intense THC potency with a near 1:1 ratio of TH

variants.title: Blue Magoo Super Slim Electric Dartz PR 10 x 0.4 g
variants.body_html: Dab Bods Blue Magoo Super Slim Electric Dartz are a sleek and convenient way to consume cannabis in a compact format. Each pack contains ultra-slim pre-rolls, carefully crafted with quality dried cannabis for a smooth and reliable burn. Blue Magoo brings bold blueberry notes with a sweet and fruity profile that stands out from start to finish. Easy to carry and designed for those who appreciate quality in a slim format.

variants.title: AK47 PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Rooted in classic Colombian and Afghani landrace genetics, with contributions from Mexican and Thai lines, All Kush 47 stands as one of most iconic sativa-dominant cultivars in modern cannabis history. This profile carries nostalgic earthy and sweet floral notes, underscored by skunky depth, often accompanied by citrus and sour accents. It moves through like an echo rather than a collision, a cut defined by legacy and presence, balancing old-school earthiness with bright, living nuance in a way that feels timeless.

variants.title: Iced Sangria PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: This pre-roll delivers a high quality product with great value and convenience. Iced Sangria brings the fruity tropical terpenes with pineapple notes shining through the brightest.

variants.body_html: Each bottle contains 30 mg of soluble liquid THC and 30 mg of CBD with virtually no bitter taste. Two drops are equal to 1 mg of THC and 1 mg of CBD so you can customize your dose your own way.

variants.title: Hella Jelly PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Hella Jelly, is a potent sativa-dominant cultivar that originates from the west coast. Dense, icy looking with short orange hairs make this cultivar stand out from most. Sweet and fruity notes of cotton candy and cherry excite the senses for what is to come.

variants.title: Garlic Zkittlez
variants.body_html: Garlic Zktlz is a loud indica-dominant strain born from GMO (Garlic Cookies) x Zktlz. Expect very strong THC potency and dense, resin-packed buds with olive-green tones, amber pistils, and a frosty layer of trichomes. It hits with savoury garlic and spice up front, followed by sweet tropical fruit and a hint of diesel. It’s funky, fruity, and full of flavour.

variants.title: Dante’s Inferno
variants.body_html: Dime Bag Smalls Dante’s Inferno indica dominant hybrid flower is packed with small, sun grown buds and is a genetic cross of Oreoz × Devil Driver. The buds are icy and dense with deep green and hints of purple. Each pouch delivers a sweet and fruity flavour with notes of spice and pungent citrus aroma. Grown in Ontario, Dime Bag Smalls offers very strong THC potency potential. Size isn't everything with value this big.

variants.title: Jonny's Stash Rotational
variants.body_html: Jonny’s Stash Rotational Sativa is a curated collection of premium sativa cultivars. Experience the pinnacle of freshness and quality with each batch, showcasing a diverse spectrum of flavours, aromas, and effects.

variants.title: Liberty Haze
variants.body_html: Our Pepe Everyday line offers top quality with best-in-class value. Liberty Haze is a classic sativa. Expect delicious flavours of hazy citrus and sweet diesel. This strain has a powerful bouquet of sweet lime with notes of herbaceous spice and pungent lemon.

variants.title: Durban Poison
variants.body_html: Our Pepe Everyday line offers top quality with best-in-class value. Durban P is a classic landrace strain. Expect delicious flavours of minty musk and herbaceous spice. This is classic cannabis at its finest.

variants.title: Pink Gas
variants.body_html: Our Pepe Everyday's Ready-to-Roll is our value milled product line. Our Ready-to-Roll Pink Gas is a classic kush and gas forward indica that delivers on everything you need from flavour and effects, to value and potency.

variants.title: Ripped Sativa
variants.body_html: Get RIPPED Sativa. Packed with bold sativa-dominant whole flower. This pouch hits with high THC levels. No nonsense — just straight-up quality at floor pricing.

variants.title: Laundry Loopz PR 4 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: First its straight GMO-style funk, like warm laundry that somehow still smells loud. Then the “Loopz” kicks in: a sweet, citrus, sugary edge that smooths the corners and keeps it from going full skunk. It looks the part too, with bright green buds caked in trichomes and orange hairs running wild throughout. Sun + LED grown and rainwater fed in our Quebec greenhouse. Hangdried, trimmed and packed the way we’d want to find it.

variants.title: Lemonberry 60’s+ Dbl Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Lemonberry 60’s Double Infused Pre-Rolls deliver a bright, flavour-forward smoke. Zesty lemon notes lead the experience, followed by a smooth berry finish that keeps things balanced and approachable. Double infused for added potency, Lemonberry is sativa designed to amplify fresh citrus and soft berry aromas while maintaining a smooth, consistent burn.

variants.title: Tropicanna FSE Resin Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Tropicanna, a legacy Tangie × GSC sativa dominant hybrid. This famed lineage brings together Tangie’s vibrant citrus character with GSC’s potency. Expect an explosion of juicy tangerine, orange, tropical fruit and pineapple in every puff, rounded out with subtle earthy undertones.

variants.title: Organic Lemon Cherry Pie Craft PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: This edition of the Lemon Cherry Pie genetic was grown at an indoor vertical farm using organic living soil. This indica leaning cultivar is rich in terpenes with notes of lemon zest, sweet cherry and creamy gas. The plant's dense and sticky buds are hand trimmed, cured for a minimum of three weeks and never irradiated.

variants.title: Lemon Ztrawz
variants.body_html: Lemon Strawz is a sativa cultivar bred from parents Lemon Up x Sour Strawz. True to its name, the lemon flavour explodes alongside bright, sweet candy notes. The buds produce beautiful shades of green mixed with bright orange pistils, caked in milky white trichomes.

variants.title: Route 66 Live Resin Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Route 66 — also known as Jelly Rancher, it is a vibrant cross of Very Cherry x Notorious THC. It tantalizes the taste buds with a burst of sweet berries, zesty citrus, and a hint of sour apple, balanced by an earthy undertone. Live resin, no distillates, no additives. In a premium XL Ceramic Cart.

variants.title: With Love From Scarbourough PR 5 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Experience the love from Scarborough in a convenient large pre roll format. A decadent indica‑leaning hybrid that blends the cooling, dessert‑mint profile of Kush Mintz with the dense, doughy, resin‑heavy character of Do‑Si‑Dos.

variants.title: Star Cab Cherry Chem PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Star Cab Chery Chem is a hybrid-leaning strain selected from our Star Cab Cherry Chem worked line. Our Star Cab Cherry Chem twisted pre-rolls are a modern day OG Kush, grown in sunny South Western Ontario in living soil, whole plant hung and offering high THC and terpenes. Cared by a talented team of legacy craft growers. The nose is a sweet earthy fuel paired with a pungent skunky finish derived from a mixture Stardawg, GMO, Cherry Pie, Chem 91bx. Featuring high THC potency potential with 3.5%+ terpenes. Bred by, selected by, and grown by 7 Farms Down.

variants.title: Z-OG PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Rooted in classic West Coast OG genetics and refined through modern selection, Z-OG blends old school depth with a smoother, contemporary edge. Chosen for its chunky, resin-rich buds, this cultivar is driven by a terpene profile led by linalool, humulene, and caryophyllene. The aroma opens with sweet, ripe fruit and soft candy notes, followed by a gentle herbal layer and a warm finish of peppered spice. Z-OG is a quiet nod to our legendary ZXFPOG. If you know, you know.

variants.title: Z-OG PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Rooted in classic West Coast OG genetics and refined through modern selection, Z-OG blends old school depth with a smoother, contemporary edge. variants.title: Oklahoma Coma PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Oklahoma Coma is an indica-dominant strain bred from Truffle Too x Dip X' Stix. Dense, resin-rich dark purple buds with bold diesel, earthy and sweet kerosene type aromas that produce a flavour of gas and spice. The aroma and beautiful look of this flower excite the user for what is to come. Trimmed and cured whole flower milled and machine rolled. Our pre-rolls are filled with — all bud and no shake for maximum enjoyment and a consistent experience.

variants.title: HellCap OG
variants.body_html: Born from the depths of our breeding room at Sixty Seven Sins, HellCap OG merges two juggernauts: our infamous Gary Satan (GP x Jealousy) and the revered Cap Junky. The result is a hellishly loud hybrid with towering resin production, pronounced bag appeal, and a terpene structure that punches far above its class. HellCap OG regularly pushes 32% THC with over 3% terpenes, expressing a complex blend of gas, sour citrus, and earthy OG funk. Its effects are potent, immersive, and long-lasting. A true capstone cultivar for those who love loud West Coast genetics with refined modern edge.

variants.title: Kush Pie Milled
variants.body_html: Our Kush Pie, also known as Cherry Boat #25 S1, is a multi-generational breeding project. The #25 was selected out of 100 plants and selfed (S1). Out of a selection of 50 females, a unique plant was chosen with terpene profiles to match. A dessert you can smoke. Our Kush Pie is a 60/40 sativa dominant strain. Kush Pie is a treat to your senses, offering unique dessert and fruit profiles with heavy notes that hint at Neapolitan ice cream, baked pie and mystery fruits. Kush Pie smells as unique as it is distinctive.

variants.title: Dripbar Blood Orange Mosa Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Try the refreshing taste of orange citrus and smooth vanilla in Blood Orange Mosa, with the control and customizability of Sticky Greens' Dripbar all-in-one, disposable vapes with LED display.

variants.title: Cake N Bake Milled
variants.body_html: Cake N Bake is an indica leaning strain. A cross of LA Kush Cake x Triangle Kush, it delivers a dessert-like sweetness with a subtle gas finish. The dense trichome covered buds offer a reliable experience.

This slick tin protects your cargo and makes any session simple and portable.

variants.title: Royal Ace #6: VantaBlack PR 3 x 0.5 g

This cultivar brings together the sweet, baked apple and creamy gas notes of Fried Applez with the earthy, grape-tinged kush backbone of Black Diamond, resulting in an aroma that’s both rich and mouth-coating. Dense, resin-soaked buds and jet-black undertones make this strain as visually stunning as it is potent. Crafted for connoisseurs who crave both flavour and depth.

variants.title: Royal Ace #5: Purple Zombie PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Purple Zombie greets the senses with an intricate tapestry of flavours. As the experience unfolds, the influence of RNTZ adds a layer of fruity and floral undertones, infusing each puff with a delightful burst of flavour. The smoke is smooth and aromatic, with hints of berry and grape that linger pleasantly on the palate.

variants.title: Sour Kush PR 10 x 0.35 g

The terpene-rich flower expresses vibrant ripe fruit aromas with a hint of classic skunk, giving the strain a complex and memorable profile. Crafted for consumers who appreciate flavour-forward hybrids, Cherry Punch offers a well-rounded experience. Each pre-roll is rolled for consistency and an even burn, providing a fragrant, full-bodied smoke that showcases the quality and craftsmanship Green Mountain is known for.

variants.title: Gastro Pop PR 10 x 0.5 g

variants.title: Forbidden Applez PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Fruit Drops is all about those fruity terpenes -- strains with flavour and aroma that could peel the paint off the walls when you pop the tube. Forbidden Applez is a tasty hybrid strain that smells like a red candied apple. This cross of Forbidden Fruit x Sour Apple is a potent flower.

variants.title: Orangutan TT's PR 20 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Orangutan TT's is a hybrid strain made from a genetic cross between Grease Monkey and Zktlz. This strain is a potent and flavourful treat with a candy-like sweetness and a floral spice.

variants.title: Cali Kush PR 4 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Cali Kush is a true classic. The parent to many of today’s modern Kush genetics, it still holds its own. The earthy and grassy notes are backed up with anise and pine, and come together to create a smooth and creamy smoke with a special bit of nostalgia.

variants.title: Maui Wowie PR 4 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Just the mention of Maui Wowie to some brings back memories, to others we only know it as the parent to some of the most potent sativas on the market today. Hints of spice and fruit poke through a herbaceous back note, giving this sativa a profile you can’t help but recognize.

variants.title: Cosmic Cookies PR 1 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Cosmic Cookies pre-rolls by Truro Cannabis delivers sweet citrus and bright flavour in a convenient format. Made with whole Cosmic Cookies flower, this sativa leaning cultivar delivers a smooth and consistent burn across every pre-roll. Grown indoors and handcrafted in Truro, Nova Scotia, these pre-rolls showcase craft quality and reliable flavour in a ready-to-consume format.

variants.title: Golden Hour - PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Golden Hour (GMO x Mint Choco Chip). Open structure with good internodal spacing and medium green buds that develop rich orange pistils and a subtle trichome shine. Diesel, pine, and spice with dense buds showing warm golden hues and natural colour contrast. 28%+ THC, always grown and groomed in-house. Warm, hazy, and slow-setting. The one you reach for as the light fades and everything softens.

variants.title: Pineapple Nuken PRs 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: A taste of the tropics, now in a twelve-pack. A cross between Pineapple Haze and Nuken, this hybrid offers a sweet fruity aroma with earthy undertones thanks to its exotic terpene profile that’s high in ocimene, farnesene, and caryophyllene.

variants.title: Nebula II CBD PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: CBD-rich pre-rolls, with low-to-no THC, now come in a 12-pack, no assembly required. Filled with our indica-dominant hybrid Nebula II CBD, this pack offers a dozen opportunities to enjoy the saccharine-scented strain tinged with the aroma of earth and woods, and warm flavours of vanilla, honey and fruit.

variants.title: Cannon PR 1 x 7 g
variants.body_html: Back by popular demand, Irony presents the Cannon. Our laughably large 1x7 g pre-roll is back for good. Packed with premium flower from carefully selected rotating strains, the Irony Cannon delivers a slow, steady burn with bold flavour. Built for sharing, showing off, or confidently keeping to yourself, the Cannon is ready for any occasion.

variants.title: Break Time - PR 1 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Over Time keeps it simple and affordable with this high value pre-roll. Smooth and approachable, it’s a popular choice for consumers looking for quality cannabis without stretching their budget.

variants.title: On the Clock - Sativa PR 10 x 0.35 g

variants.title: Radical Juice PALS PR 10 x 0.4 g
variants.body_html: Palmetto Radical Juice is an indica cultivar born from the Tropicanna Cookies x Rntz lineage, bringing together sweet, fruity, citrus and gas notes in one bold expression. Its aroma leans slightly off centre, exactly the kind of twist you’d expect from a Palmetto strain that doesn’t mind standing out. With top terpenes of caryophyllene, limonene and linalool, this flower carries a layered scent profile shaped by its well-known genetics. Radical Juice doesn’t overthink its vibe, it shows up bright, a little odd and unmistakably Palmetto.

variants.title: Apes in Space PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Apes in Space is presented in a 3 × 0.5g pre-roll format designed to preserve its full aromatic and flavour expression. The profile leads with classic skunky and earthy tones, supported by warm spice. As the burn develops, lighter notes of citrus and berry appear, followed by a subtle diesel finish that adds depth. Anchored by limonene and caryophyllene, the terpene profile delivers a layered and distinctive character. Rolled with care for a smooth, even burn, these pre-rolls offer consistency, convenience, and bold flavour without distraction.

variants.title: Peanut Butter Breath PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Lune Rise Farms Peanut Butter Breath pre-rolls are crafted with strain specific, single source sun-grown whole flower, hang dried and cured to preserve its unique cannabinoid and terpene profile. Tasting Notes: Enjoy sweet aromas of nutty gas with a touch of eucalyptol on the exhale. At Lune Rise Farms, we are committed to bringing the time-honoured traditions and practices of regenerative farming to the cultivation of cannabis. We truly believe that natural products are best looked after by the craftspeople of the earth, the farmers. We grow and harvest. We don’t manufacture.

variants.title: Gelato Punch PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Irony Gelato Punch pre-rolls are what happens when a pie shop and a jet engine share a smoke break. The parents are Punch Pie and Jet Fuel Gelato, so expect a creamy, berry, sweet and kind of gassy flavour in all the right ways. An indica dominant flower that offers high THC and offers top terpenes of myrcene, limonene and ocimene providing a unique experience. Tastes good, burns smooth. Classic Irony, honestly.

variants.title: Odourless OG PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Odourless Cannabis is the result of years of careful breeding and natural cultivation. Odourless OG is crafted to minimize the smell of cannabis while preserving its full potency and distinct flavour while offering discretion. A virtually scent-free experience without the strong cannabis aroma, perfect for those seeking discretion. Lacking the telltale odour typical of cannabis, the scent won’t linger in the air, stick to clothing or permeate your surroundings, making it a convenient and versatile choice for any setting. But discretion doesn’t mean compromise. Smooth, refined and with a clean burn, this cannabis retains its full potency, delivering a preserved terpenoid profile that adds depth to the experience. Whether you're looking for privacy or simply a more subtle option, Odourless Cannabis offers a new way to enjoy cannabis on your terms.

variants.title: Mandarin Dream PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Mandarin Dream is a hybrid strain (50% indica/50% sativa) created by crossing the classic Stormtrooper #12 x Mandarin Sunset strains. This bud has a sour citrus flavour with a lightly herbal creamy exhale. The aroma is earthy and fruity with a sour citrus overtone and hints of pungent diesel and fuel.

variants.title: Strawberry Cheezequake PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: No, you’re not suffering from a case of deja vu, you’re picking up the scent of our enigmatic Di-Fruitti, which we’ve revamped to Strawberry Cheezequake to better profile this strain. So let us officially reintroduce this strawberry soaked, yogurt dipped, cheesecake experience to you now. Welcome, Strawberry Cheezequake. The profile is high quality and smells and tastes exactly as it sounds.

variants.title: Blackberry Moonrocks PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: An indica dominant cross of Blue Moonrock and Blackberry Kush, Blackberry Moonrocks brings a loud flavour and a sticky sweet nose. After a 12-cut phenohunt, we locked in the one that thrives most in our hybrid greenhouses. With pinene, myrcene and linalool leading the way, you can expect smooth berry aroma, a hint of pine and a light floral finish. Blackberry Moonrocks is gassy, tasty and grown with care.

The buds are also known for their dark green and purple hues, which are a result of the strain's genetic lineage. This strain has a high myrcene content.

variants.title: Durban Poison PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: The spark that starts it all. Durban P is a sativa phenotype selected for its vibrant terpene profile and crystal coated buds. With terpinolene, myrcene and ocimene leading the way, expect sweet citrus on the nose, earthy spice through the middle and a crisp pine finish.

Earthy and grounded at first, the aroma opens into fresh pine and bright citrus, like a forest walk finished with a twist of lemon peel. Caryophyllene, myrcene, and limonene come together for a smooth experience. Strong roots, smooth presence, and a finish that lingers, reminding you why some classics never fade.

The buds are dense, crystallized spheres. It's an impressive large format product at an accessible price for consumers.

variants.title: Limited Flower
variants.body_html: Royal Harvest flower is the result of a lifetime spent listening to cannabis. For over 38 years, Royal Harvest has worked hands-on with this plant, long before legalization and long before cannabis became a commodity. Every cultivar is grown with respect, patience, and the understanding that true quality cannot be rushed, forced, or faked. The flower is cultivated to express its full potential, structure, resin, aroma, flavor, and effect. Each run is carefully dialed in through a cultivation program designed to bring out what makes that strain special, not what makes it faster or cheaper. They don't chase yields, they chase excellence. From rich, dessert-forward classics like Frosted Fruitcake, Red Velvet Runtz, and Korzie Kush, to rare and expressive genetics selected from a living library of hundreds of cultivars, Royal Harvest grows only what earns its place. Every strain is chosen for character, not trends. This flower is never mass-produced and never generic. While strains may rotate, the standard never does. Each harvest reflects decades of experience, constant refinement, and a deep belief that cannabis should elevate. Royal Harvest is craft cannabis in its purest form-grown with love, guided by legacy, and built to be experienced.

variants.title: Rooster Call PR 4 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Rooster Call pre-rolls bring you high THC sativa strains on rotation. The current strain and terpene profiles are right on the pack. Strong, easy on the wallet and grown under the sun. Quality you can count on.

variants.title: Grape Limeade Super Slim Electric Dartz PR 10 x 0.4 g
variants.body_html: Explore the fresh indulgence of Dab Bods Grape Limeade Super Slim Electric Dartz — a perfect fusion of juicy grape and zesty lime in a sleek, straight-style format. Each pack features ultra-slim pre-rolls, filled with premium indica-leaning dried flower for a smooth experience. Designed for convenience and discretion, these Electric Dartz offer a clean, even burn and a satisfying draw every time. The fruity, tangy profile makes each puff as enjoyable as the last, Grape Limeade delivers aroma-forward indulgence with Dab Bods’ signature quality. Electric Dartz blend premium flower and portability in one ready-to-enjoy package.

variants.title: Cherry Boat PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Cherry Boat, a sativa dominant strain bred from 11-week Pink Kush and Cherry Chem, delivers sweet fruit, chocolate and funk. Grown in living soil with high THC and rich terpenes by craft growers.

variants.title: Strawguava PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Strawguava is an evenly balanced hybrid strain (50% indica/50% sativa) created through crossing the delicious Strawnana x Papaya strains. Like its name implies, Strawguava packs a sweet and sugary strawberry berry flavour with hints of fresh guava, tropical citrus and a touch of spicy herbs. The aroma is very much the same, although it has a light tropical flowery sense to it as well that complements the rest perfectly. This bud has dense, diamond-shaped dark olive green buds with lots of thin, bright orange hairs and a coating of tiny, golden-white crystal trichomes.

variants.title: 35's Platinum Gas PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Authentic and accessible craft. Qwest started small and continues to abide by the same principles that inspired our Creston beginnings. Small batch. Hang dried. Genetics sourced and rotated to meet your curiosity. We bring a touch of the Pacific West Coast and a dedication to making the craft flower experience accessible to all Canadian enthusiasts.

variants.title: Crab Cakes PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: In Nova Scotia, snow crab caught off Cape Breton's coast is transformed into one of the region's most celebrated delicacies. Served in fine restaurants and essential to any maritime feast, crab cakes represent local culinary excellence. Skosha's Crab Cakes strain delivers a similarly refined experience. This potent sativa dominant hybrid crosses Snow Lotus with GSC, yielding high THC. The result captures the classic GSC with the newer strain's creamy profile while introducing bright fruit and berry notes, all wrapped in a distinctively pungent aroma. Crab Cakes presents a fascinating genetic surprise. Despite inheriting from two indica dominant parents (Snow Lotus and GSC), the plants exhibit classic sativa characteristics with tall, elongated branches. The buds are dense and trichome-coated, showcasing the strain's high quality. The leading terpenes include myrcene, limonene, caryophyllene and humulene.

variants.title: Cherry Chemtrail PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Cherry Chemtrail prepared by The Kitchen takes flavour to new altitudes with a sweet, funky twist and a floral finish that lingers like a well kept secret. A high-flying cross of Jet Fuel Gelato x Cherry Cheesecake, this hybrid levels out with bold aromatics and velvety undertones. Some say they don’t want you to taste this, but we did it anyway. Our products are hang-dried, hand-trimmed, hand-packed, and non-irradiated.

The result is a layered, full-throttle flavour that hits with potency and lingers long giving a true OG experience.

variants.body_html: Coastal Cuts are the new rotational offerings from the Victoria Cannabis Company. Each Cultivar is grown using Living Soil Synganics. No runs, no clogging… the days of packing cones is over. The releases will vary from in-house bred flower to traditional West Coast cuts that all highlight the unique and diverse offerings that Vancouver Island is famous for.

Every all-in-one is equipped with rechargeable USB-C technology, so they won't run out of juice before you do.

variants.title: Pink Goo Diamond Sauce Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: The Pink Goo Disposable vape pen is meticulously crafted. Infused with liquid diamonds, this disposable vape delivers high potency that's smooth and robust with every draw. The infusion of plant derived terpenes introduces a multi-layered flavour profile that harmonizes effortlessly with the naturally sweet and floral Pink Goo. A delicate herbal nuance enhances the earthy berry gas, creating a rich and complex flavour experience that's as refined as it is powerful. The impeccable combination of liquid diamonds and expertly curated terpenes ensures a vaping experience that's potent and flavourful.

variants.title: Blood Orange Sherb Liquid Diamond Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Unleash the next level of vaping with our Liquid Diamonds High-Potency Disposable Vape, custom-crafted for an ultra-smooth, intensely flavourful experience. Inspired by the bold sherb strain, and infused with blood orange, juicy peach, and hazy pine, this one-of-a-kind profile is designed exclusively for our Versus Liquid Diamonds extract. Experience next-level performance with exclusive dual coils that deliver bigger clouds — without sacrificing flavour. Paired with variable voltage control, you can toggle between flavourful draws and maximum vapour. This cutting-edge hardware puts you in the driver’s seat, letting you dial in your perfect hit every time.

variants.title: Tangerine Dream Live Resin Liquid Diamond Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: A sativa dominant hybrid strain (50% sativa/50% indica) created through crossing the classic G15, Afghan and A5 Haze. This vape is derived from live resin featuring diamonds derived from live resin (zero distillate), is true to strain and bursts with bold orange and tropical notes, delivering a smooth, juicy hit that feels bright. Built with next generation hardware, the device is postless, discreet and pocket-sized with full oil visibility through its innovative 360° design. A wide mouth opening ensures optimal airflow while the USB-C rechargeable battery keeps it going strong right down to the very last drop.

variants.title: Wedding Cake Pure Live Resin Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Box Carts deliver unmatched flavour, potency, and convenience. Expect rich flavour with creamy undertones — finished with a hint of natural sweetness.

variants.title: Bright Mind Sweet Citrus Liquid Diamond+CBG Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Jublee Bright Mind CBG all-in-one vape features a unique blend of our in house full spectrum hash oil, high potency THCA liquid diamonds and CBG isolate, delivering a smooth, citrus-forward draw. Housed in a biodegradable hemp shell with a recyclable glass tank. Thoughtfully made and designed to leave less behind.

variants.title: Pineapple Punch Live Diamonds Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: (GAS) Box Carts are rechargeable and discreet. Crystal-rich live diamonds provide bold flavour and high potency in every draw. Pineapple Punch features bright tropical pineapple and subtle sweet citrus notes. (GAS) Box Carts are pre-charged and easy to use. Just grip, rip and go.

variants.title: Pedro’s Sweet + Mango Haze Live Resin Dual Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Pedro’s Sweet Sativa + Mango Haze live resin delivers sweet berry, citrus, tropical fruit and spice in every draw on this dual chamber AIO vape. Crafted from single strain fresh frozen flower and extracted to preserve full spectrum cannabinoids and terpenes, this 2:1 THC:CBD device is USB-C rechargeable and lets you flip between strains or mix both for a custom flavour and potency experience. Pedro’s Sweet is a cross of a Dominican Sativa x White Russian x an unknown indica, bursting with sweet berry, citrus and spice with strong THC potential. Mango Haze is a 2:1 CBD:THC sativa and is a Northern Lights x Skunk x Haze cross known for its sweet, earthy and tropical mango aroma. The Pedro’s chamber is THC dominant, while the Mango Haze chamber is CBD forward, allowing for THC, CBD, or both in one device.

variants.title: THC Lime Drops
variants.body_html: MOD THC Lime Drops are a soluble THC tincture in a compact squeeze bottle designed for easy and precise dosing. Each drop contains 1 mg of THC, natural flavour and virtually no bitter cannabis extract taste. Formulated with MyCellⓇ delivery system technology for a more predictable and consistent experience.

variants.title: 2:1 THC:THCV Zoom Drops Space Fruit
variants.body_html: These fruity drops are crafted from high purity THC and THCV distillates, each bottle boasts 30 mg/g of THC + 15 mg/g of THCV + 10 mg/g CBD (totalling 852 mg of THC + 426 mg of THCV + 284 mg of CBD). Diluted in top shelf MCT for max potency and infused with a blend of botanical terpenes. With a small, metered syringe for precise dispensing, these drops provide a unique experience.

variants.title: Dream Drops
variants.body_html: Dream Drops by ufeelu feature a non-intoxicating blend of 600 mg of CBD, 300 mg of CBN and 300 mg of CBG in a sunflower oil base. Infused with ufeelu's signature DREAM blend of more than 30 terpenes featuring sweet berry notes with light floral and herbal undertones. Our drops are designed to be taken sublingually and contain broad spectrum oil extracted from Canadian grown hemp. ufeelu is an experienced and passionate cannabis collective based in Vancouver, BC, founded in 2018. We believe in using natural and simple ingredients to curate thoughtful non-intoxicating cannabis products designed with versatile usability in mind.

variants.title: THC:CBD 30:60 Full Cannabinoid Spectrum Oil
variants.body_html: Orchard THC:CBD 30:60 Full Cannabinoid Spectrum Oil is a combination of minor-cannabinoid-rich liquid diamonds and CBD sourced from BC hemp in a carrier of MCT oil. The liquid diamonds are high in THC and rich in a myriad of minor cannabinoids including CBC, CBG and CBN. The result is a 1:2 ratio of THC:CBD with approximately 30 mg of THC and 60 mg of CBD per 1 ml. A 0.3 ml syringe is provided. Start low and use the graduated 0.1 ml sections of the syringe to measure the appropriate dosage amount for your needs. Our oils are to be used for ingestion only, not intended for smoking. Orchard's CO2 extracts are efficiently extracted and carefully formulated on site at our 20,000 sq ft production facility on Vancouver Island, BC.

variants.title: LA Confidential NSFW Whipped Diamonds
variants.body_html: The Adults Only LA Confidential NSFW Whipped Diamonds blend rosin crafted diamonds with rich hash, whipped to aerate the crystals into a light and velvety consistency. This concentrate carries an all natural flavour profile drawn directly from the flower, with skunky and earthy depth from its Afghani x California indica lineage and no added terpenes.

variants.title: Frenchy Macaroni
variants.body_html: With its unique blend of earthy undertones and a touch of sweet, creamy richness, this strain is perfect for those looking to add a little extra flair to their cannabis experience. As the name suggests, Frenchy Macaroni offers a charming, delightful experience. The aromatic profile is a blend of herbaceous earthiness and a subtle sweetness, making it a great choice for any occasion where you want to indulge in something special.

variants.title: Devil Fruit Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Smoke the forbidden fruit. Max's Devil Fruit AIO fuses ultra-potent THC extract (78-80%) with a sweet fruity punch. Housed in Max's exclusive stainless-steel shell, this 1.25g AIO is built for MAX performance. With a cottonless, stemless ceramic atomizer and PrecisionFlow Clogless Technology, each hit delivers dense clog-free vapour and full-throttle Devil Fruit flavour.

variants.title: BLK Caviar PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: A BLKMKT exclusive. Bred in-house, BLK Caviar is a standout from anything else in our line. Nicknamed "Thanksgiving Dinner" with a nose reminiscent of turkey and gravy. Our pre-rolls are always made with small batch whole flower that is hang dried, hand trimmed and handcrafted into raw organic cones. Housed in our custom black glass jar with our own custom designed Integra Boost Stick. Always our genetics. Always grown in-house and never sourced.
