variants.title: Reptilian Reserve
variants.body_html: Conspiracy Reptilian Reserve brings quality cannabis with this strain specific bag of dried flower. Expertly grown and crafted for consistency, it delivers bright flavour, potency and value. Conspiracy makes quality cannabis.

variants.title: Ultra Sour
variants.body_html: The classic Ultra Sour cultivar. This flower features the tartness of Meyer lemon with the diesel and pungent notes from the cultivar's Kush undertones. A sativa-leaning sour with outcroppings of orange pistils from deep green, crystal-rich buds.

variants.title: White Chocolate PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: White Chocolate is a highly potent sativa-dominant cultivar, created by crossing Chocolope x White Moonshine. On the palate, White Chocolate offers a wide range of flavours, including earth, spice, melon, and cherry, easing into a rich chocolate finish. Each pre-roll delivers a robust flavour and aroma, providing a unique and pleasing smoke for discerning connoisseurs.

variants.title: Radical Juice
variants.body_html: Radical Juice is an indica cultivar born from the Tropicanna Cookies x Rntz lineage, bringing together sweet, fruity, citrus and gas notes in one bold expression. Its aroma leans playful and slightly off-centre — exactly the kind of twist you’d expect from a Palmetto strain that doesn’t mind standing out. With terpenes of caryophyllene, limonene and linalool, this flower carries a layered scent profile shaped by its well-known genetics. Radical Juice doesn’t overthink its vibe; it shows up bright, a little odd, and unmistakably Palmetto.

variants.title: The Titan Variety Pack PR 20 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: 1Spliff’s Titan Variety Pack includes pre-rolls that feature popular strains from 1Spliff. Perfect for exploring flavours, aromas and craft quality hits.

variants.title: Sour Kush Milled
variants.body_html: Already milled and ready to roll, or vape or pack a bowl. Divvy’s hybrid flower is available in bulk bags containing gently ground from whole flower.

variants.title: Gastro Pop
variants.body_html: EastCann Gastro Pop is a high-THC, indica-dominant hybrid of Apples & Banana x Grape Gasoline. Delivering a super sweet berry grape flavour, with hints of sour citrus and fresh tree fruits. The buds are dense with beautiful frosty trichomes.

variants.title: Payday Pack
variants.body_html: Overtime Payday Pack delivers strain specific quality built for real value. This format offers consistent potency, solid bud structure and reliable flavour.

variants.title: AK 47
variants.body_html: Old school, still overpowered. All Kush 47 brings craft flower with a skunky, gassy nose and spicy finish that hits like a throwback loadout. Clean trim, bold flavour, and high-impact sessions every time. No frills, just firepower.

variants.title: Crash Glow Craft
variants.body_html: Crash Glow mixes the sweet fruit of Dayglow and creamy spice from the Grape Pie × Wedding Crashers F2 cross, for a tangy sweetness with a hit of gas. Authentic and accessible craft. Qwest started small and continues to abide by the same principles that inspired our Creston beginnings. Small batch. Hang dried. Genetics sourced and rotated to meet your curiosity. We bring a touch of the Pacific West Coast and a dedication to making the craft flower experience accessible to all Canadian enthusiasts.

variants.title: Raspberry Runtz
variants.body_html: Raspberry Rntz joins the Potluck Fruit Collection with a bold berry flavour and a bright pop of citrus zest. These indica-dominant buds have a purple and green hue with a pungent, ripe, gassy aroma. Raspberry Rntz is a juicy jam full of flavour and ready-to-roll into your stash.

variants.title: Liberty Haze 28
variants.body_html: Our Pepe Everyday line offers top quality with best-in-class value. Liberty Haze is a classic sativa. Expect delicious flavours of hazy citrus and sweet diesel. This strain has a powerful bouquet of sweet lime with notes of herbaceous spice and pungent lemon.

variants.title: Pink Kush Mints
variants.body_html: Big Bag o' Buds proudly presents Pink Kush Mints, an indica dominant fusion of Pink Cookies and Kush Mints with big Kush, herbal and cream aromas. Boasting high THC with a humidity pack in the bag to keep your Pink Kush Mints fresh.

variants.title: Durban Poison
variants.body_html: Our Pepe Everyday line offers top quality with best-in-class value. Durban P is a classic landrace strain. Expect delicious flavours of minty musk and herbaceous spice. This is classic cannabis at its finest.

variants.title: Halli Berri
variants.body_html: An Ice Cream Cake x Blockberry, creation. The aroma can be described as bright candy citrus, with creamy vanilla notes.

variants.title: Bubblegum
variants.body_html: Bubblegum is a potent indica with high THC, delivering rich and nostalgic bubblegum flavour with hints of berry and candy. This classic strain offers a smooth and flavourful smoke. With a terpene profile led by myrcene, limonene and caryophyllene, Bubblegum blends sweetness with subtle spice.

variants.title: Grape Ape
variants.body_html: Grape Ape joins the Potluck Fruit Collection with bold grape candy flavour and sweet berry notes. These indica-dominant buds have a deep purple hue with a loud, fruity aroma that jumps out of the bag. Grape Ape is a juicy throwback, sweet, sticky, and packed with flavour, like a fruit market.

variants.title: Sasquatch Sap
variants.body_html: Sasquatch Sap is a sativa cultivar with a personality all its own, with Chem’s Sister x Chocolate Diesel lineage. Its diesel, berry and floral aromas give it a distinctive profile that feels both familiar and a little wild around the edges. With terpenes like caryophyllene, limonene and myrcene, this flower leans into bold, expressive scents shaped by its genetics. The buds are sturdy, textured and unapologetically character-forward — exactly the kind of plant you’d expect from a strain named after a hairy mythical wanderer.

variants.title: Crown Jewels - Desi Gold
variants.body_html: Crown Jewels: Desi Gold showcases select cultivars originating from India’s Desi region, an area recognized for its long-standing cannabis heritage. These strains are known for their naturally sweet and fruity flavour profiles, offering a smooth and approachable expression shaped by origin and tradition. The experience emphasizes clarity and purity, allowing the character of the genetics to come through without distraction. Carefully cultivated and thoughtfully cured, this 3.5g dried flower offering reflects a commitment to quality, integrity, and respect for regional influence.

variants.title: Punch Out
variants.body_html: Over Time keeps it fresh with a bag of rotating indica dried flower. Always high value and consistently smooth, each drop brings something new for consumers who want quality cannabis at a fair price, time after time.

variants.title: Northern Nights
variants.body_html: Northern Nights is a modern tribute to the legendary Northern Lights. This cultivar blends Fire OG x G13 as part of the parental lineage for an indica experience. Its earthy, woody, and subtly sweet aroma evokes the northern sky.

variants.title: Lemon Razz
variants.body_html: Lemon Razz by LowKey is a sativa cross of Meat Breath x Macmosa with terpinolene, myrcene, ocimene, limonene and pinene. A flavour burst of lemon and lime with a smooth creamy raspberry on the exhale.

variants.title: The Grind
variants.body_html: The Grind is finely milled flower designed for easy packing and consistent rolls without the extra effort. Packed in a convenient format, it’s a reliable and versatile option for consumers looking for an affordable, ready-to-use flower that keeps things moving—on your schedule, not the clock.

variants.title: Punch Out
variants.body_html: Over Time keeps it fresh with a bag of rotating indica dried flower. Always high value and consistently smooth, each drop brings something new for consumers who want quality cannabis at a fair price, time after time.

variants.title: Southern Sugar Smalls
variants.body_html: Southern Sugar, bred from Georgia Pie × Rainbow Chip, expresses a clean, modern hybrid profile with a distinctly dessert-driven identity. Fluffy, diamond-shaped buds are finished with a dense frosting of trichomes that give the flower a true sugar-dusted look. The aromatic profile leans bright with fresh fruit sweetness, followed by cool mint and an under-layer of light diesel. Southern Sugar presents as a polished cut, evoking the soft sweetness and warmth of Southern sugar cane fields.

variants.title: Purple Gas Milled Ready-to-Roll
variants.body_html: Purple gas is a legacy cultivar that was originally bred by crossing Pre-98 Bubba with Sour Diesel. It offers pungent earthy and diesel flavours with hints of citrus and pine. It has vibrant shades of purple with beautiful orange hairs and sparkling trichomes. Our milled, ready-to-roll products are made with nothing but trimmed whole flower for a consistent experience every time.

variants.title: Royal Dive #5: Purple Zombie
variants.body_html: Purple Zombie greets the senses with an intricate tapestry of flavours. The enchanting sweetness of Sweet Zombie mingles effortlessly with the deep, earthy notes of Purple Kush, creating a rich, complex taste that is both soothing and invigorating. As the experience unfolds, the influence of RNTZ adds a layer of fruity and floral undertones, infusing each puff with a delightful burst of flavour. The smoke is smooth and aromatic, with hints of berry and grape that linger pleasantly on the palate.

variants.title: Candy Apple
variants.body_html: Candy Apple is a sweet and fruity sativa with high THC. This vibrant strain is packed with crisp apple flavour, creamy vanilla undertones and a sugary finish that lives up to its name. It's crafted from a unique lineage of Blueberry, Pineapple and Afghan. With dominant terpenes such as limonene, pinene and ocimene, Candy Apple offers bold flavour.

variants.title: Lindsay OG
variants.body_html: Lindsay OG showcases its BC breeding and Ontario lineage through dense trichome-rich buds and an unmistakable skunky aroma layered with pine, citrus and earth.

variants.title: Blackberry Moonrocks
variants.body_html: Nothing hits like a moonrock. An indica-dominant cross of Blue Moonrock and Blackberry Kush, Blackberry Moonrocks brings a loud flavour and a sticky-sweet nose. After a 12-cut pheno hunt, we locked in the one that thrives most in our hybrid greenhouses. With pinene, myrcene, and linalool leading the way you can expect smooth berry aroma, a hint of pine, and a light floral finish. Gassy, tasty, and grown with care, Blackberry Moonrocks is a fruity hit from outer space.

variants.title: Blueberry Muffinz
variants.body_html: Forget the headaches of missing the oven timer and tossing the burnt ones in the trash, Blueberry Muffinz loves all the heat. Packed full of flavour and aromas that will have you thinking you just got teleported to the bake sale, this aroma is something special. If this strain feels familiar that’s because it was once called Skullcap. Now revamped to Blueberry Muffinz to better highlight the aromas, these super dense bright green buds are caked in frosty trichomes and reek of a funky blueberry fruitiness that's hard to pin down in one whiff. Multiple attempts may be required. Prepare for a no nonsense smoke with a smooth burn and a tonne of flavour. This strain is a chef's kiss.

variants.title: Ripped Sativa
variants.body_html: Get RIPPED Sativa. Packed with bold sativa-dominant whole flower. This pouch hits with high THC levels. No nonsense — just straight-up quality at floor pricing.

variants.title: Platinum Lemon Cherry Gelato
variants.body_html: Platinum Lemon Cherry Gelato by VOLO is an exclusive breeder’s cut selected by the geneticist himself, Capulator. Its aroma opens with zesty lemon peel, cherry candy and vanilla cream over faint pine and spice. On the palate, expect bright citrus snap, ripe cherry sweetness and a silky gelato-like creaminess, finishing with a subtle gassy edge. The bag appeal is standout with dense, hand trimmed flowers showing lime to deep violet hues under a heavy platinum frost of trichomes, accented by vivid orange pistils and a sticky, resinous feel. Our small batch flower undergoes a meticulous process, including hang drying, precision hand trimming, slow cold curing and hand packaging. Dive into this rich blend of potent genetics and sophisticated flavours.

variants.title: Panama Gold
variants.body_html: Panama Gold is a vintage strain that stands the test of time. This hybrid strain has an earthy and woody aroma that is layered with subtle hints of citrus and spice, creating a smooth smoke.

variants.title: Perma Fried
variants.body_html: A Seed Junky cross of Hawaiian Rain x Permanent Marker, which results in large heavily frosted dark green flowers. The aroma is tropical, gassy and fruity with a peppery petrol kick. The flavour is similar with a spicy fruit filled smoke. Terpenes include limonene, linalool and beta-caryophyllene.

variants.title: Guzzlers Milled Ready-to-Roll
variants.body_html: Guzzlers is a popular indica dominant strain known for its strong aroma of gas and funk. It offers high levels of THC and frosted purple buds finished with a proper dry and curing process. Our milled, ready-to-roll products are made with nothing but trimmed whole flower for a consistent experience every time.

variants.title: Bollywood
variants.body_html: Bollywood brings a fusion of Rntz and Lemon Cherry Gelato. Striking purple buds covered in sparkling trichomes deliver a sweet earthy flavour with bold notes of lemon and diesel.

variants.title: The Grind
variants.body_html: The Grind is finely milled flower designed for easy packing and consistent rolls without the extra effort. Packed in a convenient format, it’s a reliable and versatile option for consumers looking for an affordable, ready-to-use flower that keeps things moving—on your schedule, not the clock.

variants.title: Apes in Space
variants.body_html: Apes in Space is a high-quality dried flower selected for its depth, character, and unmistakable aroma. The profile opens with classic skunky and earthy notes, followed by warm spice that creates a grounded first impression. As the experience develops, lighter undertones of citrus and berry emerge, rounded out by a subtle diesel finish that adds complexity. Driven by limonene and caryophyllene, the terpene profile delivers a layered and expressive flavour. Carefully cultivated and cured, this 3.5g offering highlights the full character of the cultivar through clean, honest presentation

variants.title: Radical Juice
variants.body_html: Radical Juice is an indica cultivar born from the Tropicanna Cookies x Rntz lineage, bringing together sweet, fruity, citrus and gas notes in one bold expression. Its aroma leans playful and slightly off-centre — exactly the kind of twist you’d expect from a Palmetto strain that doesn’t mind standing out. With terpenes of caryophyllene, limonene and linalool, this flower carries a layered scent profile shaped by its well-known genetics. Radical Juice doesn’t overthink its vibe; it shows up bright, a little odd, and unmistakably Palmetto.

variants.title: AAAA Kush
variants.body_html: AAAA Kush boasts dense, resin soaked buds with slightly purple hues and fiery pistils beneath a thick trichome layer. Its aroma is of savoury Kush devlivers gas heavy flavours on every inhale. Cultivated with precision, hand trimmed with care and terpene-rich genetics, AAAA Kush is smooth and potent. Lineage: $10K Purple Kush X Original G13.

variants.title: Cherry Bang Bang
variants.body_html: Cherry Bang Bang is a high THC hybrid with bold tropical notes of pineapple, cherry and gas. Grown in small batches, hang dried, hand trimmed and slow cured to perfection.

variants.title: Kush Mintz
variants.body_html: Kush Mintz is a carefully cultivated hybrid combining equal parts indica and sativa for a balanced and versatile expression. The flavour profile opens with refreshing mint notes, followed by soft, cookie-like sweetness that lingers on the palate. Smooth and approachable, this cultivar is well suited for those who value flavour clarity and refinement. Thoughtfully selected and cured, this 3.5g dried flower offering reflects a commitment to consistency, quality, and honest presentation.

variants.title: Skunkadelic
variants.body_html: Skunkadelic is a throwback to the golden era of cannabis. It's loud, funky and unapologetically skunky. With high THC, this classic delivers nostalgic potency.

variants.title: Royal Dive #7: Scarface OG
variants.body_html: Scarface OG is an enigmatic OG style cultivar with no publicly documented lineage, adding to its cult classic mystique. What it lacks in genetic paperwork, it more than compensates for in presence and potency. This strain produces dense, trichome laden flowers with a bold aromatic profile dominated by diesel fuel, earthy pine and subtle citrus undertones.

variants.title: Crumble Kush
variants.body_html: Crumble Kush is your go-to for milled flower with a rotating selection of strains. Just check the label to see what’s inside. Each batch is carefully picked and milled to perfection while still being able to preserve moisture, texture and terpene content. Stop wasting time grinding and start spending time smoking. Different strains, always fresh, never boring.

variants.title: Sacré Bleu
variants.body_html: Sacré Bleu, this one's a flavour bomb. A bold cross between Blue Dreams and Sour Orange Pucker, Sacré Bleu hits with sweet berries, sharp citrus and a hint of earthy gas. On the inhale, it's all sweet and fruity, but don't blink because the sour punch kicks in hard on the exhale. Packed with myrcene, caryophyllene and selinadiene. Loud terpenes and complex flavour.

variants.title: Stinky Pinky
variants.body_html: Stinky Pinky is our take on the classic Pink Kush from 1964 — a potent pheno descended from the legendary OG Kush. Drenched in sugary trichomes and reeking of sweet, kushy gas, this strain delivers that highly potent West Coast flavour we can't get enough of.

variants.title: The Mosh Pit
variants.body_html: The Mosh Pit by 3Saints is a rotational milled product that provides a new flavour experience in each new lot. Expertly blended to create something new each time.

variants.title: Gorilla Ghost
variants.body_html: Gorilla Ghost moves quietly but leaves a lasting impression. Born from the iconic cross of Ghost OG x GG #4, Gorilla Ghost delivers old school power with a refined, terpene forward personality. Earthy and grounded at first, the aroma opens into fresh pine and bright citrus, like a forest walk finished with a twist of lemon peel. Caryophyllene, myrcene, and limonene come together for a smooth, grounded experience with just enough lift. Strong roots, smooth presence, and a finish that lingers, reminding you why some classics never fade.

variants.title: Silver Diesel
variants.body_html: Silver Diesel is an OG's dream. Her lineage is renowned, bred by crossing Lamb's Bread with a classic and iconic Sour Diesel results in harvests of sativa-dominant chunky buds and high THC. This is seriously one dank diesel.

variants.title: Durban Poison
variants.body_html: The spark that starts it all. Durban P is a sativa phenotype selected for its vibrant terpene profile and crystal coated buds. With terpinolene, myrcene and ocimene leading the way, expect sweet citrus on the nose, earthy spice through the middle and a crisp pine finish.

variants.title: Candyland
variants.body_html: Candyland is a bright sativa that crosses the legendary Granddaddy Purple and Bay Platinum Cookies. Its dense olive green buds boast a sparkling layer of sugar-like trichomes, accented by vibrant golden orange hairs. The aroma is rich with prominent notes of sweet grape, berry, lemon and classic skunk-y undertones.

variants.title: Silver Diesel
variants.body_html: Silver Diesel is an OG's dream. Her lineage is renowned, bred by crossing Lamb's Bread with a classic and iconic Sour Diesel results in harvests of sativa-dominant chunky buds and high THC. This is seriously one dank diesel.

variants.title: Gasserole
variants.body_html: Gasserole is served hot straight from the BC 1/4 kitchen. This sativa dominant offering stirs together Last Supper and Gas Guzzler into a wild medley of spice, ripe fruit and high octane fuel that fills the room before you even lean in. Its sticky, golden buds are glazed with resin. Cheeky and never subtle, Gasserole is made for those who like their smoke flaming and full bodied.

variants.title: Platinum Gas Craft
variants.body_html: Platinum Gas combines the resin-rich qualities and earthy Kush notes of Platinum Kush with the pungent petrol and skunky aroma of Gas Mask. A Platinum Kush and Gas Mask cross with a sweet earthy profile. Authentic and accessible craft. Qwest started small and continues to abide by the same principles that inspired our Creston beginnings. Small batch and hang dried. Genetics sourced and rotated to meet your curiosity. We bring a touch of the Pacific West Coast and a dedication to making the craft flower experience accessible to all Canadians.

variants.title: Clock In
variants.body_html: Over Time Clock In delivers dependable quality at a fair price with rotating batches of sativa dried flower. Each release offers something new to explore while maintaining consistent standards for value-driven consumers who appreciate both variety and reliability. Designed to balance affordability with quality, Clock In keeps things simple and consistent.

variants.title: Gas n' Up
variants.body_html: Gas n’ Up is an indica dominant strain of Venom OG x Humboldt OG. The bud is a smoky emerald with hints of sage green and speckled with rusty red hairs, topped with a heavy dusting of trichome crystals. This distinct flavour is marked by a complex blend of spicy diesel, black pepper and earthy woodiness.

variants.title: Golden Hour
variants.body_html: Golden Hour (GMO x Mint Choco Chip). Open structure with good internodal spacing and medium green buds that develop rich orange pistils and a subtle trichome shine. Diesel, pine, and spice with dense buds showing warm golden hues and natural colour contrast. 28%+ THC, always grown and groomed in-house. Warm, hazy, and slow-setting. The one you reach for as the light fades and everything softens.

variants.title: Clock In
variants.body_html: Over Time Clock In delivers dependable quality at a fair price with rotating batches of sativa dried flower. Each release offers something new to explore while maintaining consistent standards for value-driven consumers who appreciate both variety and reliability. Designed to balance affordability with quality, Clock In keeps things simple and consistent.

variants.title: Grapey Grape
variants.body_html: Grapey Grape brings those candy-like notes with a full-grown twist of sweet, nostalgic concord grape and a tart finish to keep you coming back for more. G.A. Milled Flower is made from whole flower and boosted with botanical terpenes to deliver ultra-smooth hits with BIG, BOLD flavour at a price that won’t break the bank!

variants.title: Johnny Cage
variants.body_html: Johnny Cage by FLHIGH doesn’t tiptoe into the spotlight — it kicks the door open. This dried flower release brings bold flavour, potent effects, and a whole lot of attitude. Featuring a rotating strain lineup, every drop delivers something fresh while staying true to what FLHIGH does best: quality, potent cannabis. Whether you’re rolling up solo or sharing with friends, Johnny Cage is built for those who want reliable potency, smooth smoke, and standout personality in every jar. The rotating strain format keeps things interesting, giving you a new experience each time while maintaining the same FLHIGH standard you can count on. Loud, confident, and always ready for action — Johnny Cage doesn’t wait in the wings, it takes centre stage.

variants.title: Chatty Kathy
variants.body_html: Chatty Kathy (Chatterbox x SinMintz). Tall and leggy growth with smaller, dense buds and strong structural resilience. Diesel, mint and spice with compact buds and bold orange pistils. High THC, always grown and groomed in house. Lighter and great when you’ve got a lot to say.

variants.title: Kadillac Rainbow
variants.body_html: Kadillac Rainbow prepared by The Kitchen is smooth. Open the door to a rich bouquet of ripe berries, creamy gas and a hint of spice. This cross of Pure Michigan and Rntz shines with a kaleidoscope of colours and bold personality. Grown in the foothills of the Monashee Mountains in the beautiful Okanagan, it delivers layered flavours from spark to finish. Our products are hang dried, hand trimmed, hand packed and non-irradiated.

variants.title: Frosted Rootbeer
variants.body_html: Boasting one of the most delicious aromas to ever bubble out of a Big Bag, Frosted Rootbeer provides a unique experience for flower lovers. The flower's high potency is perfectly paired with sweet vanilla, spice and fruit to deliver a sativa leaning experience with bite.

variants.title: Gastro Pop
variants.body_html: EastCann Gastro Pop is a high-THC, indica-dominant hybrid of Apples & Banana x Grape Gasoline. Delivering a super sweet berry grape flavour, with hints of sour citrus and fresh tree fruits. The buds are dense with beautiful frosty trichomes.

variants.title: The R&D Series
variants.body_html: Introducing the R&D Series, a rotating dried flower drop featuring limited batch cultivars straight out of Bud Lafleur’s research and development lab. Every release is a test. If it's great, it stays. If not, back to the lab. Small batch, rotating genetics, high potency and dialled in terpene profiles that are hand selected by our cultivation team. They come straight from our R&D program, where the future of flower is born.

variants.title: Part Time
variants.body_html: OMY! Part-Time is your go-to middle gear. A rotational hybrid that changes cultivars but never changes the mission: reliable balance, clean taste, and a comfortable ride.

variants.title: The Collective PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: The collective brings the best Northern Canna offers in a rotational 4-strain multi-pack.

variants.title: Cherry Blast
variants.body_html: Cheers' Cherry Blast is a cross between Black Cherry Punch and Orange Cookies. This sativa dominant hybrid delivers an explosion of fruity, sweet and spicy notes, reminiscent of ripe cherries dipped in citrus with a whisper of mild pepper.

variants.title: CoCo Thunder
variants.body_html: Spinning with a storm of flavour and nostalgia, CoCo Thunder is the new indica dominant cultivar from BC 1/2 OZ, bringing together the legendary Chocolope and Alaskan Thunder F. The pairing strikes with sweet cocoa, roasted coffee and an earthy finish. The buds are thick and gleaming, as if they have weathered a lightning storm of terpenes.

variants.title: Sin N' Juice
variants.body_html: Picture that perfect pour of sunshine with a mischievous twist. This is Sin N’ Juice, a sativa dominant cut from BC 1/2 OZ that blends Sin City Juice and Orange Julius into a bright and tangy fusion of sweet fruit and orange candy notes. With quality bud structure, it shines with that unmistakable West Coast confidence, filling the air with tropical sweetness the moment you open the bag.

variants.title: Ripped Bubba Smalls
variants.body_html: Ripped Bubba is an indica dominant strain merging the genetics of Pre-98 Bubba Kush and Jack the Ripper. The buds are dense with lime and dark green hues highlighted by amber pistils and a thick coating of frosty trichomes. The aroma is a complex blend of passionfruit, sweetness, spice and skunk, which carries through into the flavour. This offering stands out for its distinctive combination of aroma, flavour and visual appeal.

variants.title: America's Most Wanted
variants.body_html: America’s Most Wanted carries that outcast energy, the kind that heats up wherever it lands. This indica dominant release under BC 1/4 blends the notorious Black Biscotti and Permanent Marker to create a mix of sweet dough, dark fruit and diesel layered with a lingering funk. The buds glisten like a trophy from the underground, dense and rich with that unmistakable BC legacy mark. Potent and flavourful, America’s Most Wanted is the kind of flower that always ends up on your list again.

variants.title: Sugar Factory PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Sugar Factory was pheno hunted in-house by our team. Bred by Cedar Creek Genetics from the cross of (Zoap x Zangria) x Sweet Retreat, this standout indica hybrid delivers a vibrant flavour profile blending juicy guava, crisp candy apple, and soft floral sweetness. Because it’s the right thing to do, all our pre-rolls are made exclusively from whole flower, rolled in small batches into slim cones, and hand-packaged in our signature tin.

variants.title: The Heavy PR 1 x 2 g
variants.body_html: Introducing The Heavy. This 15mm ceramic shell contains BLKMKT Genetics. Indoor grown whole flower that's handcrafted in BC and bred by us. Engineered for precision it's all ceramic with precisely designed intake holes and a tapered mouthpiece allowing for optimal airflow with ultra thin rice paper that ensures a slow and smooth burn.

variants.title: Britscotti Glass Cannon BLNT PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Introducing the Britscotti Glass Cannon BLNT, a pre-roll of a truly unique cultivar. Straight sweetness, cream cheese and vanilla, this cross of Gelato #25 x GSC x South Florida OG is a smooth and potent indica with notes of sweet butter and hints of lemon. This is our first straight-cut BLNT cannon, crafted with a glass tip and made from quality hemp designed to a precise thickness to ensure a slow burn while retaining full flavour from our indoor grown, handcrafted small batch flower.

variants.title: Kryptochronic
variants.body_html:
Our signature indica-dominant powerhouse, Kryptochronic is bred from Fruity Pebbles OG × Alien Cookies × Jet Fuel Gelato, delivering the heavy, couch-lock experience everyone keeps coming back for. 

Expect classic OG gas and kush aromas complemented by sweet fruit and citrus undertones. After years of refining this cultivar and continuously improving our cultivation practices, the Kief team has produced our best batch yet.

variants.title: Purple Rain PR 5 x 0.35g
variants.body_html: Purple Rain, our latest elite craft offering is now available in a convenient, large format. Grab a pack and you will be hit with an irresistible aroma that smells like a jar of citrus and mixed berries with dank, gassy undertones. With love from Scarborough

variants.title: Gasolina
variants.body_html: Born from Blueberry Diesel x Thai Haze, Gasolina is an indica leaning strain with big fruity flavours and that classic gassy punch. You’ll get a smooth berry and diesel taste, a smooth smoke and that classic indica experience. Grown in BC, our bud is hand trimmed, hang dried, hand packed and perfectly cured to bring out its full flavour and character.

variants.title: Neon Cowgirl
variants.body_html: Saddle up—Neon Cowgirl has just ridden into town. Proudly offered under the BC Smalls banner, this sativa-dominant beauty marks its inaugural homegrown rodeo. This 3.5g bag holds the offspring of two showstoppers: the sweet southern charm of Strawberry Cough encounters the smoky grit of Peanut Butter Breath. Together, they’re charged with aromas of dark berries, lemon, vanilla, and deep woods. Neon Cowgirl ain’t here to blend in—she’s here to blaze her own trail.

variants.title: Quickies GMO Jet Fuel PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: GMO Jet Fuel cylindrical pre-rolls are a unique blend of citrus, garlic, pepper and funk. A sativa-leaning strain for those who want to amp up their everyday experience. Now in a 10x0.35g Quickie format.

variants.title: Yocan UNI Pro-Digital Box Mod-Yellow
variants.body_html:
The Yocan UNI Pro takes cartridge vaping to the next level with a fully customizable experience that fits virtually any 510-threaded oil cartridge. Featuring precise voltage control, an adjustable cartridge chamber, and a crisp OLED display, this box mod gives you full control over your sessions—whether you're chasing flavour, clouds, or both.

Designed with versatility and performance in mind, the UNI Pro is the perfect upgrade for vapers who want more from their portable setup.

Key Features & Benefits:

Universal 510 Compatibility – Adjustable height and diameter settings accommodate most oil cartridges

Precise Voltage Control (2.0V–4.2V) – Fine-tune your experience to match your preferred potency and flavour

OLED Display – Clear, real-time feedback on voltage, battery level, and session duration

Built-in Battery (650mAh) – Rechargeable power that keeps up with your day

Compact & Ergonomic Design – Comfortable to hold, easy to carry, and discreet in any setting

Magnetic Cartridge Adapter – Snap-in connection makes swapping cartridges quick and hassle-free

Preheat Function – Warms up thicker oils for consistent hits every time

With its sleek design and customizable performance, the Yocan UNI Pro is built for users who want convenience without compromise. It’s everything you need in a portable cartridge vaporizer—refined, reliable, and ready when you are.

variants.title: Root Beer Float
variants.body_html: Root Beer Float is a rare indica dominant strain created through crossing XXX OG and Vanilla Kush. Enter into a sweet hazy, earthy bliss with hints of lemon and pine aroma with this 7g bag of craft cannabis. Enjoy the classic Root Beer flavour combined with frothy vanilla notes. BOLD Craft Cannabis is indoor grown, small batch, hang dried, slow cured and hand trimmed.

variants.title: Cosmic Cookies
variants.body_html: Cosmic Cookies by Truro Cannabis is a high THC sativa leaning cultivar with bright citrus flavour and delicate floral notes. Grown indoors in Truro, Nova Scotia, this cultivar is known for its bold aroma, high potency and vibrant terpene profile. Each batch is hang dried, hand trimmed and slow cured to preserve flavour and deliver a smooth smoke. Carefully grown in small batches, Cosmic Cookies highlights the craft quality and terpene-rich experience Truro Cannabis is known for.

variants.title: Micro Milled Indica
variants.body_html: Micro Milled Indica delivers boutique BC-grown, micro-cultivated flower as a rotating curated blend of genetics in a pre-milled, ready-to-roll format. Curated from BC micro-cultivated Indica genetics and expertly milled in small batches, it preserves terpene richness and potency while eliminating the need for grinding. This craft-quality flower maintains the character and complexity of whole buds in a convenient, ready-to-roll format.

variants.title: Ultra Bubbles
variants.body_html: Ultra Bubbles by Trailblazer — a gas-forward, citrusy, sativa-dominant cross of Midnight M'mosa and Ultra Sour #20, an OG Organigram genetic bred in-house. These pungent and dense buds offer loud gas aromas, loaded with bright orange pistols and frosted in trichomes. Ultra Bubbles is grown in an indoor micro-climate environment in small batches and is always smart-cured, hang-dried, and hand-trimmed. Uncover the extraordinary with Trailblazer.

variants.title: AK Pie PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: AK Pie is a sativa-dominant strain of the famous AK47 and Cherry Pie. It has a unique sour fruit and gas profile with notes of sour raspberry, guava and diesel. The flower is grown indoors at a purpose built in-door facility on Vancouver Island in organic living soil. Full plant hang-dried for two weeks, hand trimmed and cured for a minimum of two more weeks in Terp Lock bags.

variants.title: Jokerz Blunt PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: JOKERZ is an indica-dominant cultivar born from the sought-after cross of White Runtz and Jet Fuel Gelato. Its terpene profile leans rich and expressive with sweet, candy-like notes up front, unfolding into layers of creamy gelato, pungent gas, and subtle earthy complexity. The flower is expertly milled and packed in artisanal cones, handcrafted with the finest papers from France and Spain, and sealed with Arabic gum from the Acacia tree.

variants.title: DHC Mystery Box - High House Party
variants.body_html:
The Ultimate Smoking Box!

Daily High Club is the premier creator of smoking gear boxes, delivering limited edition themed boxes every month. Carefully crafted in California, featuring custom artwork and exclusive designs making them perfect for collectors and smoking connoisseurs.

Collect them all! Every box colour = a unique theme!

What’s Inside Your Box?

•Custom out-of-this-world bong designs inspired by pop culture

•The coolest smoking accessories including hand pipes, grinders, stickers & more

•Smoking essentials from top brands like Raw, Zig Zag, Clipper & more

variants.title: Banjo
variants.body_html: This edition of Banjo was bred by Parker Sullivan and grown by STACKS 306 at their facility in Lloydminster, SK using hydroponics. This sativa-dominant cultivar is rich in terpenes, with notes of blueberries and kush. The plant’s classic, green buds are hand trimmed, cured for a minimum of three weeks, and never irradiated. Available for a limited-time-only.

variants.title: Giddy Up Sativa PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Giddy Up Sativa Pre-Rolls feature a rotating curated blend of genetics from premium BC micro-cultivated sativa flower, produced in small batches for exceptional quality. Each pack includes five Dutch-finished half-gram pre-rolls, carefully prepared to deliver a smooth, consistent burn. These craft pre-rolls highlight standout sativa genetics known for their bright terpene profiles and distinctive character.

variants.title: Bubble Burst Liquid Diamond+Cured Resin Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Meet Bubble Burst, the pre-charged sativa all-in-one built for taste without the fanfare. Bursting with ripe strawberry and candy sweetness with a cool mint finish that keeps every pull fresh and smooth. Powered by 70-75% liquid diamonds and 15-22% flavourless cured resin blend that has a discreet neutral flavour enhanced with natural and botanical terpenes. The result is smooth, consistent and true to flavour without a hint of harsh aftertaste and no additives or carriers. Conveniently rechargeable with USB-C port, DEALR vapes are built for convenience and discretion.

variants.title: Organic Triangle Queen PR 3  x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Some cuts don’t need to shout to be heard. Triangle Queen is one of them. Refined and quietly commanding, this indica-dominant cultivar brings a sense of calm confidence to the ritual. Rolled using LSO whole flower in organic hemp paper, these small-batch pre-rolls deliver the full expression of her character. Expect a layered aromatic profile where tropical fruit and subtle sour notes drift over a base of earthy forest floor and muted rubber. The smoke is thick and composed, carrying hints of citrus, musky cherry and a soft, lingering sweetness on the exhale. A cultivar fit for those who appreciate the quieter side of royalty.

variants.title: Super Silver Bubba PR 3 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Roll out with Super Silver Bubba, a Hybrid cut from Super Silver Haze x Bubba Kush, grown in-house at our indoor facility in Salmon Arm, BC. This offering highlights classic West Coast genetics with earthy pine, citrus zest, and a subtle hash-forward finish. Crafted with care and authentic BC love, and priced so everyone can get in on the good stuff.

variants.title: Blue Thai #2
variants.body_html: When you’re with the buds and it’s time for a sesh, all you need is blue skies and some Blue Thai #2. Spinach® Blue Thai #2 is an ode to everything awesome about dried flower. This cultivar is a straight sativa-dominant strain with an undeniably high potency. Classic fruity, skunky, and citrusy flavours and aromas that come from a puckering lineage of Sour Blueberry and Lemon Thai through a trio of familiar yet harmonious terpenes — limonene, caryophyllene, and humulene.

variants.title: Sour Green Apple Live Resin Gummies
variants.body_html: This package of BIGGIES gummies delivers a sour green apple blend that’s crisp, tangy, and irresistibly refreshing with peach undertones. It’s that zesty-meets-sweet combo, bright green apple bite balanced with smooth, juicy peach turned up into a vibrant, mouthwatering experience that hits with every bite. Each pack includes 30 oversized 8g gummies, each infused with 10mg Live Resin THC, totaling 300mg THC per container. Available for a limited-time-only.

variants.title: BC Organic Lemon Cherry Pie
variants.body_html: BC Organic Lemon Cherry Pie is a standout indica that brings together the bright citrus–cherry profile of Lemon Cherry Gelato with the creamy, gassy depth of Georgia Pie. The result is a richly layered flavour experience, balancing refreshing lemon zest and sweet cherry notes with smooth, dessert-like undertones. Medium-to-tall plants produce dense, heavily frosted buds that release an enticing bouquet of citrus, berry sweetness, and creamy gas. With genetics coming from heavy hitters like Gelato, Sunset Sherbet, Gelatti, Kush Mints, and GSC, Lemon Cherry Pie brings big flavour and seriously solid roots. Certified Organic by Pro-Cert. Grown in organic living soil without the use of artificial pesticides and fertilizers. Hang dried, hand trimmed and hand packaged into reusable/recyclable glass jars.

variants.title: BC Organic Plumz
variants.body_html: BC Organic Plumz is here — just in time for berry season. A cross of Zerberry and PapayaDawg from Grounded Genetics, this cultivar bursts with rich berry aromatics, layered with sweet and funky notes for a full-bodied profile. Grown in organic living soil, each bud is hand-trimmed and packed in our premium glass jars — craft cannabis at its finest. Available for a limited-time-only.

variants.title: T.M.T Saturn Indica PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Take Me to Saturn Indica Pre-Rolls feature a rotating curated blend of genetics using premium BC micro-cultivated indica flower, crafted in small batches for exceptional quality and enjoyment. Each pack includes five Dutch-finished half-gram pre-rolls, carefully prepared to deliver a smooth, consistent burn. Sourced exclusively from some of British Columbia’s finest micro-cultivators, these craft pre-rolls highlight standout indica genetics known for their rich terpene profiles and distinctive character.

variants.title: Quickies Kush Mints vs. Chemsicle Combo Pack PR 20 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Tweed Quickies Chemsicle vs. Kush Mints Combo Pack gives you options. Featuring ten pre-rolls of a sativa strain and ten pre-rolls of a hybrid strain.

variants.title: Widow Pop
variants.body_html: Resinous and expressive, Widow Pop is a potent indica combination of iconic White Widow with the fruity force of Gastro Pop. Expect heavy gas layered with sour undertones, a dash of black pepper and subtle sweetness reminiscent of tangerine and fresh lemongrass. Dominant terpenes myrcene, limonene and caryophyllene drive its bold, full-spectrum aromas. Its big and densely packed buds are light green accented with bright orange pistils and have a sticky, weighty feel. Soar is selective and disciplined in process. Grown in smaller batches and carefully sorted to ensure only our best buds make it through. Hand-harvested, hang-dried and hand-detailed with a humidity pack in every bag.

variants.title: Northern Lights PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Northern Lights Indica by Uncle Bob is prepared with a focus on steady handling and reliable quality. Each 0.5 g pre-roll in this 10-pack is made from BC grown flower and rolled with care for a consistent burn. The cultivar is produced through simple and respectful processing that keeps the plant’s natural character at the forefront. Sized for convenience and prepared with attention from harvest through rolling, it is a dependable option for those who prefer straightforward, well-made pre-rolls they can count on.

variants.title: Puffco New Pivot - Dark Blue
variants.body_html:
Big performance comes in a small package with the Sapphire Puffco Pivot. This compact concentrate vaporizer delivers smooth, flavour-packed hits in a sleek, pocket-friendly design that's ready whenever you are. Whether you're dabbing solo or sharing with friends, the Pivot puts the full Puffco experience in the palm of your hand. Finished in a striking sapphire blue, it's built to stand out without slowing you down.

Key Features & Benefits
Quick-Release 3D Chamber: Heats your concentrates evenly for bigger clouds, better flavour, and fuller effects.
Real-Time Temperature Control: Keeps your hits consistent, no matter how long the session goes.
Four Precision Heat Presets: Dial in your perfect temp with options that suit your style, whether you're chasing flavour or clouds.
Light Bar + Haptic Feedback: Get visual and tactile cues that make timing your dabs effortless.
Compact and Low-Profile: As portable as a pen, but built to perform like a powerhouse.
Long-Lasting Battery: Ready for extended sessions with fast USB-C charging when it's time to power up.
Fresh Sapphire Finish: A bold sapphire blue colour that brings a clean, modern look to every session.

The Puffco Pivot is all about high performance without the fuss. Grab it, pack it, and enjoy smooth, flavourful hits wherever you are.

variants.title: Pufferz Grape Gas Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: 'Spinach PUFFERZ Grape Gas isn't just a vape, but a fun, multi-sensory experience stuffed into one puffy device. Puff, Puff, don't pass on this all-in-one vape that's designed to delight your senses and deliver bigger, more potent hits thanks to our liquid diamonds infusion. We've dialled up the grape flavour notes so that each time you sesh, you're puffing in style with this new vape design. Sweet, juicy, and absolutely ripe for any good session. Spinach PUFFERZ Grape Gas has refreshing grape flavour notes from right off the vine and powered- up gas aromas straight from the pump. With inspiration from a strain with a Grape ?and Jet Fuel GLTO lineage, each puff goes full throttle with a liquid diamonds filled potency of 98.1% THC. Fill your basket and your tank in this powerful, puffy all-in-one vape. '

variants.title: Moose Tracks
variants.body_html: Moose Tracks joins the Canada Collection with a creamy vanilla and nutty sweet flavour. This sativa's got dessert profile, like packing your sesh with a double scoop of flavour.

variants.title: Drippyz Coco Freeze Liquid Diamonds Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Drippyz Coco Freeze Liquid Diamonds 510 cart is a bright, tropical cart. Expect juicy pineapple, sweet coconut cream, and a subtle vanilla warmth carried by ultra‑refined Liquid Diamonds for a clean, potent, and flavour‑saturated pull every time.

variants.title: Apple Frttr Liquid Diamonds Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: The Apple Frttr liquid diamonds 510 thread cartridge brings rich and crisp apple flavour with subtle sweet and spiced notes in every draw. Crafted with liquid diamonds extract, this cartridge delivers a smooth terpene-rich experience with bold flavour expression. With love from Scarborough.

variants.title: Strawberry OG Live Resin
variants.body_html: The Strawberry OG live resin brings together juicy berry sweetness and classic OG funk in a terpene-rich concentrate that's exactly how the flower smells. Extracted from fresh frozen flower to preserve the strain’s natural profile, expect ripe strawberry notes, earthy pine, Kush notes and a heavy gassy backend that lingers on the palate. Loud flavour, full spectrum and no shortcuts. With love from Scarborough.

variants.title: Lemon GLTO Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: The Loud Plug Lemon Gelato (Lemon GLTO) is a bright, citrus‑forward live resin cart that captures the zesty, dessert profile of in its freshest form. Extracted from flash‑frozen flower, this cart delivers true‑to‑plant flavour with layers of lemon peel, sweet cream, and light herbal pine.

variants.title: Jungl' Cake PR 7 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: MTL Cannabis Jungl' Cake buds are lime green with thin deep orange hairs and a coating of frosty white crystal trichomes. The flavor is sweet with notes of pastry dough, creamy marshmallow and cashews. The aroma is earthy and nutty with a sweet fruity overtone that's both sugary and spicy.

variants.title: Double Blue Cherry Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Juicy Hoots has a unique straw mouthpiece. Dive into Double Blue Cherry, where the bold flavours of sour blue raspberry pair with sweet cherries, all infused with high THC. But here's the real game changer, our stainless steel straw mouthpiece cools the vapour. It's also compatible with all 510-thread batteries.

variants.title: Frozen Lemons Pure Live Resin Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: EastCann's Frozen Lemons is a live resin vape made from fresh frozen cannabis. This 510-thread cartridge delivers the native terpene profile of the Frozen Lemons cultivar Freezer Burn x Lemon Fire , offering citrus-forward and earthy aromatic notes with a sharp, frost-like finish.

variants.title: Organic Sugar Haze PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Grown organically in BC, Organic Sugar Haze is a carefully cultivated sativa, hang-dried and slow-cured to enhance aroma and potency. With sweet berry and sugar notes layered over gentle haze undertones, this strain delivers a smooth, aromatic experience that’s both rich and satisfying.

variants.title: Max 60'S Strawberry Fuel Infused PR 3 x 0.45 g
variants.body_html: Strawberry Fuel Max 60’s are potent with liquid diamonds and crushed diamonds on the inside and a solid diamond coating on the outside. Each pre-roll is high in THC and delivers a bold blend of sweet strawberry and gassy fuel with smooth, layered potency.

variants.title: Drippyz Mango Tango Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Drippyz Mango Tango is a tropical, terp‑packed infused pre‑roll bursting with ripe mango, sweet citrus, and a hint of pineapple. Mango Tango blends high‑potency whole flower with a smooth, flavour‑forward infusion to deliver a bold, juicy hit from start to finish.

variants.title: Natural Blueberry Pomegranate
variants.body_html: Say bonjour to Bubble Kush Natural. Made with a low-sweet fruit sugar recipe and real fruit flavours, blueberry and pomegranate show up in the same can and it just works. No bitter aftertaste, no artificial colouring, no unnecessary additives — just clean ingredients. All the classic Bubble Kush home-run taste, the Natural way.

variants.title: Hash Ball
variants.body_html: A rich, aromatic hand‑rolled 2 gram hash ball crafted from carefully sifted trichomes and pressed to create a smooth, pliable, slow‑burning experience. Deep, resinous aromas with notes of earthy spice, warm cocoa, and sweet herbal undertones. When heated, it softens into a silky, terp‑rich melt

variants.title: Exotic Gas Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Exotic Gas liquid diamonds delivers a rich profile with potency. Tangy, sweet and earthy flavours, plus that unmistakable gas twist. The inhale is smooth and the exhale is warm.

variants.title: Sour Chem
variants.body_html: It’s dank, it’s pungent, it’s straight up in your face gas. Spinach® Sour Chem is our ode to what all our buds know and love, a sativa strain with classic flavours and aromas like diesel, chemical and zesty citrus. With tasty terpenes like farnesene, caryophyllene and limonene, flavours will linger on the tip of your tongue with ease. With a lineage that traces back to Chemdawg and Sour Diesel, it’s no surprise that this strain offers a high THC potency.

variants.title: Raspberry Sativa THC Gummies
variants.body_html: Wyld Raspberry sativa enhanced THC soft chew is sustainably made using real fruit, botanical terpenes, natural flavours and compostable packaging. 10 mg of THC per soft chew.

variants.title: Jungle Fumes & Kandy Cake
variants.body_html: Jungle Fumes (Sour Diesel x Chemdawg x Lemon OG). Compact, tightly stacked buds with strong colour contrast developed through dense, controlled growth. Loud gas and citrus with dark, tightly packed buds showing green and purple contrast. 28%+ THC, always grown and groomed in-house. Big flavour with a brighter, more expressive feel. A go-to when you want something loud that stands out. Kandy Cake (Triangle Kush x Animal Cookies). Taller structure with strong branching and conical buds that develop darker tones through maturity. Sweet berry and citrus with darker buds, subtle purple hues, and vibrant pistil contrast. 28%+ THC, always grown and groomed in-house. Rich, sweet flavour with a more laid-back feel. Great when you want something indulgent that leans into comfort.

variants.title: Cherry Ztripez PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Presented in a precision-engineered tin with a hinged lid and custom insert for effortless access, Cherry Ztripez Pre-rolls showcase bold flavour through Broken Coast’s lens of modern mastery. Born from Lemon Cherry x Animal Z, this indica expresses sweet and tangy cherry layered with gassy depth and a smooth pine finish. Phenohunted and extensively tested, it delivers a potent THC range while preserving a vibrant terpene profile led by beta-caryophyllene, linalool, and alpha-humulene. Grown in small batches in strain-specific rooms using precise cultivation methods, the flower is hang-dried, cold-cured, carefully milled, and hand-packaged without irradiation to protect its integrity from first aroma to final ash.

variants.title: Sugar Haze PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Grown organically in BC, Organic Sugar Haze is a carefully cultivated sativa, hang-dried and slow-cured to enhance aroma and potency. With sweet berry and sugar notes layered over gentle haze undertones, this strain delivers a smooth, aromatic experience that’s both rich and satisfying.

variants.title: Max 50'S Kiefers Slurricrasher Infused PR 3 x 0.45 g
variants.body_html: Slurricrasher Max 50’s Kiefers Quad Infused Pre-rolls bring bold raspberry flavour and potency in every puff. Enjoy quadruple infusion: rich honey oil from Pura Vida, botanical terpenes infused into the flower, crushed diamonds mixed throughout the core, and a thick kief coating on the outside. Expect a deep burst of sweet-tart raspberry layered with creamy gas and a subtle funk that won’t quit. This is kief country. Saddle up.

variants.title: Dbl Rainbow Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Taste the ultimate in fruit confection — Double Rainbow. These sweet infused pre-rolls are carefully crafted with potent liquid diamonds infused into whole bud flower and coated in crystalline layer of THCa for a visually stunning experience.

variants.title: Organic Electric Skunk Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Organic Electric Skunk is a high-potency sativa vape designed for a hard-hitting, flavourful experience. By combining terpene-rich live resin with liquid diamonds, this cart delivers a concentrated, skunky punch that stays true to its organically grown roots. Electric Skunk features sharp, pungent notes layered with bright herbal depth and a clean finish. Potent and smooth, this vape is a reliable choice for a high-intensity session on the go.

variants.title: London Zoap
variants.body_html: London Zoap, a cross of London Pound Cake x Zoap, is an Indica that delivers a dense, dessert-leaning profile where LPC’s heavy berry vanilla dough meets Zoap’s candied soap-zest terpene signature. Expect deep purple coloration, high resin density, and a terp stack that leans linalool–limonene–caryophyllene with supporting sweet esters.

variants.title: Dragon Glass PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Dragon Glass is a heavy-hitter born from crossing Black Runtz and GGC (Good Greens Candy), bred by Good Greens and pheno'd in-house. Enjoy a smooth, flavourful experience of sweet fruit, creamy vanilla, and diesel undertones. Since day one, BLKMKT pre-rolls have been packed via centrifuge in-house, and now into RAW organic cones and placed in custom matte black glass tube with a custom designed Integra Boost Stick.

variants.title: Atomic Berry Liquid Diamond+Cured Resin Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Extremely compact and discreet body. 40% Stripped Cured Resin, 8% Terpenes, 52% Diamonds. Clean vapour and enhanced safety via isolated airway. Inhale activated. Charges with USB-C.

variants.title: Blue Razz Lemonade
variants.body_html: XMG's face-twistingly fun flavour is now available in a bold, sour sipper. Blue raspberry meets lemonade for the XMG Atomic Sours Blu Razz Lemonade 355ml, infused with 10mg THC, 10mg CBG, and guarana for flavour-packed refreshment. With no cannabis aftertaste, it’s all sweet sailing and a super sour kick from here.

variants.title: Blue Soufle
variants.body_html: Blue Soufle opens like morning light through an open window, soft and bright, carrying a calm sweetness in the air. Elongated buds form in lifted clusters, showing forest green and mint tones, tenuous lavender blue hues, and a delicate crystal sheen. Nothing sharp, nothing rushed, the profile moves in gentle layers of ripe blueberry skin and soft baked sweetness. Shaped by its lineage from Blueberry Cruffin, 4516, and Souflé, this sativa-dominant cut is defined by form and tone. Available for a limited-time-only.

variants.title: Kush Cookies PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Since day one Kush Cookies has taken up some serious real estate in the greenhouse because tray after tray it delivers. In fact, 80 tons have been put out into the world since 2021. This powerful indica-dominant comes to you via a careful cross of GMO Cookies and OZ Kush. The dense light green buds are caked in trichomes and put off a powerful aroma that’s sure to perfume any room no matter the size. Think roasted herbs, cracked pepper, a twist of citrus, and that unmistakable Kush dankness. Don’t be fooled by the size of these buds, post grind they’ll turn into mountains on the tray. Comfortable being rolled and taken to go or sacrificed in a bowl, Kush Cookies hits the mark every time guaranteed.

variants.title: Organic Mystic Mountain PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Balanced in both form and function, Mystic Mountain offers a gentler path forward. This 1.5:1 CBD:THC is packed with LSO whole flower and rolled in organic hemp paper, showcasing a bright, fruit-forward profile. Notes of ripe strawberries, creamy custard and a touch of watermelon create a soft, inviting smoke that’s as approachable as it is flavourful.

variants.title: Jet Fuel Funk
variants.body_html: Bred by Compound Genetics and renamed by Joi Botanicals, Jet Fuel Funk was created by crossing GMO and Jet Fuel Gelato. Jet Fuel Funk’s aroma is a very noticeable garlic and funk alongside gas and diesel notes. With a generous ratio of large to small buds, these bags are sure to turn some heads.

variants.title: Bubblegum Marker
variants.body_html: Bubblegum Marker is an indica-dominant strain bred by Seed Junky Genetics, which crosses Sherbert and Permanent Marker. This strain features sweet, old-school bubblegum candy notes with hints of gas. It grows prolifically into deep purple buds covered in orange hairs.

variants.title: Bazooka
variants.body_html: Bazooka explodes out of a vintage candy shop. Born from Bubble Gum Biscotti and Grape Gasoline, these buds deliver a rush of chewy sweetness, purple fizz, and a piquant bite that lingers like sugar. Bazooka looks like it rolled straight out of an arcade: noisy, gummy, and full of flash. Big-cut and bubbling with presence, Bazooka is a throwback to when flavour ruled the game. Available for a limited-time-only.

variants.title: Liquid Diamond Guava Passion Fruit Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Tropical, tangy, and diamond-loaded. Liquid Diamond Guava Passion Fruit is an indica-dominant 510 cart packed with ultra-potent liquid diamonds and botanical terpenes. Each pull bursts with juicy passionfruit flavour layered with guava, melon, pineapple, and kiwi, finished with a musky citrus twist.

variants.title: Baccarat
variants.body_html: Baccarat is a sativa-dominant cultivar from DEALR, crossing Pai Gow and Mimosa, offering a refined and elegant expression of citrus, stone fruit, and a subtle floral touch. The flower is sculpted into radiant, dense, and shiny nugs. The aroma unfolds slowly, offering equal parts charm and intensity, leaving a trace of exotic intrigue in the air. Baccarat is not about chance; it is about taste and timing. Available for a limited-time-only.

variants.title: Micro Milled Sativa
variants.body_html: Micro Milled Sativa delivers boutique BC-grown, micro-cultivated flower as a rotating curated blend of genetics in a pre-milled, ready-to-roll format. Curated from BC micro-cultivated sativa genetics and expertly milled in small batches, it preserves terpene richness and potency while eliminating the need for grinding. This craft-quality flower maintains the character and complexity of whole buds in a convenient, ready-to-roll format.

variants.title: Grape Quad Diamond Infused PR 3 x 0.45 g
variants.body_html: Grape Quad Diamond Infused pre-rolls from Skullcrusher 70’s by RAD bring high THC. Packed with liquid diamonds and solid diamonds inside, then finished with a sparkling diamond coating, these pre-rolls offer bold and juicy grape flavour.

variants.title: Jungle Tongue NSFW Liquid Diamond Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Adults Only Jungle Tongue NSFW Liquid Diamond Disposable Vape serves up mouthwatering hits of exotic fruit with a cheeky hint of gas. Juicy mango, sweet pineapple, and a kiss of citrus collide in this potent, USB-C rechargeable disposable packed with liquified THC diamonds. With its advanced flat ceramic heating element, every pull bursts with smooth, tropical flavour and serious potency.

variants.title: Tropical Kush NSFW Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: The Tropical Kush liquid blunt diamond cartridge is what happens when your favourite blunt takes a trip to paradise, no wrap required. Made with real diamonds from our hydrocarbon extraction process and flavoured with botanical terpenes, this cart bursts with juicy notes of pineapple, mango and exotic tropical fruit layered over that classic Kush backbone. Loaded with liquid diamonds, it delivers a smooth full bodied pull.

variants.title: Cherry Tang
variants.body_html:
A sweet and tart sativa that packs a flavourful punch and high potency.

 Sweet and sour in all the right ways, Cherry Tang packs a flavourful punch and a heavy-hitting potency. Our strongest sativa yet, this cross of Cherry Pie and Tangie bursts with energizing citruses, ripe cherries and earthy herbs powered by dominant terpenes limonene, caryophyllene and myrcene. The buds are chunky and oversized with light greens, thick orange hairs and bright crystal trichomes. Pure BC bud, hand-harvested, hang-dried and hand-finished.

variants.title: Sherbert Cookies
variants.body_html: Sherbet Cookies is a sativa dominant hybrid from Platinum Cookies and Sunset Sherbet with bright citrus, sweet berry, and light floral notes. Creamy sweetness combines with a vibrant fruit-forward aroma. Fluffy neon green buds are covered in vibrant orange pistils and a thick layer of frosty trichomes. Indoor grown, small batch, hang dried, slow cured, and hand trimmed to the BOLD standard.

variants.title: Sativa Eh! PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Built for the bold, packed for the journey. Each pack comes with ten perfectly rolled 0.5g pre-rolls, sized just right for easy sessions wherever the day takes you. No grinder, no fuss, just grab and go. Grown and rolled right here in Canada, Sativa Eh! deliver bold flavour and a smooth smoke from start to finish. Whether you're heading out on the trails, kicking back at the cabin, or gathering with friends for the big game, this pack is built for wherever you roam in the Great White North.

variants.title: Short Shifts Line Change Liquid Diamond Infused PR 8 x 0.3 g
variants.body_html: Short Shifts Line Change deliver the same hard-hitting flavour and dialled-in consistency as the big High Sticks, now with more shifts per pack. This rotational liquid diamond infused mini pre-roll pack is designed for quick flavour changes, consistently calling up new homegrown drops to the join the team.

variants.title: Strazzberry Dmnd Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Add little razzle dazzle to your sesh. Strazzleberry is the perfect blend of sweet and sours. Juicy hits of both strawberry and raspberry, this bunch packs potency. G.A. Ultra-Infused Pre-Rolls are made using milled whole flower, dusted in premium kief, boosted with botanical terpenes, and infused with diamonds to deliver our most potent pre-roll yet with 60%+ THC and the G.A. flavours you love.

variants.title: No.27 100's Distillate Delta 9 White Freeze Carton Gummies
variants.body_html: This multipack from Glenn’s contains individual soft chew pouches, each delivering 10 mg of THC. Each pouch contains a single soft chew featuring a cool red, white and blue ice pop inspired flavour with a sweet finish. Made with Delta 9 THC distillate, these soft chews are crafted to deliver consistent potency and a smooth edible experience. Glenn’s soft chews feature the brand’s signature rippled texture, created through a proprietary molding process that sets them apart from traditional flat soft chews and reflects Glenn’s focus on craftsmanship and flavour. The single serve pouch format makes consumption simple while the carton provides convenient storage. Designed for consumers looking for a reliable format with a refreshing flavour profile and consistent quality.

variants.title: Indica 10 Straights PR  10 x 0.75 g
variants.body_html: This pack features 10 straight-cut pre-rolls, each packed with 0.75g of milled single-strain indica-dominant whole flower (no shake, no trim) for a lengthier session. Potent Indica strains rotate from batch to batch. Packaged in a durable, smell-proof, leak-proof, and water-proof container to keep up with your grind.

variants.title: Laundry Loopz
variants.body_html: We took Kush Cookies and Crumbled Lime and let them collide into a sticky hybrid with a nose that earns the name. First its straight GMO-style funk, like warm laundry that somehow still smells loud. Then the “Loopz” kicks in: a sweet, citrus, sugary edge that smooths the corners and keeps it from going full skunk. It looks the part too, with bright green buds caked in trichomes and orange hairs running wild throughout. Sun + LED grown and rainwater fed in our Quebec greenhouse. Hang dried, trimmed and packed the way we’d want to find it.

variants.title: Trial No. 016 Lto
variants.body_html: A striking cross of Unicorn Poop and Sundae Driver. This hybrid was chosen for its complex aromas of sweet florals and savoury herbs of rosemary and sage that finish with a subtle gassy edge and citrus zest. This cultivar produces dense, trichome-rich buds in shades of deep and light greens accented by bright orange pistils. Each Trial strain is a chance to try fresh genetics we’re trialing in the greenhouse. Grown in smaller batches and available in limited release drops. Available for a limited-time-only.

variants.title: BC Organic Plumz PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: BC Organic Plumz is here — just in time for berry season. A cross of Zerberry and PapayaDawg from Grounded Genetics, this cultivar bursts with rich berry aromatics, layered with sweet and funky notes for a full-bodied profile. Grown in organic living soil - craft cannabis at its finest. Available for a limited-time-only!

variants.title: Sativa 10 Straights PR 10 x 0.75 g
variants.body_html: This pack features 10 straight-cut pre-rolls, each packed with 0.75g of milled single-strain sativa-dominant whole flower (no shake, no trim) for a lengthier session. Potent Sativa strains rotate from batch to batch. Packaged in a durable, smell-proof, leak-proof, and water-proof container to keep up with your grind.

variants.title: Drippyz Variety Pack Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: The latest in flavour innovations from Drippyz. The new Drippyz Variety Pre-Roll pack features infused pre-rolls in five bold flavours: Bubba Joon, Lemon GLTO, Mango Tango, Dragon Fruit Rntz and Pina Colada. Each pre-roll is loaded with liquid diamond-infused premium TLP flower strains you’ve come to know and love. For extra potency, they’re dusted with a premium blonde kief coating that amplifies both flavour and potency — creating a potent, flavourful experience from start to finish. Enjoy a new level of taste and strength with every Drippyz pre-roll in this unique assortment!

variants.title: Lemon Cherry Popperz PR 14 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Make your next session pop off with new Good Supply Lemon Cherry Popperz, a tangy-sweet sativa bred from ICC x Rntz x Lemon Cherry Gelato, bursting with orchard-fresh flavour. A loud splash of gas leads the way, layered with fruity citrus and sharp pine. All pop, no flop, this sweet strain delivers a full-on entourage effect, so go ahead and take a pop at Good Supply Lemon Cherry Popperz in our convenient pack of pre-rolls.

variants.title: Little Red Sativa PR 4 x 0.5 g
variants.brand: The Original Fraser Valley Weed Co.
tags: The Original Fraser Valley Weed Co.
variants.body_html: Little Red joints from The Original Fraser Valley Weed Co. Classic cone-style joints filled with a half-gram of a rotating selection of quality BC sativa. Expertly ground then rolled in all-natural paper and packed in a take-anywhere tube with four pre-rolls inside. Greenhouse-grown in abundance in BC’s finest growing region, the Fraser Valley.

variants.title: Green CRK Slims PR 10 x 0.4 g
variants.body_html: Packed straight and steady from top to bottom, in a portable carton. Stuffed with a tropical, citrusy and earthy sativa. All you need is a light. Super Toast. Always Ready.

variants.title: Bubble Pop Cake
variants.body_html: Bred by Seed Junky Genetics, Bubble Pop Cake is a cross of Bubblegum Sherb x Cap Junky. Crack open the pouch and you'll find candy-coated, dense, marbled buds — vibrant greens and purples swirled through, absolutely loaded with frosty trichomes. What made us fall for Bubble Pop Cake is its standout nose and taste — you'll hit a rush of sweet bubblegum candy upfront, layered with smooth creamy sherbet and a punch of gassy fuel on the backend. Because it’s the right thing to do, all of our flower is hang-dried, hand-trimmed, slow cold-cured, and hand-packaged. We keep it fresh and terpy by sealing it up in nitrogen-flushed pouches with a humidity pack inside. And yeah — non-irradiated, obviously.

variants.title: Bag O Milled Ultra Sour
variants.body_html: If terpinolene and limonene had a lovechild it’d be Ultra Sour. The tartness of meyer lemon meets the diesel and pungent notes from the cultivar’s kush undertones. A sativa-leaning sour is milled and ready to roll, and you can expect a medley of fresh terps that are sweet and fruity on the nose and herbal upon exhale.

variants.title: Organic Orange Crush
variants.body_html: Grown organically in BC, Organic Orange Crush is a sativa-dominant strain carefully cultivated to highlight its vibrant aroma and potency. Each batch is hang-dried and slow-cured to preserve its terpene-rich profile and overall quality. Bright and citrus-forward, it features juicy orange notes layered with a subtle sweetness and a sharp, zesty finish. Smooth and flavourful, this strain delivers a consistent, well-rounded session that stays true to its bold, fruit-forward roots.

variants.title: Organic Purple Passion Fruit
variants.body_html: Grown organically in BC, Organic Purple Passion Fruit is a carefully cultivated sativa, hang-dried and slow-cured to preserve its vibrant aroma and potency. Showcasing striking deep purple buds, this strain bursts with tropical passion fruit sweetness complemented by subtle dark berry undertones and a gentle earthy finish. Smooth and fruit-forward, it delivers consistent quality and a satisfying smoke from start to finish.

variants.title: Organic Sugar Haze
variants.body_html: Grown organically in BC, Organic Sugar Haze is a carefully cultivated sativa, hang-dried and slow-cured to enhance aroma and potency. With sweet berry and sugar notes layered over gentle haze undertones, this strain delivers a smooth, aromatic experience that's both rich and satisfying.

variants.title: Honeystick Twist Battery - Rose Gold
variants.body_html: Sleek, stylish, and built for performance, the Honeystick HMP Twist Battery in Rose Gold is a versatile companion for your favorite 510-thread cartridges. Its slim form and adjustable voltage make it ideal for both beginners and seasoned users looking for control and convenience in one elegant package. Key Features & Benefits: 510 Thread Compatibility – Works with most standard cartridges Adjustable Voltage – Choose your preferred heat setting for smoother hits Stylish Rose Gold Finish – Sophisticated look with a modern touch USB Charger Included – Stay powered up and ready to go Designed for portability and precision—perfect for discreet use without compromising on style or function.

variants.title: High Potency 95+ Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Jays presents potent products full of flavour in convenient formats for everyday Canadians. Green Dragon brings deep, fruity flavour with a complex tang of citrus and a sweet rich exhale. These highly potent 510 Cartridges are formulated with quality cannabis extract, with more than 92% THC, captured in state-of-the-art custom designed 510 hardware.

variants.title: Valley Girl PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Bred by Archive Seed Bank, Valley Girl comes from a cross of SFV OG and Face Off OG. What do we love about Valley Girl? First off, the flavour. It’s that classic sweet gas profile with a hint of funky musk to keep things interesting. Each pack has slim, hand finished pre-rolls made from quality flower, never trim, packaged with a humidity pack for lasting freshness.

variants.title: GMO PR 1 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Don’t let the name deceive you. This strain inspiration traces its lineage back to GSC and a Deep Sour Kush background. GMO (Garlic, Mushroom, Onion) Cookies has an unmistakable sweet and savoury taste. Terpenes like caryophyllene, myrcene, and humulene make it one of the most popular indica strains out there. You can’t make a soup out of it, but it sure goes nicely in a bowl.

variants.title: Astronaut Status Temple Ball Hash
variants.body_html: Our Astronaut Status Temple Ball is made in-house, using the dry sift process. We press our hash at low temperatures for maximum flavour, and hand roll each piece into a perfect temple ball. Aged for full flavour, expect a sudden flood of memories from your favourite hash from back in the day. Additive free, which means no distillate, no botanical terpenes. Hash the way it was mean to be.

variants.title: UK Cheese PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: UK Cheese is a hybrid cultivar leaning slightly sativa (60% sativa, 40% indica). This legendary strain earned its reputation through a uniquely bold and complex aroma. Expect a powerful blend of pungent skunk, earthy moss and sour wood layered with subtle hints of sweetness and fuel. Just one bud is enough to fill the room with its unmistakable scent.

variants.title: Jungle J Pure Live Resin Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Our Jungle Juice Pure Live Resin Vape cartridge is crafted exclusively from fresh-frozen flower. We never add additives, thinning agents, or botanical terpenes — because doing it right matters. Upon your first inhale, expect to be blown away bold flavours of Citrus, Gas and unforgettable tang. Calibrated for smooth, consistent flavour with every pull, we recommend pairing our carts with a quality battery featuring variable temperature settings. Start at 2V and gradually adjust to find your perfect experience.

variants.title: Larry PR 7 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: LowKey’s indica-dominant Larry is a legacy cross of Black Domina x Gelato 33. Its buds are a deep emerald green with very heavy purple undertones all coated with loads of big crystals. This old school strain transmits an aroma of pungent diesel mixed with sweet and earthy whispers of mint, lemon and pine.

variants.title: Night Kush PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Night Kush Indica Pre-Rolls deliver old-school kush character — earth, pine, and warm spice — burning smooth with a dense, strong finish. A true indica experience.

variants.title: Black Diamond X PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Black Diamond X bred by Maven Genetics — dense, marbled buds dripping in frost. Hits you with loud diesel, rich earth, and that sticky dank funk. Our pre-rolls are hand-finished, made from premium flower— never trim — and are packaged with a humidity pack for lasting freshness.

variants.title: Sugar Factory Ceramic Tip PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Sugar Factory was pheno hunted in-house by our team. Bred by Cedar Creek Genetics from the cross of (Zoap x Zangria) x Sweet Retreat, this standout indica hybrid delivers a vibrant flavour profile blending juicy guava, crisp candy apple, and soft floral sweetness. Because it’s the right thing to do, all our pre-rolls are made exclusively from whole flower, rolled in small batches into slim cones with a ceramic tip.

variants.title: Jonny's Stash Rotating Reefers PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: A rotating pre-roll offering of craft flower, hand-dried, hand-trimmed, sorted and milled for the perfect consistency.

variants.title: Kandy Cake
variants.body_html: Kandy Cake (Triangle Kush x Animal Cookies). Taller structure with strong branching and conical buds that develop darker tones through maturity. Sweet berry and citrus with darker buds, subtle purple hues and vibrant pistil contrast. High THC, always grown and groomed in house. Rich, sweet flavour. Great when you want something indulgent that leans into comfort.

variants.title: Sapphire Kush
variants.body_html: Sapphire Kush milled flower is an indica dominant strain that is grounded in ancient Kush and enchanted with the essence of dark berries. This legendary strain is always produced with milled flower from whole buds.

variants.title: Feather Weight PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Light by design, big on character. Feather Weight pre-rolls are crafted for those who love the ritual but prefer a softer touch. This pack of Acapulco Gold joints delivers clean flavour, potency and a smooth, easy burn that feels lighter on its feet. It’s a lighter way to light up. Flower that's perfectly portioned and ready when you are.

variants.title: Mango Dream PR 1 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Enjoy Potluck's newest fruit flavour, Mango Dream! This sativa strain has a bold, tropical aroma with fresh mango and herbal flavours. This flavour-packed pre-roll is a perfect addition to your stash.

variants.title: El Jefe PR 7 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: This speak-easy style strain stays LowKey by crossing indica-dominant Animal Mints x Sherb Cake lineages. A sweet aroma of smooth peppermint and tropical flowers is followed by jazzy sweet notes of a tangy, tart cake flavour. El Jefe showcases dense, resinous buds with a deep green hue, often tinged with shades of purple. Its trichome coverage is also worth talking about.

variants.title: Chatty Kathy Premium Glass Tip Blunt PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Chatty Kathy (Chatterbox x SinMintz). Tall and leggy growth with smaller, dense buds and strong structural resilience. Diesel, mint, and spice with compact buds and bold orange pistils. 28%+ THC, always grown and groomed in-house. Lighter, more engaging, and easy to share. Great for social settings, or when you’ve got a lot to say.
