variants.title: Permanent Lee Hi
variants.body_html: Permanent-Lee Hi, a cross of Permanent Marker and Supreme Lee Hi, presents dense, emerald buds edged in lavender hues and golden frost. This Indica-dominant cultivar carries an aroma of gas, sweet berry, and lemon-pine spice. Finished with flair, this cut moves like water but lands with power, smooth and heavy hitting.

variants.title: East Coast Flamingo
variants.body_html: Gushing with sweet citrus and diesel aromas, this potent, sativa-leaning Flambagner cross from BBOB is perfect for those chasing high-potency and terp-filled tokes

variants.title: Banjerine Cold Cured Live Rosin
variants.body_html:
Pressed from fresh frozen Banjerine (Banjo x Cotton Candy) flower. Crafted using a focused 90-159 micrometer pull, delivering a bright, forward-leaning sativa expression with real lift. Harvested at peak maturity & frozen immediately, the cultivar's character is preserved from the start. Cold-cured to preserve its most volatile aromatics. The profile opens with vivid tangerine citrus, followed by a subtle floral softness that keeps it light on the palate. Beneath it all, a restrained diesel undertone adds structure & edge without heaviness. Clean, expressive, and modern in character, Banjerine delivers a flavour arc that stays lively from first inhale through finish.

100% Solventless. Nothing added. Nothing lost. Astrolab: Feel The Gravity.

variants.title: Dopezilla Elemental Phoenix Dab Rig 7 in. Orange
variants.body_html:
The Dopezilla Elemental Phoenix Dab Rig rises from the ashes with bold style and fiery function. Standing 7.87 inches tall, this uniquely shaped rig from the Elemental line features vibrant orange accents inspired by the legendary phoenix. Equipped with a showerhead percolator, it cools and diffuses vapor for smooth, flavourful pulls that are as clean as they are powerful.

Key Features & Benefits:
Unique Design: Eye-catching silhouette delivers standout style and comfortable handling.
Showerhead Percolator: Creates excellent diffusion for cooler, smoother, and more flavourful hits.
Fire Line Design: Vibrant orange finish with cool details captures the spirit of the mythical phoenix.
Durable Borosilicate Glass: Built to handle regular sessions while maintaining lasting clarity and strength.
Compact 7.87-Inch Size: Easy to handle, store, and enjoy without sacrificing performance.

Rise above ordinary sessions and let the Phoenix ignite every dab with legendary style and smooth, fiery flavour.

variants.title: Dopezilla Elemental Dragon Straight Tube Water Pipe 13 in. Red
variants.body_html:
The Dopezilla Elemental Dragon Water Pipe unleashes fierce style with a smooth and satisfying performance. Standing 13 inches tall, this straight-tube bong from the elemental line channels the raw power of a dragon with blazing red accents and a bold fiery design. Inside, a pyramid percolator tames the heat by cooling and diffusing each hit, delivering dense, flavourful clouds worthy of a legendary beast.

Key Features & Benefits:
13-Inch Straight Tube: Classic silhouette offers effortless pulls.
Pyramid Percolator: Breaks smoke into fine bubbles for cooler, smoother, and more enjoyable hits.
Fire Line Design: Striking red finish with cool details brings fierce, dragon-worthy energy to every session.
Durable Borosilicate Glass: Built to withstand regular use while maintaining crystal-clear looks and lasting performance.
Wide, Stable Base: Helps keep your bong planted securely between rips.

Awaken the beast, spark the bowl, and let the Dragon breathe fire with every pull.

variants.title: Cloudious 9 Tectonic9 Auto Dispensing Grinder Black
variants.body_html:
The Cloudious9 Tectonic9 Auto Dispensing Grinder combines the dependable performance of a traditional grinder with the convenience of an automatic dispensing system. Designed for smooth, mess-free sessions at home or on the go, it delivers a consistently fluffy grind while its built-in vibration motor evenly dispenses your herb exactly where you want it. Crafted from durable space-grade anodized aluminum, this innovative piece is built to handle everyday use with precision and ease.
Key Features & Benefits:
Auto Dispensing Technology: Built-in vibration motor evenly dispenses ground herb for cleaner, more controlled loading.
28 Diamond-Shaped Grinding Teeth: CNC-machined teeth produce a consistently fluffy grind with minimal effort.
Precision Flip Spout: Hidden flip-out spout helps direct herb exactly where it's needed with less mess.
Sliding Dispensing Gate: Securely stores your ground herb and helps prevent accidental spills while traveling.
LED Viewing Window: Illuminated storage window lets you quickly check how much herb remains.
Space-Grade Anodized Aluminum: Lightweight yet exceptionally durable construction stands up to everyday use.
Textured Grip: Matte finish and textured exterior provide a secure, comfortable grip while grinding.
One-Button Operation: Simple controls make grinding and dispensing quick, intuitive, and hassle-free.
Colour Options: Pick from a sleek black or cool grey to suit your style.
Whether you're rolling, packing a bowl, or filling a bong, the Tectonic9 streamlines the process with clean, consistent dispensing and the reliability of a classic grinder.

Each pre-roll is intentionally blended from select sativas to create a synergy that amplifies both the entourage and sour citrus flavour profile. From the moment you crack the tube, powerful notes of sweet berry and bold lemonade burst through, staying aromatic and flavourful all the way down to the last puff. Redshift Berry Lemonade Diamond Infused Pre-Rolls were engineered to deliver intense effects with a surprisingly smooth smoke. A sweet sativa designed to keep the vibes flowing, Redshift Berry Lemonade is exactly as fun and flavourful as it sounds.

variants.title: Mach 1 Live Rosin
variants.body_html: JUSTKUSH Live Rosin is a 100% solventless concentrate crafted from the finest sun-grown, living soil, fresh-frozen whole flower. Mach 1, a cross between Violator Kush & Amnesia Haze, boasting a fresh, citrus-forward flavour with a hint of earthiness. Using only water, ice, heat, and pressure, this meticulously processed rosin preserves the full spectrum of cannabinoids and terpenes, for a clean, pure concentrate. Hand-selected at peak potency and extracted from the finest 73-159u hash at low temp. Grown under the Okanagan Valley sun, Canada's renowned growing region, this live hash rosin provides connoisseurs with a truly authentic, high-quality, clean concentrate that delivers pure potency and unmatched flavour.

variants.title: Animal Style Pure Live Rosin Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Brindle Farms Animal Style Live Rosin Vape Cart is a rich, solventless expression crafted from fresh-frozen flower and pressed to preserve its full terpene profile. Deep earthy gas and sweet doughy notes lead the flavour, followed by a smooth, clean finish. Potent and well-balanced, this live rosin cart showcases Brindle Farms’ commitment to premium small-batch extracts.

variants.title: Cherry Lime Blast Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Pucker up for Cherry Lime Blast, the Sativa vape that hits your taste buds with a zesty cherry-lime smack and a hint of raspberry sweetness. But don't let the flavour fool you! This 1g 510 cartridge packs a serious punch, with 91-96% THC delivering smooth, potent hits that lift your mood and spark your creativity. Designed to keep the vibes social, cheerful, and effortless, it's powered by high-potency distillate and built with a ceramic core, glass cartridge, and hemp mouthpiece for a hit that's as reliable as it is delicious. Get ready to blast off because your taste buds are in for a ride.

variants.title: Huckleberry Pi Live Resin
variants.body_html: Huckleberry is a true BC Strain and is a classic indica-dominant (50% indica / 50% sativa) born from the legendary pairing of Berry Pie and Cotton Candy. True to its name, this decadent strain is as visually stunning as it is enjoyable to smoke, which bursts with sweet and sour berry, with creamy vanilla and lavender undertones. Its aroma is equally lavish, with strong fruity, berry aroma with vanilla, cream, and flower notes. This live resin is crafted from premium British Columbia flower and refined through a proprietary hydrocarbon extraction process. The result is a golden, creamy concentrate with a high-terpene, full-spectrum profile that’s aromatic, flavorful, and truly luxurious.

variants.title: Cherry Cola Hash Rosin Gummies
variants.body_html: Nostalgic soda-shop flavour with a sweet confectionery edge. DEALR Infused Cherry Cola gummies come in a pack of ten hash rosin infused pieces, each delivering 10mg THC. Crafted to bring you bright cherry notes blending with a fizzy cola-inspired twist, creating a familiar flavour profile. Gluten-free.

variants.title: Fizzy Grape Liquid Diamonds Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Ride the flavour wave with Fizzy Grape All-in-One Vape. Now super charged with liquid diamonds and a sweet flavour blast of fizzy grape. Super Toast grab n' go rechargeable vapes are always ready, no battery required. Our custom vape design is the stuff of ergonomic dreams, with the perfect palm-feel and super comfortable mouthpiece for long hauls and big fluffy clouds. Super Toast. Always Ready.

variants.title: Foggy Peaches Gummies
variants.body_html: Get ready to pucker up with the XMG Atomic Sours Foggy Peaches X Pack, a 10-pack x 5.8mg of bold, juicy gummies inspired by the hit Atomic Sour beverage. Each gummy blends sweet peach and zesty lemon with a super sour haze that smacks hard and lingers long. Infused with 10mg THC + 10mg CBG, it’s all about pure, flavour-first intensity with no cannabis aftertaste. Ten pieces, one epic pack, and a sour-sweet combo.

variants.title: Organic Mint Chocolate Chip PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: The dense, resin-laden buds of Mint Chocolate Chip have a rich, herbaceous, skunky aroma. Notes of cool mint and subtle chocolate become more apparent when the flower is combusted, making for a smooth smoke that finishes with a slight tang on the exhale. With a first-place win at the Unicorn Cup and Karma Cup, Mint Chocolate Chip is known as a highly versatile strain. These easy-to-smoke half-gram joints are made entirely of AAAA Sweetgrass flower (no trim) and, to top it off, everything is 100% organic, right down to the hemp papers they're rolled in.

variants.title: Redshift Berry Lemonade Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Portal’s Redshift Berry Lemonade Liquid Diamond 510 Vape propels potency into orbit. With 95-99% Liquid Diamonds, this sativa delivers sweet berry and bright lemon notes for a flavour profile that’s bold, clean, and futuristic. Each meticulously engineered 0.95g cartridge features Portal’s lock-top mouthpiece — a safeguard against pocket debris and rogue particles — guaranteeing consistent performance from launch sequence to power-down. Redshift Berry Lemonade is where high potency, advanced design, and interdimensional flavour converge.

variants.title: Lemon Cherry Popperz
variants.body_html: Make your next session pop off with new Good Supply Lemon Cherry Popperz flower, a tangy-sweet sativa bred from ICC x Rntz x Lemon Cherry Gelato, bursting with orchard-fresh flavour. A loud splash of gas leads the way, layered with fruity citrus and sharp pine. All pop, no flop, this sweet strain delivers a full-on entourage effect, so go ahead and take a pop at Good Supply Lemon Cherry Popperz.

variants.title: Organic Sugar Haze
variants.body_html: Grown organically in BC, Organic Sugar Haze is a carefully cultivated sativa, hang-dried and slow-cured to enhance aroma and potency. With sweet berry and sugar notes layered over gentle haze undertones, this strain delivers a smooth, aromatic experience that’s both rich and satisfying.

variants.title: XVape-Aria Dry Herb Vaporizer-Red
variants.body_html: The XVape Aria brings together sleek design, cutting-edge upgrades, and refined performance for a next-level vaping experience. Featuring a hand-blown borosilicate glass mouthpiece and a ceramic conduction oven, this portable powerhouse delivers clean, flavourful vapor with fast heat-up and full temperature control. Its durable metal body, USB-C fast charging, and precision-engineered airflow make it a standout choice for dry herb and concentrate users who want both power and purity in the palm of their hand. Key Features & Benefits: Borosilicate Glass Mouthpiece: Preserves terpene flavour and cools vapor for a smoother draw USB-C Charging: Faster and more efficient charging with pass-through capability Ceramic Heating Chamber: Even heat distribution with rapid 15-second warm-up Full Temp Control (212°F – 464°F): Fine-tune your session with precision OLED Screen & Haptic Feedback: Clear visuals and subtle vibration alerts for a responsive experience Isolated Airflow System: Ensures clean, uncontaminated vapor Dual Session Timers: Choose from 5 or 10-minute sessions to match your preference Built-in Scraping Tool: Convenient and discreet for on-the-go maintenance Durable Metal Frame: Built to last with a premium finish Compatible with Dry Herb and Concentrates: Versatile functionality for any preference Portable, powerful, and purpose-built, the XVape Aria redefines what a compact vaporizer can do.

variants.title: Yocan Zivo 2.0 510 Battery - Black
variants.body_html:
"The Yocan Ziva 2.0 is a sleek, pocket-friendly 510-thread battery designed for users who value discretion without sacrificing control. Its concealed cartridge design keeps your setup protected and low-profile, while the integrated display screen provides real-time battery and voltage information. With adjustable voltage, preheat functionality, and auto-draw activation, the Ziva 2.0 delivers a customizable and convenient vaping experience in a compact form factor. 

Key Features & Benefits:
Concealed Cartridge Design: Keeps cartridges protected while maintaining a clean, discreet appearance.
Auto-Draw Activation: Simply inhale to enjoy effortless operation without pressing buttons.
TFT Display Screen: Easily monitor battery life, voltage settings, resistance, and puff count.
Precision Voltage Control: Adjustable from 1.8V–4.2V in 0.1V increments for a personalized balance of flavour and vapor production.
10-Second Preheat Function: Helps warm thicker oils for smoother, more consistent draws.
650mAh Battery: Delivers reliable all-day performance in a compact, portable device.
USB-C Fast Charging: Recharges in approximately one hour.
510-Thread Compatibility: Works with most standard 510-thread cartridges up to 2g.
Built-In Safety Protections: Features overheat, short-circuit, low-voltage, and auto-shutdown protections for dependable everyday use. 

With its stealthy design, smart display, and customizable performance, the Yocan Ziva 2.0 is an excellent choice for convenient, on-the-go vaping."

variants.title: Gloves Off Grape Liquid Diamond Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: High Stick's next generation all-in-one hits hard every time. Filled with liquid diamonds, Gloves Off Grape delivers a bold mix of grape-forward sweetness layered with juicy berry and fruity notes for a flavour that finishes strong every shift.

variants.title: Double Drip Berry Burst Resin
variants.body_html: Double Drip - Berry Burst Resin is all about flavour, flexibility, and fun. This saucy, berry-forward resin is finished with added botanical terpenes to dial up juicy aroma and bold berry flavour, making it perfect for enjoying your way - dab it, drizzle it, or dress up your favourite pre-rolls. With a smooth, glossy texture that's easy to work with, Berry Burst is great for topping bowls, rolling infused joints, or settling in for flavour-first dabs. The 2-gram Double Drip jar means more to play with, more to share, and more ways to enjoy bright berry flavour from start to finish.

variants.title: Pink Kush
variants.body_html: Pure Sunfarms' cut of Pink Kush from BC's Vancouver Island is a coastal relative of the legendary OG Kush. This special strain is beloved across Canada for its strong aromas, colourful flowers and high THC potential. Beneath a thick coating of trichomes, the dense and round buds feature forest green leaves, often with a purple hue, mixed with dark amber pistils. Grown in a high-tech greenhouse in the Fraser Valley, each bud is carefully trimmed and hand-groomed, dried and cured to precise standards. Pink Kush showcases gassy aromas of white pepper, orange, butterscotch, coffee, earth and grapefruit, the result of a rich combination of terpenes that includes caryophyllene, myrcene, humulene, bisabolol, and limonene.

variants.title: Cherry Tang PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Purple Fog is a stunning purple indica descending from potent Purple Punch and Jungle Cake lineage. From a large family tree of head-turners, this purple takes the cake with its deep violet colours that run all the way to the stem, and striking lilac and lavender hues on the grind. It delivers relaxing aromas of smooth florals, woodsy pine and sweet, savoury herbs, with a healthy punch of gas and spice from dominant terpenes limonene, linalool, and beta-pinene. The plant produces dense, frosty deep purple colas with sharp emerald leaves outlined in dark purple. Its grape-shaped nugs are solid and compact, frosted in sticky golden trichomes. Pure BC bud, hand-harvested, hang-dried and hand-finished.

variants.title: Purple Fog
variants.body_html: Sweet and sour in all the right ways, Cherry Tang packs a flavourful punch and a heavy-hitting potency. Our strongest sativa yet, this cross of Cherry Pie and Tangie bursts with energizing citruses, ripe cherries and earthy herbs powered by dominant terpenes limonene, caryophyllene and myrcene. The buds are chunky and oversized with light greens, thick orange hairs and bright crystal trichomes. Pure BC bud, hand-harvested, hang-dried and hand-finished.

variants.title: Sugar Haze PR 1 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Grown organically in BC, Organic Sugar Haze is a carefully cultivated sativa, hang-dried and slow-cured to enhance aroma and potency. With sweet berry and sugar notes layered over gentle haze undertones, this strain delivers a smooth, aromatic experience that’s both rich and satisfying.

variants.title: Tractor Beams PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Space Race Cannabis' Tractor Beams contain expertly rolled pre-rolls, each packed with premium indica flower and engineered for even, slow-burning sessions. As a true indica from Space Race Cannabis, Tractor Beams locks on with an irresistible pull.

variants.title: Pure Moroccan Hash Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Discover a timeless smoke with Tremblant’s Pure Moroccan Hash Pre-rolls — a pack crafted for enthusiasts who appreciate that classic hash experience. Made from a blend of pure bubble hash and slow-roasted kief, each pre-roll delivers a smooth, full-bodied draw that hits you with a deep, earthy richness and warm spice notes. With a potent THC profile, these pre-rolls offer a smooth, satisfying hash experience in a convenient ready-to-enjoy format. Thoughtfully rolled for an even burn, this pure hash pre-roll is ready to spark.

variants.title: Fully Charged Cherry Crush Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Spinach® Fully Charged Cherry Crush infused pre-rolls fill each sesh with fresh cherry flavour notes and aromas, offering a sweet treat inspired by a strain with Granddaddy Purple x F1 Durb lineage. Each pre-roll is 50%+ Total THC from an infusion of liquid diamonds and live rosin, and with a potent kief coating.

variants.title: Forbidden Fruit Liquid Diamonds Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Forbidden Fruit Liquid Diamonds 510 Carts pull you in with rich sweetness from the first inhale. Indulgent and layered, it’s a flavour you don’t rush. Ripe berry richness, deep fruit punch notes, and a bright flash of citrus create a lush, full-bodied profile that lingers on the palate. Crafted with liquid diamonds delivering 95 - 99% THC, this sativa offering feels right at home when the pace picks up. Back Forty’s 510 hardware delivers smooth, consistent clouds you can count on.

variants.title: Key Lime Kush Liquid Diamonds Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Key Lime Kush Liquid Diamonds 510 Carts hit with a citrus-kush potency from the first pull. This hybrid delivers a bold flavour profile, layering sharp lime over a sweet finish that stays true to its kush roots. Crafted with liquid diamonds delivering 95 - 99%% THC, the balanced, full-bodied flavour is an indulgent choice. Back Forty’s 510 hardware delivers smooth, consistent clouds you can count on.

variants.title: Solar Flares PR 20 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: A blazing pack of sativa pre-rolled joints. These quality, hand twisted pre-rolls feature rotating single strain sativa flower from some of Canada's finest craft growers. Smooth and consistent burns and unbeatable value make this pack a stellar sativa adventure.

variants.title: Blackberry Breath Liquid Diamonds Cape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Blackberry Breath Liquid Diamonds 510 Carts drench your tastebuds with juicy blackberry from the first inhale. Ripe, fresh-picked sweetness delivers a vibrant, berry-forward profile that hits bright and lingers. This indica is crafted with liquid diamonds delivering 95 - 99% THC. Back Forty’s 510 hardware delivers smooth, consistent clouds you can count on.

variants.title: Flyers Frosted Wedding Party Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Claybourne Frosted Flyers Infused Wedding Party pre-rolls are THCa diamond frosted, terpene enhanced and infused with liquid diamonds. These 3 x 0.5 g hybrid pre-rolls boast 42-48% THC. Looking for bold flavour and a potent experience? Look no further than Claybourne Frosted Flyers.

variants.title: Space Vikings PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Space Race Cannabis' Space Vikings PRJs are your launchpad for an epic, sativa-powered experienced. This pack delivers perfectly rolled pre-rolls, each one handcrafted for smooth, consistent burns and ready to ignite whenever inspiration strikes. A pure sativa offering from Space Race Cannabis.

variants.title: Valkyries PR 20 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: These high quality, hand twisted pre-rolls feature rotating single strain indica flower from some of Canada's top craft growers. Smooth, even burns and stellar value deliver an epic indica odyssey.

variants.title: Flyers Frosted Pitstop Peach Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Claybourne Frosted Flyers Infused Pitstop Peach pre-rolls are THCa diamond frosted, terpene enhanced and infused with liquid diamonds. These sativa pre-rolls boast high THC. Looking for bold flavour and a potent experience? Look no further than Claybourne Frosted Flyers.

variants.title: Electric Green Frog Liquid Diamonds Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Sticky Greens’ Pure Diamonds vapes offer liquid THCa diamonds with no distillate. Try our potent vapes with Electric Green Frog inspired by sweet green apple, tart lime and smooth vanilla flavours.

variants.title: Sputnik PR 1 x 0.4 g
variants.body_html: GREAT PRICE - GREAT QUALITY. Sputnik is a rotating single strain Sativa PRJ that is designed to increase a retailer's basket size. Sputniks are hand twisted with best in-class, even burning papers that create an optimum consumer experience at a fantastic price.

variants.title: C99 Haze PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: C99 Haze is a sativa cross of the tasty C99 and the legendary Haze. Complex citruses are layered with sweet and tangy tropical fruit topped off with sugary candy. The pack includes tapered pre-rolls and a glass filter tip.

variants.title: Black Cherry Glto+Velvet Noir Infused PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: This combination of Deep Black Cherry and warm velvet richness comes together in this 2x1 g Blunt pack. Get two amazing flavours that play off each other’s aromas and exciting flavours. Enjoy this combo from Black Cherry GLTO and Velvet Noir.

variants.title: Lemon Drip Liquid Demons Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Liquid Demons Infused Pre-Rolls: devilishly potent and sinfully flavourful. Infused with sugary lemon, boosted with a blend of distillate plus liquid diamonds and finished with a kief-THCa diamond crust. They’re diabolically delicious. Super Toast. Always Ready.

variants.title: Pink Goat Live Whipped Diamonds
variants.body_html: Smooth, sweet, and a little bit legendary. Pink Goat Live Whipped Diamonds brings creamy berry flavour with a rich, indulgent finish that hits deep and satisfying. High-purity THCa diamonds folded into a rich, whipped terpene sauce texture that’s easy to scoop and full of flavour. Expect sweet berry notes, subtle creamy undertones, and a heavy indica lean that’s built for slowing things down. Perfect for late-night dabs or stacking onto a bowl when you’re ready to unwind — this one’s all about big flavour.

variants.body_html: Strawberry Banana 60’s+ bring smooth, creamy fruit flavour with sweet strawberry notes and mellow banana undertones. This double-infused blend is all about easy enjoyment — balanced, flavourful, and made for laid-back sessions that still hit just right. Designed for sharing and social moments, Strawberry Banana delivers a familiar, crowd-pleasing profile that stays smooth from spark to finish. Sweet without being overpowering and packed into convenient 60’s, this one is a go-to for anyone looking for a flavour-first infused pre-roll with a smooth, creamy finish. Smooth, fruity, and always a good idea.

variants.body_html: GLAZED Wild Cherries Liquid Diamond vape delivers waves of ripe, juicy cherries with bright red fruit sweetness. variants.title: Grape Infused PR 2 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Whether it’s a jelly, a juice or a bunch off the vine, Grape is nature's candy with a sour bite in a potent and flavourful pack of infused pre-rolls. Cannabis, ready to consume, whenever you need it—that's Standard Issue. Stripped of excess, honed to essentials, and designed to keep pace — not for show, but for real life. Consistent, dependable, and ready when you are. Standard Issue: everything you need, nothing you don't.

variants.title: Rainbow Driver PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: The Woody Nelson edition of the Rainbow Driver genetic was bred by Archive Seed Bank and grown in an indoor vertical farm using organic living soil. This high-THC cultivar is rich in terpenes, including Limonene, Beta-Myrcene, and Nerolidol and smells like super sweet gas. The plant’s dense, sticky buds are cured for a minimum of three weeks and never irradiated.

variants.title: Big White PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Five pre-rolls packed with Big White, a cross of West Coast old school favourites, The White x Big Bud. This powerful yet balanced indica produces sweet buds that deliver flavours of icing sugar and berries, with light floral and cakey notes from dominant terpenes caryophyllene, myrcene, and bisabolol. Pure BC bud, rolled with precision and ready to burn.

variants.title: Sugar Haze
variants.body_html: Grown organically in BC, Organic Sugar Haze is a carefully cultivated sativa, hang-dried and slow-cured to enhance aroma and potency. With sweet berry and sugar notes layered over gentle haze undertones, this strain delivers a smooth, aromatic experience that’s both rich and satisfying.

variants.title: Star Blasters PR 20 x 0.4 g
variants.body_html: Harness the energy of the sun with Star Blasters, a pack of 20 pre-rolls filled with a rotating selection of premium Hybrid strains. Designed for those who want a long-lasting journey through the galaxy, Star Blasters offer a harmonious blend of effects-uplifting yet calming, energizing yet grounding. Like orbiting a brilliant star, these pre-rolls provide a balanced high that's both radiant and soothing. Perfect for day or night, Star Blasters let you bask in the light of a stellar experience, wherever your travels take you.

variants.title: Snicker-Giggle-Chuckle-Bums Variety Pack PR 15 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Unleash a symphony of snickers with Violet Tourist's Snicker-Giggle-Chuckle-Bums - the ultimate comedy caravan for giggle fiends. This riotous multi-pack rolls deep with 15 x 1.0g PreRoll Joints (PRJs) (15g total): 5 indica, 5 sativa, 5 hybrid - a balanced barrage of belly laughs across the spectrum. You may laugh so hard your cat defects in your bed.

variants.title: Kush Cookies
variants.body_html: Since day one Kush Cookies has taken up some serious real estate in the 3Saints greenhouse because tray after tray it delivers. In fact, they’ve put 80 tons into the world since 2021. This powerful indica comes to you via a careful cross of GMO Cookies and OZ Kush. The dense light green buds are caked in trichomes and put off a powerful aroma that’s sure to perfume any room no matter the size. Think roasted herbs, cracked pepper, a twist of citrus, and that unmistakable Kush dankness. Don’t be fooled by the size of these buds, post grind they’ll turn into mountains on the tray. Comfortable being rolled and taken to go or sacrificed in a bowl, Kush Cookies hits the mark every time guaranteed.

variants.title: Berry Tundra Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: One part blue. Two parts berry. All parts frosted and sweet to increase the delicious bite and intensity of Berry Tundra. Bigger, Bolder and loaded with liquid diamonds! G.A. Liquid diamond 510 Carts takes a signature botanical terpene infused distillate and adds liquid diamonds to deliver the most potent line up yet. Now with the G.A. flavours you love. General Admission liquid diamond vape blend is primarily composed of liquid diamonds, with just enough distillate added to ensure performance and stability of the product.

variants.title: Jean Guy CBD PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: A CBD-rich cross of the legendary, Sativa Jean Guy strain. Experience the best of both worlds with Orchid CBD's Balanced Jean Guy pre-rolls. This sativa captures the famously bright, fragrant floral appeal of the original, but tames the intense THC potency with a near 1:1 ratio of THC and CBD.

variants.title: Purple Fog
variants.body_html: Purple Fog is a stunning purple indica descending from potent Purple Punch and Jungle Cake lineage. From a large family tree of head-turners, this purple takes the cake with its deep violet colours that run all the way to the stem, and striking lilac and lavender hues on the grind. It delivers aromas of smooth florals, woodsy pine and sweet, savoury herbs, with a healthy punch of gas and spice from dominant terpenes limonene, linalool, and beta-pinene. The plant produces dense, frosty deep purple colas with sharp emerald leaves outlined in dark purple. Its grape-shaped nugs are solid and compact, frosted in sticky golden trichomes. Pure BC bud, hand-harvested and hang-dried. Available for a limited-time-only.

variants.title: Fruit Joy Live Rosin Infused PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: This live rosin infused pre-roll is made of Fruit Joy flower and Fruit Joy live rosin. The Fruit Joy genetic was bred in Spain by Grateful Seeds from GGF's award-winning Barbara Bud (DJ Komfa selection) and a fantastic Papaya selection from La Kalada. Grateful Seeds took these two award-winning strains and created the Fruit Joy, which itself has gone on to international fame as an incredibly flavourful and fruit-forward hash and rosin. This cold cured live rosin comes from sungrown fresh-frozen flower grown in BC's Cowichan Valley and the flower was produced by GGF at our Duncan BC micro-cultivation site. These live rosin infused pre-rolls pack a flavourful fruit-forward punch. Available for a limited-time-only.

variants.title: Organic Lillooet Gold Straight Cut PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Organic Lillooet Gold pre-rolls are rolled, not stuffed. True roll technology ensures a straight cut pre-roll that burns evenly top to bottom. Refined over the last 25 years Organic Lillooet Gold is a true legacy cultivar. Known for its reliability and distinctive character. The lineage traces back to Texada Timewarp, Rene, Seaweed and Concrete. Certified Organic and sun grown to perfection deep in the mountains near Lillooet BC. Available for a limited-time-only.

variants.title: Red Congo Liquid Diamonds Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Red Congo Liquid Diamonds 510 cartridge by Jonny Chronic is a sativa-dominant strain with 95% THC and minimal CBD. Made with liquid diamonds and botanical terpenes, this vape offers a cannabis forward experience with a hint of strawberry. Greentank makes Jonny Chronic cartridges which are compatible with most generic 510-threaded batteries. Red Congo Liquid Diamonds is dominant in limonene, linalool, and myrcene. Red Congo Liquid Diamonds should be stored in a cool dry place in the upright position when not in use.

variants.title: Nebula Kush Smalls
variants.body_html: When the stars align, Nebula Kush drifts into view. This indica-dominant flower carries the lineage of Afghan Skunk and Nebula, a cross rooted in earth yet glowing with the pull of the cosmos. Its buds are dense and frost-laden, blending herbal spice with skunky undertones and a subtle sweetness that lingers like stardust. Nebula Kush feels both celestial and grounded, like a distant galaxy, a cultivar that is anchored in true Kush tradition.

variants.title: Alpha Blue
variants.body_html: Named for its standout outline, Alpha Blue carries Blue Dream and NYC Diesel in a Sativa-dominant classic expression. The flavour opens with sweet blueberry and bright citrus, followed by a sharp fuel slice. It is as fruit-forward as it gets, set against a hazy background. Its slightly elongated Sativa bud structure features intense emerald notes. The best of its two legendary parents, that’s why it’s called the Alpha, the top blue.

variants.title: Guava Biscotti PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Happy Hour Organic Guava Biscotti pre-rolls showcase a flavour-forward hybrid bred from a Guava Biscotti backcross, offering creamy dessert notes complemented by bold earthy, peppery, and woody characteristics. The result is a smooth, full-bodied smoke with depth and complexity. Grown by Coast Mountain Cannabis in a certified organic living soil system, this small-batch flower is cultivated using regenerative practices and enriched with in-house microbial teas made from glacial water sourced from the Pemberton Ice Cap. Cold cured to preserve terpenes and hand manicured for quality, each pre-roll is straight-cut and precisely packed to ensure optimal moisture and a consistent, even burn throughout.

variants.title: Cosmic Cherry PR  1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Cosmic Cherry 1g Pre-Roll showcases Valhalla Flwr’s award-winning genetics (Wedding Cake x Wedding Crasher), delivering bold cherry sweetness with rich, earthy depth. This indica-leaning favourite offers a potent, full-bodied experience with a smooth, slow, even burn. Crafted from 100% milled whole flower — no trim or shake — using small-batch, indoor BC flower that is hang-dried, hand-trimmed, and cured 3+ weeks. Each joint is hand finished to ensure quality and consistency. 2nd place Unicorn Cup winner, finished with Integra Boost for lasting freshness.

variants.title: Trifecta PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: This three-strain pre-roll pack showcases Valhalla Flwr’s top 3 standout genetics: Cosmic Cherry, Rainbow Lava, and Pebble Punch. Each half-gram pre-roll is crafted from 100% milled whole flower — no trim or shake — for a smooth, non-irritating smoke and consistent burn. Expect fruit-forward, balanced, and creamy profiles across the lineup. Made from small-batch, indoor BC flower, hang-dried, hand-trimmed, and cured 3+ weeks. Each joint is hand finished to ensure quality and consistency. Includes Integra Boost for freshness. Available for limited-time-only.

variants.title: Sour Animal Live Rosin
variants.body_html: Brindle Farms Sour Animal Live Rosin is a bold, solventless expression crafted from fresh-frozen flower and expertly pressed to preserve its natural terpene profile. Available for a limited-time-only with sharp diesel and sour citrus notes lead, balanced by a subtle earthy sweetness. This small-batch rosin delivers a clean, pronounced flavour highlighting Brindle Farms’ commitment to premium, carefully made extracts.

variants.title: Garlic Haze PR 20 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Garlic Haze crosses Garlic Bud and Haze, delivering a bold flavour and aromatic experience with high-THC potency. Expect prominent garlic on the nose, paired with sweet citrus notes and spice. Rich forest green buds are coated in amber trichomes & bright orange pistils.

variants.body_html: Watermelon gives you refreshing sugar water, light citrus and sweetness. Easy to enjoy in a portable and all-around dependable all-in-one vape. variants.title: Vipers Venom Diamond Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Viper’s Venom is a diamond dusted, diamonds infused indica pre-roll that’s as bold as it is flavourful. Each puff bursts with the sweetness of watermelon and strawberry with a creamy coconut finish.

variants.title: West Coast Cookies
variants.body_html: For the first time, the remake is going to be better than the original. Spinach® West Coast Cookies is a new take on a classic strain making for a super flavourful and potent cultivar. A cross between GMO #12 and SFV OG, it has earthy, piney, and citrusy flavours with aromas pumped up from terpenes like myrcene, limonene, and caryophyllene. This powerhouse cross is a flavourful strain, with pumped up potency.

variants.title: Strawberried Liquid Diamonds Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Get Strawberried! This sativa-dominant all-in-one vape bursts with juicy strawberry flavour and sky-high potency. It’s packed with ultra-pure liquid diamonds extract and botanical terpenes, delivering a rip-roaring 94–97% THC.

variants.title: Bubble Up
variants.body_html: Welcome to the world of Bubble Up, a unique indica-dominant cultivar from Tribal, now in a generous 14g Whole Flower format. This extraordinary strain is the result of exceptional genetics (The Zoap and Deluxe), producing trichome covered, premium whole flowers. Bubble Up is celebrated for its truly distinct kush profile, with subtle hints of gas and an essence of Zoap.

variants.title: Yocan UNI 3.0 Battery – Rosy
variants.body_html:
Custom Fits. Smooth Hits. Endless Style.

The Yocan UNI 3.0 isn’t your average 510-thread battery—this little powerhouse is all about customization and smooth vaping sessions. Whether you’re a seasoned vaper or just starting out, the UNI 3.0 makes life easy with its adjustable height and width controls, fitting most cartridges like a glove. Plus, with a sleek display and multiple user interface options, it’s built to match your vibe.

And the best part? It comes in seven awesome colorways—whether you’re into classic black or feeling bold with rose gold, there’s a UNI 3.0 for you.

Key Features & Benefits
Customizable Cartridge Fit – Adjust the height and width for a snug, secure fit on most cartridges (11-16mm diameter).
Three UI Modes – Switch between Classic, Planet, and Shiny Cat modes on a bright, animated 1.93" display.
Wide Voltage Range – Fine-tune your sessions with adjustable voltage from 1.8V to 4.2V.
650mAh Battery – Compact but powerful, lasts all day and recharges fast with Type-C charging in just one hour.
15-Second Safety Cutoff – Built-in protection for safer, worry-free vaping.
Compact and Portable – Only 75mm tall, lightweight, and easy to carry anywhere.
Available in 7 Colorways – Black, Green, Light Blue, Rose Gold, Rosy, Violet, White.

The Yocan UNI 3.0 Battery is your ticket to effortless, customizable vaping. Clean look, smooth hits, and serious versatility in one pocket-friendly device.

variants.title: Yocan Orbit Concentrate Vaporizer - Blue
variants.body_html: The Yocan Orbit Vaporizer Pen is a small and portable concentrate vaporizer. This device has a 1700mAh battery to keep you powered up all day, but when it is time to charge, you can relax knowing a USB-C charger is the best way to get the job done quickly. It only takes 2.5 hours to fully charge the Orbit when plugged into a wall adapter. This awesome wax pen uses terp pearls, a quartz ball that creates better air flow, even heating and optimal concentrate vaporization. These adorable pearls sit in a coil-less quartz cup, which also adds to the stellar vaporization. The Orbit features a rotary cap on the mouthpiece to help achieve better air flow as well. Yocan has altered their preset temperatures to be the best temperature for vaping wax, now between 3.4 and 4.0 volts since the addition of the pearls. The Orbit also has a 10-second preheat to help heat up hardened wax. The stainless-steel body is lightweight and heavy duty for a premium feel.

variants.title: Royal Press Live Rosin
variants.body_html: Royal Press by HighXotic is a smooth, flavour-forward live rosin made for those who appreciate clean, high-quality extracts. Pure, potent, and true to the plant, Royal Press is all about enjoying live rosin the way it’s meant to be — simple, refined, and satisfying.

variants.title: Poppin' Peach Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge

Designed to uplift your senses with its sativa-dominant profile, this cartridge is perfect for those looking for a delightful burst of peachy flavour. Immerse yourself in the world of Platinum Vape and discover the magic of Poppin' Peach, a cartridge that promises to make your vaping experience truly unforgettable.

variants.title: Space Cake PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Space Cake is a sativa strain with Snow Lotus and GSC lineage that has a terpene profile of caryophyllene, farnesene and humulene. With hints of vanilla and berries, this is a fruity cultivar.

variants.title: Gas Pack PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Dom Jackson’s legendary Gas Pack is now rolled up. This pack features smooth burning pre-rolls crafted from quality whole flower. Never trim, never shake. Each pre-roll delivers bold gassy flavour layered with creamy undertones, offering a rich and consistent session from start to finish.

variants.title: Tropicanna
variants.body_html: Tropicanna — a legacy Tangie × GSC sativa-dominant hybrid. This famed lineage brings together Tangie’s vibrant citrus character with GSC’s potency and balance. Expect an explosion of juicy tangerine, orange, tropical fruit, and pineapple in every puff, rounded out with subtle earthy undertones. Grown locally in Delta, BC, our bud is hand-harvested, hang-dried, hand-packed, and perfectly cured to bring out its full flavour and character.

variants.title: El Jefe
variants.body_html: This strain stays LowKey by crossing indica-dominant Animal Mints x Sherb Cake lineages. A sweet aroma of smooth peppermint and tropical flowers is followed by jazzy sweet notes of a tangy, tart cake flavour. El Jefe showcases dense, resinous buds with a deep green hue, often tinged with shades of purple. Its trichome coverage is also worth talking about.

variants.title: Pacific Island Punch THC:CBG 1:1 Soda
variants.body_html: Pacific Island Punch delivers a zesty South Pacific citrus profile, bursting with sweet lime and sour orange, balanced by juicy peach and passionfruit notes. Crafted with real juice and nano-infused for fast onset, each can now features a balanced 10mg THC + 10mg CBG blend. variants.title: Frosted Gumbo PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Frosted Gumbo is an indica-dominant cultivar with a marvelous gassy, vanilla nose. Having a sweet and intense flavor, Frosted Gumbo blends both sweet and spicy flavors, it's truly one of a kind! Top terpenes include Caryophyllene, Myrcene, and Limonene.

variants.title: Blue Thai
variants.body_html: When you're with the buds and it's time for a sesh, all you need is blue skies and some Blue Thai. Spinach Blue Thai is our ode to everything awesome about dried flower. Our take on this cultivar is a straight sativa strain with an undeniable, blast off level of potency that'll blow your mind from the first puff. We're also highlighting the classic fruity, skunky, and citrusy flavours and aromas that come from a puckering lineage of Sour Blueberry and Lemon Thai through a trio of familiar yet harmonious terpenes - limonene, caryophyllene, and humulene. So, the next time you pop this in a bowl or roll a joint, get ready to say, 'My, oh my, that's some dope Blue Thai.'

variants.title: Garlic Mintz
variants.body_html: Say hello to Garlic Mintz bred by Cabin Fever - the lovechild of GMO x Animal Mints that's equal parts pungent powerhouse and smooth operator. These buds come dense, blanketed in thick, sparkling frost, with that unmistakable chem-garlic edge that hits the nose in an unforgettable way.

variants.title: Porto Leche Ceramic Tip PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Sometimes tough jobs require a simple tool. Having your path lit makes the journey so much more enjoyable. Introducing the Tribal Porto Leche Ceramic Tip pre-roll. Starting with whole buds, we first mill it into the perfect consistency for burning, then pack it into a cone that is finished with a ceramic crutch and a silicone stopper. A single strain whole flower pre-roll to light your way. The Tribal Porto Leche Ceramic Tip pre-roll is the tool for the job, no matter the job.

variants.title: BC Organic Tangerine Sunrise PR 5 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: It’s sativa season with BC Organic Tangerine Sunrise. A cross of Hawaiian Sunrise x Tangenesia, this cultivar shines with bright green buds, orange pistils, and frosty trichomes. Aromas of sweet orange peel mingle with citrus and funk, evoking fresh-squeezed orange juice. Grown in organic living soil, milled to perfection, and packed in our organic hemp cones.

Inspired by a strain with a Kushberries and White RNTZ lineage, this all-in-one vape will be the experience you've been looking for. '

variants.title: 60+ Peach Pony Diamond Dipped Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Inspired by Canada's Wild West with real value, high potency and quality cannabis. Boasting a blend of whole flower, THCA diamonds and our sweet Peach Pony flavour, these blunts are diamond coasted and ceramic tipped. There's a new smoke show in town with high THC.

variants.title: Peach Mango Hi-Fi Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Peach Mango is sticky sweet nectar with bright notes of tart and sour. The taste of summer is everlasting when these two juice heavyweights combine. G.A. Diamond Infused Pre-Rolls are made with our trusted base of quality milled whole flower and boosted with a custom infusion of THCa, finished with our triple-distilled distillate and kief coating. With over 44% THC, unlock better moments with the flavours you love dialed-up.

variants.title: Pufferz Peach Iced Tea Disposable Vape
variants.body_html:
Spinach PUFFERZ Peach Iced Tea isn't just a vape, but a fun, multi-sensory experience stuffed into one puffy device. Puff, Puff, don't pass on this all-in-one vape that's designed to delight your senses and deliver bigger, more potent hits thanks to our liquid diamonds infusion. We've dialled up the peachy flavour notes so that each time you sesh, you're puffing in style with this new vape design.

A refreshing draw of thirst-quenching flavours that'll put you in full- on chill mode. Spinach PUFFERZ Peach Iced Tea is filled with fresh peachy and iced tea flavour notes puffing their way through your session. Liquid diamonds shine and shimmer in this vape, like the glistening of condensation on a delicious glass of peach iced tea making for a 98.1% THC potency. Inspired by a strain with a Peach RNGZ and GLTO #33 lineage, enjoy a refreshing tasting experience with each puffy hit.'

variants.title: Super Lemon Haze
variants.body_html: Divvy's Super Lemon Haze milled flower is a ready-to-consume SKU for your stash.

variants.title: Space Cake
variants.body_html: Divvy's got you with our Space Cake strain in your flower bag. Space Cake is a Hybrid strain with Snow Lotus and Girl Scout Cookies lineage that has a terpene profile of Fenchol, Caryophyllene, and Terpineol. With hints of vanilla & berries, this fruity cultivar is your new go-to.

variants.title: Chocolate Blunt PR 1 x 1.25 g
variants.body_html: This is what a blunt was always supposed to taste like. Molten Chocolate lays down heavy cocoa flavor with a creamy OG finish. Rich, loud, and unapologetically flavourful - built for smokers who miss when blunts actually tasted good.

variants.title: Thunder Zkittlez
variants.body_html: Grown organically in BC, Organic Thunder Zkittlez is a hybrid strain, hang dried and slow-cured to lock in its rich aroma and effects. Bursting with bold, fruit-forward flavors, Thunder Zkittlez delivers sweet berry, candy-like Zkittlez notes, and a subtle hint of glue. Smooth and flavorful, this hybrid is a fun, flavorful choice for any session.

variants.title: Cherry Lemonade Dmds Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: GLAZED Cherry Lemonade Liquid Diamond vape delivers a blend of sweet cherries and zesty lemon. This high potency vape is as refreshing as a frosty pink lemonade on a hot summer day, blending juicy cherry sweetness with punchy lemonade flavour. The BOLD choice for when distillate vapes aren't enough. Rechargeable and ready to enjoy right out of the bag.

variants.title: Guava Haze Infused PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: The Platinum Guava Haze Diamond Infused and Dusted pre-roll is a sativa dominant hybrid, known for its Gelato phenotype and sweet and fruity terpenes.

variants.title: Blue Razzleberry Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Blue Razzleberry brings a shock of refreshing blueberry that makes our classic sweet and sour raspberry flavour better than ever.

variants.title: Sweet Pucker
variants.body_html: Crack open Sweet Pucker and unleash a mouthwatering jolt of tangy and sweet flavours inspired by a nostalgic tart treat. This bold mix of lemon, lime and orange lands with a fizzy, puckering sensation that wakes up every tastebud. With no cannabis aftertaste, every sip is bright and fruity. Infused with 10 mg of THC, 10 mg of CBG and guarana.

variants.title: Myrtle Beach PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Our team phenohunted this beauty in house. Created by Seed Junky Genetics from the Malibu x Cap Junky cross, Myrtle Beach brings a vibrant burst of citrus, tropical candy sweetness and warm spice that lingers on the nose and palate. Because it’s the right thing to do, all our pre-rolls are made exclusively from whole flower, rolled in small batches into slim cones and hand packaged in glass tubes with cork tops.

variants.title: Animal Face PR 14 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: At Carmel, making a great pre-roll means starting off with quality whole flower and producing in small batches. Each of our pre-rolls is hand filled into a slim cone and packaged in a portable tin with a humidity pack. Our Animal Face pre-rolls are made w

variants.title: Pink Pavlova
variants.body_html: Named for a dessert that never plays it soft, Pink Pavlova blends Pink Cookies and Strawberry Pavé into a syrupy indica dominant sensation with sugar coated swagger. The flavour is all berry compote and gas, folded into cake crust, cream and crushed pepper. Sticky buds sparkle with green and violet hues, like a meringue spun out of smoke. A bold BC-bred treat that's like dessert and lingers like a dream.

variants.title: Myrtle Beach
variants.body_html: Our team phenohunted this beauty in house. Created by Seed Junky Genetics from the Malibu x Cap Junky cross, Myrtle Beach brings a vibrant burst of citrus, tropical candy sweetness and warm spice that lingers on the nose and palate. The buds are dense, drenched in resin and highlighted by striking orange pistils. Because it’s the right thing to do, all of our flower is hang dried, hand trimmed, slow cold cured and hand packaged. We keep it fresh and terpene-rich by sealing it in nitrogen flushed pouches with a humidity pack inside. Non-irradiated, obviously.

variants.title: Diamonds In Dubai Infused PR 1 x 2 g
variants.body_html: Tenzo’s Diamonds in Dubai is a handcrafted quality infused blunt made with BLKMKT's limited Peanut Butter Mac flower (Peanut Butter Breath x MAC), elevated by Quebec pressed hash and THCa diamonds. This quality pre-roll delivers a potent, slow burn with a terpene profile inspired by the richness and exotic flavours of Dubai. Packed into an elegant ceramic tipped straight cut hemp wrap designed to maximize flavour and a smooth, slow burn.

variants.title: Cuban Linx PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: The diverse richness of exotic terpenes found in Cuban Linx give these buds an invigorating lemony aroma that is accentuated by hints of gassy diesel and a touch of spiciness. A truly refreshing strain, Cuban Linx was bred by crossing TK Skunk and Trigerian. The result is a huge bud with a shape that resembles corn on the cob. Tribal's Cuban Linx pre-rolls are produced with nothing but hang dried, slow cured, whole buds which have been consistently ground, and wrapped in premium RAW organic hemp cones. Enjoy pre-rolls packaged in eco-friendly tin tubes.

variants.title: Cabana Cannabis Co Rolling Tray - Coco - Medium
variants.body_html:
"Kick back and roll in style with the Cabana Cannabis Co Coco Rolling Tray! Featuring a vibrant tropical design with a cool coconut graphic, this medium tray is the perfect blend of fun and functionality. Whether you're enjoying a solo sesh or rolling with friends, this rolling tray adds a little island vibe to your routine while keeping everything neat and organized.

Key Features & Benefits:

Tropical & Bold Design: With its colourful coconut and palm tree graphic, this tray brings an island flair to your rolling space, giving you a laid-back vibe every time you use it.

Ideal Size for Rolling: The medium size gives you more than enough space for easy and efficient rolling, leaving room for all your extras.

Sturdy & Durable: Made from strong, high-quality metal, this rolling tray is built to last and withstand all your rolling needs.

Easy to Clean: The smooth surface makes cleaning a breeze—just wipe it down and you’re ready to roll again!

Perfect Gift: Looking for a fun and thoughtful gift for a cannabis enthusiast? This vibrant tray is the way to go!

Add some island-inspired style to your rolling game with the Cabana Cannabis Co Coco Rolling Tray—because every roll should feel like a vacation!"

variants.title: Fully Blasted Peach Passionfruit CBN:THC Gummies
variants.body_html: SOURZ by Spinach® Fully Blasted Peach Passionfruit 1:1 CBN and THC gummies feature a combination of luscious peach and tart passionfruit flavours. With a balanced blend of 10mg THC and 10mg CBN per piece, this dual-flavoured gummy is over-the-top with natural flavours and blasted with sour crystals. Enjoy 10 gummies per pack.

variants.title: Grape Gingerale Live Rosin 10THC 20CBG
variants.body_html: Grape Ginger Ale is back, but now with 20mg of CBG! Juicy grape leads the way, finishing with the crisp bite of authentic ginger ale. Made with real grape concentrate and BC grown whole-plant, fresh-frozen live rosin. Like all other Sweet Tooth products, it is proudly crafted on Vancouver Island.

variants.title: Grapefruit Zero 25 CBG 25 CBD
variants.body_html: Two powerhouse cannabinoids, 25mg CBD and 25mg CBG, in a zero-sugar grapefruit soda that actually tastes amazing. Sweet and tangy with that crisp, refreshing citrus bite you know and love. Nano-emulsion technology makes for faster absorption. Like all other Sweettooth products, it is proudly crafted on Vancouver Island.

variants.title: Drippyz Multi Pack Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Get ready for a flavour-blasted experience with the Drippyz Infused Pre-Roll Multipack is a convenient 3x0.5g format. Featuring infused pre-rolls in three bold flavours: Mango Tango, Cocolious, and Dragon Fruit. Each pre-roll is loaded with liquid diamond-infused premium TLP flower strains you’ve come to know and love. For an extra kick, they’re dusted with a premium blonde kief coating that amplifies potency and botanical terpenes to amplify flavour — creating a powerful, tasty experience from start to finish. Enjoy a new level of taste and strength with every Drippyz pre-roll in this unique assortment!

variants.title: Blue Razz Lemonade Liquid Diamond Charged AIO Vape
variants.body_html: BOXHOT PRESENTS: Blue Razz Lemonade, a 1g hybrid all-in-one vape featuring a colossal dose of THC and charged with some of the purest liquid diamonds on the market, together with distillate and botanical terpenes. Rewind and press play on potency, belting out with a digital LED screen and roaring performance, this beauty hits big with tart blue raspberry flavour. Every all-in-one is equipped with rechargeable USB-C technology, so they won't run out of juice before you do.

variants.title: Frozen Watermelon Liquid Diamond Blend AIO Vape
variants.body_html: An ice storm hit the sweetest watermelons of the bay. Frozen Watermelon captures the delicate summer fruit with a refreshing finish from the freezer. Loaded with liquid diamonds! G.A. 1g USB-C Rechargeable All-In-One Vapes takes their signature botanical terpene-infused distillate and adds liquid diamonds to deliver the most potent line up yet. Now with the G.A. flavours you love. General Admission liquid diamond vape blend is primarily composed of liquid diamonds, with just enough distillate added to ensure performance and stability of the product.

variants.title: Mix Tape Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: The MixTape Vape is a crafty concoction of cured resin made from a variety of R&D cultivars grown over the past year. Reaching into the Sweetgrass vault for the deeper cuts, this one-of-a-kind blend was extracted from nothing but whole flower by friends at Common Roots Extracts on Vancouver Island. The result is a literal melting pot — a 1g cart of pure, golden resin that delivers a rich, smooth, and complex smoke that hits with fresh pine, tangy citrus, and subtle floral notes. Imagine the classic mix tape — those whimsical mystery tours through hidden gems and near hits. The Mix Tape Vape is a nod in that direction, conjuring a sense of nostalgia that harkens back to the days gone by when you would add a bit of this and a bit of that to a blank cassette to create a musical journey that was all your own.

variants.title: Pink Kush Liquid Diamond Charged AIO Vape
variants.body_html: BOXHOT PRESENTS: Pink Kush, a 1g indica-dominant all-in-one vape featuring a colossal dose of THC and charged with some of the purest liquid diamonds on the market, together with distillate, and botanical terpenes. Rewind and press play on potency, belting out with a digital LED screen and roaring performance, this beauty hits big with that classic gas that fueled a legend. Every all-in-one is equipped with rechargeable USB-C technology, so they won't run out of juice before you do.

variants.title: Blueberry Avalanche Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Blueberry Avalanche Diamond Vape by Boomstick is built around high-potency liquid diamonds derived from indoor-grown flower, delivering strong THC levels through quality live resin inputs. Infused with blueberry-forward botanical terpenes, it offers a bold, flavour-driven profile while maintaining a consistent and reliable formulation. Free from distillate, this vape stays true to Boomstick’s focus on potency, value, and clean input sources.

variants.title: Peachy Pie PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Peachy Pie is a fruity, indica-dominant strain from Peach Cobbler and Cherry Pie. This cultivar delivers sweet, fruit-forward notes layered with diesel and earthy hints. These large buds are coated in shimmering trichomes. Whole flower and hand crafted, just the way your pre-rolls should be. BOLD Craft Cannabis flower is indoor grown, small batch, hang dried, slow cured, and hand trimmed.

variants.title: Live Rosin 2:1 THC/CBC Tablets
variants.body_html: Live Rosin 2:1 THC/CBC capsules offer a simple, measured way to explore a cannabinoid-forward format made with live rosin. Each tablet contains 10mg of THC and 5mg of CBC in a clear 2:1 ratio, delivering consistent cannabinoid content in an easy-to-use tablet form. With 25 capsules per pack, this format is designed for consumers who value precision, clarity and straightforward dosing. Crafted with live rosin inputs and presented in a clean tablet format, these tablets focus on consistency and ease—no added complexity, just a balanced cannabinoid ratio in a compact, reliable pack.

variants.title: Garlic Haze
variants.body_html: Garlic Haze crosses Garlic Bud and Haze, delivering a bold flavour and aromatic experience with high-THC potency. Expect prominent garlic on the nose, paired with sweet citrus notes and spice. Rich forest green buds are coated in amber trichomes & bright orange pistils.

variants.title: Britscotti Blunt PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Originally bred by Cookies, Dank of England pheno-hunted and produced this cut, crafting Britscotti — a cross of Girl Scout Cookies and Gelato #25 x South Florida OG. A smooth, yet extremely potent indica with a distinct aroma and flavour profile packed into a straight-cut ceramic-tipped BLNT. Experience notes of sweet, buttery biscuits and hints of lemon. Flavour translates with a slight nuttiness that's reminiscent of espresso. As always, we only use whole handcrafted flower in our pre-rolls, which are packed by centrifuge, dutch folded, and placed into a recyclable glass tube with a custom Integra Boost pack to ensure perfect moisture control.

variants.title: Lemon Cherry Popperz
variants.body_html: Make your next session pop off with new Good Supply Lemon Cherry Popperz flower, a tangy-sweet sativa bred from Ice Cream Cake x Rntz and Lemon Cherry Gelato, bursting with orchard-fresh flavour. A loud splash of gas leads the way, layered with fruity citrus and sharp pine. Go ahead and take a pop at Good Supply Lemon Cherry Popperz.

variants.title: Limelight Flower Petites
variants.body_html: At first glance, Limelight stands out from the crowd with its camera-worthy pyramidal nugs of summer greens and purple/pink hues. These sublime colours are ground zero for a profuse dusting of frost that evoke scenes of a sub-zero winter in the mountains. Bred by Wizard Trees and hunted and developed by our team, this sativa-dominant cut has a phenomenal structure that produces gorgeous dense flowers that make trimming a breeze. Where Limelight really starts to shine is in the breaking open of the bud when wafts of refreshing evergreen and earthy, sour citrus notes drift by. The dry pull yields tasty, creamy, slightly sweet and tangy flavour hits while the ignited experience leads with a sharp chem-like note of bitter orange peel that quickly dissipates with a soothing splash of freshly cut, sweet basil. Gelonade forward, the taste is exotic, complex and totally worth savouring...right down to the crisp apple-like finish.

variants.title: Unicorn Poop PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Unicorn Poop was hunted in-house and the result is a luxurious, indica-dominant phenotype of Unicorn Poop, by Thug Pug Genetics. From the iconic pairing of Sophisticated Lady and GMO, Unicorn Poop leaves a lasting impression; funky, sweet, and impossible to forget. Each inhale delivers a refined blend of sweet-and-sour citrus and berry, followed by a spicy, skunky, diesel finish that lingers on the palate.

variants.title: Garlic Haze
variants.body_html: Garlic Haze crosses Garlic Bud and Haze, delivering a bold flavour and aromatic experience with high-THC potency. Expect prominent garlic on the nose, paired with sweet citrus notes and spice. Rich forest green buds are coated in amber trichomes & bright orange pistils.

variants.title: Revelry - The Daytripper - Navy
variants.body_html:
Stay ready for wherever the day takes you with The Daytripper Smell Proof Crossbody Bag from Revelry. Built for everyday adventures, this compact yet spacious crossbody combines odor control, weather resistance, and smart organization in one sleek piece. Whether you’re navigating city streets, heading to a festival, or hitting the trails, The Daytripper keeps your essentials secure, accessible, and discreet. Designed with versatility in mind, it can be worn across your chest for quick access or on your back for comfortable all-day movement. Multiple compartments, interior organizers, and a lockable waterproof zipper help keep everything in place while Revelry’s signature Carbon Filter System works overtime to trap unwanted odors.

 

Key Features & Benefits
Carbon Filter System: Multi-layer odor filtration helps contain strong smells for discreet travel
Rubber-Backed Exterior: Water resistant construction adds durability and protection from the elements
Adjustable Crossbody Strap: Wear it comfortably across your chest or back for versatile everyday carry
Multi-Compartment Storage: Keeps accessories, essentials, and valuables neatly organized
Waterproof Lockable Zipper: Adds extra security while helping protect contents from moisture
Interior Divider & Pockets: Makes it easy to separate and access your gear
Easy Access Exterior Pocket: Convenient storage for grab-and-go essentials
Custom Protective Lining: Helps extend the life of the filter system while adding durability
Genuine Leather Accents & Metal Hardware: Premium finishing touches for a clean, elevated look
Compact Travel-Friendly Size: Spacious enough for daily essentials without feeling bulky

 

The Daytripper blends function, style, and discretion into a versatile carry piece built for everyday use and spontaneous adventures alike.

variants.title: Lunar Lychee Liquid Diamond Coated Infused PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Portal’s Lunar Lychee Diamond Infused Pre-Roll takes potency to a new dimension. Coated in THCA diamonds and clocking in at 40–48% THC, this indica hits with a slow-building gravitational pull for deep relaxation, a wave of warmth, and a subtle tingling that feels otherworldly. Asian pear, vanilla cream, and exotic lychee notes create a flavour profile engineered for pure indulgence that stays smooth and steady from spark to finish. Lunar Lychee isn’t just a pre-roll; it’s your platform to another realm.

variants.title: Facade PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Catch the sun while it lasts with Facade, a limited-edition hybrid crafted from a cross of Eye Candy x Apples & Bananas.  Turning up the heat at 24–30% THC, this uplifting, sociable, and euphoric strain is built for long days, late nights, and everything in between. Bursting with citrus, floral, and musky notes, its terpene profile of beta-caryophyllene, d-limonene, and linalool keeps the vibes bright and bold. Summer won’t last forever, and neither will this seasonal exclusive, so grab your 3x0.5g pack of pre-rolls before they’re gone.

variants.title: Cherry Picker Lemonade Liquid Diamond Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: These pre-rolls are precisely crafted pre-rolls infused with flawless liquid diamonds — a slapshot of flavour. Each one is coated in a layer of fresh kief made from the same top-quality cannabis we grow ourselves and put into every pre-roll. Our pre-rolls are for new and diehard cannabis fans. By Canadians, for Canadians.
