variants.body_html: These pre-rolls are precisely crafted pre-rolls infused with flawless liquid diamonds — a slapshot of flavour. Each one is coated in a layer of fresh kief made from the same top-quality cannabis we grow ourselves and put into every pre-roll. Our pre-rolls are for new and diehard cannabis fans. By Canadians, for Canadians.

variants.title: Berry Tundra Hi-Fi Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: One part blue. Two parts berry. All parts frosted and sweet to increase the delicious bite and intensity of Berry Tundra. G.A. Diamond Infused Pre-Rolls are made with our trusted base of quality milled whole flower and boosted with a custom infusion of THCa, finished with our triple-distilled distillate and kief coating. With over 38% THC, unlock better moments with the flavours you love dialed-up.

variants.title: Sour Green Apple Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Crisp, sour and classic to the core, that's Sour Green Apple. No fuss flavour and convenience in a pack of infused pre-rolls. Cannabis ready to consume - whenever you need it. That's Standard Issue. Stripped of excess, honed to essentials, and designed to keep pace - not for show, but for real life. Consistent, dependable, and ready when you are. Standard Issue: everything you need, nothing you don't.

variants.title: Cherimoya What Whipped Diamonds
variants.body_html: With a sharp edge, this bold and whipped favourite hits right away. This profile isn't here to play it safe, with a constant finish that stays true.

variants.title: Cherry Ztripez PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Cherry Ztripez hits like the first bite of a ripe cherry, with flavour that’s sweet, tangy, and impossible to ignore. Born from Lemon Cherry x Z Animal, this high-impact indica blends bold sour cherry and gassy depth with a smooth, aromatic pine finish. Anchored by beta-caryophyllene, linalool, and alpha-humulene terpenes, the flavour profile is vibrant and layered, delivering sweet indulgence with a side of gas. Cherry Ztripez offers a balanced, flavour-forward experience that will make you want to reach for seconds. Grown in laboratory-grade, strain-specific rooms, the flower is hang-dried, cold-cured, carefully milled and hand-packaged without irradiation. From first aroma to final ash, Cherry Ztripez is pure craft, available in a 1x1g blunt.

variants.title: Garlic Haze PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Garlic Haze crosses Garlic Bud x Haze and delivers a bold flavour & aromatic experience with high-THC potency. Expect prominent garlic on the nose, paired with sweet citrus notes and spice. Rich forest green buds are coated in amber trichomes & bright orange pistils.

variants.title: Garlic Haze PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Garlic Haze crosses Garlic Bud x Haze and delivers a bold flavour & aromatic experience with high-THC potency. Expect prominent garlic on the nose, paired with sweet citrus notes and spice. Rich forest green buds are coated in amber trichomes & bright orange pistils.

variants.title: Daze Off
variants.body_html:
Fade away into Staycation’s Daze Off. ☁️ 

Unwind with Daze Off Indica, a rotating selection of premium indica flower chosen for rich flavour, smooth smoke, and deeply relaxing effects. Each batch features a unique cultivar, offering fresh terpene profiles and aromas while delivering the same calming experience perfect for evenings, quiet nights, and slowing things down after a long day.

variants.title: Juicy Pineapple Blunt Infused PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Juicy Pineapples Diamond Infused Blunt delivers notes of ripe, juicy pineapples with bright tropical sweetness. This high potency hybrid blunt layers pineapples and golden nectar for a smooth, balanced smoke. Infused with high purity THC Diamonds and wrapped in a non-tobacco, nicotine-free tea leaf blunt wrap. The BOLD choice for when regular blunts aren’t enough.

variants.title: Drippyz Lemon GLTO Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Drippyz Lemon GLTO infused pre-rolls are bursting with gassy, sweet and citrusy notes. Each pre-roll is crafted from Sticky Bunz flower infused with liquid diamonds for high potency. These pre-rolls are delicately coated in a layer of blonde kief, amplifying both flavour and strength. From the first puff to the last, Drippyz Lemon GLTO delivers a bold blend of taste and power. Discover the fusion of intensity and flavour in every pre-roll.

variants.title: Midnight Sherb
variants.body_html: Midnight Sherb isn't here to play it safe. Smooth vanilla, sharp citrus, and deep, earthy grit come together in a sativa dominant ride built for the ones who don't follow maps, don't wait for daylight, and don't ask for permission. No gimmicks. No shortcuts. Just straight up handcrafted fire for those who ride after dark.

variants.title: Simply Milk Chocolate
variants.body_html: This convenient multi-pack of five Simply Milk Chocolate THC medallions are crafted with crave-worthy, creamy milk chocolate infused with 10mg pure THC. Made by two cancer-surviving sisters in beautiful BC.

variants.title: No.26 200's True Rosin Strawberry Cream Gummies
variants.body_html: Glenn's 200's contains 20 single gummy pouches of 10 mg each for a total of 200 mg THC in every carton! Each gummy is crafted with premium solventless hybrid rosin. Bringing together two delicious flavours, you'll get 10 strawberry cream gummies and 10 orange cream. Rich strawberry meets silky cream in a dreamy throwback to old-school milkshake flavour and creamy orange nostalgia in every bite. Smooth, sweet and timeless.

variants.title: BC Guava Gas 2.0 Live Rosin
variants.body_html: BC Guava Gas is a top shelf Live Rosin Extract with 6% CBG and 7% Terpenes. Fresh pressed from Sara’s Secret, a cultivar that Rosebud Cannabis Farms genetically derived using DJ Short’s Blueberry and Chem ‘91 strains. Sungrown, synthetic-free in living soil by using regenerative farming methods. This full-spectrum pure rosin extract is all-natural and offers a unique terpene profile that transitions from a fruity, sweet guava to an exotic gassy undertone. The result is a mouthwatering hybrid for consumers to enjoy.

variants.title: BC Organic Tangerine Sunrise
variants.body_html: Rise & grind — it’s sativa season with BC Organic Tangerine Sunrise. A cross of Hawaiian Sunrise and Tangenesia, this cultivar shines with bright green buds, orange pistils, and frosty trichomes. Aromas of sweet orange peel mingle with citrus and funk, evoking fresh-squeezed orange juice on a quiet morning. Grown in organic living soil, each hand-trimmed bud is packed with care in our premium glass jars.

variants.title: Pineapple Apple Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Fruity, sweet and like an orchard transformed into a tropical oasis. Pineapple Apple is sweet, juicy and finishes with a burst of citrus. Bigger, Bolder and loaded with liquid diamonds! G.A. Liquid diamond 510 Carts takes our signature botanical terpene infused distillate and adds liquid diamonds to deliver our most potent line up yet. Now with 95%+ THC in the G.A. flavours you love.

variants.title: Flavour Bomb Grape Gonzo Liquid Diamonds Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Get ready for liquid diamond flavour with the Nugz Flavour Bomb Blueberry Rebel all-in-one vape, your portable juicy blueberry vape. Crafted for consumers who seek flavour and high potency, this all-in-one device delivers smooth and dense clouds made from liquid diamonds and fruity terpenes. Like its pre-roll counterpart, this vape was made to deliver bold berry notes and potency. No fillers, no fluff, just high purity, high THC flavour in a sleek device. Flavour first. Potency always. Nugz forever.

variants.title: Dark Moon Smalls
variants.body_html: This indica-dominant flower pulls from Dante’s Inferno × Pure Michigan × Ice Cream Cake, a layered build where dessert meets fuel. Dark Moon rises where the sky goes quiet. Notes lean into soft vanilla cake and a touch of spice, wrapped in a dense, frosted structure. It carries a rich duality, smooth yet weighty, where brightness fades into something darker.

variants.title: Rocket Fizz
variants.body_html: Bubble Kush Rocket Fizz is a throwback in full colour. A red-white-and-blue daydream that cracks open with bright cherry, melts into creamy citrus lime, and finishes on a cool blue raspberry fizz that lingers just long enough to pull you back in. It’s sweet, tart, and unapologetically nostalgic — like sticky fingers, sunburnt shoulders, and the last popsicle in the freezer. Familiar, electric, and dangerously easy to love. 10mg of THC.

variants.title: Orange Creamsicle CBD:CBG Gummies
variants.body_html: Premium, rapid onset, high quality, CBD & CBG TROPHY gummies. The package features large 6g gummies with a total of 5mg CBD and 5mg CBG per individual gummy with a total of 100mg of CBD and 100mg CBG per package. A nostalgic burst of citrusy sunshine, this orange creamsicle combines the bright, zesty flavor of juicy oranges with smooth, velvety vanilla cream. Every bite is a perfect balance of tangy and sweet—refreshingly light, delightfully creamy, and endlessly satisfying. These gummies are made with cannabis ingredients sourced from British Columbia and crafted using all-natural ingredients. They are vegan, gluten-free, sulphite-free, and enhanced with cannabis terpenes.

variants.title: Blue Maui PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Introducing Blue Maui, a sativa dominant budget friendly pre-roll by BC Doobies, crafted to bring tropical flavours to your session. A unique blend of Blue Dream x Maui Wowie, this cultivar delivers a delicious fusion of sweet blueberries, juicy pineapple and a hint of pine on the finish. Smooth and flavourful, Blue Maui delivers tropical island flavours without the premium price tag.

variants.title: Mystery Pack Live Rosin Gummies
variants.body_html: Embrace the unknown with our Mystery Pack! Each pack is a different surprise flavour of our delicious live rosin–infused edibles, featuring a rotating mix of mouthwatering flavours. You won’t know which ones you’ll get — but every bite delivers the same full-spectrum effects, clean ingredients, and premium live rosin.

variants.title: Bone Smashing
variants.body_html: Forged by Milk Bone and Mint Smash, causing a collision of dessert sweetness, cool mint, and crushing depth, Bone Smashing is a hybrid offering with a lingering impression that feels both familiar and devastating. Hardened nugs, heavy in the hand, show deep green tones shadowed by darker undertones, all sealed under a stout frost of trichomes. It first snaps like a proper mint-line Kush, followed by waves of sweet confection and a restrained gas punch, like something built to fracture the ordinary and leave only the essential behind.

variants.title: WTF?! Mystery Punch Liquid Diamond Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: This All-in-One vape is packed with juicy flavour and super-charged with liquid diamonds. But…what’s the flavour?! Here’s a hint: a concentrated hit of punchy fruit flavours. Super Toast grab n’ go rechargeable vapes are always ready, no battery required. Thier custom vape design is the stuff of ergonomic dreams, with the perfect palm-feel and super comfortable mouthpiece for long hauls and big fluffy clouds. Super Toast. Always Ready. Formulated using a liquid diamond blend and flavouring agents.

variants.title: Lemon Cherry Popperz PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Make your next session pop off with new Good Supply Lemon Cherry Popperz, a tangy-sweet sativa-dominant bred from Ice Cream Cake x Rntz and Lemon Cherry Gelato, bursting with orchard-fresh flavour. A loud splash of gas leads the way, layered with fruity citrus and sharp pine.

variants.title: Shucanna Georgia Pie PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: ShuCanna's Georgia Pie is a potent, slightly indica-dominant hybrid strain 60% indica/40% sativa created by Seed Junky Genetics by crossing Gelatti and Kush Mints. It features a sweet, earthy, and nutty, peach-cobbler aroma. Georgia Pie nugs have bunches of striking orange hairs and trichomes that are thick and tinted with purple, orange, and green. Hand trimmed, full plant hang dry and 45 day cure ensures that the utmost care and attention has been spent on every single bud! All ShuCanna products include a humidity pack to maintain freshness and correct moisture levels.

variants.title: Variety Pack Craft PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: The Variety Pack is a rotating sampler of craft pre-rolls from our favourite craft growers. Every pack includes 3 x 0.5g pre-rolls with 3 unique genetics, made with natural hemp paper, in a reusable doob tube.

variants.title: Neon Sunshine
variants.body_html: Neon Sunshine is a vibrant hybrid cultivar from Tribal, now available in a generous whole flower format. A cross of Zktlz x Falcon 9, Neon Sunshine delivers truly unique and beautiful buds that are dense, frosty and bright.​ A sweet and salty fusion finished with a subtle hint of fuel. Expect bright and tangy notes of tropical fruit and citrus that meet vibrant and frosty flowers.

variants.title: Gigantic Grape Hash Rip Strips
variants.body_html: SHRED Rip-Strips feature a 2g piece of hash, perfectly sliced into 10 easy-to-use strips. Gigantic Grape is the next bold new flavour, created by pressing botanical terps into hash to create a luscious and layered experience. SHRED Rip-Strip hash has an added twist of juicy flavour that’s perfect on its own or punching up the potency on a bowl or joint.

variants.title: Blue Razzberry Shotz
variants.body_html: Introducing SHRED Shotz! Sip smart with Blue Razzberry, a bold and juicy 65ml shot-sized beverage with a very fast onset time of just 15 minutes*. Our really fancy fast-acting nanoemulsion tech (FAST) breaks the cannabis infusion down into tiny particles so your body can more easily digest them. Pair all that with a blue raspberry flavour and you've got a super quick and delicious beverage. *Onset defined in terms of mean blood concentrations. Onset times may vary.

variants.title: Lemon Royale Rosin
variants.body_html: Lemon Royale Live Hash Rosin; aromas of dank lemon, grapefruit and a subtle blood orange sweetness. Flavours are a citrus bomb with a hint of 'trop. Sungrown in a greenhouse in living soil with a high level of care; hand harvested and crafted into solventless jar grade live hash rosin with the 73u-159u micron range.

variants.title: Permanent Chapo
variants.body_html: Permanent Chapo by Pistol and Paris is a powerful cultivar born from the fusion of Permanent Marker and Chapo OG, with genetics sourced by Goblin Medicine. This strain brings together bold flavour and unmistakable potency, delivering a rich, gassy profile layered with sharp fuel notes, dark earth, and a subtle chemical bite that lingers on the finish. Dense, resin-heavy buds showcase deep green tones with flashes of purple, wrapped in a thick frost of trichomes. On the inhale, Permanent Chapo hits with pungent OG gas and ink-like funk, followed by a smooth, earthy exhale that reflects its classic OG lineage.

variants.title: BC Organic Bling Blaow PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Two standout phenotypes emerge from this cross: deep purple buds reminiscent of Gastro Pop and vibrant green selections so frosty they appear almost white. Expect fruit-forward aromas with sweet candy notes and a touch of sharp polish. With steep, triangular buds and heavy trichome coverage, this cultivar stands out as one of the most visually striking in Coast Mountain’s lineup — now available in pre-roll format for the on-the-go consumer.

variants.title: Flavour Bomb Pink Berry Rush Liquid Diamonds Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: The Nugz Flavour Bomb Pinkberry Rush all-in-one vape delivers bright berry flavour with every pull backed by the high-THC Nugz is known for. Loaded with liquid diamonds and fruity terpenes, this all-in-one brings smooth and dense clouds with juicy pink berry flavour. No shortcuts, no cut corners, just high purity, potent, berry flavoured vapour in a sleek device. Flavour first. Potency always. Nugz forever.

variants.title: Blue Berry Rebel Diamond Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html:
Experience a blast of flavour and a burst of potency with Nugz Flavour Bomb Blue Berry Rebel Infused Pre-Rolls, a multipack of 5 x 0.5g THCa diamond-infused pre-rolls that deliver bursts of juicy, blue berries with every inhale.?

?This isn't your typical multipack; it's a flavour wave for the senses. Each pre-roll is meticulously crafted with indoor grown flower, never irradiated, and infused with THCa diamonds and resin + terps to deliver an intense, high-THC, full-flavour experience that will make your taste buds explode.

variants.title: Tropicanna PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Tropicanna - a legacy Tangie x Girl Scout Cookies sativa-dominant hybrid. This famed lineage brings together Tangie's vibrant citrus character with GSC's potency and balance. Expect an explosion of juicy tangerine, orange, tropical fruit, and pineapple in every puff, rounded out with subtle earthy undertones. Grown locally in Delta, BC, our bud is hand-harvested, hang-dried, hand-packed, and perfectly cured to bring out its full flavour and character.

variants.title: Nuclear Sour Flavored THCa Diamonds
variants.body_html: Nuclear Sour THCA Diamonds – premium, high-purity THCA crystals with an intense, puckering sour profile. This spring release delivers a tropical sour storm: juicy mango, pineapple, and guava sweetness colliding with sharp, mouth-watering tartness and a spritzy lemon citrus zing. Ideal for spring refresh and sour-loving cravings.

variants.title: Flavour Bomb Watermelon Wave Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: This isn't your typical vape cart; it's a flavour wave for the senses. Meticulously crafted using liquid diamonds, this .95g cart delivers a massive hit of THC for an intense, full-flavour experience that will make your taste buds explode! It's ready for any standard 510 thread battery.

variants.title: Kush Mints Fse Resin Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Experience the rich, full-spectrum flavour of Kush Mints in an all-in-one vape, made exclusively with single-strain full spectrum extract (FSE) resin. A potent indica-dominant cross of Animal Mints and Bubba Kush, this west coast classic delivers smooth, doughy vanilla notes layered with cool mint and a touch of gas. Expect bold flavor, powerful effects, and the authentic essence of the strain — captured straight from the plant.

variants.title: Live Rosin Raspberry Cream Soda Zero
variants.body_html: The first zero-sugar cream soda made with whole-plant, fresh frozen live rosin, then added bright, tangy raspberry for a twist, balanced with smooth vanilla cream undertones. Like all other Sweettooth products, it is proudly crafted on Vancouver Island.

variants.title: Orange Vanilla Twist Liquid Diamonds Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Dive into a swirl of something sweet, creamy, and totally dreamy with summertime vibes and flavours. The Spinach® Orange Vanilla Twist 1g vape delivers refreshingly bold experiences with a potent 96.7% THC, powered by shimmering liquid diamonds and botanical terpene infused distillate for that extra-smooth hit. Inspired by genetics rooted in Orange CRSH and Blue Dream, Orange Vanilla Twist wraps every session in a swirling blend of bright citrus and silky vanilla — an irresistible twist that transforms any moment into a flavourful indulgence.

variants.title: Pure Cake Skunk PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Happy Hour Organic Pure Cake Skunk pre-rolls showcase a bold fusion of Super Skunk Haze and Layer Cake, resulting in a citrus-driven indica with depth and character. Grown by Coast Mountain Cannabis in a certified organic, regenerative living soil system, each plant is supported by rich organic inputs and in-house microbial teas brewed with glacial water from the Pemberton Ice Cap. Carefully cold cured to protect terpenes and hand manicured to preserve structure, this flower is crafted with precision from start to finish. Rolled into straight-cut pre-rolls with ideal moisture content, each joint burns evenly and smoothly, delivering a consistent and flavourful experience in a convenient multi-pack.

variants.title: 91 Ox PR 7 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: 91 Ox is an indica-dominant strain that comes from crossing Biscotti x Scotty 2 Hotty. The bud is frosty green deriving from the crystal coverage with lots of fire orange hairs working their way out. The aroma and taste are where this bud’s name comes into play, with a stench of heavily pungent diesel accented by touches of spiced cookies and floral undertones.

variants.title: Day Dreamin' Infused CBD Flower
variants.body_html: Crafted by Grown Here Farms, infused CBD flower combines incredible Umpqua CBD flower with a pinch of in-house naturally occurring CBD kief. Never synthetic or processed, GHF kief is naturally screened from the CBD flower itself in a gentle tumbler. Giving you that extra lift in your CBD potency to maximize the amazing flower, while keeping your THC below 1%. With dominant terpenes of bisabolol, myrcene, guaiol, caryophyllene, and nerolidol, flavours of hops, cinnamon, chamomile and a sweet floral/citrus finish.

variants.title: Simply Dark Organic Chocolate
variants.body_html: Rich. Dark. Wildly convenient. The 5-pack of Simply Dark Organic Chocolate offers 10mg medallions of organic decadence infused with pure THC. Crafted in BC, created by two cancer-surviving sisters, this chocolate has clean ingredients, great origin, and vibes.

variants.title: Grape Stomper Whipped Diamonds
variants.body_html: Grape Stomper Whipped Diamonds is a premium concentrate crafted from high-purity THCA diamonds, whipped into a smooth, creamy texture. Following refinement for purity, botanical terpenes are carefully introduced to deliver a sweet, grape-forward profile. This sativa-dominant offering is designed to pair high THC potency with a vibrant flavour experience. With an easy-to-handle consistency, it's ideal for dabbing or vaporizing. Produced in small batches, this top-shelf extract reflects Dab Bods’ commitment to precision extraction and bold flavour.

variants.title: Hash Fusions Taster Series Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: The Lord Jones® Hash Fusions Taster Series is the culmination of thoughtful curation to bring you three unique ice water hash-infused pre-roll experiences. With hand selected flower and hand-crafted ice water hash, enjoy this collection in a three half-gram pack. This Taster Series includes favourites such as White Tahoe OG x White Tahoe OG, Cosmic Kush x Platinum GMO, and Sour Blueberry x Sour Blueberry. Each pre-roll sits at 40%+ THC and features a premium ceramic filter for a smooth smoking experience.

variants.title: BC Organic Tangerine Sunrise PR 1 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Rise & grind — it’s sativa season with BC Organic Tangerine Sunrise. A cross of Hawaiian Sunrise and Tangenesia, this cultivar shines with bright green buds, orange pistils, and frosty trichomes. Aromas of sweet orange peel mingle with citrus and funk, evoking fresh-squeezed orange juice on a quiet morning. Grown in organic living soil, milled to perfection, and packed in our organic hemp cones.

variants.title: Pink Kush Live Resin Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Pink Kush Live Resin Pre-Rolls are crafted using fresh, hang-dried Pink Kush flower infused with pure Pink Kush live resin. Get a double dose of that sweet spice, earth, vanilla, and gas. From the Pure Infusions collection, a lineup of pure, true-to-flower experiences. Rolled with natural wood cones and a Dutch fold for pure flavour and a smooth smoke. Packed with a limited-edition collectable glass tip.

variants.title: Flavour Bomb Atomic Peach Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Experience a wave of fresh flavour and a burst of potency with the Nugz Flavour Bomb Atomic Peach 0.95g 510 Vape Cart. This high-potency cartridge delivers an intense flavour of juicy, sweet peach with every inhale.

variants.title: Electric Lotus Smalls
variants.body_html: Electric Lotus is a sativa dominant flower born from the cross of Eye Candy and Jah Magic, an elevated combination with supreme flavour. It comes in hot with lemon zest cutting through tropical haze, grounded by an herbal incense. The buds are loud and wild. Grown in BC, this strain glows with solar flare intensity.

variants.title: Sherbadough PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Sherbadough was phenohunted in house by our team. Bred by Archive Seed Bank from the cross of Sunset Sherbet x Dosidos, this standout strain delivers a rich bakery inspired flavour profile with prominent notes of dough, cookies and funk. Because it’s the right thing to do, all our pre-rolls are made exclusively from whole flower, rolled in small batches into slim cones and hand packaged in glass tubes with cork tops.

variants.title: THCa2 High Voltage Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Max's THCa High Voltage Variety Pack delivers three electrified pre-rolls infused and coated with THCa for next-level potency. Each pre-roll hits with very strong THC potency potential (50-55%) and is supercharged with Max’s proprietary terpene formulation, engineered for bold, fruit-forward flavour. Inside the pack you'll find three explosive varieties: THCa Electric Apple, THCa Grape Galaxy, and THCa Lemon Lime.

variants.title: Sgt. Pineapple Liquid Diamond Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: A big, juicy burst of syrup-soaked pineapple, amped up with liquid diamonds. This all-in-one vape delivers an extra potent experience with big flavour. Bringing the fan-favourite Sgt. Pineapple as a puffable classic with this grab-n’-go vape — no battery required. Super Toast. Always Ready. Formulated using liquid diamonds, distillate, and flavoring agents.

variants.title: Truffle Treats PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Truffle Treats by Truro Cannabis offers sweet pastry, lemon and nutty aromas in a convenient 5 pack. Each pre-roll is made from 100% whole Truffle Treats flower for a consistent, flavourful and smooth burn every time. Grown and handcrafted in Truro, Nova Scotia, these premium pre-rolls bring dessert-inspired flavour and small-batch craft quality together in one clean, ready-to-enjoy format.

variants.title: 3Saints Frosted Lemons FSE Resin Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: No fluff. No filler. Just full-spectrum extract chaos in a cart. Frosted Lemons FSE is pure resin-nothing added, nothing watered down. Just 100% single-strain input with zero added terps. You get the whole strain, loud and uninterrupted. Think sharp lemon citrus up front, creamy vanilla riding underneath, and a deep fuel-soaked finish that lingers long after the pull. Bright, energizing, and built for all-day momentum. No prep, no ritual-just grab, pull, and keep it moving.

variants.title: Ice Cream Rntz
variants.body_html: Scoop up Ice Cream Rntz, an indulgent indica that turns every session into a treat. Sweet layers of cake, creamy vanilla, and a hint of popcorn swirl together resulting in a blissful, uplifting, and focused high that just melts the stress away. Selected through our beta program for its standout potency and decadent aroma, this extended time offer gives you another chance at a flavour-packed experience that's as smooth and satisfying as your favourite sundae. Whether you're chasing a mid-day sweet treat or an after-dinner dessert, Ice Cream Rntz is a satisfyingly scrumptious addition to your routine.

variants.title: Nightshade Berry Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Smoke the forbidden fruit. Max's Nightshade Berry AIO fuses ultra-potent THC extract (78-80%) with a dark, dangerously-sweet berry blast that bites back. Housed in Max's exclusive stainless-steel shell, this 1.25g AIO is built for MAX performance. With a cottonless, stemless ceramic atomizer and PrecisionFlow Clogless Technology, each hit delivers dense clog-free vapour and full-throttle nightshade berry flavour.

variants.title: TKO PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Sitka Legends are proud to roll out TKO, a heavyweight indica-dominant hybrid that's built to impress. Born from the powerhouse lineage of Triangle Kush x OG Kush x Gelato 41, TKO delivers a knockout combination of classic kush gas and creamy dessert sweetness. Expect bold notes of earthy pine and fuel layered with smooth gelato creaminess and a subtle hint of citrus zest, creating a flavor profile that's both nostalgic and indulgent. Every batch of TKO is grown with precision, featuring dense, frosty buds that are hand-trimmed, hang-dried, and given a patient three-week cure to maximize terpene depth and potency.

variants.title: Pineapple Gone Wild Diamond Dusted Infused PR 3 x 0.6 g
variants.body_html: Summer just got louder. Pineapple Gone Wild brings full tropical heat to Dab Bods' Diamond Dusted Infused Pre-Rolls, coated in bright yellow diamonds and finished with a bold green filter. This pre-roll doesn't just taste like pineapple - it looks like one too. Big pineapple flavour in this sativa leaning hybrid and serious diamond shine make this summer LTO built for hot days, long nights, and nonstop summer vibes.

variants.title: Chimera Junky PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Sitka Legends is proud to present Chimera Junky. A frost-drenched, dense flower with standout top-shelf bag appeal. This Cap Junky x Chimera#3 delivers dense, heavy buds coated in a thick layer of milky trichomes with subtle olive-green tones and fine amber pistils, reflecting careful cultivation and hand finishing. The nose is loud and immediate, opening with sweet gas and creamy cookie aromatics, followed by soft notes of earth and mint. This Sitka Legends release is grown by That's Dope, highlighting exceptional craftsmanship and terpene expression.

variants.title: Pop Drop & Roll
variants.body_html: Get ready to Pop, Drop & Roll, our latest innovation in milled flower that doesn’t hit pause. From the first pop to the last puff, it’s fresh, aromatic and easy to roll, pack or spark. Bursting with flavour and uniquely designed for portability, this custom and entirely new pack was created for convenience. Includes BC grown milled flower from Avant genetics and a separate compartment for something special, crafted for you. Pop it, drop it, roll it, repeat.

variants.title: Perfectly Peach Liquid Demons Diamond Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Liquid Demons Infused Joints: devilishly potent and sinfully flavourful. Infused with syrupy sweet peach, boosted with a blend of distillate plus liquid diamonds and finished with a kief-THCa diamond crust. Super Toast. Always Ready.

variants.title: Funk Marker PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Sitka Legends proudly introduces Funk Marker, a bold indica dominant cultivar crafted for those who chase loud terpene profiles and serious potency. Created from the powerhouse pairing of First Class Funk x Permanent Marker, this cultivar brings together heavy fuel intensity with exotic character. Funk Marker opens with a punch of gassy funk and solvent-like chem, followed by layers of sweet candy and subtle floral notes on the finish. Sitka only uses full flower inputs that are hang dried and slow cured for 3 weeks, locking in maximum potency and an insane terpene punch for a truly next-level smoke.

variants.title: Cosmic Cookies PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Cosmic Cookies Pre-Rolls by Truro Cannabis delivers sweet citrus and bright flavour in a convenient five-pack format. Made with 100% whole Cosmic Cookies flower, this sativa-leaning cultivar delivers a smooth, consistent burn across every 0.5g pre-roll. Grown indoors and handcrafted in Truro, Nova Scotia, these pre-rolls showcase craft quality and reliable flavour in a ready-to-enjoy format.

variants.title: Razz Pizzazz Liquid Demons Diamond Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Liquid Demons Infused Joints: devilishly potent and sinfully flavourful. Infused with candied raspberry, boosted with a blend of distillate plus liquid diamonds and finished with a kief-THCa diamond crust. Super Toast. Always Ready.

Instead of oversized show buds, we’re loading up the smalls. Small in size, massive in flavour, potency and consistency. Same trusted genetics, same careful cultivation, just a smarter way to stock up. Great Buy Oz is all about stretching your dollar while keeping standards high. Fresh, potent and expertly grown, this is the kind of flower you grab when you want dependable quality, everyday smoke and a price that feels like a win every time you open the bag. Big value. Solid flower. A genuinely great buy.

variants.title: OG Lemonade Shotz
variants.body_html: Introducing SHRED Shotz! Sip smart with OG Lemonade, a sweet and tart 65ml shot-sized beverage with an insanely fast onset time of just 15 minutes*. Our really fancy fast-acting nanoemulsion tech (FAST) breaks the cannabis infusion down into tiny particles so your body can more easily digest them. Pair all that with a classic lemonade flavour and you've got a super quick and delicious beverage. *Onset defined in terms of mean blood concentrations. Onset times may vary.

variants.title: Citrus Punch Shatter Infused PR 6 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Citrus Punch infused pre-rolls combine bright citrus and tropical fruit notes with added shatter for enhanced potency. Smooth-burning and flavour-forward, delivering an uplifting sativa effect with a strong, consistent experience.

variants.title: Chem Diesel
variants.body_html: Chem Diesel delivers a sharp, fuel-forward profile with notes of citrus and earth. This sativa offers an energizing, clear-headed effect with strong potency and a bold, lingering aroma.

variants.title: Lemon OG
variants.body_html: Lemon OG features bright citrus notes layered over earthy pine and subtle gas. A balanced sativa with uplifting effects and a smooth, flavourful finish.

variants.title: Lemon OG
variants.body_html: Lemon OG features bright citrus notes layered over earthy pine and subtle gas. A balanced sativa with uplifting effects and a smooth, flavourful finish.

variants.title: Chem Diesel
variants.body_html: Chem Diesel delivers a sharp, fuel-forward profile with notes of citrus and earth. This sativa offers an energizing, clear-headed effect with strong potency and a bold, lingering aroma.

variants.title: Platinum Jellysickle
variants.body_html: Platinum Jellysickle delivers a sweet, creamy profile with berry notes and a subtle gassy finish. High potency with a relaxing, indica-leaning effect and strong bag appeal.

variants.title: Melonade
variants.body_html: Melonade offers a juicy, fruit-forward profile with notes of melon, citrus, and light sweetness. Smooth smoke with a relaxing, indica-leaning effect and strong terpene expression.

variants.title: Melonade
variants.body_html: Melonade offers a juicy, fruit-forward profile with notes of melon, citrus, and light sweetness. Smooth smoke with a relaxing, indica-leaning effect and strong terpene expression.

variants.title: Platinum Jellysickle
variants.body_html: Platinum Jellysickle delivers a sweet, creamy profile with berry notes and a subtle gassy finish. High potency with a relaxing, indica-leaning effect and strong bag appeal.

variants.title: Tropical Orchard Flight Infused PR 12 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html:
Experience vibrant, juicy flavors with the Tropical Orchard Flight. This variety pack delivers a sun-ripened, fruit-forward experience for a truly flavorful session.
Each pre-roll is hand-finished and expertly rolled with whole flower, and flavored with a precise blend of cannabis and botanical terpenes. For maximum impact, every pre-roll is infused with THCa Diamonds and coated with premium kief, delivering high-THC potency and smooth, flavorful hits.
Curated for discovery, the Tropical Orchard Flight features a lineup that helps you explore the full depth of our potent selection and find your next favourite flavour.

variants.title: Purple Passion Fruit
variants.body_html: Grown organically in BC, Organic Purple Passion Fruit is a carefully cultivated sativa, hang-dried and slow-cured to preserve its vibrant aroma and potency. Showcasing striking deep purple buds, this strain bursts with tropical passion fruit sweetness complemented by subtle dark berry undertones and a gentle earthy finish. Smooth and fruit-forward, it delivers consistent quality and a satisfying smoke from start to finish.

variants.title: Flyers Frosted Infused PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Claybourne Flyers Frosted Infused Variety Pack Bundle features two flavourful Variety Packs in one convenient box. Each 5 x 0.5 g Variety Pack has 5 strains in each pack. These pre-rolls are THCa diamond frosted, terpene enhanced and infused with liquid diamonds. Looking for bold flavour and a potent experience? Look no further than Claybourne Frosted Flyers.

variants.title: OG Kush PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: For the first time, the remake is going to be better than the original. Spinach® OG Kush is our new take on a classic strain making for a super flavourful and potent cultivar. A cross between GMO #12 x SFV OG, get earthy, piney, and citrusy flavours and aromas pumped up from terps like myrcene, limonene, and caryophyllene. This potent cross doesn’t only make for a flavourful strain — it pumps up the potency to high levels and makes it the newest ‘OG’ experience you won’t want to miss.

variants.title: Spiked Mai Tai PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Spiked Mai Tai was pheno hunted in-house by our team. Bred by Jungle Boys from the cross of Mai Tai x Jungle Cake, this standout strain delivers a bold flavour profile blending vibrant fruit, sharp gas, and deep funk. Because it’s the right thing to do, all our pre-rolls are made exclusively from whole flower, rolled in small batches into slim cones, and hand-packaged in our signature tin.

variants.title: Backpackers Golden Tangie PR 10 x 0.75 g
variants.body_html: Pack light, roll heavy. Back Forty Golden Tangie Backpackers are straight-cut sativa pre-rolls, packaged in a resealable, water resistant tin that’s ready for any adventure. This Golden Goat x Tangie cross glistens with syrupy sweetness and orange citrus notes on the nose with a subtle sour base. Each pre-roll is wrapped in hemp paper that lets the flower's flavour shine through, burning steadily and evenly thanks to precisely milled flower. Enjoy a smooth smoke, very strong potency and dominant limonene, myrcene and caryophyllene terpenes. Toss the Backpackers tin into your bag and hit the Back Forty with Golden Tangie.

variants.title: Pineapple Glimmer Whipped Diamonds
variants.body_html: Pineapple Glimmer Whipped Diamonds are BAM's newest innovation. THCA Diamonds whipped with cannabis derived terp sauce with a dash of botanical terps to create this new texture. Packed with flavour and potency, diamond whips are here to wow!

variants.title: Ice Cream Rntz
variants.body_html: Scoop up Ice Cream Rntz, an indulgent indica that turns every session into a treat. Sweet layers of cake, creamy vanilla, and a hint of popcorn swirl together. Selected through our beta program for its standout potency and decadent aroma, this extended time offer gives you another chance at a flavour-packed experience that’s as smooth and satisfying as your favourite sundae. Whether you’re chasing a mid-day sweet treat or an after-dinner dessert, Ice Cream Rntz is a satisfyingly scrumptious addition to your session.

variants.title: Galactic Guava PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Blast off into bold, tropical flavour with Galactic Guava. This Terra Farms pre-roll pack is crafted from quality flower and rolled for a smooth, even burn. Expect juicy guava notes layered with sweet, fruity undertones and a rich aroma that fills the room. With a vibrant flavour profile, Galactic Guava delivers a satisfying experience from start to finish.

variants.title: Backpackers Golden Tangie PR  10 x 0.75 g
variants.body_html: Pack light, roll heavy. Back Forty Golden Tangie 10x0.75g Backpackers are straight-cut sativa-dominant pre-rolls, packaged in a resealable, water-resistant tin that’s ready for any adventure. This Golden Goat and Tangie cross glistens with syrupy sweetness and orange-citrus notes on the nose, layered over a subtle sour base. Each pre-roll is wrapped in hemp paper that lets the flower’s flavour shine through, burning steadily and evenly thanks to precisely milled flower. Enjoy a smooth smoke, very strong potency, and dominant limonene, myrcene, and caryophyllene terpenes. Toss the Backpackers tin into your bag and hit the Back Forty with Golden Tangie.

variants.title: Fully Blasted Strawberry Watermelon 1:1 CBG THC Gummies
variants.body_html: Prepare for blast off! SOURZ by Spinach® Fully Blasted Strawberry Watermelon 1:1 CBG | THC gummies are action-packed with a balanced blend of 10 mg THC and 10 mg CBG per piece and infused with liquid diamonds. These dual-flavoured gummies are over-the-top with natural flavours and blasted with sour crystals, featuring a combination of juicy strawberry and fresh watermelon flavours. Enjoy 10 gummies per pack with 100 mg THC total and 100 mg CBG total per multi-pack.

variants.title: Slim-Bitz Live Rosin Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Enjoy Slim-Bitz - part of Sauce Rosin Labs’ infused pre-roll debut: single-strain milled flower uniformly infused with solventless live rosin for a clean, terpene-rich burn. Pressed from fresh-frozen inputs and select trichomes, the rosin is gently blended through the core (not painted) to keep the roll smooth and consistent from spark to finish. Slim format, precise roll. Expect pronounced cultivar character, dense aroma, and even ash — produced without hydrocarbons, additives, or flavoring. Made in small batches with tight weight control and quality checks, Slimbitz delivers the Sauce profile you know in a ready-to-spark format. Store in a cool, dark place and reseal to protect freshness.

variants.title: Ghost OG
variants.body_html: Beware the delightful haunting of Ghost OG. A spectral blend of Triangle Kush, Chemdawg, and Hindu Kush, this Indica apparition drifts in with whispers of earthy citrus-pine. Trichome-coated buds and lingering hints of spice all perfectly captured in this generous full-ounce bag. Invite this ghost home — it’s friendly, we promise.

variants.title: Strawberry Matcha PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: A bright blend of Iced Matcha and Strawberry Jerry in a restrained, artful assortment, Strawberry Matcha pre-rolls offer a refined yet straightforward presentation. Each one releases a soft lift of ripe strawberry and leafy green tea, with a gentle touch of sweet, herbal earthiness. A smooth trailing sweetness follows, recalling berry syrup over a subtle vegetal undertone. This DEALR Sativa-dominant rendition delivers a crisp aromatic signature anchored in a balanced mix of fruit and herb.

variants.title: Zesty Parm PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Bright, savory, and unmistakably bold, Zesty Parm delivers a flavour experience that lives up to its name. These Terra Farms half-gram pre-rolls are crafted from carefully selected flower and expertly rolled for a smooth, even burn every time. Expect sharp citrus notes layered with a unique, savory funk that keeps each session interesting from first spark to final pull. A rich aroma makes Zesty Parm a go-to choice for both seasoned smokers and those looking to try something a little different.

variants.title: Blackjack Whipped Live Resin
variants.body_html: Boomstick Blackjack Whipped Live Resin Concentrate delivers high-potency performance in a 1.2g format built for value. Crafted from indoor-grown flower and processed using a live resin extraction method, this whipped consistency preserves a rich cannabinoid profile while maximizing THC content. Terpene-forward, it’s a premium concentrate offering more product and more potency in every jar.

variants.title: Funk Marker PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Sitka Legends proudly introduces Funk Marker, a bold indica-dominant cultivar crafted for those who chase loud terpene profiles and serious potency. Created from the powerhouse pairing of First Class Funk and Permanent Marker, this cultivar brings together heavy fuel intensity with exotic character. Funk Marker opens with a punch of gassy funk and solvent-like chem, followed by layers of sweet candy and subtle floral notes on the finish. Sitka only uses full flower inputs that are hang dried and slow cured for 3 weeks, locking in maximum potency and terpenes for a next-level smoke.

variants.title: Cherry
variants.body_html: Experience the vivid taste of sun-kissed cherries in every effervescent sip. This sparkling water offers a pure, juicy burst of cherry flavour, perfectly fresh.

variants.title: Plat Kush Breath PR  10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: From the award-winning team at Valhalla Flwr’s recent pheno hunt comes another banger: Platinum Kush Breath Pre Rolls. Bred by In House Genetics from crossing Platinum and OGKB V2.1, this one is for the kush lovers. This cultivar was pheno hunted by an incredible cultivation team and hand selected to bring big terps, big effects and of course some beautiful buds. With a profile of gassy, earthy and some rubber and pine on the back end, this strain is nothing short of impressive. Hang dried, hand trimmed, never irradiated and grown with love and intention. Whole milled flower input and hand finished for a perfect burn every time.

variants.title: Ice Cream Rntz PR 14 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Scoop up the new Ice Cream Rntz, a indica that delivers sweet layers of cake, creamy vanilla and a hint of popcorn thanks to its cis-nerolidol, alpha-thujone and beta-caryophyllene terpenes. Selected through our beta program for its standout potency and decadent aroma, these pre-rolls are high in THC. Ice Cream Rntz is a flavour packed experience that’s as smooth as your favourite sundae.

variants.title: Gelato 41 Live Resin Shatter
variants.body_html: Gelato 41 Live Resin Shatter brings a classic dessert profile to life with the clarity and depth only fresh-frozen extraction can deliver. Crafted at sub-zero temperatures, this live resin shatter preserves the strain’s natural terpene richness and full-spectrum character in a glassy, easy-to-handle slab. Gelato 41 shines with sweet vanilla cream, berry gelato, and a hint of citrus, balanced by subtle earthy undertones. On the dab, expect a smooth melt, clean flavour, and a layered aroma that lingers beautifully in the room.

variants.title: Strazzleberry Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: G.A. Diamond Infused Pre-Rolls are made with our trusted base of quality milled whole flower and boosted with a custom infusion of THCa, liquid diamonds, and finished with our triple-distilled distillate and kief coating. With over 38% THC, unlock better moments with the flavours you love dialled-up.

variants.title: Watermelon
variants.body_html: Experience the vibrant taste of perfectly ripe watermelon in every effervescent sip. This sparkling water offers a pure, fresh burst of summery flavour.

variants.title: Reserve Indica PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: The Reserve Indica Pre-Roll collection is a connoisseur-grade line of specially pheno-hunted indica-dominant cultivars chosen to meet the strict standards of Vancity® Cannabis. As part of the grading process, all pre-rolls must have highly potent THC, a complex terpene profile, and a proper cure for a clean burn. Pre-rolls are made with whole flower only. Because this cultivar rotates, aroma and taste may vary by lot and strain. Includes a QR card so you can learn more about your limited-edition indica.

variants.title: Live Resin Mexicola
variants.body_html: Dabble’s Mexicola Live Resin is made from sun grown plants that are immediately frozen to capture the best flavour and aromas. They are then processed into a delightful, aromatic live resin with a sugared texture. Dominant terpenes include, beta-caryophyllene, humulene, and farnesene.

variants.title: Pink Pavlova PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Named for a dessert that never plays it soft. Pink Pavlova blends Pink Cookies and Strawberry Pave into a syrupy, indica-dominant sensation with sugar-coated swagger. The flavour is all berry compote and gas, folded into cake crust, cream, and crushed pepper. Sticky buds sparkle with green and violet hues, like a meringue spun out of smoke. A bold BC-bred treat that hits like dessert and lingers like a dream.

variants.title: Rockstar Kush PR 1 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Rockstar Kush is a West Coast classic derived from the powerful Rockbud and Bubba Kush lineage. Celebrated for its bold, earthy character, this cultivar delivers rich layers of spice, pine, and sweet earth. Dense buds with deep green hues and vibrant orange hairs make Rockstar Kush as visually striking as it is satisfying.

variants.title: Hell's Kitchen
variants.body_html: A BLKMKT Exclusive from their breeder's playground. Hell's Kitchen is a cross of Britscotti and Devil's Driver. This flavour-forward indica is richly layered by bright notes of grapefruit with a smooth smoke delivering citrus up front before unfolding into rounded, savoury undertones of buttery biscuits. BLKMKT flower is always indoor grown, hand-trimmed, hang-dried, cold cured, and hand packaged at facilities in B.C. Never sourced, never any shortcuts.

variants.title: Midnight Maraschino Ceramic Tip Infused Blunt PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Experience elegance and decadence with Midnight Maraschino Kief-Dusted Infused blunt. Made from Espresso Gelato flower (Espresso and Grandi Candy), this choco-cherry delight was handcrafted for indulgence with deep flavour notes and infused with a precise blend of liquid diamonds, distillate and a curated natural botanical blend. B.C. grown whole flower is packed inside a beautiful straight-cut slim blunt that's coated in premium-grade kief and a skinny, long ceramic tip. Rolled in-house and packaged in a custom reusable glass tube.

variants.title: Mango Lime Mega Party Pack Gummies
variants.body_html: SHRED’ems Mango Lime Mega Party Pack has 50 packs of tangy MAX10 gummies, each with 10mg THC. That’s a total of 500mg per pack! These gummies are gushing with sweet mango and lime flavour. To cap it all off these bangers are vegan-friendly and made with all-natural flavours.

variants.title: Day Dreamin' Infused CBD Flower
variants.body_html: Enjoy Day Dreamin’ Infused CBD Flower proudly cultivated by Grown Here Farms. This strain of Umpqua, whose name means “dancing waters”, pays homage to Oregon’s Umpqua Valley Native American tribes. It is a 70-30% indica-dominant with genetics derived from such classics as Sour Diesel and Blueberry. This CBD flower is infused with a pinch of their in-house CBD kief. Giving you that extra lift in CBD potency, while keeping THC below 1%. With dominant terpenes of Bisabolol, Myrcene, Guaiol, Caryophyllene, and Nerolidol, flavours of hops, cinnamon, chamomile, and a sweet floral/citrus finish. Craft-grown, hand-harvested, hang-dried, never irradiated, and premium hand-trimmed with love, for you.

variants.title: Paradise Pnch Zero Party Pack Gummies
variants.body_html: Step into full-tilt tropical mode with SHRED’ems Paradise PNCH ZERO Party Pack — their first flavour-blasted zero gummy, crafted for those who want big taste with zero compromises. Each vegan-friendly gummy packs a bold wave of juicy fruit punch flavour, blending bright tropical notes with a smooth finish. With 10mg of THC per gummy and ten mouthwatering pieces in every Party Pack, Paradise PNCH ZERO delivers guilt-free, sun-soaked flavour.

variants.title: Hoagies PR 3 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Freshly rolled hoagie-sized joints served up beefy, bulky and full of herbs. Stuffed with a whole gram of potent, fresh, indica-dominant strain du jour. A 3-pack for now, later and just in case. Super Toast. Always Ready.

variants.title: Spiked Mai Tai
variants.body_html: Spiked Mai Tai was pheno hunted in-house by our team. Bred by Jungle Boys from the cross of Mai Tai x Jungle Cake, this standout strain delivers a bold flavour profile blending vibrant fruit, sharp gas, and deep funk. The buds are dark green, dense, and heavily frosted with trichomes. Because it’s the right thing to do, all of our flower is hang-dried, hand-trimmed, slow cold-cured, and hand-packaged. We keep it fresh and terpy by sealing it in nitrogen-flushed pouches with a humidity pack inside. And yeah — non-irradiated, obviously.

variants.title: Jam Slam Ground Flower
variants.body_html: 7g of potent ready-to-roll indica with aromas of sweet berries and jammy donuts. Ground from whole nugs, fluffy and fresh. No grinder needed. Super Toast. Always Ready.

variants.title: M.Tai X Jungle Cake PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Bred by Jungle Boys from the cross of Mai Tai and Jungle Cake, this standout strain delivers a bold flavour profile blending vibrant fruit, sharp gas, and deep funk. Because it’s the right thing to do, all Caramel’s pre-rolls are made exclusively from whole flower, rolled in small batches into slim cones, and hand-packaged in glass tube.

variants.title: Timewarp PR 7 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Originating from our neighbouring Gulf Island, Texada, Timewarp is a true celebration of ocean-grown BC Bud. This sativa-leaning, BC heirloom strain hits you with a sweet and sour lemon flavour, coupled with a hint of pine. Timewarp buds are sungrown outdoors in living organic soils on Salt Spring Island. They're hang dried for 14+ days to best preserve terpenes and flavour. Rolled in organic unbleached cones and finished by hand.

variants.title: Elderflower Pom
variants.body_html: Elderflower Pom is a vibrant, uplifting sipper that presents a perfect balance of soft elderflower aromas with a splash of tart, zesty pomegranate. Made with natural botanical essences and fruit flavours. Nano-infused for fast onset, balanced 1:1 ratio with 5mg THC and 5mg CBD.

variants.title: CYOA
variants.body_html: Two high quality strains. Choose your own adventure by exploring each strain on their own or combine both strains.

variants.title: Blueberry Blaster Party Pack THC:CBG Gummies
variants.body_html: Blueberry Blaster SHRED’ems feature the perfect 1:1 THC:CBG combo in every gummy. With a sweet and juicy sour blueberry profile, these sugar-coated, vegan-friendly gummies deliver a bold flavour! Available in a 10-gummy Party Pack with a total of 100mg THC and CBG per pack!

variants.title: Lemon Gelato
variants.body_html: Lemon Gelato is a citrus creation bred from Thin Mint GSC, Lemon Haze and Sunset Sherbet, delivering a zesty twist on the gelato family. This hybrid is the definition of smooth potency with bold aromas of lemon zest, sweet cream and a gassy undertone. The bag appeal is undeniable with dense lime green buds dusted in frosty trichomes. Every batch is hang dried, slow cured and hand packed to lock in its terpene-rich profile and silky smoke, brought to you with love from Scarborough.

variants.title: Jealousy x Apples & Bananas PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Jealousy x Apples & Bananas is a potent legacy indica-dominant hybrid. Jealousy is a 50/50 hybrid strain produced by crossing Sherbert Bx1 x Gelato 41. Compound Genetics and Cookies collaborated to create Apples & Bananas: a combination of a Platinum Cookies x Granddaddy Purple hybrid with a Blue Power male. They crossed the resulting hybrid with Gelatti to create Apples & Bananas. Flavour profile is earthy and gassy with hints of spice. Jealousy x Apples & Bananas Pre-Rolls are produced from whole flower of our best-in class batches, and we have refined our mixing and milling processes to mirror the high quality and THC levels of our popular craft whole flower products. All Truro Pre-Rolls are hand-weighed and hand-packaged in recyclable tubes for a true craft pre-roll experience.

variants.title: Organic Comatose
variants.body_html: Comatose is a heavy Kush and one of Canada's most popular legacy strain, now in 28g bags. This indica-dominant flower is reported to be a cross of OG Kush and another unknown indica. Comatose have dense, resinous flowers which produce high levels of THC and an earth gassy fragrance.

variants.title: Chatty Kathy
variants.body_html: This sassy sativa is a cross of Chatterbox and SinMintz, serving up a bold diesel flavour with a minty fresh finish and a whisper of spice.

variants.title: Vanilla Cream
variants.body_html: Vanilla Cream is our favourite phenotype of Velvet Cream from Cookies Fam Genetics. A truly divine and lucious Sativa that hails from Ice Cream Cake x Medellin lineage. Big, frosty green and bright purple nugs that glow. Expect aromas and flavours of vanilla and cream with soft undertones of gas. Non-irradiated, hand trimmed, and hand packed with care in Princeton, BC.

variants.title: Rainbow Driver
variants.body_html: The Woody Nelson edition of the Rainbow Driver genetic was bred by Archive Seed Bank and grown in an indoor vertical farm using organic living soil. This high-THC cultivar is rich in terpenes, including d-limonene, beta-myrcene, and trans-nerolidol and smells like candy and gas. The plant's bright, frosty buds are hand-trimmed, cured for a minimum of 3 weeks and arrive with a Boveda humidity pack. Never irradiated.

variants.title: Black Truffle
variants.body_html: Black Truffle, developed by MaxYields, the prolific breeder of 3rd Coast Genetics, is a potent indica dominant strain with THC levels ranging from 26% to 31%. Esteemed in the underground cannabis scene, this award-winning strain results from the fusion of White Truffle and Pure Michigan genetics. The strain’s unique flavour profile, featuring a blend of spicy rubber and gas, contributes to its distinctiveness. With a terpene profile ranging from 3% to 4.5%, Black Truffle showcases aromatic compounds that elevate its sensory characteristics, providing an exceptional and memorable cannabis experience.

variants.title: Strawberry Frost PR 4 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Sweet like fresh strawberry jam, finished with a cool, icy twist. Strawberry Frost  blends juicy berry flavour with a refreshing chill for a smooth, laid-back smoke -  perfect for slow days and good vibes.

variants.title: Pink Kush Mints
variants.body_html: Pink Kush Mints, an indica-dominant fusion of Pink Kush and Girl Scout Cookies with BIG kush, herbal and cream aromas, is now available pre-milled! Ditch the grinder and get in on this gassy bag of cakey kush that’s fresh AF.

variants.title: Juice Box Smalls
variants.body_html: Juice Box, a Sativa-dominant banger bred from Strawberry Horchata and Space Candy, quenches your palate with sweet berry juices and floral, gassy flavours, accented by a sharp, sugary sting that lingers on your tongue. Juice Box’s nose slams you with ripe strawberry and candied zest, developing into a starry tang. The buds are sticky, purple streaks on a background of neon-green, teasing a well-balanced, cosmic adventure.

variants.title: Whiplash
variants.body_html: Rooted in legacy Indica genetics, Whiplash brings together M8 & Lebanon #3, two cultivars known for their traditional structure and resin presence. Medium-to-dense clusters form buds with a solid, grounded build. The notes lean proper Kushy and restrained, led by earthy hash tones with subtle herbal depth and a faint sweetness underneath. Whiplash presents as a composed, heritage-driven flower with a serious, no-frills temperament.

variants.title: La Chancla PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Packed as tenner, La Chancla brings a bright, punchy flavour set rooted in standout genetics. The child of Cinderella 99 and Queen of the South, this Sativa cut leans heavily into citrus and tropical fruit, with lemon notes and sweet pineapple leading the way. As it develops, the taste sharpens with a tangy edge, followed by light earth and a restrained touch of spice that keeps everything in balance. La Chancla lands crisp, with a timeless, flavour-driven identity that stands on its own.

variants.title: French Beignet PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: French Beignet is an Indica-dominant cultivar with a bakery-forward, fuel-layered lineage: Apple Fritter crossed with MAC1 and Gary Payton. It opens with sweet, curated nuances and amplifies them before you even get into the second or third skin. Overall, it smokes with a fresh-fried dough stamp, then transitions into sweeter pine with an ultra-fine skunky whisper.

variants.title: You Don't Know Jack PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: You Don’t Know Jack leans into two legendary Sativa lines, Jack Herer and Amnesia, brought together in a set of ten neatly packed BC Doobies, each showing their character from the moment the seal breaks. It opens with sharp orange and sweet spice, then shifts into a hazy, woody arrangement, a flavour-driven cultivar that reflects the distinct qualities of its lineage. Uncluttered and true to its roots, You Don’t Know Jack arrives straightforward and classic.

variants.title: Maraschino Cherry PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Maraschino Cherry sets the tone with a classic cherry-forward profile, polished and plush from the first pull. Featuring Kosher Tangie and Tropicana Cherry, this Sativa-Dominant pre-roll opens with rich, syrupy cherry layered over soft citrus zest. The flavour stays smooth and rounded, carrying notes of fruit and subtle herbal funk. It combines ripe cherry, orange peel, and a faint old-school musk. Maraschino Cherry delivers a refined, vintage-leaning profile.

variants.title: Krypto Kandy`
variants.body_html: Krypto Kandy is an expression bred from Krypto Kush × Honey Pavé, combining two flavour-forward genetic lines into a visually appealing flower. The well-formed flower tops show light green calyxes with a consistent layer of trichome coverage. The lineage brings together the dessert-leaning temper of Honey Pavé with the prominent, more resinous anatomy associated with Krypto Kush. Sweet candy notes and honeyed citrus come first, supported by gentle earthy and fuel-adjacent undertones. Krypto Kandy emphasizes aroma complexity, terpene profusion, and bag appeal.

variants.title: Love Potion #9 PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Love Potion #9 is a DEALR Indica-dominant pre-roll that comes from Northern Lights #5 and Love Potion #5, two classic cultivars known for their expressive profiles. The flavour unfolds with soft floral sweetness and light herbal tones, followed by earthy pine and a gentle spice on the finish. It also leans warm and nostalgic, layering fresh flowers, and a subtle incense-like note. Love Potion #9 offers a smooth, refined profile with a quiet nod to closeness.

variants.title: Honey Fresca
variants.body_html: Honey Fresca is an Indica-dominant flower that unites its parents, Honey Bananas and Fresca Melon, in a sweet, fruit-forward mix. The nugs are rounded and dense, showing jade shades with touches of gold and peach-coloured pistils across the surface. This authentic BC offspring offers a mélange of ripe melon and sun-kissed sweetness supported by a subtle mineral base.

variants.title: 6Th Sense Smalls
variants.body_html: 6th Sense is where instinct meets sensation. This Indica-dominant from BC Smalls taps into deeper frequencies with its Sherb Bx1 #6 x Red Vines lineage, a cross that delivers rich dessert shop aromas and hypnotic colour. Open the bag and you’re met with waves of berry, red licorice, and subtle sherbet notes, with dense buds glistening like they know a secret. Grown small-batch in BC, this one’s made for those who trust their gut and chase the flavour. 6th Sense doesn’t just hit, it knows.

variants.title: Jade Noir
variants.body_html: Scale brings its own presence here. Drawn from Zkittles × Cherry Noir, Jade Noir is an Indica-dominant expression that carries a darker, more saturated visual tone across the lot. The structure shows substantial weight and consistency, with resolute formation and a dense, cohesive feel throughout the zip. It opens restrained, then deepens into noir sweetness paired with fruity undertones and a hint of cherry that ties the lineage together. With even structure and alignment, Jade Noir maintains cohesion across the board.

variants.title: Columbian Gold PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Born from highland origins, BC Doobies’ Colombian Gold emerges from an iconic Colombian landrace in two full-gram, Sativa-dominant pre-rolls that honour its storied reputation. It presents a bright combination of light citrus, dry grass, and soft spice, capturing the unmistakable character tied to its tropical roots. Offered as a bold pair, this release highlights one of the most recognized landrace cultivars in cannabis history.

variants.title: Kim's Sweet Diesel
variants.body_html:
The Jolly Boys have arrived and are proud to introduce Kim's Sweet Diesel, an indica-dominant cultivar that's as smooth as it is flavorful. This exceptional strain offers a delightful combination of sweet, fruity notes with a peppery kick and subtle gassy undertones, creating a complex profile that is sure to please the pallet.

Each bud of Kim's Sweet Diesel is carefully hand-trimmed and hang-dried, then given a slow three-week cure to bring out its full potential. The result? Chunky, resin-coated nugs with vibrant green hues, deep orange pistils, and a frosty layer of trichomes that glisten in the light. This strain delivers a soothing and relaxing high, perfect for letting go of the day's stress or embracing a peaceful evening.

Jolly Boys are all about quality and craftsmanship, and Kim's Sweet Diesel is no exception. Whether you're after its bold flavor or deeply calming effects, this cultivar is sure to satisfy. Sit back, take a puff, and let the sweetness take you away!

variants.title: Orange Velvet Underground Caviar
variants.body_html: Orange Velvet Underground Caviar showcases bright citrus and orange-forward notes, balanced by a tangy sour punch and subtle herbal spice. Earthy undertones add depth, creating a complex and memorable concentrate. Crafted for a velvety texture and refined finish, Orange Velvet Underground Caviar highlights the full aromatic range of this unique hybrid, delivering an elevated flavour journey in every dab.

variants.title: Animal Tsunami
variants.body_html: Please welcome the newest addition to the Sitka Legends team. Bringing you their knockout Animal Tsunami, an indica-dominant cultivar born from the luscious Animal Cookies x Caramel Tsunami cross. This premium cultivar offers a flavour explosion of sugary, creamy nutty caramel with earthy notes of woody pine, perfectly paired with an aroma of sweet cookies and spicy herbs. Prepare for a heavy hitter that hits as smooth as it tastes! They ensure excellence with hand-trimmed, hang-dried nugs that undergo a three-week slow cure, resulting in dense, minty green, spade-shaped buds adorned with purple hues, orange hairs, and sparkling purple-tinted trichomes. Terpenes include limonene, caryophyllene, and myrcene.

variants.title: Ruby Haze
variants.body_html:
Ruby Haze from That’s Dope by Sitka Legends is a powerhouse sativa-dominant cultivar, born from the bold Cherry Punch #4 x Black Cherry Punch #2 cross. Bursting with electrifying tart cherry and sweet berry flavours, its rich aroma of ripe cherry and sugary spice is pure enjoyment. Terpenes include terpinolene, limonene, and pinene.

Crafted with precision, every fluffy, trichome-drenched nug is hand-trimmed, hang-dried, and cured for three weeks to lock in its top-tier flavour and potency. Drenched in deep greens, purples, and fiery crimson pistils, Ruby Haze is straight-up eye candy. This isn’t just another cultivar—it’s a statement. Ruby Haze is a testament to That’s Dope’s legendary craftsmanship.

Ruby Haze PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: The Jolly Boys are back and buzzing with their latest drop-Ruby Haze, a high-voltage sativa bursting with cherry-charged flavor. This mouthwatering marvel blends Cherry Punch #4 x Black Cherry Punch #2 to deliver an electrifying hit of tart cherry and sweet berry, wrapped in a zesty swirl of sugary spice. Every nug of Ruby Haze is hand-trimmed, hang-dried, and slow-cured for three weeks to unlock maximum flavor and potency. Drenched in deep greens, royal purples, and fiery red pistils, it's as gorgeous as it is powerful. Crafted for those who crave bold flavor and an energetic lift, Ruby Haze isn't just a strain-it's a cherry-powered ride you won't forget.

variants.title: Fade To Black
variants.body_html: Born from the collision of Blackout Bobby and Maximum Carnage, Fade to Black is a heavy indica that offers a decadent blend of creamy fruit, cocoa, and dank kush with a gassy finish — all wrapped in dense, trichome-coated buds that sparkle like midnight frost. Each bud is expertly hand-trimmed, hang-dried, and carefully cured over three weeks to unlock its full potential. Terpenes commonly include caryophyllene, limonene, and farnesene.

variants.title: Chimera Junky
variants.body_html: Sitka Legends is proud to present Chimera Junky. A frost-drenched, dense flower with standout top-shelf bag appeal. This Cap Junky x Chimera#3 delivers dense, heavy buds coated in a thick layer of milky trichomes with subtle olive-green tones and fine amber pistils, reflecting careful cultivation and hand finishing. The nose is loud and immediate, opening with sweet gas and creamy cookie aromatics, followed by soft notes of earth and mint. This Sitka Legends release is grown by That's Dope, highlighting exceptional craftsmanship and terpene expression.

variants.title: Funk Petals
variants.body_html: The Jolly Boys have arrived and are ready to turn it up loud with their latest Funk Petals. An indica dominant strain born from the unique cross of First Class Funk and Miss Kim. This cultivar is a sensory delight, offering a harmonious blend of sweet, candy-like notes with a funky, earthy undertone. The complexity of its flavor makes it a standout for those who appreciate depth and character in their flower. The nugs are dense and frosty, showcasing vibrant green hues with subtle purples and fiery orange pistils, all enveloped in a glittering layer of trichomes. Each bud is expertly hand-trimmed, hang-dried, and carefully cured over three weeks to unlock its full potential, a testament to the Jolly Boys dedication to quality and craftsmanship-fit for those who appreciate the finer things.

variants.title: Possum Glass Tip PR 3 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Possum is a potent indica that blends Roadkill Skunk with the frosty potency of Pure Michigan. This strain offers an unmistakably pungent skunk aroma that's sharp, earthy and true to its vintage roots. Beneath the heavy funk, subtle notes of gas and creamy sweetness add depth to its complex nose. The buds are dense, resin-soaked and glisten with thick trichome coverage, showcasing its craft lineage. Possum delivers that classic skunky punch from the first whiff to the last pull. It's bold, nostalgic and potent.

variants.title: Gold Cash Gold Glass Tip PR 3 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Introducing Gold Cash Gold, a premium cannabis strain created from the exceptional lineage of Oooze 1.0 and Pure Michigan, boasting a unique aroma profile that sets it apart from other strains. Expect a captivating blend of burnt plastic, sweetness, skunk, and gas, offering a complex sensory experience that satisfies even the most discerning connoisseurs. This strain is perfect for enthusiasts seeking a bold and distinctive experience. Gold Cash Gold’s intriguing scent and high-quality flowers make it a standout choice for those looking to elevate their cannabis experience.

variants.title: Black Truffle Glass Tip PR 3 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Black Truffle Glass Tip Pre-Roll showcases the legacy-bred excellence of MaxYields and 3rd Coast Genetics. A heavy-hitting indica born from White Truffle x Pure Michigan, this whole flower pre-roll delivers bold notes of spicy rubber and gas, backed by a rich 3–4.5% terpene profile. Hand-trimmed and expertly packed, each pre-roll features a premium borosilicate glass tip with a stainless-steel screen, ensuring smooth, cool draws with every hit. Crafted for connoisseurs, this is potency and flavor refined.

variants.title: Tagalongz Glass Tip PR 3 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Tagalongz is a slightly indica dominant hybrid cross of Peanut Butter x OOOZE bred by legendary breeder Max Yields. This cultivar offers a distinct nutty base note with earthy flavors on the exhale.

variants.title: Pure Michigan Glass Tip PR 3 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Introducing PUREMICHIGAN, an award-winning hybrid born from the fusion of OOOZE 1.0 and MENDOBREATH F2, gaining prominence in the cannabis community over the past 8 years. By the 9th week of bloom, PUREMICHIGAN yields high-quality flowers coated with sticky OOOZE frost. Departing from fruity-terped exotics, its terpene notes range from a subtle burnt essence to hints of hops and earthiness. Legendary cannabis breeder Max Yields refers to it’s profile as having “dark, evil terps,” noting the rarity of a modern, connoisseur grade hybrid without any fruity terpenes.

variants.title: Nebula Runtz Glass Tip PR 3 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Nebula Runtz was bred by the Atlantic team and made by crossing Toyz x Archive x Bakers Dozen. The two parents behind this strain are some of the newest genetics in the legacy market and by breeding them together we are the only company to have this new cultivar. The terpene profile is a mix of gelato from Toyz and a deep gas taste and aroma from bakers dozen’s triple OG x CKS & Cream.

variants.body_html: Introducing Mai Tai x Zero Gravity, a captivating sativa crafted by expert cultivators. This unique blend boasts the invigorating essence of Mai Tai combined with the out-of-this-world Zero Gravity. With a tantalizing aroma reminiscent of tropical fruits and a hint of earthiness, embark on a cosmic adventure with Mai Tai x Zero Gravity.

variants.body_html: Kiwi Lemonade Soft Chew – A zesty blend of tangy lemon and sweet kiwi in a soft, chewy bite. With a sativa profile, it’s crafted for an uplifting, energetic experience. Bright, refreshing flavour meets a lively vibe.
