A bright, terp loaded, sativa-dominant cultivar with big flavour from a cross of Mango Smile, originally bred by Mephisto Genetics, and Zkittlez. These premium craft smalls deliver dense, terpene rich nugs that are completely coated in shimmering trichomes with hints of purple and fiery orange pistils. The aroma bursts out with sweet tropical candy, and juicy fruit punch, followed by a light gas finish.

variants.title: Backpackers Blue Magic PR 10 x 0.75 g
variants.body_html: Pack light, roll heavy. Back Forty Blue Magic Backpackers are straight-cut hybrid pre-rolls packaged in a resealable, water-resistant tin that are ready for any adventure. This Blue Dream x Green Magic cross hits with fresh fruit, dank earth and a hint of spice. Each pre-roll is wrapped in hemp paper that lets the flower's flavour shine through, burning steadily and evenly thanks to precisely milled flower. Enjoy a smooth smoke, very strong potency and dominant caryophyllene, humulene and limonene terpenes. Toss the Backpackers tin into your bag and hit the Back Forty with Blue Magic.

variants.title: Cherry Sakura PR 4 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: All terpenes used are formulated specifically  for inhalation, enhancing the aromatic and flavour profile of each joint.

variants.title: Grape Smuggler Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Grip it and rip it with Grape Smuggler - an indica trio of 0.5 g diamond-drenched pre-rolls built for the brave. These dubious doinks come locked and loaded with botanical terp-boosted THCa diamonds and a crushed THCa diamond coating for maximum strength and a smooth relentless burn. This plump package comes in at a tantalizing 60% THC with a fat load of grape flavour and an earthy berry touch for total satisfaction.

variants.title: Porto Leche PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Some pairings are just meant to be - like the deep, bold taste of aged red berries or the smooth, velvety comfort of fresh cream. Porto Leche (Oreoz x Grape Jubilee, Breeder: Exotic Genetics) captures both in perfect harmony, delivering a flavor experience that's rich, indulgent, and effortlessly smooth. The first hit bursts with notes of ripe, jammy berries, coating your palate in deep, complex sweetness. As you exhale, a wave of creamy smoothness follows - like the soothing finish of a cold glass of milk. Porto Leche, from Tribal. Bold yet balanced, with flavours you'll want to savour, again and again.

variants.title: Key Lime Kush Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Take the Back Forty anywhere with our compact and rechargeable Key Lime Kush all-in-one vape. Built with a sleek, textured design that’s as discreet as it is stylish, this pocket friendly powerhouse is anything but ordinary. It’s a citrus smooth flavour trip offering bright and tart key lime flavours with a creamy Kush finish.

variants.title: Cuban Linx PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Cuban Linx is a hybrid strain of cannabis that tends to be sativa leaning. With its refreshing lemony aroma and diverse terpene profile, this genetic is most appreciated when looking for a euphoric, stimulating boost in creativity. The elevated THC levels offer a high that can be appreciated in both the body and the mind. Cuban Linx was bred by crossing TK Skunk and Trigerian. The result is a huge bud with a shape that resembles corn on the cob. With both parents being elevated in THC, it is no surprise that Cuban Linx provides a euphoric and full-bodied high. Due to indoor cultivation at reduced temperatures, the quantity of terpenes increased greatly and produced distinct, complex flavor profiles. This strain is most commonly known to provide a euphoric, uplifting high. It is ideal when seeking a stimulating boost in creativity with minimal effects on lucidity. Cuban Linx offers an energizing, euphoric high, even for more experienced cannabis users. The diverse richness of exotic terpenes found in Cuban Linx give these buds an invigorating lemony aroma that is accentuated by hints of gassy diesel and a touch of spiciness. A truly refreshing strain, its flavors and smells are as exciting as the high it provides. Our pre-rolls are produced with nothing but whole buds which have been consistently ground to deliver rich flavors and wrapped in premium hemp cones.

variants.title: Lemon Gelato PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Lemon Gelato is a citrus creation bred from Thin Mint GSC, Lemon Haze and Sunset Sherbet, delivering a zesty twist on the gelato family. This hybrid is the definition smooth potency, with bold aromas of lemon zest, sweet cream and a gassy undertone. The bag appeal is undeniable, with dense lime green buds dusted in frosty trichomes. Every batch is hang dried, slow cured and hand packed to lock in its terpene-rich profile and silky smoke

variants.title: Neon Sunshine PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Like driving a classic Corvette down Hwy 101 from Malibu to Venace beach. Stereo up, roof down. Nothing but sand, surf, and some of that, Neon Sunshine! Introducing Tribal's Neon Sunshine. Created by legendary breeder Exotic Genetix, Neon Sunshine is Zkittles x Falcon 9. Sweet & tangy flavours meet vibrant & frosty flowers... the true California dream!

variants.title: Baby Jeeter Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Blends are a mix of both indica and sativa plant types.

variants.title: Cherry Tang
variants.body_html: Sweet and sour in all the right ways, Cherry Tang packs a flavorful punch and a heavy-hitting potency. Our strongest sativa yet, this cross of Cherry Pie and Tangie bursts with energizing citruses, ripe cherries and earthy herbs powered by dominant terpenes limonene, caryophyllene and myrcene. The buds are chunky and oversized with light greens, thick orange hairs and bright crystal trichomes. Pure BC bud, hand-harvested, hang-dried and hand-finished.

variants.title: Bubble Up PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Pushing the envelope, that's what we're known for. Introducing Bubble Up by Tribal (Zoap x Deluxe, Breeder Exotic Genetix). Bubble up is a unique strain. Extra sticky flowers with a fresh and clean scent. Bubble up is ready to scrub in.

variants.title: Big Hits Duo Pack PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: An all-star 10-pack featuring two potent indicas: Big White and Kush God. Big White is a potent yet balanced cultivar delivering a sweet nose of icing sugar, berries, light florals and cakey notes. Kush God is a potent indica with loud aromas of fresh tropical fruit, juicy red grapes and sweet berry desserts. Made with fresh flower, ground with precision, and ready to burn.

variants.title: Firecracker Smalls
variants.body_html: Firecracker is a beautiful cross of Blue Tarts and Tropicanna Cherry, expertly bred by a legacy cultivator from BC's interior. This offering delivers big flavour, combining sweet and fruity undertones with a gassy finish. The vibrant flowers showcase lime and dark green tones with hints of violet, all topped with a generous layer of milky trichomes.

variants.title: Shark Attack Heavies Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: One of SHRED’s most popular flavours is now more potent than ever in Heavies form. Shark Attack Heavies are loaded with sweet, blue raspberry flavour with a triple threat of diamonds, disty and terps. Smooth, flavourful, and seriously potent — each pre-rolls clocks in at 50% THC. Not for lightweights.

variants.title: Great Buy
variants.body_html: Looking for a no brainer that delivers big on quality without the big spend? Meet Nugz Great Buy Oz, a rotational bag of quality Nugz smalls that proves value doesn’t mean cutting corners. It is packed with non-irradiated whole flower straight from the Nugz garden. Instead of oversized show buds, we’re loading up the smalls. Small in size, massive in flavour, potency and consistency. Same trusted genetics, same careful cultivation, just a smarter way to stock up. Great Buy Oz is all about stretching your dollar while keeping standards high. Fresh, potent and expertly grown, this is the kind of flower you grab when you want dependable quality, everyday smoke and a price that feels like a win every time you open the bag. Big value. Solid flower. A genuinely great buy.

variants.body_html: Zooted Indica is a bag of rotating Indica flower at a low price. Each batch showcases a new hand picked Indica strain.

variants.body_html: Alien Gushers is an indica-dominant strain created through crossing Alien OG and Triangle Kush. The flavour and nose are similar — a combination of sour tropical fruits and rich creamy cookies with touches of spicy grape.

variants.title: Stargals PR 10 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Blast off into a dreamy, pink-hued haze with Stargals by Space Race Cannabis! These 10 x 1g Indica pre-rolled joints are crafted for those who want to sparkle and unwind in true Barbie-style glamour. Stargals deliver a smooth, relaxing high that's perfect for chilling under the stars or vibing with your besties. Each joint is meticulously rolled with premium, indica-dominant flower, ensuring a consistent burn and a cosmic escape into tranquility. Get ready to shine bright and embrace the fabulous, laid-back vibes!

variants.title: Raspberry Lemonade Diamond Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g

variants.title: Fzy Peach THC:CBG Live Rosin Gummies

variants.title: Ice Cream Rntz PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Scoop up the new Ice Cream Rntz, an indica that turns every session into a treat. variants.title: Watermelon Breeze CBC Gummies

Sweet, clean and thoughtfully balanced, Watermelon Breeze keeps things light while staying unmistakably Pearls.

variants.title: CBG + Rosin Infused Raspberry Black Tea

variants.title: White Peach PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Striking as if it were suspended in light, preserved at the moment it reached its peak, White Peach is a truly unique exotic selection. Born from the union of The White and the famed Peach Rings, it represents a fruit lineage converging toward an exquisite evolution. White Peach carries a steady, even burn from first light to its natural conclusion

variants.body_html: Our sparkling coconut water with pineapple is infused with 10 mg of THC and 10 mg of CBG. Coconut water and pineapple has long been a drink of choice in the Caribbean islands. This beverage made with real Caribbean coconut water is best enjoyed cold.

variants.title: Rosin Infused Lemon Green Tea
variants.body_html: TeaPot Lemon Green Tea is a complex and refreshing beverage made with real green tea and natural lemon flavour. It contains 10 mg of solventless THC and is naturally caffeinated.

variants.title: Candyland PR 20 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Candyland is a bright sativa that crosses the legendary Granddaddy Purple and Bay Platinum Cookies. Its dense olive green buds boast a sparkling layer of sugar-like trichomes, accented by vibrant golden orange hairs. The aroma is rich with prominent notes of sweet grape, berry, lemon and classic skunk-y undertones.

variants.title: Kush Mints
variants.body_html: Kush Mints is a hybrid cultivar that brings together the classic lineage of Animal Mints x Bubba Kush. variants.title: Deja Vu Smalls
variants.body_html: Deja Vu is an indica-dominant cut rooted in old-world lineage, where Kashmir, Afghan, and Colombian landrace genetics converge in a return to classic cannabis form. variants.title: Triangle Queen Petites
variants.body_html:
Every once in a while there’s a cut that impresses without calling too much attention to itself. Triangle Queen by Relentless Genetics is that sort of cultivar. Refined. Demure. Almost regal. Its dense, chunky flowers - gorgeous and otherworldly when freshly harvested and somewhat understated nugs when dry - are caked in trichomes that befit a true queen.


Leaning in, she has a phenomenally complex aroma that emanate notes of tropical fruit and subdued sour off the top with muted rubber and earthy forest floor rounding out the bottom. Flavour-wise, it’s orangey citrus on the dry pull with an initial musky cherry on the first hit once sparked. The thick smoke is majestic with tropical sweetness, sour gas and a dash of soap mingling throughout. The exhale is a citrus orange perfume with just a hint of marzipan. 


If you love a heavy indica-leaning cut with laidback inclinations then this one might just grant your wish. Elevation from the get-go, followed by a slow glide to the Kushy pillow is guaranteed. Triangle Queen, your Highness indeed.

variants.title: Juicy Jays - Terp Enhanced Hemp Wrap Lemon Cake - 2/pack - 25/box
variants.body_html: Treat your session to something sweet with Juicy Jay's Terp Enhanced Hemp Wraps – Lemon Cake. These flavourful wraps are made from natural toasted hemp and infused with terpenes to elevate the overall experience. The Lemon Cake variety delivers a sweet and tangy, dessert-inspired taste that adds a bright, citrusy twist to your herb without overpowering it. Completely tobacco-free, these wraps offer a smooth, slow burn while letting the flavour shine through. Each pack is sealed for freshness and includes two wraps, making it an easy and convenient piece to bring along when you want something a little more flavourful in the rotation. Key Features & Benefits: Natural Toasted Hemp: Made from hemp for a tobacco-free alternative that burns smoothly Terp Enhanced: Infused with terpenes to help amplify the flavour and overall experience Lemon Cake flavour: Sweet, tangy, dessert-like taste with bright citrus notes Guaranteed Freshness: Individually sealed packs help maintain flavour and quality 2 Wraps per Pack: Convenient two-pack format for easy use and portability A bright, dessert-inspired wrap that brings sweet citrus flavour and terp-enhanced enjoyment to every roll.

variants.title: Flyers Frosted Podium Pack Infused PR 8 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Claybourne Flyers Frosted Infused Podium Pack 8 strains in one pack. These 8x0.35g pre-rolls are THCa diamond frosted, terpene enhanced and infused with liquid diamonds. Looking for bold flavour and a potent experience? Look no further than Claybourne Frosted Flyers.

variants.title: Smoky Apple Iced HashWoods Hash Infused PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Saturday's Smoky Apple Iced HashWoods is an indica-dominant 1g blunt infused with premium Royal City Cannabis craft iced water hash - made by freezing and sifting trichomes for a clean, solvent-free extract. Smoky Apple features Royal Goddess iced hash and a fruity, earthy indica flower blend that brings out crisp fresh apple, sweet woody spice, and earthy depth in every pull. Packed in a hand-rolled hemp wrap and finished with a wooden filter tip for a smooth, slow-burning smoke that hits just like the weekend.

variants.title: Valley Girl Pure Cured Resin Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Fewer ingredients, bigger flavour. We only use Valley Girl flower when producing our cured resin vape, which means full flavour busting with bold notes of gas, musk and and just a pinch of sweetness. Designed for convenience, our vape is an all-in-one device with preheat functionality, ready to use straight out of the box. Plus, our hardware is calibrated for low temperature sessions, offering a smooth draw and robust flavours with every inhale. Made without additives, which means no distillate and no botanical terpenes. Bred by Archive Seed Bank, Valley Girl comes from a cross of SFV OG and Face Off OG. What do we love about Valley Girl? First off, the flavour. It’s that classic sweet gas profile we can’t resist with a hint of funky musk to keep things interesting.

variants.title: Glazed PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Bright, bold, and ready when you are. This 2x1g pre-roll pack features a rotating selection of single-strain sativa flower - always high in THC. Whole flower and hand crafted, just the way your pre-rolls should be.

variants.title: Gasberry Kush
variants.body_html: Gasberry Kush is a seriously musky and floral indica that brings in some sweet finishing notes from its genetic line that includes Lemonpaya and Cherry Pie. This bag is dank and delicious.

variants.title: Strawberry Lemonade Infused PR 2 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html:
Sweet. Tangy. No-nonsense. Strawberry Lemonade blends ripe strawberries and tart lemon in a potent and all-around flavourful pack of infused pre-rolls. It's a refreshing hit that delivers - every time.

Cannabis ready to consume - whenever you need it. That's Standard Issue. Stripped of excess, honed to essentials, and designed to keep pace - not for show, but for real life. Consistent, dependable, and ready when you are. Standard Issue: everything you need, nothing you don't.

variants.title: Blue Dream
variants.body_html: It doesn't get more classic than this. This legendary Sativa has a mouth-watering blueberry smell that fills the room the second you crack open the bag. This versatile cultivar can be enjoyed by novice and experienced consumers alike!

variants.title: Baby Jeeter Strawberry Sour Diesel Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Strawberry Sour Diesel is a sativa strain infused with liquid diamonds and finished with a kief coating. Sweet strawberry flavour leads the profile followed by a sharp pine note and a classic diesel edge that adds contrast. Bright and expressive, the flavour moves from ripe fruit into a crisp fuel driven finish.

variants.title: Cherry Picker Lemonade Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Our next generation all-in-one hits potent every time. Filled with liquid diamonds, Cherry Picker Lemonade combines sweet cherries with a citrus punch that always scores.

variants.title: Baby Jeeter Blue ZKZ Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Blue ZKZ is an indica strain infused with liquid diamonds and finished with a kief coating. It brings together tart citrus and sweet earth, layered with soft wildflower notes that add depth and complexity. Inspired by the pairing of Blue Diamond and ZKZ, the profile blends bright citrus with grounded sweetness and a soft floral edge.

variants.title: Ghost OG PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html:
Ghost OG is a hybrid strain made from GMO Cookies & Garlic Buds. Ghost OG has a hardy flavor profile of zesty skunk & pine.  Witness forest green buds with dense nodes. A perfect option for anytime of the day, this hybrid strain offers euphoric happiness, without feeling sedative. 

Appearance; 

  • Forest Green Nugs 

Nose;  

  • Skunk & Earthy Pine 

Flavor;  

  • Floral, Gas & Sweetness 

Effects; 

  • Uplifting, Happy, Relaxed

variants.title: Mexican Lime
variants.body_html: Each sip of M*ry Jones Mexican Lime delivers a bold burst of citrus. With sweet and tart flavours, this vibrant lime-forward drink is crisp, clean and never overwhelming. Infused with 10 mg of THC per can, it’s smooth and zesty without any bitterness or lingering aftertaste.

variants.title: ZKTLZ Live Diamonds Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Crafted with premium ZKTLZ flower, live diamonds, and a kief coating, ZKTLZ Live Diamonds Infused Pre-Rolls deliver bold berry flavour and sativa effects.

variants.title: The Collective Oz
variants.body_html: The Collective OZ brings a combination of your favourite Northern Canna offerings in a rotational ounce.

variants.title: SMRF Liquid Diamonds Vape Cartridge

A flavourful twist on a popular strain — now in vape form.

variants.body_html: Three bold rides. One rowdy pack. The Rowdy Variety Pack brings the noise with a trio of triple-diamond infused pre-rolls featuring Blood Orange, Frosted Grape, and Howler. This heavy-hitting, indica-dominant strain features dense, frosty buds with a rich aroma of fresh blueberries and grape, layered with a gassy undertone. Expect deeply relaxing, anti-anxiety, and sedative effects.

The bag opens into a drift of deep earth, dark resin, and soft woody tones breaking through the air. A DEALR special that doesn’t chase signals, it bends the space around it.

variants.title: Select : Sweat Helmet PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Brought to you by Smoker Farms, Sweat Helmet half-gram pre-rolls are built for those who appreciate intensity, precision, and a no-nonsense cannabis experience. Each pre-roll contains 0.5g of high-quality, whole flower, carefully milled and rolled to deliver a smooth, even burn and robust flavour from start to finish. This strain has an unmistakable aroma of diesel, earth and spice with a sharp citrus edge. The flavor is bold and layered and lingers on the palate, leaving a lasting impression. Bold flavor. Big impact. No compromises. Sweat Helmet is your ticket to a premium pre-roll experience.

variants.title: Sin N' Juice PR 3 x 0.5 g

variants.body_html: Take the plunge into tropical mango and fresh kiwi flavour notes with Spinach® Fully Charged Mango Kiwi Haze CBC infused pre-roll with a potency of 40%+ total THC and added rare cannabinoid CBC. variants.body_html: Blast to the future with BOXHOT Code Blue Whipped Diamonds, a breathtaking ringer with a steady blue razz rhythm and a burst of fruity flavour to kickstart your tastebuds. Super pure THCa diamonds are converted to a butter-smooth consistency and boosted with botanical terps to deliver flavour and potency. Add this to a dab rig and crystal whip them taste buds.

variants.title: Wes' Coast Kush
variants.body_html: MTL’s Wes' Coast Kush is an indica dominant strain. The flower is a hazy light green colour with purple undertones and is covered in white crystal trichomes. The smoke is packed with a sweet, earthy and spicy taste that finally culminates in a diesel aftertaste.

variants.title: Baby Jeeter Pink Lemon Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Pink Lemon is a hybrid strain infused with liquid diamonds and finished with a kief coating. It features a sweet citrus profile led by raspberry and lemon, with a bright grapefruit-like note rounding out the flavour. variants.title: Pink Lemonade
variants.body_html: Summit Pink Lemonade brings the summer season with crisp lemonade and a nostalgic blend of raspberry and strawberry. Crafted with Summit’s signature low-sugar approach, it delivers a vibrant, balanced profile that stays effortlessly drinkable from the first sip to the last. Non-carbonated and infused with 10mg of THC per 355mL.

variants.title: Comatose PR 14 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Comatose is a potent Kush and one of Canada's most popular legacy strains. This indica-dominant flower is reported to be a cross of OG Kush and another unknown indica. Comatose have dense, resinous flowers which produce high levels of THC and earthy, citrusy fragrances.

variants.title: Roll-X PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Victoria Cannabis Company is proud to present their first in house bred cultivar the Roll-X. Thick creamy smoke with highlights of lime backed up by notes of sweet earthy forest floor. This is the first release under the new Living Soil Synganic growing method.

Harvested plants are whole plant hang dried in optimal conditions for a minimum of two weeks before the finished flower is carefully hand-trimmed and hand-sorted. Grown, processed and packaged in the same micro-facility, Amani Craft is dedicated to delivering the freshest flower in the market.

Diamond Infused Pre-Rolls are made with a trusted base of quality milled whole flower and boosted with a custom infusion of THCA, finished with triple-distilled distillate and kief coating. Unlock better moments with the flavours you love dialed-up.

Cut from the rare mix of an Asian Land Race × Green Crack, it stands as an indica-dominant variety with distinction. It brings romantic herbal tones and soft earth nuances, alongside tropical fruit accents that add contrast.

variants.title: Watermelon Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Fresh and sweet. We've smashed this Watermelon flavour with a light sugar, sweet citrus and crisp profile in a potent and all-around flavourful pack of infused pre-rolls. Cannabis, ready to consume, whenever you need it — that's Standard Issue. Stripped of excess, honed to essentials, and designed to keep pace — not for show, but for real life. variants.title: O.P.P. Resin Infused Blunt PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Turn things up with the Bonkers Orange Push Pop Resin Infused Blunt. Packed with vibrant Orange Push Pop flower and expertly infused with high-quality cannabis resin, this blunt delivers a bold, flavour-forward smoke from start to finish. Bright citrus and sweet orange candy notes lead the way, balanced by smooth, gassy undertones that keep each pull rich and satisfying. Slow-burning and heavy-hitting, this infused blunt is built for those moments when regular just won’t cut it—loud flavour, amplified potency, and unapologetically Bonkers.

variants.title: Fruity Pebbles 97+ Liquid Diamonds Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Expect big flavour and extremely high potency from this Fruity Pebbles 97+ Liquid Diamonds 510 vape. variants.title: Georgia Peach Smasher Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Weed Me Max’s Georgia Peach Smasher AIO is a 1g sativa vape with very high THC potency potential. Max’s proprietary terpene blend delivers the flavour of fresh Georgia peaches, juicy and sweet with a slight tartness and a bright citrus edge. Housed in Max’s all-metal rechargeable AIO with a ceramic atomizer and clog-free Precision Flow Tech™, the device provides smooth draws that amplify both flavour and potency.

variants.title: Big Apple PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Big Apple was bred by Seed Junky Genetics by crossing Apple Fritter x Sherb BX1. This heavy smoke delivers bold notes of sour citrus, cream and apple pie. Our pack of pre-rolls are made exclusively from whole flower and are hand finished and hand packaged with a humidity pack for freshness.

variants.title: Black Widow CBD PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: A pack of pre-rolls that are rich in CBD with a little THC and lots of terps in the mix! These joints taste spicy, woodsy, and a little nutty.

variants.title: Cherry Ztripez
variants.body_html: Cherry Ztripez hits like the first bite of a ripe cherry, with flavour that's sweet, tangy, and impossible to ignore. Born from Lemon Cherry x Animal Z, this high-impact indica blends bold sour cherry and gassy depth with a smooth, aromatic pine finish. Anchored by beta-caryophyllene, limonene, and linalool terpenes, the flavour profile is vibrant and layered, delivering sweet indulgence with a side of gas. With a potent THC range, Cherry Ztripez offers a balanced, flavour-forward experience that will make you want to reach for seconds. Grown in laboratory-grade, strain-specific rooms, the flower is hang-dried, cold-cured, carefully milled and hand-packaged without irradiation. From first aroma to final ash, Cherry Ztripez is pure craft.

variants.title: Truffle Treats PR 1 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Truffle Treats by Truro Cannabis offers sweet pastry, lemon and nutty aromas in a convenient format. Each pre-roll is made from whole Truffle Treats flower for a consistent, flavourful and smooth burn every time. Grown and handcrafted in Truro, Nova Scotia, this premium pre-roll brings dessert-inspired flavour and small-batch craft quality together in one clean, ready-to-enjoy format.

variants.title: Truffle Treats
variants.body_html: Truffle Treats by Truro Cannabis is a high-THC hybrid with a distinctive sweet, pastry-like aroma balanced by bright lemon zest and subtle toasted nut notes. Grown indoors in small batches in Truro, Nova Scotia, this cultivar was selected for its rich terpene profile, dense structure, and clean, smooth burn. Hang-dried, hand-trimmed, and slow-cured for up to 28 days to lock in full flavour and freshness, Truffle Treats delivers the craft quality and consistency Truro is known for.

variants.title: Rootbeer 6 Pack
variants.body_html: SHRED Root Beer delivers that bold, creamy, spiced taste you know and love — smooth, satisfying, and absolutely never boring. This nostalgic beverage is packed with a potent 10 mg THC in every can for a full-throttle, flavour-forward experience. Get ready for a fresh, classic taste and a serious hit. Grab a SHRED Root Beer and enjoy! Available in a grab and go 6-pack of 355 mL cans with 10 mg THC each.

variants.title: Crazy Cream Soda 6 Pack
variants.body_html: SHRED Crazy Cream Soda cranks classic vanilla flavour into a must-try beverage with big potency. Experience that sweet, nostalgic taste combined with a potent 10 mg THC in every can. It’s the perfect blend of fresh fizz and delicious flavour. Pop a cold one and enjoy! Available in a grab and go 6-pack of 355 mL cans with 10 mg THC each.

variants.title: Rootbeer
variants.body_html: HRED Root Beer delivers the bold, creamy, spiced taste you know and love — smooth, satisfying, and absolutely never boring. This nostalgic beverage is packed with a potent 10 mg THC in every can for a full-throttle, flavour-forward experience. Get ready for a fresh, classic taste and serious potency. Grab a SHRED Root Beer and enjoy!

variants.title: Crazy Cream Soda
variants.body_html: SHRED Crazy Cream Soda cranks classic vanilla flavour into a must-try beverage with big potency. Experience that sweet, nostalgic taste combined with a potent 10 mg THC in every can. It’s the perfect blend of fresh fizz and delicious flavour. Pop a cold one and enjoy!

variants.title: Sage n' Sour Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: A cross between Sour Diesel x S.A.G.E. This cultivar takes the classic Sour Diesel profile to the next level. Sage n’ Sour live resin carries forward its bright citrus-pepper punch and herbal depth. Together, they create a classic sativa-forward live resin that delivers both potency and robust flavour — perfect for connoisseurs who expect the full expression of the plant in a vape format.

variants.title: Mango Hurricane Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Potluck Popz Mango Hurricane is a portable flavour packed mini vape. The Mango Hurricane Popz delivers a tropical wave of juicy mango and bright citrus in a smooth and discreet puff. Tiny but terpene-rich, it offers high THC and flavour. No buttons, no prep, just inhale and enjoy.

variants.title: Code Red
variants.body_html: Code Red hits the sirens with a loud cross of Red Rntz and Scotty 2 Hotty. This sativa dominant exotic delivers juicy cherry and berry sweetness layered over pine, pepper and gassy earthiness, driven by its dominant terpenes. The buds pop with bright green, dripping with frosty trichomes and streaked with orange hairs.

variants.title: Sour Ranger 30+
variants.body_html: There's a new sheriff in town! Introducing SHRED Sour Ranger 30+ - affectionately named for its pungent sour + diesel aromas and a MINIMUM potency of 30% THC. Packed in a 7g bag and milled to perfection, look no further, SHRED's 30%+ milled blend has arrived.

variants.title: Zooted Sativa
variants.body_html: Zooted Sativa is a bag of rotating Sativa flower at a low price. Each batch showcases a new hand picked Sativa strain.

variants.title: Reefer-ready Cherry Bomb
variants.body_html: Cherry Bomb from Jonny Chronic is a potent sun grown sativa-dominant hybrid strain that produces dense light green buds with golden orange pistils and a thick frosting of trichomes. Created from crossing complex parents, Mama’s Chili Bomb x Headspace, share legendary genetics from OG Kush, Tangerine Dream and a Hawaiian landrace. Cultivated in southwestern Ontario under the sun, all of our plants are hang dried and cured before our team goes through and carefully selects top colas to then be hand trimmed and hand packed in house.

variants.title: OJ Zainbow
variants.body_html: OJ Zainbow is a gapefruit ,orange citrus explosion. Zainbow produces beautiful green flower that is incredibly dense and covered in frosted trichomes. The Grafefruit citrus nose translates perfectly to the mouth coating flavour and citrus Z terps.

variants.title: Watermelon Waterfall Liquid Diamond Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Watermelon Waterfall Liquid Diamond all-in-one contains our popular Watermelon Gshers dried flower input combined with liquid diamonds in a disposable vape pen format. This high potency all-in-one (AIO) vape features strain specific inputs cultivated in Princeton, BC and is available in a conveniently small sized device. Watermelon Waterfall’s flower lineage is a cross of Gelato 41 x Triangle Kush x Watermelon OG.

variants.title: Black Cherry Gelato Live Rosin
variants.body_html: This Black Cherry Gelato live rosin was produced by High Fidelity using fresh frozen flower and a solventless ice water extraction followed by a cold cure. This hybrid cultivar delivers a terpene profile marked by sweet cherry, citrus, and gas. Hand crafted in Nelson, BC.

variants.title: Og Rootbeer Jar Of Joints PR 14 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Crack open the Jar of Joints and dive into the frothy flavour of SHRED’s OG Rootbeer. Each perfectly packed 0.5g cone bursts with sweet, spicy, and creamy vanilla aromas that hit like a nostalgic root beer float. This sativa-dominant blend is all about smooth, flavourful pulls and classic SHRED vibes.

variants.title: Fire G13
variants.body_html: FIRE G13 by Trailblazer is an earthy and sweet indica-dominant cross of FIRE OG and G13, an OG Organigram genetic bred in-house. These potent and beautiful buds offer deep green and purple hues, loaded with bright orange pistols. FIRE G13 is grown in an indoor micro-climate environment in small batches and is always smart-cured, hang-dried, and hand-trimmed. Uncover the extraordinary with Trailblazer

variants.title: Organic Mint Chocolate Chip Hash Infused PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Taking things up a notch, Sweetgrass presents a brand-new 1g infused pre-roll featuring certified organic Mint Chocolate Chip whole flower and water-extracted hash. This living soil organic micro continues to expand its line of extracted products with a 1g cone of the beloved Mint Chocolate Chip, paired with fine Kootenay bubble hash made the old-school way. Imagine all the flavoured notes of herbal, minty, chocolatey goodness with an added kick for those looking to level up. Milled and blended into an ideal consistency, ensuring an even burn.

variants.title: Tropic Thunder PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Tropic Thunder is a cross between Tropicana Cookies x Banana Kush. This aromatic sativa strain offers a bright tropical citrus profile layered with sweet fruit and subtle gas. Light green buds are dense and finished with a frosty coating of trichomes. Produced on Stó:lō traditional territory, Tropic Thunder weaves Indigenous practices with intentional, craft cultivation methods.

variants.title: Purple Lemonade PR 14 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Purple Lemonade is commonly bred from Purple Haze, Lemon Skunk, and Sweet Skunk, creating an indica-dominant cultivar. While some breeders list variations — such as Purple crossed with Citrus Cali genetics — the Purple Haze, Lemon Skunk, and Sweet Skunk lineage is the origin most often cited. Offered in a 14g whole flower format. Dominant terpenses include beta-caryophyllene, limonene, and bisabobol.

variants.title: Dark Rainbow Craft
variants.body_html: This edition of the Dark Rainbow genetic was bred by Archive Seed Bank and grown at an indoor vertical farm using organic living soil. This indica-dominant cultivar is rich in terpenes with notes of citrus and funk. The plant’s dense, frosty buds are hand trimmed, cured for a minimum of three weeks, and never irradiated.

variants.title: La Bomba
variants.body_html: La Bomba is a standout Broken Coast genetic, crossing Jet Fuel Gelato and Wedding Cake. This balanced 50/50 hybrid boasts a potent THC, delivering a dynamic profile of grape, earthy, and citrus flavours. Crafted with Broken Coast’s signature cultivation practices, La Bomba is a new expression of premium cannabis grown in small batches, hang dried, hand trimmed, and slow cured to preserve terpene richness and potency. It’s bold, balanced, and built for those who appreciate something different.

variants.title: CBD Blend Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Discreet Mild delivers a tropical twist infused with Mild Mango. This hybrid CBD blend offers low odour and flavour. Each cartridge is made from small batch liquid diamonds and crafted to keep things low key. Discreet Mild is your quiet moment in a loud world.

variants.title: Strawberry Gummies
variants.body_html: Platinum Strawberry Hybrid soft chew is a product that combines the candy making traditions of Germany with the world of cannabis infused edibles. Taste our strawberry soft chew, each one bursting with its own distinct flavour and meticulous craftsmanship.

variants.title: Full Spectrum Live Rosin Boosts Gummies
variants.body_html: Now in a 10-pack format with 100 mg THC from live resin in total! Pure. Potent. Eat your resin. Impromptu Full Spectrum Live Rosin Boosts Multipack are candies made without sugar, gluten, or animal products that each deliver a reliable 5 mg THC experience. Enjoy two flavours — Blue Raspberry and Cherry! This is the real deal; an authentic cannabis experience and the whole plant in one fell swoop. Discover the small and discreet package that you can easily carry in your pocket or purse with no extra bulk. Always close at hand, enjoy a predictable experience wherever you are.

variants.title: Pink Kush Live Resin
variants.body_html: Hotbox Pink Kush Live Resin brings the heat with loud, gassy terps and sweet floral notes locked in from fresh flower. Born from the hallowed OG Kush lineage, this indica-dominant hybrid delivers those classic vanilla-kush vibes wrapped in sugary trichomes. Potent, sticky, and straight-up legendary — no shortcuts, all fire.

variants.title: Cherry x Blue Raspberry Zlushie Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Our 510 cartridge is crafted for reliability and purity. Made from medical grade stainless steel, this cartridge offers a clean and durable vaping experience. The oil specific ceramic core is engineered for optimal heat distribution, preserving the full flavour and potency of your oil. Enjoy consistent vapour with every haul, delivering smooth draws from start to finish.

variants.title: Sherbadough
variants.body_html:
Sherbadough was pheno hunted in-house by our team. Bred by Archive Seed Bank from the cross of Sunset Sherbert x Dosidos, this standout strain delivers a rich, bakery-inspired flavour profile with prominent notes of dough, cookies, and funk.

The buds are bright green, densely packed, and heavily frosted with trichomes.

Because it's the right thing to do, all of our flower is hang-dried, hand-trimmed, slow cold-cured, and hand-packaged. We keep it fresh and terpy by sealing it in nitrogen-flushed pouches with a humidity pack inside. And yeah-non-irradiated, obviously.

variants.title: Black Cheese Rosin Donut Glass Tip Infused PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Black Cheese is a craft grown, high THC sativa pre-roll that delivers flavour and potency. Expertly rolled with a live rosin infused centre, it offers a true rosin donut experience that's smooth, flavourful and bursting with terpene-rich vapour. Housed in a custom glass tip with a stainless steel filter, each draw stays cool and consistent. Born from the legendary UK Cheese x Black Truffle lineage, Black Cheese brings together classic skunky and funky cheese notes with deep earthy truffle undertones, creating a complex aroma.

variants.title: Fiji Zour Apple Dripbar Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Check out our new DripBar All-in-One LED Hardware, featuring Fiji Zour Apple a flavour crafted for those looking for a crisp, orchard fresh apple taste with layers of sour and sweet. Fiji Zour Apple features the taste of sour apple and a splash of tropical sweetness for a one-of-a-kind taste.

variants.title: Rainbow GLTO Liquid Diamond Infused PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Rainbow GLTO Liquid Diamond infused pre-rolls offer vibrant raspberry aromas, enhanced for high potency. Sourced from some of the top Ontario growers, these infused pre-rolls deliver fresh quality for a bold experience.

variants.title: Trapstar
variants.body_html: This ain’t from grandma’s stash. With lineage from It’s Fire genetics, Trapstar might just leave you in the dust. Inspired by the realest in the game. Trapstar is icy – crystal coated, covered in diamonds. OGs say this is the most GOATED strain you’ll ever smoke. Mess around and find out.

variants.title: Blue Tartz Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g

Expect bold aromas and an exciting terpene profile, all wrapped in a smooth, resin-drenched burn.

variants.body_html: Minionz is smooth and loaded with banana inspired notes. Infused with terpene-rich extract and packed for consistency, every pre-roll delivers an even burn and a steady draw from start to finish. Fresh sealed to lock in those sweet fruit tones.

variants.title: Lime Rntz

Dominant terpenes include linalool, myrcene, caryophyllene, geranene, and pinene, creating notes of fresh lime, floral sweetness, soft spice, and pine undertones. Each flower is hang-dried, hand-trimmed, slow cold-cured, and packaged fresh with a humidity pack to help preserve terpene integrity and quality. Non-irradiated. Premium, carefully crafted flower.

variants.title: Biscotti PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Introducing Biscotti by 1Spliff, a blend of flavour and flair. Crossed with Gelato 25 and Sour Florida OG, these pre-rolls are both potent and tasty. Expect a sweet, earthy inhale with a hint of citrus zest that finishes smooth and creamy, just like your favourite dessert.

variants.title: Peach Please PR 4 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Juicy peach & stone fruit flavour with a sweet, tangy kick. 4 × 0.5g pre-rolls  packed with smooth, high-quality cannabis. Sassy name. Seriously good smoke.

variants.title: Dual Pre PR 20 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: A dual strain pack of pre-rolls.

variants.title: Permanent Marker PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Permanent Marker is a popular high THC hybrid strain crossed between Biscotti S1, Sherb BX and Jealousy. Delivering pungent flavours of soapy funk with hints of candy and floral gas tones.

variants.title: Dragon Cookies PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Back by popular demand. This indica dominant cultivar gets its earthy and sweet flavours and aromas from its Strawberry Diesel lineage, with pine undertones from its Holy Grail Kush lineage. Dragons breathe fire and you will too with this rare find.

variants.title: Rainbow Belts Live Rosin
variants.body_html: Brindle Farms Rainbow Belts Live Rosin delivers vibrant, candy-sweet terps with a smooth, gassy finish. Pressed from fresh-frozen whole flower and crafted in small batches, this 1g rosin preserves the full spectrum of flavour and potency. Expect bright fruit, deep resinous notes, and a clean, solventless experience that reflects Brindle Farms’ commitment to top-tier craft quality.

variants.title: Foggy Peaches 4 Pack
variants.body_html: XMG Atomic Sours Foggy Peaches brings the hit flavour in a new form. Juicy peach collides with a haze of sour lemon in this bold beverage. Each can is infused with 10mg THC, 10mg CBG, delivering a tangy twist with no cannabis aftertaste. Made for sour seekers who want the refreshment, and the haze, dialled up.

variants.title: Drippyz Bubba Joon Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Drippyz Bubba Joon infused pre-rolls hit with sticky and sweet notes layered over the bold, earthy and gassy depth of Bubba OG flower. Infused with liquid diamonds for high potency and dusted in blonde kief, these pre-rolls don’t just shine, they slap.

variants.title: STIX Sour Chem PR 10 x 0.4 g
variants.body_html: Good to go, whenever you are! We’ve perfected the pre-roll and packed them into sleek stix full of Sour Chem with dank, pungent, and straight up in-your-face gas. Spinach STIX® Sour Chem is our ode to what all our buds know and love — a sativa strain that hits on classic flavours and aromas like gasoline, chemicals, and zesty citrus. With a lineage that traces back to Chemdawg and Sour Diesel, it’s no surprise that this portable pre-roll flexes a high THC potency. This pre-roll is as potent as it is sleek.

variants.title: Bane Chamber Wax
variants.body_html: Bane Chamber Sugar Wax is dark, heavy and smooth. This potent indica concentrate delivers a rich, terpene-heavy experience with a gritty sugar-like texture for dabbing or topping your favourite flower. Expect deep gas and earthy citrus on the nose. Bane Chamber is extracted from high THC flower and refined to preserve key cannabinoids and terpenes. Welcome to the chamber, inhale accordingly.

variants.title: Cured Rosin - Made By Vangyptian
variants.body_html: Premium solventless concentrate pressed from cured hash inputs, this cured rosin delivers rich, traditional flavour with modern smoothness. Dense, stable, and deeply aromatic for connoisseurs who want heritage and potency combined. Each batch is strain-specific and rotational.

variants.title: Forbidden Fruit Liquid Diamond Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Forbidden Fruit is now extracted from strain specific flower. These liquid diamond disposables bring consumers the flavour they have come to expect with Fuego.

variants.title: Comboz Purplecherry
variants.body_html: This Big Bag o' Buds CombOz is for indica lovers! With two separate 14g bags, you get the best of both worlds: Pink Kush Mints' gas and kushy notes + Purple Cherry Punch’s mouth-watering sweet berry aroma. High THC levels ensure a potent journey regardless of which route you take!

variants.title: Goldie Knox Jar Live Rosin
variants.body_html: Extracted using only ice and water, retaining more terpenes and cannabinoids. Goldie Knox is a unique cross that produces a calming and relaxing effect.

variants.title: Baby Jeeter Bubba G Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Bubba G is an indica-dominant strain infused with liquid diamonds and coated in kief. Known for its fruit forward profile, each inhale delivers sweet berry notes followed by a light spice and earthy kush finish. The aroma blends ripe berries with subtle floral and grounded undertones, creating a smooth and balanced flavour experience.

variants.title: Gran Turismo PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Tribal Gran Turismo pre-rolls deliver the same high octane flavour profile as the flower. It's gas forward with creamy and sweet undertones, now in a convenient pre-roll pack. Rolled from whole flower (never trim or shake) and finished for an even burn, each pre-roll delivers the same high quality you expect from Tribal. Grown indoors, hang dried, hand trimmed and packed fresh to preserve flavour and potency, Gran Turismo pre-rolls showcase dominant terpenes caryophyllene, limonene and linalool for a terpene-rich and smooth smoke from start to finish.

variants.title: Sativa PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Sativa by Thumbs Up is a strain specific pre-roll pack featuring ever changing strains.

variants.title: Frosted Tiger Nuts PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Frosted Tiger Nuts is a cross between Horchata x Frosted Fruit Cake. This indica-dominant hybrid is as potent as it is beautiful. Horchata is a 50/50 hybrid created through crossing Mochi Gelato x Jet Fuel Gelato. Frosted Fruit Cake is an indica-dominant cross between Fruity Pebbles OG x Wedding Cake. The combination creates a beautiful terpene profile of fuel and funk. At Northern Canna we believe our pre-rolls should be the same quality as our dried flower. Our Pre-Rolls are made with big's and tops, not lowers or micros. We believe pre-rolls are not meant to hide low quality flower. This creates a truly an enjoyable experience for all.

variants.title: Goofiez PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Goofiez was developed by crossing Apples & Bananas and Jokerz. Bred by Compound Genetics, Goofiez features flavours such as pear, peach and vanilla.

variants.title: Sour Raspberry Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html:
The sweet, fruity flavor of ripe raspberries bursts on your palate, perfectly balanced by a zesty sourness that delivers a mouth-puckering twist.

Made with liquid diamonds.

variants.title: Gryphon Bent Neck Water Pipe 12.2"
variants.body_html:
The Dopezilla Elemental Gryphon Water Pipe is a 12.2-inch bong that keeps things smooth, effortless, and easy to enjoy. Drawing from the Gryphon’s air-element energy, this piece leans into a clean, modern aesthetic with an anodised finish that instantly elevates it beyond your typical clear glass. It’s eye-catching without trying too hard.

On the function side, it’s built for easygoing, consistent sessions. The beaker base adds extra water capacity for better cooling, while the bent neck keeps everything comfortable so you’re not hovering at a weird angle mid-hit. Inside, a pyramid perc handles filtration, diffusing smoke just enough to smooth things out while keeping airflow open and satisfying.

It’s straightforward in all the right ways: dependable, stylish, and the kind of piece you’ll keep reaching for.

Key Features & Benefits
Beaker Base & Bent Neck Design: Stable, comfortable to use, and built for smooth, natural pulls
Pyramid Perc: Provides added filtration for cooler, more balanced hits
14mm Male Bowl: Compatible with standard accessories for easy swaps and cleaning
Durable Glass Construction: Designed for regular use without feeling fragile
Anodised Finish: Sleek, modern look that stands out from traditional clear glass
Custom Box: Comes packaged in a designed box for safe storage or gifting

If you’re after a reliable everyday bong with a bit more personality, the Gryphon is an easy step up.

variants.title: Dopezilla Sylph Dab Rig 7.7"
variants.body_html:
The Dopezilla Elemental Sylph Dab Rig is a 7.7-inch bong that keeps things smooth, compact, and easy to get into. Designed with that light, air-element feel, it’s comfortable in hand and built for clean, flavour-forward sessions without overcomplicating your setup. The anodized smoky grey finish gives it a more refined, modern look — understated but dialed in.

Performance-wise, it delivers exactly where it matters. The showerhead perc provides solid diffusion, cooling things down while still letting your terps come through properly. Hits stay smooth on the inhale without sacrificing flavour, and the included 14mm quartz banger rounds things out with consistent heat and clean sessions right out of the box.

It’s a smaller piece that still holds its own when it comes to function.

Key Features & Benefits
Compact 7.7-Inch Design: Easy to handle, store, and travel with
Showerhead Perc: Smooths and cools hits while keeping flavour intact
14mm Quartz Banger: Reliable heat retention for consistent sessions
Durable Glass Construction: Built for regular use without feeling delicate
Anodized Smoky Grey Finish: Clean, modern look with a subtle edge
Custom Box: Comes packaged for safe storage or gifting

If you’re looking for a compact bong that keeps things smooth and flavour-forward, this one’s an easy pickup.

variants.title: Atomik Asteroid Dual Use Water Pipe - 5.5 in.
variants.body_html:
Blast off with the Atomik Asteroid Dual-Use Water Pipe, a 5.5-inch cosmic wonder that delivers big performance in a compact form. Designed for smooth, flavourful hits with minimal drag and superior percolation, the Asteroid makes every session feel like you're floating through the stars. Perfect for solo explorations or intergalactic gatherings, this piece is ready to propel your sessions to new, thrilling galaxies.

Fully equipped with a quartz banger, herb bowl, carb cap, and stainless-steel dab tool, the Asteroid gives you everything you need to dive into both concentrates and dry herbs. Its sleek, durable design makes it a stellar addition to any cosmic collection.

Key Features & Benefits:

Compact 5.5-Inch Size: Portable and powerful, making it ideal for both at-home adventures and on-the-go sessions.

High Percolation: Advanced design provides smooth, filtered hits that take your experience to the next level.

Minimal Drag: Effortless pulls that maximize flavour and keep the resistance light, letting you enjoy the full experience.

Complete Accessory Kit: Includes a quartz banger, herb bowl, carb cap, and stainless-steel dab tool—everything you need to explore new worlds of flavour.

Durable Glass Construction: Made from high-quality glass that’s both reliable and easy to clean.

Modern Space-Age Aesthetic: A sleek, eye-catching design that stands out like a comet streaking across the night sky.

Prepare to be launched into another dimension with the Atomik Asteroid Dual-Use Water Pipe—compact, mighty, and ready to take your sessions to a whole new universe!

variants.title: Candi Gas Mixed Pack - Froot Stripez & Gas Tingz
variants.body_html: Candi Gas is a milled cannabis variety pack designed for consumers who love bold, gas-forward flavours. This pack includes two milled batches of quality flower, Froot Stripe and Gas Tingz. Conveniently pre-milled and full of flavour, Candi Gas delivers a powerful experience at a great value.

variants.title: Vanilla RNTZ Liquid Diamonds Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Like a burst of confetti, this vape has explosive flavours that'll sweeten any session. 98.1% THC potency. We'll say it again. 98.1% THC POTENCY. So, the Spinach Vanilla RNTZ 1g liquid diamonds vape doesn't only hit those sweet, vanilla, and creamy flavour notes, it hits the senses at an unparalleled level of potency thanks to that shimmering liquid diamonds infusion. With inspiration from the Vanilla RNTZ strain and a Vanilla Kush and RNTZ lineage, this vape levels up all the sweet vibes, tastes and aromas in each puff.

variants.title: Moonlit Berry Gummies
variants.body_html: This multipack contains 10 immediate containers, each with one soft chew - for a total of 10 soft chews. Unwind with the Moonlit Berry 10-pack gummies carefully formulated to help you craft the perfect chill day or night. Each single gummy blends 10mg THC with 20mg CBN, for a total of 100mg THC and 200mg CBN per pack. Bursting with rich dark berry flavour, these gummies deliver bold taste, while supporting calm and tranquil vibes. Convenient single-serve packaging makes it easy to enjoy wherever you are.

variants.title: Jonny's Stash Rotational
variants.body_html: Jonny’s Stash Rotational Indica is a curated collection of premium indica cultivars. Experience the pinnacle of freshness and quality with each batch, showcasing a diverse spectrum of flavours, aromas, and effects.

variants.title: Sour Grape Rush Gummies
variants.body_html: This multipack contains 10 immediate containers, each with one soft chew - for a total of 10 soft chews. Experience Sour Grape Rush, a 10-pack of individually wrapped gummies designed for flavour and experience. Each gummy blends 10mg THC with 25mg CBG for a unique, uplifting balance. Bursting with tart purple grape flavour and a long-lasting sour finish, these gummies deliver bold taste with every bite. With 100mg THC and 250mg CBG per pack, Sour Grape Rush offers precise dosing, convenient single-serve packaging, and a rush of tangy flavour, perfect for anytime enjoyment,

variants.title: Peachy Pie PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Peachy Pie is a fruity, indica dominant strain from Peach Cobbler and Cherry Pie. This cultivar delivers sweet, fruit-forward notes layered with diesel and earthy hints. These large buds are coated in shimmering trichomes. Whole flower and hand crafted, just the way your pre-rolls should be. BOLD Craft Cannabis flower is indoor grown, small batch, hang dried, slow cured, and hand trimmed.

variants.title: Gas Pack
variants.body_html: Gas Pack 3.5g features expertly grown whole flower showcasing bold gas aromas and flavours in a rotating single-strain by Pistol and Paris selection.

variants.title: Nostalgia Aged Sticky Hash Infused PR 4 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Jublee Nostalgia Infused Pre-Rolls (32–40% THC) — a carefully curated pack designed to celebrate both heritage and innovation. Each pre-roll is built around a rotating selection of premium hybrid flower and infused with Jublee’s renowned Aged Sticky Hash, produced in the traditional Afghan method for a truly authentic expression of craft. Together, they create a potent, slow-burning experience that balances strength with nuance. The flavour is unmistakably retro: rich Kush notes layered with smooth, resinous undertones, evoking classic sessions while delivering the consistency and refinement of modern extraction. The hash infusion not only boosts potency but also enhances the texture of the smoke, offering a full-bodied draw that is smooth, satisfying, and distinctly Jublee. Nostalgia Infused Pre-Rolls deliver more than just convenience — they’re an invitation to reconnect with the roots of hash culture in a format that’s easy, reliable, and deeply flavourful.

variants.title: Sour Green Apple Liquid Diamonds Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: A crisp burst of tart green apple hits your taste buds first, followed by sweet, fruity undertones that keep things fresh and vibrant. Bright, sour, and undeniably tasty. Made with liquid diamonds.

variants.title: Sour Green Apple Liquid Diamonds Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: With every inhale, you’re greeted by the sharp, sweet-tart notes of a crisp, juicy apple. These new palm-style devices are loaded with features for controllability to enhance your experience. Features like, variable voltage and 10 second pre-heat. Made with liquid diamonds.

variants.title: Space Cake Milled
variants.body_html: Divvy's milled Space Cake flower is ready to roll, pack or vape right out of the bag. This convenient, pre-ground sativa cultivar boasts lineage from Snow Lotus and GSC. Its terpene profile features fenchol, caryophyllene and terpineol to deliver smooth, sweet and cream notes for a flavourful experience. No grinder needed.

variants.title: The Collective Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: The Collective Diamond Infused 5x0.5g rotational pre-rolls.

variants.title: Live Resin Zlush Rntz Infused PR 3 x 0.6 g
variants.body_html: Zlush Rntz is a fusion of fruity sweetness and spicy zest. This unique hybrid strain blends coolness with a burst of bold flavours. With every inhale, enjoy a fresh and flavourful experience that's full of character and diamond coated.

variants.title: Watermelon Z Live Resin Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Watermelon Zktlz by Be Humble is a disposable vape. Sweet, smooth and loud like a summer anthem. This strain specific cart delivers a flavour that’s juicy like watermelon, bursting with tropical notes and finished with a smooth and fruity fade. Bold and nostalgic, it’s flavour that moves like a classic beat. Built for the grind and made to shine.

variants.title: STIX Space Cake PR 10 x 0.4 g
variants.body_html: Good to go, whenever you are! We’ve perfected the pre-roll and packed them into sleek stix full of Space Cake heaven with sweet, frosty and decadent flavours. Space Cake is a sweet strain, ready for any portable indulgence moments to keep you movin’ or to chill out and share a little green with your friends. With strain lineage from Space Cake x Snow Lotus, this pre-roll is a refined take on a classic. This pre-roll hits when it comes to looks, tastes, smells, and feels. This session treat is as delicious as it is sleek.

variants.title: BC Organic Mandarin Zktz PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: From our friends at Odyssey Genetics we are excited to introduce our BC Organic Mandarin Zktz, an exotic cross of California Black Rozé x Mandarin Sunset R1. Her dense resinous buds bring bold aromas of sweet oranges, complemented by spicey and gassy notes. Expect excellent flavour translation to the smoke, with a mouthwatering profile that offers a tantalizing sensory experience. Grown in our organic living soil, hand-trimmed and never irradiated.

variants.title: Miami Daze PR 14 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Welcome to Miami Daze by Vibe! This delightful pack of sativa pre-rolls is your passport to an adventure.

variants.title: 91 Royale
variants.body_html: This citrus funk sativa (Lemon Royale x White 91) is a flavour bomb. Strong notes of lemon and a dank funk linger in the flavour. This plant has large sticky green buds that are covered with resin.

variants.title: Britscotti
variants.body_html: Originally bred by Cookies, Dank of England phenohunted and produced this cut crafting Britscotti, a cross of Gelato #25 x GSC x South Florida OG. A smooth yet potent indica with big buds and a distinct aroma and flavour profile. Experience notes of sweet buttery biscuits with hints of lemon. Flavour translates with a slight nuttiness that's reminiscent of espresso. BLKMKT flower is always indoor grown, hand trimmed, hang dried, cold cured and hand packaged at our own facilities in BC. Never sourced, never any shortcuts.

variants.title: Cake N Bake or Citrus Candy Cake
variants.body_html: Light, bright and ready to vibe. Expect pineapple sweetness, citrus and a soft floral aroma — with just enough gas on the back end to turn heads. Packed with trichome-covered buds that hit as good as they smell.

variants.title: Sandalwood & Grapefruit Fizz Bath Bomb
variants.body_html: A fragrant bath fizz infused with CBD extract, sandalwood and grapefruit. Dissolve in a warm bath to enjoy a full body soak. Made without colourants and made with sandalwood, grapefruit and essential oils. Each Noon & Night Sandalwood and Grapefruit Fizz Bath Bomb contains 100 mg of CBD. Avoid broken skin and sensitive areas. For topical use only.

variants.title: Ratio'd Tropic Boost Gummies
variants.body_html: Call it Tropic, call it Boost — either way, this one’s all fruit. Ten gummies with a sugar-dusted tropical flavour profile, each loaded with 10 mg THC, 10 mg CBD, and 20 mg CBG. That’s 100 mg THC, 100 mg CBD, and 200 mg CBG across the pack in a clean 1:1:2 ratio. No Future 10X the Madness: flavour in the front, numbers in the back.

variants.title: Pineapple God
variants.body_html: High-THC indica-leaning Pineapple God is one of Soar’s exclusive cultivars. This plant offers stacked colas of sticky green, pink and purple buds with exotic aromas of tropical fruit. Pineapple God is a potent God Bud cross with aromatic Black Cherry Punch. Soar Cannabis is selective and disciplined in our process. Grown in smaller batches and carefully sorted to ensure only our best buds make it through to the finished product. Hand-harvested, hang-dried, and hand-detailed with a humidity pack in every bag.

variants.title: Blue Dream Jumbo Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Pura Vida Legacy's Blue Dream live resin jumbo cartridge is packed with live resin. This sativa leaning hybrid features the iconic OG Blue Dream lineage, delivering a sweet berry flavour profile. With high THC and a strong terpene profile, this cart is compatible with all 510-thread batteries.

variants.title: Rosin Infused Lemon Black Tea
variants.body_html: Using only the finest ingredients, TeaPot Rosin-Infused Lemon Black Tea is made with real black tea and natural lemon flavour. It contains 10mg of solventless THC with a refreshing taste that will enhance your day.

variants.title: Blackberry Frost Infused Blunt 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Our Blackberry Frost Infused Blunt is a high-potency slow-burning blunt featuring a premium oil infusion rippling with flavours of jammy blackberry and creamy vanilla. Made with small batch, hang-dried, whole flower and hand-finished with a generous coating of premium fresh-flower kief. Finished with a Dutch crown for a smooth, even burn.

variants.title: Terp Gush Lemon Sherb Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Step into a world where flavour knows no bounds with the The Loud Plug’s Terp Gush Lemon Sherb 510 Vape. A true-to-flower experience, this juicy live resin is the bursting with purity and potency, having been crafted from only fresh-frozen Lemon Sherb flower that’s undergone a meticulous arctic hydrocarbon extraction to capture and preserve the most terpene-rich, citrusy notes in every drop. With each puff, you'll taste the sun-kissed zest of lemon groves; a true gusher of flavourful terpenes perfectly preserved for an unparalleled vaping experience.
