variants.title: 1:2 THC:CBG Tablets
variants.body_html: Blips 1:2 THC/CBG Tablets are designed for simplicity and consistency. Each tablet contains 10mg THC and 20mg CBG, with 25 tablets per pack for a total of 250 mg THC and 500 mg CBG. Tiny, discreet, and portable, Blips offer a precise 1:2 ratio of cannabinoids in an easy-to-use format. A straightforward option for consumers looking for controlled dosing and a sugar-free alternative to traditional edibles.

variants.title: Blackberry Lime 2.5 THC + 5 CBG Seltzer
variants.body_html: JUST Seltzers Lite Blackberry Lime delivers a crisp, fruit-forward flavour with a refreshing balance of juicy blackberry and bright lime. Lightly sparkling and easy to enjoy, it’s designed for consumers looking for lower-intensity without sacrificing taste. Each can contains 2.5mg THC and 5mg CBG. Made with a clean, straightforward ingredient list and no unnecessary extras, JUST Seltzers Lite focuses on what matters most: flavour, consistency, and value. It’s approachable, sessionable, and built for repeat enjoyment. JUST Seltzers Lite. Because why not?

variants.title: Rainbow Driver Cured Resin Gummies
variants.body_html: The Rainbow Driver Gummies feature Rainbow Driver by Woody Nelson, pressed by High Fidelity, and gummified by Elevate in Port Coquitlam, BC. Each bag includes ten 10mg cured resin-infused gummies with notes of citrus and bramble berries.

variants.title: Berry Fumez
variants.body_html: Berry Fumez Live Hash Rosin sweet fermented strawberries give way to volatile gas aromas in this exclusive Slurmmm genetic. Sungrown in a greenhouse using living soil and a high level of care, the plants are hand harvested and crafted into solventless, jar grade live hash rosin in the 73u–159u micron range.

variants.title: Northern Apple Jaxx Live Rosin
variants.body_html: Crafted from certified organic, sun-grown cannabis cultivated at 420m elevation in Lillooet’s intense, arid climate, this live rosin is harvested at peak maturity and fresh frozen. Using first-wash trichome heads in the 90–159μ range, it is washed and pressed solventlessly to preserve clarity, flavour, and the cultivar’s natural expression. The profile opens with crisp green apple and watermelon, followed by subtle sandalwood and pine, finishing clean and resinous, drawn from Apple Jaxx, Northern Lights, and G13 genetics. Produced in small batches with a focus on purity, flavour, and terroir-driven expression, Northern Apple Jaxx reflects EarthWolf’s commitment to thoughtful cultivation and uncompromising solventless craft.

variants.title: Live Rosin Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: This 100% pure full spectrum live rosin was produced by High Fidelity using fresh frozen flower and a solventless ice water extraction followed by a gentle decarb process in house. Handcrafted in Nelson, BC, this rotating selection of live rosin captures a rich terpene profile and features a golden color and full flavor, delivering true dab quality taste and with the ease of a vape.

variants.title: Ice Cream Cake Gembar Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: An indica-dominant hybrid (75% indica / 25% sativa) bred from the celebrated Wedding Cake and Gelato #33 lineages. This vape features live resin diamonds derived from Live Resin (ZERO Distillate), staying true to the strain’s natural profile with a luxurious fusion of sweet, creamy flavour notes that deliver a smooth, decadent draw. Engineered with next generation hardware, the device is post less, discreet, and pocket friendly, offering full oil visibility through its innovative 360° design. A wide mouth opening provides optimal airflow for consistently rich pulls, while the USB C rechargeable battery ensures strong performance right down to the final drop.

variants.title: Super Sativa Oil
variants.body_html: Crafted with organic cold-pressed coconut oil, organic extra virgin olive oil, and organic ice water hash, Super Sativa Oil preserves the flower’s full expression. Each drop delivers a bright profile of flavour and aroma in a smooth oil format. Single source, small batch, and organic.

variants.title: Strawberry Froyo Blunt PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Strawberry Froyo is an indica-dominant cultivar bred from Grape Cream Cake and Grandpa’s Gun Chest. Expect a sweet, creamy profile with notes of strawberry, yogurt, and cake, thanks to dominant terpenes caryophyllene, limonene, and farnesene. The flower in expertly milled and rolled into a slow burning blunt wrap.

variants.title: Coffee Creamer Blunt PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Inspired by the smoothest part of your morning ritual, Coffee Creamer Blunt is worth savouring. This Seed Junky genetic is a decadent indica with rich, creamy coffee and vanilla flavours and hits as satisfying as your first sip. This Zkittles and Kush Mints cross pairs old-school depth with dessert-like nuance for an indulgent taste. Produced in small batch, strain-specific rooms, hang-dried, cold-cured, and hand-trimmed before rolling into a decadent blunt wrapped in premium hemp for a slow, smooth burn. From first spark to final exhale, enjoy Coffee Creamer, it’s pure craft excellence you can taste.

variants.title: Pick Me Up PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Pick Me Up is sativa-dominant strain made by crossing Unicorn Poop x Animal Face. This sativa-dominant flower grows dense buds covered in a thick layer of trichomes. The herbaceous funk and fruity citrus attributes are loud and obvious, with lingering gassy undertones. Top terpenes include Caryophyllene, Myrcene, and Limonene.

variants.title: Gastro Pop Premium Smalls
variants.body_html: Gastro Pop Smalls is a hybrid cross of Apples & Bananas and Grape Gasoline from Compound Genetics. A pungent, complex aroma of sweet fermenting apples and bananas with a stinky sour grape gasoline. The forest green buds are dense, and all calyx with dark purple hues. Minimum guaranteed total terpene: 4.5%. Harvested plants are whole plant hang dried in optimal conditions for a minimum of two weeks before the finished flower is carefully hand-trimmed and hand-sorted. Grown, processed and packaged in the same micro-facility, Amani Craft is dedicated to delivering the freshest flower in the market.

variants.title: Purple Lemonade
variants.body_html: Purple Lemonade is commonly bred from Purple Haze, Lemon Skunk, and Sweet Skunk, creating an indica-dominant cultivar. While some breeders list variations — such as Purple crossed with Citrus Cali genetics — the Purple Haze, Lemon Skunk, and Sweet Skunk lineage is the origin most often cited. Offered in a 14g whole flower format. Dominant terpenses include beta-caryophyllene, limonene, and bisabobol.

variants.title: Gas Tank Cold Cured Resin Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: With high THC, GAS Tank delivers strain specific potency with bold flavour and a true-to-flower experience. No additives, just full spectrum cold cure resin. Smooth and potent, fuel up with GAS Tank.

variants.title: Milk Chocolate Live Rosin Waffle Cones
variants.body_html: A delicious blend of Belgian milk chocolate and strain-specific Gelato 41 live rosin wrapped in a crunchy waffle cone. Taste the live rosin difference, feel the live rosin difference.

variants.title: Lemonatti Slim PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Created by crossing Gelonade x Biscotti, Lemonatti is a sativa that doesn’t disappoint when it comes to terpene content. Lemonatti delivers a flavour that can only be described as a lemon cookie topped with sweet and creamy lemon frosting. The product is delicately milled and machine packed into convenient pre-rolls for maximum flavour and convenience.

variants.title: Sativa
variants.body_html: This sativa-dominant whole flower delivers strong THC potency potential and bold, flavourful buds.

variants.title: Pink Flamingo Dripbar All-in-One Vape
variants.body_html: Pink Flamingo floats the taste of ripe red strawberries blended with light, creamy vanilla.

variants.title: Watermelon Drip Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Trippy Sips Watermelon Drip oozes Summertime flavour. With a waterfall of juicy ripe watermelon this 0.95g 510 vape packs pure liquid diamonds what more can you ask for. Every pull delivers a crisp, watermelon rush.

variants.title: GMO Kush PR 70 x 0.4 g
variants.body_html: GMO Kush from Big Bag O’ Buds offers tube-style pre-rolls with high THC potency. This strain delivers a pungent, funky profile with earthy kush aromas that make a lasting impression. With bold, robust flavours and a smooth finish.

variants.title: Shake & Puff Rapid CBN THC Nighttime Inhaler Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: The MediPharm Labs Nighttime CBN THC Rapid Inhaler is fast-acting without any smoke or vapour. Enjoy a perfectly measured puff every time. Designed to deliver the product to your lungs for increased bioavailability and a speedy onset. The aroma and flavour are very subtle to offer a smooth and discrete experience. For optimal use, remove the cap and shake vigorously for 3-5 seconds. Immediately after shaking, exhale, then your place lips around the mouthpiece with your chin tilted upwards. Begin inhaling first, then press down on the canister to release product while continuing to inhale. Hold in for 5-10 seconds before exhaling. Wait to feel the effects before determining whether to take another dose.

variants.title: Indica
variants.body_html: This indica-dominant whole flower delivers strong THC potency potential and bold, flavourful buds.

variants.title: Golden CRML Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Unlock liquid diamond purity and a flavour that's truly gold. The Golden CRML 0.95g 510 vape combines a perfectly smooth sweetness, with a velvety exhale. It's rich, potent, and irresistibly smooth. A gold-standard of elevation.

variants.title: Red Razzleberry Ld Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Sticky Greens Red Razzleberry brings the fresh picked taste of sweet and sour raspberries to our extra potent infused pre-rolls. We’ve blended this fresh flavour into whole flower cannabis, evenly mill-infused it with a liquid THC diamond blend, and then coated each pre-roll with kief in this big multi-pack.

variants.title: Blue Razzleberry Dripbar All-in-One Vape
variants.body_html: Blue Razzleberry brings a shock of refreshing blueberry that makes our classic sweet and sour raspberry flavour better than ever.

variants.title: Purple Fog
variants.body_html: Purple Fog is a stunning purple indica descending from potent Purple Punch x Jungle Cake lineage. From a large family tree of head-turners, this purple takes the cake with its deep violet colours that run all the way to the stem, and striking lilac and lavender hues on the grind. It delivers aromas of smooth florals, woodsy pine and sweet, savoury herbs, with a punch of gas and spice from dominant terpenes limonene, linalool, ​and beta-pinene. The plant produces dense, frosty deep purple colas with sharp emerald leaves outlined in dark purple. Its grape-shaped buds are solid and compact, frosted in sticky golden trichomes. Pure BC bud, hand-harvested, hang-dried and hand-finished.

variants.title: Gas Mask Variety Pack PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Quality pre-rolls. Three bold strains. One gas-powered lineup. The Gas Mask variety pack features a curated mix of Banjo, Ghost Banner and Gas Mask, which are potent indica and indica dominant cultivars with gassy, citrus and earthy profiles. Each pre-roll is hand packed with whole flower (no trim, no shortcuts) for a smooth and consistent burn and full spectrum flavour. Whether you're exploring the range or stocking up on favourites, this variety pack brings high THC.

variants.title: Where's My Car
variants.body_html: Where My Car features a unique sweet and sour aroma with a cake finish, derived from its genetic relatives Amnesia Haze x Lemon Kush. This potent sativa comes pre-milled and ready to roll!

variants.title: OG Kush
variants.body_html: For the first time, the remake is going to be better than the original. Spinach® OG Kush is our new take on a classic strain making for a super flavourful and potent cultivar. A cross between GMO #12 x SFV OG, get earthy, piney, and citrusy flavours and aromas pumped up from terps like myrcene, limonene, and caryophyllene. This cross doesn’t only make for a flavourful strain, it pumps up the potency to new levels and makes it the newest ‘OG’ experience you won’t want to miss.

variants.title: BC Organic Lemolada
variants.body_html: Enjoy a taste of summer, with BC Organic Lemolada. With sweet citrusy notes, and some tropical vibes, prepare for an inviting sensory experience. A unique cross of Lemonade Runtz x Taco Colada, her robust aromas translate exceptionally well to the flavour profile which will surely leave you wanting more. Grown in our organic living soil, hand tended, and never irradiated, her pristine buds come packed in our premium glass jars for optimal freshness.

variants.title: Mutant Tire Fire
variants.body_html: All Gas No Brakes. This potent hybrid strain ignites your senses with its pungent and savory aroma inherited from GMO, complemented by sweet and fruity notes from Sherb Crasher. Brace yourself for an intense and energetic high that stimulates the mind and relaxes the body. With its vibrant buds covered in resinous trichomes, Mutant Tire Fire is a visual delight that offers a captivating cannabis experience unlike any other.

variants.title: Grape Kush NSFW Liquid Blunt Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: This cartridge is built for those looking for the bold, unmistakable taste of a grape blunt in a potent, ultra-smooth 510-thread vape. Packed with insanely strong liquid diamonds, it delivers deep, rich grape flavour with a hint of earthy spice — just like rolling up, minus the wrap. Made with our industry-leading BHO extraction, there are no added solvents, pigments, fillers, or waxes — just pure, unfiltered potency. If you miss the classic grape blunt, this one’s for you.

variants.title: Hawaiian Pineapple
variants.body_html: Hawaiian Pineapple, a sativa-dominant, crowd-pleaser bred by crossing Dole Whip and Cookies & Cream. When it comes to flavour, the name says it all. Hawaiian Pineapple packs a mouthwatering sweet and tropical pineapple taste with a light creamy fruity exhale. The aroma is extenuated with undertones of sour citrus and spice. The buds are sativa structured with gleaming trichomes and colorful hues.

variants.title: Zeropoint95 -The Red One Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Tastes just like No Future’s best-selling gummy, because they don't believe in messing with a good thing. A taste of red, dialed all the way up. That rush of juicy, sweet watermelon hits first — bright, full, and unapologetic before sinking into a smooth fade that’s deep and unhurried. It’s familiar but heavier, like the glow of taillights on wet pavement — steady, slow, and impossible to miss. No Future 0.95g vapes aren't here to change your life. They're here to make it taste better for less. Intense flavour, zero drama.

variants.title: Blue Cookies
variants.body_html: Blue Cookies is a flavour-packed hybrid that blends the best of Blueberry and Girl Scout Cookies, offering a sweet, fruity herbal aroma. This flower has a heavy nose and the flavor to match.

variants.title: Ultra Orange Hash Hole Infused PR 1 x 2 g
variants.body_html: The Pure Sunfarms Trials program just got more potent. The Ultra Orange Hash Hole is a hand-crafted infused pre-roll featuring Ultra Orange, a highly expressive citrussy sativa from the trials library, hand-selected for its impressive aromatics. The hash hole is made with solventless, terp-rich hash rosin, cold cured and pressed in-house in a hash lab, then rolled into a snake and encased within freshly ground flower and natural paper. Finished with a wide-mouth glass filter and a Dutch crown. Ultra Orange is a potent cross of MK Ultra and Agent Orange, delivering notes of freshly peeled oranges, sour citrus and sweet earth that are amplified in this slow-burning, smooth-smoking, highly potent infused pre-roll.

variants.title: Day + Night Dual Disposable Vape
variants.body_html:
Slide over and dial in your experience with this THCV:CBN dual device that is USB-C rechargeable and ready to rip. Shine bright with a supercharged sativa surging with explosive citrus flavour and then move to the moon with a chill indica that hits you with a deep grape and blueberry flavour from a custom blend of botanical terpenes.

The Cruise Control Day + Night Dual 2.0 g all-in-one vape offers the best of both worlds, with Formula-V at 230 mg THCV, 350 mg THC, and 340 mg CBD and Couch Lock Kush at 350mg THC, 300mg CBD, and 150mg of CBN - the perfect cannabinoid stack to last you from sunrise to sunset. Slide to the sunny side for THCV and cruise over to the moon for your CBN or max out in the middle if you are feeling indecisive. Have your vape and smoke it too.

variants.title: B!tch Slap
variants.body_html: B!tch Slap (Fruity Pebbles OG x Grape Pie x Zkittlez) is loud, creamy gas with just a kiss of fruit - this strain doesn't play nice. The inhale brings a rich, velvety fuel note that coats the palate, while subtle sweet berry undertones peek through on the exhale. Potent, euphoric, and heavy-hitting, B!tch Slap is perfect for those who crave that gassy punch with only a whisper of sweetness. Hang Dried, Hand-Trimmed, Cured for 30days.

variants.title: Double Black Hash
variants.body_html: The new Vortex Double Black Hash takes our award-winning original to potent new heights. Crafted with proprietary techniques and hand-selected premium cured flowers, this next-generation Black Hash delivers a more powerful high- setting a new benchmark for modern hash.

variants.title: U15 Black Cherry Soda Sativa 7 g - Unit 15
variants.body_html: Black Cherry Soda is a sativa-dominant cultivar bred from Black Dahlia x Ace of Spades, offering a bold, fruit-forward experience wrapped in deep purple hues and frosty trichomes. Crafted in small indoor batches by Unit 15 Ltd., this format provides premium, hand-trimmed whole flower ideal for discerning consumers who value both flavour and effect. Expect an aromatic burst of black cherry, cola, and subtle floral spice. The buds are dense and vibrant, with dark violet coloration, bright orange pistils, and a glistening resin layer that signals both potency and quality. Grown under full environmental control in our purpose-built indoor facility, Black Cherry Soda is cold-cured to preserve its terpene profile and ensure a smooth, clean burn. This cultivar is a true standout for those who appreciate sativa-leaning effects paired with boutique aesthetics and flavour.

variants.title: Pop n' Pour Bubble Trubble
variants.body_html: Freshly ground sticky sweet indica popping with sugary bubblegum aromas. Fluffy, sticky goodness packed in a pop top tube with a humidity pack to keep things super easy and extra fresh. Just shake, pop n' pour. Super Toast. Always Ready.

variants.title: Virtue Caviar Flight Caviar
variants.body_html: The Caviar Flight offers a curated selection of Virtue Caviar concentrates. Each is made from premium inputs and refined to deliver potency alongside rich terpene profiles. Expect authentic flavors and a flawless, velvety texture in every jar. Built for discovery, the Caviar Flight brings together a selection of standout concentrates, giving you a taste of what defines the premium collection.

variants.title: Blueberried Liquid Diamond Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Get Blueberried! This indica all-in-one vape bursts with juicy blueberry flavour and sky-high potency. It's packed with ultra-pure Liquid Diamonds extract, delivering a rip-roaring 94-98% THC. From the first puff to the last, this vape is built to get you RIPPED.

variants.title: Blueberried Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Get Blueberried! This indica 0.95g 510 cart bursts with full-on blueberry flavour and sky-high potency. It's loaded with ultra-pure Liquid Diamonds, delivering 94-98% THC. From the first puff to the last, this cart is ready to get you RIPPED.

variants.title: Randy's Fahrenheit Butane Torch - Black
variants.body_html:
The Randy’s Fahrenheit Torch is built for reliable heat, precise control, and everyday durability. Designed with a lightweight yet solid feel, this butane torch delivers consistent performance whether you’re dialing in a gentle flame for flavour or turning up the heat for bigger sessions. Its ergonomic design keeps it comfortable in hand, while the auto-ignition system makes lighting quick and effortless.
With adjustable flame control and powerful heat output reaching up to 2372°F, the Fahrenheit Torch gives you the flexibility to fine-tune your setup exactly how you like it. A built-in base and flame lock also allow for hands-free use, making longer sessions or heating tasks easier and more convenient.

Key Features & Benefits:
High Heat Output: Produces temperatures up to 2372°F for fast, efficient heating when you need serious power.
Adjustable Flame Control: Easily fine-tune the flame size to match your preferred heat level and session style.
Hands-Free Flame Lock: Lock the flame in place for continuous use without holding the trigger.
Auto-Ignition System: Reliable push-button ignition provides a clean, consistent flame every time.
Durable Construction: Lightweight but sturdy build designed for dependable, long-term use.
Stable Base: Includes a built-in base so the torch can stand upright for convenient hands-free operation.
Long Burn Time: Offers approximately 40 minutes of continuous use on a full tank.
Colour Options: Choose your style with Black, Blue or Silver.

Reliable, powerful, and easy to use, the Fahrenheit Torch is a solid addition to any setup.

variants.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
variants.body_html: The classic Chocolate Chip Cookie packing 10mg of strain-specific, full-spectrum cannabutter extracted from local craft cannabis. These cookies treat you right, we promise.

variants.title: Live Rosin Reserve
variants.body_html: Limited, small batches of solventless live rosin, carefully extracted from various cultivars we are actively growing like: Rainbow BLTZ, Critical Condition, The Grape Slurpee, Truffle Berry, and more. Our Solventless Live Rosin is made from single source, fresh frozen whole flower — grown in living soil by Just Kush. Extracted from the finest 73–159-micron ice water hash, we use only water, ice, heat, and pressure, at low temp — preserving the cannabinoids and terpenes. This solventless concentrate reflects Just Kush's commitment to craftsmanship, from hand-watered plants to hand-harvested flowers, hand-pressed rosin, and hand-packaged products.

variants.title: Orange Velvet Liquid Diamonds Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Lord Jones® curates cannabis experiences at the highest level to truly go above and beyond with each product. With our Lord Jones Liquid Diamonds x Live Resin vape, we knew that one extract would not be sufficient in delivery on that promise. Liquid Diamonds deliver on potency, reaching 99.2%, but our Live Resin delivers on a full spectrum with the preservation of terpenes, flavonoids, and that added premium experience with each puff. The Orange Velvet strain is no diamond in the rough. This vape was born out of a desire to bring the highest quality cannabis to those that seek to go above and beyond with each session for premium experiences. So, enjoy a fresh summer treat of summer’s past with creamy orange flavours that push boundaries of taste experiences and aromatic delights.

variants.title: 95+ Tangie Cream Biodegradable Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: A smooth Tangie Cream distillate in a biodegradable disposable vape. It delivers citrusy sweet flavour with a clean finish, crafted for convenience and sustainability.

variants.title: Electric Blueberry FSE Resin Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Platinum Electric Blueberry FSE Resin all-in-one vape is an indica dominant strain with Afghani × Thai lineage. Each inhale bursts with juicy and fruity flavours that linger on the palate.

variants.title: Rainbow GLTO Liquid Diamond Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Rainbow GLTO is now infused with raspberry flavour. Crafted from strain specific flower and refined into liquid diamonds, each disposable vape delivers high potency. Fuego ensures a smooth and flavourful draw that meets the expectations of discerning consumers.

variants.title: BC Organic Lemolada
variants.body_html: Enjoy a taste of summer, with BC Organic Lemolada. With sweet citrusy notes, and some tropical vibes, prepare for an inviting sensory experience. A unique cross of Lemonade Rntz x Taco Colada, her robust aromas translate exceptionally well to the flavour profile which will surely leave you wanting more. Grown in our organic living soil, hand tended, and never irradiated, her pristine buds come packed in our premium glass jars for optimal freshness.

variants.title: Atomic Slurricane
variants.body_html: Atomic Slurricane is an exceptional cultivar born from the cross between Do-Si-Dos x Purple Punch x Atomic Pink. Its dense, perfectly trimmed flowers display deep green hues with subtle purples, covered by a thick layer of translucent, sticky trichomes that give them a striking frosted appearance. A true aromatic explosion, Atomic Slurricane showcases a rich terpene profile (4% to 6%) dominated by limonene, linalool, and beta-caryophyllene, delivering a sweet and complex bouquet of ripe fruits, floral notes, and refined spices. Meticulously cultivated, this strain combines aesthetics, intensity, and sensory sophistication.

variants.title: Blue Rhino Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Dab Bods Blue Rhino 50’s+ triple infused pre-rolls are the overachievers of pre-rolls. Infused with resin, distillate and botanical terpenes, then coated in diamonds, these pre-rolls don’t just roll, they strut. Each pre-roll delivers a smooth and consistent burn with a burst of sweet blueberry taste that’s impossible to ignore. Blue Rhino is flashy and full of personality.

variants.title: Cherry Bomb
variants.body_html: Cherry Bomb from Jonny Chronic is a potent sun-grown, sativa-dominant hybrid strain that produces dense light green buds with golden orange pistils and a thick frosting of trichomes. Created from crossing complex parents, Mama’s Chili Bomb x Headspace, share legendary genetics from OG Kush, Tangerine Dream and a Hawaiian landrace. Cultivated in southwestern Ontario under the sun, all of our plants are hang-dried and cured before our team goes through and carefully selects top colas to then be hand-trimmed and hand-packed in house.

variants.title: West Coast Classics Duo Pack PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: A ten-pack duo featuring two BC-grown West Coast classics: Pink Kush and Blue Dream #16. Pink Kush is a tried-and-true kush. Our cut came to us from legacy bud on Vancouver Island. It expresses classic aromas of of white pepper, orange, butterscotch, coffee and earth. ​Blue Dream #16 is our hand-picked pheno of the California classic Blue Dream. This sativa boasts dreamy aromas of citrus, blueberry, spice and cake. Made with fresh flower, ground with precision, finished with a Dutch crown for an easy light and clean, even burn.

variants.title: Florida Oranges
variants.body_html: Nugz Florida Oranges is a citrus fuelled flower that delivers exactly what you’d expect from its name: loud orange zest with a punch of gas on the backend. This indica leaning hybrid comes stacked with sticky resin-rich buds bursting with a tangy and sweet terpene profile led by limonene, caryophyllene and myrcene. Hand trimmed, hang dried and grown in our indoor facility, Florida Oranges brings big flavour and high potency for consumers who want more out of their bag. Packed fresh in a resealable mylar pouch to lock in that Nugz quality.

variants.title: Florida Oranges PR 7 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Nugz Florida Oranges pre-rolls are a citrus fuelled product that delivers exactly what you’d expect from its name: loud orange zest with a punch of gas on the backend. This indica leaning hybrid is rolled with sticky resin-rich buds and showcases a terpene lineup led by limonene, caryophyllene and myrcene.​ Hand trimmed, hang dried and grown in our indoor facility, Florida Oranges brings big flavour and high potency for the consumers who want more bang for the buck. As always, packed fresh and rolled properly to lock in that Nugz quality.

variants.title: Gran Turismo
variants.body_html: Gran Turismo from Tribal is a high octane indica bred for flavour chasers and potency seekers. Expect a gas forward nose layered with creamy and sweet undertones and dense, trichome-coated buds. Grown indoors under precision controlled conditions, hang dried, hand trimmed and nitrogen sealed in an airtight can to lock in freshness. Dominant terpenes include caryophyllene, limonene and linalool, delivering a smooth smoking experience that stays true to the craft promise.

variants.title: Purple Fog
variants.body_html: Purple Fog is a stunning purple indica descending from potent Purple Punch x Jungle Cake lineage. From a large family tree of head-turners, this purple takes the cake with its deep violet colours that run all the way to the stem, and striking lilac and lavender hues on the grind. It delivers aromas of smooth florals, woodsy pine and sweet, savoury herbs, with a punch of gas and spice from dominant terpenes limonene, linalool, ​and beta-pinene. The plant produces dense, frosty deep purple colas with sharp emerald leaves outlined in dark purple. Its grape-shaped buds are solid and compact, frosted in sticky golden trichomes. Pure BC bud, hand-harvested, hang-dried and hand-finished.

variants.title: Neon Lotus
variants.body_html: Neon Lotus is a fresh take on an indica leaning lineage. This strain is popular for its potency. This hang dried flower offers tangy fruit, herbal earthiness and diesel funk. Neon Lotus brings all the razzle dazzle, no reservation required.

variants.title: Peach Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Peach. Sweet and simple. Juicy nectar, orchard fresh and no need to wait until summer. Peach season is in-hand with a portable, discreet and all-around dependable all-in-one vape. Cannabis ready to consume — whenever you need it. That's Standard Issue. Stripped of excess, honed to essentials, and designed to keep pace — not for show, but for real life. Consistent, dependable, and ready when you are. Standard Issue: everything you need, nothing you don't. Triple-distilled distillate for purity. Botanical terpenes for taste. No gimmicks - just smooth pulls and big flavour. Welcome to the new standard.

variants.title: Pineapple Glimmer Whipped Diamonds
variants.body_html: Pineapple Glimmer Whipped Diamonds are BAM's newest innovation. THCA Diamonds whipped with cannabis derived terp sauce with a dash of botanical terps to create this new texture. Packed with flavour and potency, diamond whips are here to wow!

variants.title: Moon Drops Bubble Hash Coated Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Up your game with DEBUNK Triple Infused Moon Drops Darts, an indica that delivers a full serving of lychee and pear, hints of juicy citrus and berries. This pack of Darts are Bubble Hash coated and infused with THCa, Liquid Diamonds, and botanical terpenes for maximum flavour and potency — no distillate to be found. With high-quality milled flower in a classic format, this cross between Purple Urkel x Do-Si-Dos comes in at 40% THC, delivering a pack of bold, premium pre-rolls built for potency.

variants.title: Berry Sunshine Diamond Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Bright blue skies lie ahead with Berry Sunshine. Ripe berries, fresh lemon juice and some sugar make this flavour shine. G.A. Diamond Infused pre-rolls are made with our trusted base of quality milled whole flower and boosted with a custom infusion of THCa, finished with our triple distilled distillate and kief coating. Unlock better moments with the flavours you love dialled up.

variants.title: Fruitsplosion Five Diamond Blend Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Fruitsplosion Five is a harvest of popular fruity flavours in this liquid diamond-infused pre-roll variety pack. Enjoy Lychee Ice, Blue Shark, Mango Tango, Pink Swirl and Apple Blast flavours, each rolled into whole flower cannabis, evenly mill-infused with a liquid THC diamond blend, and then coated in kief. 44% Liquid Diamond, 35% Distillate, and 20% botanical terpenes.

variants.title: CBG Cluster Bomb The Red One Gummies
variants.body_html: Seriously, we actually did it. No Future CBG Cluster Bomb – The Red One is a 10-pack that drops 50 mg CBG per gummy, adding up to 500 mg total in the bag. It’s our strongest CBG format to date, delivered in bold red gummies that don’t hold back. Straightforward, heavy numbers, and no confusion — just the kind of scale that belongs in the 10X the Madness family.

variants.title: Sour Zkz Bubble Hash Coated Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Up your game with DEBUNK Triple Infused Sour ZKZ Darts, a vibrant sativa-dominant that that cuts deep with sharp lemon-lime citrus flavour and subtle earthy notes to balance it out. This five pack of darts are bubble hash coated and infused with THCA diamonds, and botanical terpenes for maximum flavour and potency. Wrapped around high-quality milled flower in a classic half-gram format, this iconic cross of ZKZ and Sour Diesel comes in at 40% THC for a pack full of potent pre-rolls.

variants.title: B!tch Slap PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Bitch Slap (Fruity Pebbles OG x Grape Pie x Zktlz) is loud, creamy gas with just a kiss of fruit — this strain doesn’t play nice. The inhale brings a rich, velvety fuel note that coats the palate, while subtle sweet berry undertones peek through on the exhale. Potent, Bitch Slap is perfect for those who want that gassy punch with only a whisper of sweetness. Hang-dried, Hand-trimmed, cured for 30 days.

variants.title: Biodegradable 95+ Double Mango Liquid Diamonds Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Expect big flavour and extremely high potency from this Biodegradable 95%+ Double Mango Liquid Diamonds All-in-One. This eco-friendly disposable vape has a removable and recyclable battery housed in a biodegradable corn PLA shell. Fresh mango aromas burst with tropical sweetness from this potent blend of liquid diamonds and live resin. With a robust botanical and cannabis derived terpene profile, this rechargeable All-in-One premium hardware is perfectly calibrated and optimized for this specific formula to allow for the perfect vaping experience.

variants.title: G-Wagon PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: A stunning release by Umami Seeds, G-Wagon is a cross of Georgia Pie and Zwish. This indica-leaning bruiser grows in chunky, box-like clusters of bright silver, resinous flowers. This is VCC’s first release of a very unique flavour profile. This flower is straight up savory and reminds one of lime corn chips and sweet gas. With over 3% total terpenes and flowers coming in over 30%, she will soon be a staple in every discerning enthusiasts must have list.

variants.title: Diamond Doobies Dragon's Breath Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Go frost yourself with BOXHOT Dragon’s Breath Diamond Doobies infused pre-rolls. Enjoy a powerful blast of dragon fruit complemented by notes of skunk and tropical fruits. This iced-out sativa trio is infused with a botanical terp-boosted liquid diamond blend then coated in a layer of crushed diamonds to deliver massive potency and flavour.

variants.title: Lime Heads
variants.body_html: Lime Heads is a sativa-dominant hybrid offering a layered flavour profile of bright lime, classic kush, and subtle cake-like sweetness. A cross of The Lime and Headband, this cultivar has quickly become a staff favourite at Island Genetics. Grown indoors at a purpose-built Vancouver Island facility, Lime Heads is cultivated in organic living soil with close attention to plant health and quality. Plants are hang-dried for two weeks, hand-trimmed, and cured for a minimum four weeks in Terp Lock bags to preserve aroma and overall flower integrity.

variants.title: Turbulence
variants.body_html: These buds deliver a rich, savory, earthy gas profile with the grind releasing a diesel-soaked oil rag aroma and notes of lemon menthol on the dry pull. All gasoline on the exhale. Dense, sticky buds are olive green with a traditional bud structure. Available for limited-time-only.

variants.title: Gas Leak Rosin
variants.body_html: Sugr's Drop Culture Live Rosin Gas series features potent live rosin concentrates extracted from gas strains renowned for their pungent, fuel-like aromas and flavours. Full spectrum of cannabinoids and terpenes, all achieved through a solventless extraction process.

variants.title: Pineapple Haze
variants.body_html: Pineapple Haze brings classic Super Silver Haze traits of a potent sativa, but with an added touch only Pineapple Buds can provide. By crossing this outstanding genetic with Pineapple Tart, the flavour profile gets an added mouth-watering, creamy, pineapple coconut taste. The flowers are bright green with red hues and have a thick frosty coating of trichomes.

variants.title: Organic Apex Kush PR 1 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Meet Apex Kush, a potent indica grown organically in the heart of BC and cultivated with care. Each bud is hang dried and slow-cured for four weeks to enhance its complex aroma and flavor. Rich and layered, Apex Kush opens with chocolate and coffee notes, followed by a sweet, fruity exhale and a hint of spice.

variants.title: Envy PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html:
Bred by Carmel x Treez, Envy is a striking cross of Thin Mint Jealousy and Permanently Jealous, delivering a potent and unforgettable experience. Open the pouch to reveal dense nugs with vibrant purple marbling and deep dark green hues, all coated in a thick layer of frosty trichomes. Envy's allure lies in its bold aroma and flavor profile-a heady mix of funk, pepper, and gas.

variants.title: Mollo Mango Seltzer 4 Pack
variants.body_html: This multipack contains 4 immediate containers, each with one beverage - for a total of 4 beverages. variants.title: Maxed Out Sticky Peach Liquid Diamond Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Clickstix by Chillbilly introduces the Maxed Out Liquid Diamonds All-in-One Vape-and this ain't just another cart, it's a modular sesh machine. Built with magnetic sides, these vapes snap together like magic, letting you mix and match flavours, stack your stash, or share with a buddy. Sticky Peach brings a powerful peach punch with a gassy exhale, powered by high-potency diamonds created via hydrocarbon extraction. Whether you're doubling down on your favourite or clicking together a custom combo, Clickstix let you build your sesh your way-just like your truck: loud, proud, and full of power.

variants.title: Neon Sunshine Live Rosin Happle Sm'Hash
variants.body_html: The first cannabis beverage collaboration has arrived in Ontario, where soda artistry meets hash mastery. Sheesh Sodas and Nugz unite to reimagine the legendary Happle, infused with Neon Sunshine Live Rosin — the Zktlz x Falcon 9 strain that captures pure California. Sweet and tangy flavours meet vibrant, frosty terpenes for a taste that’s all sunshine and good vibes. Each sip blends premium ingredients including real Canadian apple juice with Sheesh’s signature sparkle and Nugz’s full-spectrum rosin — delivering a bright, delicious and smooth experience. Limited release.

variants.title: Blue Razz Lemonade Gummies
variants.body_html: The XMG Atomic Sours Blue Razz Lemonade X Pack features an iconic tangy blue raspberry and zesty lemonade flavour combination. These soft chews offer a super sour twist. Each soft chew is infused with 10 mg of THC and 10 mg of CBG with no cannabis aftertaste.

variants.title: Tropical Twist Live Resin Badder
variants.body_html: The Tropical Twist live resin badder is smooth and bursts with juicy exotic fruit notes and a rich, aromatic finish. This format provides more of our high quality live resin badder at a great price.

variants.title: Cherry Bang Bang Live Resin Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Iris Labs' Cherry Bang Bang is a cherry forward sativa leaning phenotype of Pineapple Fruz x Wild Cherry. Live resin, no distillates and no additives.

variants.title: Switch V5 Triple Chamber Tropical Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: The Boutiq Trio-Politan has a triple chamber that features a custom live screen display for flavour selection, battery and use tracking. Botanical extract blends of rich flavours with aromas from caryophyllene, sweet vanilla myrcene and tart strawberry create a complete flavour experience. The hardware and flavour assortment in this device is all to support the smooth and potent liquid diamond extract that's high in THC.

variants.title: Purple Fog PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: These pre-rolls are packed with freshly ground Purple Fog, a true purple stunner descending from potent Purple Punch x Jungle Cake lineage. The inhale delivers aromas of smooth florals, woodsy pine and sweet, savoury herbs, with a punch of gas and spice. Ready to burn in pack of ten.

variants.title: Sgt. Pineapple Slims PR 20 x 0.4 g
variants.body_html: These fine pre-rolls are slim like Jim, packed straight and steady from top to bottom, in a pocket-sized pack. Stuffed with sweet, tropical hybrid bud, smelling like canned pineapple chunks. All you need is a light. Super Toast. Always Ready.

variants.title: Facade PR 7 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Catch the sun while it lasts with Facade, a limited-edition hybrid crafted from a cross of Eye Candy x Apples & Bananas. Turn up the heat with high THC. Bursting with citrus, floral, and musky notes, its terpene profile of beta-caryophyllene, d-limonene, and linalool keeps the vibes bright and bold. Summer won’t last forever, and neither will this seasonal exclusive.

variants.title: Banjo PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Banjo is a carefully curated indica dominant pre-roll featuring a funky blend of citrus, diesel and earthy notes. Each pack includes pre-rolls made with whole flower (never trim), delivering a smooth and flavourful smoke. Hand packed, evenly rolled and ready to spark.

variants.title: Ghost Banner PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: This hybrid blends potent lineage and bold terpenes to deliver a smooth and gassy pre-roll experience with hints of citrus and earth. Each pack of pre-rolls are expertly rolled with whole flower for a clean burn.

variants.title: Facade
variants.body_html: Catch the sun while it lasts with Facade, a limited-edition hybrid crafted from a cross of Eye Candy x Apples & Bananas. Turn up the heat with high THC. Bursting citrus, floral, and musky notes, its terpene profile of beta-caryophyllene, d-limonene, and linalool keeps the vibes bright and bold. variants.title: Gas Pack
variants.body_html: Dom Jackson’s Gas Pack offers a high quality craft cannabis experience. Each strain is hand grown in our micro-cultivation facilities, where we meticulously tend to every plant from seed to harvest, ensuring high quality. Our dedication to traditional methods shines through in every detail. Each bud is carefully hang dried, hand trimmed and hand packaged to preserve its full integrity and potency. The result is a product that’s not only powerful but also crafted with precision and care. Gas Pack delivers a potent and smooth smoke.

variants.title: BC Organic Lime Drizzle
variants.body_html: BC Organic Lime Drizzle is an exquisite cultivar crafted from the rare pairing of Caviar Lime x PapayaDawg, bred by Grounded Genetics. Its bouquet opens with bright candied lime, layered over rich undertones of gas and earthy funk. Grown in our organic living soil, this cultivar exemplifies the harmony of aromas and flavour, delivering a refined expression that lingers long after each exhale.

variants.title: The Feel Stick XL
variants.body_html: The Feel Stick features a broad spectrum blend of 500 mg of CBD, 100 mg of CBG and 100 mg of CBC in a moisturizing cocoa butter and beeswax base. Our mess-free salve stick is designed to be applied to muscles and joints. Camphor and menthol leaves a tingly, cooling sensation with sweet citrus notes from the lemon eucalyptus and lemongrass essential oils. Avoid broken skin and sensitive areas. For topical use only.

variants.title: La Bomba
variants.body_html: La Bomba is a standout Broken Coast genetic, crossing Jet Fuel Gelato x Wedding Cake. This 50/50 hybrid boasts a potent THC content, delivering a dynamic profile of minty, earthy, sweet and gassy flavours. Crafted with Broken Coast’s signature cultivation practices, La Bomba is a new expression of cannabis grown in small batches, hang dried, hand trimmed and slow cured to preserve terpene richness and potency. It’s bold and built for those who appreciate something different.

variants.title: Mary-go-round
variants.body_html: Selected seasonal cannabis strains depending on the time of the year. In winter, an indica leaning strain with an earthy flavour. In summer, a sativa leaning fruity flavour.

variants.title: Mango Kush x Galactic Giggles Shatter
variants.body_html: Blast off into a stellar experience with Galactic Giggles x Mango Kush Shatter! This potent concentrate delivers a fusion of kushy and mango sweetness with undertones of pine, diesel, and a touch of banana on the finish. As powerful as rocket fuel, brace yourself for an otherworldly journey filled with contagious giggles that will launch your senses into orbit.

variants.title: Envy
variants.body_html:
Bred by Carmel x Treez, Envy is a striking cross of Thin Mint Jealousy and Permanently Jealous, delivering a potent and unforgettable experience. Open the pouch to reveal dense nugs with vibrant purple marbling and deep dark green hues, all coated in a thick layer of frosty trichomes. Envy's allure lies in its bold aroma and flavor profile-a heady mix of funk, pepper, and gas that hits hard and lingers.

Because it's the right thing to do, all of our flower is hang-dried, hand-trimmed, slow cold-cured, and hand-packaged. We keep it fresh and terpy by sealing it up in nitrogen-flushed pouches with a humidity pack inside. And yeah-non-irradiated, obviously.

variants.title: Sloppy Troppy Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Portal’s Sloppy Troppy Liquid Diamonds 510 Cartridge channels raw potency and precision into every pull with 95–99% THC. The formulation pairs the strength of Liquid Diamonds with bold tropical notes of watermelon and citrus, built to hit smooth while staying punchy from start to finish. Engineered with a first-to-market lock-top mouthpiece (to keep it clear of lint in your pocket!), it’s crafted for reliability and flavour integrity, giving you a premium experience every time. Sloppy Troppy isn’t just another vape. It’s a high-voltage expression of fruit-forward firepower.

variants.title: 1:1 Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: hydrocarbon extraction with inputs from Country Club partners and Terroir Craft Farms. The cured resin is housed in a 1g full ceramic cartridge fitted for a 510 battery with a recommended voltage of 1.8v–2.5v. Made in BC.

variants.title: Bluenose Berry
variants.body_html: Bluenose Berry by Truro Cannabis is a high THC indica hybrid with serious candy-shop vibes. This exclusive pheno of Grape Pie x Jet Fuel Gelato was hand-selected from over 100 seeds. It delivers a sweet strawberry-rhubarb jam aroma and a fruity, tangy flavour that lingers on the exhale. Its multi-coloured buds blend deep green and purple hues with wiry rust-orange hairs and a thick blanket of sugary trichomes for top-tier bag appeal. Grown indoors in Truro, Nova Scotia, Bluenose Berry is true craft flower. Hang-dried, hand-trimmed, and slow-cured for 28 days to lock in flavour and ensure a smooth, even burn. Big flavour, bold colour and unmistakable quality.

variants.title: Miracle Mints PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: At PURPLEFARM, a great pre-roll starts with what matters most: exceptional flower. Our Miracle Mints pre-rolls are made exclusively with our Ontario-grown, small-batch cultivar. This breeder cut of Cap Junky (Kush Mints #11 × Alien Cookies #7) is known for its heavy frost, complex terpene profile, and high potency. Each pre-roll is hand-filled into a slim cone and packaged with a humidity pack to preserve freshness. Expect bold, creamy mint flavours with hints of gas and sweetness, delivering a smooth, satisfying smoke every time. Miracle Mints is your go-to for consistency, potency, and premium taste — crafted with care, rolled with precision, and always fresh.

variants.title: Ray’s Peach Rosin Lemonade
variants.body_html: Ray’s Peach Lemonade takes our iconic lemonade base that's bright, crisp and tart, and smooths it out with the lush sweetness of ripe, sun kissed peaches. The result is a golden blend that tastes like summer in a bottle. It has vibrant citrus up front, mellow peach in the middle and a clean, refreshing finish. But Peach Lemonade isn’t just a flavour, it’s a Ray’s experience. It's infused with THC and powered by our in-house emulsion technology.

variants.title: Cocolato Live Resin Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: The Cocolato Live Resin All-in-One Vape takes you on an unfiltered journey of audacious dank flavour and potency. Each hit is a testament to its purity. Handpicked fresh frozen flower undergoes an arctic extraction adventure, locking in those bold terpenes and cannabinoids. Go ahead and savour the sweet, gassy and creamy flavours of this live resin. With love from Scarborough.

variants.title: Berry Watermelon Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: It’s giving fruit-punch flashback, with a sweet chorus. Berry Watermelon loads up a full 1.2g of nostalgic flavour. Plug in and turn up. Vox 1.2g 510 Carts are heavy-hitters! Triple-distilled distillate and boosted botanical terps for flavour that hits ultra loud. Built to go hard from first rip to last.

variants.title: Dunkd Red Pop Rntz Infused PR 10 x  0.3 g
variants.body_html: Introducing DUNKD Red Pop Rntz - infused with flavour-packed botanical terpenes, this homegrown indica-dominant gem boasts clouds of fruity, sweet goodness. Every puff is a big league burst of nostalgic berry flavour leaving your taste buds gushing like it’s 1999. Each joint is generously coated in a frosty micro trim, delivering consistent quality and a smooth, flavourful smoke from start to finish.

variants.title: Live Rosin Tabs
variants.body_html: Pressed tablets crafted with solventless Invader cold cure live rosin, delivering precise, discreet and full spectrum dosing. Easy to swallow and portable.

variants.title: Big Steal Live Rosin
variants.body_html: Thrifty Big Live Rosin is one of the best concentrate deals in Canada. Good luck finding a better diamond in the rough offering than this amazing and portable grab bag.

variants.title: Deep Value PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Introducing Deep Value pre-rolls (sativa), crafted to bring together quality, convenience and affordability. Each batch is carefully prepared and rolled to ensure a smooth and reliable burn from start to finish. With a focus on consistency and everyday value, Deep Value pre-rolls make it easy to consume fresh cannabis in a format you can count on.

variants.title: Rainbow Razz Distillate Infused PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Rainbow Razz infused pre-rolls offer a vibrant explosion of flavours and a fusion of rainbow infused raspberries, combined with potent THC extract in a quality disposable vape.

variants.title: Red Hawaiian Distillate Infused PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: XPLOR Red Hawaiian Distillate infused pre-rolls deliver a blend of fruit flavours combined with potent THC extract.

variants.title: Lemon-Up PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Lemon-Up pre-rolls by Truro Cannabis are smooth burning, citrus loaded sativa pre-rolls made with craft whole flower. This high THC cultivar is a legacy cross of Lemon Tree x Purple Punch x Trop Cookies and hits with bright lemon, lime and orange flavour — like a fruit stand exploded (in the best way). Each cone is expertly topped and packed to perfection, offering the same slow, flavourful experience as a hand-rolled pre-roll. No shake, no shortcuts. Grown indoors in Truro, Nova Scotia, Lemon-up is true craft flower. Hang-dried, hand-trimmed and slow cured for up to 28 days to lock in flavour and bring out its full terp profile. These pre-rolls deliver big citrus and true craft quality in every cone.

variants.title: Caps Junky PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Caps Junky by Truro is a potent legacy indica-dominant hybrid. This cultivar is a collaborative project between two of the most important modern breeders: Capulator and Seed Junky Genetics. This 50/50 balanced strain was created by crossing Kush Mints 11 (Bubba Kush x Animal Mints) x Alien Cookies (GSC x Aliendawg). Flavour profile is sweet, fruity, and minty. Caps Junky Pre-Rolls are produced from whole flower of our best-in class batches, and we have refined our mixing and milling processes to mirror the high quality and THC levels of our popular craft whole flower products. All Truro Pre-Rolls are hand-weighed and hand-packaged in recyclable tubes for a true craft pre-roll experience.

variants.title: Coffin Candy
variants.body_html: These jams are crafted from hand picked strains celebrated for their legendary terpene profiles. This indica hybrid delivers a sweet fruit candy flavour, thanks to the pairing of Rntz and Strawberry Zkilato, two strains known for their rich flavours and smooth, complex aromas. Expect dense, frosty buds absolutely drenched in trichomes, glistening like they were dusted with stardust. The aroma is a burst of juicy berries and tropical candy with a creamy finish that lingers. The flavour is bold, sweet and smooth from start to finish.

variants.title: Grape Hash
variants.body_html: Unveil the unparalleled elegance of Be Humble's Grape Hash, a 2-gram masterpiece meticulously crafted for true cannabis connoisseurs. This exceptional hash exudes the essence of succulent grapes, blending earthy undertones with delightful sweetness, reminiscent of a vintage wine. Each delicate puff reveals a symphony of flavors, enveloping your senses in a refined cannabis journey. With every session, experience the luxurious fusion of premium cannabis and the allure of fine grapes, perfectly balanced for an extraordinary encounter. Elevate your cannabis experience and immerse yourself in the sophistication of Be Humble's Grape Hash, where cannabis craftsmanship meets the essence of fine winemaking.

variants.title: Monsters Animal Amnesia Infused PR 1 x 2.38 g
variants.body_html: Straight out of the lab and into your hands, it’s Animal Amnesia, the latest creation from the Good Supply Monsters line. We spliced the wild intensity of Animal CKS with the genetics of Amnesia OG, then supercharged it with full spectrum resin and a second strain extract for double the entourage effect. This hybrid pre-roll offers high THC. Animal Amnesia explodes with diesel, sweet and skunky notes that lingers long after the smoke clears. Designed for maximum potency, these XL cones use flower, resin and high quality components that burn smooth and even.

variants.body_html: Say hello to Razzberry Bliss CBN vape. Blending the juicy flavours of raspberries with CBN (cannabinol), a non-intoxicating compound found in specific cannabis cultivars. Razzberry Bliss CBN vape is the perfect way to get the benefits of CBN.

variants.title: Sour Tangerine Live Resin Hash
variants.body_html: This terpene-rich infusion of live resin delivers a full-body high. Embrace nature with every inhale, wrapping you up in a wave of euphoria.

Rich and layered, Apex Kush opens with chocolate and coffee notes, followed by a sweet, fruity exhale and a hint of spice.

variants.title: Trial No. 015
variants.body_html: Trial No. 015 is a balanced hybrid selected for its uplifting citrus-pine profile and dense frosty buds. Each Trial strain is a chance to explore new genetics from our greenhouse—grown in smaller batches and available only for a limited time.

Slide it into Boost Mode for bigger clouds and bolder flavour. It offers a compact design, ceramic coil and rechargeable battery.

variants.title: Bumpin' Blue Rasp Nsfw Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: NSFW Diamond Coated pre-rolls are anything but basic!  These pre-rolls have the tart and sweet notes of classic blue raspberry, all while delivering high potency. All Adults Only — NSFW Liquid Diamonds Coated pre-rolls are filled with quality flower infused with our premium high potency liquid diamonds and are then rolled in solid diamonds. All NSFW Diamonds are made using our advanced and industry leading BHO extraction equipment and processes. Our proprietary formulation and processes allow us to liquify our premium diamonds without any added solvents, pigments, fillers, or waxes. Utilizing quality flower for quality outputs. Once our diamonds have been converted to liquid, we enhance the finished extract with botanical terpenes for the ultimate combination of flavour and experience.

variants.title: Stoned Fruit Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Go frost yourself with BOXHOT Stoned Fruit Diamond Doobies infused pre-rolls. These pre-rolls smash together mango, pineapple, and apricot in a juicy jumble of citrus and fruit that’ll leave your tastebuds wrecked and wanting more. variants.title: Diamond Doobies Deluxe Ruby Rush Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Ruby Rush diamond drenched pre-rolls. These pre-rolls come with botanical terpene boosted THCa diamonds and a crushed THCa diamond coating for potency and a smooth burn. This sativa sings with high THC potency and a cherry sweetness and citrus bite.

variants.title: Lunar Lychee Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Portal’s Lunar Lychee Liquid Diamonds 510 Cartridge pushes potency into orbit with 95–99% THC. Liquid Diamonds layered with exotic lychee, crisp Asian pear, and smooth vanilla cream, the flavour profile is engineered to be bold yet refined. Built with a first-to-market lock-top mouthpiece (to keep it clear of lint in your pocket!), it ensures consistent performance and flavour integrity from start to finish. Lunar Lychee isn’t just a vape, it’s a gravitational pull toward a black hole of indulgence.

variants.title: Granny Smith Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Expect big flavour and extremely high potency from this Granny Smith 97+ Liquid Diamonds 510 Cart. Bursting with sour apple aromas, this blend of Liquid Diamonds and Live Resin, features a sativa-leaning terpene profile.

variants.title: Mango Cake Live Resin Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Extracted from house-bred LSO Mango Cake strain, this 100% pure single-strain live resin 510 cart delivers the full fresh-plant terpene expression of Mango Cake — nothing added, nothing taken away. Packed in the market-leading CCELL Ceramic EvoMax, the ceramic core and post bring sweet mango flavours with smooth, consistent vapor from first draw to last. Mango Cake is an exotic dessert cross of GOOD BUDS’ juicy Mango Taffie and the sweet, creamy Wedding Cake. Expect a bright, tropical profile layered with soft pastry notes — true to the flower and unmistakably Mango Cake. variants.title: Guava Passion Fruit Liquid Diamond Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Weed Me Max’s Liquid Diamond Passion Punch Kush AIO is a 1g indica vape with very high THC potency potential, powered by liquid diamonds. Max’s proprietary terpene blend brings bold passionfruit layered with tropical hints of melon, pineapple, and kiwi, finished with a musky citrus edge. Housed in Max’s all-metal rechargeable AIO, with a ceramic atomizer and clog-free Precision Flow Tech™, the device delivers smooth draws that amplify both flavour and potency.

variants.title: Cream Soda Zero 4 Pack
variants.body_html: XMG Zero Cream Soda serves up XMG’s #1 soda flavour with no sugar added. Each 355ml can is lightly carbonated and bursting with flavour-forward cream soda taste. With all natural flavours, colours, plus 10mg of nano-infused THC, it’s a sweetly satisfying way to enjoy your favourite XMG beverage.

variants.title: Blueberry Donuts PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Blueberry Donuts from Good Supply is all about convenience and flavour. This indica-dominant genetic combines Northern Berry and Powdered Donuts for a profile that bursts with berry, lemon and sweet notes. Each pack includes ten perfectly sized 0.35g pre-rolls made with high-THC flower and a terpene trio of limonene, caryophyllene, and myrcene. Ready to spark and share, Blueberry Donuts pre-rolls make enjoying this tasty cultivar easier than ever.

variants.title: Lemon Diesel PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Introducing Lemon Diesel — a bold new sativa from 1964. Lemon Diesel brings an invigorating citrus twist, combining bright lemon zest with subtle earthy undertones. Its aroma is fresh and punchy, mingling notes of citrus with a hint of vanilla for a balanced, vibrant profile.

variants.title: Sunstone Liquid Crystals Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Sunstone's lush mango and peach flavours shine with every inhale.

variants.title: Fire OG Hash & Diamond Infused PR 1 x 1.5 g
variants.body_html: Get fiery with this Fire OG, which includes flower, solventless hash and liquid diamonds. It offers a gassy and earthy taste with a hint of acidic finish.

variants.title: Single Source Live Rosin
variants.body_html: Single source live rosin.

variants.title: Alien Pebbles
variants.body_html: Alien Pebbles is an evenly balanced hybrid strain brought to you by hybrid parents Alien OG x Fruity Pebbles OG (aka FPOG). Its bold fruity aromas are thanks to its Fruity Pebbles parentage, with complex and well-rounded notes of sugary grapes, tangy citrus, fresh herbs and light notes of sweet wood. The inhale is fruity with some subtle skunky notes when burned. Its frosty, stone-shaped buds are wide and chunky with rich forest green colours and eye-catching undertones of gold and bright amber, covered in sticky trichomes. Available for a limited-time-only.

variants.title: Niagara Nuken Jumbo Jar Rosin
variants.body_html: Top-tier concentrate made from fresh-frozen, whole-bud material, capturing the bold essence of the Niagara and Nuken strains. With earthy, sweet, and skunky flavours complemented by subtle notes of pine and spice, this rosin is as flavourful as it is potent.

variants.title: Sour Raspberry Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: The epitome of sour. Sour Raspberry is a full barrel of fresh market berries, sweet syrup and the perfect level of tartness. No fuss, just all-around flavour you can trust in a potent pack of infused pre-rolls. Cannabis ready to consume — whenever you need it. That's Standard Issue. Stripped of excess, honed to essentials, and designed to keep pace — not for show, but for real life. Consistent, dependable, and ready when you are. Standard Issue: everything you need, nothing you don't.

variants.title: Lemon Tartz PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Lemon Tartz is a cross between Super Lemon Haze and Wedding Cake. This aromatic Sativa strain has a distinct citrus and gas nose. The light green buds are dense and covered by a frosty coating of trichomes.

variants.title: Gasolina PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Born from Blueberry Diesel x Thai Haze, Gasolina is an indica-leaning strain with big fruity vibes and a classic gassy punch. Expect a smooth berry-diesel taste and an easy, enjoyable smoke that highlights its expressive flavour profile. These pre-rolls are made from BC-grown flower that is hand-trimmed, hang-dried, and perfectly cured to bring out its full flavour and character.

variants.title: Astronaut Status
variants.body_html: Astronaut Status was bred by Clearwater Genetics by crossing Zero Gravity x Mai Tai #4. The outcome is a funky flavour, delivering notes of gas, onion and wood. Upon opening your pouch, you can expect to see dense light green buds with lots of trichomes and bright red hairs. Because it’s the right thing to do, all of our flower is hang dried, hand trimmed, slow cold cured and hand packaged. We keep it fresh and terpene-rich by sealing it up in nitrogen flushed pouches with a humidity pack inside. Non-irradiated.

variants.title: Blue Passionfruit Diamonds Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Kolab Project Blue Passionfruit Diamonds 510 carts feature a hybrid formulation of potent liquid diamonds with a vibrant passionfruit and blueberry profile. It delivers an intense berry and tropical punch with dominant terpineol, limonene and caryophyllene terpenes. The hardware is designed for clean and consistent hits, thanks to even heating from the ceramic atomizer and stainless steel coil. Custom tuned saturation ports maintain steady clouds and flavour, while the stainless steel vent tube ensures smooth airflow. A refined black brass mouthpiece adds a touch of elegance to every hit.

variants.title: Backpackers Lemon Diesel PR 10 x 0.75 g
variants.body_html: Back Forty Lemon Diesel Backpackers are straight cut sativa pre-rolls, packaged in a resealable, water resistant tin. With a lineage of California Sour × Lost Coast OG, the strain lives up to its name, offering bright citrus and dank diesel flavours. Each pre-roll is wrapped in hemp paper that allows the flower's flavour to shine, burning steadily and evenly thanks to precisely milled flower. It offers a smooth smoke featuring prominent limonene, myrcene and caryophyllene terpenes.

variants.title: Sloppy Troppy Diamond Infused PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Portal’s Sloppy Troppy Diamond Coated pre-roll is a sativa blend high potency THCA diamonds. Each pre-roll is intentionally blended from select sativas to amplify both the entourage effect and the tropical flavour profile. From the moment you crack the tube, bold notes of watermelon, citrus and exotic tropical fruit burst through, staying aromatic and flavourful all the way down to the last puff.

variants.title: Strawberry Grail
variants.body_html: Strawberry Diesel x Holy Grail Kush. Strawberry Grail comes from a legacy lineage. These origins explain its high THC levels. Strawberry Grail offers woody, spicy and diesel aromas. The main terpenes are caryophyllene, limonene, farnesene, linalol and myrcene. Craft cannabis grown with love in Varennes, Quebec.

variants.title: Rays Blackberry Rosin CBG Lemonade
variants.body_html: Blackberry Lemonade starts with our signature lemonade base that's crisp and tart, then blends it with the deep, juicy sweetness of ripe blackberries. The result is a layered flavour profile that’s sweet up front, tart on the finish and perfectly smooth throughout. But Blackberry Lemonade isn’t just about taste, it’s about the experience. It's infused with both THC and CBG.

variants.title: Princess Cut Aventurine Diamond Coated CBG Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Princess Cut Aventurine brings you this uplifting experience with a beautiful hint of mint lime and CBG infused for a relaxing time.

variants.title: Electric Lemonade
variants.body_html: Electric Lemonade is what happens when citrus decides to plug itself directly into an outlet. This sativa tastes like a lemon that woke up one morning and chose fame — bright, zesty, and absolutely unwilling to blend in. The aroma hits like a lemonade stand on opening day, but with a twist: a little berry sweetness sneaks in like it’s trying to join the band. Think tangy citrus first, then a juicy berry back-up singer that smooths everything out. Crafted exclusively from whole buds—not trim—the grind comes out soft, fluffy, and perfectly even every single time. Zero stems, zero prep, zero nonsense. Just bold citrus-berry flavour from start to finish, ready to roll or pack the moment you open the bag.

variants.title: Organic Apex Kush PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Meet Apex Kush, a potent indica grown organically in the heart of BC and cultivated with care. Each bud is hang dried and slow-cured for four weeks to enhance its complex aroma and flavor. Rich and layered, Apex Kush opens with chocolate and coffee notes, followed by a sweet, fruity exhale and a hint of spice.

variants.title: Duke Nukem Caviar
variants.body_html: Duke Nukem Caviar brings a vibrant blend of citrus and earthy sweetness with subtle notes of mint, lavender, and a soft pine undertone. The result is a bright, expressive concentrate with a velvety texture and refined finish. Expertly crafted to capture the full aromatic range of this standout cultivar, Duke Nukem Caviar delivers bold flavour and exceptional quality in every dab.

variants.title: Grape God Caviar
variants.body_html: Grape God Caviar delivers a rich, layered flavour experience with sweet, berry, and pine-forward notes, brightened by subtle hints of grapefruit and grounded by earthy undertones that add depth. Crafted for a velvety texture and refined finish, Grape God Caviar highlights the full aromatic range of this iconic strain, delivering premium flavour in every dab.

variants.body_html: Gastro Pop by KWALL is a limited release that blends bold and modern genetics with quality craft. The buds are dense and resin-rich, showcasing deep violet and forest green tones wrapped in a heavy blanket of trichomes. On the palate, sweet grape and banana cream lead the way, followed by rich fuel and subtle spice on the exhale for a truly layered flavour. True to KWALL’s craft commitment, our small batch flower undergoes a meticulous process, including hang drying, precision hand trimming, slow cold curing and hand packaging to preserve terpene integrity and maximize flavour and smoothness.

variants.title: Yocan Evolve Plus XL Vaporizer Kit - Sakura Pink
variants.body_html:
The Yocan Evolve Plus XL is an innovative all-in-one dab pen, designed for both convenience and performance. Ditching traditional threading, this device features a magnetic connection for quick and hassle-free attachment of the atomizer tube. Equipped with quad coil technology, its four quartz rods deliver massive clouds and pure, flavourful vapor without sacrificing efficiency.

Built from medical-grade quartz and durable aluminum, the Evolve Plus XL withstands high heat while maintaining a clean and consistent experience. The adjustable airflow valve lets you customize your draw—whether you prefer dense clouds or rich flavour. With a powerful 1400mAh battery, this vaporizer keeps you going all day, and the micro-USB charging makes recharging simple and convenient.

To enhance portability, Yocan has integrated a dual-compartment silicone storage jar at the base of the battery, perfect for stashing your concentrates. Complete with a lanyard and dab tool, the Evolve Plus XL ensures effortless, on-the-go sessions whenever you need them.

Key Features & Benefits
Quad Coil Quartz Technology – Four quartz rods maximize vapor production and flavour for smooth, potent hits.
Magnetic Connection – Easy-to-use design eliminates threading for quick assembly and effortless maintenance.
Adjustable Airflow – Customize your experience with an airflow valve for dense clouds or optimal flavour.
Powerful 1400mAh Battery – Extended battery life keeps you vaping longer without constant recharging.
Leak-Proof Coil Caps – Prevents mess and conserves concentrate for a cleaner experience.
Built-in Silicone Storage – Dual-compartment jar at the base for convenient concentrate storage.
Micro-USB Charging – Charge anywhere with a universal micro-USB port.
Complete Kit – Includes a lanyard and dab tool for easy handling and portability.
Built for Performance, Designed for Convenience
The Yocan Evolve Plus XL Vaporizer Kit is a powerful and portable solution for concentrate enthusiasts. With quad coil heating, a long-lasting battery, and built-in storage, this vaporizer is made for smooth, hassle-free sessions anywhere you go.

variants.title: Midnight Berries Liquid Diamond Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Dive into the dark side of sweetness with Midnight Berries Liquid Diamond vape - a juicy, succulent blend of bold berry flavours that burst with every pull. Sweet, rich, and irresistibly fruity, Midnight Berries captures the essence of ripe, midnight-harvested berries for an experience that's as flavourful as it is powerful. Expect high potency, smooth clouds, and BOLD flavour. The BOLD choice for getting Glazed when distillate vapes aren't enough.

variants.title: Big Apple Pure Live Resin Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Our Big Apple Pure Live Resin Vape cartridge is crafted exclusively from 100% fresh-frozen flower. We never add additives, thinning agents, or botanical terpenes. Because doing it right matters. Upon your first inhale, expect to be blown away bold flavours of Sour Citrus, Cream and Apple Pie. Calibrated for smooth, consistent flavour with every pull, we recommend pairing our carts with a quality battery featuring variable temperature settings. Start at 2V and gradually adjust to find your perfect experience.

variants.title: Blue Magoo Resin Infused Milled Flower
variants.body_html: Dab Bods Blue Magoo Resin Infused Milled Flower brings rich, full-bodied flavour in a ready-to-roll format. Blue Magoo meets potent resin and cannabis terpenes for a bold, aromatic blend that delivers classic Dab Bods intensity. Expect vibrant blueberry and sweet, fruity notes with every smooth, consistent burn. Expertly milled for easy use and even infusion, this product bridges the gap between top-tier concentrates and premium flower-no tools, no fuss, just potent convenience. Blue Magoo Resin Infused Milled Flower is crafted for those who want serious flavour and potency in every pack.

variants.title: Afghan Black Hash
variants.body_html: Crafted in the tradition of Afghan hash-making, our Black Hash begins with carefully selected, fresh hang-dried flower. The flower is meticulously dry sifted to produce a clean, aromatic kief, rich in natural terpenes and cannabinoids. This kief is then expertly pressed into a dense, jet-black hash with a golden center that is smooth, flavorful, and true to its origins. The result is a premium concentrate that delivers both potency and an authentic, time-honored experience.

variants.title: Big Apple
variants.body_html: Bred by Seed Junky Genetics, Big Apple is a standout strain born from a cross of Apple Fritter and Sherb BX1, delivering both in potency and flavour. Its heart-shaped, dense nugs are coated in a frosty layer of trichomes, showcasing a striking appearance. The aroma and flavor profile blends sharp sour citrus, creamy notes, and sweet apple pie, creating a rich, full-bodied smoke that lingers on the palate. Because it is the right thing to do, all of our flower is hang-dried, hand-trimmed, slow cold-cured, and hand-packaged. We keep it fresh and terpy by sealing it up in nitrogen-flushed pouches with a humidity pack inside. And yeah, non-irradiated, obviously.

variants.body_html: Blueberry Donuts from Good Supply is ready to bring big flavour to your stash. This indica genetic combines Northern Berry x Powdered Donuts for a flavour profile that bursts with berry, lemon and sweet notes. With high THC and a terpene trio of limonene, caryophyllene and myrcene, this cultivar delivers bold aroma and taste.

Stealthy, stylish, and built for real life—the RYOT VERB 510 Battery is a compact powerhouse designed to elevate your cartridge vaping experience. With a durable exterior and a discreet flip-top lid, the VERB keeps your cartridge protected while delivering smooth, consistent hits wherever you go.

variants.body_html: Tropicanna Tangie from Big Bag O’ Buds is a sativa-leaning cultivar that boasts sweet clementine flavour. Perfect for those who crave a nostalgic citrusy terpene profile and a smooth sesh full of tangy-tasting pulls, thanks to top terpenes limonene and myrcene. Frequently tipping the scales at the higher end of the 24-30% THC range, this potent sativa is perfect for sunny day hangs around the park.

variants.title: Pink Rhino
variants.body_html: Pink Rhino is a cross of everyone’s favourite Pink Kush and old school legend White Rhino. Our growers have brought together two iconic parents to deliver a new candy-like kush that’s got it all: potency, dense sticky nugs, sweet aromas of sugary honey and classic kush notes of earth and gas from dominant terpenes linalool, myrcene, limonene. The plant produces cakey light green nugs that are naturally super tight and thickly coated in sugar from top to bottom.

variants.title: Cherry Bomb
variants.body_html: Cherry Bomb from Jonny Chronic is a potent sun-grown, sativa-dominant strain that produces dense, light green buds with golden-orange pistil and a thick frosting of trichomes. Created from crossing complex parents, Mama’s Chili Bomb and Headspace share legendary genetics from OG Kush, Tangerine Dream, and a Hawaiian Landrace. Cultivated in Southwestern Ontario under the sun, all of their plants are hang dried and cured before the team goes through and carefully selects top colas to then be hand trimmed and hand packed in-house. Dominant terpenes include Myrcene, Limonene, and Linalool.

variants.title: Heavy Hitter
variants.body_html: This flower boasts dense, sticky buds with a vanilla cookie dough gas terpene profile. Our flower is hang dried and hand trimmed on the branch, then cold cured for 20 days to ensure a clean burn and smooth smoke.

variants.body_html: 7ACRES White Widow 28g is a sativa-dominant cultivar created by crossing popular classics - White Widow x Cold Creek Kush. Thoughtfully selected crosses to create the first of it's kind. Try White Widow today, your taste buds will thank you.

variants.body_html: It doesn't get more classic than this. This legendary sativa has a blueberry smell that fills the room the second you crack open the bag.

variants.body_html: BC Smalls’ Fortune Cookies brings big flavour to every bag. Bred by Bulletproof Genetics, this is a cross between GSC and Fortune Teller. Grown in BC by legacy cultivators who know their craft, Fortune Cookies delivers sticky, crystal-coated buds in deep green and purple hues.

variants.body_html: Glenn’s No. 21 Sour Mango turns tropical sweetness into a puckering punch. Juicy mango flavour meets a bold sour twist for a soft chew that’s both sharp and smooth.
