variants.title: Tropical BFJ PR 1 x 1.5 g
variants.body_html: A juicy and fruity sativa blend full of sweet tropical berry flavour. This BFJ is all about bright flavours and is smooth. Grown in a hybrid greenhouse in Ontario, this big fat joint offers strong THC potency potential. Oversized and flavour loaded, it’s not just a joint, it’s a BFJ.

variants.title: Iced Peachy Mango Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Picture a roadside fruit stand where juicy mangoes, tropical citrus fruits and fuzzy peaches are being sliced up just for you. Take that flavour to go with the –ness Iced Peachy Mango All-in-One Liquid Diamonds 1g vape! Sativa-dominant and made with liquid diamonds and botanical terpenes, it’s all the delicious fruity flavour, plus high THC in a convenient cart and battery combo. A tropical escape in your pocket.

variants.title: 35's White Walker PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Walk this way — fast. White Walker (White Widow x Skywalker) leans spicy and pine-forward with a citrus hit. It'll have you running back for more. Say goodbye to overpriced mediocrity. Qwest 35’s 3.5g whole flower pre-rolls are crafted in small batches and hang-dried to keep their natural flavours and potency. Consistent craft quality without the sticker shock. The truth is in the bag.

variants.title: Gorilla Zkittlez
variants.body_html: Introducing Green Mountain Health Alliance’s Gorilla Zktlz Dried Flower. This strain delivers a captivating blend of spicy artisan chocolate, aromatic herbs, and fresh blossoms, creating an aroma that’s truly heavenly. Born from the renowned Original Glue x Zktlz lineage, Gorilla Zktlz inherits exceptional genetics while adding its own unique flair — promising to impress even the most discerning cannabis connoisseurs. With over 3% total terpenes, its top three — beta-caryophyllene, myrcene, and d-limonene — work in harmony to deliver a rich, full-bodied experience that balances flavour, potency, and smoothness.

variants.title: Get Buttered Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Jays presents potent products full of flavour in convenient formats. Get Buttered is a rich and smooth butter-flavoured vape featuring caryophyllene for depth and linalool for brightness. These highly potent 510 cartridges are formulated with quality cannabis extract that's high in THC, captured in state-of-the-art custom designed 510 hardware from 14th Round.

variants.title: Max Exhaust Haze Shatter
variants.body_html: MAX Exhaust Haze Shatter delivers high THC. This terpene heavy, sharp, citrus and diesel sativa brings a bold flavour and a clean, crisp snap.

variants.title: Maui Wowi PR 4 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Just the mention of Maui Wowie to some brings back memories. Others only know it as the parent to some of the most potent sativas on the market today. Hints of spice and fruit poke through an herbaceous back note, giving this sativa a profile you can’t help but recognize.

variants.title: BC Organic Mandarin Zktz
variants.body_html: From our friends at Odyssey Genetics we are excited to introduce our BC Organic Mandarin Zktz, an exotic cross of California Black Rozé x Mandarin Sunset R1. Her dense resinous buds bring bold aromas of sweet oranges, complemented by spicey and gassy notes. Expect excellent flavour translation to the smoke, with a mouthwatering profile that offers a tantalizing sensory experience. Grown in our organic living soil, hand-trimmed and never irradiated, expect nothing but the best buds in our premium glass jars.

variants.title: Watermelon Splash Diamond Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Keep the warmth of summer alive with Watermelon Splash. Bursting with juicy watermelon, syrupy sugar and tropical flavour that'll make things a little sweeter. Now 60%+ THC! G.A. Ultra-Infused Pre-Rolls are made using milled whole flower, dusted in premium kief, boosted with botanical terpenes, and infused with diamonds to deliver our most potent pre-roll yet. Go Higher than ever before with 60%+ THC and the G.A. flavours you love.

variants.title: House Shatter
variants.body_html: Hotbox House Shatter (OG Gas Series) delivers straight from our vault of gas-heavy strains. Crisp, glassy slabs packed with bold OG flavour and high potency. Always classic, always fire — no matter which legend is in rotation.

variants.title: Mango Fuzz BOOSTED Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Meet Back Forty BOOSTED, our all-in-one vape now with an extra twist. Mango Fuzz is tropical with ripe mango up front and a splash of juicy peach on the finish. Slide it into Boost Mode for bigger clouds and bolder flavour. It offers a compact design, ceramic coil and rechargeable battery.

variants.title: Blueberry DNTs Grind
variants.body_html: Redecan Blueberry DNTS Grind delivers perfectly ground, terpene-rich milled flower built for convenience without compromise. Made exclusively from whole flower, never shake or trim, we’ve tuned the mill size to lock in potency and preserve the strain’s signature terpene profile. A cross of Northern Berry x Powdered Donuts, this hybrid boasts high THC and a flavour spectrum of juicy berry sweetness with tart and sour notes. With caryophyllene, humulene and myrcene leading the charge, every jar offers a fresh, true-to-strain experience crafted through meticulous growing practices, hang drying and precision milling.

variants.title: Rare Cuts
variants.body_html: Delve into the exclusive world of Rare Cuts, a prestigious cannabis offering curated by The Florist. Each batch of Rare Cuts represents the pinnacle of cultivation excellence, showcasing a meticulous selection of rare strains that epitomize luxury and sophistication in cannabis. Limited in availability but boundless in impact, Rare Cuts sets a new standard for connoisseurs.

variants.title: Lazer Jet Craft
variants.body_html: Inked into your brain. Lazer Jet (Gary Payton x Falcon-9) is potent with diesel funk, citrus, and a grounded earthiness. Hit CTRL+P — this one's worth printing in colour. Crafted with care. No shortcuts. Qwest flower is small batch, hang-dried, and hand-selected to preserve its flavour, potency, and terpene-rich aroma. No gimmicks — just trichome-caked buds with real character, made for those who know the difference. The truth is in the bag.

variants.title: Cookie'z
variants.body_html: LowKey’s Cookie’z (Platinum Cookies x Ice Cream) flower glitters under bright light, captivating the eye as its scent grabs the nose with a wave of cream and sweetness, as its name suggests, and the barest hint of spice, pine and citrus for depth. Its trichome layer is dense enough to obscure leaves that range from sea foam to emerald, interspersed with indigo. Our recipe is complete with the saffron orange threads this rare sativa phenotype exhibits throughout its robust and compact flowers.

variants.title: Astronaut Status PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Astronaut Status was bred by Clearwater Genetics by crossing Zero Gravity x Mai Tai #4. The outcome is a funky flavour, delivering notes of gas, onion and wood. Because it’s the right thing to do, all our pre-rolls are made exclusively from whole flower, rolled in small batches into slim cones and hand packaged in glass tubes with cork tops.

variants.title: Green Congo
variants.body_html: Experience the wild allureof Green Congo.This extraordinary Sativa dominant strain has it's origins deeply rooted in Africa, merging the potent lieage of Congoleseand Bangi-Haze genetics. Adorned with mesmerizing mint-coloured and fiery orange hairs. Congo is a high terpene creation, loaded with pine and funky cream combined with a cool minty finish.

variants.title: Celestial Mega PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: 1Spliff Celestial Mega Pack is a cosmic collection of seven stellar strains. Inside you will find Hawaiian Snowcone, a potent mix of Zktlz x Lemon Cherry Gelato for those who love bold and aromatic flavours. Purple Aya shines with regal indica vibes and Island Pink offers a sweet and floral aroma. Quantum Kush blends Sweet Irish Kush x Timewreck for flavourful potency, Pink Lemonade brings a sweet and sour twist, Grape Escape bursts with fruity notes and Orange Rntz wraps it up with a citrusy finish. Whether you're a connoisseur or just want variety, this pack delivers unique strains.

variants.title: XVape Lanza Dry Herb Vaporizer - Black
variants.body_html:
The XVape Lanza is a compact dry herb vaporizer designed for smooth performance and precise control. Wrapped in a sleek, diamond-cut body with a soft-touch silicone finish, Lanza delivers clean, consistent vapor in a pocket-sized form. Fast heat-up, real-time temperature regulation, and thoughtful session features make it an easy choice for everyday use.

Powered by ceramic conductive heating, the Lanza preserves flavour while producing dense, satisfying vapor. Five preset temperature options let you fine-tune each session, while intuitive controls and an RGB LED light bar keep operation simple and discreet. With fast USB-C charging and a reliable built-in battery, the Lanza is ready whenever the moment calls.

Key Features & Benefits

Ceramic conductive heating: Promotes even heat distribution for clean flavour and efficient extraction

Five preset temperatures: Adjustable from 180°C to 220°C to suit different strains and preferences

Real-time temperature control: Maintains consistent heat throughout each session

Pocket-sized and discreet: Compact design that’s easy to carry and low profile

Soft-touch silicone cover: Comfortable grip with added protection and insulation

RGB LED light bar: Clearly displays device status with a modern, refined look

Multiple session timers: Lets you tailor session length with ease

Auto shutoff safety feature: Helps conserve battery life and adds peace of mind

1000 mAh built-in battery: Supports multiple sessions on a single charge

USB-C PD3.0 fast charging: Minimizes downtime between sessions

Stainless steel dosing caps: Simplify loading while keeping the chamber cleaner

Sleek, reliable, and designed with everyday convenience in mind, the XVape Lanza delivers a refined dry herb experience that’s easy to carry, simple to use, and consistently satisfying.

Made using only fresh-frozen flower, this extract is great for dabbing on its own or adding a boost of potency to your pre-rolls.

variants.title: Biodegradable Strawberry Gary Liquid Diamonds Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Expect big flavour and extremely high potency from this Biodegradable 97+ Strawberry Gary Liquid Diamonds All-in-One. This Eco-Friendly disposable vape has a removable & recyclable battery housed in a biodegradable corn PLA shell. Sweet Strawberry aromas are accented by notes of pepper and diesel from this potent blend of Liquid Diamonds and Live Resin. The robust terpene profile offers an uplifting and calming experience. The rechargeable All-in-One premium hardware is perfectly calibrated and optimized for this specific formula to allow for the perfect vaping experience.

variants.title: Kush Mint BOOSTED Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Meet Back Forty BOOSTED, our all-in-one vape now with an extra twist. Kush Mint delivers a crisp wave of cool mint that's smooth and built to last. Slide it into Boost Mode for bigger clouds and bolder flavour. It offers a compact design, ceramic coil and rechargeable battery.

variants.title: Pretty Sweet PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Pretty Sweet Sativa is a potent and delish rotating Sativa strain, in a 20x0.4g pre-roll pack. Whether its gaming with your buds or doodling in your sketchbook, Pretty Sweet Sativa will be your new go-to j.

variants.title: Pretty Sweet
variants.body_html: Pass 'N Play, a potent and delicious rotating sativa strain specifically selected.

variants.title: CBG Happy Place Mango, Peach & Yuzu
variants.body_html: Savour the taste of summer with every sip of THC + CBG Mango Peach & Yuzu Juice. The flavours unfold like a tropical paradise on your palate. Imbibe in the richness of mangoes, the sweetness of peaches, and the citrusy brightness of yuzu, all in one delightful can. Dosed with 20mg of CBG and 10mg of THC.

variants.body_html: Sweet and tangy white peach pairs perfectly with warming cardamom in this sparkling botanical water. Juicy and bursting with flavour, fresh peach on the nose gives way to a mildly spicy finish. A balanced dose of 10mg of THC and 10mg of CBD.

variants.title: Rainbow Driver Live Rosin
variants.body_html: Rainbow Driver live rosin was produced by High Fidelity using fresh frozen flower and a solventless ice water extraction followed by a cold cure. This hybrid cultivar delivers a terpene profile marked by candy sweetness and gas. Hand crafted in Nelson, BC, this limited run showcases the full expression of Rainbow Driver in its purest form.

variants.title: Mint Chocolate Chip Cured Resin Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: The award-winning Mint Chocolate Chip makes its return in a refined cured resin vape cart. Crafted from certified organic, living soil-grown Sweetgrass flower, this cart preserves the cultivar’s signature herbaceous aroma with layers of cool mint and subtle chocolate. Smooth and flavourful, it captures the essence of this fan favourite in a convenient, portable format, expertly produced by Common Roots Extracts.

variants.title: El Gastro Cured Resin Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: El Gastro Cured Resin is produced from single-source, indoor-grown whole flower cultivated in organic living soil. This cured resin combines Gastro Pop and El Chapo flower to create a rich, kush-forward concentrate profile. Carefully processed with additional filtration, the resin delivers a high concentration of cannabinoids and terpenes. The aromatic profile features notes of black pepper spice, herbal earth, and diesel fuel. Available for limited-time-only.

variants.title: Melon Menage Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Melon Ménage from Flyte Liquid Diamonds serves up watermelon, kiwi, and melon that bursts with sweet, fruity flavour. This 1g cart blends 30% ultra-potent liquid diamonds with 70% distillate and botanical terpenes for a potency of 91–97% THC. Housed in top-tier postless 510 hardware.

variants.title: Dante's Inferno Pre-Rolls 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: From Valhalla Flwr’s recent pheno hunt comes Dante's Inferno 3x0.5g Pre Rolls. Bred in collaboration by Clearwater Genetics and Tiki Madman by crossing Oreoz and Devil Driver, this cultivar was run from seed and hand selected by our team for its loud profile, dense bud structure and incredible smoke. With an earthy, gassy, and sweet profile this newest selection from the pheno hunt is sure to wow indica consumers everywhere. Hang dried, hand trimmed and never irradiated. Whole milled flower input and hand finished for a perfect burn every time. Now available in new transparent PR tubes.

variants.title: Tiger Balm PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Enter Tiger Balm, an indica-dominant blend forged from MAC 69 and Menthol, two hitters known for their bite. The flavour claws through mint, earthy kush, and diesel-soaked pine. The aroma growls with eucalyptus and gas, backed by forest musk. Packed into two 1g pre-rolls, Tiger Balm delivers a sharpened edge, full of fire.

variants.title: Platinum Kush Breath
variants.body_html: From Valhalla Flwr’s recent pheno hunt comes another banger: Platinum Kush Breath flower. Bred by In House Genetics from crossing Platinum and OGKB V2.1, this one is for the kush lovers. This cultivar was pheno hunted by an incredible cultivation team and hand selected to bring big terps and of course some beautiful buds. With a profile of gassy, earthy and some rubber and pine on the back end, this strain is nothing short of impressive. Hang dried, hand trimmed, never irradiated and grown with love and intention. Now available in new mylar bags with a viewing window.

Loud scents of mixed tropical-fruit followed by creaminess, baked goods, and gas on the finish. Beautifully formed cone-shaped buds feature multiple hues of green, complemented by sparkly trichomes that are easily visible to the naked eye.

Super Toast grab n’ go rechargeable vapes are always ready, no battery required. Our custom vape design is the stuff of ergonomic dreams, with the perfect palm-feel and super comfortable mouthpiece for long hauls and big fluffy clouds. Super Toast. Always Ready.

variants.title: Bluefin Tuna PR 7 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: These pre-rolls are made from hand selected strains notable for their exceptional flavours. These packs are filled with Bluefin Tuna, which is created by crossing Tuna Kush x Blueberry. This strain has a sweet blueberry taste that's accented by hints of pungent diesel and sour gas. It has fluffy pepper-shaped dusty green buds with light amber undertones, orange hairs and a coating of frosty sandy amber crystal trichomes.

variants.title: OG Kush 1 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: OG Kush is a legacy indica strain crossed with Hindu Kush and Chemdog, creating a rich aroma of pepper, pine and fuel. Each single pre-roll is crafted from whole flower, meticulously milled and rolled.

variants.title: Blue Thai PR 1 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: All you need is blue skies and some Blue Thai. Spinach® Blue Thai is our ode to everything awesome about dried flower. Our take on this cultivar is a straight sativa strain with an undeniable, blast off level of potency from the first puff. We’re also highlighting the classic fruity, skunky, and citrusy flavours and aromas that come from a puckering lineage of Sour Blueberry x Lemon Thai through a trio of familiar yet harmonious terpenes — limonene, caryophyllene, and humulene. So, the next time you pop this in a bowl or roll a pre-roll, get ready to say, ‘My, oh my, that’s some good Blue Thai’.

variants.title: THCa Infinity Seedless Grape Infused PR 2 x 0.7 g
variants.body_html: THCa just hit infinity and so did the flavour. This pre-roll packs a dual infusion of liquid diamonds (inside and out), unleashing a power surge of 70%+ THC that hits harder and smoother than anything else. We supercharged it with our fan-favourite Seedless Grape, featuring our proprietary terpene blend that bursts with juicy grape sweetness. The result? An unmatched wave of MAX potency and MAX flavour that knows no limits.

variants.title: Early Lemon Berry PR 7 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html:
Get more of the good stuff with Nugz Early Lemon Berry, now rolled up in a 7-pack of smooth-burning half-gram joints. Packed with the same top-shelf flower you know and love, these Pre-Rolls hit with that sweet and tangy Early Lemon Berry flavour - a citrusy blast of limonene and berry goodness that makes every puff pop.

We've leveled up the experience with thinner, smoother papers and a wider crutch for better airflow and an even draw. Plus, our new transparent packaging lets you see exactly what you're getting - Pre-mium craft flower, perfectly packed and ready to spark.

Big flavour, bright vibes, and a bulk-friendly price - that's the Nugz way.

variants.title: Dante'z Inferno PR 7 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html:
Brace yourself for Dante'z Inferno, an indica strain packing a serious THC punch. Born from the legendary cross of Oreoz and Devil Driver, this strain delivers dense, round-shaped buds blanketed in an impressive layer of frosty trichomes, giving them a striking, white-coated appearance-it's like fire and ice made a deal in Dante'z depths.

The flavour? It's a wild ride: sharp diesel with smooth creaminess, and a bold hit of fruit finish that keeps things dangerously exciting. Dominated by myrcene, caryophyllene, and limonene, this strain brings a perfect storm of relaxation and taste.

Cultivated indoors in Pointe-Claire, Quebec, Dante'z Inferno isn't just grown-it's crafted. Hand-harvested, whole plant hang-dried, hand-trimmed, and cold-cured for 14 days, every bud is treated like royalty. Our pre-rolls are prepared using our whole flower (never trim), finely milled, filled in 98mm wood pulp paper, natural brown cone, not bleached, non GMO, with a 26mm W tip and burn white to light gray with a slow to medium burn rate. Finally, each package is carefully packed by hand.

Light it up and step into the fire.

variants.title: Cipher ArcSnap Electronic Dugout
variants.body_html:
Step outside knowing your next hit is instant. No lighters fighting the wind, no harsh smoke, no wasted flower burning between pulls. ArcSnap is an all-in-one electric dugout designed to make every session simpler, smoother, and more discreet.

Built with ArcTech heating, ArcSnap delivers consistent, windproof hits in seconds. The enclosed design keeps smoke and odor low, while the self-extinguishing system ensures your flower only burns when you inhale. With powerful battery life and effortless one-handed use, ArcSnap is always ready when you are.

Key Features & Benefits
ArcTech Heating: Instant, windproof hits that perform in almost any condition.
Enclosed Design: Minimal smoke and odor for discreet, low-key sessions.
Self-Extinguishing System: Flower only burns when you inhale, reducing waste and harshness.
Long-Lasting Battery: 100+ hits per charge so you can go longer without recharging.
One-Handed Operation: Simple, intuitive use for quick, seamless hits.
Flame-Free Design: No lighters, no butane, no hot ash, and no burnt fingers.

ArcSnap delivers clean hits, zero waste, and total control in a sleek, pocket-ready piece built for modern sessions.

variants.title: Cipher Churwarden Kit for Nautilus (all models)
variants.body_html:
Elevate your Nautilus vaping experience with the Cipher Churchwarden Stem Kit. This set adds a playful, sophisticated twist to your sessions, letting you explore smooth, cool hits like never before.

Key Features & Benefits

Two Churchwarden Stems: Includes both a short and long stem to suit your preferred style of vaping.

Smooth, Cool Vapor: Extended stems help cool the vapor for a more enjoyable, flavourful puff every time.

Universal Adapter: Connects seamlessly to your Nautilus Sherlock dry herb vaporizer and supports any Churchwarden stem with a 10.4mm diameter connector.

 Versatile Usage: Stems can be used with or without a pod in the Nautilus chamber, giving you full control over your sessions.

Playful, Customizable Experience: Transform your dry herb vaping into a ritual of sophistication and fun.

 With the Churchwarden Kit, your Nautilus becomes more than a vaporizer—it becomes a gateway to smooth, indulgent, and adventurous sessions.

variants.title: Blueberry Jam PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Blueberry Jam, an indica-dominant hybrid that hits like a slow exhale after a long day. Bursting with sweet blueberry notes layered with skunk and earthy undertones, this strain delivers a deeply relaxing, full-body melt paired with a smooth wave of euphoria. Perfect for evening unwinds, movie nights, or shutting the world off—just a heads-up, this one can hit potent and isn’t for the faint of heart.

variants.title: Watermelon G Whipped Diamonds
variants.body_html: Blast to the future with BOXHOT Watermelon G Whipped Diamonds, a gushing geyser bursting with intense watermelon and subtle fruity notes to leave you flavour-soaked. Super pure THCa diamonds are converted to a butter-smooth consistency and boosted with botanical terps to deliver a one-two indica hit of flavour and potency. Add this next-gen heavy hitter to a dab rig and crystal whip them taste buds

variants.title: Sour Melon Berry Gummies
variants.body_html: Meet our Sour Melon Berry a 10-pack of individually wrapped gummies. Each gummy contains 10mg THC and 10mg CBD, for a total of 100mg of each per pack. Bursting with juicy watermelon and sweet strawberry, each piece is layered with a mouthwatering sour twist that lingers on the tongue. Perfect for anytime enjoyment, these gummies offer bold flavour, precise dosing, and a delicious experience.

variants.title: Purple Punch PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Purple Punch is the sweet union of two indica dominant classics. It's a delicious dessert strain with aromas of grape candy, blueberry muffins and tart fruit punch.

variants.title: Peanut Butter Breath Shatter
variants.body_html: The potent Peanut Butter Breath Shatter boasts flavours of PB, vanilla, and just a hint of coffee. Extracted via hydrocarbon extraction for a potent, solid shatter and a perfect balance of high THC and a great taste. Made using only fresh-frozen flower, this extract is great for dabbing on its own or adding a boost of potency to your pre-rolls.

variants.title: Pink Grapefruit OG PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Flint & Embers’ Pink Grapefruit OG (Sweet Pink Grapefruit x OG Kush) is an assertive sativa-leaning flower, with a powerful and complex flavour. Bursting with a gassy aroma and dripping with a tropical fruit taste, this explosive mixture is an OG lovers dream. Naturally grown in microclimate conditions inspired by the unique environments each plant thrives in – Pink Grapefruit OG pre-rolls are single strain, whole bud, milled to perfection and evenly rolled with eco-friendly papers. Every pack of pre-rolls comes in a reusable kit that locks in freshness for pre-rolls that are ready when you are. These hypnotic herbs are light green with golden stigma hairs, and long-stemmed trichomes.

variants.title: Orange Turpentine PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Orange Turpentine (Cap Junky x Cap's Frozen Oranges), our first sativa dominant cultivar that we've brought to market, introduces your palate to vibrant flavours with potency. Picture this, a burst of citrus featuring zesty orange undertones intertwined with a hint of frosty mint from the Cap Junky. Our small batch flower undergoes a meticulous process including hang drying, precision hand trimming, slow cold curing and hand packaging to preserve terpene integrity and maximize flavour and smoothness. We take our whole flower, mill it in-house and then fill ten perfect pre-rolls. Dive into this rich blend of potent genetics and sophisticated flavours.

variants.title: Blue Imagination PR 7 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Get RIPPED — Blue Imagination-style! Perfectly crafted pre-rolls, packed with pre-ground strain-specific sativa for a smooth, balanced burn. Sealed in a rugged black Pop-Top container to keep your stash fresh.

variants.title: Nana's Jam Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: XPLOR's Nana's Jam Disposable Vape bursts with the sweet harmony of ripe strawberries and creamy bananas. Embark on the journey of this lip smacking flavour. Now in premium disposable hardware.

variants.title: Pink Slurricane PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Pink Slurricane is a hybrid cannabis strain known for its unique and pungent aroma, as well as its potent effects. It is created by crossing Pink Kush x Slurricane, resulting in a hybrid that offers a balance of indica and sativa. Pink Slurricane is characterized by its dense, frosted buds that are often tinged with shades of pink or purple, making it a visually appealing strain.

variants.title: Tropical Meltdown
variants.body_html: Tropical Meltdown is a potent sativa-leaning hybrid born from Kali Mist x Nuclear Fallout, delivering a tropical flavour. Its dense, frosty buds boast incredible bag appeal, while the aroma blends sweet citrus and berries for a fruity flavour.

variants.title: Possum Glass Tip PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Discover the Possum Glass Tip pre-roll, a strain that delivers a potent and gassy profile with sharp skunk undertones, creating a pungent aroma. Expertly packed with trichome-rich buds and fitted with a sleek glass tip for a smooth, clean burn.

variants.title: Pineapple Coconut
variants.body_html: Green Monké Pineapple Coconut contains a 2:1 CBD to THC ratio. It is sweetened with erythritol and stevia. Best served over ice, garnished with an umbrella. Made without sugar, gluten or animal products.

variants.title: Dragon Pendant PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Craft indoor grown, milled flower wrapped in high quality cones, offering the consumer a convenient smoking experience.

variants.title: Peach Tree
variants.body_html: Pepe's Peach Tree is flavourful with great bag appeal. This sativa leaning flower is born out of a double Peach Ozz cross. Expect aromas evocative of sweet peaches, hints of gas and lime with a smoke that's very smooth and flavourful. As with all Pepe products, Peach Tree only has our best handpicked buds.

variants.title: Waffle Cone PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Introducing Waffle Cone, an indica dominant hybrid strain created through crossing Jet Fuel Gelato x Dosilato. The aroma is a blend of sweet cream and fruit with nutty undertones, reminiscent of freshly baked waffle cones at your favourite ice cream parlour. With dense olive green frosty buds that sparkle in the light, Waffle Cone offers a smooth smoke and a rich, creamy and nutty flavour profile that lingers on the palate. Waffle Cone undergoes a meticulous process and is slow cured, hang dried, hand trimmed and never irradiated. With love from Scarborough.

variants.title: GMO Kush Indica
variants.body_html: GMO Kush from Big Bag o’ Buds offers of high-quality bud with a pungent, funky profile and earthy kush aromas that both GMO and Kush fans will love. It offers a potent, pungent indica experience. Big Bag o’ Buds GMO Kush is grown and hand-harvested in strain-specific, micro-climate grow rooms.

variants.title: Super Lemon Haze Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Back Forty’s Super Lemon Haze boasts a tangy, citrus burst of flavour with subtle herbal undertones. With hits of terpinolene, phellandrene, caryophyllene and limonene, and up to 88% THC.

variants.title: Queen of Tartz PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Queen of Tartz is a sativa-dominant strain that reigns supreme in flavour and potency. Carefully selected from a cross of Key Lime Pie and Infatuation, it boasts dark, dense and gassy buds from its Infatuation lineage, while the zesty citrus of Key Lime Pie shines through. The smoke is exactly what you’d expect from a high-potency sativa.

variants.title: Diamond Thrilla Triple-Diamond Infused PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Bling out with our triple-diamond infused pre-roll, for moments where you're looking to elevate your experience. Our premium, whole flower handcrafted pre-roll is infused with Liquid Diamonds, Whole THCa Diamonds, and then dusted in Diamond Dust, all derived from our own craft grown flower. Packed inside a ceramic-tipped cone and housed in our premium custom glass tubes.

variants.title: C4
variants.body_html: C4 is a heavily indica leaning flower that offers earthy, gassy and pungent aromas.

variants.title: Double Melon Gulp Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Dive into the irresistible world of Double Melon Gulp, where the delightful fusion of watermelon and cantaloupe meet. Each draw bursts with fresh flavour from this all-in-one, USB-rechargeable unit, ensuring convenience at your fingertips. Treat yourself to the juiciest hit with every sip and let Double Melon Gulp transform your vaping experience.

variants.title: Apples & Bananas PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Introducing Apples & Bananas — the sweetest new offering from 1964. Sweet and sour fruits blend with subtle herbal, gas notes to create a complex and mouth-watering smoking experience. The nuanced fruit salad profile translates deliciously to the smoke with an impressive duration of flavour.

variants.title: Vanilla Frosting PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Vanilla Frosting is an indica-dominant strain, a blend of Humboldt Frost OG x Humboldt Gelato BX3. Its flavour truly matches its name, tasting strikingly of vanilla frosting with a sweet, creamy profile, enhanced by subtle floral undertones. The aroma adds pungent herbal notes.

variants.title: Sour x Papaya PR 7 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: This iconic blend combines the tangy kick of Sour Kush with the rare, sweet notes of Golden Papaya for a tropical hit that’s bold, sweet, and earthy. Expertly milled and packed into pre-rolls, this hybrid strain delivers high THC levels.

variants.title: Candy Rain Premium Glass Tip PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: 1SPLIFF Candy Rain pre-rolls are crafted with precision and packed with high quality flower. Featuring a sweet and aromatic profile with hints of candy-like notes and a touch of earthiness, each pre-roll is designed for smooth and consistent pulls.

variants.title: Lemon Shocker PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Lemon Shocker delivers a burst of sour lemon zest with a touch of sweetness to keep things smooth. It’s like biting into a lemon drop candy with a surprise twist. Bold, tangy and refreshing.

variants.title: Strawberry Amnesia
variants.brand: The Original Fraser Valley Weed Co.
tags: The Original Fraser Valley Weed Co.
variants.body_html: Strawberry Amnesia is smooth and sweet with aromas of wild berries, citrus and earthy cocoa. This potent sativa is a legacy cross of Strawberry Cough x Amnesia, with dense buds featuring pink and purple hues under a thick layer of trichomes. Greenhouse-grown in abundance in BC’s finest growing region, the Fraser Valley.

variants.title: Royal Dive #6: VantaBlack
variants.body_html: VantaBlack is a bold cross between Fried Applez x Black Diamond. This strain lives up to its name — deep effects, with an aroma that pulls you in like a black hole of dank. This cultivar brings together the sweet, baked apple and creamy gas notes of Fried Applez with the earthy, grape-tinged kush backbone of Black Diamond, resulting in an aroma that’s both rich and mouth-coating. Dense, resin-soaked buds and jet-black undertones make this strain as visually stunning as it is potent. Crafted for connoisseurs who want both flavour and depth.

variants.title: Pink Rhino
variants.body_html: Pink Rhino is a cross of the popular Pink Kush and old school legend White Rhino. Our growers have brought together two iconic parents to deliver a new candy-like kush that’s got it all: potency, dense sticky buds, sweet aromas of sugary honey and classic kush notes of earth and gas from dominant terpenes linalool, myrcene, limonene​. The plant produces cake-y light green buds that are naturally super tight and thickly coated in sugar from top to bottom.

variants.title: Gas Basket
variants.body_html: Gas Basket, an Indica-dominant cross of Bakers Dozen x Gary Payton, delivers sweet cookie dough with earthy undertones and a subtle gas note.

variants.title: Blackberry Lemonade CBD:CBN:THC Gummies
variants.body_html: Pearls by Grön Blackberry Lemonade is now in a grab ’n go 10-pack box, with 10 individual tubes each holding 5 sugar-coated soft chews. Every gummy carries a 1:1:1 ratio with 2 mg THC, 2 mg CBD, and 2 mg CBN. That’s 100 mg of each cannabinoid in total. Bursting with the tart sweetness of blackberries and the citrus pop of lemonade, these Pearls bring fruit-forward flavour in a format made for sharing or stocking up.

variants.title: Ratio'd Moon Berry THC:CBD:CBN Gummies
variants.body_html: One cannabinoid? Too easy. Two? Still not enough. Moon Berry brings three to the table — THC, CBD, and CBN in a 1:2:1 ratio. Each gummy hits with 10 mg THC, 20 mg CBD, and 10 mg CBN, stacked across 10 sugar-coated pieces. Total pack? 100 mg THC, 200 mg CBD, 100 mg CBN. Big flavour, bigger format, and no confusion — just straight math and a blast of berry.

variants.title: Barbara Bud Cold Cured Ice Water Hash
variants.body_html: Barbara Bud is one of the world's most famous hash-making strains. This incredible ice water hash comes from sungrown flower that was cultivated with organic methods, hand harvested and then fresh frozen immediately. The frozen flower is gently washed to produce high-quality and very melty bubble hash. The three highest quality micron sizes are combined to produce a full spectrum experience. It is then cold cured it for stability and texture. This incredibly flavourful ice water hash delivers all that amazing Barb peach profile in a 1g package.

variants.title: Romulan Fire Live Rosin Infused PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: This live rosin infused pre-roll is made from indoor grown ChemoRomulan (Chemo x Romulan) flower and award-winning French Fire Barb live rosin. The flower was bred and is unique to GGF. The rosin, also a GGF only genetic, was made from gorgeous outdoor cannabis that was fresh-frozen in the field and made into fantastic ice-water hash and then pressed into rosin at their micro-processing facility on Vancouver Island. These infused pre-rolls taste great and hit hard, producing massive amounts of smoke and a full flavour experience. Available for a limited-time-only.

variants.title: High Noon Reserve Original Z Live Resin Badder
variants.body_html: High Noon Reserve Sativa Live Resin Badder is a quality, small batch extract crafted from fresh frozen cannabis to preserve the full spectrum of terpenes and cannabinoids. Expertly extracted using hydrocarbon methods, this live resin badder delivers bold aroma, vibrant colour and a smooth and creamy texture that’s easy to dab and rich in flavour. Each rotating sativa strain is carefully selected for its terpene profile, whether it leans citrusy, fruity or gassy with sparkle. No added terpenes.

variants.title: Strawberry Lemonade Distillate Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Sweet. Tangy. No-nonsense. Strawberry Lemonade blends ripe strawberries and tart lemon in a potent and all-around flavourful pack of infused pre-rolls. It’s a refreshing hit that delivers every time. Cannabis ready to consume — whenever you need it. That's Standard Issue. Stripped of excess, honed to essentials, and designed to keep pace — not for show, but for real life. Consistent, dependable, and ready when you are. Standard Issue: everything you need, nothing you don't. Standard Issue pre-rolls are made from milled whole flower, infused with distillate and botanical terpenes.

variants.title: Grapefruit Mac Live Rosin
variants.body_html: Bred along the stunning Sea-to-Sky Corridor by a skilled local breeder, this cultivar delights both the palate and the nose with its vibrant and complex aroma. An initial blast of gas gives way to a citrus aftertaste. Made by pressing 73-159 µm from first wash of certified organic, sun-grown cannabis flowers.

variants.title: Pineapple Drift Diamond Infused PR 1 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Surf’s up! Pineapple Drift is a riptide of bold pineapple, get drenched in tropical flavour that hits as hard as a tidal wave. G.A. Ultra-Infused Pre-Rolls are made using milled whole flower, dusted in premium kief, boosted with botanical terpenes, and infused with diamonds to deliver their most potent pre-roll yet.

variants.title: Peach Crescendo Liquid Diamond Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Max potency, ready to rip. Get liquid diamonds in the palm of your hand with the DEBUNK Peach Crescendo all-in-one vape, a delightful indica that delivers a burst of ripe peach layered with tropical tang, underscored by sharp sour notes and a smooth, gassy finish on the exhale. Proprietary hydrocarbon extraction process converts THCA diamonds into an ultra-pure, ultra-potent THC liquid diamond isolate that is then enhanced with a touch of custom botanical terpenes. Housed in powerful, USB-C rechargeable hardware with a wide mouth opening for optimal airflow to minimize clogging, this kingpin holds it down.

variants.title: Blue Zushi PR 1 x 2 g
variants.body_html: This king sized 2g pre-roll is packed with Blue Zushi, hand-finished with a Dutch crown and fitted with a glass tip for a smoother draw. Crafted from expertly milled whole flower, not trim or shake, it delivers a clean, even burn from start to finish. Blue Zushi offers a layered flavour profile with gassy funk, sweet citrus, and hints of peppered earth —all amplified in this bold, extended format. Pistol and Paris products are grown with care, attention, and intention. All crops are hang-dried, cold-cured, and hand trimmed to preserve quality. Every step is carefully done by hand to honour each unique cultivar and showcase its fullest expression.

variants.title: Backpackers Chemzilla PR 10 x 0.75 g
variants.body_html: Pack light, roll heavy. Back Forty Chemzilla Backpackers are straight-cut indica-dominant pre-rolls, packaged in a resealable, water-resistant tin that’s ready for any adventure. This Chemdawg and Godzilla Glue cross offers a potent chemical profile with deep, earthy notes and a touch of spice. Each pre-roll is wrapped in hemp paper that lets the flower's flavour shine through, burning steadily and evenly thanks to precisely milled flower. Enjoy a smooth smoke, very strong potency and dominant caryophyllene, humulene, and myrcene terpenes. Toss the Backpackers tin into your bag and hit the Back Forty with Chemzilla. Available for a limited-time-only.

variants.title: Bubblegum Marker PR 3 x 0.5  g
variants.body_html: Bubblegum Marker was bred by Seed Junky Genetics by crossing Bubblegum Sherb with Permanent Marker. Expect bold notes of bubblegum, gas and lime. Because it’s the right thing to do, all Carmel’s pre-rolls are made exclusively from whole flower, rolled in small batches into slim cones, and hand-packaged in glass tubes with cork tops. Available for a limited-time-only.

variants.title: Purple Cherry Punch PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Purple Cherry Punch Bag o' Doobs offers 10 cone-style 0.5g pre-rolls, rolled with hemp paper for a smooth, premium experience. This indica-dominant is a cross of Sour OG Cheese x Black Cherry Punch, boasting sweet grape, berry, and floral aromas with dominant terpenes like β-caryophyllene, limonene, and humulene. It’s a flavourful choice for those who appreciate big flavour, quality and convenience.

variants.title: Gastro Pop
variants.body_html: Gastro Pop is a hybrid created by a crossing Apples & Bananas and Grape Gasoline by the breeder Compund Genetics. A pungent, complex aroma of sweet fermenting apples and bananas with a stinky sour grape gasoline. The forest green buds are dense, and all calyx with dark purple hues. Minimum guaranteed total terpene: 4.5%. Harvested plants are whole plant hang dried in optimal conditions for a minimum of two weeks before the finished flower is carefully hand-trimmed and hand-sorted. Grown, processed and packaged in the same micro-facility, Amani Craft is dedicated to delivering the freshest flower in the market.

variants.title: Naked Solventless NSFW Liquid Diamond Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Crafted for purity and potency — no solvents, no compromises. We start with fresh-frozen biomass, extract premium bubble hash, and press it into full-spectrum rosin. THCA diamonds naturally form, are separated, liquified through decarboxylation, and blended with the strain’s original terpene-rich sauce for unmatched flavour. The result? A smooth, potent experience designed for those who demand the best. This device is USB-C rechargeable, postless, and is small and discrete to fit easily inside your palm. No added flavouring agents, solvents, pigments, fillers or waxes in this premium extract.

variants.title: THCa8 Peach Cobra Lily Infused PR 2 x 0.7 g
variants.body_html: MAX Potency Just Broke the Limit, Welcome to THCa∞. Peach Cobra Lily clocks in at 70% THC, powered by our double THCa infusion. Each pre-roll is amped UP with our proprietary terpene blend, delivering a fierce, fruit-forward blast of juicy peach.

variants.title: Gas Pack
variants.body_html: The gas pack is Dom Jackson's 7g rotational flower lineup. A collection of heavy hitting cultivars chosen for pure gas, flavor, and smoke ability. Each batch rotates to spotlight small batch genetics with loud nose, sticky texture, and smooth burn.

variants.title: CBG Heat Wave (Strawberry Lemonade)
variants.body_html: Blends are a mix of both indica and sativa plant types.

variants.title: Original Blood Orange, Yuzu & Vanilla
variants.body_html: Blends are a mix of both indica and sativa plant types.

variants.title: Dopezilla Siren Dab Rig 8.25"
variants.body_html: "The Dopezilla Elemental Siren Dab Rig is an 8-inch purple mini beaker designed to deliver smooth, flavorful hits with style. Featuring a showerhead percolator, this rig ensures excellent diffusion for clean and enjoyable dabbing sessions. Key Features & Benefits: Mini Beaker Base: Stable design with optimal water capacity for filtration. Showerhead Perc: Provides smooth, even hits with minimal splashback. 14mm 90° Male Quartz Banger: Durable and easy to use, perfect for concentrates. High-Quality Glass: Built to last while maintaining visual appeal. Vibrant Design: Striking purple finish with Siren-inspired aesthetics. Answer the call and let the Siren guide your session—smooth hits so good, they’re practically enchanting."

variants.title: Dopezilla Leviathan Bubble Base Water Pipe 13.25"
variants.body_html: "The Dopezilla Elemental Leviathan Water Pipe is a 13-inch blue bong designed for smooth, filtered hits with style. Equipped with a pyramid percolator, this bubble base water pipe ensures impressive diffusion and a clean smoking experience every time. Key Features & Benefits: Bubble Base: Provides stability while maximizing water filtration. Pyramid Perc: Enhances diffusion for cooler, smoother hits. 14mm Male Bowl: Compatible with standard accessories for easy loading and cleaning. Durable Design: High-quality glass construction built to last. Stylish & Functional: Striking blue design with elemental Leviathan theme adds flair to your collection. Unleash the beast and let the Leviathan take a splash—smooth hits that make waves every time!"

variants.title: Afghan Black Diamond Dusted Hash
variants.body_html: Step back in time with the classic flavour of Afghan Black Diamond Coated Hash. This hash delivers the rich and traditional taste that seasoned consumers will recognize. But don't let the nostalgia fool you, this hash is coated in potent diamonds. Rediscover the essence of tradition with a modern twist and elevate your sessions to new heights.

variants.title: Juicy Jay's Rolling Papers - Marshmallow - 1 ¼
variants.body_html:
Sweet, smooth, and unmistakably fun, Juicy Jay’s Marshmallow Rolling Papers bring a dessert-inspired twist to every roll. Infused with a soft marshmallow flavour and made with Juicy Jay’s signature triple-dip process, these papers deliver consistent taste from start to finish. The 1 1/4 size is ideal for balanced rolls that are easy to handle and perfect for everyday sessions.

Crafted from high-quality paper with natural soy-based ink, these rolling papers burn evenly and smoothly while keeping the flavour front and center. Whether you are switching up your usual rotation or leaning into sweet profiles, Marshmallow is a standout choice.

Key Features & Benefits

Marshmallow flavour infusion: sweet, smooth taste in every roll

Triple-dip flavour process: consistent flavour from start to finish

1 1/4 size: balanced rolls that are easy to handle

Natural soy-based ink: cleaner, more refined burn

Slow, even burn: reliable performance with every session

High-quality paper: smooth rolling and dependable results

A go-to choice for anyone who wants a sweet flavour profile without compromising roll quality.

variants.title: Black Mountain Side
variants.body_html: Black Mountain Side is a sativa dominant strain among many phenotypes of GSC crossed with Durban P and OG Kush. The buds are dense and green in colour with traces of purple and a thick layer of crystals. This flower boasts potent aromas and flavours of lemon, diesel and skunk.

variants.title: Kush Cookies
variants.body_html: You'll whisper its name in reverential tones after this bud passes your lips - 'Kush Cookies'. Potent, terpene-rich, with dense and sticky buds, Kush Cookies is a rare lineage of GMO Cookies and OZ Kush that delivers highly aromatic notes of savoury herbs and spicy earth, with undertones of citrus and musk. 3Saints Kush Cookies has an average terpene percentage at an astounding 4.4 per cent (varies by lot). The dominant terps are caryophyllene, limonene and linolool, grown righteously in the sun in a hybrid greenhouse, rain watered, hand harvested, hang dried and expertly cured. All this delivers high flavour, high Potency and high terpenes. What's not to revere? Go on, whisper the name again 'Kush Cookies'.

variants.title: Kush Cookies PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: A full-body, hard-working indica. A rare lineage delivering highly aromatic notes of savoury herbs & spicy earth, with undertones of citrus & base notes of musk.

variants.title: Frosted Podium Pack Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Claybourne Frosted Flyers Infused Variety Pack features 3 strains in one pack: Pitstop Peach, Lemon Cherry G, and Watermelon Z. These 3x0.5g pre-rolls are THCa diamond frosted, natural terpene enhanced, and infused with liquid diamonds. Looking for bold flavour and a potent experience? Look no further than Claybourne Frosted Flyers.

variants.title: XO Strawbae Diamond Dusted Infused PR 3 x 0.6 g
variants.body_html: Sweet. Sparkly. Seriously next level. Fall head over heels with XO Strawbae, the ultimate diamond-dusted infused pre-roll that is as bold as it is beautiful. Packed with premium, hand selected flower and lightly dusted in a shimmering mix of THCa diamonds and botanical extract, every puff is a love letter to high-end cannabis. Each inhale bursts with juicy strawberry sweetness, kissed with subtle floral and candy notes, creating a flavor profile as irresistible as your favorite crush. Smooth, potent, and crafted for connoisseurs, committed to the strain lineage of sweet strawberry, XO Strawbae delivers an euphoric, head-to-toe high that lingers long after the last puff. 3 pack of 0.6 g pre rolls

variants.title: BC Organic Tea Time PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: The ultimate candy treat has landed! variants.title: Pineapple Bang

variants.body_html: Meet the Hive Spinner, the most interactive drop in the Buzz’d lineup. This isn’t your average AIO — it’s got a digital screen to keep your pull stats on point, plus a built-in fidget spinner so you can zone in, spin out, or keep your fingers buzzing during those deep Hive convos. Whether you're linking with the crew or vibing solo, the Hive Spinner keeps things smooth, flavourful, and fun. It’s a pocket-sized session tool made for portability.

variants.title: Real Fruit Grapefruit Gummies
variants.body_html: Wyld Grapefruit Sativa THC:CBG:CBC soft chews are a 1:1:1 product made sustainably using real fruit, botanical terpenes and natural flavours. Each soft chew contains 10 mg of THC, 10 mg of CBG and 10 mg of CBC. All Wyld soft chews are packaged in a fully compostable pouch, and our recipes are formulated by food scientists to provide consistent experiences that taste amazing. Wyld soft chews use sunflower lecithin and are made to be thermostable up to 55°C with a firm texture that doesn’t stick to your teeth. Each Wyld Grapefruit Sativa soft chew contains the terpenes limonene, valencene, beta-caryophyllene, alpha-pinene and beta-pinene.

variants.title: THCa8 Seedless Grape Infused PR 2 x 0.7 g
variants.body_html: THCa just hit infinity and so did the flavour. This pre-roll packs a dual infusion of liquid diamonds (inside and out), unleashing a potent 70%+ THC that hits smooth. We supercharged it with our popular Seedless Grape, featuring our proprietary terpene blend that bursts with juicy grape sweetness. The result? An unmatched wave of MAX potency and MAX flavour that knows no limits.

variants.title: Gas Monkey
variants.body_html: Gas Monkey is an indica-leaning hybrid bred from parents Grease Monkey and an unknown Gas cultivar. Gas Monkey buds are dense with bright orange pistils, caked with frosty trichomes. Skunky gas drives the flavour, backed with a light grape undertone.

variants.title: Gilded Live Rosin
variants.body_html: Jublee Gilded Live Rosin is a showcase of precision and artistry, crafted through a meticulous solventless process. Fresh cannabis is first water-washed and mechanically pressed, preserving purity while extracting the plant’s essence. It’s then cold-cured and whipped into a luxurious texture that enhances both flavour and experience. With a THC range of 69–77% and a rare 2–15% CBG, this rosin strikes a balance between potency and depth. Aromas of tropical fruit mingle with the warmth of freshly baked brioche, leading into a smooth, buttery inhale with a rich, full-bodied finish. The elevated CBG content adds nuance, rounding out the profile and complementing the high-THC for a layered, sophisticated effect. For connoisseurs, Gilded is more than a concentrate — it’s an elevated expression of live rosin craft, marrying old-world technique with modern refinement.

variants.title: Little Red PR 4 x 0.5 g
variants.brand: The Original Fraser Valley Weed Co.

variants.body_html: Little Red brings you classic Fraser Valley indica-dominant flower in a smaller, take-anywhere tube. Cone-style joints filled with a half-gram of a rotating selection of quality BC whole-bud. Expertly ground then rolled in all-natural paper and packed in a pocket-ready tube with four pre-rolls inside. Greenhouse-grown in abundance in BC’s finest growing region, the Fraser Valley.

variants.title: El Jointo Viva PR 1 x 1.5 g
variants.body_html: Contains 1.5g of full flower buds, broken down by hand, wrapped in whole flower, all-natural hemp, and packaged in a resealable tube.

variants.title: Organic Mango Hashplant
variants.body_html: Mango Hashplant is a potent, organically cultivated indica from BC. A tropical powerhouse in aroma, it showcases the sweetness of ripe mango layered over a classic hashy and earthy spice profile. Each bud is hang-dried and slow-cured for a minimum of 4 weeks to lock in its potency and complex flavour.

variants.title: Root Beer Float PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Root Beer Float is a rare indica dominant strain created through crossing XXX OG and Vanilla Kush. Enter into a sweet hazy, earthy bliss with hints of lemon and pine aroma. Enjoy the classic Root Beer flavour combined with frothy vanilla notes. Whole flower and hand crafted, just the way your pre-rolls should be. BOLD Craft Cannabis is indoor grown, small batch, hang dried, slow cured and hand trimmed.

variants.title: Mac Diamond Live Resin Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Mac Diamond Live Resin hits with a double blend of Liquid Diamonds and strain-specific Live Resin, clocking 90–95% THC. Made from fresh-frozen whole flower, this 510 cart delivers true-to-strain MAC flavour with zero added botanical terps.

variants.title: Tropicale Royale Toasters Kief Coated and Distillate Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Crank up the toast level with Toasters. Super flavourful and potent kief-crusted joints infused with THC distillate and a juicy blend of pineapple, mango and guava with a zing of citrus. Super Toast. Always Ready.

variants.title: Stoned Fruit Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: BOXHOT PRESENTS: Stoned Fruit, a 1.2 g hybrid 510 vape featuring a colossal dose of THC, some of the purest cannabis distillate available. Drop into flavour with mango, pineapple, and apricot smashed together in a juicy jumble of citrus and fruit that’ll leave your tastebuds wanting more. All BOXHOT vapes are made with exclusive, oversized hardware, making them optimal for big, full hits. Best of all, BOXHOT vapes are produced using industry-leading extraction and refining processes and feature a custom blend of expertly infused botanical terpenes.

variants.title: 187 Kush
variants.body_html: Look out for 187 Kush, a killer combo of the notorious Godfather OG x Killa Kush. Soar's most potent cultivar yet, this powerhouse indica boasts a potency range of 28-34% THC. Beyond its powerful potency, its highly expressive aromatics hit just as hard with notes of pulverized blueberries, sugary jam, sweet vanilla cake, and a hint of kushy spice from dominant terpenes myrcene, humulene and caryophyllene. Its tight, dark green buds are long and triangular in structure, layered with bright sparkly trichomes from end to end, with purple flecks on the tips. Soar is selective and disciplined in process. Grown in smaller batches and carefully sorted to ensure only our best buds make it through. Hand-harvested, hang-dried and hand-detailed with a humidity pack in every bag.

variants.title: Blue Dream FSE Resin Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Introducing the Blue Dream All-in-One FSE Resin Vape. This popular hazy, blueberry sativa is now available in a convenient, flavourful, and potent AIO vape.

variants.title: Blue Zushi PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html:
Blue Zushi 3x0.5g pre-rolls are packed with expertly milled whole flower and hand-finished with a Dutch crown. This Zkittlez x Kush Mintz cross features bold, gassy aromatics and a smooth, sweet tropical flavour in a convenient three-pack.

Pistol and Paris products are true craft cannabis-grown with care, attention, and intention. All crops are hang dried, cold cured, and hand trimmed to preserve quality. Every step is carefully done by hand to honour each unique cultivar and showcase its fullest expression.

variants.title: Liquid Diamonds Huckleberry Haze Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Liquid Diamonds Huckleberry Haze 510 cart is powered by our proprietary Liquid Diamonds formulation, delivering a clean, potent hit at 95–98% THC. Bursting with bold huckleberry and sweet gummy terps, it’s vibrant, fruity, and pure Max.

variants.title: Purple Parfait PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Purple Parfait is an indica dominant hybrid known for its rich flavour profile. Born from the carefully selected cross between Blueberry Yogurt x Platinum Kush, Purple Parfait combines the best traits of both parent strains. The aroma is sweet, creamy and intensely fruity, reminiscent of a dessert made with ripe grapes and velvety yogurt. Upon inhalation, you'll encounter a smooth, rich flavour that dances between juicy grape notes and a creamy, slightly tangy undertone. Purple Parfait offers high THC levels.

variants.title: 187 Kush PR 3 x 0.5 g

variants.title: Frosted Gumbo
variants.body_html: Frosted Gumbo is an indica-dominant cultivar with a marvelous gassy, vanilla nose. Having a sweet and intense flavor, Frosted Gumbo blends both sweet and spicy flavors, it's truly one of a kind! Top terpenes include Caryophyllene, Myrcene, and Limonene.

variants.title: Yocan Orbit Concentrate Vaporizer - Green
variants.body_html: The Yocan Orbit Vaporizer Pen is a small and portable concentrate vaporizer. It only takes 2.5 hours to fully charge the Orbit when plugged into a wall adapter. This awesome wax pen uses terp pearls, a quartz ball that creates better air flow, even heating and optimal concentrate vaporization. These adorable pearls sit in a coil-less quartz cup, which also adds to the stellar vaporization. The Orbit features a rotary cap on the mouthpiece to help achieve better air flow as well. Yocan has altered their preset temperatures to be the best temperature for vaping wax, now between 3.4 and 4.0 volts since the addition of the pearls. The Orbit also has a 10-second preheat to help heat up hardened wax. The stainless-steel body is lightweight and heavy duty for a premium feel.

variants.body_html: Chocolate Kush is a potent indica dominant strain born from the cross between Chocolato and OG Kush. This cultivar blends sweet cocoa notes with earthy undertones and a hint of pine. It's the most powerful strain in Green Joy's lineup.

variants.title: Venom OG Jumbo Slab Shatter
variants.body_html: This shatter sinks its teeth into your senses with a potent punch of skunk and diesel, crafted from the legendary cross of Poison OG and Rare Dankness #1. This jumbo slab delivers a clean, glassy finish and bold flavor that'll have you coming back for more. Perfect for those looking to shake things up in a big way.?

variants.title: Pink Goo
variants.body_html: This strain’s name comes from its ultra sticky appearance. It consists of resinous droplets of dew on the sugary leaves of the often pink and purple fluorescent flower centres that leach over to the contrasting darker green buds. With the incredible tree-like trait to ooze sap from seemingly out of nowhere, it has a sweet and pleasantly rich floral flavour of earth that creates a smooth smoke.

variants.title: Green Apple Carton True Indica Resin Gummies
variants.body_html: Introducing Glenn's new multi-pack green apple carton, containing 10 pouches of single 10mg THC resin gummies. Each gummy is crafted with premium indica resin and boasts a deliciously tart, crisp green apple flavour. Every carton contains a total of 100mg THC.

variants.title: Marshmallow OG
variants.body_html: Marshmallow OG was born from a potent lineage — Jet Fuel Gelato x (Chemdawg x Triangle Kush) — and it shows. MOG, as we call it, delivers chunky, trichome-drenched buds that glisten under the light. Deep green hues are streaked with fiery orange pistils, creating a look that practically begs to be sparked. The aroma hits hard with pure gas, then softens into a creamy sweet-vanilla finish that lingers in the air.

variants.title: Astro Pink Saucy Diamond Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Papa's Herb Astro Pink, a premium strain renowned for its impressive potency and rich flavour profile. Delight in the harmonious blend of earthy and floral notes, accentuated by subtle hints of vanilla, for a truly captivating smoking experience. Enjoy it in a premium Papa's Herb disposable, come to Papa!

variants.title: Barrel Aged Hash
variants.body_html: We age this hash for up to 12 months in oak Irish whiskey barrels, which impart a distinct flavour that is unparalleled in its depth. Expect a classic hash flavour with deep creamy notes of earthy sandalwood and delicate citrus currents. We always use traditional solventless extraction processes to make this hash before the aging process transforms it into a grail level hash.

variants.title: Star PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Sensi Star is a potent indica strain rolled and ready in our signature pre-roll for a smooth, consistent burn. This classic cultivar has a pungent and sweet aroma with a citrus and earthy flavour profile. Sensi Star is a throwback favourite and rolled to perfection by Station House.

variants.body_html: Blueberry Dream delivers 20 tube-style 0.4g pre-rolls across two packs of 10, rolled in organic hemp paper for a smooth, pure taste. This potent sativa has bold sweet, floral and berry aromas from limonene, terpineol and caryophyllene.

variants.title: Chopper's Pick PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: EastCann Chopper's pick, where tradition meets innovation. With over two decades of expertise honed in the West and now flourishing in the East, our commitment has always been to deliver the highest-quality cannabis, rolled and ready to consume in a pack of pre-rolls.

variants.title: Ultra Sour
variants.body_html: If terpinolene and limonene had a lovechild it’d be Ultra Sour. The tartness of Meyer lemon meets the diesel and pungent notes from the cultivars Kush undertones. A sativa-leaning sour with outcroppings of orange pistils from deep green, crystal-rich buds.

variants.title: Storm Indica PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Storm is Skosha's unique rotating cannabis strain that mirrors the ever changing storms that hit Nova Scotia's coastline. Each batch is non-irradiated and boasts high potency. Experience never knowing quite what each new session will bring, because like the weather, Storm is always evolving.

variants.title: Live Rosin Grandady Blackberry Gummies
variants.body_html: Bursting with bold blackberry flavour and made with premium Live Rosin for a full-spectrum cannabis experience. Each StikiStix contains 10 mg of THC and features a chewy texture designed to split into four pieces for flexible dosing. A tasty, approachable way to enjoy Live Rosin with a sweet berry twist.

variants.title: Frosted Gumbo
variants.body_html: Frosted Gumbo is an indica dominant cultivar with a gassy vanilla nose. Frosted Gumbo has sweet and intensely spicy flavours. Top terpenes include caryophyllene, myrcene and limonene.

variants.title: Platinum Punch PR 14 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: The Loud Plug Platinum Punch pre-roll pack is an indica dominant cross of Platinum GSC and Punch Breath, known for its rich complexity and bag appeal. The flavour is layered and loud with sweet grape and berry up front, rounded by mint, gas, earthy spice and that classic cookie funk. We slow cure and hang dry our flower and it’s never irradiated. None of that shake or trim nonsense, only whole flower, milled to perfection before it's rolled up. That’s how we deliver smooth burns, consistent potency and real strain flavour in every pre-roll. Platinum Punch is crafted for purity, potency and quality. Taste the difference. With love from Scarborough.

variants.body_html: Weed Me’s Pink Kush Pre-Roll Multipack contains pre-rolls of this indica-dominant classic with very high THC potency potential. A relative of OG Kush, Pink Kush is recognized for its dense, trichome-coated buds and bold flavour. Aromas of gas, spice, and floral notes are driven by dominant terpenes caryophyllene, myrcene, limonene, humulene, and bisabolol. Each pre-roll is evenly milled and rolled for consistency, using only high-quality strain-specific flower. Offered in a convenient large-format pack, it delivers trusted strain quality in an accessible, value-driven format.

variants.body_html: Already milled and ready to roll… or vape… or pack a bowl. Divvy’s sativa-dominant flower is available in bulk bags containing gently ground from whole flower.

variants.title: Blueberry Dream PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Blueberry Dream delivers 10 x 0.5g cone pre-rolls, rolled in hemp paper for a smooth, pure taste. This potent sativa has bold sweet, floral and berry aromas from limonene, terpineol and caryophyllene.

variants.title: Cropped Blueberry
variants.body_html: Already milled and ready to roll… or vape… or pack a bowl. Divvy’s indica-dominant flower is available in bulk bags containing gently ground from whole flower.

variants.title: Marshmallow OG
variants.body_html: Marshmallow OG was born from a potent lineage — Jet Fuel Gelato x (Chemdawg x Triangle Kush) — and it shows. MOG, as we call it, delivers chunky, trichome-drenched buds that glisten under the light. Deep green hues are streaked with fiery orange pistils, creating a look that practically begs to be sparked. The aroma hits hard with pure gas, then softens into a creamy sweet-vanilla finish that lingers in the air.

variants.title: Dark Rainbow Craft PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: The Woody Nelson edition of the Dark Rainbow genetic was bred by Archive Seed Bank and grown at an indoor vertical farm using organic living soil. This indica-dominant cultivar is rich in terpenes, including caryophyllene, terpinolene, and myrcene, with notes of citrus and funk. Each reusable doob tube comes with pre-rolls made with natural hemp paper.

variants.title: Berry Blurry Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Berry Blurry 510 cart is a blast of strawberry, raspberry and creamy yogurt flavours. This hybrid is smooth and sweet with high THC. Built with a ceramic core, glass cartridge and hemp mouthpiece.

variants.title: Hippie Diesel PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Hippie Diesel by Magi are premium Cannabis pre-rolls grown, trimmed and packaged with care on Saltspring Island. Cultivated in small batches and grown in a legacy style. Flower is whole plant slow-cured, hand-trimmed, and non-irradiated to ensure preservation of rich terpenes and delicate trichomes. Hippie Diesel is an indica-dominant strain that has a gassy, fruity, pungent flavour and aromas of gas and exotic fruit. This strain has a full body thick smoke quality. Available for limited-time-only.

variants.title: Mega CBD 200+ Oil
variants.body_html: Glacial Gold Mega CBD 200+ Oil features organic MCT oil from coconuts, infused with broad spectrum CBD extracts. This 200+ mg/g CBD formula provides a total of 8000 mg CBD per 40ml bottle. Each bottle includes a click-dose syringe for easy dosing, with 200mg of CBD per 1.0ml syringe.

variants.title: Watermelon Splash Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Keep the warmth of summer alive with Watermelon Splash. Bursting with juicy watermelon, syrupy sugar and tropical flavour that'll make any day a little sweeter. Now 90%+ THC! Bigger, Bolder and loaded with liquid diamonds! G.A. Liquid diamond 510 Carts takes our signature botanical terpene infused distillate and adds liquid diamonds to deliver our most potent line up yet. Now with 95%+ THC and the G.A. flavours you love.

variants.title: Diesel BFJ PR 1 x 1.5 g
variants.body_html: A bold and gassy indica blend with diesel notes and a squeeze of citrus. This BFJ brings classic flavour and is smooth. Grown in a hybrid greenhouse in Ontario, this big fat joint offers strong THC potency potential. Oversized and flavour loaded, it’s not just a joint, it’s a BFJ.

variants.title: Tropical Gelato Slushie
variants.body_html: This one's for the noses that like it loud and the tastebuds that like it luxe. Tropical Gelato Slushie opens with smooth, sweet earthy gas then hits your tongue with silky gelato vibes and a citrus splash. Dessert never smelled so diesel.

variants.title: Passion Punk Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: BOXHOT PRESENTS: Passion Punk, a 1.2 g sativa 510 vape with a colossal 1000 mg of THC and some of the purest cannabis distillate available. Turn up the tropics with a juicy mix of passion fruit, guava, and mango with a punchy citrus kick to fuel your flavour rebellion. All BOXHOT vapes are made with exclusive, oversized hardware, making them optimal for big, full hits. Best of all, BOXHOT vapes are produced using industry-leading extraction and refining processes and feature a custom blend of expertly infused botanical terpenes.

variants.title: Irish Swirl Diamond Dipped Infused Blunt PR 1  x 1.2 g
variants.body_html: Irish Swirl Diamond Dipped Blunt is a highly potent blunt infused with premium oil and rich flavours of creamy Irish vanilla bean, cocoa powder and coffee. Made with small batch, hang-dried whole flower, wrapped in a smooth-smoking dark brown hemp blunt wrap, and dipped in a generous coating of potent THCA diamonds and premium fresh-flower kief. Finished with a Dutch crown for a smooth, even burn. Packed with a reusable glass tip. Formulated using distillate, botanical terpenes, and crushed THCA diamonds. Available for a limited-time-only.

variants.title: Hella Jella PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Hella Jella by Magi are premium cannabis pre-rolls grown, trimmed and packaged with care on Saltspring Island. Cultivated in small batches and grown in a legacy style, flower is whole plant slow-cured, hand-trimmed, and non-irradiated to ensure preservation of rich terpenes and delicate trichomes. Hella Jella is a California origin sativa-dominant strain. It has a distinct flavour of cotton candy, strawberry and grapes and fruity, candy shop aromas. Available for limited-time-only.

variants.title: 1:1:1 THC:CBG:CBD Oil
variants.body_html: This unique 1:1:1 THC:CBG:CBD oil is for users who enjoy an array of cannabinoids. In addition to 20mg/g of CBG and 20mg/g of CBD, the oil also contains 20mg/g of THC (568mg of each per bottle), creating a 1:1:1 THC:CBG:CBD ratio. The formulation contains CBG and CBD isolates and THC distillate, all derived from cannabis without the use of synthetic or artificial ingredients. The oil also contains a blend of 9 botanical terpenes including Alpha-Pinene, Linalool, Eucalyptol, and Beta-Caryophyllene to round out a balanced profile.

variants.title: Pink Grapes Live Rosin & Diamond Infused Blunt PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Pink Grapes Rosin Infused Glass Tip Blunts feature strain-specific inputs cultivated in Princeton, BC. These blunts contain strain specific milled flower mixed with live rosin and are generously coated in diamonds for exceptional potency. Pink Grapes was bred by crossing Pink Rntz and Grape Gas.

variants.title: Blk Caviar
variants.body_html: A BLKMKT Exclusive. Bred in-house, BLK Caviar is an anomaly from anything in the lineup. Nicknamed "Thanksgiving Dinner" with a nose reminiscent of turkey stuffing and gravy. This indica-dominant cut produces extremely dark, iced out buds with a noteworthy taste taking this one step further in bag appeal. Always made from small batch whole flower that is grown indoors & hang-dried, hand-trimmed and hand-packaged at facilities in Okanagan, B.C. Available for a limited-time-only.

variants.title: Unicorn Cke Live Rosin & Diamond Infused Blunt PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Unicorn Cke Rosin Infused Blunts feature strain-specific inputs cultivated in Princeton, BC. These blunts contain strain specific milled flower mixed with live rosin and are generously coated in diamonds for exceptional potency. Unicorn Cke was bred by crossing the legendary Wedding Cake with Unicorn Poop.

variants.title: BC Organic Sun Grown Mango Sapphire
variants.body_html: Tropical luxury in every hit. Mango Sapphire blends lush mango, creamy coconut, and zesty citrus into a bold, fruity experience backed by heavy-hitting relaxation. This indica-dominant beauty delivers a fast-hitting cerebral high that melts into full-body calm, perfect for winding down or kicking stress to the curb. With dense, resin-packed buds and an exortic terpene profile, Mango Sapphire doesn't just hit- it indulges.

variants.title: Root Beer Float PR 1 x 2 g
variants.body_html: This Root Beer Float blunt is packed with our high potency, indica dominant whole flower. Root Beer Float is a rare cross of XXX OG x Vanilla Kush. Expect a smooth and flavourful burn with sweet, earthy notes, hints of lemon and pine and that signature root beer and frothy vanilla finish. Rolled in a hemp blunt wrap and finished with a glass tip, this extra large hand crafted blunt burns slowly and smoothly. Bold Craft Cannabis is indoor grown, small batch, hang dried, slow cured and hand trimmed.

variants.title: BC Organic Sun Grown Bonkers
variants.body_html: Get ready to go Bonkers- in the best way possible. This fruity powerhouse delivers a euphoric head rush followed by a smooth, mellow body buzz that doesnt glue you to the couch. Bursting with bold blueberry, grape, and tropical candy flavours, Bonkers is your go-to for stress relief, mood elevation, and good time- day or night. Wether you're kicking back after work or vibing with your friends, this strain lives up to its name in all the right ways.

variants.title: Block Party PR 20 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Experience the joy of rotation with TRYGG's Block Party Variety Pack! This 20-Pack of 0.5g of Hybrid pre-rolls is a variety pack filled with premium cannabis strains. Each Pack will contain 10 pre-rolls of one strain, and another 10 pre-rolls of a different strain, giving you two amazing strains to experience. Embrace the celebration with Block Party by TRYGG.

variants.title: Detroit Runtz
variants.body_html:
Introducing Detroit Runtz! This indica-dominant strain boasts a robust THC potency, expertly crafted by crossing Runtz with Parkfire. Imagine deep purple buds adorned with dark orange pistils, all frosted with sticky trichomes. Detroit Runtz captivates the senses with its creamy, nutty aromas and finishes with a sweet touch.

The dominant terpenes are caryophyllene, limonene, myrcene. Grown indoors in Pointe-Claire, Quebec, we hand harvest, whole plant hang dry, hand trim, cure cold and slow for a minimum of 14 days, and hand package. Elevate your cannabis experience with Detroit Runtz.

variants.title: Sour Granny Apple Liquid Diamonds Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: She’s sour to the core. Sweet and sour lip-smacking green apple flavour supercharged with potent liquid diamonds. From our Super Fruits collection, a lineup of the most supreme fruity flavours. Packed with a toasty reusable silicone cap to keep out that pocket lint. Super Toast. Always Ready.

variants.title: Big Pleasures Classic PR 40 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Big Pleasures. Big pack of pre-rolls ready to enjoy. Classic joint-style pre-rolls packed with fresh and aromatic flower, and machine rolled with precision for a steady and reliable smoke.

variants.title: Hawaiian Snowcone PR 10 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Hawaiian Snowcone by 1Spliff is a sativa that brings together the best of Zktlz and Lemon Cherry Gelato. This strain is all about flavour, combining the sweet and fruity Zktlz with the creamy and citrusy zing of Lemon Cherry Gelato. Each bud is lovingly hand harvested, hang dried to perfection, hand trimmed and carefully hand packaged to make sure that all those natural terpenes and cannabinoids are fully preserved.

variants.title: Yocan Evolve Plus XL Vaporizer Kit - Light Blue
variants.body_html: The Evolve Plus XL from Yocan is an all-in-one portable dab pen. Instead of using threading, they've replaced it with a magnetic connection to easily attach the atomizer tube. Now featuring quad coil technology, the 4-quartz rod produces bigger clouds and better tasting vapor. The medical-grade quartz and aluminum can withstand high heat without compromising on quality. Coil caps prevent leakage, and an adjustable airflow valve enables you to choose big hits or impeccable flavour. A big 1400mAh battery lets you vape all day and the micro-USB charger allows you to power up anywhere. The base of the battery has a dual compartment silicone storage jar built in for peak portability. A lanyard and dab tool are also included to make your session ever sweeter.

variants.title: Hawaiian Snow Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Hawaiian Snow Infused Pre-rolls by 1SPLIFF is your ticket to a tropical paradise in every puff. It's a mouthwatering strain that brings together the best of Zktlz and Lemon Cherry Gelato. It is all about flavour, combining the sweet, fruity goodness of Zktlz with the creamy, citrusy zing of Lemon Cherry Gelato and infused with kief. Each bud is lovingly hand harvested, hang dried to perfection, hand trimmed and carefully hand packaged to make sure that all those natural terpenes and cannabinoids are fully preserved.

variants.title: RYOT - GR8TR Walnut Wood Top Grinder w/ Clear Glass Jar Body - 3 inch
variants.body_html:
The RYOT GR8TR combines premium materials with practical design for effortless grinding. Featuring a natural walnut wood top and a clear glass jar body, this 3‑inch grinder delivers consistent results while allowing you to monitor your grind. Durable, stylish, and easy to use, it’s a reliable addition to any setup.

Key Features & Benefits

Premium Walnut Wood Top: Smooth, natural finish adds durability and a classic look.
