Compact 3‑Inch Size: Portable and easy to handle while still providing ample grinding capacity.

Easy to Use: Simple, ergonomic design ensures comfortable operation and effortless grinding.

Stylish, functional, and built to last, the RYOT GR8TR makes grinding simple and satisfying.

variants.title: Blue Zushi
variants.body_html: Blue Zushi 3.5g whole flower delivers a striking blend of gas and tropical sweetness. Carefully cultivated for its rich flavour, this Zkittlez x Kush Mintz cross is an aromatic and smooth-smoking standout.

variants.title: Organic Mango Hashplant
variants.body_html: Mango Hashplant is a potent, organically cultivated indica from BC. A tropical powerhouse in aroma, it showcases the sweetness of ripe mango layered over a classic hashy and earthy spice profile. Each bud is hang-dried and slow-cured for a minimum of 4 weeks to lock in its potency and complex flavour.

variants.title: Organic Mango Hashplant PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Mango Hashplant is a potent, organically cultivated indica from BC. A tropical powerhouse in aroma, it showcases the sweetness of ripe mango layered over a classic hashy and earthy spice profile. Each bud is hang-dried and slow-cured for a minimum of 4 weeks to lock in its potency and complex flavour.

variants.title: Organic Mango Hashplant
variants.body_html: Mango Hashplant is a potent, organically cultivated indica from BC. A tropical powerhouse in aroma, it showcases the sweetness of ripe mango layered over a classic hashy and earthy spice profile. Each bud is hang-dried and slow-cured for a minimum of 4 weeks to lock in its potency and complex flavour.

variants.title: Cement Shoes
variants.body_html: Cement Shoes is a heavy, full-body indica delivering deep relaxation and classic couch-lock effects. Expect creamy vanilla kush, earthy undertones, and a strong diesel back note that lingers on the palate. Known for its dense frost and knockout potency, this cultivar is built for seasoned consumers seeking a powerful wind-down strain.

variants.title: Lemon Cherry Runtz
variants.body_html: Lemon Cherry Runtz is a flavour-packed hybrid blending zesty lemon citrus with rich cherry candy sweetness and a creamy, dessert-like finish. This cultivar offers a balanced high that starts with an uplifting, euphoric head buzz before melting into smooth body relaxation without heavy sedation. Visually striking with vibrant purple hues and a thick coat of frost, Lemon Cherry Runtz is a terp-driven standout ideal for any time of day.

variants.title: Sky Burst Haze
variants.body_html: Sky Burst Haze is an uplifting, terp-heavy sativa bursting with lemon citrus, tropical sweetness, and a signature hazy herbal finish. Energizing and bright, it delivers a clear-headed cerebral buzz ideal for daytime sessions. A flavour-forward sativa with a smooth, refreshing smoke that stands out in any lineup.

variants.title: Fruitquake Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Fruitquake is a liquid diamond vape that delivers a tropical explosion of flavour and potency. Packed with refined liquid diamonds, this vape is smooth but strong. Bursting with bold tropical fruit flavours, Fruitquake has sweet and juicy notes. This vape delivers potency and a rich, flavourful inhale.

variants.title: Big Buddy PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: The Big Buddy Indica Pre-Roll is full of quality and high THC flower that is in a convenient and smooth pre-roll for any consumer. This indica-dominant pre-roll is made from a variety of strains, rolled to perfection to ensure that you always get a consistently smooth burn. Get ready to stay blooming with your new preferred indica pre-roll pack.

variants.title: Heart Bong w/Bowl + Banger
variants.body_html: The Heart Dual-Use Water Pipe is as versatile as it is charming. Designed for both dry herbs and concentrates, this little beauty delivers smooth, flavourful hits every time, whether you’re in the mood for flower or extracts. Its dual-use design makes switching between sessions effortless, while the durable construction ensures it’s a piece you’ll love to use again and again. With its carefully crafted water chamber, the Heart cools and filters every puff, giving you dense, satisfying hits without harshness. Its compact, eye-catching design makes it as easy to display as it is to handle, while the sturdy base keeps everything stable, even in the middle of a fun session. Key Features & Benefits Dual-use functionality: Enjoy both dry herbs and concentrates without skipping a beat Smooth, filtered hits: Water chamber ensures cool, clean hits every time Durable materials: Built to last and maintain top performance Compact, stylish design: A gorgeous piece that fits perfectly in your space Sturdy base: Keeps your sessions worry-free and secure Easy setup: Quickly switch between dry herb and concentrate modes Charming, versatile, and built for pure enjoyment, the Heart Dual-Use Water Pipe turns every session into a little moment of bliss—smooth, flavourful, and full of heart.

variants.title: Maxed Out Liquid Diamond Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Clickstix by Chillbilly introduces the Maxed Out Liquid Diamonds All-in-One Vape — where high potency meets high customizability. Built with magnetic sides, these vapes snap together like magic, letting you mix and match flavours, stack your stash, or share with a buddy. Lemon Riot charges in with an electrifying blast of ultra-sour lemon and a punch of dank diesel flavour, crafted using hydrocarbon extraction to deliver pure diamond-powered potency. Whether you’re doubling down on your favourite or clicking together a custom combo, Clickstix let you build your sesh your way — just like your truck: loud, proud, and full of power.

variants.title: Very Berry Rocket Bundle Gummies
variants.body_html: Atomic Sours Very Berry Rocket soft chews multipack. These booming bites are some of the sourest soft chews you’ll ever put in your mouth with bold, nostalgic flavours of cherry, blue raspberry and lime. Each soft chew delivers 10 mg of THC from nano emulsified liquid THCA diamonds and 10 mg of CBG.

variants.title: Turbo Diesel PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Turbo Diesel is a sativa-leaning hybrid born from Sour Diesel and Sour Kush, delivering bold, unmistakable aromas. It hits with pungent petrol up front, rounded out by a hint of citrus and a deep, earthy finish. Grown on Canada’s 42nd parallel, South Point is for those who appreciate the details. We take the long way. Our pre-rolls are made from whole flower, rolled in reefer cones and finished with a crown end. No gimmicks. No shortcuts. Just great cannabis, straight to the point.

variants.title: Bubblegum Marker & Red Bullz PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Two strains conveniently available in a 10-pack tin of pre-rolls. Up first is Bubblegum Marker. Bred by Seed Junky, Bubblegum Marker is a cross of Bubblegum Sherb x Permanent Marker. This strain hits with bold notes of bubblegum, gas, and lime. Up next is Red Bullz, bred by Compound Genetics. Red Bullz is a cross of Grape Gas x White Rntz, delivering vibrant flavours of chem, gas, sugar.

variants.title: Bubblegum Marker & Red Bullz
variants.body_html: Two unique strains served up in our signature orange pouch. Up first is Bubblegum Marker. Bred by Seed Junky, Bubblegum Marker is a cross of Bubblegum Sherb x Permanent Marker. This strain hits with bold notes of bubblegum, gas, and lime. Up next is Red Bullz, bred by Compound Genetics. Red Bullz is a cross of Grape Gas x White Rntz, delivering vibrant flavours of chem, gas, and sugar.

variants.title: Dark Rainbow
variants.body_html: This edition of the Dark Rainbow genetic was bred by Archive Seed Bank and grown at an indoor vertical farm using organic living soil. This high-THC cultivar is also rich in terpenes, including caryophyllene, terpinolene, and myrcene, with notes of citrus and funk. The plant's dense, frosty buds are hand-trimmed, cured for a minimum of three weeks, and never irradiated.

variants.title: Tropical Glue XL Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Purple Hills AIO XL Carts are filled with a single-strain of our terpiest live resin. This reliable, accessible vape cart brings the full profile of our fresh-frozen cannabis to life in a 1g all-in-one. With hydrocarbon extraction, that flower’s terp sauce and crystallized cannabinoids are isolated and then reunited, to fill our rechargeable batteries that draw a clean hit of smooth concentrate from start to finish. Our Tropical Glue AIO provides a sweet, nutty and tropical bouquet of flavour with a diesel overtone that lingers long after your final exhale.

variants.title: Lemonberry Kush Disty Dabber
variants.body_html: BOXHOT PRESENTS: the Lemonberry Kush 1.2g Indica Disty Dabber, boasting a colossal 1000 mg of THC, botanical terpenes, and some of the purest cannabis distillate in a versatile format. Enjoy the full blast of cherry and lemon-zest flavours. All BOXHOT dabbers are manufactured with a glass syringe and stainless-steel plunger for precision.

variants.title: Blue Dream Live Resin
variants.body_html: Crafted from inputs grown by Cannaworks in Lake Country, Okanagan, this live resin celebrates their grassroots, family-style approach — founded and run by long-time friends and industry experts who value small-scale, hands-on ownership over big corporate influence. CannaWorks’ location is key: situated on 37 breezy acres between two lakes, the farm gets a natural crosswind that keeps plants healthy and strong. Once harvested, the flower is extracted by First Choice Cannabis in Sooke, BC, ensuring top-quality resin from start to finish. Blue Dream is a renowned sativa — a cross of Blueberry and Haze. The result? A sweet blueberry aroma meets warm, peppery, and pine notes, highlighted by spicy hints of hops and terpinolene. Enjoy all the best of BC cannabis: authentic genetics, pure Okanagan-grown flower, expert small-batch extraction, and true-to-strain flavour with every hit. Available for a limited-time-only.

variants.title: Rainbow Guava Live Rosin
variants.body_html: Brindle Farms’ solventless extract pressed from fresh-frozen Rainbow Guava flower. This premium rosin bursts with tropical fruit and ripe guava sweetness, accented by subtle candy-like notes. Produced from a 159–73 micron wash using a HashTek system, it showcases exceptional clarity, potency, and terpene richness. Small-batch, single-source, and crafted to deliver a smooth, flavourful experience in every gram.

variants.title: Banjo Cold Cure Live Rosin
variants.body_html: Banjo Cold Cure Live Rosin delivers a rich, wild-harvested flavour with bold notes of sweet gas, cake, and caramel, that comes from the Banjo strain. This small batch rosin is slow cured and freshly whipped for perfect texture and peak terpene preservation. With low volume, high attention craftsmanship, Back Country brings mountain vibes and worthy flavour to every dab: made for the true rosin trailblazer.

variants.title: Kush Mints Classic Gummy Hash
variants.body_html: Our 2g Kush Mints Classic Bubble Hash delivers unmatched flexibility. This hash offers rich flavour and a perfectly pliable texture, ideal for rolling snakes, packing pipes, or loading your hash rig. It's a modern twist on tradition, crafted for those who like to shape their smoke their way.

variants.title: Red Dragon x Blue Bandita Live Rosin Chamber Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: This 1g AIO packs 0.5g of each live rosin strain, delivering 67–73% THC and two bold terpene profiles ready to accompany you, anywhere you roam. Red Dragon hits with a warm kick of spice and fruit, finished with deep, earthy wood notes, like a fireside puff in the pines. Flip the switch to Blue Bandita for a juicy burst of sweet, fruity goodness that’s ripe for the picking. Whether you ride one trail or blaze both, this dual chamber is built for the flavour frontier. Lineage: West Himalayan Kush x Utopia Haze & Blueberry x Headband.

variants.title: Gold Face Hash Rosin Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Three hash rosin-infused pre-rolls crafted from one of our most intensely aromatic cultivars: Gold Face. These highly potent pre-rolls are crafted under our roof featuring fresh, hang-dried Gold Face flower infused with pure, solventless Gold Face hash rosin, cold cured and pressed in-house in our hash lab. These pre-rolls take this golden sativa to the next level, amplifying its signature loud fruit punch aroma profile. This bold expression is a reflection to its potent parents: classic citrusy and sugary Animal Face amplified by Electric Grapefruit’s bright aromas of sweet pomelo. Finished with fresh herbal notes, and a hint of something skunky. From the Pure Infusions collection, taking you higher with a lineup of pure, true-to-flower experiences. Packed with a limited-edition collectable glass tip for an elevated smoke.

variants.title: Formula 55 Citrus Rush Diamond Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Bright, bold, and undeniably potent — Formula 55: Citrus Rush by Terra Labs is a lemon lover’s dream. This infused pre-roll pack is crafted with premium indoor-grown flower, intense Live Resin Diamonds, and vibrant botanical terpenes. The result? A tart lemon flavour with a crisp, clean finish. Every pre-roll has over 55% THC, delivering consistent strength and sharp flavour in a smooth-burning format. Citrus Rush is as fresh as it is potent. Big impact — just how we like it.

variants.title: Toasters Taster Pack Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Crank up the toast level with a Toasters Taster Pack. Five super flavourful and potent kief-crusted pre-rolls infused with THC distillate in a variety of super fruity flavours: Shark Bite, Twisted Cherry, Cantaloopy, Tropicale Royale and Seriously Strawberry. Super Toast. Always Ready.

variants.title: Porto Leche Trifecta Infused PR 3 x 0.6 g
variants.body_html: Some pairings are just meant to be, like the deep, bold taste of aged red berries or the smooth, velvety taste of fresh cream. Porto Leche (Oreoz x Grape Jubilee, Breeder: Exotic Genetics) captures both, delivering a flavour experience that's rich and effortlessly smooth. The first hit bursts with notes of ripe and jammy berries, coating your palate in deep, complex sweetness. As you exhale, a wave of creamy smoothness follows, like a cold glass of milk. Tribal Trifecta Porto Leche infused pre-rolls start with Porto Leche flower that is triple infused with Porto Leche live resin, terp sauce and THCA diamonds. Rolled in hemp paper and finished with a ceramic tip. Live resin + terp sauce + THC-A diamonds = the Tribal Trifecta.

variants.title: Starting Five Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: High Sticks are precisely crafted pre-rolls infused with liquid diamonds, a slap shot of flavour and Canadian pride. Each stick is coated in a layer of fresh kief made from the same high quality cannabis we grow ourselves and put into every pre-roll. By Canadians, for Canadians.

variants.title: Breakaway Bubba Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: High Sticks are precisely crafted pre-rolls infused with liquid diamonds, a slap shot of flavour and Canadian pride. Each stick is coated in a layer of fresh kief made from the same high quality cannabis we grow ourselves and put into every pre-roll. By Canadians, for Canadians.

variants.title: GMO Cookies PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Don’t let the name deceive you. This strain inspiration traces its lineage back to GSC and a Deep Sour Kush background. GMO (Garlic, Mushroom, Onion) Cookies has an unmistakable sweet and savoury taste. Terpenes like caryophyllene, myrcene, and humulene make it one of the most popular indica strains out there. You can’t make a soup out of it, but it sure goes nicely in a bowl.

variants.title: Fire Breath PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Explore the natural wonders of the Back Forty with our Fire Breath slim pre-rolls. A cross between Fire OG and Mendo Breath, Fire Breath is a potent indica with a profile of dank earth, forest and diesel. Fire Breath pre-rolls use whole flower and are machine rolled to perfection, packed in a resealable tray.

variants.title: Zkittlez Punch PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Zkittlez Punch Sativa by Uncle Bob is prepared with steady attention from harvest through rolling. Each 0.5g pre roll in this 10-pack is made from BC grown flower and crafted for a consistent and dependable burn. This cultivar is handled with care to maintain its natural qualities, including its recognizable aromatic profile. The pre-rolls are sized for convenience and produced with the same practical approach Uncle Bob brings to every batch. It is a straightforward option for those who appreciate well made, reliable pre-rolls.

variants.title: Hawaiian Pineapple PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Hawaiian Pineapple, a sativa-dominant, crowd-pleaser bred by crossing Dole Whip and Cookies & Cream. When it comes to flavour, the name says it all. Hawaiian Pineapple packs a mouthwatering sweet and tropical pineapple taste with a light creamy fruity exhale. The aroma is extenuated with undertones of sour citrus and spice. The buds are sativa structured with gleaming trichomes and colorful hues. Dominant terpenes include limonene, myrcene, caryophyllene. Pre-rolls are made in-house by hand and machine, using only fresh, small batch premium flower grown by Pineapple Buds on the Osoyoos Indian Band.

variants.title: Frosted Lemons PR 1 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Lemons! That's what your nose will be yelling down the hall to the brain. But don’t be fooled, this is not the citrus companion you’ll be squeezing over dinner or slicing into a drink. Frosted Lemons is designed to destroy the mundane. Break it open and the profile hits immediately: sharp, zesty lemon up front, a curl of diesel underneath, and a soft vanilla sweetness rounding it all out. It’s the kind of aroma that fills a room fast and refuses to stay quiet, carrying through from jar to grind to spark with the same loud, citrus bite. Clean, bright, and unmistakably lemon-forward, this one leaves its mark long after the lid goes back on.

variants.title: Honey Bananas
variants.body_html: Honey Banana showcases dense, trichome-coated buds with bright green hues and orange pistils. The flower is sticky to the touch and slow-cured for a smooth burn. Aromas blend sweet banana, creamy vanilla, and floral honey with a hint of tropical fruit. Hand-trimmed and nitrogen-flushed to preserve natural terpene content and freshness.

variants.title: Bubblegum Marker
variants.body_html: Bubblegum Marker was bred by Seed Junky Genetics by crossing Bubblegum Sherb with Permanent Marker. Expect bold notes of bubblegum, gas and lime. Because it’s the right thing to do, all of Carmel’s flower is hang-dried, hand-trimmed, slow cold-cured, and hand-packaged. Kept fresh and terpy by sealing it up in nitrogen-flushed pouches with a humidity pack inside. And yeah — non-irradiated, obviously. Available for a limited-time-only.

variants.title: Guzzlers PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Guzzlers is a popular indica dominant strain known for its strong aroma of gas and funk. It offers high levels of THC and frosted purple buds finished with a proper dry and curing process. Our pre-roll products are made with nothing but trimmed whole flower for a consistent experience every time.

variants.title: Sour Chem PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: It’s dank, it’s pungent, it’s straight up in-your-face gas. Spinach® Sour Chem is our ode to what all our buds know and love — a sativa strain that hits on classic flavours and aromas like diesel, chemical, and zesty citrus. With tasty terps like farnesene, caryophyllene, and limonene, flavours will linger on the tip of your tongue with ease. With a lineage that traces back to Chemdawg and Sour Diesel, it’s no surprise that this strain flexes it's high THC potency.

variants.title: Platinum OG
variants.brand: The Original Fraser Valley Weed Co.
tags: The Original Fraser Valley Weed Co.
variants.body_html: An ounce of Platinum OG. This potent indica is a cross of Master Kush, OG Kush, and a third unknown parent. It delivers aromas of black pepper, sweet earth and pine, layered with notes of herbs and old school gas. Looking at its dense and silvery trichome covered bud, it’s called platinum for a reason. Expertly grown in BC’s Fraser Valley.

variants.title: Chemzilla PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Explore the natural wonders of the Back Forty with our Chemzilla slim pre-rolls. A cross between Chemdawg and Godzilla Glue, Chemzilla is a potent indica with a profile of chem, earth and a touch of spice. Chemzilla pre-rolls use whole flower and are machine rolled to perfection, packed in a resealable tray.

variants.title: Kush Mints
variants.body_html: Kush Mints is a potent indica-dominant strain bred from Animal Mints x Bubba Kush. Known for its dense, frosty buds, Kush Mints delivers a rich, sweet aroma with notes of doughy vanilla, subtle mint, and a hit of classic gas. This strain brings together bold flavour and potent effects in a true west coast classic.

variants.title: Randy's Inspo Dual 510 Battery - Noir Black
variants.body_html:
Randy’s Inspo Dual 510 Battery brings a fresh twist to a fan-favourite design, built for sessions that demand flexibility and control. Designed to hold and power two cartridges at once, this compact battery lets you switch between carts or enjoy both simultaneously for a fuller, more customizable experience. With a clean digital display and compatibility with glass setups, the Inspo Dual blends everyday convenience with elevated session options.


Key Features & Benefits


Dual cart capacity: Use up to two cartridges at the same time or flip between carts depending on your preference
Digital display: Real-time voltage and battery information keeps every session dialed in
Water pipe adapter compatibility: Attach the Inspo Dual to your favourite glass piece for smoother hits
Custom voltage range: Five voltage settings from 1.8v to 3.8v let you fine-tune flavour and hit intensity
Reliable battery performance: 650 mAh battery with a 90 minute charge time supports longer sessions
Extended atomizer support: Holds up to 2 grams per cartridge


Colour options: Available in Noir Black, Lilac Purple, and Steel Blue


Designed as the next evolution of the Inspo line, the Inspo Dual doubles the enjoyment without sacrificing simplicity. Whether you prefer switching flavours or combining carts for a fuller experience, this 510 battery delivers versatility, style, and dependable performance in every session.

variants.title: Queen of Bud Zippo Red Jasper Passionate Rose
variants.body_html:
Created for those who appreciate beauty, ritual and refined craftsmanship. This collaboration between Zippo and Queen of Bud brings together Zippo’s legendary performance with the dreamy, modern aesthetic that defines Queen of Bud. Each piece feels like a small, personal charm—crafted in the USA, built entirely from metal, and engineered with a windproof flame that delivers a smooth, reliable light. Designed to be collected and cherished, every style carries its own distinct aura. Inspired by crystals, these lighters connect to themes of clarity, passion, love and manifestation.

Key Features & Benefits


All-metal durability: American-made construction built to last
Windproof flame: stays steady in most outdoor settings
Refillable design: reduces waste and extends the life of your lighter
Effortless ignition: delivers a clean, satisfying spark
Crystal-inspired details: motifs reflect the symbolic energy of clear quartz, black obsidian and rose quartz
Signature Queen of Bud artistry: geometric accents, soft motifs and refined textures create a thoughtful visual experience
Design lineup: Golden Vertical Flame, Black Obsidian Vertical Flame, Golden Lines of Triumph, Black Obsidian Geometric, Black Obsidian Flame of Dreams, Rose Quartz Mosaic, Black Obsidian Dark Rose, Rose Quartz Filigree, Black Obsidian Midnight Manifest, Clear Quartz Mosaic, Red Jasper Passionate Rose
Portable profile: slips easily into pockets, bags and accessories

Both a functional statement piece and a meaningful keepsake, this lighter brings a touch of Queen of Bud presence to every moment

variants.title: Scented Marker
variants.body_html: EastCann Scented Marker is a high THC hybrid of Alien Mints x Permanent Marker.

variants.title: Wild Berry Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html:
Ripe means ready! Wild Berry drops a sweet blend of blueberry, raspberry, and blackberry into every hit. No extras. Just smooth, ripe flavour.

Triple-distilled distillate for purity. Botanical terpenes for taste. No gimmicks - just smooth pulls, serious THC, and big flavour. Welcome to the new standard.

variants.title: Strawberry Lemonade Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html:
A summer classic, redefined! Strawberry Lemonade blends sweet strawberries with a light lemon finish. This one doesn't sit on ice.

Triple-distilled distillate for purity. Botanical terpenes for taste. No gimmicks - just smooth pulls, serious THC, and big flavour. Welcome to the new standard.

variants.title: TIMEOFF
variants.body_html: Carefully cultivated for zesty citrus flavours, this format is perfect for consumers who appreciate quality and consistency.

variants.title: Golden Tangie
variants.body_html: Golden Tangie is temptation in its rawest form. Packed with golden buds and a bold hit of sweet oranges and tangy tangerines, this zesty sativa commands attention the second you open the pack.

variants.title: Frozen Grapes PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Fruit Drops is all about those fruity terpenes -- strains with flavour and aroma that could peel the paint off the walls when you pop the tube. Frozen Grapes is an indica dominant cross of Grapes of Wrath x Banana Split, brimming with intense juicy grape aroma and flavour. A nostalgic flower that’ll bring you right back to that classic purple taste.

variants.title: Space Tokens Berry - Tastic! Gummies
variants.body_html: Take a Space Token soft chew that is all natural and made without animal products or gluten. Made with natural flavour and colour. One soft chew contains 10 mg of high quality THC distillate. These Berry-tastic soft chews are tangy. Indica strain.

variants.title: Silver Rhino PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: This sativa-dominant strain is carrying a sturdy terpenes profile and a strong gassy nose and flavour. These beautiful premium pre-rolls contain high THC and are sure to provide the ultimate and smooth experience. This is one beast of a strain. Silver rhino a classic hard charging strain.

variants.title: CBG Infused Mango PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Abide's CBG Infused Mango 1:1:1 pre-rolls are a pack of 1:1 Organic Mango Sapphire Haze infused with CBG kief. The result is a super smooth 1:1:1 ratio of THC:CBD:CBG. Each pre-roll is made with certified organically grown single strain flower (no trim) and dry sifted CBG kief, wrapped in an unbleached hemp cone and packaged in a reusable and recyclable cardboard box.

variants.title: Straight Cash Homie Ceramic Tip Infused PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Straight Cash Homie was created by crossing LA Pop Rockz with Magic Marker #5 delivering sour candy, soap and fuel. Our ceramic tip infused pre-roll features cured resin as well as our ice water hash.

variants.title: Luscious Lemonade Gummies
variants.body_html: When life hands you lemons — turn them into gummies! Each pack is loaded with 10 lemonade-flavoured soft chews, each packing 10 mg THC for a ZESTY citrus kick.

variants.title: Red Velvet Ice Cream PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Red Velvet Ice Cream is a rare choice for consumers seeking a strain with strong lineage and exceptional qualities. We have talked to many retailers to confirm this information. Only a limited supply of seeds was sold. The buds are completely reddened with icy trichomes. They expresse a light green colouration with dark purple hues throughout. This variety maintains a creamy aroma with hints of a blend of sweet, fruity and floral notes, reminiscent of freshly baked red velvet cupcakes topped with a scoop of vanilla ice cream.

variants.title: Ultra Hi Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Purple Hills Ultra Hi infused pack of pre-rolls each start with milled whole bud that is sun grown in living soil. The flower is infused with a blend of high potency isolate, distillate and natural flavours. The finished product is a consistently pulling, evenly burning and potent pre-roll.

variants.title: Skunkcussion PR 3 x 1 g
variants.body_html: A head turner flower descendant of the Shoreline strain family, with an uncompromising skunk stench that carries through into the flavour when smoked.

variants.title: Sativa XL Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Community ℅ Purple Hills XL Carts 1.2g 510 cartridges are an affordable vape product for those who want to find the perfect balance of price, convenience and quality in a bigger size! The Sativa XL provides easy, competitively-priced access to reliable, high-caliber production and the sweet & spicy taste of a hazy sativa, and you’re good to go!

variants.title: Triple Burger SuperNova Live Resin Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Tribal's Triple Burger SuperNova Live Resin all-in-one vape has one ingredient, our fresh frozen Triple Burger flower (GMO x Double Burger. Breeder: Swamp Boy Seeds). Potent and loaded with flavour, Tribal's SuperNova disposable vape has ceramic hardware and a USB-C rechargeable battery.

variants.title: Juicy Pineapples Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: GLAZED Juicy Pineapples Liquid Diamond vape delivers a high-potency blast of ripe pineapples and tropical brightness. Every puff bursts with golden fruit flavour and juicy nectar for a smooth, sunshine-soaked rush that’s bold, sweet, and mouth-watering. The BOLD choice for when distillate vapes aren't enough. Rechargeable and ready to enjoy right out of the bag.

variants.title: Uncut PR 1 x 2 g
variants.body_html: UNCUT is our boldest pre-roll yet — a raw, unfiltered experience designed for those who don’t hold back. Packed with quality flower, this extended-format pre-roll isn’t just big for show — it’s built for substance. Every inch is rolled with intention, offering a slow, even burn. Whether you’re sharing it with a group or savouring it solo, UNCUT delivers a lasting session that doesn't rush the moment. No edits. No shortcuts. Just pure, potent flower in a format that refuses to be rushed. More than a pre-roll — UNCUT is a statement. A celebration of quality, time, and unapologetic enjoyment.

variants.title: Pink Gas Shatter Double Infused PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: This 1g infused pre-roll brings the highly-potent Pink Gas strain to life with added diamonds.

variants.title: Bussin Blue Razz Live Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Vero’s Fruity Collection Bussin Blue Razz is an indica live liquid diamond vape cart that brings a burst of sweetness with every puff. Infused with added cannabis and botanical terpenes and the strain Blue Raspberry, it delivers a smooth, sweet and sugary flavour.

variants.title: Hot Honey Liquid Diamonds Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Expect a sweet and spicy experience with this potent Hot Honey Liquid Diamonds all-in-one. This eco-friendly disposable vape has a removable and recyclable battery housed in a biodegradable corn PLA shell. Sweet wildflower honey aromas are complemented by notes of cinnamon spice. The rechargeable all-in-one hardware is perfectly calibrated and optimized for this specific formula.

variants.title: Stealth Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Introducing the Stealth Vape Cartridge, the ultimate choice for those who prioritize discretion and performance. This 1-gram vape cartridge, sourced from the renowned Crystal Clear Lab, is specifically designed to be colourless, odourless, and tasteless, allowing you to enjoy your sessions without any distractions. The Stealth cartridge features a THCa isolate with a potent THC content ranging from 84-90%, providing a potent experience while keeping CBD levels minimal. The sleek, scent-free design ensures that you can vape discreetly. The THCa isolate delivers a smooth and potent hit, ideal for those who want a clean experience without drawing attention. Stay in Stealth Mode with this premium cartridge, designed for those who value both performance and discretion.

variants.title: Charged
variants.body_html: We've amped up our flower game to bring you a bigger bag of indica buds than we've ever done before. Charged Indica is a rotating assortment of plump indoor grown indica flower buds. Grown fully indoors in precision controlled laboratory conditions, every single cannabis plant is tended to with the utmost care, thoughtfully hung to dry, hand trimmed and cured. Every batch contains a different blend of revolving powerful indica strains for a surprising assortment of flavours at consistently high THC levels.

variants.title: Unicorn Blood Distillate Infused PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: XPLOR your wild side with Unicorn Blood Distillate Infused pre-rolls. Each draw provides sweet flavour. Now boosted in potency.

variants.title: Strawberry Gush Live Resin Jumbo Dispenser
variants.body_html: Pura Vida Strawberry Gush Live Resin Jumbo Dispenser, produced via hydrocarbon extraction, this golden and full spectrum concentrate offers true to flower flavours. This hybrid strain has notes of sweet strawberries, bright orange and hints of tangy pineapple. Housed in an all-glass dispenser multi-tool that is heat resistant and safe for use for applying directly into dab rigs, dab pens, taken orally, refill vape carts or adding to rolling papers, pre-rolls, bowl toppers and more.

variants.title: Balanced Milk Chocolate
variants.body_html: This multipack contains 4 immediate containers, each with one chocolate-for a total of 4 chocolates. The #1 selling chocolate in Canada - balanced milk chocolate is now available in a bulk pack format of 4 units. Chocolate so smooth it could sell water to a fish. Every creamy and smooth Chowie Wowie Milk Chocolate Balance contains one piece of quality milk chocolate with equal amounts of THC and CBD, 10mg each. Breakable into two servings, it's perfect for sharing. Leveraging 100% THC and CBD distillate, Chowie Wowie Milk Chocolate Balance provides consistent dosing per serving. Start with 1 square then wait to feel the effects.

variants.title: Modified Grapes
variants.body_html: Modified Grapes is a potent indica-dominant cultivar that is renowned for its fruity aroma. Modified Grapes is made from a genetic cross between GMO and Purple Punch. These buds have rounded, fluffy, dark-olive-green nugs with purple undertones, thin orange hairs and a coating of dark purple-tinted, white trichomes. Top terpenes include Myrcene, Limonene, and Caryophyllene.

variants.title: Espresso Gelato
variants.body_html: Gas, Dark Purple and Iced Out, our Espresso Gelato is our own remix of Grandi Candy from Lit Farms, which was phenohunted and backcrossed to deliver a unique, gassy genetic that produces large, trichome-rich buds. It has a distinct candy-forward flavour with subtle hints of coffee and espresso. Always handcrafted from our genetics and grown in-house at our facilities in BC. Graded and hand packaged to our highest standards.

variants.title: Fruitloops Diamond Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Rise and shine, you've got a whole day to conquer! Every cannasseur knows the most important smoke of the day is the wake and bake, pull up your OJ and spark it off on a sweet foot! A sweet and creamy twist of grape, lime, orange, and strawberry bust out of this brekky baddie for a delicious punch of fruit in every puff! We've infused our premium whole flower with exquisite THCa diamonds, wrapped it all up in a golden robe of kief, and a blast of terps to sweeten the deal. Follow the smoke to your new favourite wake and bake buddy!

variants.title: TKO
variants.body_html: Sitka Legends are stoked to roll out TKO, a heavyweight indica-dominant cultivar that's built to impress. Born from the powerhouse lineage of Triangle Kush x OG Kush x Gelato 41, TKO delivers a knockout combination of classic kush gas and creamy dessert sweetness. Expect bold notes of earthy pine and fuel layered with smooth gelato creaminess and a subtle hint of citrus zest, creating a flavor profile that's both nostalgic and indulgent. Every batch of TKO is grown with precision, featuring dense, frosty buds that are hand-trimmed, hang-dried, and given a patient three-week cure to maximize terpene depth and potency.

variants.title: Purple Cow Tipper Budski
variants.body_html: Purple Cow Tipper serves up sweet grape, gassy diesel, and a touch of old-school spice. Terpenes include myrcene, limonene, and linalool.

variants.title: Northern Lights
variants.body_html: Northern Lights from Jonny Chronic is a potent sun grown indica dominant strain that produces dense green buds with a thick frosting of trichomes. Northern Lights is a landrace lineage crossing an Afghani x Thai cultivar and is dominant in caryophyllene, limonene, myrcene and bisabolol. Cultivated in southwestern Ontario under the sun, all of our plants are hang dried and cured before our team goes through and carefully selects top colas to then be hand trimmed and hand packed in-house.

variants.title: Pure Live Rosin Bar Disposable Vape
variants.body_html:
The INVADER Pure Live Rosin Bar delivers the potency and purity of a live rosin dab in a sleek, portable form, combining advanced hardware with 100% solventless live rosin. Made without distillates, added terpenes, or other additives, this product provides a pure live rosin experience in a convenient, all-in-one vape.

With cutting-edge CCELL Rosin Bar technology, this device features THC and terpene-partitioned atomization and a dual-chamber design to ensure maximum flavour and effects. It also prevents common issues like clogging and leaks, resulting in a smooth, flavourful vaping experience.

The fresh frozen inputs are curated specifically for the Pure Live Rosin Bar and processed by Crop Circle Cannabis using 100% solventless ice-water extraction and a low-temperature press process, delivering a true craft live rosin experience.

variants.title: Charged
variants.body_html: We've amped up our flower game to bring you a bigger bag of electrifying sativa nugs than ever before! Charge up your toke to 100% with Charged Sativa, a rotating assortment of plump, premium, indoor-grown sativa flower nugs in a whopping 14g pouch that'll hit you WAY harder than it hits your wallet. Grown fully indoors in precision-controlled laboratory conditions, every single cannabis plant is tended to with the utmost care, thoughtfully hung to dry, hand trimmed and cured for the best possible user experience, no matter what strain is in the mix, or which nug you pull from the bag. Every batch contains a different blend of revolving tantalizing indica strains for a surprising assortment of punchy flavours at consistently high THC levels. Charged Sativa is always a bolt of lightning to the senses, but without the sticker shock of other large-format flower bags.

variants.title: Chef's Kiss
variants.body_html: From the brand that brought you Fun Trip, it's time to experience the Chef's Kiss. A limited edition variety boxed set of four milled flower jars packed with precisely curated, small batch handcrafted BC whole flower grown by the Avant/BLKMKT team. Coarsely ground and housed in glass jars with perforated tops to allow you to create your own custom blends by sprinkling from each jar directly into your papers. A little of this, a little of that. Yes, chef!

variants.title: 20:10 Full Spectrum Oil
variants.body_html: Abide 20:10 Full Spectrum Oil is a full spectrum THC dominant 2:1 THC:CBD oil. Each ml of oil contains 20mg of THC and 10mg of CBD infused in sunflower oil. The oil is packaged in a 30ml amber glass recyclable bottle containing 600mg of THC and 300 mg of CBD, packaged within a cardboard box with an accompanying syringe for accurate dosing.

variants.title: Grape Gotti #12
variants.body_html: Grape Gotti is a rare and potent indica dominant strain known for its strong grape, gas and sweet cream flavour. Our in-house phenohunt of the Biscotti x Grape Pie genetics led to this one-of-a-kind expression that we named after the twelfth seedling. The buds are dense with a beautiful mix of green and purple hues, almost hidden underneath a thick layer of glistening trichomes. Expect a delicious berry dry pull, potent gas on the exhale, white ash and juicy resin rings. Craft designated and hand packed in compostable jars.

variants.title: The Collective Infused PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: The Collective Infused is a strain-specific bubble has infused pre-roll. Rotational.

variants.title: Sunrise To Sunset Dual Chamber Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Meet the Sunrise to Sunset Dual Chamber vape with minor cannabinoids! Enjoy the zesty citrus burst from Tangerine Sunrise (CBG), and rich berry flavour from Razzberry Bliss (CBN).

variants.title: CBG Infused OG Haze PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Abide's CBG Infused OG Haze Pre-Rolls are a CBG kief infused high THC sativa (OG Haze) pre-roll. CBG Infused OG Haze pre-rolls are made with eco-consciously sungrown OG Haze infused and sungrown CBG kief. All pre-rolls are wrapped in unbleached hemp cones and packaged in an eco-friendly recyclable cardboard box.

variants.title: Key Lime Slice Liquid Diamond Infused PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Experience flavour and potency with our Key Lime Slice Liquid Diamond infused pre-roll. This hybrid, rooted in the renowned GSC lineage, contains liquid diamonds for a rich and full spectrum product. The sweet and tangy lime flavour and creamy aroma are perfectly preserved, while the infusion enhances the strain’s terpene profile.

variants.title: Crab Cakes Premium
variants.body_html: For those seeking an on-the-go premium milled flower. Crab Cakes by SKOSHA is a potent sativa dominant cross of Snow Lotus x GSC which is cured, milled, and packaged to perfection. This product offers a creamy flavour profile you expect from a classic GSC with newer strain crossing , along with bright notes of fruit and berries. This milled flower is non-irradiated and double sealed to ensure a smooth SKOSHA experience. The leading terpenes include myrcene, limonene, caryophyllene and humulene.

variants.title: Blue Dream Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: A vibrant choice that oozes sweet and berry flavour is here to make your dreams come true. Blue Dreams is high-potency THC cannabis extract in a smooth, full-favoured vape. If you're looking for a no-nonsense vaping experience, it doesn't get any better than this. Pure cannabis, cured then extracted with C02, purified into distillate and combined with plant-derived terpenes for pure and clean cannabis flavour. Just the good stuff. Compatible with 510 thread devices. Device not included.

variants.title: Blueberry Fuego Shatter
variants.body_html: What type of berry this strain smells like is widely debated but blueberry and blackberries come to mind first. Every waft of Blueberry Fuego feels like you are getting slapped in the face with a blueberry muffin and our Shatter is no different. Consumers can expect a very smooth blueberry notes at first with a strong gassy and blackberry aftertaste. This phenotype was selected by the Next Friday team because of its heavy blueberry dessert terpenes. The strain was bred by Seed Junky Genetics crossing the infamous Slurricane with Symbiotic Genetics Wedding Crasher.
