variants.title: Black Cherry Pie
variants.brand: The Original Fraser Valley Weed Co.
tags: The Original Fraser Valley Weed Co.
variants.body_html: A half ounce of sweet Black Cherry Pie. This loud and sugary indica is a cross of powerhouse parents Cherry Pie x Blackberry Kush. It smells like a slice of cherry pie, with a hint of tart berries and earth. Its dense, sticky grape-shaped buds are dark green with flecks of purple, frosted with sugary trichomes. Expertly grown in BC's Fraser Valley.

variants.title: Blackberry Lemonade Live Rosin
variants.body_html: Smyle x Dabble collab is back with Blackberry Lemonade, featuring real BC blackberries and fresh lemon juice. A sweet-tart flavour profile balances ripe blackberry notes with bright citrus acidity. Natural cane sugar enhances the fruit-forward character without overpowering the authentic berry essence. This strain specific live rosin beverage is made with Dabbles signature, Dabbleberry, an indica-dominant cultivar known for its overwhelming aroma of key lime, with more subtle notes of rosemary and blueberry.

variants.title: Strawberry Jam Live Rosin Gummies
variants.body_html: Tasting just like Nana's jam, Dabble's Strawberry Jam live rosin is now found in a large format of delicious live rosin gummies. Ten packs of 10mg gummies are made with real strawberry puree and a slightly sour pucker dust. Free from artificial colours and flavours, and vegan and gluten-free.

variants.title: Strawberry Watermelon Live Rosin THC Gummies
variants.body_html: Vegan gummies made with full spectrum live rosin from organic flower. Bursting with sweet strawberry and refreshing watermelon flavours that pair with complimentary single strain live rosin creating a perfect combination. Now in a larger 10 pack!

variants.title: Pink Lemonade Live Rosin THC Gummies
variants.body_html: Great-tasting vegan gummies made with full-spectrum live rosin from organic flower. Enjoy a fun and fruity pink lemonade flavor, perfectly paired with complementary single-strain live rosin, packaged in a large 10-pack!

variants.title: Live Hash Rosin (Mexicola)
variants.body_html: Mexicola is a brand-new hash rosin, crafted in-house by head grower Ross Butcher through a cross of Shishkaberry and Forbidden Fruit. This strain is a fruity delight, with tropical and creamy aromas and flavours that dance across your palate. Mexicola is named in memory of Matthew Kirk, a beloved BC cannabis industry comrade gone too soon.

variants.title: Arctic Heat Muscle Cream
variants.body_html: Enjoy the same powerful, fast-absorbing formula as our full-size Arctic Heat Muscle Cream, now in a more convenient 20g size. This compact version is ideal for on-the-go use or as an introduction to the Arctic Heat experience. Featuring their signature dual-cooling and warming sensation. It’s a convenient way to explore the Arctic Heat experience in a smaller size.

variants.title: Devil's Lettuce PR 1 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Devil’s Lettuce is an indica-dominant pre-roll made exclusively with whole flower. Produced on Stó:lō traditional territory, weaving Indigenous values with craft cultivation methods. Terpenes include caryophyllene, limonene, and pinene.

variants.title: Blue Zushi PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Blue Zushi 10x0.5g pre-rolls are packed with expertly milled whole flower and hand-finished with a Dutch crown. This Zkittlez and Kush Mintz cross delivers bold gassy aromatics with sweet tropical undertones, offering a smooth, full-bodied smoking experience in a convenient multi-pack.

variants.title: THC+CBD+CBG Rose Quartz Crystal Pink Lemonade Gummies
variants.body_html: Shaped like rose quartz and bursting with pink lemonade flavour, these crystal gummies are a little ritual in every bite. Each piece blends 10mg of THC, CBD, and CBG for a layered experience that’s anything but ordinary. 10 gummies per pack. Plant-made, made without sugar.

variants.title: Purple Truffle PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Purple Truffle profiles a sweet and sour citrusy lemon flavour with hints of spicy black pepper. Purple Truffle buds are long with olive green and deep purple undertones. Grown using LSO (living soil organic) and all organic inputs. Natural predator IPM (integrated pest management) is used to keep pests away. The buds are hang dried, hand trimmed, cured 21 days and never irradiated.

variants.title: Kush Mints PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Kush Mints is a potent indica-dominant strain bred from Animal Mints x Bubba Kush. Known for its dense, frosty buds, Kush Mints delivers a rich, sweet aroma with notes of doughy vanilla, subtle mint, and a hit of classic gas. This strain brings together bold flavour and strong effects in a true west coast classic.

variants.title: BC Organic Lemolada
variants.body_html: Enjoy a taste of summer, with BC Organic Lemolada. With sweet citrusy notes, and some tropical vibes, prepare for an inviting sensory experience. A unique cross of Lemonade Rntz x Taco Colada, her robust aromas translate exceptionally well to the flavour profile which will surely leave you wanting more. Grown in our organic living soil, hand tended, and never irradiated, her pristine buds come packed in our premium glass jars for optimal freshness.

variants.title: Formula 55 Blue Jolt Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Meet the bold berry flavour of Formula 55: Blue Jolt by Terra Labs. This 3x0.5g infused pre-roll pack features premium indoor-grown flower, power-packed live resin diamonds, and carefully selected botanical terpenes. Every puff delivers smooth, sweet blueberry notes with earthy undertones. Always testing above 55% THC, these half-gram rolls hit hard and taste even better. Formula 55 offers a reliable, fruit-forward experience that doesn’t hold back. Crafted for the connoisseur, built for impact—this isn’t your average pre-roll.

variants.title: Platinum Rainbow's PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Introducing, Platinum Rainbow's Pre-rolls. This strain produces high-THC with a unique terpene content. Cultivated and processed by an indigenous and family run, craft cannabis facility located in Summerland, BC. This product contains three half-gram pre-rolls made from small, whole-flower nugs. Platinum Rainbow's delivers a rainbow, platinum finish and is indica-dominant. Coming from the lineage of Pure Michigan x Runtz, the aroma of this product is aromatic gas with fruity hints and has a tasteful tube appeal. Available for a limited-time-only.

variants.title: 95+ Creemore Royale Liquid Diamonds Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: The Creemore Royale Liquid Diamonds 510 is potent and very smooth with an earthy and spicy profile.

variants.title: Peach x Melon Dual Chamber Liquid Diamonds Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: A warm front of sun ripened peach collides with cool melon currents, triggering a slow building, flavour saturated front.

variants.title: BC Selects: Pineapple Marker 143
variants.body_html: BC Selects is a new offering from Broken Coast that deepens our commitment to offering the very best; an exclusive and limited first release of new Broken Coast strains to the recreational market. These strains are chosen by Master Grower Kevin from hundreds of in-house phenotypes, as the best-in-class genetics showcasing Broken Coast’s commitment to cannabis excellence; cola quality buds, rich trichomes, bold terps & unmistakable Broken Coast quality. Non-irradiated, these lots allow BC consumers to experience these strains in their purest state. BC Selects’ second release is Pineapple Marker, the 143rd phenotype of a Pineapple Marker genetic origin. This sativa-dominant strain delivers a tropical and sweet flavour with a citrus finish, and is high in cis-nerolidol, alpha-thujone, and beta-caryophyllene.

variants.title: Country Club Craft PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Woody Nelson's Country Club is a series of limited releases featuring some of our favourite growers and genetics. Selection is based on an internal 31-point scoring system with an emphasis on production practices, morphology, experience, and lab results. Each reusable doob tube comes with slim cone pre-rolls made with natural hemp paper.

variants.title: Pineapple Bang PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Pineapple Bang is a hybrid strain with tropical pineapple and cherry gas flavours, bred by crossing Pineapple Fruz x Wild Cherry by Seed Junky Genetics.

variants.title: Turbo Diesel
variants.body_html: Turbo Diesel is a sativa leaning hybrid born from Sour Diesel and Sour Kush, delivering bold, unmistakable aromas. It hits with pungent petrol up front, rounded out by a hint of citrus and a deep, earthy finish. Grown on Canada’s 42nd parallel, South Point is for those who appreciate the details. We take the long way. Our flower is hang dried, slow cured and hand packed. No gimmicks. No shortcuts. Just great cannabis, straight to the point.

variants.title: Blueberry Ice Live Resin 1:1 CBD All-In-One Vape
variants.body_html: Experience a mouthwatering fusion of sweet tropical fruits layered with bursts of sugary blueberry. Every inhale delivers juicy, ripe berry flavor, followed by a refreshing icy exhale that awakens your senses. Perfect for anyone craving a fruity vape with a crisp, frosty edge. Crafted in-house using premium British Columbia flower, each vape is produced through a proprietary hydrocarbon extraction process for unmatched purity and potency and paired with blueberry botanical terpenes. This cutting-edge all-in-one 2g vape combines 1:1 Live Resin and CBD, delivering a perfectly balanced experience. Built with next-generation hardware, the device is postless, discreet, and pocket-sized with full oil visibility through its innovative 360 design. A wide mouth opening ensures optimal airflow, while the USB-C rechargeable battery keeps it going strong right down to the very last drop.

variants.title: Platinum Pop Rocks
variants.body_html: Enjoy BC craft Day Dreamin’ CBD Flower proudly cultivated by Grown Here Farms. This superior strain, is a 70-30% indica-dominant. With dominant terpenes of bisabolol, myrcene, guaiol, caryophyllene and nerolidol, flavours of hops, cinnamon, chamomile and an earthy sweet floral/citrus finish. Craft grown, hand harvest, hang dry, never irradiated, grown with love, for you.

variants.title: Arctic Ice PR 4 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Chill out with Doobie Snacks Arctic Ice, a flavour packed pre-roll that delivers a frosty burst of cool mint in every puff. These terpene infused pre-rolls blend icy menthol and herbal notes with a hint of citrus zest. These pre-rolls offer a consistent and flavourful burn in a portable format. Rolled to perfection and infused with care.

variants.title: Strawberry OG Whipped Live Resin
variants.body_html: Indulge in a premium concentrate with Whipped Live Resin Strawberry OG, a boutique cannabis extract crafted for the discerning connoisseur. With a robust terpene profile, this whipped concentrate delivers a full-spectrum, rich, true-to-strain flavour. The consistency is light and creamy—similar to live rosin—making it easy to work with whether you're dabbing or topping your flower. This strain’s genetics bring a sweet, berry-forward aroma with earthy diesel undertones that fans of classic OGs will appreciate.

variants.title: Green Congo
variants.body_html: Experience the wild allure of Green Congo. This extraordinary sativa-dominant strain has its origins deeply rooted in Africa, merging the potent lineage of Congolese and Bangi-Haze genetics. Adorned with mesmerizing mint-coloured buds and fiery orange hairs, Congo is a high terpene creation, loaded with pine and funky cream combined with a cool minty finish. All the cannabis flower from High Quadz has been carefully curated by an experienced sourcing team, working closely with micro-cultivators and craft growers to bring the best craft flower to the top quality connoisseurs.

variants.title: BC Organic Lemon Loopz
variants.body_html: Hailing from Gastown Genetics, this carefully selected phenotype is a marriage of Lemon Candy Fuel x Animal Mints. The aromas lead with tangy citrus notes, followed by gassy and sweet undertones. This exclusive genetic is grown in organic living soil and follows a rigorous post-harvest treatment with a long hang dry, hand trim, and cold cure. Flavour chasers will find what they're looking for, with these trichome covered nugs packed safely in our premium glass jars.

variants.title: THC-V: THC Orange Creams'cle Live Rosin Gummies
variants.body_html: Orange Creams'cle Live Rosin Gummies by 1964 have landed! These nostalgic treats combine the vibrant flavors of this summer treat with the uplifting potency of THCV and premium live rosin. Each gummy is thoughtfully paired with M’mosa Live Rosin, crafted to deliver a bold, fruity taste. Vegan and gluten-free, these gummies are the perfect choice for those looking to add a spark to their edibles journey.

variants.title: Dragon Fruit Creamsicle Gummies
variants.body_html: TROPHY gummies are crafted without compromise. Each large 6g gummy delivers a potent 70mg of CBD, totaling 2100mg per package for unmatched value and consistency. Dive into a swirl of exotic dragon fruit and creamy vanilla bliss. This vibrant, naturally pink treat balances the delicate sweetness of ripe dragon fruit with the nostalgic comfort of a classic creamsicle—smooth, refreshing, and subtly tangy. It’s sunshine in gummy form. These gummies are made with cannabis ingredients sourced from British Columbia and crafted using all-natural ingredients. They are vegan, gluten-free, sulphite-free, and enhanced with cannabis terpenes.

variants.title: Blue Razzleberry 3:1 CBG/THC Gummies
variants.body_html: Canada's favourite gummy is now in a grab 'n go bag. 10 individual tubes each with 5 best-selling Blue Razzleberry Pearls in a 3:1 CBG/THC ratio. Each sugar-coated soft chew has 6mg of CBG and 2mg of THC. These Pearls are bursting with bright blueberries, raspberries, and lemons.

variants.title: Rockstar Smalls
variants.body_html: Same legendary Rockstar—now in a limited run of SMALLS. These compact buds pack the same resin-rich pungency, and gassy, oily flavour—just in a smaller size. A BC classic, Rockstar is a cross of Sensi Star and Rockbud with an unmistakable gassy profile tinged with earth, pine, and skunk. Pistol and Paris products are grown with care, attention, and intention. All crops are hang-dried, cold-cured, and hand trimmed to preserve quality. Every step is carefully done by hand to honour each unique cultivar and showcase its fullest expression.

variants.title: Pineapple Garlic Live Rosin
variants.body_html: Made from organic sun-grown flowers, and processed using only ice, water and gentle heat (pressed from trichomes in 73–159μ range), this live rosin blends tropical sweetness of pineapples with funky undertones of garlic and gas.

variants.title: Where's My Bike
variants.body_html: Where’s My Bike is a high-THC sativa-dominant strain born from the bold cross of Amnesia and Biker Kush. This standout strain delivers a punch of fruity, spicy, and earthy aromas. Now available in a generous 28g format—because good times shouldn’t be limited.

variants.title: BC Organic Bling Blaow
variants.body_html: Two standout phenotypes appear in this cross: deep purple buds with Gastro Pop vibes and bright green selections so frosty they look almost white. Expect layered fruit and sweet candy aromas with a hint of nail polish. Buds form steep, triangular shapes — an unmistakable look. Easily one of the most visually striking and memorable cultivars in Coast Mountain’s lineup. Certified Organic by Pro-Cert. Grown in organic living soil without the use of artificial pesticides and fertilizers. Hang-dried, hand-trimmed, and hand-packaged into reusable, recyclable glass jars.

variants.title: Hazy Mint THC Chocolates
variants.body_html: A convenient multi-pack of 5 Hazy Mint THC Organic Dark Chocolate medallions featuring fair trade organic dark chocolate infused with pure THC and a cool minty taste. Made by two cancer-surviving sisters in beautiful BC.

variants.title: Mmmosa Evo 14g Dried Flower
variants.body_html: Introducing CALI's Mmmosa EVO: The Epitome of Exquisite Cannabis. Experience the pinnacle of cannabis craftsmanship with CALI's Mmmosa EVO, an exceptional strain born from the perfect union of Purple Punch and Clementine. This unique hybrid has been carefully cultivated to deliver an unparalleled sensory journey, offering you the finest in the world of cannabis. Mmmosa EVO is a true testament to the art of cannabis cultivation. Each 14g package is filled with meticulously cultivated, indoor-grown, hand-trimmed flowers, showcasing the dedication to excellence that defines the CALI brand. Unlock the vibrant flavor profile of Mmmosa EVO. This exceptional strain combines the sweet, fruity notes of Clementine with the earthy, grape undertones of Purple Punch. The result is a harmonious blend of tastes that dance across your palate with every inhale and exhale. Our commitment to quality is unwavering. Mmmosa EVO is nurtured with precision, grown indoors under optimal conditions, and hang-dried to perfection. This careful process ensures that every bud is a work of art, delivering consistent, top-tier quality that you can trust. CALI's Mmmosa EVO is not just a cannabis strain; it's an experience. Whether you're a seasoned connoisseur or new to the world of cannabis, our commitment to excellence guarantees an unforgettable journey into the realm of relaxation, inspiration, and pure delight. Indulge in the extraordinary with Mmmosa EVO. Elevate your senses, savor the flavor, and embrace the CALI difference. This is cannabis reimagined, and it's yours to explore. Unleash the power of Mmmosa EVO and discover why CALI is the name synonymous with premium quality, handcrafted cannabis. It's time to elevate your cannabis experience.

variants.title: PAX Flow Dry Herb Vaporizer – Onyx
variants.body_html:
Meet the PAX Flow, a sleek, high-performance vaporizer built for pure flavour and effortless sessions. With enhanced airflow, fast charging, and precise heat control, it’s designed to deliver smooth, powerful draws wherever you go.

Key Features & Benefits

Enhanced Airflow: Redesigned airpath delivers stronger, smoother draws and fuller flavour.

Hybrid Heating: Combines conduction and convection for even, efficient vaporization.

Smart Heat Modes: Five preset settings let you switch between flavour-rich hits and dense clouds with ease.

Quick & Simple Cleaning: Removable oven door and fully accessible airpath make maintenance effortless.

Rapid USB-C Charging: Reaches a full charge in under 40 minutes so you’re always ready for the next session.

Compact, durable, and beautifully designed, the PAX Flow makes every session smooth, consistent, and satisfying.

variants.title: Pufferz Pineapple Coconut Liquid Diamonds Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Puff, puff, don’t pass on this all-in-one vape that’s designed to delight your senses and deliver bigger, and more potent hits thanks to our liquid diamonds infusion. We’ve dialled up the flavour and the design so that each time you sesh, you’re puffing in style. You don’t need to speak French to know this vape is the ‘crème de la crème.’ Grab a sweet, creamy treat that you can’t resist with the Spinach PUFFERZ™ Pineapple Crème all-in-one vape. Inspired by a strain with a LA Kush CK and Coco Milk lineage, enjoy hints of vanilla, citrus and a whipped-up potency at 98.1% THC.

variants.title: Flyers Frosted Lemon Cherry G Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Lemon Cherry G is a hybrid dripping in lemon zest and juicy cherry flavour — THCa diamond frosted, terpene enhanced, and made from, full bud flower infused with liquid diamonds. Each Frosted Flyer is highly potent and packed with nonstop flavour. Don’t be afraid to take down this bad boy as it hits like a fruit bomb with a gas flavoured kick.

variants.title: Banjo Berry Live Rosin Strawberry Lemonade
variants.body_html: Banjo x Cotton Candy Live Rosin takes this strawberry lemonade to the next level. This tangy, sweet strain pairs perfectly with real strawberry juice and lemon, making it one of the tastiest, most potent treats ever!

variants.title: Bubble Up Supernova Live Resin Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Pushing the envelope, that's what we're known for. Like saying grown-up things around grandma. If she hears you, you getting those dirty words washed out your mouth. Bubble Up by Tribal (Zoap x Deluxe, Breeder Exotic Genetix) is one of the most unique strains that we've brought to market. Bubble up leaves your mouth with an effervescent sensation, a cleanliness that grandma would be proud of. Extra sticky flowers and a fresh, clean scent. Bubble up is ready to scrub in. Tribal's SuperNova disposable vape delivers ceramic hardware and a USB-C rechargeable battery. Now with built-in LEDs that light up with the genetic colour, a preheat mode, three heat setting modes (1.8/2.1/2.3v) and a low visibility (no light) stealth mode.

variants.title: BC Green CRK Live Whipped Diamonds
variants.body_html:
BC Green CRK Live Whipped Diamonds is a premium concentrate crafted with high-purity THCa diamonds,
whipped into a smooth terpene sauce featuring the classic, citrus-forward Green Crack strain. This sativa
powerhouse brings an energizing burst of bright lime and tropical fruit aromas-enhanced with botanical
terpenes to amplify the fresh, zesty experience. With a creamy, easy-to-handle whipped texture, it's perfect for
dabbing or vaporizing. Produced in small batches, this top-shelf extract reflects Dab Bods' commitment to bold
flavour, precision extraction, and a clean, euphoric high that hits like a jolt of sunshine.

variants.title: Slurriboof
variants.body_html: SlurriBoof, a novel and potent indica dominant hybrid cultivar, selectively bred in-house by crossing SuperBoof and Slurricane, is one you can't miss trying. Known for its rich terpene profile with highlights of fruit, citrus and pungent flavors. Bright green buds, beautiful orange hairs and coated in a heavy layer of trichomes excite the senses for what is to come. Packaged in a child resistant, see through pouch. Ask your budtenders to take a look!

variants.title: BC Organic Luv Affair
variants.body_html: An exclusive offering from Odyssey Genetics, our BC Organic Luv Affair brings an irresistible blend of fruity, skunky and gassy notes. Her dense and frosty buds will fill the room with bold aromas, that translate perfectly to the flavours. Grown in our organic living soil, hand tended, and never irradiated, we hand pack each jar ensuring only the best buds make the cut.

variants.title: Banjo
variants.body_html:
Banjo is a sativa-leaning hybrid crafted from a cross of the classic cultivars Boost and Tangelo. Its terpene-rich profile-led by myrcene, limonene, and caryophyllene-delivers bright citrus and subtle berry notes, finished with a smooth, incense-like undertone.
Each hand-manicured bud is carefully cured to preserve premium flavour and potency. With a clean, balanced profile and expressive terpene depth, Banjo reflects a small-batch, craft-first approach.

variants.title: La Bomba
variants.body_html: La Bomba is a standout Broken Coast genetic, crossing Jet Fuel Gelato x Wedding Cake. This balanced 50/50 hybrid boasts a potent THC, delivering a dynamic profile of minty, earthy, sweet, and gassy flavours. La Bomba offers a nuanced entourage effect with a focused, relaxing, and subtly exciting experience. Crafted with Broken Coast's signature cultivation practices, La Bomba is a new expression of premium cannabis grown in small batches, hang dried, hand trimmed, and slow cured to preserve terpene richness and potency. It's bold, balanced, and built for those who appreciate something different.

variants.title: Cherry Chatter PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Sitka Legends introduces Cherry Chatter grown by Quadessence, a chill yet social sativa, born from the perfect pairing of Chatterbox and Cherry Cheesecake. This smooth cultivar slaps hard with sweet cherry notes layered with creamy cheesecake and a touch of earthy citrus. Expect an uplifting, relaxing buzz that's perfect for unwinding or chatting it up with your homies. Quadessence hang dries and slow cures for 3 weeks, ensuring that every batch offers a smooth craft experience.

variants.title: Royal Sherb PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html:
Royal Sherb from the Jolly boys is a luxurious indica dominant cross between Wedding Cake Bx1 and King Sherb V4, a dessert lover's dream. Its flavor profile is rich with notes of buttery cake batter and dough, perfectly complemented by sweet cake and sherbet-like aromas that fill the air with decadence.

The dense, frosty nugs are adorned with hues of deep green and lavender, intertwined with bright orange pistils and a shimmering layer of trichomes that glisten like frost in the morning light. Each bud is carefully hand-trimmed and hang-dried, then given a patient three-week cure to enhance its signature characteristics. True to the Jolly Boys’ commitment to quality, Royal Sherb is crafted using only full flower inputs—fit for those who appreciate the finer things.

variants.title: Banjo
variants.body_html: Banjo is a sativa-leaning hybrid crafted from a cross of the classic cultivars Boost and Tangelo. Its terpene-rich profile—led by myrcene, limonene, and caryophyllene—delivers bright citrus and subtle berry notes, finished with a smooth, incense-like undertone. Each hand-manicured bud is carefully cured to preserve premium flavour and potency. With a clean, balanced profile and expressive terpene depth, Banjo reflects a small-batch, craft-first approach.

variants.title: Sativa
variants.body_html: Crooked Dory 10g Sativa Dry Flower was built on the following principles: to bring the best possible experience to the consumer. Always expectational quality and always new sought after strains. Our Sativa dry flower offering will be filled with several different strains providing the consumer with a change in flavour from time to time but quality will never change!

variants.title: Valiant Sprinkle Tip Glass Dab Tool - Assorted
variants.body_html: The Valiant Sprinkle Tip Glass Dab Tool makes handling concentrates simple, precise, and enjoyable. Crafted from heat-resistant glass, it offers control and accuracy while staying durable and easy to clean. Its compact size and thoughtfully designed top add a touch of fun to every session. Key Features & Benefits Glass construction: Heat‑resistant borosilicate for durability and easy cleaning Unique top design: Fun, eye-catching spinkles add personality to your setup Slim handle: Comfortable grip for smooth, controlled use Portable size: Compact tool that’s easy to carry or store Pointed Tip: Easy to move material in place and reduces waste A reliable choice for users who want a clean, functional, and playful tool for working with concentrates.

variants.title: Yocan UNI Pro-Digital Box Mod-Red
variants.body_html: The Yocan Uni Pro is a compact, adjustable box mod designed for 510-thread cartridges. Built to fit nearly any cart, it offers precise voltage control so you can fine-tune flavour, smoothness, or intensity to match your preference. A reliable step up from standard pen-style batteries. Key Features & Benefits Universal compatibility: Adjustable height and diameter fit most 510-thread cartridges Variable voltage control: 2.0V to 4.2V range allows customized vapor and flavour output Preheat function: 10-second preheat helps warm thicker oils for smoother pulls OLED display: Clearly shows voltage, battery life, and settings Rechargeable battery: 650mAh capacity supports consistent daily use Magnetic adapter: Secure snap-in connection for quick cartridge swaps Protective design: Box-style body helps shield cartridges while staying pocket friendly A solid choice for users who want more control without sacrificing simplicity.

variants.title: Arctic Ice PR 4 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Chill out with Doobie Snacks Arctic Ice, a flavour packed pre-roll that delivers a frosty burst of cool mint in every puff. These terpene infused pre-rolls blend icy menthol and herbal notes with a hint of citrus zest. These pre-rolls offer a consistent and flavourful burn in a portable format. Rolled to perfection and infused with care.

variants.title: Frosted Lemons PR 4 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Lemons. Lemons. Lemons! That's what your nose will be yelling down the hall to the brain. But don’t be fooled, this is not the citrus companion you’ll be squeezing over dinner or slicing into a drink. The dense bright green buds are frosted in a lush coat of trichomes and that lemon stench seeps into everything it touches. You’ve been warned.

variants.title: Grindz - Pineapple Gelato
variants.body_html: Whether rolling up a cone or scooping into a bowl, Spinach Grindz™ Pineapple Gelato is a tropical treat with delicious flavours, undeniable aromas, and high potency. From the first whiff to the final puff, taste tangy pineapple goodness, aromas of the juiciest mango and a spritz in the air of citrus.

variants.title: Lit OG PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: LIT OG (The Soap x Velvet Rntz) from LIT Farms is one of their best crosses ever. A potent sativa strain that packs a punch in flavour of gas and funk. Dense, tightly packed buds are cloaked in a layer of frosty trichomes that shimmer in the sun. Deep shades of green interwoven with fiery orange hairs hint at the strain's strength. It is properly cured and trimmed. Our pre-rolls are made with nothing but trimmed whole flower for a consistent experience every time.

variants.title: Lemon Gelato
variants.body_html: Lemon Gelato is a citrus creation bred from Thin Mint GSC, Lemon Haze and Sunset Sherbet, delivering a zesty twist on the gelato family. This hybrid is the definition smooth potency, with bold aromas of lemon zest, sweet cream and a gassy undertone. The bag appeal is undeniable, with dense lime green buds dusted in frosty trichomes. Every batch is hang dried, slow cured and hand packed to lock in its terpene-rich profile and silky smoke, brought to you with love from Scarborough.

variants.title: Zero Boot Rear
variants.body_html: Since 1996, a small team of beverage enthusiasts have dedicated themselves to bringing you the best beverages possible and we’re not stopping anytime soon! Now, our mission at M*ry Jones is to keep bringing you the cannabis-infused flavours that you love, without any cannabis aftertaste. We’re now introducing Zero Boot Rear made without sugar!

variants.title: Pink Rhino
variants.body_html: Pink Rhino is a cross of the popular Pink Kush and old school legend White Rhino. Our growers have brought together two iconic parents to deliver a new candy-like kush that’s got it all: potency, dense sticky buds, sweet aromas of sugary honey and classic kush notes of earth and gas from dominant terpenes linalool, myrcene, limonene​. The plant produces cake-y light green buds that are naturally super tight and thickly coated in sugar from top to bottom.

variants.title: Flavour Bomb 40 Fruit Blast Diamond Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Introducing the Nugz Flavour Bomb Infused Pre-Roll Taster Pack. Five nostalgic, flavour forward, diamond infused pre-rolls packed into one collection. Each pre-roll is meticulously crafted with indoor grown flower, never irradiated, infused and coated with THCA diamonds to deliver an intense, high THC and full flavour experience.

variants.title: Emerald Cut Diamonds
variants.body_html: Emerald Diamonds delivers high THC. Extracted from Emerald OG, these terpene-rich crystals deliver sweet and creamy flavours with gassy undertones and a clean, potent finish.

variants.title: Sour Blueberry Liquid Diamonds Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Lord Jones® curates cannabis experiences at the highest level to truly go above and beyond with each product. With our Lord Jones® Liquid Diamonds x Live Resin vape, we knew that one extract would not be sufficient in delivery on that promise. Liquid Diamonds deliver on potency, reaching 99.2%, but our Live Resin delivers on a full-spectrum experience with the preservation of terpenes, flavonoids, and that added premium experience with each puff. The Sour Blueberry strain is no diamond in the rough. This vape was born out of a desire to bring the highest quality cannabis to those that seek to go above and beyond with each session for premium experiences. This is a fruity, yet sour strain that shines bright with the first fresh puff. As these notes linger on the tongue, they open up and become a potent gassy flavour that exhilarate each exhale.

variants.title: Peanut Butter Balanced Chocolate
variants.body_html: Dive mouth-first into the richness of creamy peanut butter and velvety Belgian milk chocolate with Peanut Butter Balanced Chocolate. This multipack features four squares, each crafted with smooth Belgian chocolate and creamy peanut butter filling with 10 mg of THC and 10 mg of CBD per square.

variants.title: Tropicanna Tangie
variants.body_html: Tropicanna Tangie from Big Bag o’ Buds is a sativa-leaning cultivar that boasts sweet clementine flavour. Perfect for those who want a citrusy terpene profile that reeks of nostalgia and a smooth sesh full of tangy-tasting pulls.

variants.title: Jungle Fumes Premium Glass Tip PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Stop and smell the Jungle Fumes. These dense jungle coloured buds are packed with diesel and chem flavours. The parent strains of Sour Diesel x Chemdawg x Lemon OG create a sativa that comes with a heavy diesel aroma upfront, chem undertones and notes of tropical fruits. FIGR pre-rolls are expertly rolled with a paper filter and conical shape for a smooth and consistent smoke.

variants.title: FAT MAC Redees PR 10 x 0.4 g
variants.body_html: Fat Mac is a potent indica pre-roll made from the new core Redecan genetic, a Pavé x Miracle Alien Cookies cross. Each pre-roll in our convenient Redees pack delivers high THC with rich baked goods and gassy flavours. Machine rolled for consistency and convenience, these pre-rolls use lightweight paper and a paper mouthpiece for a smooth, clean smoke. Grown and processed with Redecan’s signature care, Fat Mac brings flavour and potency wherever you go.

variants.title: Blue Lemonade Liquid Diamond Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Light, zesty lemonade, with sweet, smooth blueberries. Trippy Sips’ popular, mouth watering Blue Lemonade is now available in our portable all-in-one vape!

variants.title: GMO (Garlic Mushroom Onion) Cookies PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Don't let the name deceive you. GMO (Garlic, Mushroom, Onion) Cookies has an unmistakably sweet and savoury taste and is one of the most popular indica strains out there. You can't make a soup out of it, but it sure goes nicely in a bowl.

variants.title: Island Pink PR 7 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Sweet vanilla notes complemented by fresh floral and earthy flavour profiles describes Island Pink by 1Spliff. Buds are trichome coated with loud pink hairs and delivers high THC levels. Hand-harvested, hang-dried, cured for 21 days and hand-manicured. Pre-rolls are produced directly from the buds of the dried flower - ensuring no stems, no sticks, and no shake - just pure compact dried flower.

variants.title: CPY Mega Pack CBD Hybrid 100 caps - Tweed
variants.body_html: Tweed Mega Pack, featuring 100 softgels with 50mg CBD each.

variants.title: TIL Gems 10:0 Softgels Hybrid 100 caps - Redecan
variants.body_html: More is more with 100 packs of THC Gems. With 10mg of full spectrum THC in each softgel, that’s 1,000mg of full spectrum THC per pack. Nice. They’re easy to consume, and consistently dosed. The full spectrum blended cannabis oil is derived from a Co2 extraction process and mixed with a responsibly sourced MCT oil for effects you can depend on.

variants.title: Green Congo PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Experience the wild allure of Green Congo. This extraordinary sativa -dominant strain has its origin rooted in Africa, merging the potent lineage of Congolese and Bangi-Haze genetics. Adorned with mesmerizing mint-coloured buds and fiery orange hairs. Congo is a high terpene creation, loaded with pine and a funky cream combined with a cool minty finish.

variants.title: Sour Cherry Bliss 1:1:1 CBC/CBG/THC Gummies
variants.body_html: Pearls Sour Cherry Bliss combines a melody of CBC, CBG and THC in a 1:1:1 ratio. Each sugar-coated soft chew has 2mg of CBC, 2mg of CBG and 2mg of THC. Pearls are bursting with cherry flavour with a hint of citrus, coated in sugar for a sweet treat. Five soft chews per pack.

variants.title: Zen Oil
variants.body_html: Earthwolf Farm’s cannabis oils capture the “live” essence of the cannabis plant by infusing live bubble hash directly into organic carrier oils and decarboxylating using a unique TERP reactor technology. The result is an edible oil with a flavour true to the flower it came from. Made with cold pressed organic coconut oil and organic extra virgin olive oil, Zen Oil is an indica-dominant blend with 1:4 ratio of organic coconut oil to olive oil, and ice water hash.

variants.title: Stinky Pinky FSE Cured Resin Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Meet Stinky Pinky—the newest classic legacy cultivar 510 cart from 1964. This take on the legendary Pink Kush is a perfect representation of a West Coast Kush: 100% heavy hitting cured resin, stinking of sweet, kushy gas.

variants.title: Strawberry Ice Diamonds Vape  Cartridge
variants.body_html: Embrace the unexpected with Kolab Project’s Strawberry Ice Diamonds 510 cartridge, combining state-of-the-art technology with convenient design. Crafted with liquid diamonds, botanical terpenes, and flavouring agents, this cartridge offers a powerful punch of 95% THC and exotic notes of sweet strawberry and a hint of earthy mint. Made in Kolab Project’s premium hardware and paired with a black metal mouthpiece that’s smooth to the touch.

variants.title: Organic Triangle Queen
variants.body_html: Every once in a while there’s a cut that impresses without calling too much attention to itself. Triangle Queen by Relentless Genetics is that sort of cultivar. Refined. Demure. Almost regal. Its dense, chunky flowers — gorgeous and otherworldly when freshly harvested and somewhat understated when dry — are caked in trichomes that befit a true queen. As with all craft flower from Sweetgrass, Triangle Queen is living soil grown, certified organic, and 100% hand-tended all the way from clone to package. Leaning in, she has a phenomenally complex aroma that emanates notes of tropical fruit and subdued sour off the top with muted rubber and earthy forest floor rounding out the bottom. Flavour-wise, it’s orangey citrus on the dry pull with an initial musky cherry on the first hit once sparked. The thick smoke is majestic with tropical sweetness, sour gas and a dash of soap mingling throughout. The exhale is a citrus orange perfume with just a hint of marzipan. If you love a heavy indica-leaning cut with then this one might just grant your wish. Triangle Queen, your Highness indeed. Available for a limited-time-only.

variants.title: Zelectrolytes Smalls
variants.body_html: Zelectrolytes flips the switch with a sativa-dominant spark straight out of Orange-Ade and The Original Z. This cut looks like it’s been plugged into neon, showing off deep green and purple colouring wrapped in a glittering coat of trichomes. It bursts with grape and berry sweetness, balanced by earthy notes that keep it grounded; typical of true exotics. Packed into a 3.5g bag under the BC Smalls banner, Zelectrolytes brings flavour, juice, and sweet vibes.

variants.title: The Sour Blue One Live Rosin THC Gummy
variants.body_html: No Future is levelling up with live rosin in The Sour Blue One — packs our most popular flavour with extra bold, sour flavour and a single-dose potency. Why live rosin? Because we like our extracts the way we like our life choices — unrefined, but authentic. One gummy, 10 mg THC, all gas, no brakes. Think you know berries? Think again. This sour, blue gummy flips the script with a tangy kick you won’t forget.

variants.title: Seasonal Exotics Pack Live Rosin
variants.body_html: Dedicated to delivering live rosin drops that express delightfully unique sweet, tropical, and exotic terpene profiles. This series will feature different terpene and cannabinoid profiles, each showcasing the plant’s remarkable ability to express a different taste and aroma in a solventless format. Every batch of live rosin is crafted with premium fresh-frozen cannabis flower and strictly solventless extraction techniques. Every drop is an exclusive release—grab yours before they're gone.

variants.title: Tiger Blood Liquid Diamond Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Welcome to the wild side! Tiger Blood Liquid Diamond vapes roar with 95%+ THC and a blend of strawberry, watermelon, and coconut. This isn’t a stroll through the park — it’s a full-on flavour jungle. Loaded with liquid diamonds! G.A. 1g USB-C Rechargeable All-In-One Vapes takes our signature botanical terpene-infused distillate and adds liquid diamonds to deliver our most potent line up yet. Go Higher than ever before with 95%+ THC and the G.A. flavours you love.

variants.title: The Sour Blue One Live Rosin Gummies
variants.body_html: This limited edition doesn’t just hit—it detonates. No Future 10x The Madness delivers 10 individual packets of The Sour Blue One — Live Rosin, with a total of 100mg THC. Saliva-inducing, sour, bold, blue, and tangy—these gummies are a flavour explosion.

variants.title: Big Red Sativa PR 20 x 0.5 g
variants.brand: The Original Fraser Valley Weed Co.
tags: The Original Fraser Valley Weed Co.
variants.body_html: Big Red joints from The Original Fraser Valley Weed Co. are always 20% THC or higher. These classic cone-style joints are filled with a half-gram of a revolving selection of quality sativa-dominant BC whole bud. Expertly ground then rolled in all-natural paper, finished with a twist, and available in a bulk size offering of 20 joints per pack. Greenhouse-grown in abundance in BC’s finest growing region, the Fraser Valley.

variants.title: Snow Globe
variants.body_html: Snow Globe is a slow-motion swirl of trichomes and gas, built for those who like their cannabis icy, dense, and dialed in. This indica-dominant cross of Snowman and Chem Dawg delivers frosted-over buds packed with diesel funk, earthy undertones, and a crisp finish that cools on the exhale. Available in a full 28g format for those who appreciate plentiful amounts of frosty, top-shelf flower. Available for a limited-time-only.

variants.title: Watermelon Mojo Zktlz
variants.body_html: Tenzo presents The Greatest—a blast from the past and the number one strain fans asked to revive. Relive mouth-watering goodness with the infamous Watermelon Mojo ZKTLZ (Watermelon Zkittlez x Tahoe Hydro OG). Same cut, same bold, fruity and sweet tropical mango nose and flavour. This indica is extremely rich in terpenes and so aromatic, you'll think it was infused. Hand-packed in one of Canada's first transparent jars to showcase craft flower that is always small batch, grown indoors and hang-dried, trimmed and packaged at facilities in Okanagan, B.C. Available for a limited-time-only.

variants.title: Super Stoner Selection
variants.body_html: At Stoned, we understand that cannabis is a living, breathing, and evolving plant, each flower possessing its own unique character. Introducing Interstellar Selections, our curated collection that honors this diversity by hunting for the finest strains grown in small batches. Designed for the discerning cannabis connoisseur and those seeking something fresh from a brand they trust, Interstellar Selections brings an element of wonder and novelty to the market. Our dedication to quality and innovation ensures that each strain in this collection is pheno-hunted and award-winning, offering a premium experience that stands out. With Interstellar Selections, Stoned aims to elevate your cannabis journey, delivering new and exceptional strains that captivate and satisfy.

variants.title: Animal Sherbs Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Animal Sherbs liquid diamond vape cartridges. Now extracted from strain specific flower, combined with a quality 510 cartridge to bring consumers the flavour they have come to expect with Fuego.

variants.title: Sleeping Tiger Smalls
variants.body_html: Sleeping Tiger is like entering the calm eye of a storm. This indica-dominant cross of Biscotti and The Menthol is powerful beneath the surface, beginning with an earthy spice flow, then shifting to sweet dough and a cooling mint finish. Dense and resin-packed, Sleeping Tiger’s nugs display a dark green canvas carpeted with sparkling trichomes that speak to its strength and quality. Like its namesake, it exudes an aura of hidden power and myth, remaining regal and untamed.

variants.title: Quantum Kush PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Step into the unknown with Quantum Kush, an indica-dominant pre-roll. Packed with potent, terp-rich flower, expect smooth pulls and cosmic flavour from these pre-rolls. Far Out Crops — the truth is out there… and it smokes.

variants.title: Turbo Diesel
variants.body_html: Turbo Diesel is a sativa leaning hybrid born from Sour Diesel and Sour Kush, delivering bold, unmistakable aromas. It hits with pungent petrol up front, rounded out by a hint of citrus and a deep, earthy finish. Grown on Canada’s 42nd parallel, South Point is for those who appreciate the details. We take the long way. Our flower is hang dried, slow cured and hand packed. No gimmicks. No shortcuts. Just great cannabis, straight to the point.

variants.title: HNY HoneyStick Lil Ripper
variants.body_html: Meet the HoneyStick Lil Ripper E-Rig, a cutting-edge portable electric rig vaporizer designed for both wax and dry herb enthusiasts. Combining convenience, power, and style, this pocket-sized powerhouse offers an effortless vaping experience with its coilless quartz wax atomizer and non-contact coil dry herb chamber. Whether you're into dabs or flower, the Lil Ripper ensures smooth, flavorful hits every time.

variants.title: Sherbet Queen Live Whipped Diamonds
variants.body_html:
Sherbet Queen Live Whipped Diamonds is a top-tier concentrate featuring high-purity THCa diamonds folded

into a rich, whipped terpene sauce crafted from the flavour-packed Sherbet Queen strain. This indica-dominant

hybrid delivers a vibrant aroma of sweet berries, creamy citrus, and subtle earthy undertones-elevated with

botanical terpenes for a full-spectrum, true-to-strain experience. The whipped consistency offers a smooth,

easy-to-use texture that's ideal for dabbing or vaporizing. Produced in small batches, each gram is a decadent

treat-bringing relaxing, euphoric vibes with a burst of sherbet-like flavour that lingers long after the exhale.

variants.title: Wild Rose Reserve
variants.body_html: Meet Wild Rose Reserve—named for the Alberta’s iconic flower and crafted for carefree days and wide-open skies. With a bold mix of spicy, sweet and earthy aromas, this sativa delivers a vibrant, long-lasting effect that energizes your every move. Whether you’re road-tripping through the Rockies, kicking back by the lake, or just catching a breeze on the balcony, Wild Rose Reserve brings the chill with flavour to match. It’s a sunshine state of mind—just rolled up and ready to go.

variants.title: OG Rootbeer
variants.body_html: SHRED's OG Rootbeer is brimming with sweet, spicy, and vanilla aromas, that throw back to a frosted mug of root beer with a kushy twist. This sativa-leaning blend overflows with flavour, bubbling up nostalgic terps and smooth rips. So crack it open, SHRED heads, and take a big gulp from the foamy fountain of OG Rootbeer!

variants.title: Inside Joke PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html:
Bred by Compound Genetics, Inside Joke is a cross of Banana Cream Pop #13 and Jokerz #31 that's all about bold flavor. What made us fall for Inside Joke is its standout nose and taste. You'll catch a punch of hard candy sweetness upfront, followed by a smooth blend of gas and zesty citrus.

Because it's the right thing to do, all our pre-rolls are made exclusively from whole flower, rolled in small batches into slim cones, and hand-packaged in glass tubes with cork tops.

variants.title: Aloha White Widow PR 4 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: This Aloha White Widow phenotype reeks of diesel and skunk and has a rich, earthy taste with intermittent notes of hash.

variants.title: High Potency 95+ Mint Mocha Frap Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Jays presents playful, potent products full of flavour in convenient formats for everyday Canadians. Mint Mocha vapes are worth savouring with a bright aroma of mint, riding on the richness of coffee and cream. These highly potent 510 cartridges are formulated with quality cannabis extract, captured in state-of-the-art custom designed 510 hardware from 14th Round.

variants.title: Inside Joke
variants.body_html:
Bred by Compound Genetics, Inside Joke is a cross of Banana Cream Pop #13 and Jokerz #31 that's all about bold flavor. Crack open the pouch and you'll find dense, purple, and bright green nugs absolutely caked in frost. What made us fall for Inside Joke is its standout nose and taste. You'll catch a punch of hard candy sweetness upfront, followed by a smooth blend of gas and zesty citrus.

Because it's the right thing to do, all of our flower is hang-dried, hand-trimmed, slow cold-cured, and hand-packaged. We keep it fresh and terpy by sealing it up in nitrogen-flushed pouches with a humidity pack inside. And yeah-non-irradiated, obviously.

variants.title: Fruity Pbblz Liquid Diamond Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Fruity Pbblz Liquid Diamond AIO offers a rainbow of vibrant fruit flavours balanced with creamy, milky smoothness. This all-in-one device captures the essence of your favourite breakfast bowl, delivering rich fruity notes that melt into a velvety finish. Crafted with liquid diamonds for high potency and flavour, this convenient AIO provides reliable performance and exceptional taste throughout. Come to Papa.

variants.title: BlueBberry Se Gual
variants.body_html: Color's Blueberry Seagal whole flower is an indica-dominant hybrid with very high THC potency potential, hand-selected by Color’s brilliant phenotype hunters. This cultivar has light green buds with light orange hues throughout, hitting the nose with crisp notes of berry and pepper from the dominant terpenes beta-caryophyllene and nerolidol. Our elevated growing practices, including full temperature and humidity control and hang-drying, guarantee a consistent and enjoyable smoking experience.

variants.title: Chemdawg 60+ Double Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Chemdawg 60+ is a double-infused pre-roll featuring a bold, diesel-forward aroma with subtle citrus undertones. Made with high-quality flower and diamond concentrate, this pre-roll offers a distinctive flavour profile.

variants.title: Purple Punch PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Purple Punch is the sweet union of two indica dominant classics. It's a delicious dessert strain with aromas of grape candy, blueberry muffins and tart fruit punch.

variants.title: No. 24 True Hybrid Resin Sour Cherry
variants.body_html: Glenn’s No. 24 Sour Cherry delivers a deep cherry flavour cut with a sharp sour edge. Infused with hybrid full-spectrum resin, these gummies capture a broader range of cannabinoids and terpenes for a true-to-plant expression. Built with Glenn’s signature handcrafted process and backed by one of Canada’s leading edible producers, Sour Cherry blends bold flavour with reliable dosing for a gummy that hits the mark every time.

variants.title: Aloha White Widow PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: This Aloha White Widow phenotype reeks of diesel and skunk and has a rich, earthy taste with intermittent notes of hash.

variants.title: Space JMZ
variants.body_html: Blast off with Live Rosin Space JMZ, Astrolab’s rotational premium live rosin jam. Made expertly without solvents, Space JMZ delivers a terp-rich experience with THC levels ranging from 78–85%. Each drop is a limited-edition strain selection, carefully curated for seasoned explorers seeking bold flavour and potency. Crafted for connoisseurs.

variants.title: No.18 Distillate Delta 9 Sour Blue Raspberry
variants.body_html: Glenn’s No. 18 Sour Blue Raspberry takes the same classic Glenn’s soft chew and turns up the sour. A sharp and tangy bite meets smooth blue raspberry sweetness in every piece. Infused with delta-9 THC distillate, each soft chew delivers consistent potency you can count on. Handcrafted by one of Canada’s leading soft chew producers, Sour Glenn’s are built bold, potent and made the way soft chews were meant to be.

variants.title: GoodNight - 1000 CBN + 1000 THC Softgels
variants.body_html: Emprise’s GoodNight 1,000 mg CBN + 1,000 mg THC softgels each contain 10 mg of CBN and 10 mg of THC. The product is formulated with full spectrum THC cannabis extract and hemp seed carrier oil, which supports the entourage effect. Terpenes include myrcene, beta-caryophyllene and Linalool.

variants.title: Grape Pie
variants.body_html: This one doesn’t come with a crust nor does it need to be forked to death to be enjoyed. Grape Pie comes in loud and proud. Heavy on the ripe grape and sugary aromas these tight, round purple-tinted buds will fill any room with a delightful scent. What’s the trichome situation? Absolutely caked. These things are mega frosty. Bold and built for reruns, Grape Pie turns whatever time into prime time. And yes, your grinder will never smell the same again.

variants.title: High Noon Reserve Live Resin
variants.body_html:
High Noon Reserve Sativa Live Resin Badder is a premium, small-batch extract crafted from 100% fresh

frozen cannabis to preserve the full spectrum of terpenes and cannabinoids. Expertly extracted using

hydrocarbon methods, this live resin badder delivers bold aroma, vibrant colour, and a smooth, creamy texture

that's easy to dab and rich in flavour. Each rotating sativa strain is carefully selected for its bright, uplifting

terpene profile-whether it leans citrusy, fruity, or gassy with sparkle. Designed for those who chase clarity,

creativity, and a true-to-plant experience, High Noon Reserve brings high energy to your concentrate lineup.

variants.title: Frosted Rootbeer
variants.body_html: Boasting one of the most delicious aromas to ever bubble out of a Big Bag, Frosted Rootbeer provides a unique sensory journey for flower lovers. High potency paired with sweet vanilla, spice and fruit deliver a sativa-leaning experience with bite.

variants.title: Shatter Bar
variants.body_html: Next Friday Shatter Bar - Born from the underground, the Shatter Bar by Next Friday brings back the black market edge with every bite. This potent infused chocolate bar is loaded with rich, decadent flavor and powered by high-grade shatter concentrate for a hard-hitting experience. No gimmicks-just legacy roots and serious strength. Welcome to the new era of edibles.

variants.title: Montreal-Style Aged Hash
variants.body_html: Experience the popular Montreal-style Aged hash, meticulously crafted to deliver an authentic flavour and texture. Ideal for rolling into joints or sprinkling atop your bowl. Aged over three months. Carve it into a snake or crumble it.

variants.title: Blueberry Zlshie Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Papa's Blueberry Zlshie is a hybrid cross of Blue Sherbet, Blue Cookies and Sunset Sherbet in a 510 vape cart. It tastes like blue raspberry with earthy undertones. The aroma is fruity and sweet.

variants.title: Slurricane Jar Live Rosin
variants.body_html: Extracted using only ice and water, retaining more terpenes and cannabinoids. Slurricane is a cross between Do-Si-Dos and Purple Punch. Its flavour profile is spicy, citrusy, and peppery.

variants.title: Sour Gush Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Mini Packs – Sour Gush is an indica dominant AIO vape made from Triangle Kush x Gelato #41, delivering bold sour-sweet hits, big clouds, and smooth pulls with premium oil and terp-rich flavour.

variants.title: Banjo
variants.body_html: Banjo is a sativa-leaning hybrid crafted from a cross of the classic cultivars Boost and Tangelo. Its terpene-rich profile—led by myrcene, limonene, and caryophyllene—delivers bright citrus and subtle berry notes, finished with a smooth, incense-like undertone. Each hand-manicured bud is carefully cured to preserve premium flavour and potency. With a clean, balanced profile and expressive terpene depth, Banjo reflects a small-batch, craft-first approach.

variants.title: Cherry Cola Gummies
variants.body_html: This multipack contains 10 immediate containers, each with one soft chew for a total of 10 soft chews. SHRED'ems Cherry Cola Party Pack has 10 packs of MAX10 gummies, each with 10mg THC for a total 100MG THC PER PACK! These indica gummies are bubbling with the perfect mouth-watering combo of sweet cherry and classic cola flavours. To cap it all off these soda all-stars are vegan-friendly and made with all-natural flavours.

variants.title: Sour Raspberry Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Experience the electrifying fusion of bold raspberry with a sour kick in every puff. These new palm-style devices are loaded with features for user controllability to enhance your experience. Features like, variable voltage and 10 second pre-heat. Made with liquid diamonds.

variants.title: Sunrise Smash Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Introducing Litti's Sunrise Smash 510 thread cartridge THC vape, with the fusion of sweet strawberry and tropical mango flavours. This vape cartridge is compatible with 510 thread batteries for convenient use.

variants.title: CBG Heat Wave
variants.body_html: Elevate your beverage experience with our THC + CBG Infused Strawberry Lemonade. This harmonious blend combines the natural sweetness of sun-ripened strawberries with the zesty kick of lemons, creating a fresh elixir that transcends ordinary beverages.

variants.title: Crooklyn Diesel Diamonds
variants.body_html: Whether you're looking to add some sparkle to your smoke session or simply want to indulge in the best that concentrates have to offer, Crooklyn Diesel THCA Diamonds are the perfect choice. The gassy flavour profile is bold and intense, offering a true taste of diesel with every hit.

variants.title: The Hive Live Rosin
variants.body_html: The Hive: Honey Banana x Papaya bred by Bloom Seed Co. is a sativa-dominant, stable, wet, golden-yellow and white hash oil. Produced through solventless extraction using the HashTek system, this concentrate is crafted entirely in-house at Brindle Farms through single-source cultivation and extraction. The flavour profile is dominated by papaya, ripe fruit, and sweet honey, with tart banana back-end that delivers for a strong lingering full-bodied flavour. Available for a limited-time-only.

variants.title: Cherry Watermelon Infused PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Slide into bold flavour! Cherry Watermelon packs 38%+ THC and a rush of juicy cherry and watermelon. It’s all splash — sweet, fruity, and built for the fast lane. Made with milled whole flower, infused with our signature triple-distilled distillate, dusted in premium kief, and boosted with botanical terpenes — these infused pre-rolls deliver smooth hits, high THC potency, and the BIG, BOLD flavour you expect from G.A.!

variants.title: Midnight Sherb PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Midnight Sherb isn’t here to play it safe. Smooth vanilla, sharp citrus and deep, earthy grit come together in a sativa dominant profile. No gimmicks and no shortcuts.

variants.title: Flight Pack Craft Variety Pack PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Flight Pack is a rotating sampler of pre-rolls from craft growers. Every pack includes 3 x 0.5g pre-rolls with 3 unique genetics. The pre-rolls are rolled with natural hemp papers and packaged in a reusable tube. Made in Nelson, BC.

variants.title: Citrus Punch
variants.body_html: Punchy’s delivers big flavour and even bigger value. This citrus punch is lightly carbonated, bursting with orange, tangerine, lemon and lime flavours. Made with all-natural flavours and colours, it’s a fresh, no-nonsense way to enjoy a punch that hits just right. 10mg of THC.

variants.title: Raspberry Ginger Ale Live Resin Gummies
variants.body_html: Premium, rapid onset, live resin, high-quality BIGGIES. This multi-pack of six single gummies feature, THE BIG ONE’S, which are 8g oversized gummies with a total of 10mg THC (live resin), 30mg CBG, 30mg CBD per individual gummy equaling a total of 60mg of THC, 180mg CBG, and 180mg CBD per master container utilizing their Ice Cream Cake x Gelato #33 strain. This flavour profile features a refreshing, crisp, and clean taste of ginger ale paired with a delicious twist of raspberry lemonade. The gummies are manufactured in-house using cannabis ingredients from British Columbia and are made with all-natural ingredients. Vegan, gluten-free, sulphite-free, and cannabis-terpene enhanced.

variants.title: Pure Distillate Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Glacial Gold’s Pure Distillate—a premium vape cartridge crafted for true connoisseurs. Made with only high-purity THC distillate and zero added flavouring, this formulation delivers a smooth, potent, and unadulterated draw. Refined using Nextleaf Labs’ award-winning extraction process, Pure Distillate offers a neutral aroma, minimal taste, and consistent potency, perfect for those who prefer purity over additives.

variants.title: Wtf Slimsicles Infused PR 2 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: From the brand that brought you that three-gram monstrosity, welcome to WTF #2two straight cut slims packed with 50% sativa dominant and 50% indica dominant handcrafted BC-grown whole flower. Infused with diamonds and distillate, and coated with kief from hybrid and strain specific whole flower. This watermelon tropical flavoured flower is packed in straight cut slims and housed in our custom glass tube.

variants.title: Cadillac Rainbow PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Cadillac Rainbow is an indica-dominant cultivar born from the crossing of Pure Michigan and Runtz genetics. On the nose, expect a bold gas-forward aroma lifted by notes of lemon, sweet cherry, and herbs. All Nations’ pre-rolls are hand crafted using only whole flower for that elevated smoking experience. Produced on Stó:lō traditional territory, weaving Indigenous values with craft cultivation methods.

variants.title: Indica PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Sink into something special with Happy Hour Rotating Indica Pre-Rolls, featuring a curated selection of small-batch indica-dominant strains from TWG, a BC micro-cultivator rooted in legacy genetics and decades of experience from grower Rob Warmerdam. Curated for the legal market, each drop highlights a new, potent cultivar starting with the richly flavourful Sunset OG. Strain details clearly listed on the outside of the tin. Crafted using the RollPros Blackbird for precision straight-cut pre-rolls, the flower is grown in coconut coir, hand-trimmed, and cold-cured for two weeks to preserve full terpene expression and deliver a clean, even burn from tip to crutch. These pre-rolls are non-irradiated and always fresh. Housed in a durable, smell-proof push bottom tin, this compact and convenient packaging protects the product from being crushed or broken. Evolved through legacy, crafted by TWG — rotating strains that reflect BC’s finest.

variants.title: Super Lemon Haze Liquid Diamonds Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Super Lemon Haze Liquid Diamonds vape cartridge by Jonny Chronic is sativa-dominant, ultra-pure, and high in THC. Expect zesty, cannabis-forward botanical terpenes with hints of tangy lime and lemon flavours. Compatible with 510-thread batteries. Store upright in a cool environment for optimal performance.

variants.title: Grindz - Blue Razz
variants.body_html: It’s all razzle dazzle with the Spinach Grindz™ Blue Razz milled flower. Break open the bag, take a big whiff, and get the scents of sweet blue razz. Each puff won’t turn your tongue blue, but it will take those tastebuds on a ride through a blueberry field where you can pick the sweetest of the bunch. Then, hit that bowl, or roll it up, and enjoy a potent sesh.

variants.title: Pink Kush PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Pure Sunfarms Pink Kush, rolled and ready. It’s a popular strain for a reason, with consistently high THC and gassy complex aromas of sweet, diesel and a touch of spice. Always packed with BC grown whole flower, no trim and no shake. Rolled with natural paper and finished with a twisted end. A potent pre-roll, packed in a reusable and recyclable tube.

variants.title: Raspberry Twist Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: When life gives you lemons, add some raspberries. Raspberry Twist brings 38%+ THC and fuses sweet berry with zesty lemon. All gas, no pulp — just a smooth experience with every hit. Made with milled whole flower, infused with our signature triple-distilled distillate, dusted in premium kief, and boosted with botanical terpenes — these infused pre-rolls deliver smooth hits, high THC potency, and the BIG, BOLD flavour you expect from G.A.!

variants.title: BC Organic Luv Affair PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: An exclusive Odyssey Genetics cross of Frosted Fruit Cake x Petrol, offering aromas and flavours of ripe fruit, sharp skunky gas, and a creamy exhale. Dense, sculptural buds shimmer under a frosted veil of trichomes, shades of forest and sage green lit with flashes of lime. Fiery orange pistils weave through like sparks. Certified Organic. Grown in BC in living soil. Hang dried, hand trimmed, cold cured, and never irradiated. Hand rolled and hand packed for optimal freshness. Available for a limited-time-only.

variants.title: Stinky Pinky PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Meet Stinky Pinky — the newest classic legacy cultivar from 1964. A fresh take on the legendary Pink Kush, this classic TM FRD cut hails from Vancouver Island. The buds are coated in sugary trichomes and reek of sweet, kushy gas.

variants.title: Pink Rhino PR 5 x 0.5  g
variants.body_html: These pre-rolls are packed with freshly ground Pink Rhino, a cross of everyone's favourite Pink Kush and old school legend White Rhino. This candy-like indica delivers aromas of sweet honey and classic kush notes of earth and gas. Ready to burn in pack of five.

variants.title: Guava Haze PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Guava Haze is a brand new genetic that has come to be by crossing Squirt x Tangie x Humboldt Dream. Super frosty, bright green buds covered with reddish-orange hairs finished with a proper dry and curing process provide the consumer with an enjoyable experience that will have them coming back for more. Bursting with flavors of Guava, Mango and Orange, the look and smell of this sought after genetic excite the senses for what is to come. Our pre-rolls are made with nothing but trimmed whole flower for a consistent and pleasant experience every time.

variants.title: Coffee Creamer PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Inspired by the smoothest part of your morning ritual, Coffee Creamer 3 x 0.5g Pre-Rolls are worth savouring. This Seed Junky genetic is a decadent indica with rich, creamy coffee and vanilla flavours and hits as satisfying as your first sip. This Zkittles x Kush Mints cross pairs old-school depth with dessert-like nuance for an indulgent taste that lingers. Coffee Creamer delivers a bold yet balanced expression of potency and flavour and offers focused and creative vibes. These pre-rolls are packed with cured bud that’s been optimally milled for a smooth, indulgent smoking experience. The flower is grown in laboratory-grade, strain-specific rooms, hang-dried, cold-cured, milled, hand-packaged with care and never irradiated. From first to final exhale, enjoy Coffee Creamer pre-rolls, it’s pure craft excellence you can taste.

variants.title: Big Boy PR 1 x 2 g
variants.body_html: The Big Boy BLNT by BLKMKT is impeccably handcrafted. This fat, ceramic-tipped straight-cut pre-roll is made from all-natural hemp designed to allow for a slow burn while retaining the full flavour. Packed with our whole handcrafted BLK Caviar flower (aka Thanksgiving Dinner), this cross of Ya Hemi BX2 x SFV OG was bred, phenohunted and grown in house in Okanagan, BC. Housed in our custom reusable glass packaging.

variants.title: Pink Rhino PR 10 x 0.35
variants.body_html: These pre-rolls are packed with freshly ground Pink Rhino, a cross of everyone’s favourite Pink Kush and old school legend White Rhino. This candy-like indica delivers aromas of sweet honey and classic kush notes of earth and gas. Ready to burn in pack of ten.

variants.title: Purp'd Out Double Diamond Infused PR 5 x 0.4 g
variants.body_html: Packed with bold grape vibes, this 5-pack of infused pre-rolls is loaded with diamonds and ready to share.

variants.title: OZ Hybrid
variants.body_html: Explore the finest cannabis in a compact package with this product. This collection of small buds is crafted from boutique genetics and grown with care, offering you a premium experience without the premium price. Each batch features rotating hybrid strains, ensuring a fresh and dynamic flavour and effect profile every time you pick up a pack. Hand-trimmed and sustainably cultivated, these smalls are bursting with potent cannabinoids and rich terpenes, delivering big flavour in a small package. It's no biggie — just smalls, made perfect.

variants.title: CttnCndy Grape Liquid Diamond Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: CttnCndy Grape Liquid Diamond AIO. Experience the nostalgic sweetness infused with rich grape flavour. This all-in-one device delivers a smooth experience with every draw, balancing sweetness with bold grape notes. Crafted with liquid diamonds for high potency and flavour, this convenient AIO ensures consistency and flavour. Come to Papa.

variants.title: Apricot Kush Live Rosin Kief Coated Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: These live rosin infused kief-coated pre-rolls blend quality live rosin, delivering a smoothness and flavour. The profile is a mix of creamy vanilla, sweet milk and fruity cereal.

variants.title: Rocket Berry Limeade Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Sweet cherry and strawberry with a tart lime kiss: Rocket Berry Limeade is perfect balance of red berry sweet and citrus green sour. This new flavour blasts off with bigger clouds in our liquid diamond blend, crinkle straw 510 vape carts?

variants.title: Kandy Cake Glass Tip Blunt PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: This Indica-dominant delight merges Triangle Kush x Animal Cookies for a sensory escape like no other! Kandy Cake hits notes of sweet berries, with a gentle sweet undertone coming from prominent terpenes limonene and pinene. These dense buds are sure to satisfy any sweet tooth!

variants.title: Melonballer Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Melonballer is a cannonball of sweet, juicy melon flavours that hit like a bellyflop on a heatwave. It's all poolside vibes: relaxing, sun kissed, and soaked in summer sweetness.

variants.title: Plan't of the Ganja
variants.body_html: The evolution of cannabis has reached a higher dimension. Plan’t of the Ganja is a offering of indoor-grown, small-batch flower from Far Out Crops — cultivated for maximum flavour and potent effects. With dense, trichome-loaded buds and a pungent, otherworldly aroma, rotating small-batch craft strains will deliver a smoke that’s smooth, tasty, and just a little wild. Inspired by a world where the plants rise up and take over — Plan’t of the Ganja is proof that nature, when grown right, always wins. Cold-cured. Hand-trimmed. Never irradiated. Far Out, always. Far Out Crops.........truth is out there...it's in your stash jar.

variants.title: Kush God PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: A potent indica, rolled and ready. Each pre-roll is packed with Kush God, a powerful indica cross of Pink Kush x Pineapple God featuring notes of tropical fruit, grape and dairy from dominant terpenes myrcene, limonene and humulene. BC grown whole flower with no trim and no shake. Made with natural paper, each pre-roll is finished with a twisted end and packed in a recyclable carton.

variants.title: Purple Cherry Punch Hash
variants.body_html: Presenting Purple Cherry Punch Bag O’ Hash! Kief is slow-roasted for 12 hours, combined with ice water extracted bubble hash, and compressed into a dense 2g brick through modern pressing techniques to deliver traditional hashish in a compact form. Highly malleable but flakey when broken open, add this perfume-y and pungent indica to your roll or bowl for a punch of sweet, grape, and berry aromas.

variants.title: Spritzer
variants.body_html: Spritzer (Rntz x Grape Pie x MAC) by VOLO, bred by Capulator, delivers a bold and complex flavour that’s as tasty as it is potent, blending sweet grape candy with creamy funk and a punch of gassy diesel. The result is a rich, deeply layered smoke. Spritzer's buds are dense and frosty, showcasing deep green and purple hues beneath a heavy coat of trichomes. Our small batch flower undergoes a meticulous process, including hang drying, precision hand trimming, slow cold curing and hand packaging to preserve terpene integrity and to maximize flavour and smoothness. Whether you're drawn in by its candy-like sweetness or its potent fuel-forward finish, Spritzer doesn’t just meet expectations, it exceeds them, offering standout flavour, serious potency and undeniable bag appeal. Dive into this rich blend of potent genetics and sophisticated flavours.

variants.title: Kush Cookies
variants.body_html: You'll whisper its name in reverential tones after this bud passes your lips - 'Kush Cookies'. Potent, terpene-rich, with dense and sticky buds, Kush Cookies is a rare lineage of GMO Cookies and OZ Kush that delivers highly aromatic notes of savoury herbs and spicy earth, with undertones of citrus and musk. 3Saints Kush Cookies has an average terpene percentage at an astounding 4.4 per cent (varies by lot). The dominant terps are caryophyllene, limonene and linolool, grown righteously in the sun in a hybrid greenhouse, rain watered, hand harvested, hang dried and expertly cured. All this delivers high flavour, high Potency and high terpenes. What's not to revere? Go on, whisper the name again 'Kush Cookies'.

variants.title: Organic Electric Skunk PR 1 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Electric Skunk is a potent sativa, organically cultivated in BC. True to its name, it hits with a sharp skunky punch, layered with bright herbal depth. Each bud is hang dried and slow-cured for a minimum of 4 weeks to lock in potency and a complex flavour profile.
