variants.title: Green Congo PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Experience the wild allure of Green Congo. This etraordinary Sativa dominant strain has it's origins deeply rooted in Africa ,merging the potent lineage of Congolese X Bangi Haze genetics . Adorned with mesmerizing mint-coloured buds and fiery orange hairs, Congo is a high terpene creation , loaded with pine and funky cream combined with a cool minty finish.

variants.title: Rainbow Driver Cured Resin Fruit Gummies
variants.body_html: Rainbow Driver Fruit Chews feature Woody Nelson's Rainbow Driver, extracted by Wildcard Extracts, and made into soft, fruit chews by Elevate. Each bag includes 10 x 10mg resin-infused chews with notes of citrus and bramble berries. Made in BC.

variants.title: West Coast Cookies PR 1 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: For the first time, the remake is going to be better than the original. Spinach® West Coast Cookies is a new take on a classic strain making for a super flavourful and potent cultivar. A cross between GMO #12 and SFV OG, it has earthy, piney, and citrusy flavours with aromas pumped up from terpenes like myrcene, limonene, and caryophyllene. This powerhouse cross is a flavourful strain, with pumped up potency.

variants.title: Dolce Mia
variants.body_html: Dolce Mia is an indica-dominant cross of Platinum GSC and Punch Breath, delivering rich complexity and serious bag appeal. This cut features dense, crystal-heavy buds with deep purple hues, dark olive greens, and bright orange pistils twisting through every nug. The nose is layered and loud: sweet grape and berry notes upfront, backed by hints of mint, gas, and earthy spice—classic cookie funk meets fruit-forward punch. Each batch is slow cured, hang dried, hand trimmed, and never irradiated, crafted for purity, potency, and top-shelf quality. With love from Scarborough.

variants.title: Trip Northern Lights Live Rosin with Diamonds Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Our live rosin with diamonds all-in-one captures the plant’s fullest expression, using flower frozen at peak harvest and fresh pressed to preserve its natural cannabinoids, terpenes and plant compounds. Each pod is enhanced with potent diamonds, delivering full flower flavour and potency. Featuring Blueberry OG, an indica strain that has tangy, fruity notes of berry that blend with warm hints of cinnamon, creating a flavourful experience.

variants.title: Signature Black Maple Live Rosin
variants.body_html: Signature Live Rosin, Frosted Fruit Cake, 73µ-159µ. This is a limited small-batch drop showcasing an exceptional cut of Fruity Pebbles OG x Wedding Cake. Selected specifically for its bold, heavy OG gas terpenes paired perfectly with a delightful, sweet fruity finish, this standout cultivar is dialled in for connoisseurs who appreciate deep flavour. Crafted with Sauce Rosin Labs' renowned consistency, it stays deliciously terpene-rich and beautifully wet — dab after dab. Available exclusively for a short time — while supplies last!

variants.title: Great White Shark PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Great White Shark is an iconic Indica-dominant hybrid with a lineage that combines the skunky character of Super Skunk with the exotic influence of Brazilian Sativa and South Indian Indica. The flavour profile leans earthy and pungent with notes of citrus and subtle sweetness, while the aroma carries that unmistakable skunk essence. This classic cultivar is presented in a 3-pack of jays that burn clean and even, delivering a smooth and reliable smoke that is simple, grounded, and true to its heritage.

variants.title: Georgia Pie Flower
variants.body_html: Freshly baked. Georgia Pie is cross of Gellati x Kush Mintz that offers frosty olive green and purple buds. Hits of fresh berries in a nutty doughy crust, all the flavour with no oven required. Say goodbye to overpriced mediocrity. Qwest’s high THC flower is crafted in small batches and hang-dried to keep its natural flavours and potency. Consistent craft quality without the sticker shock. More Dank. Less Bank. The truth is in the bag.

variants.title: Blue Thai #2 PR 1 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: All you need is blue skies and some Blue Thai. Spinach® Blue Thai is our ode to everything awesome about dried flower. Our take on this cultivar is a straight sativa strain with an undeniable, blast off level of potency from the first puff. We’re also highlighting the classic fruity, skunky, and citrusy flavours and aromas that come from a puckering lineage of Sour Blueberry x Lemon Thai through a trio of familiar yet harmonious terpenes — limonene, caryophyllene, and humulene. So, the next time you pop this in a bowl or roll a pre-roll, get ready to say, ‘My, oh my, that’s some good Blue Thai’.

variants.title: Birthday Bath Bomb
variants.body_html: Bursting with nostalgic vanilla cake aroma and skin-loving ingredients, the Birthday Bath Bomb is the ultimate celebration — whether you're treating yourself or gifting to someone special. As this ultra moisturizing bath bomb fizzes and dissolves in the tub, a birthday surprise awaits, making every soak feel like a moment worth unwrapping. Happy birthday to YOU!

variants.title: Trip Blueberry OG Live Rosin with Diamonds Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Our live rosin with diamonds all-in-one captures the plant’s fullest expression, using flower frozen at peak harvest and fresh pressed to preserve its natural cannabinoids, terpenes and plant compounds. Each pod is enhanced with potent diamonds, delivering full flower flavour and potency. Featuring the legendary Northern Lights, a classic indica strain known for its sweet and earthy aroma and flavour. Enjoy a rich and flavourful experience that honours the heritage of this iconic strain while delivering high purity and strength.

variants.title: Peppermint Kush PR 1 x 2 g
variants.body_html: Peppermint Kush is an indica-dominant pre-roll crossed with Stella Blue and Nepal Kush. This strain packs a super heavy menthol aroma with hints of fresh earth. The flavour is just as potent, with a sweet woody overtone accented by spicy black pepper. The flower is milled and rolled into lightweight paper cones complete with a paper filter. Available for a limited-time-only.

variants.title: Hash Hole Infused PR 1 x 2.25 g
variants.body_html: The Hash Hole by Pistol and Paris is a premium hand-rolled pre-roll that pairs expertly milled whole flower with a centre of potent live rosin for smooth, flavour-rich pulls. Rolled in king-sized Element papers and finished with a Dutch crown, it includes a reusable 12mm glass tip for cool, consistent airflow. Presented in a sleek glass tube, The Hash Hole is ideal for special occasions or a luxurious solo session.

variants.title: Blue Dream PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html:
A timeless cultivar reborn through the lens of modern mastery. Broken Coast's Blue Dream is a new expression of a pre-legalization icon, phenohunted and perfected to deliver the nostalgic effects that made it a legend- with the elevated potencies today's connoisseurs crave.

This sativa-leaning hybrid balances sweet berry and herbal aromas with a smooth, uplifting experience that's both cerebral and soothing. Grown in our signature small-batch, strain-specific rooms, each plant is slowly hang-dried and hand-trimmed to preserve its full terpene profile and nuanced character.

Blue Dream is more than a name-it's a return to roots, refined for the future.

variants.title: GLTO #41 FSE Resin Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Introducing the GLTO 41 All-in-One FSE Resin Vape. This popular treat is now available in a convenient, flavourful, and potent AIO vape made with high quality pure FSE resin.

variants.title: Midnight Sherb
variants.body_html: Midnight Sherb isn't here to play it safe. Smooth vanilla, sharp citrus, and deep, earthy grit come together in a sativa dominant ride built for the ones who don't follow maps, don't wait for daylight, and don't ask for permission. No gimmicks. No shortcuts. Just straight up handcrafted fire for those who ride after dark.

variants.title: Tropical AF Liquid Diamonds Disposable Vape
variants.body_html:
Spinach PUFFERZ isn't just a vape, but a fun, multi-sensory experience stuffed into one puffy device. Puff, Puff, don't pass on this all-in-one vape that's designed to delight your senses and deliver bigger, and more potent hits thanks to our liquid diamonds infusion. We've dialled up the flavour and the design so that each time you sesh, you're puffing in style.

The Spinach PUFFERZ Tropical AF all-in-one vape is a special kind of holy sh*t flavour experience from that first puff to the end of the chamber. Tropical AF takes next level fruity and floral tastes to new heights thanks to the inspiration from a strain with Pink Rozay and White Runtz lineage. This vape isn't just flavourful 'AF,' it's potent 'AF' with a super charge of 98.1% THC in every puff.

variants.title: Lindsay OG
variants.body_html: In this 7g format, Lindsay OG showcases its BC breeding and Ontario lineage through dense, trichome-rich buds and an unmistakable skunky aroma layered with pine, citrus, and earth.

variants.title: Sour Blue Razz Liquid Diamonds Disposable Vape
variants.body_html:
Spinach PUFFERZ isn't just a vape, but a fun, multi-sensory experience stuffed into one puffy device. We've dialled up the flavour and the design so that each time you sesh, you're puffing in style.

Your tastebuds will rejoice as you take a hit of the Spinach PUFFERZ Sour Blue Razz all-in-one vape. Juicy blasts of blue raspberry flavour notes come through on that first hit, making for a memorable and familiar taste experience. Let those fruity flavour notes and aromas fill the air thanks to inspiration by a strain with a Blue CKS and Mendobreath lineage. Sour and fruity flavours plus the pure gas potency at 98.1% THC, equals one awesome puff.

variants.title: Gassers Lemon Cherry G Liquid Diamonds Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Introducing Claybourne Gassers — our latest evolution in high-performance cannabis. Packed with liquid diamonds and dripping with strain-specific terpenes, these palm-style all-in-one vapes hit fast, and stay loud from start to finish. Designed for the experienced consumers, Gassers deliver true Claybourne power in a sleek, portable device. If you're about big clouds, bold terps and real potency, this is your lane.

variants.title: The Collective PR 20 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: The Northern Dub brings the best Northern Canna offers in a large format rotational multi-pack.

variants.title: Highlighters Pink Lemonade Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: BOXHOT PRESENTS: Pink Lemonade, a 1.0 g sativa all-in-one vape featuring a colossal dose of THC, some of the purest cannabis distillate available, and a juicy blend of botanical terps. Drench yourself in classic lemonade flavour with this razzy-citrus cannonball, dripping with enough sweetness to be main squeeze material. All Highlighters are equipped with rechargeable USB-C technology, so they won't run out of juice before you do.

variants.title: 96+ Peach Pony Liquid Diamonds Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Inspired by life in Canada's Wild West with real value and quality cannabis ingredients. Peach Pony is a flavour straight out of the Okanagan's Wild West, blending flavours of fresh peach with liquid diamonds. Capped with a signature cowboy dust cap.

variants.title: Tropical Cream Float 4 Pack
variants.body_html: XMG+'s Tropical Cream Float Multi Pack brings a bold twist to your sip session. Bursting with sunny notes of pineapple, mango, vanilla, and caramel, each 355mL can is infused with 10mg THC, 10mg CBG, and guarana extract. With four cans per pack, it’s a flavour-packed, value-loaded way to experience cannabis.

variants.title: Yocan Iris Concentrate Vape Pen Kit - Purple
variants.body_html:
Meet the Yocan Iris. This sleek, performance-driven concentrate vaporizer is built for clean flavour, precision control, and portable convenience. With a durable aluminum-alloy body, magnetic mouthpiece, and full-colour OLED screen, the Iris delivers refined sessions from flavour-rich draws to dense clouds.

Key Features & Benefits

Precision Voltage Control: Adjustable from 2.5 V to 4.2 V, the Iris lets you fine-tune each session. You can enjoy smooth, flavour-forward hits or thicker vapor production.

Dual Modes: Choose Auto Mode for effortless draws or On-Demand Mode for manual activation and full control.

High-Efficiency QTZ Coil: The advanced quartz QTZ coil heats rapidly and evenly. It maximizes flavour and vapor quality while reducing burnt spots.

Magnetic Mouthpiece & Smart Design: The quick-release magnetic mouthpiece simplifies loading and cleaning. The aluminum alloy chassis is built to travel and last.

900 mAh Battery with Type-C Charging: The long-lasting battery provides extended use. It recharges quickly via USB-C.

Vivid Colour Choices: Available in Obsidian Black, Aurora Purple, Fresh Green, and Ice Blue, allowing you to match your vaporizer to your style.

Compact yet feature-rich, the Yocan Iris transforms your wax or concentrate sessions into refined, reliable experiences. It is ideal for both beginners and seasoned users.

variants.title: Yocan UNI Twist Battery - Red
variants.body_html: The UNI Twist can be adjusted to fit a variety of cart sizes. Its single button interface allows you to power the device on and off and start the heating element. The USB-C charges 20x faster than a basic USB and it can be charged upright to prevent leaks. The UNI Twist also has a hanging hole so you can wear it around your neck.

variants.title: Holiday Variety Pack PR 6 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: The Station House Holiday Pre-roll Six Pack Sampler is the ultimate strain sampler. It's a multi-pack containing six pre-rolls inspired by each of the following festive strains: Northern Lights, Jack Frost, Gingerbread Kush, Milk and Cookies, Sugarplum Fairy and Christmas Tree Cake.

variants.title: Dab Freak - Tsunami Dab Rig 6.5 in
variants.body_html: The Tsunami brings big, flavourful clouds in a compact size. Its reinforced showerhead perc works overtime to smooth out each hit, while the oversized chamber gives it plenty of room to cool before it reaches you. A built-in reclaim catcher keeps your concentrates from going to waste and helps the rig stay cleaner for longer. At just under 7 inches, it’s easy to handle but still delivers full-powered performance.

variants.title: Dab Freak - Firespine Dab Rig 6.7 in
variants.body_html: The Firespine is built for smooth, tasty dabs without any hassle. At just under 7 inches, it packs pro-level function into a compact, easy-to-handle rig. The double sphere perc does the heavy lifting, breaking down each pull for clean, cool hits. A built-in reclaim catcher makes sure nothing goes to waste, while the splash guard keeps your hits crisp and mess-free. It’s efficient, durable, and ready for heavy sessions.

variants.title: Dab Freak - Squall Dab Rig 6.7 in
variants.body_html:
The Squall is all about clean, flavourful dabs with zero fuss. Its multi-hole perc breaks your vapor down into smooth, easy pulls, while the recycler keeps airflow steady and cool. A reclaim catcher locks in extra concentrate and helps cut down on mess, so you can spend more time dabbing and less time cleaning. Compact but powerful, this rig hits like a storm in the best way.
Key Features & Benefits:
Multi-Hole Perc delivers smooth, balanced filtration
Recycler Design keeps airflow steady and vapor cool
Reclaim Catcher saves concentrates and simplifies cleanup
Compact 6.7-Inch Build easy to handle with solid performance
The Squall is a piece you’ll want in the rotation every session. It includes everything you need: quartz banger, carb cap, dab tool, and terp pearls.

variants.title: Dab Freak - Typhoon Dab Rig 6.7 in
variants.body_html: The Typhoon is built for smooth, effortless dabs every time. Its two-chamber system doubles the filtration, cooling your hits for maximum flavour and comfort. The showerhead perc keeps everything flowing clean and smooth, while the built-in reclaim catcher locks in extra concentrate and makes cleanup a breeze. Compact but capable, this rig is ready for sessions of any size.

variants.title: Proxy – Desert
variants.body_html:
The Puffco Proxy is a compact, modular vaporizer that delivers premium concentrate performance with the vibe of an old-school handheld pipe. Designed for simplicity and versatility, it features a single-button interface, fast heat-up time, and four precision heat settings that let you tailor every session. The Proxy’s ceramic bowl ensures smooth, flavour-forward hits, while the removable base makes it easy to clean and even easier to customize with third-party glass or accessories. Small enough to travel anywhere yet stylish enough to show off, the Proxy combines function, flavour, and fun in one effortlessly cool device.

Key Features & Benefits

Four Heat Settings: Gives you full control over vapour density and flavour, letting you dial in the perfect hit.
Ceramic Bowl: Designed for consistent heating and easy cleaning, preserving terp profiles and preventing scorching.
Single-Button Interface: Ultra-simple operation that keeps sessions smooth and intuitive.
Modular Design: Swap out the base for custom glass, accessories, or new looks as your collection grows.
Portable Size: Compact and lightweight, making it easy to carry for at-home or on-the-go sessions.
Fast Heat-Up: Reaches temp quickly so you can start your session without waiting around.
Colour Options: Available in Bloom, Storm, Desert, and Flourish to suit your personal style.

A reliable daily driver or a standout showpiece, the Puffco Proxy is the perfect mix of style, performance, and pure concentrate enjoyment.

variants.title: Neon Lotus PR 14 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Step into the glow with Neon Lotus. This hybrid delivers a heady buzz, followed by full-body relaxation that feels like checking into a luxury resort (minus the drama). A fresh take on an indica-leaning lineage, this strain is popular for its well-balanced and very strong high. Expect pure R&R from this 100% hang-dried, perfectly milled whole flower finished with a Dutch fold for easier lighting and less canoeing. Each bold hit’s tangy fruit, herbal earthiness and diesel funk are sure to leave you glowing. Looking for an experience as vibrant as its name? Neon Lotus brings all the razzle-dazzle, no reservation required.

variants.title: Raspberry Lemonade Diamond Infused PR 1 x 2.5 g
variants.body_html: What if you could take the refreshing brightness of a fresh lemon, roll it through a delightful trail walk along a raspberry patch, and wrap it up in the smell of the forest after rain? Well then you’d have our delicious new Raspberry Lemonade Diamond infused pre-rolls! Our premium whole flower boasting a delicious herbal bouquet has been elevated with sweet raspberry and bright lemon terpenes and infused with exquisite THCa diamonds for a smooth and delicious smoke! Enrobed in a rich coat of golden kief for a fresh and spicy aroma, the only thing better than a walk through the berry patch is taking this little treat along for the ride!

variants.title: Hash Hole Infused PR 1 x 2.25 g
variants.body_html: Available for a limited time only! The Hash Hole by Pistol and Paris, crafted in partnership with Dabble Cannabis Co, blends 1.75g of Perma Fried milled whole flower with 0.5g of Mexicola live rosin for a smooth, flavour-rich smoke. Rolled in king-sized Element rice papers and hand-finished with a Dutch crown, each Hash Hole includes a branded 12mm reusable glass tip for cool, consistent airflow. Packaged in an elegant glass tube and hand-rolled by Keesh himself, this premium pre-roll is ideal. Pistol and Paris products are craft cannabis—grown with care, attention, and intention. All crops are hang-dried, cold-cured, and hand-trimmed to preserve quality. Every step is carefully done by hand to honour each unique cultivar and showcase its fullest expression.

variants.title: Holiday Mixed Pack Diamond Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Available for a Limited Time Only, we invite you to celebrate the season with our Holiday Mixed Pack Diamond Infused Pre-Rolls. This festive set includes three 0.5g pre-rolls: Winter Berry, Mulled Cider, and Spiced Orange. Each pre-roll combines premium flower with potent live resin diamond concentrates and is enriched with natural botanical terpenes for enhanced flavor and aroma. Hand-rolled to perfection, they offer a smooth, even burn and rich, seasonal taste. Enjoy the ultimate holiday trea

variants.title: Real Fruit Sour Cherry Gummies Multipack
variants.body_html: Wyld Sour Cherry indica-dominant THC gummies are made using real fruit, botanical terpenes and natural flavours. Each gummy contains 10mg THC, for a total of 100mg THC per pack. All Wyld gummies are packaged in fully compostable pouches, and our recipes are formulated by food scientists to provide consistent experiences. Each Wyld Sour Cherry Indica Enhanced gummy contains 10mg of THC combined with the terpenes myrcene, linalool, beta-caryophyllene, and terpineol.

variants.title: Real Fruit Peach THC:CBD Gummies Multipack
variants.body_html: Wyld Peach hybrid CBD:THC gummies are a 3:1 product, made using real fruit, botanical terpenes and natural flavours. Each gummy contains 30mg CBD and 10mg THC, for a total of 300mg CBD and 100mg THC per pack. All Wyld gummies are packaged in compostable pouches and provide consistent experiences. Each Wyld Peach Hybrid Enhanced gummy contains 30mg CBD and 10mg THC combined with the terpenes limonene, linalool, alpha-pinene, and beta-pinene.

variants.title: I.C.C. Live Resin
variants.body_html: I.C.C (Ice Cream Cake) is a rare, indica-dominant strain (75% indica / 25% sativa) born from the legendary pairing of Wedding Cake and Gelato #33. True to its name, this decadent strain is as visually stunning as it is to consume, prior to extraction showcasing dense, frosty buds laced with deep purples and rich forest greens.

variants.title: Frosted Flyers Berry Pack Infused PR 8 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Frost Around & Find Out! These super tasty pre-rolls are THCa Diamond Frosted, Terpene Enhanced, and made from premium, full bud flower, infused with liquid diamonds. Each Frosted Flyer is highly potent and packed with nonstop flavour all the way down to the crutch. This variety pack features 4 x 0.35g Blue Dream and 4 x 0.35g Grape Gasolina.

variants.title: Holiday Fruit Punch Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Trippy Sips Holiday Fruit Punch 0.95g 510 vape is the perfect addition to your holiday potluck. This vape cart blends bright orange, sweet sugarplum, and festive cranberry flavours with high-potency THC distillate, then is infused with a liquid diamond blend and botanical terpenes for extra-potent holiday hits. Available for a limited-time-only.

variants.title: Britney's Frozen Limelight
variants.body_html: Britney's Frozen Limelight by Trailblazer is a citrusy sativa-dominant cross of Britney's Frozen Lemons x Limelight #187—OG Organigram genetic bred in-house. This lemon and gas-forward masterpiece is grown in an indoor micro-climate environment in small batches and is always smart-cured, hang-dried, and hand-trimmed. Uncover the extraordinary with Trailblazer. Available for limited-time-only.

variants.title: El Changuito PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: A name inspired by a legendary capuchin monkey, lost to gunfire and immortalized in myth. The famed lineage of El Chapo and Truffle Monkey gives rise to this potent indica-dominant pre-roll packs funky truffle flavour splashed with diesel and cut by a sharp stab of pine. The nose roars with fuel, pine, and funk, clashing with spicy forest notes and finalized with a sharp, fuel-driven punch. Dark frosty nugs gleam like El Changuito’s watchful eyes, a tribute to the legend behind the name. Ground to the perfect consistency and packed into perfect 0.5g cones, this 5-pack honours a legend with every spark.

variants.title: Zeus
variants.body_html: Island Zeus by Magi is premium cannabis grown, trimmed and packaged with care on Salt Spring Island. Cultivated in small batches and grown in a legacy style. Flower is whole plant slow-cured, hand-trimmed, and non-irradiated to ensure preservation of rich terpenes and delicate trichomes. Zeus is an indica-dominant strain with a musky, skunky scent and gives notes of mineral.

variants.title: Tangie Crush Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Foray’s Tangie Crush is a sativa-dominant formulation with an approachable potency bursting with sharp orange and sweet tangerine, followed by a smooth, earthy cannabis finish. Bold, juicy, and tangy—this is citrus with a little crush. Crafted with premium distillate and a blend of flavouring agents housed in a sleek, rechargeable 0.3g pen.

variants.title: Death Bubba PR 10 x 0.4 g
variants.body_html: TRYGG’s Death Bubba is a true indica-dominant classic—deep, and dank. Packed into ten 0.4g pre-rolls, each one hits smooth with that unmistakable skunky kick and earthy finish. This is clean, potent cannabis without the markup. Just the way it should be.

variants.title: Cream Soda 4 Pack
variants.body_html: XMG's Cream Soda Multi Pack is a throwback treat with a modern twist. Enjoy a smooth, nostalgic cream soda flavour amped up for today. Each 355mL can is infused with 10mg of nano-emulsified THC and all-natural flavours for a rich, velvety sip that hits in the right way at just the right time. With four cans per pack, it’s a value-packed way to enjoy cannabis, packed with the potency of the entourage effect.

variants.title: Blueberry THC Gummies

Wyld gummies use sunflower lecithin to improve biovailability and onset time and are made to be thermostable up to 55 degrees C, with a firm texture that doesn't stick to your teeth. Each Wyld Blueberry Hybrid Enhanced gummy contains 10mg THC combined with the terpenes limonene, linalool, alpha-pinene, and beta-pinene for a balanced, euphoric experience.

variants.title: Masterpiece
variants.body_html: EastCann's Masterpiece is a premium cannabis strain crafted from the cross of Cap Junky and Platinum bred by In-House Genetics. Expect dense, sparkling buds with bold notes of gas, fermented fruit, and pepper

variants.title: LSO Collection Blueberry Vendetta
variants.body_html: Blueberry Vendetta, a cross of DJ Short Blueberry and LA Wedding Cake Pop, showcases dense, trichome-rich buds in striking shades of deep purple and blue. Offered in a 3.5g format, it delivers sweet, fruity aromas alongside rich notes of vanilla, cream, and cake batter. Part of the Pistol and Paris LSO Collection, this cultivar is grown in living soil to highlight its full expression of flavor and aroma.

variants.title: Do Si Dos PR 20 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: A premium cannabis experience crafted for the discerning connoisseur. Our pre-rolls stand out because we meticulously select only the finest side colas for our product. We use hand-selected, top-grade buds, ensuring a superior smoking experience. Each pre-roll is packed with the rich, flavourful essence of DO-SI-Dos, promising potency that truly captures the essence of this renowned strain. Our dedication to quality is evident in every puff, delivering an unparalleled smoothness and consistency that discerning consumers will appreciate. Moreover, DO-SI-Dos Pre-Rolls are non-irradiated, preserving the plant's natural integrity and rich cannabinoid profile. This commitment to purity means you can enjoy the full, unaltered effects and flavours of our cannabis, without any compromise in quality. The result is a clean, smooth-burning pre-roll. Indulge in the luxury of DO-SI-Dos Pre-Rolls, where each inhale is a testament to our commitment to excellence and your satisfaction.

variants.title: GMO Zkittles PR 14 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: A lullaby in a loud package. GMO Zktlz doesn’t ask for your attention, it steals it. The nose hits first with sweet overripe berries tangled with deep earth and a blast of diesel-soaked funk. It’s weird. It’s loud. Expect dense resin-rich buds glowing with orange hairs and frosted like a donut.

variants.title: Amped Live Resin Blueberry DNTS Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Redecan's Amped Live Resin Blueberry DNTS 510 Cart combines the full-spectrum flavour and authenticity of live resin with the unmatched potency of high-purity Liquid Diamonds. For a high intensity true-to-strain experience, we've boosted our Legit Live Resin with liquid diamonds to deliver the full Blueberry DNTS experience, amped up. Expect rich berry, sweet, sour flavours, with no fillers or cutting agents. Featuring a medical-grade TrueDraw Ceramic core, the wide-body design is engineered for premium extracts, delivering smooth hits, enhanced airflow, and clog-free draws. Enjoy the upfliting mental clarity and alterness of Blueberry DNTS in every puff.

variants.title: Do Si Dos
variants.body_html: This strain boasts a staggeringly high THC level, ensuring potent and long lasting effects. Every puff is a ticket to an odyssey, a dance of flavours. Its rich, taste complements the potency.

variants.title: Amped Live Resin Space Age CK Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Redecan's Amped Live Resin Space Age CK 510 Cart combines the full-spectrum flavour of live resin with the unmatched potency of high-purity liquid diamonds. For a high intensity true-to-strain experience, we've boosted our Legit Live Resin with liquid diamonds to deliver the full Space Age CK experience, amped up. Expect rich floral, fruit, and cake flavours, with no fillers or cutting agents. Featuring a medical-grade TrueDraw Ceramic core, the wide-body design is engineered for premium extracts, delivering smooth hits, enhanced airflow, and clog-free draws. Enjoy the heady, cerebral calm of Space Age CK in every puff.

variants.title: FAT MAC
variants.body_html: Meet Fat Mac, a heavy-hitting indica that's about to take over in a big way. Bred from Pave x Miracle Alien Cookies, this new Redecan core strain has pastry, diesel-rich and earthy flavours that hit deep and linger long. Expect couch-lock levels of relaxation, full-body tingles and a serene state of mind that sticks. These dense, sticky buds are everything you want in an indica: loud aromas, bold flavour and heavyweight potency. Meticulously grown in single-strain, climate-controlled rooms, each bud is carefully hang-dried and hand-trimmed to deliver a clean burn and a smooth smoke that's all Redecan. Fat Mac is stacked with flavour, sticky with trichomes and built to chill.

variants.title: Qwazars Solventless Hash Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Qwazars are named after the brightest and most energetic objects in the known universe, quasars. Born from black holes ripping light through galaxies, they’re distant, mysterious and powerful. Inside this pack you'll find rotating single strain solventless hash pre-rolls. No fillers and no added terpenes.

variants.title: Grease Monkey PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Grease Monkey is potent and flavourful. It mixes the best traits from its OG parents into one great strain in a pre-roll format. Every puff hits you with a combination of nutty vanilla and that sweet, skunky diesel flavour. The smell gives off earthy vibes mixed with sugary diesel and just a hint of vanilla sweetness.

variants.title: The Mystery White One THC Gummies
variants.body_html: The future's uncertain, just like No Future The Mystery White One. This isn't your usual gummy-strap in or don't, because the flavour picks you. You never know what's coming next, but that punch? Always hits hard. Bold, unapologetic, and made for those who crave a little mystery.

variants.title: Frosted Lemons
variants.body_html: Lemons. Lemons. Lemons! That's what your nose will be yelling down the hall to the brain. But don't be fooled, this is not the citrus companion you'll be squeezing over dinner or slicing into a drink. Frosted Lemons is designed to destroy the mundane. A clear option for those looking to unplug without being glued to the couch. The dense bright green buds are frosted in a lush coat of trichomes and that lemon stench seeps into everything it touches. You've been warned.

variants.title: LSO Collection Blueberry Vendetta PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Blueberry Vendetta blends DJ Short Blueberry's sweet, fruity aroma with the creamy vanilla and cake batter notes of LA Wedding Cake Pop. The 3x0.5g pre-roll pack includes three expertly milled joints, hand-finished with a Dutch crown for a smooth, flavorful experience.

variants.title: Marshmallow Square
variants.body_html:
You look like you could use a sweet treat.

Meet the 1964 Mellow Square, the latest indulgence from the 1964 Bakery. This ooey-gooey, nostalgia-packed crispy square is infused with full-spectrum canna-butter for a true-to-flower experience. Whether you're chasing the munchies or already deep in them, this treat is here to hit the spot.

Wyld gummies use sunflower lecithin to improve bioavailability and onset time and are made to be thermostable up to 55 degrees C, with a firm texture that doesn't stick to your teeth. Each Sour Apple Sativa Enhanced gummy contains the terpenes limonene, valencene, beta-caryophyllene, alpha-pinene, and beta-pinene for an energetic and uplifting experience.

variants.title: Jean Guy
variants.body_html: Jean Guy is a classic legacy sativa-dominant strain with a Canadian origin story. Believed to be a White Widow phenotype, the dominant terpene profile of caryophyllene, nerolidol and humulene delivers spicy, citrus pepper aromas. 100% hang-dried, Good Supply offers accessible quality for all.

variants.title: Big Buddy PR 5 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Buddy Blooms presents the lil Buddy sativa, quality and high THC flower, mirroring the roll you'd meticulously craft for yourself. Except this time, we've done the rolling for you. Get the convenience of expertly crafted sativa pre-rolls without the effort. Buddy Blooms, where quality meets convenience.

variants.title: Double Rainbow Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: A bold blend of exotic fruit flavours, with a sour kiss. Wrap the taste of sweet fruity ribbons around your tastebuds with every hit on this high potency, liquid diamond-infused vape.?

variants.title: Cherry THC Gummies
variants.body_html:
This multipack contains 30 immediate containers, each with one soft chew-for a total of 30 soft chews. Emprise's Rapid Onset Cherry 10 mg THC Indica Gummy is a THC-dominant formulation made with Emprise's Advanced Nano THC Emulsions that have a rapid onset in as little as 10-15 minutes. Each Gummy delivers The Maximum Potency allowed of 10 mg THC x 30 Gummies! The product is formulated with Full Spectrum THC Cannabis Extract, Delicious Cherry flavour with a Indica terpene profile. Vegan, Natural, Rapid Onset.

Each Package contains 30 x 10 mg THC Gummies. Terpenes: Myrcene, beta-caryophyllene, Linalool

variants.title: Blue Dream Liquid Diamond Infused Blunt 1 x 1.25 g
variants.body_html: Each 1.25g infused blunt is loaded with premium indoor flower and infused with our signature, potent blend of THCa, liquid diamonds and natural terpenes that’ll amplify your taste buds.

variants.title: Marshmallow Milk
variants.body_html: Marshmallow Milk (Kush Mints x Alien Cookies) is an indica dominant cultivar. Bred by Capulator and exclusive to VOLO, this standout strain is beloved for its rich, dessert-like profile. Expect layers of creamy sweetness, cake and vanilla on the palate, balanced by a deep gas forward aroma with subtle notes of citrus and cream. Dense, frosty buds shimmer with trichomes, showcasing expert cultivation techniques and a very mindful post-production process. Our small batch flower is hang dried, precision hand trimmed, slow cold cured and hand packaged to preserve terpene integrity and maximize flavour and smoothness. Dive into this rich blend of potent genetics and sophisticated flavours.

variants.title: Gas Face PR 7 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Gas Face is a gassy strain created by Seed Junky Genetics. It boasts a combination of Face Mints and Biscotti x Sherbet genetics, as well as a pungent aroma of fuel and citrus.

variants.title: OG
variants.body_html: A crossbreed of Garlic Sherb x Cactus Breath, Buzz'd OG is a phenomenal strain that was created by Space Sherpa in Barrie, ON. This locally designed strain has a unique spicy aroma and dense flower-like buds that has great bag appeal. It's considered a unicorn strain since it's high in both terpenes and cannabinoids, most notably high in CBG. This 12-week grow flower expresses vigorous vegetative growth with strong vertical branching.

variants.title: Exotic Stingerz PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Exotic Stingerz is the fusion of some of Colorado’s dankest cannabis breeding stock. O.G. Kush and the fruity Strawberry Diesel cultivar collided to smash open a new dank dimension from which the potent Exotic Stingerz emerged. Offered in a convenient pack of pre-rolls, you'll be met with notes of tropical fruits, accented by herbal and earthy undertones.

variants.title: Irie PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Irie full flower cured pre-rolls.

variants.title: Blue Razz CBG/THC Gummy
variants.body_html: A tangy blast of blue raspberry with a 30:10 CBG-to-THC ratio. Bursting with chewy, stretchy sweetness and a sour kick.

variants.title: Honeycomb Haze
variants.body_html: Honeycomb Haze is the fusion of Colorado’s dankest cannabis breeding stock. The prized OG Kush cut and the fruitiest Strawberry Diesel cultivar collided to smash open a new dank dimension from which Honeycomb Haze emerged. The potent Honeycomb Haze strain was previously reserved exclusively for the top shelf of well-stocked Colorado dispensaries. Now one of the most potent head stash in the world is finally available.

variants.title: Irie PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Irie full flower cured pre-rolls.

variants.title: Garlic Fumez
variants.body_html: Garlic Fumez dried flower delivers a bold experience. This strain boasts a pungent, gassy aroma with distinct garlic notes, creating a unique profile that stands out. Cultivated with care, these dense and frosty buds are rich in cannabinoids and terpenes, ensuring a robust flavour.

variants.title: THC Multipack Sour Peach Gummies
variants.body_html: Juicy, bright, and with just the right amount of tart, our Olli O's Sour Peach gummies are a zesty twist on a classic. Our 10-piece multipack includes 100 mg total THC per pouch, each 3.5g gummy is individually wrapped and packed with flavour, offering a smooth, consistent cannabis experience.

variants.title: Stingerz PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Buzz’d Stingerz bring together a combination of quality and convenience with perfectly rolled pre-rolls. Crafted with milled whole flower, each pre-roll is designed to deliver a smooth burn and bold flavour profile. The compact pack format ensures freshness and portability.

variants.title: Orange Turpentine
variants.body_html: Orange Turpentine (Cap Junky x Cap's Frozen Oranges) introduces your palate to vibrant flavours with potency. Picture a burst of citrus goodness featuring zesty orange undertones intertwined with a hint of frosty mint from the Cap Junky. The buds showcase a display of vivid green hues, highlighted by a generous coat of glistening trichomes. Our small batch flower undergoes a meticulous process, including hang drying, precision hand trimming, slow cold curing and hand packaging to preserve terpene integrity and maximize flavour and smoothness. Dive into this rich blend of potent genetics and sophisticated flavours, and discover why Capulator's creations continue to captivate the global cannabis community.

variants.title: Guava Barz
variants.body_html: Guava Barz is a vibrant, tropical-forward strain with 28–33% THC. Bursting with ripe guava sweetness, creamy dessert notes, and a smooth aromatic finish, it delivers a rich, fruit-forward profile that stands out in any lineup.

variants.title: Tagalongz
variants.body_html: TAGALONGZ is a powerhouse hybrid of Peanut Butter Breath and Oreoz, delivering 28–33% THC and a standout terp profile. Expect that signature nutty, earthy PBB funk layered with creamy, dessert-like depth for a rich, unforgettable smoke.

variants.title: Yocan iShred Electronic Grinder – Blue
variants.body_html:
The Yocan iShred brings smart design and power together for effortless, consistent grinding. Combining precision engineering with modern convenience, this compact electronic grinder takes the hassle out of prepping your herb while keeping performance at its peak. Durable, efficient, and travel-friendly, it’s built to fit seamlessly into your routine wherever you go.

Key Features & Benefits

Dual-Mode Operation with Auto-Reverse: Switch between automatic or manual grinding for total control.

The motor automatically reverses if jammed, keeping each session smooth and efficient. 

Precision Zinc Alloy Blades: Sharp, long-lasting blades deliver even, fluffy results every time.

Transparent Lid & Glass Chamber: Monitor your grind in real time and use the dual-purpose glass chamber as both grinder and airtight stash jar.

Fast USB-C Charging: Recharge in about an hour and enjoy up to 100 minutes of continuous use.

Compact & Ergonomic Design: Lightweight build and comfortable grip make it easy to carry and operate anywhere.

Colour Variants: Available in Black, Ivory, Blue, Yellow, Pink, and Green to match your personal style.

Smart, portable, and powerful, the Yocan iShred turns a simple grind into a seamless experience.

variants.body_html: Sweet, juicy cherry explodes on impact. Plug in and turn up—Vox 1.2g 510 carts are heavy-hitters! Featuring triple-distilled distillate and boosted botanical terpenes for flavour that hits ultra loud. Dominant terpenes include limonene, myrcene, and beta-caryophyllene.

Made with milled whole flower, infused with signature triple-distilled distillate, dusted in premium kief, and boosted with botanical terpenes—these infused pre-rolls deliver smooth hits, high-THC, and the big, bold flavour you expect from G.A.!

variants.body_html: Introducing our Limited Edition Holiday Pre-Roll Sampler Pack. With love from Scarborough.

variants.title: Rainbow GLTO Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Elevate your experience with Rainbow GLTO, now infused with the exquisite raspberry flavour. Crafted from strain-specific flower and refined into premium liquid diamonds, each vape cartridge delivers unmatched potency and sophistication. Housed in a high-quality 510 cartridge, Fuego ensures a smooth, flavourful draw that meets the expectations of discerning consumers. Taste the difference and indulge with every inhale.

variants.title: Dutch Treat
variants.body_html: Dutch Treat is a classic sativa known for its bright, uplifting terp profile and crisp flavor. With THC ranging from 27–33%, this terpinolene-forward cultivar delivers fresh notes of pine, citrus, and sweet herbs, staying true to its Amsterdam heritage.

variants.title: Spiced Apple Live Rosin Drink
variants.body_html: Made with premium BC Okanagan apple puree, this effervescent soda delivers the perfect balance of crisp orchard sweetness and warming spices. This carbonated beverage combines warm notes with whole plant fresh frozen BC grown live rosin. Available for a limited-time-only.

variants.title: Color Calendar PR 25 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Back for another year, the Color Calendar is a festive countdown, now with 25 pre-rolls and a fresh experience. Inside, you’ll discover a variety of Color Cannabis cultivars, from popular classics to bold new favourites, plus a special limited edition holiday blend. Each pre-roll is housed in its own tube to preserve peak freshness. Available for a limited time only.

variants.title: The Dark Side Glass Tip Diamond Infused PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: The Dark Side is an indica-dominant cultivar created by crossing Skywalker OG and Black Truffle. This infused pre-roll features dense, dark purple and black-hued buds with a rich, layered aroma. Skywalker OG contributes classic gassy and pine notes, while Black Truffle adds smooth, earthy undertones. When broken apart, the buds release aromas of spicy diesel, sweet cream, and subtle truffle-like musk. Each pre-roll is infused with micronized diamonds for additional THC content and finished with a proprietary glass tip and stainless steel filter for a smooth draw and consistent burn.

variants.title: Full Spec Dimes
variants.body_html: Laughing Ass brings you full-spectrum THC oil-infused tablets made with fat soluble cocoa butter. These 10mg tablets will melt away in your mouth. Cocoa butter has a neutral taste that mixes seamlessly in cooking or warm beverage infusions.

variants.title: Winter Frost PR 7 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Brace yourself, Winter Frost is coming. This unique genetic is only available for a limited time in pre-rolls and is rolling in with an avalanche of berry flavour. Made from a Northern Berry x Powdered Donuts cross, this exceptionally icy indica-leaning hybrid features ripe berry with sweet and sour flavours. They have a terpene trio of limonene, caryophyllene and myrcene.

variants.title: Jack Truffle PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Jack Truffle, crafted by MaxYields, the prolific breeder behind 3rd Coast Genetics, is a potent sativa-dominant strain with high-THC levels. A fusion of the legendary Jack Herer and the esteemed Black Truffle, this strain offers bold flavour. Its terpene profile, dominated by terpinolene, creates a striking blend of haze, fruit, and diesel, delivering a complex and invigorating aroma. Grown in small batches, this flower is hang-dried, hand-trimmed, cold-cured, and hand-packed to preserve maximum quality and flavour. Jack Truffle delivers a premium, craft-cultivated experience for the discerning consumer.

variants.title: Mango Mac Live Rosin
variants.body_html: The Mango cultivar is known for its sweet and fruity aroma, reminiscent of mangoes or peaches. The flavour profile follows suit, with notes of tropical fruit that linger on the tongue after each hit. This rosin is made using only the very first pull from their trichome collection system.

variants.title: Granddaddy Purple Skunk PR 7 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Cultivated from an illustrious lineup of rockstar genetics, brace yourself for a potent experience of gassy aromas.

variants.title: Diamond Pave Ceramic Tip Cannon PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Introducing the Diamond Pavé Cannon, a fat roll fusion of Noir Diamant (BLK Diamond) x Blue Pavé. Straight gas, deep flavour and a slow burning, smooth smoke. Cannons are rolled in our custom straight cut cone, made exclusively with ultra thin rice paper and finished with a heavy duty black ceramic filter, engineered with precision airflow holes for the perfect draw. Chunky. Potent.

variants.title: Bold Bubba Pop Disty + Diamond Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: The Bold Bubba Pop Disty + Diamond infused pre-rolls have a delicious flavour combined with high quality distillate and diamonds.

variants.title: Blackberry Jam Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html:
Rise and shine! Blackberry Jam serves up tart raspberry and sweet blackberry with 95%+ THC and Liquid Diamonds! It's a wake-up call for your taste buds. Don't press snooze...

Grown with care in small batches by a craft cultivator committed to farm-to-store integrity, Pineapple OG brings forward the best of BC’s cannabis terroir - sun-grown attitude with indoor precision. Expect dense, trichome-rich

variants.title: Banjo
variants.body_html: This Sativa leaning hybrid is bursting with notes of citrus, and subtle blueberry. On the nose this bag is cheesey, and bright. A cross between the legendary Boost X Tangelo the results are a savoury strain with high THC, and spongey, light green buds.

variants.title: Apple Fritter PR 1 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Fill yer’ boots with Apple Fritter indica featuring cheesy and savoury flavours paired with all-Canadian freshly-baked apple aromas straight from the oven.

variants.title: Winter Frost PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Brace yourself, Winter Frost is coming. This unique genetic is only available for a limited time and is rolling in with an avalanche of berry relaxing vibes. A Northern Berry x Powdered Donuts cross, this exceptionally icy indica-leaning hybrid features ripe berry, sweet and sour flavours and 25-31% THC. With a terpene trio of limonene, caryophyllene and myrcene, Winter Frost brings body-melting bliss with a side of mental clarity. Cozy up with this frosty flower in 7g before it’s gone – because just like winter break, this one won’t last long.

variants.title: Indica Live Rosin Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: A vape cart 100% full of our house made live rosin. All Natural flavour and terpenes in tact for a full spectrum, full flavour smoke. Our indica is best for a relaxing and calming high. For best results, use a battery with a low voltage (1.5 - 2.3v)

variants.title: Jack Herer PR 6 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Jack Herer is a notable legacy strain from the mid-90s known for its lemon scent and undertone of spicy pine.

variants.title: Country Club
variants.body_html: Woody Nelson's Country Club is a series of limited releases featuring some of our favourite growers and genetics. Selection is based on an internal 31-point scoring system with an emphasis on production practices, morphology, experience, and lab results. Each bag includes craft flower that is hand-trimmed, hand-packaged, and never irradiated.

variants.title: Trainwreck PR 6 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Station House Trainwreck first class pre-rolls are made with premium whole flower, milled and perfectly hand rolled with a filter so you can go right to the last stop. The most recent addition to our fleet, ride along with Trainwreck, a sativa hybrid. With genetics stemming from Mexico, Thailand and Afghanistan, Trainwreck features aromas of pine, earth, lemon and cedar. The taste is smooth and has a subtle sweetness with a hint of spice. Always packed with a humidity device for extended freshness. Quality cannabis, everyday fares.

variants.title: Real Fruit Grapefruit 1:1:1 THC:CBG:CBC Gummies
variants.body_html: Wyld Grapefruit Sativa Enhanced THC:CBG:CBC gummies are a 1:1:1 product, made sustainably using real fruit, botanical terpenes and natural flavours. Each gummy contains 10mg THC, 10mg CBG and 10mg CBC, for a total of 100mg THC, 100mg CBG and 100mg CBC per pack. All Wyld gummies are packaged in a fully compostable pouch, and our recipes are formulated by food scientists to provide consistent experiences that taste amazing. Wyld gummies use sunflower lecithin to improve bioavailability and onset time and are made to be thermostable up to 55°C, with a firm texture that doesn’t stick to your teeth. Each Wyld Grapefruit Sativa Enhanced gummy contains 10mg THC, 10mg CBG, and 10mg CBC combined with the terpenes limonene, valencene, beta-caryophyllene, alpha-pinene, and beta-pinene for an energetic and uplifting experience.

variants.title: Banana Breeze Infused PR 1 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Banana Breeze from Potluck’s Burst Collection has a bold creamy, berry flavour. This pre-roll is double-infused and packed with tropical banana terpenes, high-THC isolate and finished with a bold kief coating for extra lift-off. Crafted with our proprietary dry-infusion technology, it burns slow, smooth, and clean - no clogs, just pure flavour. With bright citrus, floral spice, and a heavy-hitting pull, Orange Twist is your ticket to orbit. Potluck Burst brings the best-burning, most flavourful

variants.title: Watermelon Wave Infused PR 1 x 0.5 g

Each 0.5g pre-roll is hand-finished with whole flower and infused with a proprietary blend of THCa isolate, then covered in kief for potency and flavour.

variants.title: Real Fruit Elderberry 2:1 THC:CBN Gummies
variants.body_html: Wyld Elderberry Indica Enhanced THC:CBN gummies are a 2:1 product featuring a balanced dose of CBN. Made sustainably using real fruit, botanical terpenes and natural flavours. variants.title: Sativa Live Rosin Vape Cartridge

variants.title: Beach Crasher PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Wipeout your worries with Beach Crasher Pre-Rolls, rolling in hot in 5 x 0.5g cone-style sativa pre-rolls crafted for smooth, even burns and no-fuss good times. This unique Wedding Crasher x Triangle Kush Bx1 cross is milled to perfection and delivers an uplifting, euphoric high with a side of giggles, Dutch folded tips, wrapped in custom Redecan-branded cones for premium airflow and easy handling. variants.title: Grape Blast Liquid Diamond Infused kief coated PR 5 x 0.25 g
variants.body_html: Status brings you these high potency liquid diamond infused beautiful kief coated pre-rolls. With nostalgic grape flavour, these pre-rolls will bring a flavour you won't forget. Made with a specially designed cone and high end flower.

variants.title: G13 Bx1
variants.body_html: A true throwback from the West Coast. BC's G13 Bx1 revives a legend from the 90s in a fresh format. Bred from a double cross of a rare G13 clone, this indica leaning cultivar brings dense, sticky buds and an unmistakable aroma that's earthy, woody and subtly sweet. A nod to the past with an eye on the present, G13 Bx1 carries the spirit of legacy genetics into a new era.

variants.title: Tigers Bleed Liquid Diamond Infused kief coated PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Out of the jungle and into the fire. Status brings you this high potency liquid diamond infused beautiful kief coated glass-tipped blunt. With a specially designed blunt wrap and quality flower, you can expect an even smoke.

variants.title: Blue Thai
variants.body_html: All you need is blue skies and some Blue Thai. Spinach® Blue Thai is our ode to everything awesome about dried flower. Our take on this cultivar is a straight sativa strain with an undeniable, blast off level of potency from the first puff. We’re also highlighting the classic fruity, skunky, and citrusy flavours and aromas that come from a puckering lineage of Sour Blueberry and Lemon Thai through a trio of familiar yet harmonious terpenes — limonene, caryophyllene, and humulene. So, the next time you pop this in a bowl or a pre-roll, get ready to say, ‘My, oh my, that’s some good Blue Thai.

variants.title: Wild Berry Blaze Heavies Diamond & Disty Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: One of SHRED’s most popular gummy flavours is now more potent than ever in Heavies form. Wild Berry Blaze Heavies are loaded with bold, juicy berry flavour with a triple threat of diamonds, disty and terps. Each pre-rolls clocks in at 50% THC. Smooth, flavourful, and seriously potent — this is berry with bite. Not for lightweights.

variants.title: Blue Pavé
variants.body_html: Bred by Compound Genetics, remixed and phenohunted in-house. Our cut of Blue Pavé is a potent cross of Blue Azure x Pave that is high in THC and terpenes with a sweet, yet smooth flavour that translates from start to finish. Hand trimmed, hang dried, cold cured and hand packaged, our flower is always from our genetics and grown indoors at our own facilities in BC by our grow team. Never sourced, never any shortcuts.

variants.title: Cranberry Ginger Ale 10 THC + 10 CBG
variants.body_html: Throwing it back to a traditional Canadian classic. Savour the zingy snap of natural ginger flavour paired with a pop of crisp and tart cranberry. Made with real ginger, cane sugar, cranberry juice and natural flavours. Made without caffeine and infused with 10 mg of THC and 10 mg of CBG.

variants.title: Georgia Pi Live Resin Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html:
Freshly baked. Georgia Pie is cross of Gellati X Kush Mintz that offers frosty olive green and purple buds. Hits of fresh berries in a nutty doughy crust, all the flavour with no oven required.

Small-batch craft flower, flash frozen for peak freshness. This live resin vape stays true to the plant - made from our premium flower, pressed at its best, and priced to keep things honest. More dank, less bank. The truth is in the cart.

variants.title: Pink Pineapple Rosin Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Two iconic strains, one highly potent experience. Our Pink Pineapple Rosin Infused Pre-Rolls are crafted under our roof featuring fresh, hang-dried Kush God flower infused with pure, solventless Pink Kush rosin, cold-cured and pressed in-house. This strain combination was hand-selected to deliver a winning aroma profile featuring the best of both strains. Kush God brings tropical flavours of pineapple and creamy berries, while the Pink Kush rosin layers a concentrated dose of sweet spice, earth, vanilla, and gas. From the Pure Infusions collection, comes a lineup of pure, solventless, true-to-flower experiences. Packed with a limited-edition collectable glass tip for an elevated smoke.

variants.title: True Hybrid Rosin Blue Raspberry Cotton Clouds Gummies
variants.body_html: Glenn's No.23 True Hybrid Rosin gummy merges the mouth-watering flavours of blue raspberry & cotton candy, jam packed in a small size for a guilt-free, lower sugar option. Specially crafted with premium live rosin THC for the full experience. This premium live rosin infused gummy is another addition to one of the most price effective 10mg gummy line-ups in the market, brought to you by Glenn's edibles!

variants.title: Cranberry Cough
variants.body_html: Get cozy with Potluck's new limited-release holiday strain, Cranberry Cough! With a sweet berry aroma and hints of pine, this strain offers a fruity, earthy flavour perfect for warming up your winter day

variants.title: Blackberry Jam Diamond Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html:
Rise and shine! Blackberry Jam Ultra-Infused serves up tart raspberry and sweet blackberry with 60%+ THC and infused with diamonds! It's a wake-up call for your taste buds. Don't press snooze...

You read that right. DIAMONDS. G.A. Ultra-Infused Pre-Rolls are made using milled whole flower, dusted in premium kief, boosted with botanical terpenes, and infused with diamonds to deliver our most potent pre-roll yet. Go Higher than ever before with 60%+ THC and the G.A. flavours you love.

variants.title: Mellow Man
variants.body_html: Chill out with the Mellow Man! With bright citrusy notes and a down-to-earth finish, this mellow man is bound to be your new best bud! This indica-leaning strain borrows its smooth taste, and punchy cherry notes from its parent strains Ice Cream Cake and Cherry Pie. FIGR dried flower products are hand selected to ensure dense, high-quality buds are in every package.

variants.title: Orange Creamsicle Shatter
variants.body_html: Made from the popular Orange Creamsicle strain from Western Cannabis, Orange Creamsicle Shatter delivers a potent and flavorful dabbing experience with its rich blend of sweet orange and creamy vanilla notes. This high-quality concentrate offers a smooth, glass-like texture and a Indica leaning high-perfect for users seeking uplifting effects with a relaxing finish. Ideal for flavor chasers and experienced consumers alike.

variants.title: Queen of Bud Zippo Rose Quartz Filigree
variants.body_html:
The Queen of Bud Zippo Rose Quartz Filigree lighter brings softness and strength together in perfect harmony. Made in the USA with Zippo’s signature all-metal construction, it’s built to last a lifetime and designed to elevate every spark. The windproof flame delivers reliable performance in nearly any setting, while the refillable design ensures this piece stays by your side for years to come.

The Rose Quartz finish glows with gentle warmth, wrapped in intricate filigree detailing that adds texture and depth. Inspired by the rose quartz crystal tie to love, this lighter embodies the serene, empowering spirit at the heart of Queen of Bud. A golden crown emblem completes the design, sealing it with a touch of royal grace.

Key Features & Benefits

All-Metal Construction: Durable, enduring design for everyday use

Windproof Flame: Dependable spark in almost any condition

Refillable Design: Eco-conscious build for long-term use

Made in the USA: Authentic Zippo quality with a lifetime guarantee

Rose Quartz Finish: Soft pink tone with elegant filigree detailing

Signature Crown Emblem: A symbol of Queen of Bud’s radiant elegance

A timeless keepsake made to manifest love, beauty, and intention with every light.

variants.title: CBG Happy Place
variants.body_html: Savour the taste of summer with every sip of our THC + CBG Mango Peach & Yuzu Juice. As the flavours unfold like a tropical paradise on your palate. Imbibe in the richness of mangoes, the sweetness of peaches, and the citrusy brightness of yuzu, all in one delightful can.

variants.title: Rotating Sativa
variants.body_html: Happy Hour Sativa 28g features a rotating selection of legacy strains from BC micro-producers, grown indoors for optimal quality. Each batch is hang-dried, cured for a minimum of 14 days, and hand-trimmed to preserve juicy terps in mid-size nugs. Sourced from the finest BC has to offer, this large-format flower delivers premium craft quality at a price that satisfies even the most discerning customers.

variants.title: Training Day
variants.body_html: Training Day is an Indica dominant strain that will put your THC tolerance to the test. This California native is bred by crossing LA Confidential X Trainwreck. Capturing its aroma from its LA delivering a pungent earthy and pine flavour. This terpene rich cultivar is dominant in terpinolene, myrcene, and pinene.

variants.title: Mac 10 Caviar
variants.body_html: Mac 10 Caviar is a terpene-rich concentrate offering a vibrant blend of sweet, creamy citrus and soft berry. It opens with notes of ripe orange and subtle floral fruit, then gently rounds out with faint earthy spice and just a whisper of gas. Expertly crafted to highlight the rich aromatic profile of the beloved Mac 10 cultivar, this concentrate delivers a smooth, refined finish that makes every dab a flavourful journey.

variants.title: Live Rosin Sour Blueberry Gummies
variants.body_html: Bold, tangy, and bursting with berry, these Olli O's Sour Blue Raspberry gummies deliver a puckered punch of flavour in every bite. Infused with 10 mg THC, each 3.5g gummy is individually wrapped for freshness and convenience. Part of our 10-piece multipack (100 mg total THC per pouch), they’re a perfect balance of sour and sweet.

variants.title: Puffco New Peak - Glückseligkeit
variants.body_html:
Der Puffco New Peak ist die nächste Evolution im einfachen, eleganten Dabbing. Entwickelt, um jede Sitzung glatt und geschmackvoll zu gestalten, kombiniert dieses intelligente E-Rig moderne Funktionen mit einem schlanken, minimalistischen Look. Vom Silikonboden bis zur Joystick-Luftstromkappe ist jedes Detail darauf ausgelegt, Ihr Erlebnis zu vereinfachen, ohne die Leistung zu opfern.

Hauptmerkmale & Vorteile

3D-Kammer - Wandmontierte Heizung umgibt Ihr Konzentrat für maximalen Geschmack und Dampf, während empfindliche Cannabinoide und Terpene geschützt werden.

Joystick-Kappe - Feinabstimmung des Luftstroms mit einer einfachen, taktilen Bewegung, die Ihnen mehr Kontrolle über jeden Zug gibt.

Bis zu 35 Dabs pro Ladung - Ein langlebiger Akku hält Sie länger bereit für die Sitzung.

Schnelles USB-C-Laden - Laden Sie schnell auf und kehren Sie früher zum Dabbing zurück.

Abnehmbarer Glasdeckel - Kompatibel mit sowohl Peak als auch Peak Pro Glas, sodass Sie Ihren bevorzugten Stil der Filtration wählen können.

Echtzeit-Temperaturkontrolle - Intelligente Sensoren halten Ihr Dab von Anfang bis Ende auf der perfekten Temperatur.

Farbvarianten - Erhältlich in Cloud für einen sauberen und traumhaften Look, Schwarz für einen schlanken und zeitlosen Stil und Sky für eine sanfte und erfrischende Atmosphäre.

2 Jahre Garantie - Entwickelt für Zuverlässigkeit und Seelenfrieden mit vollem Schutz.

Der Puffco New Peak nimmt das Rätselraten beim Dabbing und bringt erstklassige Leistung in ein tragbares, stilvolles Design. Wählen Sie Ihre Farbe, laden Sie Ihr Konzentrat und genießen Sie eine Sitzung, die sich jedes Mal mühelos anfühlt.

variants.title: Craft Animal Face Cookies PR 5 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Craft Animal Face Cookies Blunt is a grower-exclusive phenotype crossed with Face Off OG, GSC and Animal Mints. Each blunt is packed in artisanal Futurola cones, handcrafted with the finest papers from France and Spain, and sealed with Arabic gum from the Acacia tree.

Exclusively designed for MAX, this sleek, all-metal AIO is built to unleash the full potential of our high-potency proprietary Liquid Diamonds formulation, delivering an impressive 95-98% THC.

variants.title: Tropical x Burst Collect Variety Infused PR 4 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Blast off to a new oasis with Potluck's Tropical Burst Collection! Enjoy double-infused, kief-coated pre-rolls in Mango Hurricane, Juicy Jungle Fruit, Blue Lagoon Thunder, and Passion Paradise Punch.

Whether you're crowning a bowl, boosting a joint, or infusing your favourite culinary creation, the possibilities are endless—and the experience, elevated. With its radiant golden hue, rich cannabinoid content, and complex terpene profile, this Kief is a standout in any stash. A refined touch for those who expect more from their cannabis.

variants.title: Porto Leche Live Resin Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Some pairings are just meant to be, like the deep and bold taste of aged red berries or the smooth and velvety comfort of fresh cream. Porto Leche (Oreoz x Grape Jubilee. Breeder: Exotic Genetics) captures both in perfect harmony, delivering a flavour that's rich and effortlessly smooth. The first hit bursts with notes of ripe and jammy berries, coating your palate in deep and complex sweetness. As you exhale, a wave of creamy smoothness follows like the finish of a cold glass of milk. Porto Leche from Tribal.

variants.title: Frostade
variants.body_html: Brought to life by skilled hands from the legendary Kootenays, DEALR’s Frostade is a standout cross of Lemondary and Zoda dripping in frost. This cultivar explodes with the legacy taste of gummy bears and sweet bubblegum, finishing with a bright lemon twist as it lingers. Every glass jar holds a true craft quarter from people who live and breathe the plant.

variants.title: BC Organic Black Zoap
variants.body_html: Bred by Odessey Genetics, our BC Organic Black Zoap offers complex aromas and flavours that blend sweet notes with a soapy and gassy profile. Expect excellent flavour translation, as you envelope your senses with this robust indica hybrid. Grown in our organic living soil and hand tended, expect nothing but pristine buds packed safely in our premium glass jars.

variants.title: Garlic Fumez
variants.body_html: Born from the elite breeding of Bloom Seed Co, Garlic Fumez is a powerhouse strain crossing GMO Rootbeer x Candy Fumez, delivering a bold, complex, and potent smoking experience. Expect a rich fusion of funky garlic, sweet root beer, and gassy candy notes, creating an unforgettable aroma that lingers on every exhale. Garlic Fumez—bold, flavorful, and built for those who appreciate the power of top-tier genetics.

variants.title: Orange Tingz Sauce Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: The Pistol and Paris Orange Tingz Diamond Sauce disposable vape is infused with liquid diamonds and features the distinct flavour profile of our Orange Tingz strain. Expect bright citrus notes with subtle berry undertones in each inhale.

variants.title: Blackberry 'n' Cream Liquid Diamond Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Unleash the next level of vaping with our liquid diamonds high potency disposable vape. It's custom crafted for a smooth and intensely flavourful experience. Bursting with ripe blackberries, a touch of creamy vanilla and subtle Kush undertones, this custom designed profile perfectly complements our Versus liquid diamonds extract.

variants.title: Cosmic Cherry PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Award-Winning, Never-Irradiated Craft Legacy Genetics Made From Wedding Cake And Wedding Crasher.Cultivated Indoors In Small Batches With Led Lighting In Coco Medium, It’S Hang-Dried, Hand-Trimmed, And Cured To Perfection. This Strain Features Dense Green Buds With Purple Undertones, Covered In Trichomes.Enjoy Its Earthy, Herbal Aroma And Cherry Flavour That Defines “Cosmic Cherry.”

variants.body_html:
The Ultimate Smoking Box!

Daily High Club is the premier creator of smoking gear boxes, delivering limited edition themed boxes every month. Carefully crafted in California, featuring custom artwork and exclusive designs making them perfect for collectors and smoking connoisseurs.

variants.title: Queen of Bud Zippo Clear Quartz Mosaic
variants.body_html:
The Queen of Bud Zippo Clear Quartz Mosaic lighter turns a classic into a sparkling statement piece. Made in the USA with Zippo’s all-metal construction, it is built to last and designed for reliable, windproof performance. Its refillable design ensures this lighter can be a cherished companion for years to come.

Shimmering silver lines create a mosaic-like pattern that catches the light from every angle, while a bold golden crown emblem anchors the design with regal authority. Inspired by clear quartz and its power of clarity, this lighter blends artistry with purpose, making it as meaningful as it is striking.

Key Features & Benefits

All-Metal Construction: Durable and long-lasting for everyday use

Windproof Flame: Dependable spark in almost any condition

Refillable Design: Built to last a lifetime and environmentally conscious

Made in the USA: Genuine Zippo quality backed by a lifetime guarantee

Clear Quartz Mosaic Finish: Shimmering pattern that reflects light beautifully

Signature Crown Emblem: Embodies Queen of Bud’s regal, empowering aesthetic

A lighter designed to shine, inspire, and manifest intention with every spark.

variants.body_html:
Zippo is the quintessential lighter that everyone knows and loves. Reliable and refillable, these lighters can truly last a lifetime (they even have a guarantee). This iconic lighter is made in the USA with all metal construction (no flimsy parts) and a windproof design so you can use it almost anywhere.

The Black Obsidian Midnight Manifest edition captures a sleek, modern aesthetic. A deep black base is accented with subtle wave-like patterns and a golden crown, creating a minimalist yet powerful design. Perfect for those who appreciate understated style with a touch of luxury

Key Features & Benefits

All-Metal Construction: Durable and long-lasting for everyday use

Windproof Flame: Reliable performance in almost any condition

Refillable Design: Built to last a lifetime and environmentally mindful

Black Obsidian Ripple Finish: Sleek black surface with subtle wave-like patterns

Signature Crown Emblem: Adds a touch of Queen of Bud’s regal aesthetic

variants.body_html:
Zippo is the quintessential lighter that everyone knows and loves. Reliable and refillable, these lighters can truly last a lifetime (they even have a guarantee). This iconic lighter is made in the USA with all metal construction (no flimsy parts) and a windproof design so you can use it almost anywhere.


The Black Obsidian Dark Rose design adds an elegant twist to the classic silhouette. Intricate golden roses bloom across the matte black surface, wrapping the lighter in a bold, luxurious design. variants.title: Astro Pink
variants.body_html: Papa's Herb Astro Pink, a top-tier strain renowned for its potent effects and delightful flavour profile. Delve into its rich combination of earthy and floral notes, complemented by subtle hints of vanilla, creating a truly satisfying experience. Come to Papa!

variants.title: Diamond Blaze Cosmic Cherry Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Elevate Your Luxury Experience With Our Diamond-Infused Pre-Roll. Treat Yourself To A Distinctive And Premium Smoking Experience That Will Heighten Your Senses Like Never Before. Add A Touch Of Sophistication With Our Exclusive, Award-Winning Cosmic Cherry, Made From 100% Non-Irritated Whole Milled Flower—No Shake, No Trim, Just Pure, Top-Tier Craft Buds—Paired With Twisted Banana Diamonds. Experience Cannabis Like Never Before, Where Luxury And Quality Meet In Every Puff.

variants.title: Cement Shoes
variants.body_html: Cement Shoes is a powerhouse indica strain boasting THC levels between 28–32%. A cross of Animal Cookies, OG Kush, and Wet Dream, this cultivar delivers a heavy-hitting experience with deep relaxation and a calm, euphoric edge. The dense, frosty buds are caked in trichomes and release an earthy aroma layered with notes of citrus, sweet vanilla, and diesel. The flavor follows suit with a creamy, gas-forward finish that lingers on the palate. True to its name, Cement Shoes offers a slow-building, full-bodied weight that settles deeply, making it a top pick for those who appreciate potent, flavorful indica strains crafted for quality and intensity.

variants.title: Sky Burst Haze
variants.body_html: Sky Burst Haze is a vibrant sativa strain with THC levels ranging from 28–32%. This energetic cultivar bursts with citrus, tropical fruit, and sweet candy notes, balanced by subtle herbal undertones. The bright green buds are coated in a thick layer of frosty trichomes, offering a visually stunning presentation that hints at its potency. On the inhale, flavors of lemon zest and mango dominate, finishing with a smooth, hazy sweetness. Sky Burst Haze delivers an uplifting, clear-headed experience that sparks creativity and focus, making it a perfect choice for daytime enjoyment and those seeking a refreshing, high-octane sativa bursting with flavor and aroma

variants.title: Cabana Cannabis Co Rolling Tray - Surfari - Medium
variants.body_html:

This medium-sized, stylish tray features a laid-back surf vibe with a colourful surfboard graphic, making it the ideal accessory for those who want to roll in style.
