Key Features & Benefits
Fun & Vibrant Design: The bold surfboard graphic, surrounded by tropical colours and beach vibes, brings a fresh, laid-back energy to every rolling session.

Ideal Medium Size: The medium size offers the perfect balance of space and convenience—plenty of room to roll comfortably while keeping everything organized and within reach.

Durable & Sturdy: Made from high-quality metal, this rolling tray is built to last, ensuring it handles all your rolling needs while keeping its vibrant colours intact.

Effortless to Clean: The smooth surface makes cleaning quick and easy—just wipe it down, and you're ready to roll again.

Perfect Gift Idea: Know someone who loves the beach and cannabis? This tray makes a fun and thoughtful gift that’ll definitely impress.

Add some beachy vibes to your smoking routine with the Cabana Cannabis Co Surfari Rolling Tray—because every session should feel like an endless summer."

variants.title: Mango Tango Liquid Diamonds Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Grab your dance partner, because with this vape, it takes two to tango. The Spinach Mango Tango Liquid Diamonds 1g vape is the flavour you can always count on to grab and move the night away. Inspired by the Mango Tango strain with a Tangie and True OG lineage, the 98.1% THC potency is no joke, and with liquid diamonds infusion this vape sparkles like sequins flailing about on a dance floor. While sweet, tropical, and luscious mango flavour notes and aromas fill the air, glide on a juicy cloud through your next vape sesh.

variants.title: Lamborkiwi Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Been looking for something that will rev your engine? Status brings you this high potency AIO vape elevated roller experience. With the flavour of kiwi and berries this AIO will have you rolling in style in a lamborkiwi you can afford! Filled in a conveniently small sized device you'll be getting a smoke that you won't be disappointed in!

variants.title: Grape THC Gummies
variants.body_html:
This multipack contains 30 immediate containers, each with one soft chew-for a total of 30 soft chews. Emprise's Rapid Onset Grape 10 mg THC Sativa Gummy is a THC-dominant formulation made with Emprise's Advanced Nano THC Emulsions that have a rapid onset in as little as 10-15 minutes. Each Gummy delivers The Maximum Potency allowed of 10 mg THC x 30 Gummies! The product is formulated with Full Spectrum THC Cannabis Extract, Delicious Grape flavour with a Sativa terpene profile. Vegan, Natural, Rapid Onset.

Each Package contains 30 x 10 mg THC Gummies. Terpenes: d-limonene, beta-caryophyllene, Myrcene.

variants.title: Papaya Power
variants.body_html: This sativa leaning full flower product is filled with only our best buds. Papaya Power boasts a terpene profile dominated by farnesene and alpha bisabolol. Consumers can expect sweet tropical flavours and aromas with big notes of funky gas and hints of parmesan. Bred from Papaya and Power Plant.

variants.title: Grapes and Cream Blunt PR 1 x 2 g
variants.body_html: We took our signature Grapes and Cream Blunt and cranked it up — now available in a generous 2g format. This indica-dominant masterpiece blends Grape Pie x Jet Fuel Gelato, delivering sweet, gassy notes of diesel, juicy grape flavour, and a cool hint of mint. Each blunt is hand-rolled in artisanal Futurola cones, crafted from the finest French and Spanish papers, and sealed with pure Arabic gum for a smooth, luxurious finish.

variants.title: Exotic Gas
variants.body_html: Get ready to dive deep into the dankness of our legendary Exotic Gas flower. This tasty indica dominant strain is potent and comes from the Pink Cookies lineage, bringing that heat. Picture these dense and vibrant buds, rocking shades of light green with pops of orange and forest green. It's like a visual spectacle. When you spark it up, you're in for tangy, sweet and earthy flavours, plus that unmistakable gas twist. We slow cure and hang dry our Exotic Gas. With love from Scarborough.

variants.title: Hemplixir 100 CBD Oil
variants.body_html: Purefarma'S Hemplixer 100 Cbd Oil Drops Are Carefully Extracted From The Highest Quality, Hand Selected Cbd Flower And Combined In Pure Organic Olive Oil. Our Proprietary Extraction Process Allows Us To Produce A Full Plant Profile, Preserving The Plants Distinctive Earthy Notes, Subtle Berry Flavours Without The Need For Back-Added Terpenes. Purefarma'S Cbd Oil Drops Are Formulated For Maximum Bioavailability, Providing Full Plant Benefits Simply Unavailable In A Formulated Distillate Product.

variants.title: Hash Infused Yacht Master Punch PR 1 x 2 g
variants.body_html: Contains 2g of melty ice-water hash infused (.25 grams / 14.5% hash) full flower buds, broken down by hand (never ground), wrapped in an all-natural hemp wrap, uniquely cured for 72-hours, finished with a custom glass filter tip, and encased in a re-sealable glass tube. Yacht Master Punch is known for its sweet, tropical confection-like flavour profile. It is celebrated for its creamy smoke that is smooth and easy.

variants.title: El Jointo Diamond Infused PR 3 x 0.6 g
variants.body_html: Infused with premium cannabis diamonds, El Blunto new hand-finished El Jointo line is the perfect balance of quality and affordability. Each El Jointo contains some of the finest indoor and mixed light-flower and is infused with premium cannabis diamonds (14.5% diamonds by volume). The flower is broken down by hand and neatly wrapped in clean and even burning organic hemp paper. Packaged in individual air-tight tubes and a re-sealable mylar pouch.

variants.title: Alien Pebbles PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: These pre-rolls are packed with freshly ground Alien Pebbles, an evenly balanced hybrid strain brought to you by hybrid parents Alien OG x Fruity Pebbles OG. The inhale is fruity with sweet aromas of sugary grapes and tangy citrus, and subtle skunky notes on the exhale. Ready to burn.

variants.title: 97 Octane Smallz
variants.body_html: Introducing 97 Octane, a high octane craft flower. Curated from our loudest, most iced out genetics, this collection of smalls delivers bag appeal and smooth gas. Handcrafted and indoor-grown at our BC facilities, every bud is born from our own genetics portfolio and finished to craft standards. Hand packaged in our custom designed Pop and Pour glass jar.

variants.title: Florida Sunrise Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Florida Sunrise Bubble Hash infused pre-rolls are crafted from a sativa dominant hybrid with extracted bubble hash. Florida Sunrise is known for its tropical fruit flavour. It was created by crossing Green Crush and Triangle Kush.

variants.title: Sour Peach Mango 3:1 CBG:THC Gummies
variants.body_html: This multipack contains 10 immediate containers, each with one soft chew-for a total of 10 soft chews. Wyld Sour Peach Mango Sativa Enhanced CBG:THC gummies are a 3:1 ratio product featuring a restorative, CBG-dominant profile and THC. Made sustainably using real fruit, botanical terpenes, and natural flavours, each gummy contains 30mg CBG and 10mg THC for a total of 300mg CBG and 100mg THC per pack. All Wyld gummies are packaged in a compostable pouch, and our recipes are formulated by food scientists to provide consistent experiences that taste amazing. Wyld gummies use sunflower lecithin to improve bioavailability and onset time and are made to be thermostable up to 55 degrees celsius, with a firm texture that doesn't stick to your teeth. Each Wyld Sour Peach Mango Sativa Enhanced gummy contains the terpenes limonene, valencene, beta-caryophyllene, alpha-pinene, and beta-pinene for an energetic and uplifting experience.

variants.title: Permanent Cherreis Pure Live Resin Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Our Permanent Cherries Pure Live Resin Vape cartridge is crafted exclusively from 100% fresh-frozen flower. We never add additives, thinning agents, or botanical terpenes-because doing it right matters. Upon your first inhale, expect to be blown away bold flavours of sweet cherry, gas, and a smooth creamy finish. Calibrated for smooth, consistent flavor with every pull, we recommend pairing it with a quality battery featuring variable temperature settings. Start at 2V and gradually adjust to find your perfect experience.

variants.title: Blueberry Zlshie Liquid Diamond Infused PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Hybrid Blueberry Zlshie - Liquid Diamond Infused Joint - delicious, fresh and sweet blueberry slushy flavour, internally infused and kief coated. Come to Papa!

variants.title: El Muerte
variants.body_html: Step Boldly Into The Dark, Seductive Embrace Of El Muerte, The Formidable Offspring Of Death Bubba And A Mysterious, Unknown Partner. This Indica Heavyweight Rolls Deep With Pungent Aromas Of Pine, Sweet Earth, And Skunk. Cultivated For Those Who Appreciate Flower That’S Deep, Rich, And Unapologetically Robust. Just Remember: Tread Lightly — El Muerte Always Gets The Last Laugh.

variants.title: Live Solventless Temple Ball Hash
variants.body_html: Cross Border Concentrates' Solventless Temple Ball is a traditional hash product elevated by inputs and craftsmanship. Hand rolled and cold cured, each is made from fresh frozen cannabis using ice water extraction, preserving the plant's full spectrum of cannabinoids and terpenes. This method results in a rich and pliable concentrate with deep flavour. The Temple Ball honours old world techniques while using modern flower to deliver a clean and solventless product. Expect earthy, spicy or fruity notes depending on the seasonal strain in rotation. Each batch is a unique expression of our rotating cultivar lineup and is a heritage style hash with terpene richness.

variants.title: Banapple Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: BOLD GLAZED Banapple packs big clouds of smooth, fruity sweetness with a fusion of juicy apple and creamy banana. Just like the song that gets stuck in your head, this sativa all-in-one vape delivers a vibrant mix of mellow and bright fruit flavours, creating a nostalgic yet refreshing experience you’ll want to hit on repeat. This vape contains high levels of THC with limonene, caryophyllene, and myrcene.

variants.title: Marshmallow Milk
variants.body_html: Marshmallow Milk (Kush Mints x Alien Cookies) is an indica dominant cultivar. Bred by Capulator and exclusive to VOLO, this standout strain is beloved for its rich, dessert-like profile. Expect layers of creamy sweetness, cake and vanilla on the palate, balanced by a deep gas forward aroma with subtle notes of citrus and cream. Dense, frosty buds shimmer with trichomes, showcasing expert cultivation techniques and a very mindful post-production process. Our small batch flower is hang dried, precision hand trimmed, slow cold cured and hand packaged to preserve terpene integrity and maximize flavour and smoothness. Dive into this rich blend of potent genetics and sophisticated flavours.

variants.title: Black Triangle Kush
variants.body_html: Black Triangle is a standout cross of Triangle Kush x ’88 G-13 Hash Plant with a dank terpene profile led by myrcene, caryophyllene, and farnesene. This small-batch, hang-dried flower is known for its dense frosty bud and a spicy dank profile. With a rich, complex aroma and standout indica lineage, Black Triangle is top quality craft ready to lock you in for the evening.

variants.title: Galactic Glue Caviar
variants.body_html: Galactic Glue Caviar is a richly textured, terpene-packed concentrate made to deliver a richly layered and flavour-forward experience. Crack the jar and you’re hit with dense waves of earthy-sour aroma, layered with subtle notes of pine and spice. The flavour is bold, complex, and lingering — a nod to the legendary lineage behind this flagship cultivar that’s been a cornerstone of our craft from day one. From its thick consistency to its deep, resinous flavour and terpene richness, Galactic Glue Caviar brings serious punch to every dab — a true top-shelf celebration of a fan-favourite strain.

variants.title: Pink Lily Caviar
variants.body_html: Pink Lily Caviar is a terpene-rich concentrate overflowing with expressive aromatic complexity. It opens with bright notes of candied citrus, wildflower nectar, and soft pine, leading into a sticky-sweet richness reminiscent of fresh spring sap. The aroma is layered and memorable, offering refined flavour and a smooth finish. Expertly crafted, Pink Lily Caviar exemplifies the highest standards of concentrate quality and craftsmanship.

variants.title: Queen of Tartz
variants.body_html: Queen of Tartz is a sativa dominant strain that reigns supreme in flavour and potency. Carefully selected from a cross of Key Lime Pie and Infatuation, it boasts dark, dense and gassy buds from its Infatuation lineage, while the zesty citrus of Key Lime Pie shines through. The smoke is exactly what you'd expect from a high potency sativa.

variants.title: Atomic Apple Liquid Diamond Disposable Vape
variants.body_html:
A big blast of apple! Atomic Apple is sweet and sour to the core. Jammed with Liquid Diamonds, this flavour bomb pops off at 95%+ THC.

Loaded with liquid diamonds! G.A. 1g USB-C Rechargeable All-In-One Vapes takes our signature botanical terpene-infused distillate and adds liquid diamonds to deliver our most potent line up yet. Go Higher than ever before with 95%+ THC and the G.A. flavours you love.

variants.title: Deep Fried Cookie Dough
variants.body_html: A very unique cultivar, Deep Fried Cookie Dough is a brand new genetic orginating by crossing Oreoz with Deep Fried Ice cream cake. Exotic flavors of sweet chocolate with hints of gas really stand out. Dark green buds, covered with orange hairs and sparkling trichomes excite the senses for what is to come.

variants.title: Joyride Sativa Milled Flower
variants.body_html: Joyride sativa milled flower is a potent sativa strain crafted from whole flower.

variants.title: Lemon Whips
variants.body_html: Gorilla Lemon Fire is new to the Canadian rec market and was bred from crossing the iconic Gorilla Glue #4 with Lemon Skunk and Fire OG. This indica-dominant flower is high in THC and Terpenes and produces large flowers with great bag appeal.

variants.title: Pulsar 510 DL 5.0 Thermo Series Vape - Royal Wizard
variants.body_html:
The Pulsar 510 DL 5.0 Thermo Series brings high-performance functionality and bold style together in one sleek device. Designed for both cartridge users and concentrate fans, this versatile bar-style vape delivers full control over every session with precision voltage adjustment, customizable airflow, and a bright LCD screen framed by a glowing LED light bar. Compact yet powerful, it’s built to perform while keeping your experience smooth, discreet, and stylish.

Key Features & Benefits

Full LCD Display + LED Glow: Voltage, battery life, puff count, and preheat status are all shown on the side screen with a clean LED accent.

Adjustable Voltage (1.8V–4.2V): Fine-tune your output for flavour-forward draws or dense vapor clouds.

1000mAh Battery with USB-C: Reliable, long-lasting power with fast charging between sessions.

Dual-Use Compatible: Works with standard 510 cartridges or concentrates using the optional wax atomizer.

8-Second Preheat with Planet Ring: Clears clogs and primes cartridges with a glowing countdown.

Discreet Bar-Style Build: Matte-finish body designed to mimic disposables while offering a premium feel.

Detachable Silicone Mouthpiece: Heat-resistant, magnetic design for comfort and easy cleaning.

Auto-Draw + Button Activation: Choose between hands-free pulls or manual control.

Customizable Airflow: Switch between tighter draws and open, airy clouds.

Built-In Safety Features: Protection from over-voltage and short circuits for worry-free use.

Four Distinct Finishes: Choose from Royal Wizard, Fairy Fire, Acid Splash, or Earthstorm to match your personal style.

The 510 DL 5.0 Thermo Series is the perfect balance of performance, versatility, and design, making it a standout choice for any session.

variants.title: X5 One Hitter
variants.body_html:
The X5 takes the classic one-hitter and makes it smarter. With its preloading POD system, you can prep five sessions at home and enjoy smooth, discreet hits anywhere. No loose herb containers, no sticky fingers, no harsh smoke. Just a clean, compact design that keeps things simple and convenient.

 Key Features & Benefits

Preload Five Sessions - Pack PODs directly from your grinder before heading out, so you’re ready with fresh bowls whenever you want them.

Cleaner, Smoother Hits - Designed to work with Carbon-X charcoal filters for a more comfortable draw than standard one-hitters.

Built to Last - Pure H62 brass delivers clean taste and durability, while the food-grade silicone case protects and controls odor.

Discreet by Design - At just over three inches, it fits easily in your pocket. The smell-proof, water-repellent case keeps things low profile.

The Right Amount Every Time - Each POD holds 0.15–0.2 grams, ideal for a satisfying one-hitter without waste.

Easy to Clean - PODs soak in isopropyl alcohol and the brass body rinses with soap and water. Maintenance couldn’t be simpler.

Take it anywhere, load it once, and keep your sessions smooth and stress-free.

variants.title: X5 Charcoal Filter Replacements
variants.body_html:
The X5 Charcoal Filter Replacements give you a cleaner, smoother smoking experience without changing the way you roll, pack, or light up. Designed with high-grade activated charcoal, these filters trap tar and harsh compounds before they reach your lungs, while preserving the potency and flavour of your cannabis. Whether in a joint, pre-roll, or pipe, X5 filters keep your sessions more enjoyable from the first hit to the last.

Key Features & Benefits:

Cleaner, Smoother Draws: Activated charcoal captures tar and irritants, reducing coughing and harshness.

Preserves Potency and flavour: Filters toxins without blocking THC or natural terpenes.

Universal Fit: Compatible with joints, pre-rolls, and most pipes or filter tips.

Single-Use Freshness: Each filter is designed for one-time use to maintain peak performance.

Bulk Value: Each pack comes with 80 filters so you’re stocked for session after session.

A simple switch that makes every smoke easier on your throat and lungs, the X5 Charcoal Filter Replacements are an effortless upgrade to your ritual.

variants.body_html: Blast off into Deep Space with intergalactic infused Big Bang Berry pre-rolls. A celestial fusion of 60%+ THC and out of this world berry flavour. Crafted to transport you to a new galaxy.

variants.body_html: When you're with the buds and it's time for a sesh, all you need is blue skies and some Blue Thai. Spinach Blue Thai is our ode to everything awesome about dried flower. variants.title: 60+ Blueberry Bronco Diamond Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Inspired by Canada's Wild West with real value, high potency and quality cannabis. Boasting a blend of whole flower, THCA diamonds and our signature Strawberry Stampede flavour, these blunts are diamond coated and ceramic tipped.

variants.title: Tiger Blood Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Welcome to the wild side! Tiger Blood Liquid Diamond vapes roar with 95%+ THC and a blend of strawberry, watermelon, and coconut. This isn’t a stroll through the park - it’s a full-on flavour jungle. Bigger, Bolder and loaded with liquid diamonds! G.A. Liquid diamond 510 Carts takes our signature botanical terpene infused distillate and adds liquid diamonds to deliver our most potent line up yet.

variants.title: Chemzilla
variants.body_html: Chemzilla is a potent indica with Chemdawg x Godzilla Glue lineage. With aromas full of heavy earth and spicy chem, it’s got a beast of a nose with top terpenes that include caryophyllene, limonene and humulene. The buds are forest green in colour and coated in trichomes. Back Forty flower follows good cannabis protocols and is hang dried, dry trimmed, cured for 14 days and sealed with a humidity pack.

variants.title: Cherry Beerootchie Disposable Vape
variants.body_html:
This perfectly blended masterpiece delivers the bold, fizzy kick of classic cola, layered with sweet cherry and smooth vanilla for a nostalgic twist. Every inhale is a refreshing rush of familiar soda shop vibes, with a rich and creamy exhale that keeps you coming back for more.

Designed for convenience, this all-in-one disposable is crafted for on-the-go enjoyment with no refills or charging required. Just pure, effortless flavour with every puff.

variants.title: Strawberry Cheesecake Liquid Diamond Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Experience the irresistible pleasure of Papa's Herb Strawberry Cheesecake, a delightful treat reminiscent of freshly baked cheesecake, rich with the flavour of ripe strawberries. Enjoy this delightful sensation in our convenient 0.95g liquid diamond disposable! Come to Papa!

variants.title: Hawaiian Marker
variants.body_html: Colour outside the lines with Tuck Shop's Hawaiian Marker. This loud, tropical strain is a cross of Hawaiian Rain and Permanent Marker, bursting with bold notes of fruit, creamy gas, and just a pinch of floral funk.

variants.title: Sweet Green Apple Liquid Diamonds Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Enjoy the limited-edition Spinach® Sweet Green Apple Liquid Diamonds 1g vape, made with liquid diamonds! This treat will surely delight with buttery sweet caramel and tart-green apple flavour notes. Harvest that apple and melt that caramel every session with this delicious treat.

variants.title: Gluerangutan Cured Resin Disposable Vape
variants.body_html:
Extracted from our house-bred LSO Gluerangutan strain, this 100% pure single-strain Cured Resin All-in-One Vape delivers bold, terpy flavor-no added terpenes or distillate. Packed in the market-leading CCELL Ceramic FlexPro, this All-in-One Vape features ceramic core for the ultimate expresssion of Gluerangutan flavours and terpenes.

Gluerangutan is a hybrid back-cross of the legacy strain Harambe (OG Kush x GG4 x Hash Plant), offering a sweet and sour citrus burst with gassy undertones and a crisp mountain pine finish. Selected from a 100,000+ pheno hunt, it's crafted in small batches from our organically grown flower and extracted by Common Roots Extracts on Vancouver Island, BC.

Pure flavor. Small batch. Organically grown.

variants.title: Double Bubbs
variants.body_html: Old meets new with our fresh take on this infamous legacy strain. Get nostalgic with a double cross of Bubba OG x Pre-98 Bubba Kush. This sweet and spicy indica has reminiscent aromas of coffee, chocolate, and hash, balanced by notes of fresh flowers and woody pine on the dry pull. The elongated and bulky dark green buds are spotted with bright orange pistils and a thick frosting of amber-trichomes. This classic terpene profile offers a euphoric and relaxing experience, perfect for unwinding and reminiscing on simpler times.

Vegan, Natural, Rapid Onset.

Each Package contains 30 x 10:10mg THC:CBD Gummies. Terpenes: d-limonene, beta-caryophyllene, Myrcene, Linalool.

variants.title: Berry Melts Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Berry Melts is an indica 510 vape that delivers on flavour, effect, and potency. Its fruity, creamy, delicious terp profile makes for a smooth draw with a perfect consistency of clouds. Formulated with THC distillate and natural botanical terpenes.

variants.title: Strawberry Gshers Saucy Diamond Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Try the fruity Papa's Herb Strawberry Gshers. Strawberry Gshers has a sweet aroma of fresh strawberries and skunky berry notes.

variants.title: Maple RNTZ PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Maple Runtz is an Indica-dominant strain crossed with Boston Cream Pie and Runtz. This strain has a sweet and creamy flavour with hints of fresh berries, diesel and maple. The flower is milled and rolled into lightweight paper cones complete with a paper filter.

variants.title: Twisters-Bubba & Rainbow Infused PR 2 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Two-pack of half-gram infused pre-rolls, infused with botanical terpenes and distillate. This blend pairs the tropical fruit and pineapple of Bubba Bomb with the cherry-grape notes in Rainbow Booty.

variants.title: Double Baked Cake
variants.body_html: The Jolly Boys have arrived and are stoked to launch their Double Baked Cake! A tantalizing indica-dominant cultivar that delivers the ultimate Dessert experience, Double Baked Cake is the perfect blend of indulgent Cake and Cookie flavour profiles. This exquisite cultivar offers a rich symphony of sweet, creamy vanilla cake layered with buttery cookie dough undertones, all tied together with a whisper of spice. Terpenes include caryophyllene, limonene, and myrcene.

variants.title: Orange Crush Blunt 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Orange Crush Blunt combines California Orange x Blueberry to create a citrusy, sativa-dominant strain, wrapped in a non-tobacco, nicotine free, tea leaf blunt wrap. These dense, sticky buds have strong aromas of orange, sweet citrus, and diesel. BOLD Craft Cannabis is indoor grown, small batch, hang dried, slow cured and hand trimmed.

variants.title: Dab Rig Recycler
variants.body_html: This Recycler Dab Rig from Valiant packs high-end function into a sleek, compact design. Engineered with a recycler system that continuously cycles water through its chambers, it delivers smooth, cooled vapor with every hit. At just 6 inches tall, it’s perfectly sized for easy handling and storage without compromising performance—ideal for both daily use and travel. Key Features & Benefits Recycler Filtration System – Recirculates water for superior cooling, cleaner vapor, and enhanced flavour. Compact & Portable – Small stature makes it easy to use, store, and take on the go. Borosilicate Glass Build – Heat-resistant and durable for long-lasting reliability. Splash Guard Functionality – Helps keep water away from the mouthpiece for a cleaner hit. Smooth, Consistent Draws – Designed for efficiency, ensuring flavourful and comfortable sessions. Blending portability, durability, and advanced cooling, the Recycler Dab Rig delivers a premium dabbing experience in a travel-friendly size—perfect for anyone who wants big performance in a small package.

variants.title: Bent Neck Dab Rig Recycler-Milky Purple-6in(RCL-S-034MPP)
variants.body_html: This Valiant Bent Neck Recycler Dab Rig is a compact yet powerful piece designed to deliver ultra-smooth, flavour-packed hits. Its recycler system continuously cycles water through the chamber, cooling and filtering vapor for a cleaner, more enjoyable experience. Standing just 6 inches tall, this rig blends portability with premium function, making it ideal for both quick solo sessions and sharing with friends. Key Features & Benefits Recycler Design – Circulates water for maximum cooling and filtration, producing silky-smooth vapor. Bent Neck Mouthpiece – Keeps heat away from your face while providing a comfortable angle for inhaling. Compact Size – At only 6 inches tall, it’s easy to store, transport, and handle. Durable Borosilicate Glass – Heat-resistant and built to last, even with frequent use. Splash Guard Functionality – Prevents water from reaching the mouthpiece, ensuring a clean hit every time. With its efficient recycler system, ergonomic design, and durable glass construction, the Bent Neck Recycler Dab Rig offers a refined dabbing experience in a portable package—perfect for concentrate lovers who want smooth hits without sacrificing convenience.

variants.title: Tribal Aerolith Dry Herb Vaporizer
variants.body_html:
The Tribal Aerolith is a sleek, portable dry herb vaporizer designed for smooth, flavourful sessions wherever you go. Built with premium, heat-resistant materials and an intuitive one-button interface, it delivers reliable performance with minimal effort. Whether you’re at home or on the move, its compact design and rapid heating make it the perfect companion for effortless, on-demand enjoyment.

 Key Features & Benefits

 Compact & Portable – Lightweight, pocket-sized build makes it easy to carry and enjoy discreetly anywhere.

Four Precision Heat Settings – Tailor your session to maximize flavour, potency, or both.

Straight Airflow Path – Ensures a clean, pure taste while simplifying maintenance.

One-Button Operation – Power up, adjust heat, and start vaping with minimal steps.

Rapid Heat-Up – Spend less time waiting and more time enjoying your flower.

With its refined design, customizable temperature control, and effortless usability, the Tribal Aerolith offers a premium vaping experience that’s flavourful, convenient, and perfect for new and seasoned users alike.

variants.title: Famous X Ash Catcher - 45 Degree - Male 14mm
variants.body_html:
Give your setup a little upgrade with the Famous X Ash Catcher. This handy attachment does the dirty work by catching ash and debris before it ever hits your main piece. With its 45-degree angle and 14mm male joint, it’s an easy fit for most water pipes and makes every session smoother while keeping cleanup simple.

Key Features & Benefits:

45-Degree Joint: Angled design that lines up seamlessly with 45-degree setups.

14mm Male Connection: Works with most 14mm female joints.

Cleaner Sessions: Stops ash from reaching your pipe for smoother, fresher hits.

Less Cleaning Hassle: Cuts down on buildup so you spend less time scrubbing.

Solid Glass Build: Durable glass that’s made for everyday use.

Keep your piece fresher, longer with this simple but game-changing upgrade.

variants.title: Superberry Lemonade MAX10 Gummies
variants.body_html: This multipack contains 10 immediate containers, each with one soft chew-for a total of 10 soft chews. SHRED'ems Superberry Lemonade Party Pack has 10 packs of MAX10 gummies, each with 10mg THC for a total 100MG THC PER PACK! These juicy, sativa gummies are jammed full of a sweet red berry-lemonade blast yer gonna love.

variants.title: Glazed Indica PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Smooth, strong, and straight to the point. This 2x1g pre-roll pack features a rotating selection of single-strain, indica flower - always high in THC. Whole flower and hand crafted, just the way your pre-rolls should be.

variants.title: Stink Biscuit PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Stink Biscuit Pre-Rolls by San Raf is a 3-pack of high-THC indica pre-rolls. Each pre-roll is packed with 0.5-grams of milled whole flower of Stink Biscuit, a premium and uniquely pungent indica with notes of gas, funk, and sourdough. Expertly rolled for a clean, even burn, each Stink Biscuit Pre-Rolls pack comes in an aright, resealable doob tube with a humidity pack included.

variants.title: THCa2 Lemon Lime Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: THCa² Lemon Lime is crafted with a dual infusion of THCA-coated flower and liquid diamonds to deliver a potent 55% THC. This indica-dominant pre-roll pack bursts with a sweet, bubbly citrus flavour from our proprietary terpene blend — bold and smooth, just like a classic lemon-lime soda.

variants.title: Pink Lemonade Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: The lemonade stand just got lit. Pink Lemonade Liquid Diamond vapes bring a tangy-sweet hit of citrus and berry with 95%+ THC. It’s a throwback to sunny summers with plenty of heat. Bigger, Bolder and loaded with liquid diamonds! G.A. Liquid diamond 510 Carts takes our signature botanical terpene infused distillate and adds liquid diamonds to deliver our most potent line up yet.

variants.title: East Coast Aged Hash
variants.body_html: Rooted in tradition and made with love, Jublee East Coast Hash brings the warmth of hand crafted expertise to your cannabis. Made with a Moroccan style dry sift method and a Caribbean landrace inspired cultivar, this hash has a boost of CBG kief. With high THC, it’s a smooth and flavourful product. It has a rich and earthy flavour.

variants.title: Strawberry Watermelon Gummies
variants.body_html: Keep the sun flowing with Thumbs Up Strawberry Watermelon Gummies! Packed with 10 gummies at 10 mg THC each, these delicious treats strike the perfect balance between juicy strawberry sweetness and crisp, fresh watermelon.

variants.title: Glenn's No. 16 Rosin Cotton Clouds Gummies
variants.body_html: Indulge in the sweet nostalgia of Cotton Candy with Glenn's No. 7 - Delta 9 Distillate XL Gummy. This large-format gummy is perfect for those who love a big, bold treat. Glenn's Cotton Clouds brings you a delightful cotton candy flavour. Each package of Glenn's Cotton Clouds contains a generous portion of fluffy, sugary goodness infused with 10 mg of Delta 9 THC, delivering a smooth and potent experience.

variants.title: Mega Packs Bal THC:CBD 1:1
variants.body_html: An incredible 100-pack of softgels containing 10mg of THC and 10mg of CBD in each capsule. Tasteless and odourless, providing a discreet option for those seeking the benefits of these 2 cannabinoids.

variants.title: Orange Crush PR 28 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Skip the fridge and glass, and enjoy the citrus blast from these juicy pre-rolls! Orange Crush features a bright, terpene-rich profile of limonene, caryophyllene, and myrcene for an orange delight. These whole flower pre-rolls deliver a hearty level of THC with a juicy delight. Grown in small batches with every pre-roll handcrafted, squeeze sunshine on demand with Orange Crush!!

variants.title: Jungle Joints PR 28 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Virtue Cannabis' Jungle Joints bring you our best flower in unbleached ultra fine cones, for your convenience! No shake or stem, these blends bring together the unique profiles of our premium flower. Our small batch, hang dried, slow cured premium flower is delicately milled to maintain consistency and potency.

variants.title: Princess Cut Shungite Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: The Princess Cut Shungite Infused Pre-Rolls are crafted to shine from the first spark to the last pull. Infused with potent liquid diamonds and finished with a sparkling layer of THCa diamonds, it delivers a smooth, flavourful burn that feels both elevated and opulent. The Earl Grey ice cream profile brings a delicate balance of creamy sweetness and aromatic bergamot, making each hit as unique as it is memorable. Created with care and precision, this pre-roll is made for those who appreciate sophistication in every detail.

variants.title: Princess Cut Blue Topaz Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Queen of Bud’s Blue Topaz infused pre-rolls are infused with liquid diamonds and coated in THCa diamonds. These pre-rolls deliver bold potency and a clean, even burn. Expect a vibrant blueberry açai flavour that stands out from the first inhale. Crafted with care and precision, Blue Topaz is a refined expression of elevated cannabis.

variants.title: Princess Cut Amethyst Alignment Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Queen of Bud’s Amethyst Alignment infused pre-rolls are a curated blend of power and flavour. Each pre-roll is infused with liquid diamonds and coated in THCa diamonds for a smooth and elevated experience. This pack features a standout profile of lavender and vanilla that's subtle, yet impactful. Crafted with care, these pre-rolls are made for those who value quality, consistency and taste.

variants.title: Super Silver Bubba PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Roll out with Super Silver Bubba, the newest five-pack of half-gram joints, packed with flower grown in-house at their brand-new indoor facility in Salmon Arm. Bred from the iconic Super Silver Haze x Bubba Kush cross, this hybrid brings classic West Coast energy with fresh finesse: earthy pine, citrus zest, and a little hashy hug on the finish. When the deal is real, it’s DEALR. Grown with care, crafted with authentic BC love, and priced so everyone can get in on the good stuff.

variants.title: BC Selects: Sprits 26
variants.body_html: BC Selects is a new offering from Broken Coast that deepens our commitment to offering the very best to our backyard; an exclusive and limited first release of new Broken Coast strains. These strains are chosen by Master Grower Kevin from hundreds of in-house phenotypes, as the best-in-class genetics showcasing Broken Coast’s commitment to cannabis excellence; cola-quality buds, rich trichomes, bold terps & unmistakable Broken Coast quality. Non-irradiated, these lots allow BC consumers to experience these strains in their purest state. BC Selects’ first release is Sprits 26, the 26th phenotype of a Spritzer genetic origin. This 50/50 hybrid strain delivers a minty, earthy flavour with a sweet and gassy finish, and is high in nerolidol, caryophyllene and geranyl acetate. Available for a limited-time-only.

variants.title: OG Kush
variants.body_html: For the first time, the remake is going to be better than the original. Spinach OG Kush is our new take on a classic strain making for a super flavourful and potent cultivar. A cross between GMO #12 and SFV OG, get earthy, piney, and citrusy flavours and aromas pumped up from terps like myrcene, limonene, and caryophyllene. This powerhouse cross doesn't only make for a flavourful strain, it pumps up the potency to insane levels and makes it the newest 'OG' experience you won't want to miss.

variants.title: Citrus Haze Distillate Infused PR 5 x 0.5g
variants.body_html:
Your short-cut to sunny days. Citrus Haze is dialed up to 38%+ THC, soaked in rays of tangy orange, lemon-lime citrusy flavour. Consider this your citrus mic drop.

Made with milled whole flower, infused with our signature triple-distilled distillate, dusted in premium kief, and boosted with botanical terpenes - these infused pre-rolls deliver smooth hits, high THC potency, and the BIG, BOLD flavour you expect from G.A.!

variants.title: Caps Junky Bubble Infused PR 1 x 1g
variants.body_html: Truro's Caps Junky Bubble Pre-Roll combines the 'best of both worlds' for a truly unique craft cannabis experience. This potent infused pre-roll contains a 50/50 blend of 100% craft Caps Junky flower (Kush Mints 11 X Animal Cookies) infused with single - strain bubble hash produced from 100% Caps Junky flower. Flavour profile is sweet, fruity, and minty. Caps Junky Bubble Pre-Rolls are produced from the whole flower of our best-in-class batches proudly grown on the East Coast in Truro, Nova Scotia in our small batch production facility - where each bud is carefully cultivated, hang-dried, hand-trimmed and slow-cured (21-28 days). Caps Junky Bubble Hash is produced in-house from 100% Caps Junky flower using a solventless ice water extraction process - resulting in a clean and pure single-strain hash product. The low temperatures used in our extraction & pressing process ensure minimal loss of terpenes, and results in a consistent and premium infused pre-roll experience.

variants.title: Space Cake
variants.body_html: Dive into a baker’s bowl of frosting, sweetness, and colour with this decadent and frosty flower. With crystal clear buds and creamy flavours, Space Cake takes you on a delicious journey. With lineage that traces back to Snow Lotus and Girl Scout Cookies, this cultivar hits when it comes to looks, tastes, and smells. Caked with stick-to-your-fingers trichomes, this cultivar is a delicious delight with classic terpenes like Limonene, Caryophyllene and Humulene.

variants.title: Moon Drops Liquid Diamond AIO Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: DEBUNK Moon Drops Ice All-in-One Vape is indica-dominant with lychee, pear, citrus, and berries. Hydrocarbon process turns THCA diamonds into THC liquid diamond isolate, enhanced with botanical terpenes. Housed in USB-C rechargeable hardware with a wide-mouth airflow to reduce clogging.

variants.title: Blue Zushi
variants.body_html: Blue Zushi, a cross of Zkittlez and Kush Mintz, delivers a complex, gassy aroma complemented by a smooth, sweet tropical flavour. Its dense, chunky buds showcase vibrant green and blue hues, coated in shimmering trichomes. Terpenes include beta-caryophyllene, limonene, and beta-myrcene. Pistol and Paris products are grown with care, attention, and intention. All crops are hang-dried, cold-cured, and hand trimmed to preserve quality. Every step is carefully done by hand to honour each unique cultivar and showcase its fullest expression.

variants.title: Sour Tangerine Live Resin Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: 7ACRES Sour Tangerine Live Resin Infused PRJs offer a heavy-hitting, cannabis-derived terpene infusion alongside sun-grown flower nurtured in living soil. Embrace the beauty of the great outdoors, now captured in every aromatic infused pre-roll.

variants.title: Tropical Skunk
variants.body_html: Born from the collision of Blackout Bobby and Maximum Carnage, Fade to Black is a heavy indica that offers a decadent blend of creamy fruit, cocoa, and dank kush with a gassy finish — all wrapped in dense, trichome-coated buds that sparkle like midnight frost. Each bud is expertly hand-trimmed, hang-dried, and carefully cured over three weeks to unlock its full potential. Terpenes commonly include caryophyllene, limonene, and farnesene.

variants.title: Limited Reserve PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Natural History's Limited Reserve Sativa features a curated, rotating selection from Canada’s best small batch growers. Enjoy our featured sativa cultivar in a ready-to-enjoy pre-roll format. Staying true to our brand ethos, we aim to support our community, stay true to strain, and bring our consumers the best product experience at the best price possible. Don't miss out on these flavourful limited drops!

variants.title: Strawnana Liquid Diamonds Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Push the limit with the maximum potency and optimal performance of DEBUNK Strawnana liquid diamond vapes. Level up your vape with this crisp indica, balancing sweet strawberry flavour, earthy notes, and a subtle citrus accent to keep it fresh. Our proprietary hydrocarbon extraction process converts THCa diamonds into an ultra-pure, ultra-potent THC liquid diamond isolate that is then enhanced with a custom botanical terpene formulation. A pure, potent, and consistent sesh from the first puff.

variants.title: Country Club PR 7 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Woody Nelson's Country Club is a series of limited releases featuring some of our favourite growers and genetics. Selection is based on an internal 31-point scoring system with an emphasis on production practices, morphology, experience, and lab results. Each sliding tin includes craft pre-rolls made with natural hemp paper and packed with a Boveda humidity pack.

variants.title: Neon Sour
variants.body_html: Neon Sour by San Raf is a high THC sativa that’s a feast for both the eyes and nose. Bred from G13 x Super Skunk, Neon Sour buds come in vivid colours like a green highlighter exploded in bud form. Open the jar and experience bold aromas of hazy citrus rounded out with sour, floral and cleaner terpenes. Like all San Raf flower, Neon Sour is hang dried, hand finished and hand packaged with a humidity packet.

variants.title: Quantum Kush PR 7 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: 1Spliff’s Quantum Kush is a classic craft pre-roll. Grown indoors in craft batches, this strain is hang dried, hand trimmed and hand packaged, preserving the integrity of its legacy roots. A genetic mix of Sweet Irish Kush x Timewreck, Quantum Kush delivers a bold and pungent aroma with layers of earthy pine, citrus and a hint of spice. It’s rich in caryophyllene, making it both flavourful and terpene-forward. These pre-rolls are for the ones who want heritage strains with that modern, small batch quality you can taste in every puff.

variants.title: Flavoured Peaches & Cream PR 4 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Riding the next wave in flavour infused pre-rolls, Double J’s Terpnami drops Peaches & Cream, a smooth and juicy blend. Ripe, sun kissed peach on the inhale meets a velvety cream finish, leaving behind a sweet aftertaste. Peaches bring the bright and fruity punch. Cream delivers the soft and silky close. Together, it’s a flawless fusion of sweetness and sophistication. No distillate. No shortcuts. Just whole flower and flavour. Terpnami style.

variants.title: Gorilla Berry Grape Liquid Diamonds Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Elevate your vaping experience with Tweed Gorilla Berry Grape Liquid Diamonds 510 cart. This potent product is not just a vape — it’s your ticket to a grape-escape.

variants.title: Purple Churro Redees Hemp'd PR 20 x 0.4 g
variants.body_html: Purple Churro Redees Hemp’d deliver the cinnamon and vanilla flavours from our Apples & Bananas x Cinnamon Horchata cross, now in a pack of perfectly portioned straight cut pre-rolls wrapped in ultra thin, unbleached hemp paper for a slow, flavour packed burn. With high THC and dominant terpenes such as limonene, nerolidol and caryophyllene, expect rich and aromatic smoke that's smooth and steady. The potent sativa is meticulously grown, hang dried, hand trimmed and milled to perfection before being rolled into hemp paper that enhances the flower flavour.

variants.title: Black Jelly
variants.body_html: Black Jelly by San Raf is an indoor grown strain developed from Alien Cake 3030 genetics. What makes this sativa so special is its one-of-a-kind aroma of licorice and anise with hidden notes of sweet fruit. Its dense buds come impressive in size and shape with eye catching green and orange hues, topped with a coat of sparkling trichomes. Cultivated under high quality standards, San Raf flower is hang dried, hand finished and hand packaged with a humidity packet.

variants.title: Strawberry Cough Diamond Live Resin AIO Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Strawberry Diamond Live Resin AIO operates like a diamond-powered freight train. Exclusively designed for MAX, this one-of-a-kind AIO is engineered to unleash the full force of our high-potency Liquid Diamonds Live Resin formulation, delivering a potent 90-95% THC. Packed with cannabis-derived terpenes, it captures the true-to-strain essence of Strawberry Cough — bold, strawberry-rich, with a smooth, earthy finish.

variants.title: Mochazilla Live Rosin
variants.body_html: The Goo! Mochazilla Live Rosin delivers a bold experience with rich coffee and cocoa aromas, enhanced by a unique cannabinoid profile featuring rare compounds including CBGA, THCVA and CBCA. Crafted in small batches in Alberta using a solventless process, this live rosin is made from fresh frozen whole flower extracted with ice water and pressed at low temperatures. Cold cured and whipped for consistency, Mochazilla offers a rich, distinctive profile.

variants.title: Pure Live Resin AIO Variety Pack Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: The Sherbinskis Variety Pack offers two all-in-ones in our favourite flavours. Pink Sherbs live resin brings a strong strawberry profile with hints of sweet cream, drawing on its Gelato roots. Orange Sherbs features a sweet citrus and earthy aroma with a tropical finish, a classic Sherbinskis flavour profile.

variants.title: HyperNova Haze PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Blast off with HyperNova Haze, a potent sativa from Far Out Crops. Expect a bright, explosive terp profile. Rolled from premium flower, not shake, these pre-rolls deliver a clean, smooth burn that’s anything but ordinary. Far Out Crops — the truth is out there… and it smokes.

variants.title: Jungle Tongue NSFW Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Jungle Tongue NSFW Liquid Diamond vapes from Adults Only are a wild ride for your taste buds. variants.title: THC Multipack Blue Raspberry Gummies
variants.body_html: Bold, tangy, and bursting with berry, these Olli O's Sour Blue Raspberry gummies deliver a puckered punch of flavour in every bite. variants.title: Modified Grapes
variants.body_html: Modified Grapes is made from a genetic cross between GMO and Purple Punch. These buds have rounded and fluffy dark olive green buds with purple undertones, thin orange hairs and a coating of dark purple tinted, white trichomes. Top terpenes include myrcene, limonene and caryophyllene.

variants.title: Blackberry Seltzer 4 Pack
variants.body_html: Mollo Blackberry Seltzer is made without sugar. Each can is bubbling with bold blackberry flavour and packed with 10 mg of THC from nano-emulsified THCA diamonds and 20 mg of CBG. Naturally flavoured.

variants.body_html: "Say hello to the Yocan Sip Smart Rig—your new go-to for low-key, high-quality concentrate sessions. Disguised as a travel tumbler, this sleek e-rig delivers smooth, flavourful hits with advanced ceramic heating and customizable temp control. Four Temperature Settings - Choose between 490°F–545°F to dial in your perfect hit. Smart Alerts - Lights and gentle vibration let you know when it’s good to go. Built-In Water Filtration - Cools and filters each pull for smoother, cleaner vapor. 180 mAh Battery + USB-C Charging - Lasts for over 20 sessions and charges fast. Joystick Control System - Easy, intuitive control with just a flick of your thumb. The Yocan Sip Smart Rig packs smart features and strong performance into a clean, discreet design. Whether you’re looking for flavour, smoothness, or total stealth, the Sip delivers—no mess, no fuss, just premium concentrate sessions whenever and wherever you want."

variants.title: Dream Weaver
variants.body_html: Dream Weaver offers unique earthy and floral aromas. Fresh quality and potency sourced from Ontario growers.

variants.title: Purple Trainwreck PR 10 X 0.3 g
variants.body_html: Purple Trainwreck is a hybrid cultivar from the iconic Trainwreck x Granddaddy Purple strains. This lineage combines the invigorating, citrusy notes of Trainwreck with the grape-forward qualities of Granddaddy Purple. Together, they create a balanced profile.

variants.title: Organic Mint Chocolate Chip Petites
variants.body_html: Mint Chocolate Chip is an award-winning cut that’s earned itself far-reaching accolades across Canada and internationally since it was launched in the legal market in 2021. Now available in a brand-new, high quality, 14g 'Petites' format for those looking for more bang for their buck. Hunted and developed by the team at Sweetgrass, its dense, resin-laden buds are packed with a unique and rich herbaceous aroma that exudes a certain skunkiness when broken open. Notes of cool mint and subtle cocoa become more apparent when the flower is combusted making for a smooth smoke that finishes with a slight tang on the exhale. As with all craft flower from Sweetgrass, Mint Chocolate Chip is living soil grown, certified organic, and 100% hand-tended all the way from clone to package. One hit and you’ll know why it took home top prize at both the Karma Cup and Unicorn Cup.

variants.title: Coffee Creamer
variants.body_html: ?Inspired by the smoothest part of your morning ritual, Coffee Creamer is a cultivar worth savouring. This Seed Junky genetic is a decadent indica with rich, creamy coffee and vanilla flavours and hits as satisfying as your first sip. A cross of Zkittles x Kush Mints, this indulgent genetic pairs old-school depth with dessert-like nuance for an indulgent taste that lingers.

variants.title: Double Mango Liquid Diamonds AIO Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Expect big flavour and high potency from this Double Mango Liquid Diamonds all-in-one. This eco-friendly disposable vape has a removable and recyclable battery housed in a biodegradable corn PLA shell. Fresh mango aromas burst with tropical sweetness from this potent blend of liquid diamonds and live resin. The rechargeable all-in-one hardware is perfectly calibrated and optimized for this specific formula.

variants.title: Thin Mint x Jealousy
variants.body_html:
Thin Mint x Jealousy was pheno hunted by our team in-house and was bred by Seed Junky. As you might guess from the name, this drop is a cross of Thin Mint and Jealousy. Upon opening your pouch, you can expect some dense, frosty nugs with a bright aroma of orange, sweet gas, and a hint of wood.

Because it's the right thing to do, all of our flower is hang-dried, hand-trimmed, slow cold-cured, and hand-packaged. We keep it fresh and terpy by sealing it in nitrogen-flushed pouches with a humidity pack inside. And yeah-non-irradiated, obviously.

variants.title: Blueberry Dream
variants.body_html: Big Bag o' Buds brings you Blueberry Dream, a potent sativa strain with high THC that’s as bold as it is smooth. A cross of Blueberry Kush x Blue Dream, this strain delivers sweet, floral and berry aromas.

variants.title: GMO Live Hash Rosin
variants.body_html: Available for limited time only. GMO Live Hash Rosin has a smooth, creamy texture with bold gas aromas from its Girl Scout Cookies lineage, and a touch of sourness from the Chemdog. Sustainably sun-grown at Creative Earth's regenerative farm on Vancouver Island. The flower is fresh frozen at harvest then expertly processed at the Dabble Cannabis Co. family farm, preserving its full terpene and cannabinoid profile for a pure flavourful experience.

variants.title: Rainbow Fuego
variants.body_html: Rainbow Fuego from DEALR is a dynamic sativa dominant flower bred by Seed Junky with the legendary lineage of Rainbow Sherbet and Rntz. These buds are a kaleidoscope of colour, showcasing bright lime green tones, deep purple highlights and fiery orange pistils, all blanketed in a thick, shimmering layer of icy trichomes. The aroma dazzles with tropical fruit, sweet citrus and a creamy candy twist. On the palate, it’s a juicy explosion of fruity sweetness, sugar and a zesty kick that lives up to its name.

variants.title: Blue Dream #16
variants.body_html: Blue Dream #16 is a hand-picked pheno of Blue Dream selected for its complex fruit aromas, impressive bud structure and elevated potency. Pure Sunfarms growers have been nurturing this West Coast-favourite sativa in their greenhouse for years, always on the hunt for new expressions of the cultivar—and this pheno delivers. Blue Dream #16 boasts frosty, long-stretching, lime-green buds and dreamy aromas of citrus, blueberry, spice, and cake from terpenes limonene, beta-pinene, and ocimene. Pure BC bud, hand-harvested, and hang-dried.

variants.title: M'Mosa PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Introducing M'mosa—the latest sativa offering from 1964. Its zesty orange aroma is balanced by subtle floral notes and a hint of earthiness. Terpenes include limonene, myrcene, and caryophyllene.

variants.title: Chemdog PR 3 x 0.5 g

variants.body_html: Meet Versus GSC Shatter, a powerhouse indica crafted for those who crave potency and rich flavour. High potency and bold flavour make it a must-have, offering an experience that pays homage to this legendary cultivar.

variants.title: Waffle Cone

They grow everything in living soils, full of good microbes and nutrients, which make the buds taste better and burn smoother, while keeping things eco-friendly. Every flower is picked by hand, hang-dried, and slow-cured in small batches using legacy methods. variants.title: Sticky Pineapple All-In-One Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Back Forty's all-in-one vape is designed to put the Back Forty in the palm of your hand. With a compact design and rechargeable battery, it balances function and format. Sticky Pineapple is a juicy troublemaker that's dripping and golden.

variants.title: Black Cheese
variants.body_html: Black Cheese is a bold and dynamic sativa that fuses old school funk with new school luxury. A cross of the legendary UK Cheese and the exotic Black Truffle, the aroma is unmistakable. It has a pungent, cheesy funk laced with earthy, truffle-like richness. As you break apart the dense, frosty buds, sharp notes of aged cheese and a hint of sweet spice fill the air.

variants.title: Liquid Diamond Lychee Lime - AIO Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Infused with liquid diamonds and boasting a potent high THC, this sativa-dominant 1g vape delivers smooth, flavourful hits. Zesty lime and delicate lychee sweetness combine for a perfectly balanced flavour experience, all in a convenient, ready-to-use disposable vape.

variants.title: Fully Blasted Caramel Green Apple Gummies
variants.body_html: Prepare for blast off! Limited edition SOURZ by Spinach® Fully Blasted Caramel Green Apple gummies are action-packed with 10mg THC per piece. Enjoy buttery, sweet caramel and tart-green apple flavours! This dual-flavoured gummy is over-the-top with natural flavours and blasted with sour crystals. Enjoy 1 gummy per pack, 10mg THC total.

variants.title: TenTen Sunny Drift Live Rosin Gummies
variants.body_html: Enjoy TenTen Sunny Drift, a premium cannabis gummy crafted with plant-based, natural, and non-GMO ingredients. This single gummy delivers 10mg of THC, infused with high-quality live rosin for a smooth, full-spectrum experience, and bright, fresh flavours.

variants.title: Cherry Watermelon Distillate Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Slide into bold flavour! Cherry Watermelon packs a rush of juicy cherry and watermelon that hits like a wave. Made with milled whole flower, infused with their signature triple-distilled distillate, dusted in premium kief, and boosted with botanical terpenes—these infused pre-rolls deliver smooth hits and the BIG, BOLD flavour you expect from G.A.!

variants.title: Purple Punch Mints x Orange Kush Cake Mixed Pack
variants.body_html: The Purple Punch Mints x Orange Kush Cake Mixed Pack offers the sweet, fruity and creamy blend of Purple Punch Mints #11, with the citrus, vanilla and spice of Orange Kush Cake. This combination is smooth and flavourful. Two standout cultivars, one unbeatable pack.

variants.title: Watermelon G-Bear Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Watermelon G-Bear is sweet and chewy with watermelon flavour.

variants.title: Mega Purple Gummies
variants.body_html: Available for a limited time only, the Mega Purple Gummy features Gastro Pop by JR Strain, extracted by Wildcard Extracts, and made into gummies by Elevate in Port Coquitlam. Each bag includes 10 x 10mg resin-infused gummies with notes of grape, elderberry, and black currant. Made in BC.

variants.title: Cabana Cannabis Co. 3-Stage Grinder Surfari Red
variants.body_html: Grind in style with Cabana Cannabis Co. grinders. Made from aluminum, this iconic 50mm grinder is durable and easy to use. Incredibly sharp diamond-cut teeth tear and fluff your herb to perfection. Once ground enough, flower falls into the center holding section. The sifting screen then goes to work filtering your most post bits to the bottom for a special surprise. This red grinder has a dangerously dope design on the top and comes packaged in its own box.

variants.title: Fully Blasted Strawberry Mango Gummies
variants.body_html: This multipack contains 10 immediate containers, each with one soft chew-for a total of 10 soft chews. Prepare for blast off! SOURZ by Spinach Fully Blasted Strawberry Mango gummies are action-packed with 10mg THC per piece. Bring on thundering bursts of flavour with luscious strawberry and tropical mango! These dual-flavoured gummies are over-the-top with natural flavours and blasted with sour crystals. Enjoy 10 gummies per pack with 100mg THC per gummy and 100mg THC total per pack.

variants.title: Gargantuan Grape Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Massive explosions of fruity terpene infused distillate flavour with a LIVE ROSIN AMPLIFIED full spectrum experience! Why choose when you can have the best of both worlds?

variants.title: HoneyStick Quatro Variable Voltage Vape Multi
HoneyStick Quatro Variable Voltage Vape Red
XVAPE - Aria Plus Dual Use Vaporizer - Frostwave
variants.body_html:
The XVape Aria+ brings together sleek design, cutting-edge upgrades, and refined performance for a next-level vaping experience. Featuring a hand-blown borosilicate glass mouthpiece and a ceramic conduction oven, this portable powerhouse delivers clean, flavourful vapor with fast heat-up and full temperature control. Its durable metal body, USB-C fast charging, and precision-engineered airflow make it a standout choice for dry herb and concentrate users who want both power and purity in the palm of their hand.

Key Features & Benefits:

Borosilicate Glass Mouthpiece: Preserves terpene flavour and cools vapor for a smoother draw

USB-C Charging: Faster and more efficient charging with pass-through capability

Ceramic Heating Chamber: Even heat distribution with rapid 15-second warm-up

Full Temp Control (212°F – 464°F): Fine-tune your session with precision

OLED Screen & Haptic Feedback: Clear visuals and subtle vibration alerts for a responsive experience

Isolated Airflow System: Ensures clean, uncontaminated vapor

Dual Session Timers: Choose from 5 or 10-minute sessions to match your preference

Built-in Scraping Tool: Convenient and discreet for on-the-go maintenance

Durable Metal Frame: Built to last with a premium finish

Compatible with Dry Herb and Concentrates: Versatile functionality for any preference

Available in Two Finishes: Choose from sleek Black or cool Frostwave

Portable, powerful, and purpose-built, the XVape Aria+ redefines what a compact vaporizer can do.

variants.title: Clipper Classic Micro Lighter
variants.body_html:
Small in size but big on performance, the Clipper Classic Micro Lighter is your go-to flame for convenience and reliability. Designed for portability and built with the quality Clipper is known for, this compact lighter is perfect for travel, daily use, or quick sessions. Refillable and equipped with a removable flint system, it's a smart and sustainable choice for anyone who values both function and style.

Key Features & Benefits:

Compact Size: Ultra-portable and easy to carry in any pocket, pouch, or stash bag.

Refillable: Built to last—simply refill with butane and keep it going.

Removable Flint System: Dual-purpose tool ideal for packing or tamping.

Consistent Flame: Reliable ignition for smooth, steady lighting every time.

Durable Design: Made with tough materials for long-term use.

Eco-Friendly Option: A reusable alternative to disposable lighters.

Your everyday spark, downsized for maximum convenience.

variants.title: Tribal – Genetic Pro 510 Batteries – Neon Sunshine
variants.body_html:
Designed for efficiency and portability, the Tribal Genetic Pro 510 Battery delivers a reliable and customizable vaping experience in a sleek, pocket-friendly design. Whether you're chasing flavour or maximizing vapor output, this battery gives you total control with adjustable voltage and a bright OLED display that keeps your stats in check. Built with convenience in mind, it includes a pre-heat function for thick oils and a USB-C charging port to keep you powered up without the wait.

Key Features & Benefits:

Adjustable Voltage (1.8–4.2V): Fine-tune your session from smooth, low-temp hits to powerful clouds.

OLED Display: Stay informed with real-time voltage, battery life, and puff count.

Puff Counter: Track your usage with precision for better control.

Pre-Heat Function (10 sec): Gently warms oil before use, ideal for thicker concentrates.

Safety Cut-Off (15 sec): Helps prevent overheating and overuse.

Type-C Charging (Cable Included): Fast, efficient charging with modern convenience.

510 Thread Connection: Universal compatibility with most cartridges.

Available in Multiple Variants: Choose from Drip Station, Galactic Rntz, Jigglers, Neon Sunshine, or Triple Burger to match your vibe.

Dependable, stylish, and built for on-the-go performance—this is the 510 battery reimagined.

variants.title: BC Organic Sunset Runtz
variants.body_html: When two powerhouse genetics collide, expect great things. From our friends at Gastown Genetics, BC Organic Sunset Runtz brings bold aromas of gas with a complex backing of spicey and sweet notes. This heavy hitting Indica Hybrid marries Sunset Sherbet with Runtz, to create this tantalizing cultivar that will impress even the most discerning enthusiast

variants.title: Frosted Icicles - White Freeze Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Back Forty's Frosted Icicles are infused pre-rolls coated in a layer of THCa diamonds, for a blend of potency, aroma and flavour in expertly rolled cones. White Freeze is sweet and frosty with an icy cool exhale.

variants.title: Solventless Live Rosin SOUR Blue Raz Gummies
variants.body_html: La Boca Solventless Live Rosin Sour Blue Raz soft chews offer a full plant entourage effect paired with a robust classic sour candy flavour. Natural colour, natural flavour, made without animal products and strain specific.

variants.title: Flyin’ Hawaiian - Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Catch the wave of fruit punch flavours in the Flyin’ Hawaiian vape. This classic red flavour is blended into high potency distillate, infused with liquid diamonds, and packed into our crinkle straw vape for bigger, better pulls.

variants.title: GAS Tank: Single Strain Cold Cure Resin Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: With 75-85%+ THC, GAS Tank delivers pure, strain-specific potency with bold flavour and a true-to-flower experience — no additives, just full-spectrum cold cure resin. Smooth, potent, and built for those who demand the best — fuel up with GAS Tank.

variants.title: Master Kush Ultra PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Known among cannabis enthusiasts for its storied lineage, Master Kush Ultra is an indica-dominant cultivar with a pungent, skunky, earthy aroma and a flavour profile featuring peppery gas and subtle citrus notes. Pistol and Paris products are true craft cannabis—grown with care, attention, and intention. Each batch is whole-plant hang dried, cold cured, and hand-trimmed to preserve quality at every stage. This pack includes ten half gram pre-rolls, each filled with expertly milled whole flower and hand-finished with a Dutch crown. The result is a smooth, consistent burn that reflects the brand’s commitment to craftsmanship.

variants.title: Paradise Sunrise Orange Diamond Infused PR 2 x 0.5 g Orange
variants.body_html: Craftport's 2 x 0.5g Paradise Sunrise Infused Pre-rolls are crafted with White OG flower, diamonds, and orange botanical terpenes.

variants.title: Two Pack Permanently Jealous x Bananaconda PR 6 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Two strains conveniently available in a 6 pack tin of pre rolls. Up first is Permanently Jealous. Bred by us in collaboration with the team at Treez, Permanently Jealous is a cross of Permanent Market and Jealous. With this heavy hitter, you can expect big notes of gas, funk, and soap. Up next is Bananaconda, bred by the team at Jasper Farms. Bananaconda is a cross of Snake Cake and Dual OG #4, delivering its namesake flavors of banana, cream, and gas.

variants.title: Red Apple Peach Gummies
variants.body_html: SHRED’ems Red Apple Peach Party Pack is a 10-pack of MAX10 gummies, each with 10mg THC for a total 100MG THC PER PACK! These juicy indica gummies blend the crisp sweetness of red apple with the smooth, mellow flavour of ripe juicy peach.

variants.title: Charlotte's Web Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: This unique cultivar is prized for reliable CBD and CBG content. With our focus on premium quality flower this hand trimmed ultra small batch is complimented by additional Charlotte's Web kief, extracted in house. This kief provides a smooth even burn without soggy oil soaked papers. High in Pinene and Myrcene, it presents a delicate herbal flavour, with a light hint of mint finish.

variants.title: Cherry Doughnuts PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Cherry Donuts, a cross between Purple Cherry Punch and Jelly Doughnuts, is known for its distinctive and enticing doughnut-like aroma, bringing together sweet and dessert-like characteristics with hints of fuel. Its buds are dense, vibrant green and purple. A generous coating of resin gives the buds a frosty and glistening appearance, she’s super unique, carrying subtle undertones of vanilla and cinnamon, adding depth to the overall doughnut-like scent. Their pre-rolls are filled with all bud and no shake for maximum enjoyment and a consistent experience. Trimmed and cured whole flower milled and machine rolled.

variants.title: Pink Death
variants.body_html: Pink Death, a D Bubba x Pink Kush cross, is a potent indica that features rock hard frosty buds. Its dank pine aroma leads to a spicy, sweet and earthy flavour with berry, peppery and gassy notes. The medium green triangular buds are covered in trichomes with orange highlights, offering a crisp pine and diesel scent.

variants.title: Premium Smalls
variants.body_html: Come on down to Woody's Warehouse for a rotating selection of premium smalls from their favourite growers.

variants.title: Puffco Peak Pro 3DXL – Pearl
variants.body_html:
The Peak Pro 3DXL isn’t just a smart rig—it’s a game-changer for hash enthusiasts. Designed for flavour fanatics and performance seekers, this premium device features the patented 3DXL Chamber, delivering bigger hits, smoother pulls, and mind-blowing flavour. Plus, with the Puffco Connect app, you get full control to dial in your perfect session, all from your phone.

From the joystick carb cap to the laser-cut perc slots for enhanced water filtration, every detail is engineered for an unmatched hash experience. Whether you're a seasoned dabber or just getting started, the Peak Pro 3DXL is here to take your sessions to the next level.

Key Features & Benefits
3DXL Chamber: Bigger chamber = bigger dabs and even more flavour. Simple math.
Real-Time Temperature Control: Keeps your hits consistent and perfectly dialed in—no guesswork.
4 Customizable Heat Profiles: Find your sweet spot and save it for every mood or strain.
40 Dabs Per Charge (Average): Ready to sesh all day? This rig’s got you covered.
20-Second Heat-Up Time: Quick and easy—because no one likes to wait.
2-Hour Fast Charge Time: Power up fast and get back to what matters.
Bluetooth App Connectivity: Total customization in the palm of your hand.
Customizable LED Lights: Set the vibe with light colours that match your mood.
Auto-Sleep Function: It powers down when you’re done, so you don’t have to.
Wireless Qi Charging: Ditch the cords and charge in style.
USB-C Connection: Modern, reliable, and fast.
Carrying Case Included: Take your Peak Pro 3DXL wherever the good times call.
With top-tier innovation and the ultimate user-friendly design, the Peak Pro 3DXL is more than just a rig—it’s your new best friend for hash adventures. Get ready to unlock the plant's full potential with every hit!

variants.title: Ongrok 4 Piece EZ Open Grinder 2.0 - Rose Gold
variants.body_html:
Say hello to your new favorite sidekick—the ONGROK 4-Piece Grinder! This heavy-duty, all-star grinder is built for smooth, effortless herb prep, every time. With its durable aircraft-grade aluminum build and 33 triangular teeth, it crushes herbs to the perfect medium-to-fine consistency without breaking a sweat.

Why You’ll Love It:
No More Stuck Grinders: The quarter-turn locking function means easy access to your herbs—no wrestling matches required!
Multi-Tasking Champ: With deeper chambers, this grinder doubles as herb storage and even fits a mini humidity pack to keep your stash fresh.
Removable Screen = Easy Cleaning: Lift, twist, and clean—keeping this grinder fresh is a breeze.
Portable & Tough: At 63mm, it’s the perfect size to toss in your bag, and the magnetic lid keeps it secure on the go.
Extras That Rock: Bonus brush and guitar pick scoop included for hassle-free herb handling.
This grinder isn’t just practical—it’s a game-changer. Whether you’re prepping for a chill night in or packing it for a road trip, the ONGROK Grinder is the tool you didn’t know you needed. Trust us, your herbs deserve this.

variants.title: Hard Hitters Fructose Fiend Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: The sweet tooth of the Hard Hitters lineup, Fructose Fiend is jam packed with high THC liquid diamonds and sweet and fruity botanical terpenes that will satisfy any craving. Get your fix with a heavy dose of sweet banana, orange, strawberry, and grape terpenes in this super tasty 510-thread cart.

variants.title: Private Lineup Sugar Wax
variants.body_html: Kick up the sesh with new flavours from the Private Lineup. Exclusive rotational drops of small-batch sugar wax extracted from unique genetics and selected by the team for big flavour. Try the full line-up before they're gone forever.

variants.title: Blue Dream Live Resin Hash
variants.body_html: A terpene-rich infusion of live resin. Embrace nature with every inhale.

variants.title: Corner Store Kief Coated Liquid Diamond Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Take a trip down to the corner of memory lane. The Corner Store Variety Pack has all the flavours you remember - Blue Shark, Red Razzleberry, and Pink Swirl - each blended into whole flower, mill-infused with liquid THC diamonds, and coated in kief for an extra potent pop.

variants.title: Fruit Punch Liquid Diamond Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Papa's Herb Fruit Punch - Get ready to party with fruit punch! A delicious blend of tropical flavours with energizing effects that will have you feeling inspired. You'll find paradise with every puff!

variants.title: Jack Haze Live Resin + Liquid Diamonds AIO Dsiposable Vape
variants.body_html: Meet the new 7ACRES All-in-One Vape, a sleek device with advanced features at your fingertips; digital display, variable voltage, convenient 10-second pre-heat, anti-burn technology, and USB-C fast charging. They’ve paired this upgraded device with a carefully balanced blend of 10-25% live resin and 75-90% liquid diamonds. This results in a terpene-rich, high-potency, true-to-plant, citrus-forward profile. From the first inhale to the last glance, every detail is designed to elevate your session.

variants.title: Blueberry Zlshie Liquid Diamond Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Papa's Blueberry Zlshie, is a disposable refillable vape.  High power and portable vaping experience perfect for those looking for a deliciously sweet and powerful vape. The Blueberry Zlshie is filled with high potency liquid diamond cannabis oil made from molten diamonds.  Papa's Blueberry Zlshie strain is known for its fantastic flavor and powerful effects.  With every puff, you'll savor the smooth, sweet taste of Zlushy Fruity Blueberries.

variants.title: Orange Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: TASTY'S Orange Liquid Diamond vape unleashes flavour with high THC. Taste a medley of bright and bold citrus flavours cranked up by natural botanical terpenes. The big power? It comes from an infusion of powerful liquid THC diamonds. TASTY’S vapes use specialized Active vape hardware with super wide 2 mm apertures for massive draws, huge clouds and bold flavour.

variants.title: Green Apple Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Get more taste, more THC and more diamonds with TASTY’S Green Apple Diamond Infused pre-rolls. Crafted using only milled whole flower and potent THC-A diamonds with a sweet and sour green apple bite, boosted by natural botanical terpenes.

variants.title: Pink Pineapple Liquid Diamond AIO Vape
variants.body_html: Dive into the lush, fruity vibes of juicy pineapple with hints of sweet strawberry and raspberry in the -ness™ Pink Pineapple All-in-One Liquid Diamonds 1g Vape. This hybrid beauty is crafted with liquid diamonds and botanical terpenes for high THC and bold tropical flavour, all packed into a compact cart and battery combo. Your portable pass to paradise. Explore Your -ness™.

variants.title: Cherry Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: TASTY'S Cherry Liquid Diamond vape unleashes flavour with high THC in one big cartridge. Taste the sweet and sharp tang of wild cherry flavours cranked up by natural botanical terpenes. The big power? It comes from an infusion of powerful liquid THC diamonds. TASTY’S vapes use specialized Active vape hardware with super wide 2 mm apertures for massive draws, huge clouds and bold flavour.

variants.title: Strawberry Gary
variants.body_html: Strawberry Gary has a sweet, creamy, gassy and fruity profile with thick smoke, juicy resin rings and white ash. This sativa leaning cross of GP x Red Pop was originally bred by Exotic Genetix and phenohunted in house. This sativa leaning flower is craft designated and hand packed.

variants.title: Pineapple Express Tablets
variants.body_html: Unlock an ultra value cannabis experience with our Pink Kush Ingestible Extract. Each dose delivers 10mg of high-quality, full-spectrum Pink Kush extract, carefully crafted to offer a smooth and consistent effect every time.

variants.title: Rose Quartz Liquid Crystals AIO Vape
variants.body_html:
Experience the Rose Quartz Liquid Crystals All-In-One Vape from Queen of Bud. Infused with pink lemonade terpenes, it’s as refreshing as it is potent. With upwards of 95% THC, this dainty and diamond infused all-in-one vape is positively powerful.

Crafted with care, this 1 g device is a blend of style and sophistication. The delightful notes of pink lemonade mix seamlessly with the icy blast of diamonds for a bright flavour and uniquely fresh aroma.

variants.title: Shark Attack Max10 Gummies
variants.body_html: SHRED’ems Shark Attack Party Pack has 10 packs of MAX10 gummies, each with 10mg THC for a total 100MG THC PER PACK! These sativa-dominant gummies unleash a fierce wave of jaw-dropping blue raspberry and green apple flavour.

variants.title: Cured Resin – Tangerine Punch Badder XL
variants.body_html: This high potency extract is made from cured flower that's full of sun grown flavour. Our Tangerine Punch Cured Badder packs a super sweet and sour citrusy tangerine flavour with fruity grape.

variants.title: Mystery Resin Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Unveil the unknown with Dab Bods Mystery Resin Infused Pre-Rolls. Each pack contains three (same strain) 0.5g pre-rolls, carefully crafted with high-quality cannabis and infused with potent resin to deliver an exceptional, elevated experience. The mystery strain rotates with each lot packaged and adds an element of surprise to your smoke session, offering a unique blend of effects and flavors that are different every time you light up. Infused with rich cannabis terpenes and designed for a smooth, flavorful smoke, these pre-rolls promise a one-of-a-kind experience with every puff. Perfect for those who love a little unpredictability, these resin-infused pre-rolls are ideal for adventurous smokers looking for something new and exciting in every session.

variants.title: LA Inferno Shatter
variants.body_html: Introducing our LA Inferno shatter, a potent concentrate packed with bold flavour and aroma. This shatter delivers a rich, complex profile with sweet and creamy notes balanced by earthy undertones and a touch of spice. Expect hints of dark chocolate and vanilla, layered with subtle herbal and pine accents. Smooth yet intense, LA Inferno shatter is a flavourful choice for those who appreciate depth and quality. With love from Scarborough.

variants.title: THirstC Lemonade 10 mg THC Instant Drink Powder
variants.body_html: Emprise Rapid THirstC Lemonade 10mg THC Instant Drink is ready when you are, add to 250ml of Water and consume. Each sachet contains 10mg of Advanced Nano THC Emulsion that has a rapid onset in as little as 10-15 minutes.
