variants.title: Fizzy Pops Grape Blast Liquid Diamond Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Ready to dress to impress!? Status brings you this high potency liquid diamond infused graptacular experience in a AIO vape. With the flavour of extravagant grape ready to exceed your expectations at dazzling soirees, this blunt will bring a house crashing flavour you won't forget. Filled in a conveniently small sized device you'll be getting a smoke that you won't be disappointed in!

variants.title: Lamborkiwi Liquid Diamond Infused Kief Coated PR 5 x 0.25 g
variants.body_html: Been looking for something that will rev your engine? Status brings you this high potency liquid diamond infused high roller experience with a beautiful kief coated pre roll. With the flavour of kiwi and berries this pre roll will have you rolling in style in a lamborkiwi you can afford! With a specially designed pre roll cone and premium flower, you can expect a great and even smoke that you won't be disappointed in!

variants.title: HoneyStick Quatro Variable Voltage Vape Black
variants.body_html: The HoneyStick Quatro is not your average 510 battery. Its square shape keeps it from rolling away and gives it a sturdy, pocket-friendly feel that’s easy to grip and even easier to love. With a sleek design and bold finishes, this battery looks as good as it performs. Powered by a 400mAh battery, the Quatro gives you long-lasting use and consistent output. Three voltage settings let you fine-tune your experience, while the 15-second preheat function helps prep thicker oils for smooth, satisfying hits. It’s button-activated, simple to use, and comes equipped with a micro-USB port for quick charging. Key Features & Benefits: Square Design: Stays put on flat surfaces and fits snugly in your pocket 400mAh Battery: Delivers long-lasting sessions without constant recharging Variable Voltage: Choose between 3.2V (green), 3.7V (blue), or 4.2V (red) for custom performance Preheat Function: Warms up your oil with a 15-second cycle for thicker concentrates Button-Activated: Easy operation with just a few clicks Micro-USB Charging: Convenient and fast charging from almost anywhere Compact and Portable: Ideal for on-the-go vaping The HoneyStick Quatro is all about control, comfort, and a clean, stylish vape experience from start to finish.

variants.title: HoneyStick Trigon Variable Voltage Battery Black
variants.body_html:
The HoneyStick Trigon Variable Voltage Battery delivers a standout combination of performance and design. With a sturdy 500mAh battery and a sleek triangular body, this device stays put on any surface and fits comfortably in your hand. Compatible with standard 510-thread cartridges, it offers a smooth, customizable session with four optimized voltage settings to match your mood or material.

Use the preheat function to warm thicker oils or jump right into your session with a quick hit. The Trigon supports both standard screw-on charging and pass-through charging, so you can keep using it while it powers up.

Key Features & Benefits:

500mAh Battery: Provides long-lasting power for extended sessions

Triangular Design: Prevents rolling and offers a secure grip

Variable Voltage: Choose from four temperature settings for flavour or cloud production

Preheat Function: Helps prep thick oils for smoother draws

510 Thread Compatibility: Works with most vape cartridges

Pass-Through Charging: Vape while you charge for added convenience

Screw-On USB Charger: Easy and secure charging method

With power, style, and versatility, the HoneyStick Trigon is made for those who want more from every puff.

variants.title: Raw Unbleached Tips
variants.body_html: "RAW Unbleached Tips are the perfect finishing touch for your hand-rolled creations. Made from unrefined, chemical-free paper, these tips are designed to preserve the flavour of your smoke while providing structure and support. Their sturdy build makes them easy to roll and shape, whether you prefer a simple spiral or a more intricate filter style. Lightweight yet durable, RAW tips help prevent soggy ends and allow for a smoother draw while being compact enough to stash and roll on the go. Key Features & Benefits: Unbleached and Chemical-Free: Made with natural, unrefined paper for a cleaner taste Adds Structure: Prevents ends from collapsing or getting soggy Improves Draw: Helps provide a smoother, more consistent airflow Pocket-Friendly Packs: Convenient to carry and use anywhere Stay natural from start to finish with RAW Unbleached Tips."

variants.title: RYOT Slim Aluminum Dugout – Silver
variants.body_html: Sleek, durable, and built for convenience, the RYOT Slim Aluminum Dugout is a compact all-in-one smoking solution that’s ready for any adventure. Crafted from lightweight yet tough aluminum, this modern take on the classic dugout is designed for portability without sacrificing performance. This version features a built-in bottle opener and comes paired with RYOT’s Stainless Steel Anti-Clog One Hitter, which uses a cutting-tooth tip for consistently smooth, easy hits. Whether you're on a hike, traveling light, or relaxing at home, this dugout delivers everything you need in one pocket-sized design. Key Features & Benefits Ultra-Slim Aluminum Design - Lightweight, strong, and pocket-friendly for on-the-go sessions. Stainless Steel Anti-Clog One Hitter - Engineered with a cutting-tooth tip for cleaner, smoother draws and easier packing. Built-In Bottle Opener - Adds even more functionality to your setup, perfect for social settings. Magnetic Lid and Poker Tool - Keeps everything securely in place and ready when you are. Durable Powder-Coated Finish - Scratch-resistant coating provides extra grip and long-lasting good looks. colour Options - Available in black, purple, and silver to suit your personal style. Discreet and Portable - A complete smoking kit that fits easily in your pocket or bag. From quick hits to extended sessions, the RYOT Slim Aluminum Dugout is designed to keep up with your lifestyle—wherever it takes you.

variants.title: GR8TR Solid Body Grinder 2.2 inch - Rose Gold
variants.body_html:
"The Kannastor GR8TR Solid Body Grinder is built for smokers who want full control over their grind. Its modular 7-piece design lets you customize your setup however you like, whether you want a classic grinder, a storage puck, or a full sifting system. Packed with premium features like interchangeable grinder plates, a deep dish chamber, and anti-friction rings, this 2.2-inch piece is made to handle your herbs with smooth, consistent performance every session.

Key Features & Benefits
Modular Design: Customize your grinder setup for storage, sifting, or simple grinding.
Easy Change Plates: Swap between vape and standard grind consistency with ease.
Deep Dish Chamber: Grind more herb at once with less mess.
Micro Teeth: Creates a smooth, fluffy grind for better airflow and even burning.
Anti-Friction Rings: Keeps every twist smooth while reducing residue buildup.
Storage Lid: Stash extra material or accessories right in the top compartment.

Whether you're grinding at home or packing light for the day, the GR8TR delivers premium versatility in one sleek, durable piece."

variants.title: RYOT - Verb 510 Battery - Tan
variants.body_html: Stealthy, stylish, and built for real life—the RYOT VERB 510 Battery is a compact powerhouse designed to elevate your cartridge vaping experience. With a durable exterior and a discreet flip-top lid, the VERB keeps your cartridge protected while delivering smooth, consistent hits wherever you go. Compatible with most 510-thread oil cartridges, it features three voltage settings for customized performance, plus a preheat function to keep things flowing even with thicker oils. Whether you're laying low or lighting up on the go, the VERB fits seamlessly into your lifestyle—and your pocket. Key Features & Benefits Universal 510 Compatibility – Works with most 0.5g and 1.0g oil cartridges Three Voltage Settings – Customize your experience for smoother, tastier hits Flip-Top Design – Sleek, discreet lid protects your cart and keeps it clean Preheat Function – Loosens up thicker oils with the tap of a button Magnetic Connection – Snap your cart in securely and swap with ease USB-C Rechargeable – Fast charging for all-day reliability Palm-Friendly Size – Slim, pocketable, and travel-ready Available in 5 Finishes – Choose from Black, Tan, Olive, Night Sky, Tye Dye or Black/Gold to match your vibe The RYOT VERB 510 blends form, function, and flavour—perfect for those who expect more from a compact vape.

variants.title: True Mints
variants.body_html: True Mints is creating by crossing the delicious True OG x Kushmints strains. This well-balanced hybrid offers a sweet and nutty minty flavour with a touch of citrus sour. True Mints buds are dense with green and purple undertones.

variants.title: Jonny's Stash
variants.body_html: Jonny's Stash (Rotational Indica) is a curated collection of premium indica cultivars, meticulously grown and hunted in-house at Jonny Chronic. Experience the pinnacle of freshness and quality with each batch, showcasing a diverse spectrum of flavors, aromas, and effects.

variants.title: Twisted Cherry Toasters Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Crank up the toast level with Toasters. Super flavourful and potent kief-coated joints infused with THC distillate and a refreshing twist of ripe cherry and tangy lime juice. Super Toast. Always Ready. Formulated with flavouring agents.

variants.title: Pink Grapes
variants.body_html: Bred by Compound Genetics and grown-with-love in Princeton, BC, Pink Grapes is a jaw-dropping cross of Pink Runtz and Grape Gas. With sweet grape and gas notes, the fruity tang will linger in the air for hours after the bag is opened. Terpenes include caryophyllene, farnesene, and limonene. Exotic and loud, with purple buds and flavour to match, will make this a regular rotation in your stash.

variants.title: Pineapple Kush Heavy Slims Infused PR 5 x 0.4 g
variants.body_html: SHRED Pineapple Kush Heavy Slims deliver infused, tube-style blunts packed with high THC. These sleek tubes bring sweet pineapple aromas up front, with kushy undertones and a unique toasted flavour from the tea leaf blunt paper. Infused with diamonds, disty and terps, each blunt is rolled for a smooth, satisfying burn. Perfect for those who enjoy bold, fruity flavours with potency, these blunts are anything but ordinary. Get ready to experience the fusion of sweet and kushy, all in one highly potent strain.

variants.title: Anti Gravity
variants.body_html: Introducing Anti Gravity (Grandpa's Breath x OG Kush Breath), our latest potent Indica strain. A cross of Grandpa's Breath and OG Kush Breath, this cultivar delivers an intense aroma of rotting skunk and spicy diesel, making it a bold choice for true connoisseurs. This genetic also naturally contains pure CBG, adding to its unique profile and potential effects.

variants.title: Rippin Razz 2.0
variants.body_html: Dab Bods Rippin Razz Shatter 2.0 is a top-tier concentrate that offers a flavorful and potent experience. Featuring a malleable consistency, this shatter is infused with botanical terpenes to enhance its vibrant flavor profile. With the sweet, tangy taste of blueberry and raspberry, derived from the iconic Blue Razz strain, every dab delivers a burst of fruity goodness. Perfect for those looking to indulge in a smooth, flavorful concentrate, Dab Bods Rippin Razz Shatter 2.0 offers a delightful combination of bold flavors and a powerful, long-lasting effect.

variants.title: Tropic OG Liquid Diamonds Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Elevate your vape game with the ultra-potent Versus Tropical OG 510 Vape, powered by high-purity liquid diamonds for unmatched intensity. With a max potency of 98% THC, this vape delivers a bold tropical fusion of sweet pineapple, rich passion fruit, and juicy guava, leaving a vibrant finish on every exhale. Crafted with premium hardware and a tapered round mouthpiece, it’s designed to amplify flavour, deliver smooth, satisfying hits, and reduce clogging for the ultimate high-potency vaping experience.

variants.title: Pure Milled Sativa
variants.body_html: 1Spliff Pure Milled is an sativa dominant strain crafted from top cola buds, ensuring a potent, flavourful and smooth smoking experience. With a sweet, sugary aroma and notes of berry and vanilla, this strain delivers a rich and velvety smoke. Expertly milled, this flower is precision ground for an ideal consistency. It's fluffy, even and ready to roll, pack or vape. The careful processing preserves the trichomes and terpene profile, ensuring a slow and consistent burn without excess shake or stems.

variants.title: Permafrost Diamonds
variants.body_html: Crack open a cold jar of Endgame Permafrost Diamonds and experience a chillingly potent blast of THC. Boost your smoke by breaking them down and rolling them up or load up your rig.

variants.title: Tweed Kush Mints
variants.body_html: Tweed Kush Mints is a hybrid with high THC and minimal amounts of CBD. Kush Mints comes from a cross of Animal Mints and Bubba Kush. Its buds are known to be dense and dark green, and hits of lime. Some associate minty, earthy, and pine flavours with the Tweed Kush Mints cultivar.

variants.title: Electric Blue Diamonds Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Where sky-high levels of sweet, sour, and tart collide for an electric blue raspberry flavour experience. This indica-dominant cart is packed with extra high levels of THC, liquid diamonds and botanical terpenes (limonene, linalool, caryophyllene). Designed for a premium vaping experience with a thermoplastic mouthpiece, glass housing, and ceramic core cartridge that keeps your session smooth and your flavour intense. The BOLD choice to get Glazed.

variants.title: Foxy Haze Face PR 10 x 0.3 g
variants.body_html: These Haze Face sativa pre-rolls have a citrus berry profile, reminiscent of fresh cherries, lemon and mango. We’ve taken our favourite Haze and Animal Face crosses to deliver these potent sativa pre-rolls. We make pre-rolls we would want to smoke ourselves. Even burn, white ash and good resistance. No sticks or stems, just whole flower, perfectly ground and proudly hand rolled, then perfectly twisted before we inspect and pack each one in our tin with a final freshness seal.

variants.title: Dopezilla Space Pod 3-Stage 50 mm Grinder - Air
variants.body_html: The Space Pod Grinder from Dopezilla is a durable 3-stage grinder. It has deep grooves in the lid for optimal grip, making it easier to tear and fluff your herb. The high-quality sifting screen filters your kief to the bottom chamber. Made from aluminum with extra sharp teeth, this 50mm grinder will get the job done and look good doing it. Each element is available in a different colour.

variants.title: Permanent Cherries
variants.body_html: Permanent Cherries was bred by Seed Junky by crossing Lemon Cherry x Kush Mints Bx1 x Permanent Market. Crack open the pouch and you'll be met with dense, deep green buds absolutely dusted in sugar. Upon your first inhale, you’ll pick up a little sweet cherry, gas and a smooth creamy finish. Because it’s the right thing to do, all of our flower is hang dried, hand trimmed, slow cold cured and hand packaged. We keep it fresh and terpene-rich by sealing it up in nitrogen flushed pouches with a humidity pack inside. And it's non-irradiated, obviously.

variants.title: THCa Electric Apple Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Charge up your day with Electric Apple, a sativa-dominant pre-roll infused with THCA-coated flower and liquid diamonds for an electrifying 55% THC potency. Bursting with crisp apple flavour, this convenient 3 x 0.5g pack is perfect for bold, flavourful sessions.

variants.title: Girl Scout Cookies
variants.body_html: Discover the irresistible allure of Versus GSC, Versus' latest offering, a standout indica strain that's a true fan favourite. GSC offers a delightful combination of sweet, earthy flavours with hints of mint and citrus.

variants.title: Chatty Kathy
variants.body_html: This sassy sativa is a cross of Chatterbox and SinMintz, serving up a bold diesel punch with a minty fresh finish and a whisper of spicy drama.

variants.title: Pink Kush PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: This original cut of the Pinks from the Sunshine Coast was grown at an indoor farm using organic living soil. This indica-dominant cultivar is rich in terpenes including myrcene, caryophyllene, and limonene, with notes of sweet vanilla and gas. The plants dense, sticky buds are hand-trimmed, cured for a minimum of 3 weeks, and never irradiated. Each reusable doob tube comes with 3 x 0.5g pre-rolls made with natural hemp paper.

variants.title: Red Velvet #11
variants.body_html: Bred by the renowned Grandiflora and grown here in Okanagan, BC. Their breeder's cut of Red Velvet #11 is a cross of Pina Acai x Lemon Cherry Gelato. Distinct in its appearance and nose with dark and vividly colourful buds that deliver on the funk - creamy, cheesy with rich, cakey undertones. This indica-dominant cultivar is a standout in their genetics portfolio with its bag appeal and smooth smoke. Their flower is never outsourced or contract grown. Every bud is hang-dried, hand-trimmed, cold cured, and hand-packaged in-house by our own team to ensure our highest standards are met. Terpenes include limonene, farnesene, and myrcene.

variants.title: Amani Craft
variants.body_html: A rotating selection of craft flower from Amani Craft in Lake Country, BC. Each bag features beautiful buds that are hand-trimmed, hand-packaged, and never irradiated.

variants.title: Mango Dream Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Expect a cloud made of juicy mango flavour notes. The Spinach Fully Charged Mango Dream Infused Pre-roll is bursting with tropical and succulent mango flavour notes. Inspired by a cultivar that traces its lineage back to Mango and Blue Dream cultivars, enjoy blissful flavours and high potency at 40%+ Total THC thanks to the infused with high-quality, high-potency liquid diamond and distillate blend, botanical terpenes, and finished with a kief coating.

variants.title: Cool Aid Kush PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Cool Aid Kush is a heavy-hitting, indica-dominant cultivar that brings together the classic kush character of OG Kush and a citrus twist from Rainbow Zkittlez. Expect earth and diesel-forward aromas balanced by subtle notes of lemon. They only use whole flower in their pre-rolls. BOLD Craft Cannabis is indoor-grown, small-batch, hang-dried, slow-cured, and hand-trimmed.

variants.title: Hawaiian Marker
variants.body_html: Colour outside the lines with Tuck Shop's Hawaiian Marker. This loud and tropical strain is a cross of Hawaiian Rain and Permanent Marker, bursting with bold notes of fruit, creamy gas and just a pinch of floral funk.

variants.title: Purple Octane PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html:
Introducing Purple Octane, the latest exotic gem from That’s Dope by Sitka Legends. This striking indica-dominant cultivar is born from an elite fusion of Jealousy, Sunset Sherbet, and SFV OG, delivering a terpene-rich experience that blends heritage with high-octane flair. Purple Octane boasts a complex flavour profile that opens with sweet, floral overtones, followed by creamy gas, and finishes with a touch of herbal spice. The aroma is equally captivating—lavender-diesel perfume layered with hints of grape, pine, and citrus zest. Terpenes include limonene, linalool, and caryophyllene.

Each bud of Purple Octane is hand-trimmed, hang-dried, and slow-cured for three weeks to preserve its bold character and full-bodied expression. The flowers are dense and resin-packed, showcasing deep violet hues, rich forest greens, and a generous coat of shimmering trichomes.

variants.title: Purple Churro Redees PR 10 x 0.4 g
variants.body_html: Purple Churro Redees Classic are our signature straight cut, fast burning and smooth smoking pre-rolls. They’re packed with milled whole flower bursting with vanilla and sweet cinnamon flavours, wrapped with classic paper. This Apples & Bananas x Cinnamon Horchata cross delivers high THC potency.

variants.title: Space Jam Smalls
variants.body_html: Curated by BC Smalls and brought to life by Wagyu Genetics, Space Jam delivers a one-of-a-kind indica experience, blending the stellar genetics of Falcon 9 and Sugar Coat. Its dense, sticky buds are a visual masterpiece, showcasing deep purple and forest green hues accented by bright orange hairs and a shimmering layer of trichomes. The aroma is a medley of sweet berry, creamy vanilla and a hint of earthiness. On the palate, Space Jam dazzles with flavours of lush fruit, creamy sweetness and a subtle dash of spice.

variants.title: Sticky Bunz
variants.body_html: We’re calling this one See Me Now, a nod to the track that inspired us. See Me Now, otherwise known as Jet Fuel Pie, is loud, dank and potent. With its deep green hues and a thick coat of trichomes, this flower stands out in any lineup. And once you light up, it has a bold mix of gas, sweet cream and earthiness. Slow cured, hang dried and crafted with care. With love from Scarborough.

variants.title: BLK Caviar
variants.body_html: Bred in house, BLK Caviar is an anomaly from anything in our line. Nicknamed Thanksgiving Dinner with a nose reminiscent of turkey stuffing and gravy. Extremely dark, iced out buds and noteworthy taste takes this one a step further in bag appeal. Always handcrafted from our genetics, our growers and indoor grown in our facilities in BC.

variants.title: Quick Rips PR 4 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Quick Rips sativa pre-rolls are crafted from whole flower. Each pre-roll delivers a bold and smooth profile.

variants.title: Quick Rips PR 4 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Quick Rips indica pre-rolls are crafted from whole flower. Each pre-roll delivers a smooth and bold experience.

variants.title: Afghani Sunrise Pure Live Resin Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Made from live resin, Greybeard’s Afghani Sunrise has an intense fruit and sour aroma followed by a blast of pungent shoe rubber on the finish. Crafted from Greybeard’s popular AFD, blended with Gelato and Fuel, Afghani Sunrise is the proud result of industry leading hydrocarbon extraction using fresh frozen whole cannabis at their peak of harvest for a true spectrum expression of the plant. Afghani Sunrise uses a proprietary Active 510-thread cartridge with a 1.5 mm aperture for bigger clouds and better airflow while maximizing flavour. Our newly designed 510 cartridge is recyclable with the mouthpiece made from biodegradable Hempzyme for eco-conscious consumers.

variants.title: Watermelon Mojo ZKTLZ PR 5 x 0.3 g
variants.body_html: Watermelon Mojo Zktlz is the same cut with the same bold, fruity and sweet tropical mango aroma and flavour. Extremely high in terpenes and so aromatic, you'll think it was infused. Rolled in house into raw organic cones and placed inside our matte glass tube with our custom Integra humidity boost stick.

variants.title: CBD Super Lemon Haze
variants.body_html: With notes of citrus, lemon and sweet flavours, Super Lemon Haze CBD is a cross between Lemon Skunk and Super Silver Haze, which was then crossed with a high CBD dominant male. Buds are pale green with striking orange hairs underneath a beautiful coating of trichomes. At Joi, we hang dry, hand trim and cure in stainless steel containers for at least 14 days to ensure a quality finish.

variants.title: Jet Fuel Liquid Diamonds All-In-One Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Jet Fuel Liquid Diamond all-in-one vape brings the dank experience of the popular Jet Fuel Pie strain to life in a convenient and potent format. Expect complex sweet and savoury notes, offering hints of gassy diesel accented by subtle creamy vanilla on the exhale.

variants.title: Girl Scout Cookies
variants.body_html: Discover the irresistible allure of Versus GSC, Versus' latest offering, a standout indica strain that's a true fan favourite. GSC offers a delightful combination of sweet, earthy flavours with hints of mint and citrus.

variants.title: Hash Hole Infused PR 1 x 2 g
variants.body_html: Step up your sesh with the Jellee Hash Hole, a handcrafted infused pre-roll that blends artistry and potency in every puff. This showstopper features 1.5g of Abby Leaf Blue Gumdrop flower and 0.5g of Green Amber GSC premium rosin and includes a glass filter tip. Rolled with precision by Master Terence himself.

variants.title: Animal Mints PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: With a minty flavor and invigoratingaroma ,Animal Mints is visually striking,with dense, olive green buds generously covered in a layer of frosty trichomes that lend an almost icy appearance. The aroma lives up to its name offering a refreshing mint scent that dominates the profile. Notes of earthiness and subtle pine emerge, giving the strain an appealling, complex scent that balances cool freshness with a grounding base.

variants.title: Beaver Tail PR 1 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Introducing Beaver Tail, the latest flavour-packed addition to Potluck’s Canada Collection! This indica strain features a vanilla custard aroma with a bold, gassy finish. These dense buds are bright green with a sweet and herbal flavour profile, making it the perfect addition to your stash.

variants.title: Blue Dream #16
variants.body_html: Blue Dream #16 is a hand-picked pheno of Blue Dream selected for its complex fruit aromas, impressive bud structure and elevated potency. Our growers have been nurturing this popular West Coast sativa in our greenhouse for years, always on the hunt for new expressions of the strain — and this pheno delivers. Blue Dream #16 boasts frosty, long-stretching lime green buds and dreamy aromas of citrus, blueberry, spice and cake from dominant terpenes limonene, beta-pinene and ocimene. Pure BC bud, hand-harvested, hang-dried and hand-finished.

variants.title: Jonny's Stash - Rotating Reefers PR 5 x 1 g
variants.body_html: A rotating pre-roll offering of craft flower, hand-dried, hand-trimmed, sorted and milled for the perfect consistency.

variants.title: Porto Leche PR 5 x 0.6 g
variants.body_html: Some pairings are just meant to be — like the deep, bold taste of aged red berries or the smooth, velvety comfort of fresh cream. Porto Leche (Oreoz x Grape Jubilee, Breeder: Exotic Genetics) captures both in perfect harmony, delivering a flavour experience that's rich, indulgent, and effortlessly smooth. The first hit bursts with notes of ripe, jammy berries, coating your palate in deep, complex sweetness. As you exhale, a wave of creamy smoothness follows — like the soothing finish of a cold glass of milk. Porto Leche, from Tribal. Bold yet balanced, with flavours you’ll want to savour, again and again.

variants.title: Hawaiian Marker PR 7 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Colour outside the lines with Tuck Shop's Hawaiian Marker. This loud and tropical strain is a cross of Hawaiian Rain and Permanent Marker, bursting with bold notes of fruit, creamy gas and just a pinch of floral funk. Each pack of slim, hand finished pre-rolls are made from whole flower, never trim and packaged with a humidity pack for lasting freshness.

variants.title: Death Punch PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Death Punch is a potent and pungent indica from parents Death Bubba x Purple Punch. It’s a highly potent strain with sweet and spicy aromas of cake and peppery gas, layered with dank notes of earth and skunk. Pack includes tapered pre-rolls and a glass filter tip.

variants.title: The Collective PR 12 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: The collective brings the best Northern Canna offers in a rotational 4-strain multi-pack.

variants.title: Blood Orange Kush Liquid Diamonds Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Treat your tastebuds with Tweed Blood Orange Kush 510 vape cart! This kushy delight is not just any vape — each puff delivers the flavours of a classic kush with a hint of blood orange.

variants.title: G Mint Supernova Live Resin All-in-one Disposable Vape

Flavourful and consistent, Tribal's SuperNova disposable vape comes with ceramic hardware and a USB-C rechargeable battery.

variants.title: 10X The Madness: The Blue One THC Gummies

variants.title: Switch 95+ Digital Diamonds Strawberry Jam/French Toast AIO Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: The Canadian Debut of Boutiq Switch brings high tech, high THC and highly coveted flavours to market. variants.title: Fractals Full Cannabinoid Spectrum Diamond
variants.body_html: Fractals are a one-of-a-kind product, first to the market in Canada. This full cannabinoid spectrum concentrate is high in THC and rich in a myriad of minor cannabinoids including THCV, CBC, CBN, THCVA, CBGA, CBNA, and CBDA with a total cannabinoid content of up to 93%. Fractals can be dabbed, or mixed with flower in a pre-roll or bowl for a boost of potency. The Orchard team has carefully processed and packaged this product at our production facility on Vancouver Island, BC.

variants.title: Mango Jango THC:CBG:CBD Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Welcome to flavour paradise, where the mango madness never stops. Mango Jango 2g Vapes bring you a tropical tidal wave of juicy, overflowing, sun-ripened mango. With over 2x the natural flavouring found in their 1g vapes, this mango is maxed out for a bold, fruity blast. Super session-able and supremely enjoyable, Mango Jango 2g Vapes feature reliable hardware and wider mouthpieces for smoother airflow and reduced clogging. The sustainable packaging and hemp mouthpieces? Just the mango on top. So, grab Miami Mango 2g Vapes, where the vibes are golden and the flavour is extra juicy. Made with botanically sourced ingredients and flavouring agents.

variants.title: Hash
variants.body_html: Crafted for hash enthusiasts, Thumbs Up Hash Indica offers a classic, full-bodied concentrate experience. This 2g indica-dominant hash features a sticky, malleable texture and is rich in terpenes, delivering a bold aroma and potent 40% THC.

variants.title: Dragon Fruit - AIO Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Experience the exotic sweetness of Dragon Fruit. This indica-dominant disposable vape packs high THC into every smooth hit, blending bold potency with a touch of tropical indulgence.

variants.title: 10X The Madness: The Red One THC Gummies
variants.body_html: In 10X The Madness, they've taken 10 individual packets of fan-favourite No Future The Red One Gummies and built the ultimate 100mg THC package.

variants.title: MoonBerry GULPs AIO Disposable Vape

variants.title: Strawiwi Diamond Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: What do you get when you blend the essence of fresh sweet strawberry and tart tangy kiwi? Strawiwi! variants.title: Live Resin Blackberry Gelato Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Made from fresh frozen cannabis, you'll get the full expression of Wildlife’s Blackberry Gelato terpenes and cannabinoids in this live resin vape. Limonene, farnesene and linalool exaggerate the light but fruity overall flavour, rounded out with myrcene.

variants.title: Fruit Punch Sparkling Beverage
variants.body_html: Punchy's has big flavour, bigger value. Classic fruit punch with 10mg THC and is lightly carbonated. Made with all natural flavours and colour.

variants.title: THC Softgels

variants.title: Galactic Glue PR 3 x 0.5 g

Level up your dab setup with the Famous X Quartz Banger—a clean, durable, and reliable choice for serious concentrate lovers. Whether you're chasing big clouds or tasty low-temp hits, the Famous X Quartz Banger delivers smooth sessions with every drop.

Your no-fuss quartz essential for smooth, flavourful dabs.

variants.title: CBG Raspberry & Lime Sparkling Botanical Water
variants.body_html: Raspberry Lime Sparkling Botanical Water is infused with 5 mg of THC and 10 mg of CBG. This beverage combines the bright zest of lime with the subtle sweetness of raspberry for a light and crisp experience. Made without sugar or artificial sweeteners.

variants.title: M'mosa
variants.body_html: Introducing M’mosa — the latest sativa offering from 1964. M'mosa — a cross of Purple Punch x Clementine — delights the senses with a vibrant burst of citrus and sweet tropical fruit. Its zesty orange aroma is balanced by subtle floral notes and a hint of earthiness.

variants.title: Guavalicious Pop n' Pour
variants.body_html: Freshly ground fruity sativa smelling like sweet and tangy guava lemonade. Fluffy, sticky goodness packed in a pop top tube with a humidity pack to keep things super easy and extra fresh. Just shake, pop n' pour. Super Toast. Always Ready.

variants.title: Pink Certz
variants.body_html: Pink Certz is a hybrid that was bred from The Menthol x Grape Gasoline into a strain so loud and aromatic, you’d think it came with its own air freshener. Expect a punch of diesel and a sweet finish that lingers long after the exhale with bold aroma and serious flavour.

variants.title: Comatose FSE Resin All In One Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Introducing the Comatose All-in-One FSE Resin Vape. Canada's favourite indica now available in a convenient, flavourful, and heavy hitting on the go AIO vape made from 100% FSE resin.

variants.title: BC Organic Fruit Loopz PR 10 x 0.3 g
variants.body_html: Prepare your taste buds for an exciting release from the Simply Bare greenhouse. Our new BC Organic Fruit Loopz is a FVOPA certified, sativa-dominant cultivar that's big on flavour, and sure to leave you wanting more. A cross of Blue Dream x White Widow, these two legendary cultivars collide to create a mouth-watering experience. Boasting fruity, berry, and citrus notes, she's grown in organic living soil, and is slowly hang-dried and hand-trimmed to preserve trichome integrity. Terpenes include beta-myrcene, limonene, and caryophyllene.

variants.title: Tropical Triple Berry 2:1 Gummies
variants.body_html: What happens when you combine a divine medley of mixed berries with oh-so sweet tropical guava? You get a tropical fruit explosion with Tropical Triple Berry SOURZ by Spinach™. These 2:1 CBD/THC gummies blasted with sour crystals are over-the-top with natural flavours and colours. Five gummies per pack.

variants.title: Farm Gas PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Earthy, bold, and unmistakably gassy, Farm Gas Pre-rolls are a strain-specific indica offering THC levels of 26-32%. This potent GMO and Sour Diesel cross delivers a robust aroma of diesel and gas with a whisper of sweetness on the finish. Packaged in Weed Me's signature color-coded tube, this 2-pack is crafted for a smooth, full-bodied session.

variants.title: Frosted Icicles Peach Lemonade Infused PR 5 x 0.25 g
variants.body_html: Back Forty's Frosted Icicles are infused pre-rolls coated in a layer of THCa diamonds, the perfect blend of potency, aroma and flavour in expertly rolled cones. Peach Lemonade offers sweet peach with a citrus kick.

variants.title: Pineapple Orange Peel Moon Dusted Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Blast off with Astrolab's Pineapple Orange Peel Moon Dusted Pre-rolls, a tropical explosion of flavor and potency. The flavor profile is an exhilarating mix of tropical and citrus, with juicy pineapple and tangy orange peel taking center stage. It's a refreshing, flavorful smoke that transports you to a sun-soaked paradise with every puff. With 40% THC, these pre-rolls pack a punch, sending your experience into another orbit. Whether you're flying solo or sharing with friends, P.O.P offers a next-level smoke that combines tropical flair with premium quality for a truly out-of-this-world experience.

variants.title: Neon Lotus
variants.body_html: Step into the glow with Neon Lotus. A fresh take on an indica leaning lineage, this strain is popular for its potency. This hang dried flower has a tangy fruit, herbal earthiness and diesel funk.

variants.title: BC Organic Lemon Loopz
variants.body_html: Hailing from Gastown Gardens, this carefully selected phenotype is a marriage of Lemon Candy Fuel x Animal Mints. Her aromas lead with tangy citrus notes, followed by gassy and sweet undertones. This exclusive genetic is grown in organic living soil, and follows our rigorous post-harvest treatment with a long hang dry, hand trim, and cold cure. Flavour chasers will find what they're looking for, with these trichome covered buds packed safely in our premium glass jars.

variants.title: Dr.Fizz All-in-One Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Ride the flavour wave with our Dr. Fizz All-in-One Vape, THC infused with a bold flavour mashup of fizzy cherry spice and vanilla. Our custom vape design is the stuff of ergonomic dreams, with the perfect palm-feel and super comfortable mouthpiece for long hauls and big fluffy clouds. Super Toast. Always Ready.

These highly potent 510 cartridges are formulated with quality cannabis extract captured in state-of-the-art custom designed 510 hardware from 14th Round.

variants.title: Blackberry Haze Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Push the limit with the maximum potency and optimal performance of DEBUNK Blackberry Haze liquid diamond vapes. Level up your vape with this fresh indica, grounded by a citrus base and rich berry overtone. Our proprietary hydrocarbon extraction process converts THCa diamonds into an ultra-pure, ultra-potent THC liquid diamond isolate that is then enhanced with a custom botanical terpene blend. A pure, potent, and consistent sesh from the first puff.

variants.title: Gelato Mint
variants.body_html: Gelato Mint is an Indica-dominant strain. It's it x Cookies and Cream, Breeder: Exotic Genetix, that produces elevated terpene levels in the 2-4 percent range. As its name suggests, Gelato Mint smells like a fresh mint dessert with strong pepper notes and earthy pine undertones. Due to its rich terpene profile, Gelato Mint's flavours are similar to its aromas and consistently noticeably present. Expect dark green buds coated with trichomes, purple sugar leaves, and amber-colored pistils.

variants.title: Bubble Bubble Liquid Diamond Infused Kief Coated Blunt 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Welcome to the juicy jungle. Status brings you this high potency liquid diamond infused tropical experience with a beautiful kief-coated glass tipped blunt with the flavour of juice sweetness. It has a specially designed blunt wrap and flower for an even smoke.

variants.body_html: JUST Seltzers Strawberry Watermelon delivers a burst of flavour in every sip. The sweet, sun ripened taste of strawberry blends with the crisp notes of watermelon. It has a fruit forward profile and just the right amount of carbonation. Made with Envision Emulsions’ advanced infusion technology, JUST Seltzers Strawberry Watermelon offers a consistently smooth drinking experience. The low sugar formulation keeps it crisp without any syrupy sweetness, while the cannabis infusion ensures there’s no lingering aftertaste. Designed for those who want a simple cannabis beverage that delivers on taste, this seltzer is affordable and delicious.

variants.title: Unicorn Blood Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Flavour King Cool Ape Punch vape combines juicy grape and sweet blueberry. It balances bold sweetness and tangy tartness.

variants.title: Strawberry Cheezequake PR 4 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: No you’re not suffering from a heavy case of deja-vu, you’re picking up the scent of our enigmatic Di-Fruitti which we’ve revamped to Strawberry Cheezequake to better profile this killer strain. So let us officially reintroduce this strawberry soaked, yogurt dipped, cheesecake experience to you now, welcome: STRAWBERRY CHEEZEQUAKE. The profile is top tier and smells and tastes exactly as it sounds. Do not hesitate to take multiple nosedives into the jar to stock up on as much of that aroma as possible prior to roasting.

THC: 28-33%

Morning Sun is here. Super creamy caramel on the inhale with gas and citrus notes on the exhale, this heavy indica-dominant is a cross of Kitsilano Kush Cake, Secret Cookies & Kush Mints 11. Top terpenes include Terpinolene, Limonene, and Myrcene.

Qwest was born in BC and from a deep appreciation for the plant and its process. BC Grown, small batch, hang-dried.

variants.body_html: Experience freshness like never before with Liquid Diamond Key Lime. Every pull feels like slicing into a fresh lime  —  zesty, bright, and packed with high-THC sativa. Crisp, bold, and ready to keep up with you, Key Lime is where pure flavour meets undeniable potency.

Crafted for those who appreciate the true essence of rosin, each soft chew delivers an authentic, terpene-rich experience in every bite.

variants.body_html: Jublee Bright Mind Full Spectrum Infused CBG Kief Dipped pre-rolls. Each pre-roll is double infused with Jublee’s full spectrum hash oil and rolled in golden CBG kief. The result? A smooth and flavourful smoke that captures the essence of hash.

variants.title: Purple Octane PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Purple Octane is a strong indica dominant strain that was bred by the legendary Seed Junky Genetics. This indica dominant hybrid has strong roots in the GSC and Gelato families. It is a direct cross between (Biscotti x SherbBX1) x (Jealousy F2), resulting in the appearance of dark green buds with purple hues and glistening trichomes. Its strong gassy aroma fills the room as soon as you open the bag and produces the pungent scent of petrol with fruity undertones of grapes and strawberries. The smoke from these pre-rolls begins with a creamy and nutty taste followed by hints of gas and fruit. Grown locally in extremely small batches using state-of-the-art environmentally friendly growing practices, the team at Unit 15 does not let any detail go unnoticed. Whole flower is used in these pre-rolls, which are selected and milled from small batches of expertly cured cannabis that is hand packed in our facility located in the heart of Scarborough to ensure that every joint is always fresh.

variants.title: CBD Super Lemon Haze PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: With notes of citrus, lemon and sweet flavours, Super Lemon Haze CBD is a cross between Lemon Skunk and Super Silver Haze, which was then crossed with a high CBD dominant male. Buds are pale green with striking orange hairs underneath a beautiful coating of trichomes. At Joi, we hang dry, hand trim and cure in stainless steel containers for at least 14 days to ensure a quality finish.

variants.body_html: Brain Cake is a potent and smooth-smoking sativa cultivar with mouthwatering aromas of creamy cake and ripe berries, layered with a touch of floral citrus from dominant terpenes myrcene, limonene, and caryophyllene. Pack includes tapered pre-rolls and a glass filter tip.

variants.title: Good Buds Mango Cake Cured Resin Disposable Vape
variants.body_html:
Extracted from our house-bred LSO Mango Cake strain, this 100% pure single-strain Cured Resin All-in-One Vape delivers bold, terpy flavor-no added terpenes or distillate. Packed in the market-leading CCELL Ceramic FlexPro, this All-in-One Vape features ceramic core for the ultimate expresssion of Mango Cake flavours and terpenes.

Bred in-house, our Mango Cake is an exotic dessert cross of GOOD BUDS' juicy Mango Taffie strain with sweet and creamy Wedding Cake. It leads with classic Mango Taffie smells of ripe mango sweetness with a gassy afterburn, followed by sweet vanilla frosting undertones and a creamy cake dough mouthfeel on the exhale. It's crafted in small batches from our organically grown flower and extracted by Common Roots Extracts on Vancouver Island, BC.

Pure flavor. Small batch. Organically grown.

variants.title: Noir x Jealousy Cannon PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Introducing the BLKMKT Cannons, combining two of our greatest in a chunky and fat straight cut pre-roll. Jealousy and Noir Diamant (Cookies Gelato YaHemi) are precisely combined for a gassy experience. Our cannons are packed with whole handcrafted flower grown in BC and designed to bring a slow burn.

variants.title: Gluerangutan Live Resin Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html:
Extracted from their house-bred LSO Gluerangutan, this 100% pure single-strain, cured-resin cart delivers bold, terpy flavour—no added terpenes or distillate. Packed in the market-leading CCELL Ceramic EvoMax, these 510 carts feature a ceramic core and post for the ultimate expression of Gluerangutan flavours and terpenes.

Gluerangutan is a hybrid backcross of the legacy cultivar Harambe (OG Kush x GG4 x Hash Plant), offering a sweet-and-sour citrus burst with gassy undertones and a crisp mountain-pine finish. Selected from a 100,000+ pheno hunt, it’s crafted in small batches from organically grown flower and extracted by Common Roots Extracts on Vancouver Island, BC.

Pure flavor. Small batch. Organically grown.

variants.body_html: BOXHOT PRESENTS: Pineapple Express, a 1.2g, sativa-dominant, 510 vape with a colossal 1000mg of THC and some of the purest cannabis distillate available on the market. Soak up this monster monsoon of pineapple flavour with a tropical citrus twist to carry you away. All BOXHOT vapes are made with exclusive, oversized hardware, making them optimal for big, full hits. Best of all, BOXHOT vapes are produced using industry-leading CO2 extraction and refining processes and feature a custom blend of expertly infused botanical terpenes.

variants.title: Master Kush Ultra PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Master Kush Ultra is a cross between G-13 and OG Kush and is a legacy cultivar. MKU's nose is woody and peppery with hints of orange or citrus. This indica-dominant cultivar is grown hydroponically with flood tables and soilless medium. Each plant is fed by the Dosatron nutrient delivery system, which results in a rich-terpene profile. The dark green flowers are hang-dried before being meticulously trimmed, ground to the perfect texture, and packed into a perfect ready-to-smoke pre-roll. Expect a one-of-a-kind taste and a smoke that is absolutely loaded with THC. This was a favourite cultivar in BC that went by Certified Gas.

variants.title: Magnum PR 1 x 1 .5 g
variants.body_html: Introducing Magnum's by BLKMKT - The first 1.5g handcrafted, whole-flower pre-roll. Packed with our own B.C. variants.body_html: Available for limited time only. Pack light, roll heavy. variants.body_html: Indulge in the perfectly chewy, sweet, and fruity delight of 3:1 Original Strawberry Taffy CBG/THC. Each piece is crafted to deliver a burst of juicy strawberry flavour with a smooth, melt-in-your-mouth texture reminiscent of a popular taffy treat.

variants.body_html: Tribal Trifecta. No fake terpenes and no distillate. Tribal Trifecta Bubble Up infused pre-rolls are made of triple infused Bubble Up flower with matching liquid diamonds, terpene sauce and dusted with THC-A diamonds. Rolled and finished with a ceramic tip. Liquid diamonds + terpene sauce + THC-A diamonds = the Tribal Trifecta.

variants.body_html: Introducing Mini Monsters infused pre-rolls mix pack. We took the same potent Monsters infused pre-rolls and shrunk them into two mini versions. This pack delivers high THC. The Mini Monsters mashup includes Golden Guy, a sativa forged from Jean Guy milled flower and Pineapple Express BHO, and Monkey Walker, an indica blending Monkey Butter milled flower and Starwalker Kush BHO. Each Mini Monster is made with strain specific, hang dried milled flower, before being infused with strain specific BHO and expertly rolled, coated in extract and kief.

variants.title: Cold Creek Kush PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Cold Creek Kush is an icon, which is why we had to bring it to you in an OG cone-style pre-roll for a classic experience with a smooth and consistent burn. A legendary MK Ultra x Chemdawg 91 cross, this sativa is high in THC. Bursting with earthy, herbal and woodsy notes, our Cold Creek Kush genetic has been refreshed to improve every aspect of the flower quality. Each pre-roll is packed with whole flower that’s been milled to fluffy perfection and rolled in unbleached paper with a Dutch fold for the perfect even light, letting you experience its bold and rugged character with every inhale.

variants.title: Galactica OG
variants.body_html: Galactica OG is a rare indica-dominant hybrid created by crossing Jedi Kush x Saturn OG, and grown by Krazy Krystal in the Shuswap region of BC. The surprisingly pungent aroma is dominated by skunk and fuel, with a sweet earthy finish. The flowers are round and emerald green with deep purple undertones and sunny orange hairs and a frosty coating of amber trichomes. Very high potency levels make it clear why this offering was aptly named Galactica OG — a beautiful BC-grown Kush that connoisseurs are sure to love.

variants.body_html: A popular strain, now in a more convenient size. This new variation of the legendary SMRF pre-roll packs the same bold flavour and quality into a perfectly portable format. What sets it apart? A true blue blueberry experience. Crafted with a potent strain (Berry Blue x Blueberry) and infused with blueberry flavour in every cone, this pre-roll delivers a rich and juicy burst of sweetness with every pull. Smooth, flavourful and expertly rolled for an even burn.

variants.title: Backpackers - Liquid Imagination PR 10 x 0.75 g
variants.body_html: The Backpackers pre-rolls by Back Forty are straight cut pre-rolls, perfectly packed and rolled in hemp paper for a smooth and steady burn. They're housed in a water resistant resealable tin. Liquid Imagination is a potent hybrid that’s a cross between Blue Zktlz and Jet Fuel Gelato. It’s sweet and sour with a touch of gas.

variants.title: Raspberry Riptide THC + CBD Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Geared up a with a bomb THC:CBD ratio, crush the killer summer swells of ripe raspberry while the bright citrus undercurrent carries you away. The BOXHOT Cruise Control Raspberry Riptide 2.0 g vape cart gets you where you're goin’. With oversized hardware, 1000 mg of THC, 700 mg of CBD, and some of the highest quality distillate out there, this vape is an experience.

variants.title: Baja Burst All-in-one Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Ride the flavour wave with our Baja Burst All-in-One Vape. THC infused with a citrusy flavour blast of tropical lime. Super Toast grab n’ go rechargeable vapes are always ready, no battery required. Our custom vape design is the stuff of ergonomic dreams, with the perfect palm-feel and super comfortable mouthpiece for long hauls and big fluffy clouds. Super Toast. Always Ready.

variants.title: Pink Donuts PR 4 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Double J's Terpnami presents Pink Donuts, a flavour experience that smells like a donut shop. Gassy and smooth with a sweet profile, it perfectly captures the essence of Pink Kush. Rich layers of fried dough, sugary sweetness and creamy notes wrap seamlessly around that signature gassy punch, creating a bold flavour that lingers with every puff.

variants.title: Marshmallow Mudslide PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Marshmallow Mudslide is an indica dominant hybrid born from Toasted Marshmallow x Fireside, offering a rich, dessert inspired flavour. Its flavour profile blends creamy vanilla, chocolate and sugary honey with subtle nutty and spicy undertones.

variants.title: Northern OG Kush
variants.body_html: One of the purest forms of indica you'll ever encounter in the cannabis world. Brace yourself for a potent experience of gassy aromas.

variants.title: Pine Tar Kush
variants.body_html: Explore the Back Forty with our Pine Tar Kush milled flower. A descendant of Pakistani landrace plants, Pine Tar Kush is a potent indica with a profile of pungent earth and sour pine. Made from whole flower, Back Forty milled is always fluffy, fresh and ready to roll.

variants.title: Death Vader PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: D Vader is a strain bred by the renowned Capulator himself. With a genetic lineage boasting the iconic D. Star crossed with the legendary Bubba Kush, D Vader has robust potency and flavour. Earthy and skunky notes reminiscent of D. Star meld seamlessly with the sweet and hash undertones of Bubba Kush, creating a complex smoking experience. The aroma of D Vader is potent, exuding a pungent blend of earthy and fuel-like scents that fill the air. Our small batch flower undergoes a meticulous process, including hang drying, precision hand trimming, slow cold curing and hand packaging.

variants.title: Country Club
variants.body_html: Woody Nelson's Country Club is a series of limited releases featuring some of our favourite growers and genetics. Selection is based on an internal 31-point scoring system with an emphasis on production practices, morphology, experience, and lab results. Each bag includes craft flower that is hand-trimmed, hand-packaged, and never irradiated.

variants.title: Blue Dream Liquid Diamonds Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Blue Dream Liquid Diamonds vape cartridge by Jonny Chronic is a sativa-dominant, ultra-pure experience with high-THC content and rich, earthy flavors. Compatible with 510 thread batteries, store upright in a cool environment for optimal performance.

variants.title: Diablo
variants.body_html: Diablo whole flower, a Bubba Kush x Master Kush Ultra cross, is dense and sticky with medium green buds coated in resinous trichomes. Available in 3.5g format, it features peppery diesel aromas and spicy, gassy flavours.

variants.title: Lemon Diesel
variants.body_html: Introducing Lemon Diesel — a bold new sativa from 1964. Lemon Diesel brings an invigorating citrus twist, combining bright lemon zest with subtle earthy undertones. Its aroma is fresh and punchy, mingling notes of citrus with a hint of vanilla for a balanced, vibrant profile.

variants.title: Banapple Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: BOLD GLAZED Banapple packs big clouds of smooth, fruity sweetness with a fusion of juicy apple and creamy banana. Just like the song that gets stuck in your head, this sativa cart delivers a vibrant mix of mellow and bright fruit flavors, creating a nostalgic yet refreshing experience you'll want to hit on repeat. This vape contains high levels of THC with limonene, myrcene, and caryophyllene. Compatible with 510 thread devices. Device not included.

variants.title: Iced Peachy Mango Liquid Diamonds Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Picture a roadside fruit stand where juicy mangoes, tropical citrus fruits and fuzzy peaches are being sliced up just for you. Take that flavour to go with the -ness Peachy Mango all-in-one 1g vape! Sativa-dominant and made with liquid diamonds and botanical terpenes, its all the delicious fruity flavour, plus high THC in a convenient cart and battery combo. A tropical escape in your pocket. Explore Your -ness

variants.title: Pink Grapes PR 20 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Bred by Compound Genetics and grown with love in Princeton BC, Pink Grapes is a jaw-dropping cross of Pink Runtz x Grape Gas. With sweet grape and gas notes, the fruity tang will linger in the air for hours after the bag is opened. Exotic, loud purple buds and flavour to match will make this a regular rotation in the most discerning smokers head-stash.

variants.title: Ontario's Own Sativa
variants.body_html: Ontario's Own sativa features a new and unique strain in each batch. Discover some of our most sought after dried flower strains.

variants.title: Sour Pulsar Peach THC Caffeine Gummy
variants.body_html: Prepare for Deep Space Propulsion Sour Peach. Get 10mg of THC in one sour and bold gummy. Also featuring <30mg naturally occurring caffeine.

variants.title: Sour Strawberry Void THC Caffeine Gummy
variants.body_html: Ignite your discovery, with Deep Space Propulsion Sour Strawberry Void. Get 10mg of THC in one sour and bold gummy. Also featuring <30mg naturally occurring caffeine.

variants.title: Ziestaz Shatter
variants.body_html: Available for a limited time only. In collaboration with Sweetgrass, this shatter combines vibrant citrus notes with rich, grounding earthy undertones, creating a perfect balance of refreshing zest and deep, herbal richness. Its crystalline texture breaks effortlessly, offering smooth dabs that pack a punch of flavour and potency.

variants.title: Grape Grenade Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Pull Grape Grenade is a liquid-diamond, flavour-packed explosion that’ll leave your taste buds reporting for duty. Bigger, bolder, and loaded with liquid diamonds! G.A. Liquid Diamond 510 Carts takes their signature botanical-terpene -infused distillate and adds liquid diamonds to deliver their most potent line up yet.

variants.title: Pink Goo Smalls
variants.body_html: Same legendary Pink Goo—now in a limited run of SMALLS. These buds may be smaller, but they still deliver the ultra-sticky resin, rich-floral earthiness, and smooth smoke the cultivar is known for. Named for its tree-like sap oozing trait, this cultivar stays true to its reputation—just in a more compact form.

variants.title: Yocan Shift Torch - Yellow
variants.body_html:
Take your torch game to the next level with the Yocan Shift Torch—a compact yet powerful butane torch built for precision, safety, and style. Whether you're using it for concentrates, culinary creations, or everyday lighting needs, the Shift Torch is your reliable, go-to flame source.

Key Features & Benefits

Adjustable Flame Control - Fine-tune the intensity of your flame with the built-in adjustment knob, reaching temps up to 2,500°F for optimal versatility.

Actuating Nozzle Design - A rotatable nozzle gives you directional control, letting you aim your flame exactly where you need it—perfect for detailed work or awkward angles.

Thermochromic Muzzle - The nozzle changes colour as it heats, giving you a visible cue for temperature and improving safety during use.

Windproof Performance - Engineered to maintain a strong, steady flame even in outdoor or breezy conditions.

Heat-Resistant Silicone Grip - A comfortable, non-slip silicone grip keeps your hand protected and steady, even during longer sessions.

Refillable Butane Chamber - Built with a generous capacity and is super easy to refill.

Durable Alloy & Ceramic Build - High-quality construction ensures long-term reliability and heat resistance.

Bold Colour Options - Available in five vibrant finishes to match your vibe: Pink, Yellow, Silver, Blue & Space Grey

Upgrade your torch experience with the Yocan Shift—where function meets flair.

variants.title: 95+ Saskatoon Berry Liquid Diamonds Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Inspired by Canada's Wild West with real value and quality cannabis ingredients. Saskatoon Berry is a flavour straight out of the Wild West. This prairie berry boasts rich fruity flavour blended with liquid diamonds, capped with our signature cowboy cartridge dust cap.

variants.title: Green Apple Gummies
variants.body_html: Since 1996, a small team of enthusiasts have dedicated themselves to bringing you some of the best cane sugar beverages possible and we’re not stopping anytime soon. Now our mission at M*ry Jones is to make cannabis-infused soft chews with flavours you love without any cannabis aftertaste. Each pack comes with four 2.5 mg of THC soft chews.

variants.title: Fully Charged Strawberry Watermelon OG CBG Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Enjoy the juiciest flavour combination of sweet strawberry and fresh watermelon with the Spinach® Fully Charged Strawberry Watermelon OG CBG-infused pre-roll. Infused with high-quality and high-potency cannabis extract, liquid diamonds, and dusted with kief coating at 40%+ total THC and added rare cannabinoid CBG. Inspired by a lineage that traces back to Strawberry OG & Watermelon OG — enjoy the sweet strawberry watermelon tastes.

variants.title: No.20 Distillate Delta 9 - Peach Gummies
variants.body_html: A smooth, juicy peach flavour with a perfectly balanced experience. Glenn’s No.20 delivers 10mg of Delta 9 THC in a single-pack gummy, crafted for a consistently delicious and reliable experience. If you’re looking for a flavourful treat, this gummy brings the perfect blend of sweetness and potency in every bite.

variants.title: Iced Mint Liquid Diamonds Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Enjoy the crisp and fresh taste of Iced Mint. This 1g, THC distillate 510 vape is blended with liquid diamonds for maximum potency and a frosty blast of flavour.

variants.title: Cherry Pineapple THC Seltzer
variants.body_html: Sweet cherry meets juicy pineapple in this bold, refreshing seltzer. A tropical twist that's as fun to drink as it is to say. Affordable, delicious, and just what you need.

variants.title: Tangelo 1:1:1 CBC/CBD/THC Gummies
variants.body_html: Pearls Tangelo is infused with THC, CBC and CBD in a 1:1:1 ratio. Each sugar-coated soft chew has 2 mg of CBC, 2 mg of CBD and 2 mg of THC. Pearls are bursting with citrus flavour and coated in sugar for a sweet treat no matter the occasion. 5 soft chews per pack.

variants.title: Super Lemon Haze Live Resin Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html:
Tap into pure, intense flavour and potency with DEBUNK Lemonade 1.0 g live resin vapes. Extracted from fresh frozen, outdoor-grown premium flower, our live resin vapes use single-source, strain-specific cultivars to consistently deliver a full spectrum experience.

This electric sativa is an iconic Lemon OG and Gorilla Haze cross that delivers a top-tier kickstart from its dominating lemon zest flavour. Loaded in fully ceramic, formulation-optimized hardware with the lab receipts on deck, this one's on lock.

variants.title: Yocan Black - Sip Smart Rig - White
variants.body_html:
Say hello to the Yocan Sip Smart Rig—your new go-to for low-key, high-quality concentrate sessions. Disguised as a travel tumbler, this sleek e-rig delivers smooth, flavourful hits with advanced ceramic heating and customizable temp control. Whether you’re on the move or chilling at home, the Sip is all about clean design, big performance, and total discretion.

Key Features & Benefits
Discreet Tumbler Design - Looks like your favourite drink tumbler, hits like a pro rig—perfect for on-the-go or low-key sessions.

360° Ceramic Cloud2 Chamber - Even, low-temp heating for full flavour and smooth clouds.

Four Temperature Settings - Choose between 490°F–545°F to dial in your perfect hit.

Smart Alerts - Lights and gentle vibration let you know when it’s good to go.

Built-In Water Filtration - Cools and filters each pull for smoother, cleaner vapor.

180 mAh Battery + USB-C Charging - Lasts for over 20 sessions and charges fast.

Joystick Control System - Easy, intuitive control with just a flick of your thumb.

The Yocan Sip Smart Rig packs smart features and strong performance into a clean, discreet design. Whether you’re looking for flavour, smoothness, or total stealth, the Sip delivers—no mess, no fuss, just premium concentrate sessions whenever and wherever you want.

variants.title: HoneyStick HRB
variants.body_html:
The Honeystick HRB is engineered for enthusiasts who demand a discreet yet powerful vaporizing experience. With its metal housing and precise temperature control, this portable device delivers smooth, flavourful vapor while offering simplicity and reliability. Whether you're relaxing at home or on the go, the HRB strikes an ideal balance between performance and portability.

Key Features & Benefits

Precise Temperature Control (212–428 °F) - Easily adjust to your desired temperature with accurate readings to unlock ideal vapor density and flavour profiles.


Rapid Heat-Up in 30 Seconds - Quickly reaches your set temperature so you can begin your session without delay.

Removable Ceramic Chamber - Easily swap, clean, or replace the heat-safe ceramic core for better taste and long-term upkeep.

Clear LED Display & Button Interface - Intuitive controls let you choose temperature, set preference, or activate smart oven lift mode effortlessly.

Magnetic USB-C Charging - Power up fast and safely with a magnetic connection that snaps into place—no fumbling with ports.

Honeystick HRB brings together durable materials, advanced temperature tuning, and user-friendly features to deliver a refined dry herb experience in a compact form.

variants.title: Mac Diamond Live Resin AIO Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Packed with high THC, the Mac Diamond Live Resin Disposable combines liquid diamonds and live resin for those who demand a high-potency experience. This 1g hybrid disposable delivers bold, smooth hits with complex flavour profiles, enhanced by terpenes delivered by live resin, with no added botanical terpenes.

variants.title: Jack Herer PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Jack Herer is a sativa-dominant cultivar with a spicy, piney aroma and citrus undertones. This classic offers a smooth, herbal flavour with hints of earth and lemon. Terpenes include limonene, myrcene, and caryophyllene. The flower is milled and rolled into lightweight paper cones complete with a paper filter.

variants.title: Crème de la Fleur
variants.body_html:
Creme de la Fleur is a striking cannabis strain that delights both the nose and the eyes with its unique sensory profile.
The aroma of Creme de la Fleur is a captivating blend of contrasts. It opens with earthy notes, reminiscent of a damp forest floor after rain—rich, , and full of life. This is seamlessly paired with a creamy smoothness, evoking the sweet, comforting scent of vanilla custard, adding a layer of warmth and indulgence. Finally, a subtle petrol kick weaves through the bouquet, offering a faint yet distinct whiff of diesel that lends an intriguing sharpness to the overall experience.
Visually, Creme de la Fleur is a standout. Its buds are exceptionally dense, forming tight, compact clusters that feel substantial in hand. These light green nuggets are almost entirely cloaked in a thick blanket of trichomes, giving them a frosty, shimmering quality that catches the light like morning dew. The sheer abundance of these crystalline structures not only enhances the strain’s aesthetic appeal but also hints at its potent potential.

variants.title: Outsiders Grape Animal Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Dab Bods Outsiders Grape Animal Infused pre-rolls are infused with high quality distillate and botanical terpenes, then generously coated in kief. This pack of pre-rolls showcases the popular Grape Animal strain. Savour the super sweet and fruity grape berry flavour.

variants.title: Do Si Dos PR 20 x 0.4 g
variants.body_html: A premium cannabis experience crafted for the discerning connoisseur. Our pre-rolls stand out because we meticulously select only the finest side colas for our product. We use hand-selected, top-grade buds, ensuring a superior smoking experience. Each pre-roll is packed with the rich, flavourful essence of DO-SI-Dos, promising potency that truly captures the essence of this renowned strain. Our dedication to quality is evident in every puff, delivering an unparalleled smoothness and consistency that discerning consumers will appreciate. Moreover, DO-SI-Dos Pre-Rolls are non-irradiated, preserving the plant's natural integrity and rich cannabinoid profile. This commitment to purity means you can enjoy the full, unaltered effects and flavours of our cannabis, without any compromise in quality. The result is a clean, smooth-burning pre-roll. Indulge in the luxury of DO-SI-Dos Pre-Rolls, where each inhale is a testament to our commitment to excellence and your satisfaction.

variants.title: GO TIME PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Quality Craft Pre Rolls, Full flower, proper moisture, affordable without sacrificing quality.

variants.title: Grease Monkey
variants.body_html: Grease Monkey, Stoned's new offering, merges the mighty Gorilla Glue #4 with Cookies & Cream for an out-of-this-world experience. This strain's potent effects and addictive flavor profile launch you on a cosmic voyage of discovery. With each inhale, you're treated to a galaxy of nutty vanilla and sweet skunky diesel, while its earthy aroma with hints of vanilla guides you through space. The high creeps up like a distant galaxy coming into view, before enveloping you in a nebula of euphoric relaxation. It is the key to unlocking the universe's serene secrets.

variants.title: Platinum Series
variants.body_html: Top Quality Craft Flower.

variants.title: Do Si Dos
variants.body_html: This strain boasts a staggeringly high THC level, ensuring potent and long lasting effects. Every puff is a ticket to an odyssey, a dance of flavours. Its rich, taste complements the potency.

variants.title: High Score - Liquid Diamond Double Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Enjoy the High Score Sativas Variety Pack, including Baja Breeze, The Monster, and The Twizz. This flavourful load-out includes 3 x 0.5g whole flower sativa pre-rolls infused with liquid THC diamonds, and rolled in kief for extra potency.

variants.title: Two Pack: Permanently Jealous & Bananaconda
variants.body_html: Two unique strains served up in our signature orange pouch. Up first is Permanently Jealous. Bred by us in collaboration with the team at Treez, Permanently Jealous is a cross of Permanent Market and Jealous. You can expect big notes of gas, funk and soap. Up next is Bananaconda, bred by the team at Jasper Farms. Bananaconda is a cross of Snake Cake and Dual OG #4, delivering its namesake flavours of banana, cream and gas.

variants.title: Blueberry Muffinz
variants.body_html: Blueberry Muffinz is packed full of flavour and aromas from the bake sale. If this strain feels familiar, that’s because it was once called Skullcap. Now revamped to Blueberry Muffinz to better highlight the aromas, these super dense bright green buds are caked in frosty trichomes and reek of a funky blueberry fruitiness thats hard to pin down in one whiff. Multiple attempts may be required. Prepare for a smooth burn and a tonne of flavour.

variants.title: Strawberry Sunburst 3:1 CBG:THC Gummies
variants.body_html: Strawberry Sunburst SHRED’ems are here to berry your taste buds in sweet strawberry goodness. Each pack includes five gummies with a 3:1 CBG: THC ratio, delivering 30 mg of CBG and 10 mg of THC per package. Perfect for ‘SHRED Heads’ looking to mix some minor cannabinoids into their next gummy sesh, these are as flavour packed as they are unique. Because sometimes, it’s the little things — like CBG — that make all the difference.

variants.title: Mac n' Cheese
variants.body_html: SHRED Mac n’ Cheese, another munchies-inspired BANGER in an iconic pouch! This 7g pre-milled, savoury sensation packs bold, cheesy aromas, making it the perfect side dish for any sesh — no milk or butter needed! Mac n’ Cheese delivers a smooth, satisfying vibe that hits every time. It’s everything SHRED Heads love in a blend — cheesy, easy and ready to roll

variants.title: Taster Series Variety Pack
variants.body_html: Fresh flower, bold flavours and value: meet the Taster Series Variety Pack. We’re bringing together two strains at a serious value. One half features popular strains such as Animal Rntz, Space Age Cake or Purple Churro, while the other half introduces exclusive genetics straight from the Redecan breeding program and grow team. With high THC, each bud is meticulously grown, hang dried, hand trimmed and carefully cured to deliver bold flavours and unforgettable aromas.

variants.title: Hash Hole Infused PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Hash Holes are hand rolled infused joints featuring a wooden mouthpiece, some of the highest grade indoor whole flower we can find and terpene rich hash rosin perfectly centred in the joint, creating a donut hole effect as it burns. Perfectly portioned and expertly rolled, it stands as a testament to the brand's dedication to quality and innovation in the cannabis industry.

variants.title: Green Apple Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Since 1996, a small team of enthusiasts have dedicated themselves to bringing you some of the best cane sugar beverages possible and we’re not stopping anytime soon. Now our mission at M*ry Jones is to make cannabis-infused vapes that harness a curated terpene blend that tastes just like our famous flavours.

variants.title: Blue Dream Live Resin + Liquid Diamonds AIO Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Delivering a terpene-rich infusion sourced from single strain flower grown under the sun, in living soil. Experience notes of sweet berries & earthy undertones.

variants.title: Blacksmith's Afghan Hash
variants.body_html: Roilty's Blacksmith's Afghan Hash (40-48% THC) is crafted in a time honoured tradition and delivers a rich, smooth and authentic hash experience. These dense, aromatic hash balls are hand rolled for the connoisseur seeking a taste of history and legacy.

variants.title: Lemon - Up
variants.body_html: If you are looking for those lemony, citrusy, sweet terps then you came to the right place. Lemon - Up is grown in Truro, Nova Scotia at our state of the art, small batch, indoor facility by some of the most experienced growers in the game. Our Lemon - Up will splash your taste buds with lemon, lime and orange flavours in a major way. This high THC, sativa-leaning hybrid is a cross of Lemon Tree x Purple Punch x Trop Cookies and gives gassy, earthy and citrusy aromas. We believe our buds are the best, so we treat them as such. So, of course we hang dry them. Hand trimming is also a must! We make sure that each strain is cured to perfection and depending on the strain, we find 21-28 days to be the sweet spot. We then take our best buds and hand pack them in our recyclable Nitrotin packaging.

variants.title: Heaviez GCG PR 1 x 2 g
variants.body_html: Available for limited time. JustKush used their legacy GCG (Green Crack x God Bud) whole flower and handcrafted it into this heavy hitter. variants.body_html: Peachy Dream is a sativa-dominant masterpiece proudly grown by the Jolly Boys. variants.body_html: Permanent Marker is an indica dominant hybrid. This blend is crafted in harmony by combining Biscotti crossed with Jealousy and crossed with Sherb Bx. variants.title: Yocan Black - Sip Smart Rig - Red

With the OLED display, you can track your battery life, puff count, and voltage setting with a quick glance.

Designed for convenience, the Sip offers superb functionality – inhale with an automatic draw or use the manual button mode depending on your preference. And with USB-C fast charging, you’ll be ready to rip again in no time.

Key Features & Benefits:

Discreet Drink Cup Design - Looks like a to-go cup for low-key sessions anywhere, anytime.

XTAL Coil Technology - Delivers ultra-smooth, flavour-forward hits with even concentrate vaporization.

Whether you’re new to dabbing or a seasoned connoisseur, the Yocan Sip makes it easy to elevate your concentrate game with sleek looks, top-tier tech, and effortless portability.
