variants.title: Gorilla Milk PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: A cross of the fan-favorite Gorilla Cookies x Cereal Milk, Gorilla Milk is a creamy cake-forward cultivar bringing sweet notes of sugary cereal milk and vanilla cookies, with a deep finish of red berries and spicy pepper from dominant terpenes caryophyllene, guaiol, and beta-pinene. Ready to burn in a pack of five.

variants.title: Acapulco Gold Live Resin Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Acapulco Gold Platinum Reefers start with our dried flower that has been hung to dry and hand trimmed before it is finely milled to the optimal consistency. We then mix in a live resin extract of Acapulco Gold made from butane extraction to enhance the flavour and experience to bring our pre-rolls to the next level.

variants.title: Jet Fuel Funk
variants.body_html: Jet Fuel Funk's aroma is a very noticeable garlic and funk alongside gas and diesel notes. With a generous ratio of large to small buds, these bags are sure to turn some heads. At Joi we hang dry, hand trim, and cure in stainless steel containers for at least 14 days to ensure a quality finish. Packages are filled by hand. Enjoi!

variants.title: Space Age Cake Grind
variants.body_html: Space Age Cake Grind is an indica that has huge terpene aromas with spicy pepper and earthiness in jars of milled flower. We use whole flower and mill it to fluffy perfection, so you get a convenient, consistent and high quality single strain product. Experience the fruity, cake and floral flavours of this GSC x Snow Lotus cross grown with legacy techniques featuring high THC potency. And because we only use whole flower for milling with absolutely no shake or trim, we can dial in a larger, fluffier milled flower experience that feels fresh from the grinder.

variants.title: Joyride PR 14 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Joyride pre-rolls are made with potent sativa strains crafted from whole flower.

variants.title: Highlighters - Watermelon G AIO Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: BOXHOT PRESENTS: Watermelon G, a 1.0 g indica all-in-one vape featuring a colossal dose of THC and some of the purest cannabis distillate available on the market. This gushing geyser leaves you flavour-soaked, bursting with intense watermelon and subtle fruity notes. All Highlighters are equipped with rechargeable USB-C technology, so they won't run out of juice before you do.

variants.title: 24k Gold Liquid Diamonds AIO Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Max potency, ready to rip. Get liquid diamonds in the palm of your hand with the DEBUNK 24K Gold all-in-one vape, a full-bodied sativa that hits different with an obsessively tasty flavour profile of apricot, fruit cocktail, and deep earthy Kush. Our proprietary hydrocarbon extraction process converts THCa diamonds into an ultra-pure, ultra-potent THC liquid diamond isolate that is then enhanced with a custom botanical terpene blend. Housed in potent, USB-C rechargeable hardware with a wide mouth opening for optimal airflow to minimize clogging, this kingpin holds it down.

variants.title: The Bread Bag
variants.body_html: The Bread Bag by Rosin Heads is a hybrid dried flower known for its unique aroma profile, featuring notes of baked goods and earthy undertones. Carefully cultivated and packaged in two 3.5g portions, this strain is designed for those who appreciate artisanal flavours and quality craftsmanship.

variants.title: Fully Charged Fruit Surge Mixer Pack Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: The power of fruity flavours and electrified vibes in this mixer pack will blow you away! The Spinach® Fully Charged Fruit Surge Mixer Pack has three unique infused pre-rolls filled with sweet, fresh, and fruity tastes to kick any session into high gear. These infused pre-rolls push the limits of your tastebuds with over 40%+ total THC, crafted from premium cannabis extract, liquid diamonds, and finished with a potent, kief-coated exterior. Go into a surreal world of flavour with the sweet Mango Dream, or head out to the the ultra-fruity outer limits with Galactic Grape. If you’re in the mood for something truly explosive, light the fuse of Blueberry Dynamite. Feel the electricity from one end of your session to the other with the Spinach® Fully Charged Fruit Surge Mixer Pack.

variants.title: Fire Breath PR 20 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html:
Turn up the heat with Back Forty's legendary Fire Breath. A cross between Fire OG and Mendo Breath, this potent Indica packs a punch in a 20-pack of slim pre-rolls.

With a bold profile of dank earth, forest, and diesel, this high-THC pre-roll is ready to light up the night.

Rolled in hemp paper and packed for the journey, these Fire Breath pre-rolls come in a double serving of our fan-favourite 10-packs - because the Back Forty isn't a place you visit just once.

variants.title: Purple Push Pop Ceramic Tip PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Experience WINK’s Purple Push Pop in a refined pre-roll, complete with a ceramic tip for a smooth, premium draw. This indica-dominant strain, made from ICC, Sunset Sherbet, and Jealousy F2 genetics, reveals creamy vanilla and berry notes with each puff.

variants.title: Purple Churro PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Level up with new Redecan pre-rolls. These packs of pre-rolled cones are expertly crafted for a smooth, consistent smoking experience that complements our dessert Purple Churro. This Apples & Bananas x Cinnamon Horchata cross is in a new pre-roll format with unbleached paper and a Dutch fold. With high THC and bursting with sweet vanilla and nuttiness, Purple Churro flower is meticulously grown, hang dried and then milled to fluffy perfection before being rolled into pre-rolled.

variants.title: Big White
variants.body_html: West Coast old school favourites come together to bring you Big White, a smooth riding indica with big snowy buds. A cross of The White x Big Bud, this potent yet balanced cultivar produces naturally chunky, trichome-rich buds and delivers a sweet nose of icing sugar and berries, with light floral and cakey notes from dominant terpenes caryophyllene, myrcene and bisabolol. Pure BC bud, hand-harvested, hang-dried and hand-finished.

variants.title: Live Rosin Seasonal Gas Pack
variants.body_html: Live Rosin Seasonal Gas Pack. Unleash the bold essence of cannabis. This exclusive collection is a tribute to the most potent, gas-forward phenotypes we have meticulously hunted over years. Each batch captures the distinct, fuel-like terpene profiles that connoisseurs enjoy — delivering unparalleled flavour, aroma, and potency. Crafted using fresh-frozen cannabis flower and a solventless extraction process, our Live Rosin preserves the plant’s full-spectrum of cannabinoids and terpenes. The result is a clean, smooth, and potent experience that is true to the source material. No additives, no shortcuts, just pure, unadulterated cannabis concentrate. Each Gas Pack features a selection of standout cultivars, offering variety and depth in every jar. Ideal for dabbing, vaporizing, or enhancing your flower, this seasonal release provides the bold, gassy aroma that true enthusiasts seek. Act fast, these exclusive packs are only available while supplies last.

variants.title: Pearadise 50S+ Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Escape to a blissful oasis with Dab Bods PEARadise 50’s+ Triple Infused Pre-Rolls. This strain delivers an exquisite flavor profile, featuring sweet, juicy pears beautifully accented by luscious grapes. Each puff is a delightful journey that tantalizes your taste buds and elevates your experience. Infused with premium resin, distillate and botanical terpenes, then coated with diamonds these pre-rolls pack a powerful punch with a potency of 50+. Available in a convenient 3-pack of 0.5g pre-rolls, they're ideal for sharing or savoring on your own. Dive into the refreshing sweetness of Dab Bods PEARadise and let every roll transport you to a paradise of flavor and relaxation!

variants.title: Coffee Chillows Pouches
variants.body_html:
Experience Potluck's world of flavours - without the smoke. Get loud without the cloud with Chillows! Potluck Chillows feature an infusion of THC isolate and flavours to deliver a flavourful yet discreet experience for cannabis consumers.

With 10mg per pouch and rapid onset, Potluck Chillows can elevate any experience while keeping it low-key.

variants.title: Chemzilla PR 20 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html:
Brace yourselves, the secret is out on our latest monster: Chemzilla. A cross between Chemdawg and Godzilla Glue, this potent Indica is available in a 20-pack slim pre-roll.

With a profile full of chem, earth, and spice, this high-THC pre-roll is a force of nature.

Rolled in hemp paper and packed for the journey, these Chemzilla pre-rolls come in a double serving of our fan-favourite 10-packs - because the Back Forty isn't a place you visit just once.

variants.title: Blue Ztarburzt PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Blue Ztarburzt is a cross of Purple Thai x Afghan strains. Bred by Backpack Boyz, the oversized dark green buds have deep blue undertones, thin orange hairs and a thick frosty coating of tiny, blue tinted white crystal trichomes. Expect fresh blueberries and red fruit aromas on the dry pull and an intensely sweet candy gas flavour on the smoke. Craft designated milled whole flower, hand trimmed and hand rolled in hemp paper, and packaged in home compostable tubes.

variants.title: Zour Watermelon Blunt PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Zour Watermelon is an iconic "one in a melon" sativa dominant cross of Watermelon Z x Loompas Headband. Dripping with juicy melon flavour and boasting high THC levels that make it a perfect storm of potent and sweet. Fruit Drops blunts are rolled with a natural chamomile leaf wrap.

variants.title: Pink Passionfruit & Peach Ceramic Tip Infused PR 1 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Our in-house chef has concocted a rich blend of peach and passionfruit using our small batch, indoor grown Pink Kitty flower and a precise blend of natural terpenes. Handcrafted with flower from by the AVANT Team, with zero shake or trim and packed into a custom ceramic tipped cone.

variants.title: Cosmic Lemonade PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Color's Cosmic Lemonade is a sativa dominant cross of Jean Guy and Alien Dog. Cosmic Lemonade produces a pungent and sweet citrus aroma with notes of earth and gas. These pre-rolls are perfectly packed with gently milled flower, not trim or shake, to ensure each joint contains fresh and flavourful cannabis.

variants.title: Arizer II MAX Vaporizer
variants.body_html:
Der Arizer Solo II Max nimmt alles, was Sie am ursprünglichen Solo II lieben, und verbessert es für ein noch besseres Erlebnis mit trockenen Kräutern. Mit der fortschrittlichen Rapid-Heating-Ceramic-Technologie erreicht dieses schlanke Gerät die optimale Temperatur in weniger als 30 Sekunden und liefert sanften, geschmackvollen Dampf mit minimaler Wartezeit. Entwickelt für diejenigen, die volle Kontrolle wünschen, führt der Solo II Max benutzerdefinierte Sitzungseinstellungen, automatische Bildschirm- und Steuerungsumkehr sowie einen diskreten Dunkelmodus für Umgebungen mit schwachem Licht ein. Es geht darum, Ihre Sitzung an Ihre Stimmung anzupassen, egal ob Sie unterwegs sind oder einen entspannten Abend zu Hause genießen. Das Laden ist schneller und bequemer als je zuvor mit USB-C, und die verlängerte Akkulaufzeit von 3 Stunden bedeutet mehr Sitzungen zwischen den Ladevorgängen. Kombinieren Sie es mit Ihrem Lieblings-14-mm-Glas für wassergefilterte Züge – der Solo II Max ist darauf ausgelegt, sich an Ihre Vorlieben anzupassen.

Hauptmerkmale & Vorteile

Schnelles Aufheizen - Der fortschrittliche Keramikheizer erreicht die Verdampfungstemperatur in weniger als 30 Sekunden.

USB-C-Laden & Durchgangsnutzung - Schnelles, flexibles Laden von jedem kompatiblen Gerät – plus Dampfen während des Ladevorgangs.

Benutzerdefinierte Sitzungssteuerungen - Personalisieren Sie Sitzungsdauer, Temperatur und Modi für Ihr ideales Erlebnis.

Dunkelmodus + automatische Bildschirmumkehr - Stealth-freundliche Benutzeroberfläche und intelligente Anzeigeorientierung für einfaches Betrachten aus jedem Winkel.

Premium-Glas-Dampfbahn - Reine Borosilikat-Aromaröhren liefern reinen, terpene-reichen Geschmack.

Kompatibilität mit 14-mm-Wasserpfeifenadaptern - Einfaches Anschließen an die meisten Drittanbieter-Gläser für sanftere, kühlere Züge.

Verlängerte Akkulaufzeit - Das Dual-Cell-Stromsystem liefert bis zu 3 Stunden Laufzeit pro Ladung.

Egal, ob Sie reinen Geschmack oder verfeinerte Kontrolle suchen, der Solo II Max gibt Ihnen die Werkzeuge, um jede Sitzung zu verbessern – mit der Zuverlässigkeit und Handwerkskunst, für die Arizer bekannt ist.

variants.title: Pineapple Drift Distillate Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html:
Surf's up! Pineapple Drift is a riptide of bold pineapple and 38%+ THC - get drenched in tropical flavour that hits as hard as a tidal wave.

Made with milled whole flower, infused with our signature triple-distilled distillate, dusted in premium kief, and boosted with botanical terpenes - these infused pre-rolls deliver smooth hits, high THC potency, and the BIG, BOLD flavour you expect from G.A.!

variants.title: Quickies Blood Orange Kush PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Tweed Blood Orange Kush is your one way ticket to a tranquil and elevated escape. Imagine a burst of blood orange, met with a dank classic Kush finish. It's a zesty carnival for your senses.

variants.title: NY Lemon Diesel
variants.body_html: Introducing NY Lemon Diesel – a bold new sativa from 1964. NY Lemon Diesel brings an invigorating citrus twist, combining bright-lemon zest with subtle earthy undertones. Its aroma is fresh and punchy, mingling notes of citrus with a hint of vanilla for a balanced, vibrant profile. Terpenes include limonene, terpinolene, and myrcene.

variants.title: Daytime Express Variety Pack PR 12 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Why settle for one strain when you can have three classic strains! This unique mixed 12 x 0.5g pre-roll multipack gives you the best of both worlds with a combination of sativa-dominant strains. Featuring four pre-rolls each of either Blue Dream, Amnesia Haze, Trainwreck, or Ghost Train Haze. Always packed with a humidity device for extended freshness. Product Lineage: Ghost OG x Nevilles Wreck, Blueberry x Haze, Afghani x Haze.

variants.title: Papaya C. Live Rosin
variants.body_html: Available for a limited time only. Indulge in the rich, potent experience of Papaya Cake Live Rosin, crafted from the renowned hybrid Papaya Cake. This premium concentrate is made using a solventless extraction process, preserving the terpene profile and robust cannabinoid content that make Papaya Cake so special. With its tropical, fruity aroma complemented by subtle earthy undertones, this live rosin offers an exotic taste. Expect a smooth, flavourful vapor that embodies the creamy sweetness of papaya and the balanced earthiness, making every dab a delicious treat.

variants.title: Blueberry Lights PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Blueberry Lights is a frosty, indica-dominant cultivar, born from Northern Lights x Blueberry genetics, that hits with fruity, spicy, and berry-like aromas that light up your senses. Pre-rolled in 10 x 0.35g joints—just spark and inhale. Terpenes include beta-caryophyllene, beta-myrcene, and humulene.

variants.title: Pineapple Haze PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Pineapple Haze brings classic Super Silver Haze traits of a potent sativa, but with an added touch only Pineapple Buds can provide. By crossing this outstanding genetic with Pineapple Tart, the flavour profile gets an added mouth-watering, creamy, pineapple-coconut taste. The flowers are bright green with red hues and have a thick, frosty coating of trichomes. This pre-roll is made in-house by hand and machine, using only fresh, small-batch flower. Terpenes include limonene, humulene, and caryophyllene.

variants.title: Purple G*Shers PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Purple G*shers is bred in-house by crossing a consumer favourite cultivar, Hawaiian Pineapple, with Tiki Madmen's Gushers. The result is a unique, potent sativa that has a loud tropical taste. The dark purple flowers glisten with trichomes and burst with flavour. This pre-roll is made in-house by hand and machine, using only fresh, small-batch flower. Terpenes include germacrene, myrcene, and caryophyllene.

variants.title: EmergenZ
variants.body_html: Introducing EmergenZ, an incredibly flavourful sativa-dominant cultivar crossed between Orange Push Pop and Sunset Sherbet. Potent and delicious. Indoor grown in small batches on the West Coast, Broken Coast strives to push the limits on what craft flower can be. Experience notes of citrus, grapefruit, and pine from large, trichome-rich buds. Terpenes include beta-myrcene, beta-caryophyllene, and limonene.

variants.title: Durban K x Citrus Sap Live Resin Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Lord Jones Live Resin Fusions are kief-coated and filled with high-potency, terpene-rich live resin and hard-hitting, single-strain flower sure to go beyond all expectations. With the Lord Jones Live Resin Fusions Durban Kush x Citrus Sap, take your tastebuds through an orchard of citrus and cedar flavours from the combination of tangy Citrus Sap live resin and Durban Kush flower. Together they create a live-resin-caviar-infused pre-roll like no other. With the addition of premium ceramic filters your smoking experience is now smoother than ever.

variants.title: Platinum Pave Blunt PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: A visual masterpiece, the embodiment of an extraordinary indica, a sensorial triumph – Platinum Pavé deserves every bit of the hype. Pheno-hunted from over 500 seeds from Compound Genetics, this Spritzer x Pavé cross hits hard with high THC and sweet diesel and intoxicating earthy aromas in a 1g, hemp-based blunt. The vibrantly hued, deep green and royal purple buds are dripping with an otherworldly amount of trichomes. They use slow cold curing to optimally preserve trichomes, enhancing Platinum Pavé’s unique terpene profile and flavour, including limonene, beta-caryophyllene, and linalool.

variants.title: Queen of Bud Blue Topaz Special Edition Waterpipe - 18 in.
variants.body_html:
Glamorous, grounded, and glowing in all the right ways—the Blue Topaz Special Edition Water Pipe is your new favourite centerpiece for calm, curated sessions. Standing tall at 18 inches, this elegant piece blends soft frosted textures with a dreamy ombré finish that fades from icy white to tranquil blue.
It’s more than just a pretty face. The queen-sized tree percolator delivers smooth, silky draws, while the 5mm thick borosilicate glass keeps things sturdy and chic. Frosted detailing on the base, neck, and mouthpiece adds just the right touch of sophistication—like jewelry for your glass collection.
Key Features & Benefits
Queen-Sized Tree Percolator – For a clean, cool inhale that feels as smooth as it looks.
Frosted Glass Accents – A velvety matte finish along the base, neck, and mouthpiece that’s soft to the eye and rich in texture.
5mm Thick Glass – Solid, durable, and made to last—because royalty deserves reliability.
Blue Topaz Ombre – A graceful fade from white to pale blue for a luxe, spa-day-meets-smoke-sesh vibe.
18” Tall – Statement height with balanced proportions that feel refined, not overwhelming.
This isn’t just a water pipe—it’s a vibe. Perfect for displaying, perfect for using, and perfect for those who like their sessions with a little shimmer.

variants.title: Super Heavies PR 10 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Anchor your orbit with this powerhouse 10-pack of 1-gram pre-rolled joints, forged from the densest indica flower mined from the galaxy's heaviest nebulae. Each Super Heavy delivers a smooth, gravitational pull of deep, rich flavors and a tranquil, body-locking buzz-ideal for docking into relaxation or drifting through the cosmic night.

variants.title: Kannastör Jar Body Grinder 2.2" - Black
variants.body_html: The Kannastör Jar Body Grinder is built for those who appreciate precision and durability. With its sleek black design and innovative features, this grinder offers a superior grinding experience. Whether you're grinding on-the-go or at home, the 2.2" size is the perfect balance of portability and functionality, making it an essential tool for any user. Designed with a modular body, this grinder includes a monofilament easy-change screen, allowing for seamless adjustments. The transparent chamber lets you monitor your grind level without having to open the grinder, ensuring a perfect consistency every time. Made from high-quality materials, this grinder is built to last and stands up to daily use while maintaining its sharpness and efficiency. Key Features & Benefits: Modular Design & Easy Cleaning: The removable chamber and monofilament screen allow for easy disassembly, cleaning, and quick screen changes. Efficient Grinding: Features precision-engineered teeth that offer a smooth, even grind, perfect for all your needs. Transparent Viewing Window: The clear chamber allows you to check the contents without opening the grinder, giving you full control over your grind. Compact & Portable: At 2.2", it's the perfect size for both home use and travel, offering convenience without sacrificing performance. Durable Construction: Made from premium materials, ensuring long-lasting performance that resists wear and tear. Secure Locking Mechanism: Ensures a tight seal, preventing spills and ensuring a mess-free experience. The Kannastör Jar Body Grinder combines convenience, style, and precision in one sleek, durable package, making it the ideal choice for those who want a reliable and efficient grinding tool.

variants.title: Red Jasper Raspberry Cocoa Liquid Diamond Infused PR 6 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Queen of Bud’s Red Jasper Liquid Diamond Infused Pre-Rolls are hand crafted to burn evenly with an effortlessly smooth draw. Infused with liquid diamonds, each puff delivers high potency and full flavour.

variants.title: Shungite Earl Grey IC Liquid Diamond Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Crafted with intention and precision, Queen of Bud’s Shungite pre-rolls are infused with potent liquid diamonds. Expect sweet notes with a smooth and flavourful burn.

variants.title: Limited Reserve
variants.body_html: Natural History by Token brings you a new take on a classic brand. Our Limited Reserve Sativa will feature a curated, rotating selection from some of Canada’s best small batch growers. Staying true to our brand ethos, we aim to support our community, stay true to strain, and bring our consumers the best product experience at the best price possible. Don't miss out on these flavourful limited drops!

variants.title: Lime Cranfusion Infused PR 3 x 0.4 g
variants.body_html: There's no confusion with Lime Cranfusion infused pre-rolls. Each puff is bursting with cranberries and lime. We’re talking whole flower, kief dusted and flavour amped with distillate.

variants.title: Fully Blasted Mango Lime1:1 CBC:THC Gummies
variants.body_html: Prepare for blast off! SOURZ by Spinach® Fully Blasted Mango Lime 1:1 CBC | THC gummies feature a combination of tropical mango and tangy lime flavours. Enjoy a balanced blend of 10mg THC and 10mg CBC per piece. This dual-flavoured gummy is over-the-top with natural flavours and blasted with sour crystals. 1 gummy per pack, 10mg THC total and 10mg CBC total.

variants.title: Frost'd Flakes PR 7 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Thanks to the crystalline trichomes that coat this strain, Frost’d Flakes is doubly-aptly-named in homage to its parent strains. Crossed between Cereal Milk x MAC 1, this indica variety showcases tightly grown, pale green flowers with a smattering of violet accents. Its taste and aroma are subtly sweet with fruity notes, reminiscent of fruity cereals.

variants.title: Cookie'z PR 7 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: LowKey’s French Cookie’z (Platinum Cookies x Ice Cream) flower glitters under bright light, captivating the eye as its scent grabs the nose with a wave of cream and sweetness — as its name suggests — and the barest hint of spice, pine and citrus for depth. Its trichome layer is dense enough to obscure leaves that range from sea foam to emerald, interspersed with indigo. Our recipe is complete with the saffron-orange threads this rare sativa phenotype exhibits throughout its robust, compact flowers.

variants.title: Panama Gold PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Panama Gold is a vintage strain that stands the test of time. This hybrid strain has an earthy and woody aroma that is layered with subtle hints of citrus and spice, creating a smooth smoke.

variants.title: Banana Baby
variants.body_html: Meet Banana Baby, an indica dominant strain that combines the unique genetics of Apples & Bananas and Granddaddy Purp to bring you a smooth experience with a moderate THC potency. Its dense, compact buds are a feast for the eyes, showing off bright green buds frosted with shimmering trichomes. Breathe in the sweet and citrusy aroma with hints of fruitiness courtesy of limonene, selina-diene and caryophyllene terpenes. Grown with care in Pointe-Claire, Quebec, every step is hands on. It's hand harvested, whole plant hang dried, hand trimmed and cured cold and slow for at least 14 days. Each package is lovingly packed by hand.

variants.title: Alien Kush
variants.body_html: Alien Kush (Alien Cookies x Kush Mints) is one of the most complex flower Cheers Cannabis has grown in the past year. A strong fruity nose but earthy Kush taste with a strong potency. The buds are covered in frosty white trichomes.

variants.title: Red Velvet #11
variants.body_html: Bred by the renowned Grandiflora, Red Velvet #11 is a cross of Piña Açai x Lemon Cherry G that brings cream cheese with rich and cakey undertones. Always handcrafted from our genetics, our growers and grown in our facilities in Okanagan, BC.

variants.title: Max 60's Blood Orange Tiple Infused PR 3 x 0.45 g
variants.body_html: Chillbilly Blood Orange Max 60’s bring the heat with liquid diamonds, crushed diamonds, and botanically derived distillate on the inside, plus a solid diamond coating on the outside. Each pre-roll punches in at with high THC, delivering a bold rush of deep, citrusy blood orange with a smooth finish. Big flavor—because Chillbilly plays hard and hits harder.

variants.title: Magic Pop RX
variants.body_html: Magic Pop Rockz, created by Seed Junky, is a cross between LA Pop Rockz and Magic Marker. Upon opening your pouch, you’ll be met with a candy, sweet and vibrant aroma. The strain bursts with notes of tart berries, sugar, fuel and permanent marker. The buds are dense, frosty and glittering with trichomes. Because it’s the right thing to do, all of our flower is hang dried, hand trimmed, slow cold cured and hand packaged. We believe fresh and terpene-rich is best, which is why all our flower is packaged in nitrogen flushed pouches with a humidity pack. It's non-irradiated, of course.

variants.title: Max 60's Blue Lemonade Triple Infused PR 3 x 0.45 g
variants.body_html: Blue Lemonade Max 60’s take potency to the next level with liquid diamonds, crushed diamonds, and botanically derived distillate on the inside, plus a solid diamond coating on the outside for a powerhouse experience. Each pre-roll delivers a bold fusion of tangy blue raspberry and zesty lemonade. Big flavor—because Chillbilly never does anything halfway.

variants.title: Genghis Chron PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Conquer your next session with Genghis Chron. This bold and legendary cultivar forges its dynasty from the iconic Pre-’98 Bubba Kush and Sour Diesel, delivering a smoke worthy of an emperor. Drenched in crystalline trichomes, it boasts impressive potency while striking with a pungent aroma of kush and diesel. Terpenes include myrcene, limonene, and pinene. Genghis Chron’s medium-sized, frost-dusted nugs are milled and packed with precision into this 10-pack of joints.

variants.title: BC Organic Sunset Runtz
variants.body_html: When two powerhouse genetics collide, expect great things. From friends at Gastown Genetics, BC Organic Sunset Runtz brings bold aromas of gas with a complex backing of spicy and sweet notes. This heavy-hitting, indica-dominant cultivar marries Sunset Sherbet with Runtz, to create this tantalizing cultivar that will impress. Always grown in their organic living soil, to bring out the best expression of the genetics. Hang-dried, hand-trimmed, and cold cured, her beautiful buds are packed in a glass jar for optimal freshness.

variants.title: Orange & Cream Gummies
variants.body_html: Since 1996, a small team of soda enthusiasts have dedicated themselves to bringing you one of the best cane sugar sodas possible and we're not stopping anytime soon. Now our mission at Mary Jones is to make cannabis-infused soft chews with flavours you love without any cannabis aftertaste. Each soft chew contains 2.5 mg of THC.

variants.title: Juiced Xtreme Peach Bum Resin Infused PR 3 x 0.6 g
variants.body_html: Peach Bum Juiced Xtreme resin infused pre-rolls have a robust, high quality and full spectrum resin infusion with high THC. They're juicy with peach, fruity and sweet flavours and their new kief coating.

variants.title: Orange Crush PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Skip the fridge and glass, and enjoy the citrus blast from these juicy pre-rolls! Orange Crush features a bright, terpene-rich profile of limonene, caryophyllene, and myrcene for an orange delight. These whole flower pre-rolls deliver a hearty level of THC with a juicy delight. Grown in small batches with every pre-roll handcrafted, squeeze sunshine on demand with Orange Crush!!

variants.title: Big Blue Razz Disty+Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Try the delicious flavours of the Big Blue Razz Disty + Diamond Vape. A sweet cherry and zesty sour lime aroma combined with high quality distillate and diamonds.

variants.title: Queen Green
variants.body_html: Queen Green is a heavy-hitting herbal hybrid. This aptly named strain is a cross of powerful parents Space Queen x Green Crack. Its expression is fresh and earthy with prominent aromas of herbs, dairy, and toasted peppercorns, complimented by a touch of citrus and pine, from dominant terpenes caryophyllene, limonene, linalool. In the greenhouse, the plant produces large, sticky, super tight buds with violet undertones and burnt orange hairs. Pure BC bud, hand-harvested, hang-dried and hand-finished.

variants.title: Diablo PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Diablo, a cross of MKU and Bubba Kush, boasts pungent peppery diesel aromas and spicy, gassy flavours with sticky and dense green buds.

variants.title: Cherry Blasted Lime
variants.body_html: Get ready for the familiar, very cherry flavour of XMG Atomic Sours Cherry Blasted Lime beverages. This is one of the sweetest and sourest beverage you'll ever sip. Taste the nostalgic and bold flavours of cherry and lime with zero cannabis aftertaste. Infused with 10 mg of THC, 10 mg of CBG and guarana for caffeine.

variants.title: Foggy Peaches
variants.body_html: Sip into something sweetly reminiscent with XMG Atomic Sours Foggy Peaches beverages. This is one of the sweetest and sourest beverage you'll ever sip. variants.title: Summer Haze
variants.body_html: Grab your shades and get ready to soak up the sunshine with Summer Haze. The strain in this limited-edition sativa is Where's My Bike, an Amnesia x Biker Haze cross bursting with fruity, spicy and earthy aromas and 25-30% THC. It's sociable and uplifting, perfect for days you never want the good vibes to end. Savour the long, sunlit days with Summer Haze, available for a limited time in 7g flower and 3 x 0.5g pre-rolls.

variants.title: Grape Grenade Diamond Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html:
Pull the pin, it's go time! Grape Grenade Ultra-Infused, an indica with 60%+ THC, packs a diamond-infused flavour explosion that'll leave your tastebuds reporting for duty.

You read that right. DIAMONDS. G.A. Ultra-Infused Pre-Rolls are made using milled whole flower, dusted in premium kief, boosted with botanical terpenes, and infused with diamonds to deliver our most potent pre-roll yet. Go Higher than ever before with 60%+ THC and the G.A. flavours you love.

variants.title: Hard Hitters Psycho Citrus Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Unleash the madness with Psycho Citrus. This intense vape delivers a wild burst of crazy citrus flavor that electrifies your taste buds with every inhale. But the excitement doesn't stop at the flavor-Psycho Citrus is formulated with liquid diamonds for a very hard-hitting experience. Perfect for those who crave a powerful and exhilarating vaping session, Psycho Citrus is your go-to for an unforgettable and potent citrus blast.

variants.title: Green Monsters PR 10 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Unleash the beast with this cosmic 10-pack of 1-gram pre-rolled joints, engineered from stellar sativa flower harvested at the edge of the galaxy's green frontier. Each pre-roll ignites a smooth, interstellar high-delivering vibrant, earthy flavors and a supernova of uplifting energy to fuel your orbit through the day or spark creative hyperspace jumps.

variants.title: Strawberry Pie Milled Ready to Roll
variants.body_html: Strawberry Pie is an indica-dominant hybrid cultivar made by crossing Georgia Pie with Strawberry Fritter. This sought after strain smells of fruity berry's with hints of fresh strawberries. Carefully cured and packaged for a truly enjoyable experience.

variants.body_html: Jays presents potent products full of flavour in convenient formats for everyday Canadians. Our new Sodaze diamond infused pre-rolls bring value, potency and big flavour twisted into bright colour coded cones. With a line up of 3 sweet flavours.

variants.title: Purple Zushi PR 3 x 0.5 g

variants.body_html: Wyld Sour Peach Mango Sativa Enhanced CBG:THC gummies are a 3:1 ratio product featuring a restorative, CBG-dominant profile and THC. Made sustainably using real fruit, botanical terpenes, and natural flavours, each gummy contains 15mg CBG and 5mg THC for a total of 30mg CBG and 10mg THC per pack. All Wyld gummies are packaged in a compostable pouch, and our recipes are formulated by food scientists to provide consistent experiences that taste amazing. Wyld gummies use sunflower lecithin to improve bioavailability and onset time and are made to be thermostable up to 55 degrees celsius, with a firm texture that doesn't stick to your teeth. Each Wyld Sour Peach Mango Sativa Enhanced gummy contains the terpenes limonene, valencene, alpha-pinene, and beta-pinene for an energetic and uplifting experience. Wyld is proud to be a Climate Neutral Certified brand.

variants.title: StrawKiwi Distillate Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html:
StrawKiwi brings a tidal wave of flavour! Expect big swells of strawberry mixed with a kiwi undercurrent. Kick back and escape to the island life with this 38%+ sweet and tangy treat.

Made with milled whole flower, infused with our signature triple-distilled distillate, dusted in premium kief, and boosted with botanical terpenes - these infused pre-rolls deliver smooth hits, high THC potency, and the BIG, BOLD flavour you expect from G.A.!

variants.title: Live Rosin Sour Cherry Gummies
variants.body_html: NATURAL FLAVOUR, NATURAL COLOUR Live Rosin infused, pectin-based, super large & juicy gummies with the perfect amount of Sour Cherry goodness. 5 mg per pc x 2 pcs

variants.title: Shark Bite Toasters Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Crank up the toast level with Toasters. Super flavourful and potent kief-coated joints infused with THC distillate and a tropical flavour explosion of watermelon, orange, strawberry and coconut. *Insert sandy paradise*. Super Toast. Always Ready.

variants.title: Jack Haze Lr Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Legendary strain, Live Resin Jack Haze offers a terpene-rich infusion. The flavour profile is a symphony of earthy, pine and citrus notes, reminiscent of a serene walk through a sun-dappled forest. Embrace the beauty of the great outdoors, now captured in every aromatic infused pre-roll.

variants.title: 24K Gold CBD:CBG Transdermal Spray
variants.body_html: Unveiling 24K Gold CBD:CBG Transdermal Spray containing 500mg of CBD and 50mg of CBG. Carefully crafted in the serene landscapes of Okanagan, British Columbia, this premium spray offers a unique blend of purity and sophistication. It contains a high-potency blend of pure CBD and CBG Isolates. This advanced transdermal formulation ensures rapid absorption. Enriched with 24K gold, hyaluronic acid, and magnesium, it is offered in a convenient 60mL size, perfect for on-the-go use and easy application.

variants.title: Double Baked Cake PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: The Jolly Boys have arrived and are stoked to launch their Double Baked Cake! A tantalizing indica-dominant cultivar that delivers the ultimate Dessert experience, Double Baked Cake is the perfect blend of indulgent Cake and Cookie flavour profiles. This exquisite cultivar offers a rich symphony of sweet, creamy vanilla cake layered with buttery cookie dough undertones, all tied together with a whisper of spice. Terpenes include caryophyllene, limonene, and myrcene.

variants.title: Agave Lime
variants.body_html: Say hello to Ace Valley Agave Lime. This invigorating, salty-sweet beverage brings the feeling of sun-kissed shores straight to your taste buds, with its bright, tangy lime flavour that is both vibrant and fresh. Made without sugar and features 10mg CBD and 5mg THC.

variants.title: Altitude Lemon-Lime THC+CBG
variants.body_html: Enjoy Deep Space Propulsion Altitude Lemon-Lime. This glacial citrus soda will transport you to the edge of the universe. Fuelled by 10mg THC, 10mg CBG & <30mg naturally occurring caffeine. Escape the ordinary and embrace the extraordinary.

variants.title: Comboz: Ultra Sour + Blueberry Dream
variants.body_html: Big Bag o' Buds CombOz bring you the ultimate duo: 14g of Blueberry Dream and 14g of Ultra Sour, packed into one big bag with strains neatly separated into their own resealable pouches. Blueberry Dream combines Blueberry Kush x Blue Dream for a sweet, floral and berry sativa experience with uplifting, mellow vibes at 22%+ THC. Ultra Sour packs a punch with terpinolene and limonene for a tart, lemony profile and kushy, herbal notes. Together, these sativas offer big terps, big flavour, and big buds, all in one convenient combo pack!

variants.title: Appleberry Smack Gummies
variants.body_html: Introducing Appleberry Smack Gummies, powered by FAST™, a proprietary nano-emulsion technology, that delivers cannabinoid levels that are nearly 2x higher with a 50% faster onset. Each 10mg THC pack contains four gummies (2.5mg per piece) that are formulated for rapid cannabinoid absorption. Experience the sweet bliss of apple and strawberry flavours with this rapid onset gummy.

variants.title: Jack Haze Live Resin Hash
variants.body_html: Legendary strain, Live Resin Jack Haze offers a terpene-rich infusion. The flavour profile is a symphony of earthy, pine and citrus notes, reminiscent of a serene walk through a sun-dappled forest. Embrace the beauty of the great outdoors, now captured in hash.

variants.title: Granddaddy Purple Shatter Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Experience the iconic flavour and potency of Granddaddy Purple in Shatterizer’s Shatter Infused Pre-Rolls. This pack of pre-rolls combines premium flower with shatter infusion for a smooth, potent, and flavourful smoke. Bursting with rich grape and berry notes, complemented by earthy and subtle pine undertones, these pre-rolls deliver the full essence of GDP. Each pre-roll is crafted for a consistent and satisfying experience. Quality, flavour, and potency — elevate your session with Shatterizer!

variants.title: Mango Live Action AIO Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: GAS Box Carts are rechargeable, ergonomic, and discreet. Crystal-rich live diamonds provide bold flavour and maximum potency in every draw. Mango features ripe tropical mango and sweet citrus notes, creating a calming, body-focused indica high. (GAS) Box Carts are pre-charged and easy to use. Just grip, rip, and go.

variants.title: Lemon Shortcake Ceramic Tip PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Bright and fresh, WINK’s Lemon Shortcake pre-roll is crafted for those who appreciate quality and design. Featuring a ceramic tip for an ultra-smooth draw, this sativa-dominant pre-roll delivers a light, citrus aroma with a hint of sweetness, wrapped in a stylish 116mm tube. Made with premium flower, this pre-roll combines convenience with WINK’s signature sophistication.

variants.title: Legit Live Resin Purple Churr* AIO Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Purple Churr* Legit Live Resin all-in-one vapes feature full spectrum extract derived from one ingredient: fresh Purple Churr* flower frozen at the optimal harvest time. We preserve the unique essence of the live flower using a butane extraction process to refine it into a live resin extract with remarkable flavour, colour and consistency. No added terpenes or cannabinoids, shortcuts or fillers, just the full character of Purple Churro in an all-in-one vape. Featuring a custom Turbo Core™️ heating coil and a ceramic wick that vaporizes the extract quickly and consistently, these AIO vapes recharge reliably and have a pre-heat function. These AIO Vapes paired with the terpene-rich, flavour forward live resin highlight the sweet sativa of this Apples & Bananas x Cinnamon Horchata cross and its sweet vanilla and nutty flavours.

variants.title: THC:THC-V RKT POP Live Rosin Gummies
variants.body_html: Rocket Pop Live Rosin Gummies by 1964 have landed! These nostalgic treats combine the vibrant flavours of cherry, lime, and blue raspberry with the potency of THC-V and premium Live Rosin. Each gummy is thoughtfully crafted to pair its bold, fruity taste. Made without gluten or animal products, these gummies are the ideal choice for those looking to add a spark to their edibles journey.

variants.title: 1:1:1 Sour Sunny Watermelon Lemonade THCV/CBC/THC Gummies
variants.body_html: Packed with 10 mg of THC, 10mg of THCV and 10 mg of CBC, and with a juicy fusion of Watermelon Lemonade, our Olli StikiStix feature a chewy texture and a unique shape allowing you to split them into four strips.

variants.title: Pink Death
variants.body_html: Pink Death is the descendant of two cultivars considered to be Cannabis Royalty, Death Bubba X Pink Kush. This princess is highly sought after due to her rock hard icy nugs and happy hard hitting Indica effects. A dank pine aroma begins the experience followed by a spicy but sweet earthy flavour. Best enjoyed end of day, Pink Death will have you peacefully chill and enjoying some snacks in no time.

variants.title: Blue Lemonade Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Light and zesty lemonade, with sweet, smooth blueberries- Trippy Sips unique Blue Lemonade flavour will get your mouth watering. We've blended it into high potency THC distillate infused with liquid THC diamonds, and packed into our crinkle straw 510 vape for bigger, better pulls and our most potent trip ever.

variants.title: Durban Poison
variants.body_html: This pure sativa originates from the South African port city of Durban. Growers and concentrate enthusiasts will both enjoy the over-sized resin glands which make this strain a quality choice for concentrate extraction. The buds are round and chunky, and leave a thick coating of trichomes on almost all areas of the plant.

variants.title: Pink Truffle
variants.body_html: Pink Truffle is an indica weed strain made from a genetic cross between Pink Kush and Truffle. This strain is a decadent treat, with a sweet and creamy flavor of vanilla cake and berries. Pink Truffle is 22% THC, making this strain an ideal choice for experienced cannabis consumers who are looking for a potent and delicious experience.

variants.title: Garlic Fumez
variants.body_html: Born from the elite breeding of Bloom Seed Co, Garlic Fumez is a powerhouse strain crossing GMO Rootbeer x Candy Fumez, delivering a bold, complex, and potent smoking experience. Expect a rich fusion of funky garlic, sweet root beer, and gassy candy notes, creating an unforgettable aroma that lingers on every exhale. Garlic Fumez—bold, flavorful, and built for those who appreciate the power of top-tier genetics.

variants.title: Pink Truffle
variants.body_html: Pink Truffle is an indica weed strain made from a genetic cross between Pink Kush and Truffle. This strain is a decadent treat, with a sweet and creamy flavor of vanilla cake and berries. Pink Truffle is 22% THC, making this strain an ideal choice for experienced cannabis consumers who are looking for a potent and delicious experience.

variants.title: Stargazer Haze
variants.body_html: Stargazer Haze is a potent sativa with THC ranging from 26% to 33%. Its buds are dense and frosted with trichomes, emitting a vibrant citrus and spice aroma with earthy undertones. Expect an uplifting and energizing experience, perfect for those seeking a bold and flavorful sativa.

variants.title: 420 King Size PR 25 x 0.7 g
variants.body_html: Sativa 420 King Size is a strain-specific, premium milled flower pre-roll pack. Grind features ever-changing Sativa-dominant strains for a consistently fresh experience. The flower is milled and rolled into light-weight paper cones complete with a paper filter.

variants.title: 420 King Size PR 25 x 0.7 g
variants.body_html: Indica 420 King Size is a strain-specific, premium milled flower. Grind features ever-changing Indica-dominant strains for a consistently fresh experience. The flower is milled and rolled into light-weight paper cones complete with a paper filter.

variants.title: Kush Mints PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Step into The Republic, where our ethos is grounded in crafting dank products for the people, with a focus on consistent quality at value. With a high potency guarantee and a diverse terpene profile, this bag of rotational indica-dominant flower promises to deliver full-bodied flavour with a bold and dank aroma that doesn't shy away from making a statement. Our flower is always hang-dried and slow-cured, reflecting our unwavering dedication to quality and consistency. Opt for The Republic Reserve 25 and join us in fostering a community where top-tier quality and value are always #ForThePeople.

variants.title: Cereal Milk Moon Dusted Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Blast off with Astrolab's Cereal Milk Moon Dusted Pre-rolls. This 5-pack of 0.5g pre-rolls is crafted for those who seek both potency and flavor, combining premium live rosin with a coating of kief for a cosmic smoking experience. The flavor profile is an out-of-this-world blend of creamy, vanilla, and sweet - think of the perfect bowl of cereal with a rich, dessert-like sweetness that lingers with each puff. It's a smooth, velvety smoke that feels as satisfying as a gravity-defying lift-off. With 40% THC, these pre-rolls pack a serious punch, delivering powerful effects that launch your experience into a new stratosphere. Perfect for connoisseurs who appreciate high-flying potency and premium quality, each pre-roll offers a next-level, space-worthy hit.

variants.title: The Republic Shatter
variants.body_html: The terpenes in this 8 Ball Kush are herbaceous with a spicy collection of garden aromas. 8 Ball Kush Shatter has notes of basil, oregano and rosemary arising from Caryophyllene. The terpene Humulene adds the warmth of coriander. Only fresh cannabis inputs are used with a proprietary blend of hydrocarbons, in all Shatterizer extraction processes. Specially sourced and selected from the finest growers across Canada, we look for flower with the right characteristics, from THC levels to terps and flavonoids.

variants.title: Sherbanger
variants.body_html: Sherbanger is a high-potency hybrid with THC levels ranging from 26% to 32%. This cross of Sherbert and Headbanger delivers dense, trichome-covered buds with a vibrant mix of green and purple hues. Its aroma is a bold fusion of sweet citrus, creamy sherbet, and pungent gas, creating a complex and flavorful profile. Expect a smooth yet potent experience that balances uplifting energy with deep relaxation.

variants.title: Jealousy x Apples & Bananas
variants.body_html: Jealousy x Apples & Bananas by Truro is a potent legacy Indica Dominant Hybrid. Jealousy is a 50/50 Hybrid strain produced by crossing Sherbert Bx1 with Gelato 41. Compound Genetics and Cookies collaborated to create Apples & Bananas: a combination of a Platinum Cookies and Granddaddy Purple Hybrid with a Blue Power male. They crossed the resulting Hybrid with Gelatti to create Apples & Bananas. Flavour profile is earthy and gassy with hints of spice. Jealousy x Apples & Bananas is proudly grown on the East Coast in Truro, Nova Scotia in our state-of-the-art small batch production facility, where each bud is carefully cultivated, hang-dried, hand-trimmed, slow-cured (21-28 days), and hand-packaged in 100% recyclable aluminium cans that are purged with liquid nitrogen to preserve the dried flower quality, moisture content, and terpene profile for the ultimate craft cannabis experience.

variants.title: Kush Breath
variants.brand: The Original Fraser Valley Weed Co.
tags: The Original Fraser Valley Weed Co.
variants.body_html: An ounce of Kush Breath. An indica-dominant cultivar with dank aromas of earth, herbs, and a hint of vanilla. Each ounce bag is filled with quality bud, greenhouse-grown in the Fraser Valley. Terpenes include caryophyllene, myrcene, and beta-pinene.

variants.title: VVS Glazed Diamonds and Sauce
variants.body_html: Kick that flavour in your ear with Endgame VVS Glazed Diamonds 1g. We packed each jar with flawless chunky diamonds that are dripping in a delicately balanced sweet, floral and tropical fruit flavoured terp sauce. This ones got more drip than a presidential bussdown.

variants.title: Iced Out Diamonds
variants.body_html: Flex on em with the new Endgame Iced Out Diamonds 1g. We packed each jar with breathtakingly beautiful, super potent THCA rocks that dance in the light like a flooded AP. Whether you drop them in a banger or ice out a joint, these diamonds will take you to the next level.

variants.title: Bane Chamber Sugar Wax
variants.body_html: With 75-85%+ THC , this smooth, terpene-rich concentrate brings a distinctive diesel aroma with hints of earthy citrus — like a deep breath through a finely tuned gas mask. Crafted for those who appreciate quality and potency, this sugar wax offers a rich, sticky texture and bold flavour.

variants.title: Galactic Glue
variants.body_html: Already high in THC, Galactic Glue benefits further from the entourage effect. With high b-myrcene, b-caryophyllene and pinene. This strain consistently delivers 3 - 4% terpenes. Galactic Glue gives chunky, resin covered buds, and a pungent earthy-sour aroma.

variants.title: Sour God
variants.body_html: Sour God is an internal cross from the people at Good Supply, who created this indica strain with an herbal, sour aroma reminiscent of Sour Kush. It's a well balanced India with a calming, long lasting experience.

variants.title: Hue Fusion Ash Pro Hybrid Ashtray
variants.body_html:
Say goodbye to basic ashtrays and level up your smoking setup with the HUE Fusion Ashtray Pro. This isn’t your average ashtray—it’s a multi-functional, high-tech tool built for bong enthusiasts who demand more. Crafted from durable silicone and sleek glass, it’s designed to handle everything from cleaning your bowl to storing your joints in style. The Fusion Ashtray Pro’s smart design includes a removable ash poker, magnetic closure, and stackable parts, making it as functional as it is cool. Whether you're just chilling or cleaning up between hits, this ashtray is ready for anything.

Key Features & Benefits
Dual Function: Ashtray & Debowler - Not just an ashtray—this piece doubles as a debowler, so you can clear clogs and remove ash from your bowl with ease.
Magnetic Poker Holder - Keep your ash poker in place with the custom magnet, and when you need it, it’s easy to remove for quick cleaning or use.
Removable Ash Poker - Clean and maintain your piece without hassle. The removable poker makes clearing out your bowl smooth and simple.
Heat-Resistant Silicone - Built to handle the heat, this ashtray features a heat-resistant silicone support, so you can use it even with a hot bowl.
Tight-Sealing Lid & Stackable Parts - The airtight lid keeps your stuff secure and fresh, while stackable parts make for easy storage and organization.
3 Joint Holders for Convenience - Keep your joints handy and organized with three built-in joint holders, perfect for keeping things tidy and ready to go.

The HUE Fusion Ashtray Pro isn’t just a place to dump ash—it’s a must-have tool for serious smokers. With its mix of style, functionality, and high-tech features, it’s designed to make your smoking experience more convenient, clean, and cool.
