variants.title: Queen Green PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Queen Green is a heavy-hitting herbal hybrid cross of Space Queen x Green Crack. Its fresh and earthy aroma profile delivers notes of herbs, dairy, and toasted peppercorns, complimented by a touch of citrus and pine, from dominant terpenes caryophyllene, limonene, linalool. Ready to burn in a pack of five.

variants.title: Black Sherb
variants.brand: The Original Fraser Valley Weed Co.
tags: The Original Fraser Valley Weed Co.
variants.body_html: A half ounce of Black Sherb. This indica-dominant cultivar is a descendant of Black Diamond and Sunset Sherbet. It’s a pungent one, with sweet, skunky, and sour citrus aromas and a hit of gassy diesel. The dried buds are fat and tight with dark colouration, dusted with generous crystal trichomes. Terpenes include caryophyllene, limonene, and linalool. Expertly grown in BC’s Fraser Valley.

variants.title: Strawberry Watermelon - CBG Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html:
With a refreshing splash of strawberry and watermelon flavour notes, feel the tide of

CBG wash over you as you sit on the shoreline in full relaxation mode. The Spinach®

Strawberry Watermelon OG CBG 1.2g vape gives you an immersive experience of

bliss, leaving you with a happy and relaxed high. Inspired by the Strawberry

Watermelon OG strain and a 1:10 CBG:THC ratio, enjoy the feeling of a cool breeze

on your face and the sweet taste of strawberry watermelon all day long.

variants.title: Zone Out
variants.body_html: Zone Out is indica dominant milled cannabis, crafted with high quality cannabis blends and packaged in a sealed pouch.

variants.title: Hue 3-Stage Grinder - Chrome
variants.body_html:
Elevate your grind game with the HUE Aluminum Grinder, built for smooth performance and precision. Whether you're a seasoned smoker or just getting started, this grinder's design combines form and function, ensuring your herb is shredded just the way you like it. Featuring bi-directional diamond teeth, centering wedges, and premium CNC machined components, the HUE Grinder delivers a flawless grind every time.
Key Features & Benefits:
Precision CNC Machined – For a flawless grind every time, crafted to last and deliver consistent results.
Bi-Directional Diamond Teeth – Sharp, durable, and designed to handle even the toughest herbs with ease.
Strong Neodymium Magnets – Keep everything secure, so you don’t have to worry about spills or losing any material.
Anodized Aluminum – Ultra-durable and resistant to wear, ensuring your grinder stands the test of time.
Smooth Nylon O-Rings – Enjoy effortless, precise rotation without any sticking or grinding issues.
Matching Radius Pollen Scraper – Comes with a scraper that fits perfectly for collecting your pollen with ease.
Available in 3 Colours – Choose from Champagne, Chrome, or Black to match your style. 
Whether you're into function, style, or both, the HUE Grinder has got you covered. Perfect for anyone who wants the best grind every time.

variants.title: Hue 3-Stufen Grinder - Champagner Gold
variants.body_html:
Erhöhen Sie Ihr Mahlspiel mit dem HUE Aluminium Grinder, der für eine reibungslose Leistung und Präzision entwickelt wurde. Egal, ob Sie ein erfahrener Raucher sind oder gerade erst anfangen, das Design dieses Grinders kombiniert Form und Funktion und sorgt dafür, dass Ihr Kraut genau so zerkleinert wird, wie Sie es mögen. Mit bi-direktionalen Diamantzähnen, Zentrierkeilen und hochwertigen CNC-bearbeiteten Komponenten liefert der HUE Grinder jedes Mal ein makelloses Mahl.
Wichtige Merkmale & Vorteile:
Präzise CNC-bearbeitet – Für ein makelloses Mahl jedes Mal, gefertigt, um langlebig zu sein und konsistente Ergebnisse zu liefern.
Bi-Direktionale Diamantzähne – Scharf, langlebig und dafür ausgelegt, selbst die härtesten Kräuter mühelos zu verarbeiten.
Starke Neodym-Magnete – Halten alles sicher, sodass Sie sich keine Sorgen über Verschüttungen oder den Verlust von Material machen müssen.
Anodisiertes Aluminium – Ultra-durable und verschleißfest, sorgt dafür, dass Ihr Grinder die Zeit überdauert.
Glatte Nylon-O-Ringe – Genießen Sie mühelose, präzise Drehungen ohne Kleben oder Mahlprobleme.
Passender Radius-Pollenkratzer – Wird mit einem Schaber geliefert, der perfekt passt, um Ihren Pollen mühelos zu sammeln.
Erhältlich in 3 Farben – Wählen Sie aus Champagner, Chrom oder Schwarz, um Ihren Stil zu ergänzen.
Egal, ob Sie Funktion, Stil oder beides mögen, der HUE Grinder hat alles, was Sie brauchen. Perfekt für jeden, der jedes Mal das beste Mahl möchte.

variants.title: Hue 3-Stage Grinder  - Black
variants.body_html:
Elevate your grind game with the HUE Aluminum Grinder, built for smooth performance and precision. Whether you're a seasoned smoker or just getting started, this grinder's design combines form and function, ensuring your herb is shredded just the way you like it. Featuring bi-directional diamond teeth, centering wedges, and premium CNC machined components, the HUE Grinder delivers a flawless grind every time.
Key Features & Benefits:
Precision CNC Machined – For a flawless grind every time, crafted to last and deliver consistent results.
Bi-Directional Diamond Teeth – Sharp, durable, and designed to handle even the toughest herbs with ease.
Strong Neodymium Magnets – Keep everything secure, so you don’t have to worry about spills or losing any material.
Anodized Aluminum – Ultra-durable and resistant to wear, ensuring your grinder stands the test of time.
Smooth Nylon O-Rings – Enjoy effortless, precise rotation without any sticking or grinding issues.
Matching Radius Pollen Scraper – Comes with a scraper that fits perfectly for collecting your pollen with ease.
Available in 3 Colours – Choose from Champagne, Chrome, or Black to match your style. 
Whether you're into function, style, or both, the HUE Grinder has got you covered. Perfect for anyone who wants the best grind every time.

variants.title: Gorilla Milk PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: A cross of the fan-favourite Gorilla Cookies x Cereal Milk, Gorilla Milk is a creamy cake-forward cultivar bringing sweet notes of sugary cereal milk and vanilla cookies, with a deep finish of red berries and spicy pepper from dominant terpenes caryophyllene, guaiol, and beta-pinene. Ready to burn.

variants.title: Atomic Marker
variants.body_html: Atomic Marker is a combination of Banana Cream Cake which is a mostly indica-dominant strain created by crossing Animal Cookies x Sunset Sherbet x Banana OG with Permanent Markers' lineage of Biscotti x Jealousy x Sherb Bx. Bringing flavours of sweet candy and creamy gas coming through this potent flavourful strain created by Seed Junky Genetics.

variants.title: Frozen Cola
variants.body_html: Frozen Cola has been making waves since its debut, quickly becoming popular for its striking appearance and bold profile. Combining legendary genetics, Pure Michigan x Oreoz, with an unmistakable gassy aroma accented by floral undertones and a subtle hint of cola. Iced out with a dense blanket of shimmering trichomes, this strain is as potent as it is beautiful, boasting high THC levels. Frozen Cola is bred by the legendary 3rd Coast Genetics.

variants.title: Miracle Mints
variants.body_html: Grown in Ontario, Miracle Mints, aka Cap Junky, is an indica-leaning hybrid bred from Seed Junky’s Kush Mints #11 and Capulator’s Alien Cookies #7. This exclusive breeder cut has brought us international recognition for its frosty buds, potent effects, and complex terpene profile. Featuring creamy, minty, and earthy flavours, Miracle Mints offers a truly premium experience. Every flower is hang-dried, hand-trimmed, slow cold-cured, and packaged fresh by hand with a humidity pack. Non-irradiated, always.

variants.title: Strawberry Pink AIO Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Our all-in-one vape is designed to put the Back Forty in the palm of your hand. With a compact design and rechargeable battery, it balances function and format. Strawberry Pink is a sweet swirl of strawberry.

variants.title: Blue Raspberry Ice AIO Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Our all-in-one vape is designed to put the Back Forty in the palm of your hand. With a compact design and rechargeable battery, it balances function and format. Blue Raspberry Ice balances sweet blue raspberry with an icy cool finish.

variants.title: Mixer Pack Diamond Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html:
Ultra-Infused Mixer Pack is dropping BOLD flavour like it’s the final act. With three diamond-infused pre-rolls, smooth pulls, and electric hits – the mic drop is here. You read that right. DIAMONDS. G.A. Ultra-Infused Pre-Rolls are made using milled whole flower, dusted in premium kief, boosted with botanical terpenes, and infused with diamonds to deliver their most potent pre-roll yet.

Flavours are always on rotation – Check out the latest roster at generaladmission.ca

variants.title: Sherbo x Animal Style Live Rosin Infused PR 3 x 0.7 g
variants.body_html: Available for limited time. Crafted with Sherb-O flower by Royal Harvest and infused with live rosin from Brindle Farms, these pre-rolls offer a rich, earthy, gassy flavour. The Animal Style cultivar is bred by Swampboys Seeds. Packaged as three 0.7g joints, this product offers a smooth, potent smoke.

variants.title: Gelato #33 Diamonds & Terp Sauce
variants.body_html: Gelato #33 is a rare hybrid cultivar made by crossing Ice Cream Cake x Gelato. It packs a sweet, creamy note with the fruity, smooth undertones of Gelato, creating a truly luxurious taste that is lightly pungent when released. Using only BC whole-bud and a proprietary hydrocarbon extraction process, this diamonds and terpene sauce features beautifully faceted stones loaded with a terp sauce bringing out the high-terpene, full-spectrum, golden, sappy rich, aromatic profile.

variants.title: Grape Animal Shatter 2.0
variants.body_html: Dab Bods Grape Animal Shatter 2.0 delivers a smooth, satisfying experience. This malleable shatter has been expertly crafted and enhanced with botanical terpenes, boosting its flavour profile with vibrant notes of grape and sweetness. Whether you’re a seasoned dabber or a newcomer, the easy-to-handle consistency and intense flavour will leave your taste buds craving more. Ideal for those seeking a flavourful, potent concentrate, Dab Bods Grape Animal Shatter 2.0 offers a perfect balance of smooth texture and bold, fruity flavour.

variants.title: Hendrix Haze Live Resin Liquid Diamond AIO Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: A sativa-dominant cultivar (60% sativa/40% indica) created through crossing the classic Blue Dream x Purple Punch. A mouthwatering taste of sweet, tropical fruits accented by sugary blueberries, zesty pineapples, and a punch of bright citrus. The vapes are manufactured in-house using BC whole flower through their proprietary hydrocarbon extraction process. This state-of-the-art, all-in-one vape, features live resin and liquid diamonds ‘derived from live resin’ and is true to strain. It is discreet, pocket-sized, and features a wide mouth opening for optimal airflow along with being USB-C rechargeable (good until the last drop).

variants.title: Kool Cherry-Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Try the refreshing sweet cherry taste of Kool Cherry, infused with high-potency THC distillate, blended with liquid diamonds, and flavoured with amazing botanical terpenes.

variants.title: Caribbean Crush-Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Enjoy a refreshing tropical blend of mango and pineapple flavours infused with high-potency THC distillate, blended with liquid diamonds, and flavoured with amazing botanical terpenes.

variants.title: Joyride PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Happy & Stoned Pre-rolls feature whole, sativa-dominant flowers, carefully packed for a smooth, enjoyable experience. These pre-rolls exude a sweet pine aroma, complemented by the terpenes pinene, myrcene, and limonene. The buds are hand-selected for their potency, ranging from 26-32% THC, and are crafted with an unbleached rolling paper to ensure a clean burn. Each pre-roll is packed in a protective tube, preserving its freshness and quality.

variants.title: Master Kush Ultra
variants.body_html: MKU is an indica-dominant cultivar that is renowned in the cannabis community. It has garnered accolades, clinching multiple victories at the prestigious High Times Cannabis Cup. Bred by the esteemed T.H. Seeds, this fan favourite pays homage to the clandestine CIA project MKUltra, reflecting its enigmatic origins and potency. Its terpene profiles includes limonene, beta-caryophyllene, and beta-myrcene. Pistol and Paris flowers are true craft, always produced with love and care, employing methods such as whole-plant hang-dry, cold-cure, and hand-trim. Every step is done by hand to ensure the delivery of a premium experience.

variants.title: Royal Sherb
variants.body_html: Royal Sherb from the Jolly boys is an indica-dominant cross between Wedding Cake Bx1 and King Sherb V4, a dessert lover's dream. Its flavour profile is rich with notes of buttery cake batter and dough, perfectly complemented by sweet cake and sherbet-like aromas that fill the air with decadence. The dense, frosty nugs are adorned with hues of deep green and lavender, intertwined with bright orange pistils and a shimmering layer of trichomes that glisten like frost in the morning light. True to the Jolly Boys’ commitment to quality and craftsmanship, each bud is carefully hand-trimmed and hang-dried, then given a patient three-week cure to enhance its signature characteristics.

variants.title: Lychee Peachy Ice Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: TASTY’S Lychee Peachy Ice delivers a fruity and frosty combination. Each puff has sweet, luscious lychee and peach flavours ending in an icy kick. Lychee Peachy Ice is infused with botanical terpenes. TASTY’S vapes use specialized active vape hardware with super-wide 2 mm apertures for large draws, clouds and bold flavour.

variants.title: Pink Sunset Pure Live Resin Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Made from live resin, Greybeard’s Pink Sunset has a layered profile of gas, rubber and lemon. Crafted from a blend of Pink Diesel, Stonefruit Sunset and True Sour, Pink Sunset is the proud result of industry-leading hydrocarbon extraction using fresh frozen whole cannabis at their peak of harvest for a true spectrum expression of the plant. Pink Sunset uses a proprietary active 510-thread cartridge with a 1.5 mm aperture for bigger clouds and better airflow while maximizing flavour. Our newly designed 510 cartridge is recyclable with the mouthpiece made from biodegradable hempzyme for eco-friendly consumers.

variants.title: Animal Rntz Redees PR 10 x 0.4 g
variants.body_html: Animal Rntz, the potent indica, is ready to be unleashed in Redees Classic. Grab a pack of Animal Rntz Redees and experience the fast and smooth burning straight cut pre-rolls with classic paper. This Animal Mints x Rntz cross is high in THC with sweet diesel and funky flavours. Redees are always made with hang dried whole flower, no shake or trim, milled to perfection and the patented filter tip provides consistent airflow and a clean smoking experience.

variants.title: Deep Value PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Introducing Deep Value pre-rolls, a quality and affordable product.The pre-rolls are crafted from a single strain of our exotic, small batch genetics. These pre-rolls are consistent, leveraging our expertise in selecting and rolling some of the best strains available. Our small batch flower undergoes a meticulous process, including hang drying, precision hand trimming, slow cold curing and hand packaging. We take these whole flowers, mill them in-house then fill the pre-rolls by hand.

variants.title: Strawberry Kiwi CBG
variants.body_html: Keef Life H2O is a lightly flavoured cannabis water designed for those who enjoy the quality of Keef Classics but prefer less sugar. This Strawberry Kiwi flavour is complete with 10mg THC and 5mg CBG. Experience the popular craft of Keef beverages in this non-carbonated option with added cannabinoids for a more diverse offering.

variants.title: Anti Gravity PR 1 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Introducing Anti Gravity (Grandpas Breath x OG Kush Breath), our newest strain! 1 x 0.5g Preroll. A potent Indica, it's a cross of Grandpa's Breath and OG Kush Breath. With an intense aroma of rotting skunk and spicy diesel, this strain is not for the faint of heart. Each batch is milled for top-quality prerolls, 100% hand-trimmed and hand-rolled, and packaged in fully recyclable materials.

variants.title: Cosmic Lemonade
variants.body_html: Color's Cosmic Lemonade is a sativa dominant cross of Jean Guy and Alien Dog. Cosmic Lemonade's dense, round dark green buds with dark orange stigmas produce a pungent but sweet citrus aroma with notes of earth and gas. Our elevated growing practices, including full temperature and humidity control and hang drying, offer a consistent smoking experience. Cultivated with care and nitrogen packaged for freshness.

variants.title: Diablo
variants.body_html: Diablo, a cross of MKU and Bubba Kush, boasts pungent peppery diesel aromas and spicy, gassy flavours with sticky and dense green buds.

variants.title: Quickies Sour Sucker Mints PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Tweed Sour Sucker Mints is your one way ticket to an aromatic escape. Imagine a burst of sour candy, met with a fresh minty finish. It’s a sour bouquet for your senses.

variants.title: Drippyz Multipack  Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: The Drippyz infused pre-roll multipack features a variety of five bold flavours: Razz Fire, Purple Pom-G, Island Breeze, Cocolicious and Tropicanna CKS. Each pre-roll is packed with liquid diamond infused flower and dusted with a kief outer coating that intensifies both flavour and potency.

variants.title: Caramel Chocolate Live Rosin Waffle Cones
variants.body_html: Caramel & milk chocolate wrapped in a waffle cone delicately infused with single-strain live rosin. 2 bite-sized cones packed with 5mg of THC each!

variants.title: Blueberry Lemon CBN
variants.body_html: Keef Life H2O is lightly flavoured cannabis water designed for those who enjoy the quality of Keef Classics but prefer less sugar. This Blueberry Lemon flavour is complete with 7.5mg THC and 2.5mg CBN. Experience the popular craft of Keef beverages in this non-carbonated option with added cannabinoids for a more diverse offering.

variants.title: Cool Aid Kush
variants.body_html: Cool Aid Kush is a heavy-hitting indica dominant strain that brings together the classic kush character of OG Kush and a citrus twist from Rainbow Zkittlez. Expect earth and diesel-forward aromas balanced by subtle notes of lemon, for a blissful experience. The buds are large and frosty, showcasing dark green hues and deep orange pistils. BOLD Craft Cannabis is indoor grown, small batch, hang dried, slow cured and hand trimmed.

variants.title: Cherry Crush Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html:
Crush that sweet craving with fresh cherry flavour notes bursting from our Spinach Cherry Crush 1g vape!

With inspiration from the Cherry Crush strain, we've stepped up the delicious fruity tastes to make each puff like the cherry on top of any sesh. At 94.4% THC, you're in for one sweet, tantalizing vape experience. '

variants.title: Anti Gravity PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Introducing Anti Gravity (Grandpas Breath x OG Kush Breath) our newest strain! 3 x 0.5g preroll. A potent Indica, it's a cross of Grandpa's Breath and OG Kush Breath. With an intense aroma of rotting skunk and spicy diesel, this strain is not for the faint of heart. Each batch is milled for top-quality prerolls, 100% hand-trimmed and hand-rolled, and packaged in fully recyclable materials.

variants.title: 95+ Strawberry Stampede Liquid Diamonds Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Tailored for life in Canada's Wild West with real value and quality cannabis ingredients. Strawberry Stampede is a custom blend of liquid diamonds with a splash of strawberry botanicals, featuring a custom 510-thread vape cart with a signature cowboy cartridge dust cap.

variants.title: Pineapple Coco Kush Liquid Diamond Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Papa's Pineapple Coco Kush Liquid Diamond Disposable - An iconic classic giving you a fruity and tropical twist. With coconut and pineapple flavours, this disposable is an essential! Come to Papa!

variants.title: Hi-Fi Lime Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html:
High-definition flavour coming at you. This sweet and sour jam hits all the best citrus notes. Hi-Fi Lime cranks the THC up to 1000mg!

VoxPuffz 1.2g 510 Carts are here to turn things up. Triple distilled disty is boosted with botanical terpenes for the purest, smoothest, most flavourful experience possible. This show-worthy cart features a huge 1.2g tank and a comfortable ceramic mouthtip. With 1000mg of THC these vapes don't take low for an answer. Lifting you up while raising the bar - Live Vivid with VoxPuffz.

variants.title: Hybrid Bubba Gmm - Liquid Diamonds Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Papa's Liquid Diamond Disposable is now available in Bubba Gmm! Papa's Liquid Diamond disposable products are made from melted THCA diamonds to provide our customers with a high potency, high quality experience! We brought our innovative Liquid Diamond's and infused it with our custom Bubba Gmm strain profile that we carefully crafted with the best growers in California. All of this is available in an elegant and convenient 1 gram, refillable and disposable format, to the delight of our customers!

variants.title: Mandarin Cookies
variants.body_html: Life's a little sweeter in the back forty and you won't want to wait for dessert to give our Mandarin Cookies a try! This sativa-dominant strain pulls a tangy citrus flavour with a hint of sweet nuttiness on the exhale. A cross of the classic Cookies strain and Mandarin Sunset, with some major limonene.

variants.title: Wes' Coast Kush
variants.body_html: MTL’s Wes' Coast Kush is an indica-dominant strain. The flower is a hazy light green colour with purple undertones and is covered in white crystal trichomes. The smoke is packed with a sweet, earthy and spice like taste that finally culminates in a diesel after taste.

variants.title: Sour Chem
variants.body_html: It’s dank, it’s pungent, it’s straight up in your face gas. Spinach® Sour Chem is our ode to what all our buds know and love, a sativa strain that hits on classic flavours and aromas such as diesel, chemical and zesty citrus. With terpenes such as farnesene, caryophyllene and limonene, flavours will linger on the tip of your tongue. With a lineage that traces back to Chemdawg and Sour Diesel, it’s no surprise that this strain has high THC potency.

variants.title: Cherry D Live Rosin Cola
variants.body_html: Cherry D Live Rosin takes this cherry cola to the next level. We’ve paired a peppery & tart strain perfectly with real cherry juice and the result is the most delicious and potent cola going!

variants.title: Blue Sourberry
variants.body_html: Deep Space Propulsion Blue Sourberry. A blue raspberry that is puckeringly sour and sweet, creating an experience that tantalizes the senses. Fuelled by 10mg THC, 10mg CBG & <30mg naturally occurring caffeine. Made without sugar, this new option to our popular propulsion line will keep you coming back for more.

variants.title: Double Stuffed Variety Pack
variants.body_html: Double your enjoyment with a rotating selection of two unique cultivars from the legendary Cookies catalog, cultivated by our craft partners in BC.

variants.title: Baby Jeeter Blue Dream Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Blue Dream is a sativa dominant hybrid with complex blueberry flavours heightened by the infusion of liquid diamond enhanced distillate and a kief coating. Each puff unveils a smooth, berry-forward profile complemented by hints of fresh earth and a refined herbal finish.

variants.title: Frosted Flyers Watermelon Z Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Watermelon Z is a mouthwatering indica that will have you asking for more. THCa diamond frosted, terpene enhanced, and made from premium indoor, full bud flower infused with liquid diamonds. Each Frosted Flyer is highly potent and packed with nonstop flavour all the way down to the crutch. Don’t be afraid to suck down this bad boy as it’s more sweet than it is citrus with a earthy notes to profile.

variants.title: Orange Velvet Live Resin Caviar
variants.body_html: Go above and beyond all expectations with Lord Jones® Orange Velvet Live Resin Caviar. This no-compromise live resin is curated from the finest strain that packs potency while delivering the boldest and deepest flavours for an experience like no other. Orange Velvet is a lemony strain with pine flavour notes. Each dab of this pure live resin delivers delicious citrusy, complex flavours with subtle savoury notes at the finish.

variants.title: THC Dissolving Drops
variants.body_html: MediPharm Labs THC Dissolving Drops offer a flexible way to personalize your cannabis experience, with 1.5mg of THC per drop and 450+ drops per portable squeeze bottle - no syringe needed. Designed for convenience and easy control over your dose, with a neutral flavour and minimal cannabis taste. Wait to feel the effects, track what works best for you, and adjust your dose drop by drop. This custom formulation uses water soluble, nano-emulsification, which breaks the THC into microscopic droplets for improved absorption in your system.

variants.title: Shake & Puff Rapid THC Inhaler
variants.body_html: Experience a new level of discrete with this stealth inhaler. New MediPharm metered dose Shake & Puff THC Inhalers, are fast acting without any smoke or vapour. Enjoy a perfectly metered puff every time with 5 mg of highly purified THC per puff and 100 puffs per inhaler. The MediPharm Shake & Puff THC inhaler is designed to deliver the product to your lungs for increased bio-availability and a faster onset than ingested oil. Consume with next level convenience, stealth, and discretion. To ensure accurate delivery of the product to the lungs, shake 3-5 seconds prior to each puff. Immediately after shaking, exhale and place lips around the mouthpiece. Begin inhaling first, then press down on the cannister to release product while continuing to inhale. MediPharm Labs is committed to developing premium quality products, with standards that go above and beyond.

variants.title: Grand Daddy Purps
variants.body_html: With grape power comes grape responsibility. Daddy Purps, a powerhouse indica-dominant with over 20% THC. Its boasting grape and berry aromas, thanks to the dominant Caryophyllene, Pinene, and Humulene terps. These compact buds are a sweet, frosty purple colour and dappled in orange hairs.

variants.title: Double RNTZ
variants.body_html: A cross between Detroit Runtz x Forbidden Runtz this flavour packed Indica tastes of gas and fruit with hints of grape and candy. The 2020 Leafly Strain of the year has given so many amazing Gelato & Skittlez crosses, this was our favourite backcross. Try Double Runtz today, your taste buds will thank you.

variants.title: Cryptic Chronic
variants.body_html: Cryptic Chronic is for all our fellow cannabis enthusiasts who love the west coast Cali vibes. The buds are thick and coated with trichomes, looking like they're covered in fairy dust. The bag appeal is like nothing else – gassy, pungent, and earthy with a hint of sweetness. The buds are sticky icky with a dark purple colour and orange hairs. When you blaze it up, you’ll taste a smooth, sweet, and dank taste. This indica hybrid is the perfect choice for those looking for some classic west coast kush. Stay lifted, y’all.

variants.title: Select Pheno #7
variants.body_html: Craft designated and packaged in 100 percent home compostable packaging. The terpene profile offers a rich, musky aroma with notes of black pepper and a floral fresh finish. Consumers can expect a relaxing and euphoric experience.

variants.title: Animal Rntz
variants.body_html: Animal Runtz is an indica-dominant strain that is the result of crossing Animal Cookies x Runtz. True to its lineage, Animal Runtz has a fruity tartness along with a sweet and sour aroma informed by high levels of caryophyllene, limonene, trans-ocimene and alpha-bisabolol. Sporting dense tight buds, this potent strain achieves remarkable THC levels. Animal Runtz by Redecan is improved through conscientious care and attention given to each plant through every stage of growth and harvested at its peak, expertly cured and hand trimmed to ensure the highest level of quality.

variants.title: Slurty3 Pure Live Resin Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Our Slurty3 pure live resin vape cartridge is crafted from fresh frozen flower. We never add additives, thinning agents or botanical terpenes because doing it right matters. This cartridge delivers the flavour profile of gas, cake and fruit that made us fall in love with Slurty3. Calibrated for smooth and consistent flavour with every pull, we recommend pairing it with a quality battery featuring variable temperature settings. Start at 2V and gradually adjust.

variants.title: 8 Ball Kush Shatter
variants.body_html: Our 8 Ball Kush is a solid shatter that looks good from all angles and has very strong THC potency. Originating from King Kush and the Bubba Kush strains, 8 Ball Kush has a high density of trichome that you can bank on. The terpenes in this 8 Ball Kush call the shots and will sink into your mouth. Herbaceous, with a spicy collection of garden aromas, our 8 Ball Kush Shatter has notes of basil, oregano and rosemary arising from caryophyllene. The terpene humulene adds the warmth of coriander! Only fresh cannabis inputs are used with a proprietary blend of hydrocarbons, in all Shatterizer extraction processes. Specially sourced and selected from the finest growers across Canada, we look for flower with the right characteristics, from THC levels to terps and flavonoids.

variants.title: Pink Kush
variants.body_html: Pure Sunfarms' cut of Pink Kush from BC's Vancouver Island is a coastal relative of the legendary OG Kush. This special strain is beloved across Canada for its strong aromas, colourful flowers and high THC potential. Beneath a thick coating of trichomes, the dense and round buds feature forest green leaves, often with a purple hue, mixed with dark amber pistils. Grown in a high-tech greenhouse in the Fraser Valley, each bud is carefully trimmed and hand-groomed, dried and cured to precise standards. Pink Kush showcases gassy aromas of white pepper, orange, butterscotch, coffee, earth and grapefruit, the result of a rich combination of terpenes that includes caryophyllene, myrcene, humulene, bisabolol, and limonene.

variants.title: Ghost OG
variants.body_html: Introducing Ghost OG, a timeless classic renowned by those who enjoy a proper smoke. Crafted with care, this strain tantalizes the taste buds with a delightful blend of candy gas and subtle floral undertones. While its origins may remain a mystery, one thing's for sure: Ghost OG delivers an unforgettable flavour experience that packs potency.

variants.title: Kush God
variants.body_html: Kush God is a BC-grown cultivar from the Pure Sunfarms greenhouse. This powerful indica is an iconic cross of Pink Kush x Pineapple God, featuring notes of tropical fruit, grape and dairy from dominant terpenes myrcene, limonene and humulene. The buds feature bright greens with splashes of purple and amber hairs, coated in creamy trichomes. BC bud, hand harvested, hang dried and hand finished.

variants.title: Hawaiian Juice Box Infused PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Hawaiian Juice Box is a sativa strain noted for its sweet, fruity and topical flavours, infused into a pre-roll.

variants.title: Trop Cherry Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: These tasty jams are made from hand-selected strains notable for their exceptional flavours. These packs are filled with Trop Cherry giving you a unique cross featuring Tropicanna CKS x Cherry CKS f3, producing a beautiful cherry/fruit aroma and a potent sativa-dominant flower.

variants.title: Watermelon Gushers PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Watermelon Gushers is a vibrant plant that grows extremely purple and has a powerful sweet gassy nose. These beautiful buds are round and dense with a strong sweet vanilla nose. This cultivar is small batch grown and the dominant terpenes are caryophyllene, limonene, and myrcene. This plant grows extremely colourful dense buds with exotic purple hints all over covered in a thick layer of trichomes.

variants.title: Orange Crush 44's Infused PR 4 x 0.4 g
variants.body_html: Introducing Orange Crush, a pack of infused cannabis pre-rolls. This blend combines a sativa dominant strain with an orange flavour. Each pack contains four expertly rolled pre-rolls, infused with high quality cannabis oil. The orange hued buds are meticulously grown and cured to perfection, ensuring a consistent smoke every time.

variants.title: The Perfect Threesome PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: The Signature Sampler from Supernova Farms is designed for those seeking a premium cannabis experience in a convenient, portable format. Ideal for both seasoned enthusiasts and newcomers, this sampler includes a carefully curated selection of Indica and Sativa signature strains, each representing the quality Supernova Farms is known for. Each strain undergoes a meticulous process, starting with a two-week flush before harvesting for a smoother, cleaner smoke. After harvest, the buds are hang-dried to preserve their flavor and potency. Hand-rolled with Dutch Crown finishing, the joints provide a smooth burn. The cannabis is then cured for at least 30 days to develop rich flavors and ensure the highest quality. Finally, the strains are freshly packaged to guarantee maximum freshness. This sampler offers the perfect introduction to our finest offerings.

variants.title: Hi-Fi Lime Disposable Vape
variants.body_html:

variants.body_html: Jelly Beanz Pre-rolls, bred by Underworld Genetix and grown in organic living soil by Living Cannabis, offer a premium cannabis experience with the exceptional genetics of Jealousy and Zkittles. The aroma is a tantalizing blend of fruity sweetness and dank fuel notes, while the flavour profile delivers a burst of tropical fruit with hints of gas. Dominant terpenes include Terpinolene, Pinene, and Myrcene.

variants.title: Junior J PR 1 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Versus Junior J is a 1 x 0.35g pre-roll. Expertly grown, milled, and rolled, this joint is your perfect accompaniment for a stroll around the block with your favourite four-legged friend. Packaged in a compact, recyclable tube to take with you wherever you go.

variants.title: Cracker Sammies - Cheddar Flavour
variants.body_html: Do you know what the world needs more of? Cheese and cracker sandwiches with THC in them. We felt really strongly about that, so we made these. There are 2 sammies per pack, with 5mg THC each, so you can share... or not.

variants.title: Wappa Redees Hemp'd PR 10 x 0.4 g
variants.body_html: Experience the celebrated indica icon Wappa in a whole new way with Redees Hemp’d. This legendary Sensi Star x Delahaze cross is taken to new heights thanks to smooth burning, ultra thin hemp paper that lets the earthy, musky and dank diesel flavours shine. Wappa’s buds are wildly colourful, with abundant green and yellow hues, flecked with vibrant purple, awash in rich orange pistils and shimmering with endless trichome heads. It smokes superbly with layered flavours and is especially resinous, so expect dapples of oil on the hemp paper, offering a fragrant and rich smoke that coats the palate. The dominant terpenes include myrcene, caryophyllene and limonene. Wappa is always meticulously grown with painstaking attention to detail, hang dried, milled and then perfectly rolled.

variants.title: Blueberry Dream
variants.body_html: Big Bag o' Buds brings you Blueberry Dream, a sativa strain with high THC that’s as bold as it is smooth. A cross of Blueberry Kush x Blue Dream, this strain delivers sweet, floral and berry aromas.

variants.title: Super Strawberry Watermelon Disty+Diamond Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Try the tasty flavours of the Super Strawberry Watermelon Disty + Diamond Infused pre-rolls. A sweet strawberry watermelon aroma combined with high quality distillate and diamonds.

variants.title: Garlic Truffle
variants.body_html: Bringing OG back — crank up the garlic funk and ride the zesty skunk with this throwback classic Garlic Truffle, an indica-dominant that combines the legendary Platinum OG x GMO strains. Garlic Truffle delights the senses with a robust flavour profile featuring bold notes of garlic, skunk, and pine.

variants.title: Pineapple Drift Rechargeable AIO Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Pineapple Drift is a riptide of bold pineapple – get drenched in tropical flavour that hits as hard as a tidal wave. Made with their signature triple-distilled distillate and boosted with botanical terpenes – this 1g USB-C rechargeable, all-in-one vape delivers smooth hits, high-THC potency, and the BIG, BOLD flavour you expect from G.A.!

variants.title: Gastro Pop PR 1 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Available for a limited time only. A fruit-fueled hit grown true in living soil, Gastro Pop blends juicy apple, ripe banana, and grape candy with a gassy backbone. This cut runs dense and loud, stacking early and finishing with deep purple hues and a sticky, resin-rich coat. Terpenes include beta-myrcene, ocimene, and alpha-pinene.

variants.title: Iced Zuchi PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: From the DEALR lineup comes Iced Zuchi, an indica-dominant powerhouse bred from the elite genetics of Iced Out and Zuchi. The buds used for these pre-rolls showcase vibrant lime-green hues, dark green undertones, and striking amber pistils, all blanketed in a heavy coat of trichomes. Its aroma bursts with sweet citrus, creamy gas, and a touch of earthy dankness that draws you in. On the exhale, enjoy smooth, zesty citrus and sweet cream flavours, perfectly balanced with a gassy finish that hits every time. Terpenes include limonene, myrcene, and pinene.

variants.title: Sour Pomegranate 10 mg THC Gummies
variants.body_html:
Emprise's Rapid Onset Sour Pomegranate Sativa Gummies is a THC-dominant formulation that is active in 8-12 minutes using Emprise's Advanced Nano THC Technology. Each Gummy delivers potent 5 mg THC. The product is formulated with Full Spectrum THC Cannabis Extract, Delicious Sour Pomegranate flavour with a Sativa terpene profile. Vegan, Natural, Rapid Onset.
Each Package contains 2 x 5mg THC Gummies. Terpenes: d-limonene, beta-caryophyllene, Myrcene.

variants.title: Cherry 10 THC Instant Drink
variants.body_html: Emprise Rapid THirstC Cherry 10mg THC Instant Drink is ready when you are, add to 250ml of water and consume. Each sachet contains 10mg of Advanced Nano THC Emulsion that has a rapid onset in as little as 10-15 minutes.

variants.title: Sour Strawberry Kiwi CBN + THC Gummies
variants.body_html: Emprise’s Sour Strawberry Kiwi soft chews contain 5 mg of CBN and 5 mg of THC using Emprise's advanced nano THC technology. The product is formulated with full spectrum THC:CBN cannabis extracts, sour strawberry kiwi flavour with an indica terpene profile. Made without animal products. Terpenes: myrcene, beta-caryophyllene and linalool.

variants.title: Bent Neck Dab Rig Recycler-Blue-6in
variants.body_html: If you’re after smooth, flavour-packed dabs without the splashback, this 6-inch Bent Neck Dab Rig Recycler is about to be your new go-to. Compact enough to take anywhere but powerful enough to deliver clean, cool hits every time, it’s perfect for daily sessions or sharing with friends. The recycler design keeps your water moving, filtering and cooling the vapor like a pro. Translation? Less drag, smoother inhales, and way less coughing. Plus, the bent neck isn’t just for looks (though it does look slick)—it helps keep water where it belongs and out of your mouth. Key Features & Benefits 6 Inches of Pure Power - Compact size that’s easy to handle, stash, and travel with—but still delivers big-time performance. Bent Neck Design - Comfortable to use and helps prevent splashback, so you’re only inhaling what you want to. Recycler Function - Continuous water movement filters and cools your hits for smoother, tastier dabs with less harshness. Smooth, Flavourful Hits - Maximize flavour and minimise drag. This rig makes each dab clean, cool, and seriously enjoyable. Durable Glass Build - Thick, high-quality glass means it’s sturdy enough to handle your sesh (and your clumsy moments). Available in 4 Colourways - Choose from milky blue, milky green, milky pink, or classic blue to match your setup. This Bent Neck Dab Rig Recycler proves good things come in small, super-smooth packages. Grab it, dab it, and taste the difference!

variants.title: Caps Junky PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Caps Junky Pre-Rolls are produced from the premium craft whole flower of the potent Hybrid legacy cultivar of Kush Mints 11 (Bubba Kush x Animal Mints) x Alien Cookies (Alien OG x Cripple Cake Cookies). Flavour profile is sweet, fruity and minty. Caps Junky Pre-Rolls are produced from the whole flower of our best-in-class batches, and we have refined our mixing and milling processes to mirror the quality and THC levels of our whole flower products. Caps Junky Pre-Rolls are hand-weighed and hand-packaged in 100% recyclable tubes for a best-in-class craft pre-roll experience. Caps Junky is proudly grown on the East Coast in Truro, Nova Scotia in our state-of-the-art small batch production facility, where each bud is carefully cultivated, hang-dried, hand-trimmed, slow-cured (21-28 days), and hand-packaged in 100% recyclable tubes for a true craft cannabis experience.

variants.title: Cocoa Mintz Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: With a velvety smooth and totally minty fresh flavour combination, the Spinach Cocoa Mintz 1g is inspired by the CHCLT Mint OG cultivar and sitting at 94%+ THC. This vape has been formulated with distillate and all natural botanical terpenes.

variants.title: LA Kush Cake
variants.body_html: LA Kush Cake is an indica dominant hybrid bred by crossing Wedding Cake and Kush Mints. This strain offers a skunky and vanilla aroma and has an earthy peppermint taste.

variants.title: Flower Power
variants.body_html: A combination of strains with sweet & floral aromas. Let your guard down and you might end up in a Floral Suplex!

variants.title: Maze-X Hand Pipe - Purple
variants.body_html:
Smooth Hits. Clean Design. Ultimate Control.
Say goodbye to harsh, hot hits and hello to the Maze-X Hand Pipe—designed for a smoother, cooler, and cleaner smoking experience. Engineered with precision, this innovative pipe reduces smoke temperature and filters out resin and tar for incredibly smooth draws with less coughing. Whether you're at home or on the go, the Maze-X delivers clean puffs every time.
Crafted from high-quality, durable materials like aircraft-grade anodized aluminum, medical-grade silicone, and a removable borosilicate glass bowl, this pipe is built to last. Its modular design makes cleaning quick and easy—simply take it apart, rinse, and reassemble. With thoughtful features like a bowl cap for extinguishing on the fly and optional compatibility with charcoal filters, the Maze-X Pipe takes hand pipes to a whole new level.
Key Features & Benefits

Cough-Reducing, Smoother Hits - Patented smoke path design cools and filters each draw, helping reduce harshness and delivering a smoother, more enjoyable experience.

Premium Build Materials - Aircraft-grade anodized aluminum body, medical-grade silicone cooling chamber, and a removable borosilicate glass bowl that can handle high heat without cracking.

Removable Borosilicate Glass Bowl - Holds up to 0.5 grams of dry herb. Easy to remove, clean, and reload. Extra bowls and travel cases are available (sold separately).

Cap for Quick Bowl Closure - Snuff out your bowl easily and preserve what’s left for later.

Keeps everything neat and controlled. 

Optional Activated Charcoal Filter Compatibility - Customize your filtration experience with the option to add charcoal filters (sold separately).

Easy to Clean Design - Pull apart the components, soak in isopropyl alcohol (no salt needed), rinse with dish soap, and reassemble—cleaning has never been this simple.

Why Choose the Maze-X?
The Maze-X Hand Pipe combines smart design with rugged durability for a consistently smooth, cooler smoke. Perfect for daily use or adventure-ready portability, it's an excellent choice for anyone who wants a hassle-free smoking experience with less coughing and more control.

variants.title: Nitro + Daytona Peach Infused PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html:
Hightail it on outta there with these tasty tropic half-grammers. Combining the electric watermelon and tangy berry Nitro jolt with the tuned-up peachy pit boss from Daytona Peach, these potent pre-rolls are locked and loaded in one kickass variety 10-pack.

Brimming with bangin' flavours from botanical terp blends, top-shelf distillate, and a dialled 2:1 ratio, Cruise Control THC:CBG infused pre-rolls are ready to roll wherever the tides take you.

variants.title: Sour Apple Diamond Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: This Sour Apple infusion packs a pucker punch of sweet and sour apple into our fresh whole flower. Electrified with a crisp spark of THCa diamonds and hand crafted with a fresh golden coat of kief. By upping the voltage with diamonds, spark a smooth crisp smoke sesh without soggy papers and harsh oils. Granny Smith ain't got nothin on these apples!

variants.title: Blue Pave PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Pave refers to jewlery so iced out you can't see the metal setting; there is a reason these buds are named after this sought after jewlery. Covered in trichomes, Blue Pave is a special Indica dominant strain from Compund Genetics' Pave collection, crossing their famous Pave strain with Azul Runtz. The deep blueberry-colored leaves are a hint to its prominent Blueberry Muffin flavor with a hint of menthol, flowing into a kushy finish.

variants.title: Naked Solventless NSFW Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Introducing Naked Solventless NSFW Liquid Diamond Cartridge. This 1g cartridge is made from solventless diamonds sourced from live rosin, offering a clean, all-natural taste with no added terpenes. With a THC content of 83-95%, each puff delivers a true, plant-forward flavour that captures the authentic profile of the flower. Perfect for those who seek a high-quality, earthy concentrate.

variants.title: Frosted Icicles Sour Cherry Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Back Forty's Frosted Icicles are infused pre-rolls coated in a layer of THCa diamonds, the perfect blend of potency, aroma, and flavour in expertly rolled cones. Sour Cherry is a bold twist on a classic, with notes of tart cherry and a hint of sour.

variants.title: Mango OG Saucy Diamond Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Get a taste of the tropics with Papa's Herb Mango OG. This high potency indica is a cross between KC 33 and Afghani with a mango flavour and aroma.

variants.title: Mandarin Cookies
variants.body_html: Life's a little sweeter in the back forty and you won't want to wait for dessert to give our Mandarin Cookies a try! This sativa-dominant strain pulls a tangy citrus flavour with a hint of sweet nuttiness on the exhale. A cross of the classic Cookies strain and Mandarin Sunset, with some major limonene.

variants.title: Sour Blueberry 50's+ Triple Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Elevate your experience with Dab Bods Sour Blueberry 50's+ Triple Infused Pre-Rolls. Featuring a strain that delights the senses with its sweet and sour blueberry flavor. Each puff bursts with fruity aromas, complemented by zesty citrus notes and the luscious essence of ripe berries. Infused with premium resin, distillate and botanical terpenes then generously coated with diamonds, these pre-rolls deliver a remarkable potency of 50+. Packaged in a convenient 3-pack of 0.5g pre-rolls, they're ideal for solo enjoyment or sharing with friends. Dive into a vibrant world of flavor and aroma with Dab Bods Sour Blueberry-where every roll is an adventure!

variants.title: Gluerangutan Live Rosin All-In-One Disposable Pen
variants.body_html: Pure single-strain LSO Live Rosin, now in a sleek all-in-one vape. Our Gluerangutan AIO delivers dab-quality flavor—no rig necessary. Gluerangutan is a house-bred, terpy hybrid strain that’s a back-cross of the popular legacy strain Harambe (OG Kush x GG4 x Hash Plant). It’s bursting with sweet and sour orange-lemon zest aromas, with gassy undertones and a fresh mountain pine finish. The top cut from a 100,000+ pheno hunt, Gluerangutan Live Rosin is squished in small-batches from organically grown, fresh frozen hash, exclusively on Salt Spring Island, BC.

variants.title: Lemon Cherry Sherb
variants.body_html: Lemon Cherry Sherb seduces with its rich aromatic profile, combining sour cherry, sweet-lemon notes, and a creamy touch inherited from Sunset Sherbet. Bred by Cookies Fam Genetics, combining Lemon Cherry Gelato with the legendary Sunset Sherbet offers consumers some of the most exotic and terpene-rich flavours coming out of California for those that smoke loud. Terpenes include caryophyllene, limonene, and humulene.

variants.title: Dab N Dips Cherry
variants.body_html: Just out for a dip are ya bud? Dab Bods presents to you, one of the most discreet, convenient and tastiest way to consume THC with our Dab Bods Dab n Dips! Walk through the Cherry trees and take these little dips for a spin at a price point that won't leave a hole in your pocket, just a ring. Each container contains 10 x 10mg pouches.

variants.title: Indica PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: XPLOR your wild side with Indica pre-rolls. Sourced from Canadian growers, these pre-rolls are smooth, high quality, high potency and affordable.

variants.title: Sage N' Sour Blunt 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: A cross between Sour Diesel x S.A.G.E (Sativa Afghani Genetic Equilibrium), this strain takes its well-known Sour Diesel lineage to the next level through its unique terpenes. Sage n’ Sour is full of pungent, gassy diesel notes, with peppery, limey, and cedar accents.

variants.title: Chemzilla
variants.body_html: Brace yourselves, the secret is out on our latest, Chemzilla. It’s a potent indica with Chemdawg x Godzilla Glue lineage.

variants.title: No.15 Delta 9 Watermelon Gummy
variants.body_html: Get some of the best bang for your buck with Glenn’s No.15 Delta 9 Watermelon gummy! This small, square gummy packs 10mg of premium Delta 9 THC into a bold, juicy watermelon flavour that candy-lovers will enjoy. Thanks to its smaller format, it’s naturally low in sugar. Convenient, affordable, and full of flavour, Glenn’s No.15 is a perfect choice for quality and value.

variants.title: Purple Caviar
variants.body_html: Purple Caviar is another delicacy release from SKOSHA. This indica is a sweet, sour and gassy phenotype. The cross of (Kush Mints X F1 Durb X Gusherz) has resulted in a beautifully coloured flower that will leave you with a pleasant aroma and taste in the aftermath.

variants.title: Garlic Truffle
variants.body_html: Bringing OG back — crank up the garlic funk and ride the zesty skunk with this throwback classic Garlic Truffle, an indica-dominant that combines the legendary Platinum OG x GMO strains. Garlic Truffle delights the senses with a robust flavour profile featuring bold notes of garlic, skunk, and pine.

variants.title: Thew Twizz Liquid Diamonds Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: The Twizz is an old school, red cherry flavour that you know and love. This 1g, THC distillate 510 vape is blended with liquid diamonds for maximum potency and divine flavour.

variants.title: Tropical Citrus
variants.body_html: Award-winning Tropical Citrus flavour is bursting with pineapple, grapefruit, and yuzu notes, and contains 20mg of CBD and 10mg of THC. With a 2:1 ratio of CBD to THC, it comes with a quick onset of THC and a double amount of CBD. Best served over ice with a slice of lime. 25 calories, 5g sugar, gluten-free, and vegan friendly.

variants.title: Pink GOAT 50's+ Triple Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Indulge in the ultimate cannabis treat with Dab Bods pink GOAT 50's+ Triple Infused Pre-Rolls. This strain delivers a mouthwatering berry candy flavor, beautifully accented by tropical citrus notes that invigorate your senses. Infused with premium resin, distillate and botanical terpenes, then generously coated in diamonds for an extra kick. Each pre-roll delivers an exceptional potency of 50+, ensuring a powerful and flavorful session. Packaged in a convenient 3-pack, they are perfect for sharing with friends or savoring solo. Elevate your cannabis experience with the vibrant tastes and aromas of Dab Bods pink GOAT-where every puff is a celebration!

variants.title: Jungle Fumes PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Stop and smell the Jungle Fumes! These dense Jungle-coloured buds are packed with diesel and chem flavours! The parent strains of Sour Diesel x Chemdawg x Lemon OG create a sativa that comes with a heavy diesel aroma upfront, chem undertones and notes of tropical fruits. Jungle Fumes will take you on a jungle cruise through your senses! FIGR pre-rolls are expertly rolled with a paper filter and conical shape for a smooth, consistent smoke.

variants.title: Unicorn Blood Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: XPLOR your whimsical side with Unicorn Blood. Each puff is a burst of flavour that can dazzle your senses.

variants.title: Triple Burger Trifecta Infused PR 3 x 0.6 g
variants.body_html: Tribal Trifecta. No fake terpenes and no distillate. Tribal Trifecta Triple Burger infused pre-rolls start with Triple Burger flower that is triple infused with Triple Burger live resin, terpene sauce and THC-A diamonds. Rolled in a hemp paper and finished with a ceramic tip. Live resin + terpene sauce + THC-A diamonds = the Tribal Trifecta.

variants.title: Cuban Linx Supernova Live Resin AIO Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Tribal's Cuban Linx SuperNova live resin all-in-one vape has one ingredient - our fresh frozen Cuban Linx flower (TK Skunk x Trigerian). The breeder is Swamp Boy Seeds. Potent and loaded with a traditional haze flavour, Tribal's SuperNova disposable vape has ceramic hardware and a USB-C rechargeable battery.

variants.title: Simcoe Gas Pure Cured Resin AIO Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Fewer ingredients, bigger flavour. We only use Simcoe gas flower when producing our cured resin vape, which means full flavour with notes of heavy gas, a little musk and a full spectrum product. Designed for portability, our vape is an all-in-one device with pre-heat functionality, ready to use straight out of the box. Plus, our hardware is calibrated for low temperature sessions, guaranteeing a smooth draw and robust flavours with every inhale. Additive-free, which means no distillate and no botanical terpenes.

variants.title: El Jefe
variants.body_html: This speak-easy gangster style strain stays LowKey by crossing indica-dominant Animal Mints x Sherb Cake lineages. A sweet aroma of smooth peppermint and tropical flowers is followed by jazzy sweet notes of a tangy, tart cake flavour. Pablo’s Revenge showcases dense, resinous buds with a deep green hue, often tinged with shades of purple. Its trichome coverage is also worth talking about.

variants.title: Dante'z Inferno
variants.body_html: Dante’z Inferno, a cross between Oreoz x Devil Driver, delivers a flavour profile reminiscent of sandwich cookie ice cream and campfire s’mores thanks to the Oreoz. The Devil Driver lineage adds some notes of earth and spice with a slight citrus finish. The wasabi green buds are extremely tight, lightly dusted with a snow storm of trichome crystals.

variants.title: Beast Berry Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Unleash the beast with XPLOR's Beast Berry Disposable Vape. Each pull delivers a burst of cranberry, blueberry and blackberry. It's a beastly flavour explosion. Now in premium disposable hardware.

variants.title: Amnesia Haze
variants.body_html: Amnesia Haze has a distinct terpene profile of uplifting lemon and citrus notes accompanied by energetic spice, earth and zesty aromas. This sativa marvel should satisfy even the most discerning with its lime green buds that are so thickly covered in tric

variants.title: Pink Kush
variants.body_html: Pure Sunfarms' cut of Pink Kush from BC's Vancouver Island is a coastal relative of the legendary OG Kush. This special strain is beloved across Canada for its strong aromas, colourful flowers and high THC potential. Beneath a thick coating of trichomes, the dense and round buds feature forest green leaves, often with a purple hue, mixed with dark amber pistils. Grown in a high-tech greenhouse in the Fraser Valley, each bud is carefully trimmed and hand-groomed, dried and cured to precise standards. Pink Kush showcases gassy aromas of white pepper, orange, butterscotch, coffee, earth and grapefruit, the result of a rich combination of terpenes that includes caryophyllene, myrcene, humulene, bisabolol, and limonene.

variants.title: Triangle Mints
variants.body_html: Introducing Triangle Mints, a new indica dominant cultivar from Original Stash. With a potency of 20-24%, this unique strain boasts a lineage of both Triangle Kush and Animal Mints, resulting in a truly one-of-a-kind experience. The dark green and trichome-dense buds not only look impressive, but they also offer an aroma driven by the terpenes Caryophyllene, Myrcene, and Limonene, with notes of spice, musk, and citrus. Add Triangle Mints to your collection for a straightforward and satisfying smoking experience.

variants.title: Mighty Mini's
variants.body_html: Sometimes good things come in small packages. Our mighty mini's are the small buds we separate by hand from our full flower. You can get the same flavour as our full flower offerings, for a limited time at an unbeatable price. Each bag is strain specific with the flavour displayed on the back.

variants.title: Baby Jeeter S. Plum Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Perfectly ripened plum meets caramelized sugar sweetness in our all new Sugar Plum pre-roll to create an aromatic experience that’s simultaneously indulgent and satisfying. A true sativa, Sugar Plum features high levels of linalool, myrcene, and limonene to ensure a potent entourage effect.

variants.title: Baby Jeeter Pink Lemon Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Soothe your sweet tooth with Pink Lemon, a vivacious tropical experience descended from the infamous Lemon Skunk x Purple Kush. Rich in limonene, terpinene, and humulene, Pink Lemon is the mouth-watering hybrid experience you’ve been waiting for.

variants.title: Peanut Butter Bite
variants.body_html: Our own peanut butter filling is enrobed in our signature Belgian milk chocolate to recreate a gourmet version of the popular grocery store go-to. Each 14-gram bite contains 5 mg THC & 5 mg CBD from full-spectrum, CO2 extract made from a blend of whole flower. The CBD is from Cannatonic whole flower CO2 extract. Terpenes: guaiol, Alpha-bisabolol, caryophyllene, borneol, beta-caryophyllene.

variants.title: Perma Fried PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Perma Fried is a Seed Junky cross of Hawaiian Rain x Permanent Marker, which results in large, heavily frosted dark green flowers. The aroma is tropical gas and fruity with a peppery petrol kick. The flavour is similar with a spicy fruit filled smoke. Terpenes include limonene, linalool and beta-caryophyllene.

variants.title: Purple Caviar PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Purple Caviar is another delicacy release from SKOSHA. This indica is a sweet, sour and gassy phenotype. The cross of (Kush Mints X F1 Durb X Gusherz) has resulted in a beautifully coloured flower that will leave you with a pleasant aroma and taste in the aftermath.

variants.title: Rockstar Slims PR 10 x 0.4 g
variants.body_html: These fine pre-rolls are slim, packed straight and steady from top to bottom. Stuffed with Rockstar bud, a gassy and spicy indica. Terpenes include caryophyllene, myrcene, and limonene. All you need is a light. Super Toast. Always Ready.

variants.title: Pineapple Milk Infused Blunt PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Pineapple Milk Infused Blunt is a high-potency, slow-burning blunt from Soar’s Fruit Collection, featuring a premium oil infusion and rich flavours of creamy, sugary pineapple, and graham crumbs. Made with small batch, hang-dried, whole flower and hand-finished with a generous coating of fresh-flower kief. Finished with a Dutch crown for a smooth, even burn. Formulated using distillate and flavouring agents.

variants.title: Sativa
variants.body_html: Encore AAA+ Sativa is our unique collaboration with top growers across the country providing us with some of the freshest and most exclusive lots. As avid enthusiasts, we know the excitement of discovering a new favourite strain. We are dedicated to offering a consistent high THC content. By carefully rotating our strains, we ensure that only high quality flowers make the cut.

variants.title: Cabana Cannabis Co Rolling Tray - Parasol - Medium
variants.body_html:
Bring a tropical vibe to your rolling setup with the Cabana Cannabis Co. Parasol Rolling Tray. Designed with vibrant, island-inspired artwork, this tray offers more space for your rolling essentials while adding a splash of colour to your session.

Crafted from durable, high-quality metal, the Parasol Rolling Tray features smooth, curved edges to prevent spills and make rolling effortless. The medium size gives you extra room to work with, whether you're at home or on the go, providing a comfortable and convenient rolling experience every time.

Key Features & Benefits
Tropical-Inspired Design – Bright, eye-catching graphics bring a laid-back, island feel to your sessions
Durable Metal Construction – Built to last with a sturdy, lightweight design
Smooth, Curved Edges – Helps prevent spills and keeps materials contained
More Room to Roll – Provides extra space while remaining easy to store or travel with
Easy to Clean – Non-stick surface makes maintenance a breeze

Elevate your rolling game with the Cabana Cannabis Co. Parasol Rolling Tray—perfect for those who love style, convenience, and good vibes.

variants.title: VCC
variants.body_html: Purple Hills aims to present the best craft flower in the market from passionate growers that mostly occupy the "if you know, you know" world. From Vancouver Island, the Victoria Cannabis Company (VCC) team are true community leaders, with roots in the cannabis industry going back to the beginning and a craft-led vision for the future.

variants.title: 1st Quarter
variants.body_html:
Viola’s 1st Quarter (7g Sativa) is a unique sativa-dominant cross. This is a Gorilla Poison cultivar, made by crossing the beloved Mimosa x GG4 x Durban Poison. This cultivar is grown by a micro-grower in BC and is hand-trimmed and hang-dried to perfection. These XL nugs are covered in dense green, orange pistils and are complemented by fluffy green buds with golden undertones. This flower features bold aromas of tropical fruit with notes of nutty vanilla and woody pine, with uplifting effects that will get you going. Viola's 1st Quarter Sativa is a top-choice for sativa lovers!  

Top Terps: Linalool, Terpinolene, and alpha-Humulene

variants.title: Bang Snap Hash
variants.body_html: Bang Snap Hash by Catch Me Outside. Bang Snap Hash blends potency and nostalgia. This hash is designed to deliver a powerful and memorable experience. Crafted from meticulously sifted and screened dry flowers, Bang Snap Hash offers an intense aroma and robust flavour profile. The hash boasts a soft and pliable texture, with a striking dark brown exterior and a rich, golden-green interior. To enhance its nostalgic appeal, each piece is wrapped in rolled parchment paper, reminiscent of the beloved bang snaps. When smoked, it delivers a spicy and potent experience, reflecting its full spectrum legacy roots. This hash is versatile and can be consumed in various ways, from traditional smoking to modern vaporizing methods.

variants.title: BC Organic Pineapple Sour PR 10 x 0.3 g
variants.body_html: Available for limited time only. Pucker up and get ready to enjoy this hot release from Simple Bare’s greenhouse, BC Organic Pineapple Sour. Crossing the legendary Sour Diesel with Pineapple Kush, her buds are dense and frosty with beautiful green and purple hues. With sour and gassy notes, and subtle hints of fruit, this indica-dominant cultivar boast the potency and flavours that will surely impress. Terpenes include limonene, caryophyllene, and farnesene. Grown in organic living soil, hang-dried, hand-trimmed, and cold cured to perfection.

variants.title: Fruit Punch Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Enjoy the nostalgic berry flavours of our beloved Sativa Fruit Punch strain in our all new liquid diamond 510 thread cartridges! Made with melted diamonds for a pure and potent hit, it provides a consistently smooth and satisfying experience. Come to Papa!

variants.title: Baby Jeeter Boutique Drop Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: A limited edition pack of Liquid Diamond Infused Baby Jeeter pre-rolls. Every few weeks, we switch it up with new strains, delivering high THC and fresh flavours. Each pre-roll is made with quality buds, infused with liquid diamonds and rolled in our in-house kief for extra potency. More diamonds, more THC and more flavour. Always a consistent burn. And with each drop, you’re getting something fresh, high quality and limited edition.

variants.title: Frosted Fruit Cake
variants.body_html: Frosted Fruit Cake has very high potency with a unique candied fruit and gas aroma. The strain features large, dense buds with bright orange pistils and deep green hues under a think frosting of trichomes. Coming from a cross of Fruity Pebbles OG x Wedding Cake, this indica leaning hybrid is craft designated and packed in home compostable containers.

variants.title: Crop Circle - Smalls
variants.body_html: Far Out Crops' Crop Circle rotational SKU. Grown in our cutting edge indoor facilities. Hand packaged and trimmed with precision, our Crop Circle undergoes a cold cure process. Never irradiated, our product maintains its properties intact.

variants.title: AAA PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Far Out Crops, where quality and craft come together in every bud. As pioneers in craft cannabis, we are dedicated to delivering the finest strains, satisfying both connoisseurs and casual consumers. Our master growers handpick and nurture each plant, ensuring optimal growth and potency, resulting in a superior product. Our small-batch approach maintains the highest standards of quality, preserving the natural terpenes and cannabinoids that make each strain unique. Consumers prefer craft cannabis for its rich, authentic experience. At Far Out Crops, we believe premium quality should be accessible to all. We are committed to offering top-quality cannabis at a fair price, making it accessible for everyone to enjoy our exceptional strains. Choose Far Out Crops for a cannabis experience that is truly out of this world. Discover the difference that craft cannabis can make with our meticulously cultivated, high-quality strains.

variants.title: Blueberry Yum Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Get that Blueberry Yum now in a 2g vape. Bodacious blueberry, luscious lemon, and vibrant vanilla. The extra-large 2g fill is specially formulated with a delicious cannabinoid-packed extract with 1,000mg THC, up to 300mg CBG, and 300mg CBD, and over 2x the natural flavouring found in their 1g vapes. Super session-able and supremely tasty, Blueberry Yum 2g Vapes feature reliable hardware and wider mouthpieces to improve airflow and reduce clogging. They double-distill and double-filter the THC distillate for superior quality flavour and potency. Made with botanically sourced ingredients and flavouring agents.

variants.title: Mango Kiwi Haze 10:1 THC:CBC Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Enjoy Spinach® Mango Kiwi Haze CBC 1.2g vape with a 1:10 CBC:THC ratio. Inspired by the always fresh and fruity Mango Haze cultivar, our juicy mango and kiwi flavour notes mix to create a one-of-a-kind vape flavour experience.

variants.title: Blackberry Breath
variants.body_html: This heavily indica dominant cultivar is well known and well loved for both its potency and its intense flavours of sweet, earthy cherry and woodiness.

variants.title: Fruit Punch Slims PR 10 x 0.4 g
variants.body_html: These fine pre-rolls are slim, packed straight and steady from top to bottom. Stuffed with Fruit Punch, a sweet and juicy sativa. All you need is a light. Super Toast. Always Ready.

variants.title: Lite N' Smooth Pack PR 5 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: hifeelu – your trusted brand for social cannabis experiences! Introducing our first pre-roll pack, featuring craft-grown balanced-flower carefully selected for its exquisite fruity terpene profile. Each pre-roll features a first-of-its-kind activated charcoal filter, ensuring a smooth experience.

variants.title: Menthol Ice Liquid Diamonds Eco-friendly AIO Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Now available as an eco-Friendly all-in-one. This disposable vape has a removable and recyclable battery housed in a biodegradable corn PLA shell. Expect a cool experience with this potent Menthol Ice Liquid Diamonds all-in-one. Derived from liquid diamonds and live resin, this vape cartridge has high potency and a full spectrum flavour that is true to the Menthol cross of Gelato x White Diesel x Jet Fuel. Packaged in home compostable jars.

variants.title: Pop Culture Liquid Diamond AIO Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Phant's liquid diamond vape is packed with potent THCa decarboxylate. The Pop Culture Liquid Diamond SKU features a rotating selection of four flavours. Now available in a convenient all-in-one vape that's rechargeable.

variants.title: CBG Heat Wave (Strawberry Lemonade) Sour Squeezy Gummies
variants.body_html: Taste the flavours of our THC and CBG Strawberry Lemonade Sour Squeezy. Taste the harmony of sweet, sun ripened strawberries and zesty lemons for a tangy treat.

variants.title: Cobra Chicken Live Resin Blammo Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Get ready to wrangle the Cobra Chicken Live Resin stashed in our durable and rugged Blammo hardware. Dive into the feisty blend of spicy herbs and a hint of gooseberry zing that Cobra Chicken struts around with. This cannabis strain packs potency that'll have your senses honking for more. Buckle up for a wild flight with the essence of Cobra Chicken — crafted for those who dare to face the cheeky side of cannabis and savour every squawk-worthy moment.

variants.title: Purple Churro Grind
variants.body_html: Purple Churro Grind brings you the indulgent desserty flavour of Cinnamon Horchata x Apples & Bananas in beautifully ground 7g jars of terpene-rich milled flower. Made exclusively with whole flower, we carefully selected and precisely tuned the mill size for optimal freshness and to ensure no terpene or potency loss. That means you can indulge your sativa sweet tooth with the vibrant vanilla and sweet cinnamon flavours bursting from this unique genetic. Puff pastries takes on a whole new meaning with the intensely relaxing and satisfying cerebral power made without shake or trim. So roll up, or pack a bowl and enjoy the ultra-sticky grind, drool-worthy aromas and loud effects. The proof is in the process: meticulously grown, carefully hang dried and precisely milled for an unforgettable expression of Purple Churro Grind in 7g jars.

variants.title: True Glto 33 Diamonds & Sauce
variants.body_html: Sherbinskis genetics, fresh frozen, ice water extracted into glistening hand formed solventless diamonds and sauce. Bright and busting with terpenes and THC, this extract captures the best of Sherbinskis, ready to dab or infuse. Served up in a signature Sherbinskis jar.

variants.title: Melonade Liquid Diamond Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Max potency, ready to rip. Get liquid diamonds in the palm of your hand with the DEBUNK Melonade all-in-one vape, an intense sativa that dominates with smooth citrus and melon flavour and tangy undertones. Our proprietary hydrocarbon extraction process converts THCa diamonds into an ultra-pure, ultra-potent THC liquid diamond isolate that is then enhanced with a custom botanical terpene blend. Housed in powerful, USB-C rechargeable hardware with a wide mouth opening for optimal airflow to minimize clogging, this kingpin holds it down.

variants.title: Animal Rntz Grind
variants.body_html: Animal RNTZ Grind unleashes beautifully ground jars of terpene-rich milled flower made for convenience. Made exclusively from whole flower, we carefully selected and precisely tuned the mill size for optimal freshness and to ensure no terpene or potency loss. That means you can enjoy the intense sweet fruit and sour tartness of this high THC indica in an accessible format made with no shake or trim. So roll up or pack a bowl of this Animal Cookies x RNTZ cross. Unbridled flavour and velvety smoke, this genetic may surprise you. We’ll keep this strain wild with meticulous growing practices, hang drying and precise milling to create a beastly expression of Animal RNTZ Grind in jars.

variants.title: XVape Vista Mini 2 - Black
variants.body_html:
The XVape Vista Mini 2 is a high-performance, compact electronic dab rig designed for smooth, flavourful, and hassle-free sessions. With four temperature settings, wireless charging, and an ergonomic glass design, this portable e-rig delivers premium dabbing without the need for a torch. The built-in water filtration system ensures cool, clean hits every time, while the replaceable atomizer and quartz heating element maximize vapor production and flavour.

Whether you're dabbing at home or on the go, the Vista Mini 2 is built for effortless, efficient, and enjoyable use. Its sleek design, intuitive controls, and advanced technology make it a top choice for dab enthusiasts who want portability without compromising performance.

Key Features & Benefits:
Four Temperature Settings – Customize your dabs for optimal vapor and flavour.
Quartz Heating Chamber – Ensures clean, consistent heat for smooth hits.
Built-In Water Filtration – Delivers cooler, less harsh vapor.
Wireless & USB-C Charging – Convenient, fast charging for on-the-go use.
Removable & Replaceable Atomizer – Easy maintenance and long-lasting performance.
LED Light Indicator – Displays temperature settings and battery life.
Sleek & Portable Design – Compact, durable, and easy to carry.
For a next-level dabbing experience, the XVape Vista Mini 2 offers a perfect blend of technology, design, and performance—all in a portable, easy-to-use package.

variants.title: Luminous Lime PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Color's Luminous Lime 10x0.35g PRJs are a sativa-dominant hybrid legacy phenotype of White Widow, a genetic cross of a Brazilian Sativa and Indian Indica. It's dominant terpenes - Beta-Caryophyllene, Alpha-Bisabolol, Nerolidol, Guaiol and Linalool produce a sour citrus and funky flavour and aroma, with hints of pine. These pre-rolls are perfectly packed with gently milled flower, not trim or shake, to ensure each joint contains the freshest and most flavourful cannabis possible. Perfect for stocking up or sharing!

The Honeystick Duo VV Plus takes dual-cartridge vaping to the next dimension, delivering versatility, power, and precision in one sleek package. Key Features & Benefits:
Dual Cartridge Compatibility – Use one or both carts at the same time for a personalized experience.
Digital Display Screen – Easily check voltage, battery life, and vape mode in real time.
4 Voltage Settings (2.6V - 3.6V) – Adjust for flavour, smoothness, or bigger clouds.
8-Second Preheat Mode – Perfect for thick oils or cold conditions.
Draw Activation – Just inhale—no buttons needed.
Auto Shut-Off for Safety – 5-minute timer conserves battery life and prevents overheating.
Fits Most Cartridges Up to 2mL – Versatile design works with a wide range of carts.
USB-C Rapid Charging – Recharge faster and keep the session going.
Ambient Light Indicator – Easily see which cartridge is active.
All Power, No Limits
The Honeystick Duo VV Plus is built for convenience, performance, and style, making it the perfect choice for those who want a customizable, hassle-free dual-cart vaping experience.
