variants.body_html: Grab a sweet and sour slice of summer-inspired magic with Watermelon Lime Seltzer. Pucker up and dive into a fizzy fantasy of bubbly delight with a nano-emulsified blend of 10mg THC and 20mg CBG. This is your ticket to a sweet and sour wonderland bursting with juicy watermelon and zesty lime flavours. Made without sugar so you can sip away without a care in the world. Whether you enjoy it straight from the chilled can or over ice, this unforgettably effervescent beverage will cast a fresh spell on your taste buds.

variants.title: Strawnana Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Our Strawnana Cart is a fusion of flavours. This classic blend combines the sweet and juicy taste of ripe strawberries with the smooth and creamy essence of bananas. Not only is this cart potent, Strawnana offers exceptional value without compromising on quality. Strawnana is a timeless favourite that's always in season.

variants.title: Dr. Kush Cream Soda
variants.body_html: Sip the symphony of XMG Dr. Kush Cream Soda. It’s the perfect flavour harmony of spiced cola and vanilla cream soda with an electric smoothness you’ll vibe with. Elevated with 10mg of nano-emulsified THC and all-natural flavours and colours in 355ml cans, this flavour pairing hits all the right notes. Fresh, rich, and oh-so-smooth and velvety, just one sip and your tastebuds will thank you.

variants.title: Wildberry Acai Seltzer
variants.body_html: Indulge in Wildberry Açai Seltzer, a light and fresh way enjoy cannabis. Enjoy familiar seltzer effervescence and all-natural, bold berry and exotic açai flavours infused with a nano-emulsified formulation of 10mg THC and 20mg CBG. Made without sugar, it’s a perfect indulgence. Ready to enjoy straight from the can, or served over ice.

variants.title: Banjorine Dream Live Rosin Gummies
variants.body_html: Sheesh Banjorine Dream Sativa Live Rosin Gummies are made with 10 mg of organic Banjorine bursting with real fruit juice. Four mouthwatering gummies packed with premium single-strain cannabinoids.

variants.title: Cherry D Live Rosin Gummies
variants.body_html: Sheesh Cherry D Indica Live Rosin Gummies are made with 10 mg of organic Cherry Diesel bursting with real fruit juice. Four mouthwatering gummies packed with premium single-strain cannabinoids.

variants.title: Dr. Kush Cream Soda Zero
variants.body_html: Every sip of XMG Zero Dr. Kush Cream Soda is a symphony of flavour. Indulge in the harmony of this spiced cola and vanilla cream soda duet that’s made without sugar, for electric smoothness you’ll vibe with. Elevated with 10mg of nano-emulsified THC and all-natural flavours and colours in 355ml cans, this flavour pairing hits all the right notes. Fresh, rich, and oh-so-smooth and velvety, just one sip and your tastebuds will thank you.

variants.title: Blood Honey x Sticky Bananas
variants.body_html: Dive into a euphoric balance of potency and deliciousness with RAD Sticky Bananas x Blood Honey Shatter. An instant classic concentrate boasting tropical and sweet flavour profiles, extracted via hydrocarbon extraction for a potent, solid shatter and a perfect balance of high THC and a great taste. Made using only fresh-frozen flower, this full-spectrum extract is great for dabbing on its own or adding a boost of potency to your pre-rolls.

variants.title: Mango Cake
variants.body_html:
Mango Cake is an exotic dessert cross of GOOD BUDS’ original Mango Taffie strain with Wedding Cake. It leads with classic Mango Taffie smells of juicy mango sweetness with a gassy afterburn, followed by with sweet vanilla frosting undertones from the Wedding Cake. The dry pull tastes like ripe mangoes and orange zest, with a creamy cake dough mouthfeel on the exhale.


Grown in small batches in Living Organic Soils, each batch of Mango Cake is hand harvested, hang dried, hand trimmed and hand packed using artisanal slow-cure methods.

variants.title: Peach High-Alive Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Peach High-Alive is a sensational blend of five fruit flavours from another Fruit classic. It's a nostalgic blend of peaches, passionfruit, and a tangy citrus mix that you'll remember.. Try it with Trippy Sips' crinkle straw mouthpiece, designed for bigger, better pulls and maximum flavour.

variants.title: Chocolate Fusions Fudge Brownie Bite 1:1:1 CBN:CBD:THC
variants.body_html: Enjoy a multi-dimensional cannabis experience with three delicious layers of silky-smooth chocolate, brownie crunch inclusions, and a chewy fudge core. Lord Jones® Fudge Brownie Bite 1:1:1 CBN | CBD | THC Chocolate Fusions™ take you above and beyond to a higher level of chocolatey goodness. These hand-crafted and artfully created chocolate bites deliver an extraordinary moment of decadent cannabis. Experience 5 chocolate bites with a balanced ratio of 2mg CBN, 2mg CBD, and 2 mg THC per piece with10mg CBN, 10mg CBD, and 10mg THC total per pack.

variants.title: Dubb Bubbs Cured Resin Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: These Dubble Bubba infused pre-rolls are made from full spectrum cured resin and high terpene distillate blended with craft flower from our double cross of Bubba OG x Pre-98 Bubba Kush. The traditional strain aromas are amplified with a terpene profile containing sweet and fruity notes of this legacy genetic. These flavourful and high potency infused pre-rolls are all packaged up in a wrapper.

variants.title: Face Lock Shatter
variants.body_html: Get ready to experience Face Lock Shatter. This is a super potent concentrate. Despite its strength, this shatter offers incredible value, making it a great deal for consumers who demand quality without breaking the bank.

variants.title: Rotational FSE Resin Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Introducing the 1964 Indica Rotational FSE Resin Vape — the latest gem in our renowned 1964 vape collection. Discover the pinnacle of full-spectrum extracts, crafted from our finest, hand-selected flowers. Act quickly — each exclusive batch is only available for a limited time!

variants.title: Guava OG Diamonds Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Embrace the unexpected with Kolab Project’s Guava OG Diamonds 510 cartridge, combining state-of-the-art technology with convenient design. Crafted with liquid diamonds, this cartridge offers high THC and exotic notes of earthy and tropical guava. Made in Kolab Project’s hardware and paired with a black metal mouthpiece that’s smooth to the touch.

variants.title: Double Bubba PR 7 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Old meets new with our fresh take on a legacy strain. This is a double cross of Bubba OG x Pre-98 Bubba Kush. This sweet and spicy indica has aromas reminiscent of coffee, chocolate and hash, with notes of fresh flowers and woody pine on the dry pull. The elongated and bulky dark green buds are spotted with bright orange pistils and a thick frosting of amber trichomes. These craft designated pre-rolls are hand packed in-house with whole milled flower.

variants.body_html: Old meets new with our fresh take on a legacy strain. This is a double cross of Bubba OG x Pre-98 Bubba Kush. variants.title: Shuffle 2-pack Of J's PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: High Note's Shuffle two-pack of Js offers some of our most sought after cultivars: The Blues and Hash Plant. The Blues is a hybrid cross of Blueberry x White Widow that offers a strong, sweet yet sour citrusy aroma and flavour. Hash Plant is a heavily leaning indica. This strain gives off a rich Afghani aroma that’s undercut with a hint of hashish.

variants.title: Double Bubba
variants.body_html: Old meets new with our fresh take on this infamous legacy strain. This is a double cross of Bubba OG x Pre-98 Bubba Kush. This sweet and spicy indica has aromas reminiscent of coffee, chocolate and hash, balanced by notes of fresh flowers and woody pine on the dry pull. The elongated and bulky dark green buds are spotted with bright orange pistils and a thick frosting of amber trichomes.

variants.title: Super Lemon Guy Monsters 1000 Resin Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: We’ve packed full spectrum Jean Guy resin into a vape and dialled up the entourage effect with Super Lemon Haze cannabis terpenes, enhanced with a splash of citrus. We packed high THC into a custom cartridge outfitted with a proprietary heating element that vaporizes the extract faster than a standard cart.

variants.title: Hippie Cripwalk Smalls
variants.body_html: Introducing Hippie Cripwalk — get ready for this classic. This sativa-dominant cultivar has a lineage of All Kush 47 x Blue Satellite and boasts a mossy, deep green appearance. This bud explodes with sweet citrus, distinctive pine, and earthy flavours and is complemented by a spicy exhale and frosty trichomes. You can trust the name — Hippie Cripwalk — it's a timeless choice for cannabis enthusiasts.

variants.title: Dab N Go Sherbet Queen Diamonds and Sauce
variants.body_html: An indica-dominant strain know for the tangy delicious fruit aromas, Sherbet Queen is sure to please. Using this fiercely effective strain, Dab Bods combines it into a convenient 0.5 gram, easy to use, portable, and rechargeable vaporizing device, pre-loaded with a chamber full of diamonds and sauce. Perfect for those looking for portability and no mess. This tiny discreet solution uses pure and potent crystals of THC sauced up in a terpene rich resin. Cute and convenient, easy and portable. For use with a USB "C" charger.

variants.title: Galactic Grape Diamond Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Close your eyes and imagine a warm summer breeze at sunset, drifting lazily through row on row of vineyards. We've lifted that soft earthy grape bouquet and infused our signature Galactic Glue with the essence of those little drops of twilight. Rich in Caryophyllene and Myrcene our Galactic Glue pairs perfectly with the robust and spicy notes of a freshly picked grape. Enhanced by exquisite THCa diamonds for a crisp, smooth, flavour forward smoking experience. Finally, enrobed in golden kief this hand crafted and perfectly aged fruity twist is sure to delight even the most discerning sommelier with dank deliciousness.

variants.title: Emergenz
variants.body_html: Introducing EmergenZ, an incredibly flavourful sativa strain crossed between Orange Push Pop and Sunset Sherbet. This strain is potent and delicious. Indoor grown in small batches on the West Coast, Broken Coast strives to push the limits on what craft flower can be. Experience notes of citrus, grapefruit and pine from large, trichome-rich buds.

variants.title: Famous Design Sapphire Fumed Lrg Sherlock -Blue-5.5in.
variants.body_html:
Enhance your smoking experience with the Famous Design Sapphire Fumed Sherlock Pipe! At 5.5 inches, this pipe combines striking aesthetics with exceptional functionality. The dazzling sapphire-fumed finish and classic Sherlock design add a touch of elegance to every session, delivering smooth and satisfying hits.

Key Features & Benefits
Handblown Borosilicate Glass: Expertly crafted from durable, heat-resistant glass for consistent and long-lasting performance.
Sapphire Fumed Finish: Featuring vibrant, shimmering blue tones, this pipe offers a captivating look that stands out in any collection.
Ergonomic Sherlock Shape: The timeless curved design ensures comfortable handling and a refined smoking experience.
Deep Bowl: Designed for longer, more enjoyable sessions with fewer refills needed.

Perfectly Portable: At 5.5 inches, this pipe is compact enough for on-the-go use while still delivering top-tier performance.
Whether you’re adding to your collection or looking for a standout piece, the Famous Design Sapphire Fumed Sherlock Pipe offers style, quality, and functionality in one beautiful package. Brighten up your sessions with this stunning accessory!

variants.title: Mint Madness All-In-One Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Introducing Litti's Mint Madness all-in-one. Immerse yourself in the flavour of mint, now with added liquid diamonds.

variants.title: Mega Mixed Berry Disty+Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Enjoy the delicious flavours of the Mega Mixed Berry Disty + Diamond Vape. A fruity berry aroma combined with high-quality distillate and diamonds. Experience the true potency!

variants.title: Sugar-Free Black Cherry CBN Gummies
variants.body_html: Chew and Chill Sugar-Free Black Cherry CBN is a full-flavour formulation, with 10mg of THC per pack. This product also contains 5mg of CBN. Each pack contains two chews, giving customers the freedom to enjoy a great-tasting product with no sugar. All Chew and Chill products are gluten-free, dairy-free, and keto.

variants.title: Red Apple Peach Max10 THC Gummy
variants.body_html: Looking for something sweet? SHRED'ems Red Apple Peach has you covered! This juicy indica gummy blends the crisp sweetness of red apple with the smooth, mellow flavour of ripe peach. With 10mg THC packed into just one MAX10 gummy.

Each package contains 20 mg of CBN, 20 mg of CBD and 10 mg of THC, and are complemented with a custom blend of indica terpenes and lavender and chamomile extracts.

variants.body_html: Blast to the future with BOXHOT Apricot Kush Whipped Diamonds, an iconic chart-topper that keeps it fresh -n' fly with rich apricot, a touch of tang, and earthy Kush. Super pure sativa THCa diamonds are converted to a butter-smooth consistency and boosted with botanical terps to deliver a one-two hit of flavour and potency. Add this next-gen heavy hitter to a dab rig and crystal whip them taste buds.

variants.body_html: Blast to the future with BOXHOT Tangerine Scream Whipped Diamonds, a blazing behemoth that comes alive with good citrus vibrations and a touch of berries and tropical fruits. variants.title: Shark Attack Max10 THC Gummy
variants.body_html: Get ready to sink your teeth into SHRED'ems Shark Attack! This sativa gummy unleashes a fierce wave of flavour with a jaw-dropping combo of blue raspberry and green apple. With 10mg THC packed into one MAX10 gummy, you're in for maximum flavour in just one bite.

variants.body_html: Experience Potluck's world of flavours - without the smoke. Get loud without the cloud with Chillows! Potluck Chillows feature an infusion of THC isolate and flavours to deliver a flavourful, yet discreet experience for cannabis consumers.

variants.body_html: Pivot to Puffco with this remarkable and dazzling dab experience. Portability has never hit better than with the Pivot, full flavour and power come together for a sensational session. Incredibly easy to use, simply load, click and enjoy. Single button interface, 4 heat settings, a 3D ceramic bowl and fantastic flavour are still at the forefront. Charge it using a USB-C charger in an hour and a half to use for 15 sessions.

variants.title: Focus V Aeris
variants.body_html: The Aeris is a pocket-friendly ergonomic extract vape. Constructed from stainless steel with a silicone shell, it's perfect for taking on the go. Adjust the airflow with two carb caps on the magnetic mouthpiece (one to savour flavour and one for big clouds). Swap the battery pack when it runs out for a seamless session. You can also charge wirelessly or with USB-C pass through charging. Single button operation makes dabbing a breeze, and the 360 heating and full-sized chamber is stellar. Use the Focus V app to customize presets, change your LED lightshow, bop between 365-600°F and collect XP to take top spot on the leaderboard. The Aeris comes with a dust cap, dab swabs, dab tool and shoulder carrying bag (plus its atomizer can be swapped with other Focus V devices!).

variants.title: Happy Hour Special PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Freedom Cannabis brings you our Happy Hour Special in pre-roll format. This 2 x 1-gram pre-roll SKU features two of our best strains in one pack. First try our Mimosa, a special sativa strain that tastes and smells like a citrus orchard. Then finish off your day with our Slurricane which is a smooth indica that features a heavy grape flavour and aroma. This sativa/indica SKU is registered between 21-27% THC and both strains are an amazing smoke. Both pre-rolls are weighed for accuracy and finished to perfection. Enjoy a real Happy Hour!

variants.title: Red Razzleberry
variants.body_html: Red Razzleberry Drip N' Rip brings a fresh and slightly sour raspberry burst to our high potency THC distillate. Add as much or as little as you'd like to give your bowl, dab or flower a boost in THC and taste, using our easy-to-apply syringe.

variants.title: Bubble Bubble Infused PR 5 x 0.25 g
variants.body_html: Ready to start blowing bubbles! variants.body_html: Ultra Jean-G by Big Bag o' Buds is here to elevate your smoking experience! This iconic sativa-dominant strain is a potent cross between Ultra Sour and Lemon Margy. Expect an explosion of gassy, lemony, and herbal aromas with a hint of pine. These trichome-covered buds deliver a THC potency of 25-31%, perfect for those who crave a high-octane, citrusy punch. With dominant terps like limonene, ?-caryophyllene, and linalool, it's a value-packed choice for the OGs.

variants.title: Franken' Fruit Tube-style PR 70 x 0.4 g
variants.body_html: Find your golden hour when you embark on a tantalizing taste voyage with Palmetto Goldberry. variants.title: Atman 510 Battery 2.0-4.0V Adjustable Voltage-Glossy Gold-380mAh
variants.body_html: These 510 threaded batteries are compatible with pre-filled or refillable cartridges. The Atman 380mAh battery, allows you to enjoy vaping all day before recharging. Adjust the voltage between 2.0 and 4.0V depending on the type of material you’re using in your cartridge. The 510-thread size is the most common, so it will fit with the majority of available carts. The USB provides a fast charge without requiring a wall block. For safety purposes and to prevent overheating the battery stops outputting power if the draw taken is too lengthy. To turn the device on, quickly press the button 5 times. Hold that same button down to draw. It’s personal preference whether you prefer to hold the button and heat up the material to get a massive hit or start drawing as soon as you press the button down for a more moderate hit. Preheat mode can be activated by rapidly clicking the button 2 times, this allows for the battery to continuously heat for 15 seconds. The device also has an auto-shutoff to prevent overheating. Variable voltage is achieved by simply twisting the bottom of the battery to desired temperature. The voltage range is between 2.0 and 4.0 volts. Remember, different viscosities will vaporize better at different temperatures. To charge the battery, screw on the charger the same way you would thread the cartridge. It is recommended to charge in a computer or a similar device. Sometimes using a wall adapter (especially a high powered one) can cause damage to the battery. The lights on the device and charger will be red while charging, and then turn off on the pen and change to green on the charger when complete.

The product is made with full spectrum CBD cannabis extract and hemp seed carrier oil, making this product a true-to-plant softgel. After all if it grows together, it goes together. Softgels offer customers a discrete format and keeps cannabis oil fresh and sealed from oxidative degradation that occurs in two piece capsules. They also provide incredible value when compared to edibles.

variants.title: Crystal Multipack Infused PR 8 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html:
Discover the magic of our Crystal Multipack Pre-rolls, This collection features three unique experiences, each inspired by a different crystal and infused with 100% plant-derived botanical terpenes. Embrace the power of love, serenity, and optimism with our premium high-THC cultivars.
Rose Quartz Strawberry Basil Lemonade Pre-rolls (Sativa): Our Rose Quartz line embodies the essence of universal love, designed to enhance comfort in social settings, uplift the spirit, and foster deep connections. Infused with sweet Strawberry Basil Lemonade terpenes, this exquisite pre-roll delivers an enchanting aroma. Inhale love, exhale doubt—it's time to fall in love with life all over again.
Blue Topaz Blueberry Acai Pre-rolls (Indica): Dive into the calming and energizing essence of Blue Topaz. Renowned for its ability to soothe the mind, our Blue Topaz pre-rolls are infused with the luscious aroma of Blueberry Acai. Experience a perfect balance of tart and sweet, designed to awaken your senses.
Aventurine Zesty Mint Lime Pre-rolls (Sativa): Channel the adventurous spirit of Aventurine with our invigorating pre-rolls. Our Aventurine pre-rolls are infused with the refreshing aroma of Zesty Mint Lime. This revitalizing blend will leave you feeling refreshed and ready to take on the world.
Sunstone Tropical Sunset Delight (Hybrid): This hybrid blend combines the creative essence of Sunstone with the vibrant flavors of a tropical sunset. Each pre-roll offers a harmonious mix of fruity and tropical notes, perfect for inspiring creativity and unwinding after a long day. Embrace the warm glow of Sunstone and enjoy a flavorful smoking experience that sparks imagination and soothes the soul as the sun sets.

variants.title: Rose Quartz Pink Diamond Coated Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Our new Rose Quartz Strawberry Lemonade pre-rolls are where the essence of universal love meets the perfect high. Rose Quartz, renowned for its ability to enhance comfort in social settings, uplift the spirit, and foster deep connections, is now embodied in our premium high-THC cultivar. Infused with 100% plant-derived botanical terpenes, this exquisite pre-roll delivers an enchanting aroma of sweet Strawberry Basil Lemonade. Inhale love, exhale doubt—it's time to fall in love with life all over again.

variants.title: Indica PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Hiway's two-pack of 1-gram joints are Indica-dominant and chosen from a variety of plants to always ensure you get a consistent THC range. Evenly rolled for a smooth burn, these joints are ready when you are.

variants.title: Lychee Bubble Tea Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: nfuzed by Lamplighter - Where Premium meets Potency. Using premium aeroponic whole milled flower, we infuze each joint with the purest distillate and real world terpenes and natural flavouring agents. Lychee Bubble Tea is fragrant, sweet and smooth featuring fruity and floral notes for a truly unique experience

tags: The Original Fraser Valley Weed Co.
variants.body_html: A bulk pack of 10 classic cone-style joints stuffed with Strawberry Amnesia, a legacy cross of Strawberry Cough and Amnesia. A potent, smooth sativa with aromas of sweet berries, a squeeze of citrus and earthy cocoa.

variants.title: Pine Tar Kush PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Explore the Back Forty with our Pine Tar Kush slim pre-rolls. A descendant of Pakistani landrace plants, Pine Tar Kush is a potent Indica with a profile of pungent earth and sour pine. 40's use whole flower and are machine-rolled to perfection, packed in a resealable tray.

variants.title: Lemon Diesel PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Explore the Back Forty with our Lemon Diesel slim pre-rolls. A cross between California Sour and Lost Coast OG, Lemon Diesel is a potent Sativa with a profile of bright citrus and heavy fuel. 40's use whole flower and are machine-rolled to perfection, packed in a resealable tray.

variants.title: Interstellar Live Rosin Cream Soda 10mg THC
variants.body_html: Dive into the cosmos with Astrolab's Interstellar Live Rosin Cream Soda, where every sip offers a journey through the galaxy of flavor and purity. Crafted using only the finest sun-grown, glacial-fed cannabis, our soda is infused with 100% solventless live rosin. Extracted purely through heat and pressure, our method preserves the rich terpenes and minor cannabinoids, delivering a drink that's not just refreshingly smooth, but also vibrantly potent. This cream soda is a tribute to natural processes and cosmic curiosity-perfect for those who seek solventless exploration in every effervescent bubble.

variants.title: Interstellar Rocket Lime Live Rosin Soda 10mg THC
variants.body_html: Blast off with Astrolab's Interstellar Rocket Lime Live Rosin Soda, your all-natural ticket to a vibrant, citrus, solventless infusion. Each bottle is a burst of fresh, zesty lime flavor, perfectly balanced with the clean, crisp essence of our solventless live rosin. Harnessing the power of sun-grown, glacial-fed cannabis, extracted solely through heat and pressure, we capture the plant's full spectrum of terpenes and cannabinoids. Savor the lively lime kick that rockets your palate into a new dimension of refreshment and relaxation.

variants.title: Propulsion Cream Soda (THC+CBG+Caffeine)
variants.body_html: Get ready for liftoff! Deep Space Propulsion Cream Soda is fueled with 10 mg of THC, 10 mg of CBG and less than 30mg naturally occurring caffeine. This refreshingly delicious bold Cream Soda will ignite your discovery! THC effects may be felt within 30 minutes of consumption (individual results may vary).

variants.title: Rainbow Razz Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Unleash the vibrant explosion of flavours with Rainbow Razz 1g Disposable Vape. A delightful fusion of rainbow-infused raspberries. Combined with potent THC extract in a high-grade disposable vape to provide both novice and experienced consumers something new to explore.

variants.title: Purple Poison
variants.body_html: Size doesn't matter. Dime Bag Smalls Purple Poison hybrid flower is packed with small, outdoor grown buds and is a genetic cross of Grape Gas x White Runt. The buds are fluffy and green with bright orange pistils. Each pouch has the perfect balance of fruity, spicy, and gassy aroma. Size isn't everything with value this big.

variants.title: Lemon Splash
variants.body_html: This is our first Ontario release in our Pepe Gold line. This line is designed as a truly inspired expression of Canadian cannabis. Lemon Splash is our phenotype of the Lemon Splash strain. This lemony fresh sativa has sweet lemon flavours. Pepe's Gold line is comprised solely of buds that measure more than 2.5 cm in diameter and have been expertly cured for a minimum of 45 days to optimize terpene expression and trichome development with the goal of creating beautiful bag appeal along with a positive smoking experience.

variants.title: Jean Guy
variants.body_html: Our flagship sativa is trés magnifique. Experience the high potencies from the White Widow x Unknown cross, and loud citrus and earthy aromas delivered by the caryophyllene, guaiol and limonene.

variants.title: Kush Dreams
variants.body_html: Size doesn't matter. Dime Bag Smalls Kush Dreams indica flower is packed with small, outdoor grown buds and a genetic cross of Kushmints (Rabid Hippy Cut) x White Nightmare. The buds are a deep purple with pops of lime green and coppery orange pistils, blanketed in trichomes. Each pouch hits the nose with a unique minty, berries and spice aroma. Size isn't everything with value this big.

variants.title: Kandy Cake
variants.body_html: This indica-dominant delight merges Triangle Kush x Candy Cane for an experience like no other! Kandy Cake hits notes of skunk and diesel, with a gentle sweet undertone coming from prominent terpenes limonene and pinene. These dense buds are sure to satisfy any sweet tooth! FIGR dried flower products are hand selected to ensure dense, high-quality buds are in every package.

variants.title: Forbidden Fruit Pack Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: A new multipack of Baby Jeeter flavours exclusively available in Canada. Each pack contains pre-rolls infused with liquid diamonds featuring a curated assortment of Peaches, Sugar Plum and Apples and Bananas. Each strain offers a variety of flavours.

variants.title: Pedro's Sweet Sativa
variants.body_html: Pedro's Sweet Sativa is a proudly Canadian sativa-dominant hybrid with fluffy, trichome-covered buds. Rich in terpenes like beta-caryophyllene and pinene, Pedro's Sweet Sativa smells sweet with undertones of spice. Unique to Color, this culitvar is a genetic cross of Dominican Sativa, White Russian and an unknown indica with very strong THC potency potential. Color Cannabis products are grown in southern Ontario, using state-of-the-art greenhouses with strain-specific nutrient and water regimes to ensure the purity of each plant. Cannabis flower is harvested with care and dried naturally, for optimal flavour and freshness. Our new nitrogen infused pouches lock-in freshness and are 80 per cent less waste than conventional packaging!

variants.title: Pax Plus Dual-Use Vaporizer - Sage
variants.body_html: Pax Plus is a dual-use vaporizer so you can enjoy extracts and dry herbs. A sleek and modern vape, its slim body can easily fit into a bag or pocket for on-the-go discreet use. New experience modes allow you to customize your session with Stealth, Efficiency, Flavour and Boost modes. Each offering a unique session. Different (included) oven lids also let you tailor the session to your preference. The new 3D oven screen is easy to remove, and a multi-tool and brush help keep your device clean and working efficiently and effectively. Keep your oven sealed with the magnetic lid closure. The battery should last roughly 2 hours.

variants.title: Rockstar
variants.body_html: Step into the spotlight with Weed Me’s Rockstar, an indica-dominant strain packed with 24–30% THC for a bold and uncompromising experience. Known for its earthy and skunky aroma, Rockstar delivers a powerful sensory profile that lingers long after the smoke clears. Offered in a generous 28g formatt and carefully packaged to preserve freshness, this strain stands out as a premium choice for those who demand the best.

variants.title: BC Organic Pineapple Sour
variants.body_html: Available for limited time. Pucker up and get ready to enjoy this hot release from the Simply Bare greenhouse, BC Organic Pineapple Sour. Crossing the legendary Sour Diesel with Pineapple Kush, her buds are dense and frosty with beautiful green and purple hues. With sour and gassy notes, and subtle hints of fruit, this indica-dominant flower boast the potency and flavours that will surely impress. Dominant terpenes include Limonene, Caryophyllene, and Farnesene. Grown in organic living soil, hang dried, hand trimmed, and cold cured to perfection.

variants.title: Peach High-Alive Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Peach High-Alive is a sensational blend of five fruit flavours from another Fruit classic, now in Trippy Sips Infused Pre-Rolls! Enjoy the taste of fresh peaches, passionfruit, and a tangy citrus mix blended into whole flower, then mill-infused with high potency THC distillate, and kief-coated for an extra kick on your tasty trip.

variants.title: White Hot Guava
variants.body_html: The legends at Sitka are stoked to introduce their White Hot Guava, an indica dominant marvel crafted from the fusion of Guava Gelato and White Fire OG. Renowned for its unique flavour, boasting tropical fruity notes with hints of guava, citrus and earthy undertones. Users report feeling a relaxing euphoria with a sense of mental clarity from this epic cultivar! Sitka always hang dries and slow cures for an additional 3 weeks to ensure a next level craft experience!

variants.title: Dopezilla Space Pod 3-Stage 50 mm Grinder - Earth
variants.body_html: The Space Pod Grinder from Dopezilla is a durable 3-stage grinder. It has deep grooves in the lid for optimal grip, making it easier to tear and fluff your herb. The high-quality sifting screen filters your kief to the bottom chamber. Made from aluminum with extra sharp teeth, this 50mm grinder will get the job done and look good doing it. Each element is available in a different colour.

variants.title: Bodega Boyz Ceramic Tips Multipack 1 g
variants.body_html: Just the tips! Bodega Boys in-demand ceramic filters are flying solo. You've tried them, you love them, now it's time to snag a 20 pack. Now only are they reusable, they make your session sweet. Each tip is 9mm and perfect for a 1g joint.

variants.title: Bodega Boyz Unrefined Brown Paper Ceramix Tip Cones 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Bodega Boyz are ready to be stuffed. This 6 pack of mini cones are made from unbleached and unrefined brown rolling paper. These 80mm cones can hold up to 0.5g of flower, perfect for an afternoon stroll or a killer solo sesh. Each cone has a reusable ceramic filter inside, ensuring your hit is smooth and your cone is easy to hold onto.

variants.title: The Canna Czar Infused Blunt PR 1 x 2.1 g
variants.body_html: Soar presents The Canna Czar: a larger-than-life, 2.1g, specialty twax blunt. For the first time since its legacy debut, this masterfully handcrafted creation is brought to you in partnership with The Canna Czar. From the inside-out, it begins with a golden shatter snake encased within freshly ground flower, carefully wrapped in a slow-burning hemp blunt paper, coated with pure THC distillate, and generously hand-decorated in a premium-chilled kief crust. Accompanied by a natural hemp wick for lighting, to preserve flavour and integrity.

variants.title: Frosted Flyers Variety Pack Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Claybourne Frosted Flyers Infused Variety Pack features five different cultivars in one pack. These five pre-rolls are THCA diamond frosted, terpene enhanced with natural flavouring agents and infused with liquid diamonds. Looking for bold flavour and a potent experience? Look no further than Claybourne Frosted Flyers.

variants.title: Kool Cherry Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Trippy Sips' discreet, palm-sized all-in-one vapes are here! Our innovative crinkle straw mouthpiece cools the vapour to give you bigger, better pulls every time. And this vape is rechargeable so you can savour the 0.95g of high potency THC distillate with Kool Cherry's summertime cherry taste.

variants.title: Kool Grape Gulps Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Trippy Sips' 2g Gulps offer big flavour and big clouds in a discreet, palm-sized, all-in-one-vape. Our innovative crinkle straw mouthpiece cools the vapour to give you bigger, better pulls every time. And it's rechargeable so you'll have clouds for days with 2g of Trippy Sips' potent, but well balanced THC:CBG:CBD formulation. Enjoy the burst of delicious grapes in our Kool Grape flavour.

variants.title: Hash Wrap
variants.body_html: Rolled in what?!? Yes, you read that right. Nugz Hash Wrap Sativa! We did it! After going back to the lab, we were able to hand craft a beautiful 1g slab of hash and roll it around a glass filter tip. We then fill the "Hash Wrap" with 0.7 g of whole flowers that we mill to perfection. Hash and flower are the same strain, so you get your favourite flavours, with no paper taste! Hand packed and hand rolled... and at 1.7g, you might need a hand with this one!

variants.title: Michigan Melonz
variants.body_html: Michigan Melonz, a potent indica of Melon Cake x Pure Michigan, offers high THC levels, blending candy sweetness, melon, gas, and rubber flavours.

variants.title: Live Flower
variants.body_html: HER.B Live Flower features Space Panda, an authentic Oreoz x Oreoz indica. Grown in the heart of BC’s cannabis country, this certified organic bud thrives in living soil and is free from pesticides and irradiation. Space Panda is not just a flower, it's a crystalline marvel, heavily frosted with trichomes that sparkle. This unique curing process from living fresh frozen flowers preserves every delicate terpene and cannabinoid. Its flavour profile is a rich tapestry of earthy and sweet notes. HER.B Live Flower is a testament to sustainable cultivation and the art of cannabis refinement.

variants.title: Maui Wowie
variants.body_html: Just the mention of Maui Wowie, to some, brings back memories, to others, we only know it as the parent to some of the most potent sativas on the market today. Hints of spice and fruit poke through a herbaceous back note, giving this sativa a profile you can’t help but recognize.

variants.title: Hash Wrap
variants.body_html: Rolled in what?!? Yes, you read that right. Nugz Hash Wrap Indica! We did it! After going back to the lab, we were able to hand craft a beautiful 1g slab of hash and roll it around a glass filter tip. We then fill the "Hash Wrap" with 0.7 g of whole flowers that we mill to perfection. Hash and flower are the same strain, so you get your favourite flavours, with no paper taste! Hand packed and hand rolled... and at 1.7g, you might need a hand with this one!

variants.title: Captain Kush Rip Strips
variants.body_html: SHRED X Captain Kush Rip-Strip hash is a piece of botanical terpene-infused hash pressed flat and cut into 10 easy-to-use hash strips. For added flavour and potency in your roll or bowl, simply rip it and strip it. It has the distinctive gassy, floral Kush-like aromas of Captain Kush.

variants.title: Strawberry Jack liquid Live Resin Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Try the authentic fruity flavour of fresh frozen flower in the -ness Strawberry Jack Pure Live Resin Vape. This high potency sweet and fruity sativa brings hints of skunky lavender, berries and pepper.

variants.title: Grape Escape Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Introducing Litti's Grape Escape 510 cartridge. Immerse yourself in the rich and sweet flavour of grapes, now with added liquid diamonds.

variants.title: Commando
variants.body_html: Commando (Triple Sec x Cap's Frozen Lemons) introduces your palate to a vibrant carnival of flavours with potency. Picture this: a burst of citrus goodness, featuring zesty lemon undertones intertwined with the sweet and tangy notes of Triple Sec, creating a medley that dances on your taste buds. It's like a tropical vacation for your senses, courtesy of Commando by Capulator. The buds showcase a mesmerizing display of vivid green hues, highlighted by a generous coat of glistening trichomes. Our small-batch flower undergoes a meticulous process, beginning with hang-drying and precision hand-trimming. After careful curing, each batch is thoughtfully hand-packaged into our premium glass jars.

variants.title: Purple Rain
variants.body_html: Introducing Purple Rain, our latest elite craft offering. These big, juicy buds are a sight to behold, speckled with purple and green, and frosted with a potent layer of trichomes. Break up a bud, and you’ll be hit with an irresistible aroma that smells like a jar of citrus and mixed berries with dank, gassy undertones. With love from Scarborough.

variants.title: Tropicana Cookies
variants.body_html: Tropicana Cookies is the ultimate cannabis experience. This elite indica-dominant hybrid is a blend of GSC x Tangie 21. Expect a seriously satisfying sour citrus kick, followed by a subtly sweet, cookie-flavoured exhale that'll keep you coming back for more. When you break and light those buds, the aroma shifts from sweet earthy citrus to a smooth, tangy mint essence. Tropicana Cookies undergoes a meticulous process – slow-cured, hang-dried, and hand-trimmed. It's delivered to you with love, from Scarborough.

variants.title: Sunday Cruiser
variants.body_html: Stop and smell the flowers with this breezy indica. Sunday Cruiser is a cross of Pineapple God x Freshwater Taffy (Gusherz x Gelati). This potent strain delivers a complex aroma profile of spicy florals, layered with notes of sweet mint and a kick of gas from dominant terpenes myrcene, ocimene and linalool. The plant produces large buds with rich green and deep purple colours. BC bud, hand harvested, hang dried and hand finished.

variants.title: Orange Turp
variants.body_html: Orange Turp (Cap Junky x Cap's Frozen Oranges), our first sativa-dominant cultivar that we've brought to market, introduces your palate to a vibrant carnival of flavours with potency. Picture this: a burst of citrus goodness, featuring zesty orange undertones intertwined with a hint of frosty mint from the Cap Junky, creating a medley that dances on your taste buds. It's like a cool tropical vacation for your senses, courtesy of Coolio by Capulator. The buds showcase a mesmerizing display of vivid green hues, highlighted by a generous coat of glistening trichomes. Our small-batch flower undergoes a meticulous process, beginning with hang-drying and precision hand-trimming. After careful curing, each batch is thoughtfully hand-packaged into our premium glass jars.

variants.title: Fun Trip
variants.body_html: Blast into the past with Fun Trip, milled whole flower assortment that's bursting with flavour. Perfect for any occasion, each puff is a journey back to carefree days, letting you rip and dip your worries away. Always made from premium, handcrafted whole flower, in a pack of pre-rolls that are always curated to deliver high quality flower in an easy-to-use pack. Includes a scoop for easy use!

variants.title: Rotating Hybrid
variants.body_html: Embark on an unparalleled cannabis journey with Snicklefritz. Pure hybrid goodness in a rotating assortment of fresh strains. Snicklefritz will keep these rotating hybrid cultivars new and fresh with an updated menu showing all the new drops!

variants.title: Orange THC Gummies
variants.body_html:
Emprise's Rapid Onset Orange 10 mg THC Sativa Gummy is a THC-dominant formulation that is active in 8-12 minutes using Emprise's Advanced Nano THC Technology. Each Gummy delivers The Maximum Potency allowed of 10 mg THC. The product is formulated with Full Spectrum THC Cannabis Extract, Delicious Orange flavour with a Sativa terpene profile. Vegan, Natural, Rapid Onset.
Each Package contains 1 x 10 mg THC Gummies. Terpenes: d-limonene, beta-caryophyllene, Myrcene.

variants.title: Funk Master
variants.body_html: Discover the medley to Funky town. We've captured the essence of real dank nugs with skunky, gas and earthy aromas that bring the funk. A combination of sweet skunk, funky cheese and pungent diesel notes, get down and get dank with Funk Master.

variants.title: All Purpose Flower Sativa
variants.body_html: All Purpose Flower (Sativa) is a blended product of sativa-dominant whole buds with pungent aromas, packaged in a large format 28g pouch. The hybrid greenhouse grown flower has a terpene profile of beta-caryophyllene, bisabolol, and terpinolene.

variants.title: Sonic Lemon Fuel
variants.body_html: Prepare for lift-off with an out-of-this-world, sonic boom of a strain: Sonic Lemon Fuel. As the name suggests, you'll experience high-flying hits of lemon and skunk and gas (oh my!), leaving your senses invigorated -- yet wanting more. Its fire-like red hairs and signature terps like Limonene, Terpinolene, and beta-Ocimene ignite this strain to new heights! These sound-barrier breaking buds pack a powerful punch, thanks to its diesel-descending lineage. Take it for a spin and find out for yourself.

variants.title: Pulsar Herbal Chef Electric Butter Infuser
variants.body_html: The Herbal Chef Electric Butter Infuser works with butter, oil or tinctures! Easy to use, you can have epic infusions in as little as a half hour. Equipped with a digital readout, push-button controls and preset infusion modes, it's perfect for everyone from amateurs to connoisseurs. There’s an overheat/dry safety shutoff to prevent disasters and it's super simple to clean. This device uses 5 cups (1.6L) for infusions and has a time range of 30 minutes to 12 hours depending on what you're infusing.

variants.title: Cipher Nautilus Dry Herb Vaporizer – Redheart Wood
variants.body_html:
Old-school charm meets cutting-edge performance in the Cipher Nautilus – Redheart Wood Edition. This standout dry herb vaporizer blends the classic aesthetic of a traditional pipe with the modern power and precision you expect from Cipher. Now crafted in rich Redheart wood, the Nautilus turns every session into a statement—warm, timeless, and unmistakably premium.
With an ultra-responsive OLED screen, you can easily adjust your temperature, monitor session time, and check battery life at a glance. It heats up in just 30 seconds, charges fully in 1 hour, and is powered by a robust 1200mAh battery—designed to last all day. Its deep ceramic chamber ensures clean, flavour-rich hits every time. And for those who like to elevate their ritual, the optional Churchwarden Stem Kit (sold separately) adds a touch of elegance to your sesh.

Key Features & Benefits
Premium Redheart Wood Finish – Classic, handcrafted look with natural wood grain.
1200mAh Battery – Long-lasting power for extended sessions.
Fast Performance – 30-second heat-up time, 1-hour full recharge.
OLED Display – View battery life, temp settings, session timer & more.
Precise Temp Control – Customize your experience down to the degree.
Deep Ceramic Chamber – Delivers clean, consistent, and flavourful draws.
Churchwarden Stem Compatible – Add-on stem (sold separately) for a refined, cool-draw experience.

Vintage style. High-tech soul. The Nautilus – Redheart Wood Edition is more than a vape—it's a ritual.

variants.title: Pulsar Dabtron - Blue
variants.body_html: The Dabtron eRig is super simple to use and gives you heavy hits. Take it on the go with its 2000 mAh battery and use it all day. It gives you 4 preset temperatures and preheats in 20 seconds. The glass mouthpiece, downstem and base as well as coil-less quartz atomizer are all easy to clean and contribute to fantastically flavourful sessions. Epic airflow is achieved whether you’re using hands-on or hands-free mode. Charge up this big battery with a USB-C charger (included in the box).

variants.title: Irie Rolls PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: When it comes to enjoying a premium smoking experience without breaking the bank, Irie’s Apple Fritter pre-rolls stand out as an exceptional choice. Packaged conveniently in a 10-pack of 0.5 grams each, these pre-rolls offer a phenomenal value for those seeking both quality and quantity. variants.title: Honeystick Interactive Battery - Rainbow
variants.body_html: The Interactive Battery from HoneyStick is a sleek draw-activated 510 cart pen. Your cart comes to life with each draw and shows stats on the interactive hi-res screen. You'll find voltage, battery life and current operations like the 15 second preheat. When you want to use the preheat function click the button twice quickly and the screen will display a blinking red rocket and 1.8V. If you want to use one of the preset temperatures click 3 times to bop between 2.8V, 3.4V and 3.8V (this will show on the screen as well as the coloured band at the base). This fits carts up to 3ml! However, only cartridges with bottom base airflow holes will work. The 650 mAh battery will last for a while and it can be charged through the USB-C port (charger not included).

Cannabis historian Ben Kaplan tells the story of the the dealers, stealers and rebels who made and lost money in the big cannabis boom. He'll spark your interest with Trudeau's legalization ploy, Canopy founder Bruce Linton's $22 billion buzz and the lawyers who helped turn weed gummies into gold. In the words of Michael Chabon "..Catch a Fire left me shaking with laughter - when I wasn't shaking my head in dismay.

There is a 10 second timer to prevent overheating, so if you’d like a larger hit make sure to pause during your hit. With this device you can vape out of a jar or off of your dab tool for a true nectar collector experience. You can also preheat your unit by drawing, melt a little bit of extract roughly the size of a rice grain onto the coils and draw again – this is ideal for those monitoring their doses. This pen-sized device is perfect for beginners or experts.

variants.title: Strawberry Kiwi THC:CBG Gummies
variants.body_html: Strawberry Kiwi Soft Chews are sweet on the inside and sour-coated on the outside, with 10mg of THC and 10mg of CBG. Enjoy this iconic flavour duo: strawberry + kiwi, in the most delicious way yet.

variants.title: Two Pack: Orange Zushi & White Stank
variants.body_html: Two unique strains served up in our signature orange pouch. Up first is Orange Zushi. Orange Zushi is a cross of Zktlz x Kush Mints #11 and was selected for it’s balance of gas, fruit and just the right amount of cake. Up next is White Stank. Bred by Elev8, White Stank is a cross of GMO x White Truffle. With this stinker, expect dense buds that deliver an unforgettable funky gas.

variants.title: Neon Lambo
variants.body_html: This hand picked phenotype was selected for its high octane aromas and high THC potential. A cross of Gas Face x Rockstar, Neon Lambo delivers a pungent gassy profile, balanced by a smooth and sweet creamy finish from dominant terpenes caryophyllene, myrcene and linalool. The plant produces massive buds featuring flecks of deep purple. BC bud, hand harvested, hang dried and hand finished.

variants.title: Blue Dream Diamond Encrusted Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Claybourne Frosted Flyers Infused Blue Dream pre-rolls are THCa diamond frosted, terpene enhanced and infused with liquid diamonds. These pre-rolls are sativa dominant. Looking for bold flavour and potency? Look no further than Claybourne Frosted Flyers.

variants.title: Goldberry Pals PR 10 x 0.4 g
variants.body_html: Embark on a tantalizing taste voyage with Palmetto Goldberry. Picture this: the luscious sweetness of blueberry colliding with the quirky allure of skunk in a flavour paradise that'll make you feel like you've been hit with the warm rays of taste sensations. Crafted from the legendary lineage of Pot of Gold and Blueberry, this cultivar is your golden ticket to flavour riches beyond imagination. With dominant terpenes of Myrcene, Limonene, and Caryophyllene, hoist your flavour sails and set course for Palmetto Goldberry.

variants.title: Hawaiian Snow PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Hawaiian Snow is an up-and-coming sativa-dominant cultivar created by crossing Hawaiian Haze and Purple Haze. It has dense buds coated with a frosty layer of trichomes, giving it a sparkling appearance. The aroma is characterized by a combination of tropical and citrus notes, with hints of pine and earthiness while the flavour can be sweet and fruit, with a touch of spice on the exhale. Dominant terpenes include Caryophyllene, Myrcene, and Limonene.

variants.title: Chemical Romance PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Chemical Romance was made by lovingly crossing a Chem Brulee female with a Love Potion #9 male. The incredibly flavourful result produced a nose smitten with a powerful sour citrus and poetic floral undertones. Chemical Romance Pre-Rolls flavours populate your palette, with terpenes dominant in Beta-Caryophyllene, Selinadienes, and Terpinene.

variants.title: Diamond Handz - Baja Banger Diamond Infused PR 3 x 0.45 g
variants.body_html: The Baja Banger Diamond Handz double infused pre-rolls contain a liquid diamond and distillate infusion with a sticky spray of zesty lime and tangy lemon.

variants.title: Tropical Clouds Distillate Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Live your life in the sky. Tropical Clouds is sweet and tangy with big waves of guava. This flavourful sativa comes lifts off in the daytime at 36-40% THC. These ultra potent pre-rolls are made by taking our sun grown bud, milling it to perfection and infusing it with distillate and botanical terpenes. Take your taste buds on a tropical vacation, with Cabana Cannabis Infused Pre-Rolls.

variants.title: Pear Herer Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: BOXHOT presents Pear Herer, a sativa 510 vape with some of the purest cannabis distillate available on the market. It has a juicy blend of pear and apple complemented by a tropical splash. All BOXHOT vapes are made with exclusive, oversized hardware, making them optimal for big, full hits. Best of all, BOXHOT vapes are produced using industry-leading CO2 extraction and refining processes and feature a blend of expertly infused terpenes.

variants.title: Grand Daddy Purps
variants.body_html: With grape power comes grape responsibility. Thankfully that responsibility is crushing some Grand Daddy Purps, a potent indica with high THC and grape and berry aromas. The dominant terpenes are caryophyllene, pinene and humulene. You’ll want to cosplay as a grape jelly sandwich after you’ve laid eyes on this sweet frosty purple treat that’s dappled in orange hairs. Complex aromas and compact buds await from this popular indica cross of Mendo Purps x Skunk x Afghanistan. You down with GDP? Good.

variants.title: Headbanger
variants.body_html: Headbanger craft cannabis is a carefully grown and cured sativa-dominant hybrid sourced from a cross between Sour Diesel x Biker Kush. Lovingly cultivated in small batches in southeastern BC, our Headbanger flower boasts a dense bud structure and produces a signature sour aroma that is sure to please your senses. Our flower is hand-trimmed and slow-cured to perfection, ensuring a consistent and pleasurable smoking experience every time.

variants.title: Sweet Berry Kush
variants.body_html: Ready to meet the very berry kush of your dreams? Good, because it’s love at first sight with Sweet Berry Kush. Unveil the big berry and citrus sweet aromas underpinned with the slight diesel and earthiness of this fruity indica beauty. With a dense, tight bud structure and frosted like a wedding cake, you’ll want it to be death till you part. Vibrant green buds speckled with burnt orange pistils, this kush boldly walks down the aisle with a dominant terpene profile of limonene, pinene, beta-Caryophyllene and Trans-ocimene. Borne from a cross between Banana OG x Purple Punch, this is one bouquet you’ll never want to throw away.

variants.title: Watermelon G-Bear Distillate Infused PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: XPLOR your wild side with Watermelon G-Bear Distillate Infused Pre-rolls. Each draw provides a reminiscent sweet watermelon gummy taste. Now boosted in potency!

variants.title: Honeydew Lime Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Juicy honeydew and tangy lime provide an instant burst of freshness. Like all Lamplighter vapes, this is double distilled, hand filled and in premium tech. Flares by Lamplighter, a blend of natural flavours and high quality distillate in a premium cart.

variants.title: Pink Lemon Shatter Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Zest Cannabis Pre-Rolls are a combustion of flavour & potency, made from AAA+ grade flower, and high quality BHO/Isolate extracts. Our Pink Lemon Shatter Infused Pre-rolls is all crafted with thoughtfully milled flower, blended with extracts for a juicy combo of 34-40% THC and aromatics for a mind-bending experience.

variants.title: Snow Cherry OG
variants.body_html: Chill out with Snow Cherry OG, an earthy, grassy and extra funky cross of Cherry Cookies x The White. Making a grand entrance, the dense, oversized buds are drenched in an avalanche of sticky and aromatic trichomes. The cherry on top? These brilliant buds boast very high THC potency. Meticulously grown, carefully hang dried and hand trimmed for a frost-covered expression of Snow Cherry OG.

variants.title: Fire OG Rosin Infused PR 1 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Take a trip down memory lane with this classic indica hybrid. Crossing the well-known SFV OG Kush with OG Kush, our new BC Organic Fire OG is an ode to the legacy market. Bringing the gassy and Kush vibes, it boasts dense sticky buds with green hues and orange pistils. Grown in organic living soil, hang dried and hand trimmed, our flower is then mixed with rosin and expertly packed in our hemp cones.

variants.title: Ongrok Toothless 5 Piece Grinder - Black
variants.body_html: Ongrok's 5-piece toothless herb grinder is made from aircraft grade aluminum. A floral pattern on the interior replaces typical teeth for a uniquely fine grind. Its built-in storage jar is dangerously deep and is sealed with an airtight lid for optimal freshness. Utilizing a quarter turn locking function makes it a breeze to open and use, while a super strong magnet holds the other levels in place. Cleaning is a breeze with the removable screen, just lift the handle and turn counter clockwise to detach.

variants.title: Relief Cherry Cola THC:CBC:CBG Gummies
variants.body_html: A soothing splash of cherry cola flavour compliments 5mg each of THC, CBG, and CBC per gummy in this thoughtfully curated formulation. Made with a gluten-free and vegan recipe – these melt-proof gummies are made using a culinary innovation by Azuca Time Infusion TM and may result in a quicker onset time.

variants.title: Buddies

variants.title: Bubble Bath
variants.body_html: Bubble Bath is full of gas and pine and brings citrus nose to the plate in this caked cultivar that looks like it just got out of the suds. Light some candles and bring your rubber duck because Bubble Bath is potent, flavourful and uniquely special.

variants.title: Strawberry Sorbet THC:CBD:CBG Gummies
variants.body_html: Sweeten any experience with these perfectly balanced gummies, each containing 2mg each of THC, CBD, and CBG. These gummies are designed with THC and powered by CBD and CBG. Made with plant-based pectin, not gelatin – these melt-proof gummies are made using a culinary innovation by Azuca Time Infusion TM and may result in a quicker onset time.

variants.title: Animal Rntz Redees Blunts 4 x 0.4 g
variants.body_html: Animal RNTZ Redees Bluntees are ready to run wild. This ferociously fruity Animal Cookies x RNTZ cross comes correct with high THC and is elevated to a higher level with hemp-based blunt wraps and patented filter tips for a lush smoking experience. This indica’s unbridled sour tartness and intense sweet fruit flavours offer a luxuriously indulgent smoke that’s a feast for the senses. Inside Bluntees is meticulously grown flower that’s carefully hang-dried, ground and perfectly rolled for a satisfyingly slow burn and smooth airflow in personalized packs.

variants.title: Indica PR 4 x 0.5 g

variants.title: D. Burger Joints 14 x 0.5 g

variants.body_html: A pack of classic cone-style pre-rolls stuffed with D. Burger (aka Donny Burger). A deliciously savoury, pungent and gassy indica with flavours of barbecue, grilled cheese and dark garlic.

variants.title: Captain Kush Dartz PR 10 x 0.4 g
variants.body_html: SHRED's Dartz, tube-style pre-rolls crafted with organic hemp paper. Featuring Captain Kush, SHRED's inaugural indica blend.

variants.title: Purple Churro Redees Hemp'd PR 10 x 0.4 g
variants.body_html: Get fried with the indulgent desserty flavour of Purple Churro Redees Hemp’d. Bursting with vibrant vanilla and sweet cinnamon, indulge your sativa sweet tooth with this Cinnamon Horchata x Apples & Bananas cross in our smooth-smoking hemp-wrapped Redees. Enjoy the high THC potency in our signature straight-cut, hemp-wrapped pre-rolls containing no shake or stems, just meticulously grown flower that’s carefully hang dried, ground and perfectly rolled for an unforgettable smoking experience. Puff pastries takes on a whole new meaning with Purple Churro Redees Hemp’d.

variants.title: Purple Churro Redees Blunts 4 x 0.4 g
variants.body_html: Purple Churro Redees Bluntees are dessert on a higher level. We’ve elevated the vibrant vanilla and sweet cinnamon flavours of this Cinnamon Horchata x Apples & Bananas cross with a hemp-based blunt wrap and patented filter tips for a bold smoking experience. Indulge your sweet tooth with the satisfying slow burn and smooth smoke of this sativa with high THC. Inside Bluntees is meticulously grown flower that’s carefully hang-dried, ground and perfectly rolled for smooth airflow and rich taste in a personalized packs.

variants.title: Red Hawaiian Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: XPLOR a potent flavour blast, Red Hawaiian 1g Disposable Vape is an enticing blend of fruit flavours. Combined with potent THC extract in a high-grade disposable vape to provide both novice and experienced consumers something new to explore.

variants.title: Lemon Linx Resin AIO Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: So many of us have been caught in this perilous situation before. You got a smoke, but no lighter? If only there was an all-in-one solution... Well, now there is! Introducing Nugz Lemon Linx All-in-one Resin Vape. 1g of our Lemon Linx cured resin + distillate and botanical terpenes, paired with innovative rechargeable vape hardware to ensure a flavour-packed inhale from first pull to the last drop! Draw is activated, so there are no buttons to push; unless you want to increase the power, you can press and hold the Turbo button for fuller clouds. Ceramic heating element, USB-C rechargeable, and ready to go right out of the box. Nugz Lemon Linx All-in-one Resin Vape. All you need is one.

variants.title: Caribbean Crush AIO Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Trippy Sips’ all-in-one disposable vapes are here. These discreet vapes feature our innovative crinkle straw mouthpiece, designed for bigger, better pulls, and classic flavours such as the pineapple and mango tropical fruit blend of Caribbean Crush.

variants.title: Alien Limeade Distillate Infused PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: XPLOR your wild side with Alien Limeade Distillate Infused Pre-rolls. Each draw provides a sour explosion of lemon and lime. Now boosted in potency!

variants.title: Early Lemon Berry Shatter
variants.body_html: Introducing Nugz Early Lemon Berry Shatter! Nugz Shatter is made from in-house grown cured cannabis, extracted with butane, and purged in a vac-oven. The resulting product is fully de-gassed, shelf stable, and snaps when forced. One of the most easy-to-use formats available, Nugz shatter pairs well with a dab rig, bowl-topper, or pre-roll infusion.

variants.title: Fully Blasted Peach Orange 1:1 THC|CBD Gummy
variants.body_html: Prepare for blast off! SOURZ by Spinach Fully Blasted Peach Orange 1:1 CBD | THC gummies are action-packed with a balanced blend of 10mg THC and 10mg CBD per piece. Glide through the galaxy with sweet peach and juicy orange flavours! This dual-flavoured gummy is over-the-top with natural flavours and blasted with sour crystals. Enjoy 1 gummy per pack, 10mg THC total and 10mg CBD total.

variants.title: Hard Hitters Cloudberry Liquid Diamond Dispenser
variants.body_html: This Liquid Diamond Dispenser from Endgame is a game-changer. THC Diamonds mixed with terp blends to deliver some of our hardest-hitting dispensers to date. Cloudberry is a tangy/berry blend of some of our favorite exotic terps - a guaranteed banger, flavour sensation with some of our highest THC% to date.

variants.title: Cuban Linx Shatter
variants.body_html: Get ready for a flavour blast with Nugz Shatter - crispy, golden, and absolutely irresistible! We start with our premium homegrown OG Sativa Cuban Linx and use BHO to extract all the rich cannabinoids and terpenes. The result is high-potency golden slabs of shatter with a refreshing citrusy lemon aroma that adds a vibrant twist to your sesh!

variants.title: Jolts Arctic Cherry Lozenge Hard Candy
variants.body_html: A 10 mg THC lozenge that is now available in an arctic cherry flavour. These slow dissolving sublingual lozenges are made without animal products. For optimal sublingual/buccal absorption, suck lozenge for about 15 seconds, then hold under tongue or between cheek and gum until fully dissolved.

variants.title: Roil Lemon Haze Shatter
variants.body_html: Roilty Roil Lemon Haze Shatter (76-82% THC) is 1G of our highest potency BHO concentrate. This sativa strain has a citrusy, sweet aroma, with myrcene and limonene terpenes leading the charge to leave you feeling like royalty!

variants.title: Cement Shoes Diamond Dusted Hash
variants.body_html: Cement Shoes Diamond Dusted Hash Balls are the ultimate fusion of two powerhouse cannabis products: diamonds and hash. With Cement Shoes, you get the best of both worlds - the potent effects of diamonds and the rich flavor of hash - all rolled into one heavy-hitting experience.

variants.title: Fully Blasted Strawberry Mango Gummy
variants.body_html: Prepare for blast off! SOURZ by Spinach Fully Blasted Strawberry Mango gummies are action-packed with 10mg THC per piece. Bring on thundering bursts of flavour with luscious strawberry and tropical mango! This dual-flavoured gummy is over-the-top with natural flavours and blasted with sour crystals. Enjoy 1 gummy per pack, 10mg THC total.

variants.title: Mango Kush
variants.body_html: Transport yourself to a tropical paradise with Encore's Mango Kush. This hybrid dried flower boasts a delightful blend of mango and earthy undertones. Crafted with care and precision, Mango Kush is the perfect choice for both novice and seasoned cannabis enthusiasts alike.

variants.title: Cocolicious Liquid Diamonds Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Introducing Cocolicious, an indulgent vape that’s incredibly smooth. With every puff, you’ll be treated to a sweet, gassy, and earthy aroma and taste that lingers like a sweet caramel drizzle. Cocolicious is your go-to for a rich and satisfying vape experience. With love from Scarborough.

variants.title: Baby Jeeter Apples and Bananas Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Apples and Bananas is a multi-layered hybrid that embodies a balance of flavours. This strain combines the sweet and fruity essence of apples with the creaminess of bananas, complemented by subtle undertones of black pepper, creating a unique taste profile.

variants.title: Baby Jeeter Peaches Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Peaches is an indica crafted by crossing Marionberry with Eddy OG, resulting in a unique and flavourful strain. This strain captivates the senses with its aroma, offering a sweet, slightly tangy peach essence in every inhale. Complementing the fruity notes is a subtle undertone of floral spice which adds complexity to the taste profile.

variants.title: Frosted Flyers Banana OG Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Claybourne Frosted Flyers Infused Banana OG pre-rolls are THCa diamond frosted, terpene enhanced and infused with liquid diamonds. These pre-rolls are indica dominant. Looking for bold flavour and potency? Look no further than Claybourne Frosted Flyers.

variants.title: Yellow Topaz Live Rosin Chamomile Petal Infused PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: The yellow topaz crystal is believed to promote harmony and balance, both within oneself and in relationships with others. It fosters inner peace, happiness, and empathy, while also enhancing communication skills and mental clarity. The energy of this stone helps individuals deepen their sense of unity and connection with those around them. Immerse yourself in the delicate flavours and aromas of chamomile petal cones and our terpene blend Mango Honey Bliss.

variants.title: Strawberry Watermelon 4:1 CBG:THC Gummies
variants.body_html: Sink your teeth into a juicy combination of strawberry and refreshing watermelon flavours with SOURZ by Spinach Strawberry Watermelon 4:1 CBG|THC gummies. With 8 mg CBG and 2 mg THC per gummy, chill out and immerse yourself in a happy and relaxed high. These dual- flavoured gummies blasted with sour crystals are over-the-top with natural flavours. Enjoy 5 gummies per pack and 40 mg CBG total and 10 mg THC total.

variants.title: Strawberry Snowstorm Diamond Dusted Resin Infused PR 2 x 0.75 g
variants.body_html: Get swept away this holiday season with our Dab Bods Strawberry Snowstorm Diamond Dusted Resin Infused Pre-Rolls. Featuring the strain Strawberry Cough, our classic Resin Infused Pre-Roll filled with our signature resin and cannabis terpenes you have come to love is jazzed up with a coating of diamonds for this festive season! Get them while you can because unlike a Canadian winter, these won't last for forever!

variants.title: Tropical Clouds Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html:
Live your life in the sky. Tropical Clouds is sweet and tangy with big waves of guava. This flavourful sativa comes lifts off in the daytime at 88-94% THC.

We're making waves with our triple distilled distillate infused with botanical terpenes. Wicked big flavour and ultra high potency make this 510 cart total paradise.

variants.title: Prickly Pear Liquid Diamonds Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Desert meets dessert with this potent Pricky Pear Liquid Diamonds vape. Expect a sweet and fruity flavor that's accented by a touch of black pepper spice and fresh sugared lemon. Derived from Liquid Diamonds and Live Resin, this vape cartridge has extremely high potency above 90% and a full spectrum flavour that is true to the original cross of Chitral Kush x OGKB x Ocean Haze. The unique terpene profile offers a calming and creative experience, ready for your next adventure.

variants.title: Little Dipper Concentrate Vape Pen-Purple
variants.body_html: The little dipper is a super cool dab straw. Using Dip Device's signature technology, it makes it easier to directly consume your concentrates. You can even dip the tip right into your container! It heats up quickly and features three settings for perfect precision. You can preserve flavour or go right to big hits easily. The large 650mAh battery lasts a long time and is easily charged with a micro-USB charger. Each hit is super smooth from the epic air flow and the device is super simple to clean.

variants.body_html: The little dipper is a super cool dab straw. Using Dip Device's signature technology, it makes it easier to directly consume your concentrates.
