variants.title: HoneyStick Trigon Variable Voltage Battery Multi
variants.body_html: The Honeystick Trigon Battery has solid construction and a sleek design. Forget about your vape rolling away from you with the unique triangular shape. The 500 mAh battery provides a long-lasting charge and easily threads onto your 510 carts. Switch between 4 optimal temperatures for a satisfyingly smooth session or use the preheat function for an extra heavy hit. Power up either by twisting your charger onto the device or enjoy pass-through charging so you can keep puffing.

variants.title: Pax Plus Dual-Use Vaporizer - Onyx
variants.body_html: Pax Plus is a dual-use vaporizer so you can enjoy extracts and dry herbs. A sleek and modern vape, its slim body can easily fit into a bag or pocket for on-the-go discreet use. New experience modes allow you to customize your session with Stealth, Efficiency, Flavour and Boost modes. Each offering a unique session. Different (included) oven lids also let you tailor the session to your preference. The new 3D oven screen is easy to remove, and a multi-tool and brush help keep your device clean and working efficiently and effectively. Keep your oven sealed with the magnetic lid closure. The battery should last roughly 2 hours.

variants.title: Cabana Cannabis Co. 3-Stage Grinder Parasol Green
variants.body_html: Grind in style with Cabana Cannabis Co. grinders. Made from aluminum, this iconic 50mm grinder is durable and easy to use. Incredibly sharp diamond-cut teeth tear and fluff your herb to perfection. Once ground enough, flower falls into the center holding section. The sifting screen then goes to work filtering your most post bits to the bottom for a special surprise. This green grinder has a dangerously dope parasol design on the top and comes packaged in its own box.

variants.title: Shatterizer Vaporizer - Silver Top
variants.body_html: The Shatterizer vaporizer is designed in Canada. Perfect for concentrates and extracts, its modern look and sleek design deliver satisfyingly smooth hits. Its aluminum globe is durable and lets the vapor cool down before you draw. Stay powered up for roughly 40 hours with a 2-hour charge. Switch between 3 optimal preset temperatures so you get the hit you want, every time. There is also a 15 second continuous heat option for those that want to go big. For beginners and connoisseurs alike, the Shatterizer is top notch.

variants.title: I.C.C.
variants.body_html: Our Ice Cream Cake maintains that dank, earthy sweetness every cake-lover expects from this indica-dominant, cookies-based varietal with a twist. The onset of germacrene-B in our terps gives this cake a matcha-like quality. Expect chai spice to start, followed by sage, clove and astringent simple syrup once you break open these evergreen, trichome-rich buds.

variants.title: Peach Passionfruit 1:1:1 CBN:CBD:THC Gummies
variants.body_html: Dive into luscious peach and exotic passionfruit flavours with SOURZ by Spinach Peach Passionfruit 1:1:1 CBN | CBD | THC gummies. With a balanced ratio of 2 mg CBN, 2 mg CBD, and 2 mg THC per gummy, unwind and immerse yourself in a mellow and dreamy high. These dual- flavoured gummies blasted with sour crystals are over-the-top with natural flavours. Enjoy 5 gummies per pack and 10 mg CBN, 10 mg CBD, and 10 mg THC total.

variants.title: Gorilla Berry
variants.body_html: Tweed Gorilla Berry is an indica strain with high THC and minimal amounts of CBD. Its citrus, berry and gas flavour notes derive from its Frosted Kush x Gorilla and TKBx1 x Blueberry lineage

variants.title: Cement Shoes Diamond Dusted Hash
variants.body_html: Cement Shoes Diamond Dusted Hash balls are the ultimate fusion of two powerhouse cannabis products: diamonds and hash. With Cement Shoes, you get the best of both worlds – the potent effects of diamonds and the rich flavour of hash – all rolled into one potent experience.

variants.title: Two Pack: Orange Zushi & White Stank PR 6 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Two unique strains served up in our signature orange pouch. Up first is Orange Zushi. Orange Zushi is a cross of Zktlz x Kush Mints #11 and was selected for it’s balance of gas, fruit and just the right amount of cake. Up next is White Stank. Bred by Elev8, White Stank is a cross of GMO x White Truffle. With this stinker, expect dense buds that deliver an unforgettable funky gas.

variants.title: High Heat
variants.body_html: Pheno hunted in-house, High Heat is a cross of Bubba Octane x Seed Junky OG. High Heat was selected for its potent Kush aroma, backed by distinctive notes of gas and lemon-lime. Upon opening your bag, you'll be greeted by bright green buds that are not only dense but also generously sugar-coated.

variants.title: SLUMPZ
variants.body_html: The ultimate power flower designed to elevate your cannabis game. Crafted with precision, these potent indica single strains made from whole flower for a next-level experience.

variants.title: Fire Breath
variants.body_html: Turn up the heat with Back Forty's legendary cultivar – Fire Breath. A cross between Fire OG x Mendo Breath, this potent indica produces dense buds loaded with trichomes, offering pungent notes of fresh earth, woody spice, and a hint of diesel. Our Back Forty flower is always hang-dried, dry-trimmed, and includes a humidity pack.

variants.title: Purple Monkey Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: You'll go ape for smooth, sweet grape in a hard hitting, potent THC distillate. 100% plant-based terpenes, no monkeying around. Good Vapes from Good Supply.

variants.title: Gorilla Berry
variants.body_html: Tweed Gorilla Berry is an indica strain with high THC and minimal amounts of CBD. Its citrus, berry and gas flavour notes derive from its Frosted Kush x Gorilla and TKBx1 x Blueberry lineage

variants.title: Blackberry Breath PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: This heavily indica-dominant cultivar is well-known and well loved for both its potency and its intense flavours of sweet, earthy cherry, and woodiness. With dominant terpenes of Bisabolol, Caryophyllene, and Linalool, this variety consistently hits high-THC levels. This Blackberry Breath flower was expertly grown in the heart of BC and was hang-dried, hand-trimmed, and cured to perfection.

variants.title: 95+ Blueberry Bronco Liquid Diamonds Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Not your first Rodeo? Giddy-up and go with Wild West's line up of 95+ vapes. Blueberry Bronco brings the ripe and tangy sweetness of fresh summer berries.

variants.title: Glitter Bomb Distillate Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Like glitter, this one will stick with you! Glitter Bomb Infused Pre-Rolls bring peach & raspberry cotton candy. Add some glitz & glam to your life with Glitter Bomb. Now ultra-potent with 36-40% THC!

variants.title: Jungle Fumes
variants.body_html: Stop and smell the Jungle Fumes! These dense, jungle-coloured buds are packed with diesel and chem flavours. The parent strains of Sour Diesel x Chemdawg x Lemon OG create a sativa-dominant strain that comes with a heavy diesel aroma upfront, chem undertones, and notes of tropical fruits. Dominant terpenes include Limonene, Caryophyllene, and Myrcene. FIGR dried flower products are hand selected to ensure dense, high-quality buds are in every package.

variants.title: Fatty Patty - Chocolate Covered Peppermint Fatty
variants.body_html: No Future Peppermint Fatty is cool with a rich chocolate coating over a creamy and sweet patty of peppermint.

variants.title: Rockstar
variants.body_html: Popular with BC growers in pre-legal times, Rock Star is a cross of Sensi Star x Rockbud, Often chosen for its potent indica effects, resinous buds and strong skunk lineage, the sweetly pungent scent will grab your attention delivering a similar flavour with a gassy oily essence. The bouncy olive green buds are medium in size with a generous covering of orange hair.

variants.title: Neon Sunshine Live Resin FSE
variants.body_html: Coming from legendary breader Exotic Genetics, Neon Sunshine (Zktlz x Falcon-9) is a mix of fruits and funk. Cherries, tropical fruits, and a strong layer of fuel make this strain a staple in any canna-enthusiasts rotation. Now available in a full-spectrum extract!

variants.title: Bubble Up Fresh Frozen Hash Rosin
variants.body_html: Pushing the envelope, that's what we're known for. Introducing Bubble Up, by Tribal. (The Zoap x Deluxe, Breeder Exotic Genetix) One of the most unique strains that we've brought to market. Nugz Fresh Frozen Hash Rosin (FFHR) is derived from our single source indoor-grown genetics, frozen at harvest to preserve the flowers’ natural terpene profile, flavours and aromas. Our FFHR is made by sieving frozen Bubble Up whole flowers through 159 µm to 73 µm wash bags in ice water to produce a bubble hash that is then pressed into a honey-like rosin. Best stored in the fridge and brought to room temperature 10 minutes before use.

variants.title: Melonade Liquid Diamond Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: DEBUNK Melonade liquid diamond vapes are a cross of Watermelon Zktlz and Lemon Tree with a smooth citrus and melon flavour. Our proprietary hydrocarbon extraction process converts THCa diamonds into an high purity and potent THC liquid diamond isolate that is then enhanced with a custom botanical terpene blend.

variants.title: Bubble Up Live Resin Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Pushing the envelope, that's what we're known for. Introducing Bubble Up, by Tribal. (The Zoap x Deluxe, Breeder Exotic Genetix) One of the most unique strains that we've brought to market. Extra sticky flowers, fresh, clean scent, and effects to remember. Bubble up is ready to scrub in! Tribal's Bubble Up Live Resin Vape cart delivers an elevated cannabinoid and terpene experience. We utilize a cryogenic extraction process that preserves the profile of the flower and offers above average terpene content, flavours, and effects thanks in part to our extraction process and premium Ascera cartridge components.

variants.title: Pink Rose #4 PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Pink Rose #4 is a potent pheno-type of the genetic cross of Lemonchello x Lemon Pound Cake. This potent indica-leaning hybrid has bright floral and fruity aromas with a sweet dry pull and earthy exhale. The buds are extremely frosty with shades of green, orange, and light pink. Fresh out of a pheno-hunt, Pink Rozay #4 expressed with the highest potency and terpene profile. Craft designated, hand-packed in hemp paper, and packaged in compostable tubes.

variants.title: Purple Zushi
variants.body_html: Purple Zushi is an aromatic and potent pheno-type of the iconic cross of Zktlz x Kush Mints #6. This exotic lineage has given rise to legendary variants such as Blue, Yellow and Pink Zushi. Our in-house pheno-hunt expressed hues of deep purples and intense berry notes, giving birth to our own unique expression; Purple Zushi. Expect sweet candy fruit flavours balanced by a fresh coolness for a complex and balanced taste. Craft designated and packaged in compostable jars.

variants.title: BC Organic Cement Shoes
variants.body_html: Sink into BC Organic Cement Shoes. Our new organic certified indica is born from the unique cross of OGKB x Animal Cookies x Wet Dream. These dense and resinous buds have sour, earthy and citrusy aromas. These buds are grown in our living soil, hang dried, hand trimmed, cold cured and non-irradiated.

variants.title: Space Cake
variants.body_html: Indoor grown craft cannabis. Bred specifically to deliver high THC & terps. Carefully crossed from GSC and Snow Lotus, Dank Craft Space Cake is high in terpenes and THC. It delivers a creamy flavour profile backed up by bright notes of fruit and berries.

variants.title: BC Organic Bridesmaid
variants.body_html: Our FVOPA organic certified BC Organic Bridesmaids is a sweet treat for the cake lovers. Her buds are frosty and dense, and ooze cakey goodness with a gassy finish. This Indica leaning Hybrid is a cross of the legendary Wedding Cake with Jealousy and is grown with care in organic living soil. These beautiful buds are hang-dried, hand-trimmed, and stored in a premium glass jar to ensure freshness.

variants.title: Gluerangutan
variants.body_html: Gluerangutan is some sticky island dank. So sticky that it often re-clumps after milling. It hits you like a truck with powerful diesel base aromas, followed by citrus zest overtones and a fresh mountain pine finish. The top cut from a 100,000+ pheno hunt, Gluerangutan is Ocean Grown next to the Salish Sea in Living Organic Soils, harvested by hand, and hang dried in small batches using artisanal slow-cure methods.

variants.title: Space Funk PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Space Funk, a cross between Eastside OG and Purple Jellato, stands as an indica dominant hybrid meticulously developed over a 15-month pheno-hunting process by our master grower. This particular phenotype boasts a blend of sweet, creamy and citrusy notes coupled with a gassy terpene profile. Discerning consumers can anticipate buds with distinct fuel flavours. Noteworthy features of our cultivation process include a two-week flushing period with 0 ppm filtered water, followed by careful hang drying, hand trimming and hand rolling. Our buds undergo a curing process of at least 120 days, during which each bud is meticulously prepared by removing middle stems before grinding, resulting in Dutch-crown pre-rolls packaged in recyclable materials.

variants.title: Hawaiian Fanta
variants.body_html: A Compound Genetics strain packing a sweet and fruity punch into a sour lemon candy taste. Enjoy these pungent, tangy flavours and smooth pineapple soda aromas. The bud structure is medium to slightly larger size buds of average density. Lighter green in colour with faint purple highlights, illuminated in trichomes. The flavour is sweet tropical fruit, with a sour tang finish, while the aroma has an uniquely similar nose and taste, bursting with a prominent pineapple zest and sweet aromatics of tropical fruit.

variants.title: Gas Collection
variants.body_html: The Gas Collection is a range of craft cannabis strains that come from various farms in British Columbia. Gas Cannabis refers to strains with exceptional potency, fuel, skunk or spicy terpene profiles, or visually appealing characteristics. In other words, they have unique aromas and flavours that set them apart from exotic cannabis strains. BC Weed Co. ensures our quality by using only hand crafted and finished cannabis, not using irradiation, nitro flushing and packing our cannabis consciously in cans.

variants.title: Rosin Infused PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Simply Bare's Organic Rosin Roll is here. A single strain flower- hash rosin combo packed perfectly into a pre roll. This high potency infused pre roll boasts intense flavours. Both the flower and rosin are from the same FVOPA certified organic strain, resulting in an extremely terp forward experience while smoking. This Rosin Roll starts with our sun grown flower, hand trimmed, milled then mixed carefully with our organic live rosin and finished off in organic hemp paper.

variants.title: MAC V2
variants.body_html: Find your new best bud. VOLO presents MACV2 from seed to shelf. This cultivar is brought to you by one of the most recognized breeders: Capulator Genetics. MACV2 is a cultivar crossing GSC, Alien Dawg, Starfighter and Columbian. This Cap’s Cut selected unicorn-phenotype produces potent terpenes and high THC.

variants.title: BC Organic Mango Cake PR 7 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Bred in-house, BC Organic Mango Cake is an exotic dessert cross of GOOD BUDS’ original Mango Taffie strain with Wedding Cake. It leads with classic Mango Taffie smells of juicy mango sweetness with a gassy afterburn, followed by with sweet vanilla frosting undertones from the Wedding Cake. The dry pull tastes like ripe mangoes and orange zest, with a creamy cake-dough mouthfeel on the exhale. Grown in small batches in Living Organic Soils, each batch of Mango Cake is hand harvested, hang dried, and slow cured following artisanal legacy methods. Rolled in unbleached cones, Mango Cake Pre-rolls are hand-finished and hand packed into recyclable Ecolite Dube Tubes.

variants.title: Gold Cash Gold
variants.body_html: Oreoz 1.0, a dark black-purple diamond, brings forth a frosty, creamy, menthol gas aroma. Pure Michigan, born from Oreoz 1.0 and MendoBreath F2, offers legendary genetics. Together, they create a strain of unparalleled bag appeal and astonishing effects, captivating cannabis enthusiasts worldwide.

variants.title: Frosted Cream Puffs
variants.body_html: Dive into a baker's bowl of frosting, sweetness, and colours with this decadent and frosty flower. With crystal clear buds, and creamy flavours, Spinach Frosted Cream Puffs takes you on a delicious journey that thrills all your senses. With strain lineage from Snow Lotus & Girl Scout Cookies, this cultivar hits when it comes to looks, tastes, smells, and feels. Caked with stick-to-your-fingers trichomes, this cultivar is a delicious delight.

variants.title: Rotterdam
variants.body_html: Highly Dutch's Rotterdam Indica is an organic blend of high potency indica flower. Rich in terpenes with earthy, piney notes and sweet floral tones, each batch is heavy-hitting, full of aroma and flavour. Organically grown, Highly Dutch selects quality flowers that deliver a consistent potency and unique experience in every batch.

variants.title: Day & Night
variants.body_html: A dual pack ounce bag filled with 14 grams each of sativa and indica dried flower, for all your day and night time needs.

variants.title: Indica 20% Plus
variants.body_html: Presenting Weed Me's strain-specific, premium milled cannabis! This indica-dominant strain boasts a very strong THC potency potential, is milled for convenience and sealed in tinted glass jars with an Integra pack to preserve terps and flavours.

variants.title: Amsterdam
variants.body_html: Highly Dutch's Amsterdam Sativa is an organic blend of high potency sativa flower, packing sweet floral flavours with punchy aromas to compliment any occasion. Organically grown, Highly Dutch selects quality flowers that deliver a consistent potency and unique experience in every batch.

variants.title: Galactic Glue
variants.body_html: Already high in THC, Galactic Glue benefits further from the entourage effect with high b-myrcene, b-caryophyllene and pinene. This strain consistently delivers 3 - 5 % terpenes. Galactic Glue gives chunky, resin covered buds, and a pungent earthy-sour aroma.

variants.title: Monkey Butter
variants.body_html: This stuff is bananas. Monkey Butter is on the loose and someone should call animal control, because this indica is a beast with high THC. No, really though it's nutty with earth and woodsy aromas thanks to the dominant terpenes of beta-caryophyllene, cedrene and humulene. So quit your monkeying around and indulge in these compact light green buds with amber pistils that shimmer with milky trichomes. Because this cross of Gorilla Glue x Peanut Butter Breath means business. Monkey business.

variants.title: Wedding Cake
variants.body_html: A truly sought-after delicacy, Wedding Cake is known for its dense buds and frosty trichomes and are a delight for the senses. This strain has intense sweet, fruity, earthy, and spicy flavours with just a hint of vanilla. We've taken the best of the best and cultivated one delicious treat. Wedding cake is a cross between Triangle Mints, Kush Mints and White Tahoe Cookies. This creates a refined cultivar that's dense, frosty and flavourful.

variants.title: BC Bounty
variants.brand: The Original Fraser Valley Weed Co.
tags: The Original Fraser Valley Weed Co.
variants.body_html: BC Bounty from The Original Fraser Valley Weed Co. A bulk, rotating ounce of expertly grown quality dried flower. Greenhouse-grown in abundance in BC's finest growing region, the Fraser Valley.

variants.title: Kush Cookies
variants.body_html: You'll whisper its name in reverential tones after this bud passes your lips - 'Kush Cookies'. Potent, terpene-rich, with dense and sticky buds, Kush Cookies is a rare lineage of GMO Cookies and OZ Kush that delivers highly aromatic notes of savoury herbs and spicy earth, with undertones of citrus and musk. 3Saints Kush Cookies has an average terpene percentage at an astounding 4.4 per cent (varies by lot). The dominant terps are caryophyllene, limonene and linolool, grown righteously in the sun in a hybrid greenhouse, rain watered, hand harvested, hang dried and expertly cured. All this delivers high flavour, high Potency and high terpenes. What's not to revere? Go on, whisper the name again 'Kush Cookies'.

variants.title: Illuminati
variants.body_html: This bud is shrouded in mystery. Cultivated meticulously in the legacy market by us for more than six years as a Slurricane, we've maximized the look and taste of our Illuminati strain. Its exceptional lineage of Dos-si-dos x Purple Punch shines brightly in this cultivar, and through an extensive in-house phenohunt, we've ensured its unparalleled uniqueness. Get ready to immerse yourself in this perfectly curated hybrid flower. The dense buds are almost blue in colour, adorned with dense trichomes, vibrant orange hairs and delicate lavender sugar leaves. When the bag is opened, the aroma of vanilla cookies, burnt rubber and chlorine captivates your senses. On the palate, a gassy introduction transforms into a symphony of sweet undertones, culminating in a smooth finish. Illuminati heralds the extraordinary beginning of what the Artiznl team has to offer.

variants.title: Island Time
variants.body_html: Island Time buds are cultivated to meet our exacting standards to ensure that the product you get is coated in trichomes, loaded with sweet, tropical flavours and rich in terpenes. There’s no time, like Island Time.

variants.title: RS-11
variants.body_html: RS-11 is the result of crossing Black Sherbert x Oz Kush x Pink Guava. It boasts a sought-after and distinctive terpene profile, with vibrant green flowers and a coat of dusty trichomes. Designed to hit all targets from appearance to effect, this strain is sure to attract and leave a lasting impression. Once the flowers are harvested, they undergo a thorough and precise drying process, which involves hanging them to air-dry for a minimum of 14 days. Then is set to cure for a minimum of 30 days. This not only preserves the potency of the flower, but also enhances its flavour and aroma. As a result of the intensive process, these flowers possess an overwhelming and captivating aroma that fills the room upon opening. Their flawless appearance is a testament to the careful craftsmanship and the attention to detail. All in all, these are not just flowers, but luxurious and exquisite products that have been carefully curated to deliver a premium experience.

variants.title: With Love from Scarborough - Craft Collective
variants.body_html: Experience the love from Scarborough with the elite cross of Kush Mintz x Do-Si-Dos. Immerse yourself in its rich aroma, a subtle combination of gassy undertones, earthiness and a hint of sweet mint chocolate. The buds? They're a sight to behold. Large and dense with a touch of foxtail structure, playing between shades of light and dark green, complemented by bright orange pistils and finished with a trichome sparkle. This indica dominant flower is hang dried, slow cured and carefully hand trimmed.

variants.title: Master Mazar Kush
variants.body_html: You could climb the Himalayas, or you could get just as high with Master Mazar Kush. A heavy, dense indica flower with bold diesel and sweet, fruity aromas that clocks in at 21-27 percent THC. Leave the mountaineering to the professionals and indulge in a classic kush experience that'll help you wind down with its heavy and relaxing vibe. Made from a cross of Master Kush X Mazar and featuring dominant terpenes of caryophyllene, myrcene and humulene, these majestic, frosty green buds with fiery orange pistils will inspire you to shout your love from the mountaintops but good luck leaving the couch.

variants.title: Grower's Choice Indica
variants.body_html: High-quality indica-dominant bud at a great price; Good Supply is taking it to the next level with Grower's Choice.

variants.title: Frosted Cherry
variants.body_html: For the discount smoker looking for something different, Potluck is a new take on the 'value ounce' -- featuring whole-flower pouches designed for mixing and matching your way to an ounce. Potluck is available in Indica, Sativa, Hybrid 7g options. The word pot-luck appears in the 16th century English work of Thomas Nashe, and used to mean 'food provided for an unexpected or uninvited guest, the luck of the pot'. Potluck dinners are events where the attendees bring a dish to a meal - a different meal. Potluck Indica Dominant Hybrid will launch with Frosted Cherry and will continually introduce new craft, boutique strains as product sells out. This strain is tasty like the classic GSC with a sweet profile that's also crisp and fresh. The smooth taste makes for an enjoyable smoke.

variants.title: Mango Haze
variants.body_html: Mango Haze whole flower is a balanced CBD/THC cultivar that is rich in flavour. Bountiful terpenes give this cultivar its signature mango scent. The sativa-dominant hybrid produces dark green, resinous flowers with bright orange pistils and mild THC potency potential. Boasting an aromatic profile much like you would expect from its namesake, its creamy, sweet, espresso nose lingers on the palate. Dominant terpenes include ocimene, myrcene, and limonene.

variants.title: Republic Reserve 25%
variants.body_html: Step into The Republic, where our ethos is grounded in crafting products for the people, with a focus on quality at value. Our newest ounce bag, the Republic Reserve 25, was precisely curated to deliver a potent, indica-dominant offering cultivated with conscious care and consistency in mind. With a guaranteed minimum 25% THC and a diverse terpene profile, it promises to deliver full-bodied flavour with a bold and dank aroma that doesn't shy away from making a statement. Each bud is hang dried and slow cured, reflecting our unwavering dedication to quality and consistency. Opt for Republic Reserve 25 and join us in fostering a community where top-tier quality and value are always #ForThePeople.

variants.title: OCB Ultimate Rolling Papers - King Size Slim
Philter Phrend
variants.body_html:
Say goodbye to secondhand smoke and lingering odors with the Philter Phrend, your ultimate companion for discreet and responsible smoking. Designed for up to 500 exhales, this compact personal filter eliminates smoke, odor, and germs from your exhale, creating a cleaner, more considerate experience.

Simply inhale from your favorite smoking accessory and exhale into the Phrend—no smoke, no smell, no hassle. Perfect for those who value privacy and cleanliness, the Phrend ensures your sessions remain personal and mess-free, wherever you go.

variants.title: Pink Formula Pink Eraser Magnet Glass Cleaner
Pink Forumula Scrub Bud Grinder Brush
variants.body_html: Keep your grinder clean with the Scrub Bud Grinder Brush from Pink Formula. Equipped with durable PP bristles it easily brushes off and cleans the stuck-on resin and oils that come from normal wear and tear. The comfortable handle fits in the palm of your hand for serious cleaning sessions. Pair it with Pink Formula's Grinder Cleaner Spray for the ultimate refresh.

variants.title: Purple Power Original-32oz
variants.body_html: Purple Power is a soaking-style cleaning solution. It's safe to use on a variety of materials like glass, quartz, acrylic and silicone. Simply soak your piece for 45 minutes, you don't need to use a brush to get it back to sparkling clean. The liquid is biodegradable so stop worrying about other chemical cleaners and get clean with Purple Power. Available in 32oz solution.

variants.title: Silicone Ice Cream Dab Tool
variants.body_html: Keep summer alive all year round with this super cute ice cream dab tool. This handy helper can Maneuver and manipulate your concentrates for easy consumption. The ice cream is made from silicone, which handles heat well and the stick is stainless steel.

variants.title: Maple Sugar 4:2:1
variants.body_html: Create a new nighttime rhythm with Manna's full spectrum CBN-infused organic maple sugar. It can be mixed into teas, water or used as an ingredient and is vegan and gluten free. Each sachet contains 10mg of CBN, 5mg of CBD and 2.5mg THC.

variants.title: Maple Sugar
variants.body_html: Elevate naturally with full spectrum Manna Maple Sugar. Our organic maple sugar is created in small batches with simple, locally sourced products that can be mixed into any beverage or used as an ingredient and is vegan + gluten free. Manna highlights two classic Canadian plants in a timeless flavour pairing; organic maple and cannabis. Each sachet contains 10mg THC.

variants.title: Slurricane Mint
variants.body_html: Slurricane mint is a high-THC flower for a good price- with gassy and sweet flavor with a mint undertone. High terpene profil give a great smell while opening the contenant, mostly gassy and gelato type odor. The slurricane mint is a cross between Slurricane XI x Margy's mint, both high thc lineage give this strain a well balanced body and head high, Hybrid lineage. Grown Indoor in highly controlled environnement under LED light spectrum, giving the product quality consistency over and over. Hang dried, hand trimmed, hand packaged , only small room batch at the time, all what's concidered Craft product criteria are met.

variants.title: Pink Octane
variants.body_html: Pink Octane's sky-high THC and gassy undertones shot it straight to the top of GreenSeal's in-house Nursery program. Absolutely covered with frosty trichomes, the visible potency of this blushing indica-typical phenotype is confirmed by its powerfully euphoric and relaxing effects. You'll be tickled pink by its sweet and nutty flavour profile, mingled with a subtle touch of funky fuel aroma.

variants.title: Eddy’s Watermelon
variants.body_html: Famed breeder Dying Breed arrived at this super sweet Sativa by crossing Watermelon Zum Zum #3 with OG Eddy. With medium sized, light green nugs, this uplifting daytime Sativa features a bright blast of watermelon flavours and stress-free, energetic effects. This phenotype exemplifies the characteristics of the original Watermelon Zkittlez. Its high THC content and pronounced watermelon terpene profile sets it apart from other Zkittlez crosses.

variants.title: LA Kush Cake
variants.body_html: You dont have to wait for a special occasion to enjoy this cake. Introducing LA Kush Cake - a timeless cross of Wedding Cake and Kush Mints. This exquisite strain promises a delectable blend of sweet dough and gas. Perfect for any occasion, LA Kush Cake offers a guilt-free escape with all the flavor and none of the calories. Elevate your moments with this extraordinary cultivar.

variants.title: Cropped Harvest (Indica)
variants.body_html: Already milled and ready to roll… or vape… or pack a bowl. Divvy’s indica-dominant flower is available in bulk bags containing gently ground from whole flower.

variants.title: CBD Runtz
variants.body_html: CBD Rntz is a sativa-dominant strain of cannabis that produces moderate levels of THC and CBD, as well as generous amounts of terpenes. Due to its rich terpene profile, CBD Rntz produces a fruity, sweet aroma with earthy notes and spicy undertones. Expect light green buds coated with sticky, gooey trichomes, and bright orange pistils.

variants.title: Green Monster Breath
variants.body_html: You don't want to get close to most monsters, but we've found the exception: Green Monster Breath from Spinach. Like a mad scientist's nod to GMO Cookies and Animal Cookies, the pungent smell, candied strawberry taste, and oh-so crystally buds, make it an intense encounter for all the senses. Feeling brave? Bravo, you've finally met your match.

variants.title: Nishin
variants.body_html: Nishin has an old school skunky sweetness with dense yellow and green buds. That familiar sweet sulphur and spice of your favourites from the past speaks to its indica-dominant ancestry. Grown under the sun and hang dried these flowers are sure to delight. Nishin is Ojibwe for “finest, best, good" and reflects our commitment to providing exceptional value to our consumers and giving back to First Nations communities while driving Indigenous participation in the legal cannabis market.

variants.title: Inzane in the Membrane
variants.body_html: Don’t you know Inzane in the Membrane is loco? Okay, let’s be real for a minute. Whether you’re taking hits from the bong, rolling one up, or hitting the dry herb vape – this sativa is going to be in your top five. Just check the track list: high THC with citrus, pine and tangy hits from the dominant caryophyllene, terpinolene and humulene terpenes. We’re talking all bops, no flops. These buds show off every shade of green and the trichome covering is so mean you’ll want to say you knew about it before it was famous. We’re predicting this one will be very popular.

variants.title: Berry Splash Infused PR 3 x 0.4 g
variants.body_html: Take a trip to a berry paradise with Berry Splash Infused Pre-rolls! Each puff will have an explosion of berry flavours with slight floral notes! Made with whole flower input, dusted in kief and flavoured with distillate!

variants.title: Oatmeal S'More Cup
variants.body_html: THC: 5.00mg per piece CBD: 5.00mg per piece -- Oatmeal cookie cup filled with marshmallows and chocolate chips. Each package contains two 30g cups each infused with 5mg THC, 5mg CBD, and 5mg CBN,

variants.title: Fully Charged Wavy Watermelon Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: It’s the first slice of summer with this sweet and juicy infused pre-roll. With a lineage tracing back to the Watermelon and Zktlz cultivars, you know that Spinach® Fully Charged Wavy Watermelon infused pre-rolls will bring the sweet taste of watermelon with high quality and high potency cannabis extract infusion combined with a dusted kief coating.

variants.title: Wondermelon Slush Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Fire up your tastebuds with Fuego Wondermelon Slush! Reminiscent of those multi-coloured mixes combining watermelon, cherry, and lime botanical terpenes. Combined with potent THC distillate in a high-grade 510 cartridge for the flavourful experience consumers have come to love from Fuego.

variants.title: Pink Cherry Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Pink Cherry is a knockout of pure live resin, expertly extracted in Ontario expressing myrcene and limonene – the fruity flavours of grape, berry and stone fruit. Small batch BHO extraction ensures a whole flower cannabinoid experience for the connoisseur and everyday consumer alike. Captured in a universal 510 cart for convenient pulls wherever you are.

variants.title: Wes' Coast Kush
variants.body_html: MTL's Cannabis Wes' Coast Kush is an indica dominant strain. The flower is a light colouered green with purple undertones covered in tricomes. The flavour is packed with a sweet, earthy, and kush taste and gassy finish.

variants.title: AAA+ Indica
variants.body_html: Crooked Dory offers high-end ounces at affordable prices through our Rotating Ounce program. We change the strain every six weeks, allowing you to try a variety of premium products at a fraction of the cost.

variants.title: Peach Gelato
variants.body_html: Grab a scoop, roll it up or put it in a bowl. Spinach Peach Gelato dried flower and pre-rolls bring flavours of sweet, juicy peach and creamy gelato thanks to lineage tracing back to Cake Creashers X Marionberry. With terpenes like myrcene, limonene, and linalool, you'll feel like you've got a double-decker gelato sundae with peaches on top. It's easy to melt away with this high potency strain.

variants.title: Headbanger
variants.body_html: Throw up the horns for Headbanger. Coming in at 22-28% THC, this sativa absolutely shreds and features amped-up earth, fruit and gas aromas. This Biker Kush x Sour cross is hang-dried, hand trimmed and carefully cured for an ultra-potent and irresistible flavour with a consistent burn. The buds are tight and dense with purple flecks and excessive trichome coverage. Advanced production techniques and cultivation expertise allow us to produce an intense expression of Headbanger with an enhanced sour and citrus flavour profile, heavy-hitting potencies and satisfying effects. Available in 7g and featuring dominant terpenes of caryophyllene, limonene and fenchone dominant terps - you'll want to experience an encore.

variants.title: Baked Animal
variants.body_html: Baked Animal is a BC-grown cultivar from the Pure Sunfarms greenhouse. This potent hybrid is a cross of the widely popular Animal Face and smooth-smoking Baker’s Delight. Featuring sweet aromas of berries, cake, cream and light gas from dominant terpenes myrcene, caryophyllene and limonene. Its dense and colourful buds are rich with sugary trichomes. Pure BC bud, hand harvested, hang dried and hand finished.

variants.title: Captain Kush
variants.body_html: Ahoy Land Lubbers! Introducing SHRED's first Indica specific blend: Captain Kush! This kushnado of flavours is going to tickle the tastebuds of SHRED Heads who can't get enough of that most alluring of aromas: Kush. So not only is this blend skunky AF - it's also our first Indica blend. Avast, ye SHRED Heads!

variants.title: Maple Pancakes
variants.body_html: What's more Canadian than Maple Pancakes? Bring on the classic Canuck flavours of this sativa-dominant flower named for its delicious buttery and maple syrup aromas paired with sweet berries and pancake batter. Just one of four new strains inspired by classic Canadian flavours. Available by the quarter-ounce, mix-and-match your stash and sample a little bit of everything without breaking the bank.

variants.title: Pink Cookies x Kush Mints
variants.body_html: This strain offers a deliciously smooth vanilla flavour with earthy and peppermint aromas. A potent indica-dominant hybrid crossed with the popular Pink Cookies and Kush Mints. Dominant terpenes include myrcene, limonene and farnesene.

variants.title: LA Pop Star
variants.body_html: Say hello to LA Pop Star, a legend born from crossing GG4 x LA Kush. This hybrid sensation isn't just a hit for its high potency—it's also got serious flavour game. Prepare to be starstruck by its spicy herbal kick and a touch of diesel on the finish. As for looks, these buds are the real VIPs. Picture them as the headliners of the green room, with buds in a deep olive green hue, topped off with orange highlights and a sparkling coat of amber crystals. Our meticulous hang-drying and slow-curing process ensure the best quality. LA Pop Star isn't just a strain—it's the chart-topping anthem you've been waiting for. With love from Scarborough.

variants.title: Pink Kush
variants.body_html: Pure Sunfarms' cut of Pink Kush from BC's Vancouver Island is a coastal relative of the legendary OG Kush. This special strain is beloved across Canada for its strong aromas, colourful flowers and high THC potential. Beneath a thick coating of trichomes, the dense and round buds feature forest green leaves, often with a purple hue, mixed with dark amber pistils. Grown in a high-tech greenhouse in the Fraser Valley, each bud is carefully trimmed and hand-groomed, dried and cured to precise standards. Pink Kush showcases gassy aromas of white pepper, orange, butterscotch, coffee, earth and grapefruit, the result of a rich combination of terpenes that includes caryophyllene, myrcene, humulene, bisabolol, and limonene.

variants.title: KEFF
variants.body_html: Large format cannabis craft flower that is highly potent and terpene-rich. Appeals to the consumer who’s looking for a high quality craft at a reasonable price.

variants.title: Roll Up Sativa PR 1 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Roll Up to your next hang without bringing your full cannabis stash. Grab a current Divvy sativa-dominant flower that’s ready to rumble whenever you are.

variants.title: Blackberry Gelato PR 10 x 0.3g
variants.body_html: Our Blackberry Gelato pre-roll smells like a freshly-iced blackberry toaster strudel - fruit-forward, with undertones of fuel, Canadian maple, and mulled spices. Wildlife pre-rolls are rolled from whole buds, never shake. We remove sticks and stems by hand, and finish with a hand twist for quality assurance. Our processing rooms' environments are set to ensure minimal moisture loss. A crowd favourite, this easy-smoking cultivar has a THC range of 20-24%, with a Trans-Caryophyllene-dominant terpene profile to add a hint of black pepper and spice. Limonene, Farnesene and Linalool exaggerate the light-but-fruity overall flavour, rounded out with Humulene and Guaiol. The ripe flowers are round, very dense, and sticky - especially once cured. Visually, they're a west coast rainforest green, with hints of dark purple throughout, contributing to the cultivar name. This in-house bred cultivar is the result of a cross between a Jordan Of The Islands Blackberry Kush & Jet fuel Gelato.

variants.title: Hawaiian Sativa Shatter
variants.body_html: Dab Bods shatter offers a high-quality hydrocarbon cannabis concentrate with impressive cannabanoid potencies up to 80 per cent, and a translucent, glass-like consistency that is easy to dab vape or add to dry flower. Ideal for those who are new to dabbing, or looking for a high-value offering that doesn't skimp on the THC, this sativa-heavy extract is priced and positioned to appeal to those who want the very best, on a budget.

variants.title: Valiant Everyday Essentials Beaker Bong - Navy - 10in.
variants.body_html:
Everyday value at affordable prices. These are Everyday Essentials. Handcrafted from the high-quality thick borosilicate glass, our mid-sized Everyday Essentials 10” Beaker Water Pipe provides massive hits in a convenient and compact package.

  • Thick Borosilicate Glass
  • Straight Design w/ Beaker Base
  • Ice Pinch for Frosty Cool Hits
  • Flared Mouthpiece
  • Includes Removable Bowl

Puffco New Peak - Black
variants.body_html:
The Puffco New Peak is the next evolution in easy, elegant dabbing. Designed to make every session smooth and flavourful, this smart e-rig combines modern features with a sleek, minimalist look. From the silicone base to the joystick airflow cap, every detail is made to simplify your experience without sacrificing performance.

Key Features & Benefits

3D Chamber - Wall-mounted heating surrounds your concentrate for maximum flavour and vapor while protecting delicate cannabinoids and terpenes.

Joystick Cap - Fine-tune airflow with a simple, tactile motion that gives you more control over every hit.

Up to 35 Dabs per Charge - A long-lasting battery keeps you session-ready for longer.

Fast USB-C Charging - Recharge quickly and get back to dabbing sooner.

Swappable Glass Top - Compatible with both Peak and Peak Pro glass, so you can choose your preferred style of filtration.

Real-Time Temperature Control - Smart sensors keep your dab at the perfect temperature from start to finish.

colour Variants - Available in Cloud for a clean and dreamy look, Black for a sleek and timeless style, and Sky for a soft and refreshing vibe.

2-Year Warranty - Built for reliability and peace of mind with full coverage.

variants.title: Yocan Cylo Portable Vaporizer Blue & Red
variants.body_html:
Say hello to the Yocan Cylo—a bold little device that delivers big performance in a clean, compact package. Whether you're just diving into the world of wax or you're already a seasoned dabber, the Cylo brings something special to the table. It’s got power, precision, and style all rolled into one. With a customizable LED glow, smooth magnetic mouthpiece, and a bright display screen that keeps you in the loop, this vaporizer is all about easy, reliable sessions that hit just the way you like. It’s made for people who want control over their experience without overcomplicating things—just set your voltage, hit that button, and enjoy.

Key Features & Benefits
Adjustable Voltage (2.0–4.2V) – Fine-tune your sesh for flavour, clouds, or a bit of both with 0.1V precision.

Strong 1300–1400mAh Battery – Lasts through plenty of hits and charges fast with USB-C.

C4-DE Plus Ceramic Coil – Delivers clean, even heat and smooth vapor with every draw.

0.96" TFT Display – Bright, easy-to-read screen shows voltage, puff count, and battery life at a glance.

Customizable LED Lights – Choose from different colours or keep it low-key in stealth mode.

Magnetic Mouthpiece – Easy to load and clean, no sticky threads to mess with.

Sturdy Build – Zinc-alloy body feels solid in your hand without being bulky.

Colour Variants – Available in White, Black & White, Blue & Red, Red & Gold, Black, Green & Purple.

If you're looking for a sleek, reliable wax vaporizer that delivers solid performance with zero hassle, the Yocan Cylo has you covered. It’s easy to use, fun to customize, and built to keep up with your vibe—wherever the day takes you.

variants.title: True GLTO 33 Live Resin Vape Cartridge

variants.title: OMG
variants.body_html: Check out this extraordinary shatter that will leave you exclaiming 'OMG' with every hit. The astringent sweetness combines harmoniously with kushy undertones and a refreshing hint of mint. With every inhalation, you'll savor the rich and complex flavors that make this gassy shatter truly exceptional.

variants.title: Blue Raspberry Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Going blue in the face trying to find your new favourite 510? We’ve got three words: creamy, blue, raspberry. That’s right, Blue Raspberry 510s and all their indulgent, lip-smacking, electric berry flavours are now available in our reformulated, higher-potency vapes with reliable cartridges featuring a ceramic core, glass cartridge and hemp mouthpiece. And with 87-93% THC, you’ll be singing ‘da ba dee da ba di’ with those blue extra-terrestrials in no time.

variants.title: Catacomb Kush Shatter
variants.body_html: Roilty 1g Shatters are high-potency BHO extracts that pack a punch. Our Catacomb Kush is certainly no slouch at 73.6% THC and nearly 4% terpenes. Created using a true British Columbia bred strain, Death Bubba, a sedative cross between Death Star and Bubba Kush, this shatter is spicy and crisp with 2.2% Beta-Caryolphellene. Fire up and slip into your own cozy catacomb (read: couch) as the effects wash over you.

variants.title: Mango Haze
variants.body_html: Mango Haze whole flower is a balanced CBD/THC cultivar that is rich in flavour. Bountiful terpenes give this cultivar its signature mango scent. The sativa-dominant hybrid produces dark green, resinous flowers with bright orange pistils and mild THC potency potential. Mango Haze is a genetic cross between Northern Lights x Skunk x Haze; with dominant terpenes of myrcene, pinene, beta-caryophyllene and farnesene. Our elevated growing practices, including full temperature and humidity control and hang-drying, create a consistent and enjoyable smoking experience.

variants.title: Kush God
variants.body_html: Kush God is a BC-grown cultivar from the Pure Sunfarms greenhouse. This powerful indica-dominant is an iconic cross of Pink Kush x Pineapple God, featuring notes of tropical fruit, grape, and dairy from dominant terpenes Myrcene, Limonene, and Humulene. The buds feature bright greens with splashes of purple and amber hairs, coated in creamy trichomes. Pure BC bud, hand-harvested, hang-dried, and hand-finished.

variants.title: Inzane in the Membrane
variants.body_html: Don’t you know Inzane in the Membrane is loco? Okay, let’s be real for a minute. Whether you’re taking hits from the bong, rolling one up, or hitting the dry herb vape – this sativa is going to be in your top five. Just check the track list: high THC with citrus, pine and tangy hits from the dominant caryophyllene, terpinolene and humulene terpenes. We’re talking all bops, no flops. These buds show off every shade of green and the trichome covering is so mean you’ll want to say you knew about it before it was famous. We’re predicting this one will be very popular.

variants.title: Chemango Kush
variants.body_html: Chemango Kush by San Rafael '71 is a premium indoor-grown indica bred from exclusive, top-tier genetics sourced from a world-class breeding facility in Comox, British Columbia. This next-generation cultivar offers a notably high THC range of between 24% - 30% THC along with a completely unique and novel blend of fruit, sour, and chem aroma notes. Chemango Kush features huge, ultra-dense buds with gorgeous olive-green tones and glistening trichomes. Chemango Kush is hang-dried, hand-finished, and carefully hand-bottled with an included humidity pack.

variants.title: Sage n' Sour
variants.body_html: A cross between Sour Diesel x S.A.G.E (Sativa Afghani Genetic Equilibrium), this strain takes its well-known Sour Diesel lineage to the next level through its unique terpenes. Sage n’ Sour is full of pungent, gassy diesel notes, with peppery, limey, and cedar accents.

variants.title: Rocketship Rosin One Hitter Guavacot Kush
variants.body_html: Lightspeed live rosin infused whole flower one hitter. The Rocketship Rosin one hitter is portable.

variants.title: Frosted Cream Puffs PR 3 x 0.5 g

variants.title: Roach Clips - Mushroom
variants.body_html: Smoke your joints down to the filter with this iconic mushroom roach clip. No more burnt fingers or awkward passes to friends. Simply clip your joint in and smoke to your heart’s content.

variants.title: Famous Design Floral Lush Ashtray - Gold Accent
variants.body_html: Delicate in looks only, this high caliber ashtray is tops. Floral lush does it again with a stunning teal ashtray topped with an elegant floral design and gold accents. A unique shape gives you lots of room for ashes and a long notch perfect for holding a partially smoked (or about to be smoked) joint. It comes inside a classic giftbox with the same beautiful floral and gold design.

variants.title: Famous Design Floral Lush Aluminum 2 Stage Grinder - Teal and Gold
variants.body_html: The Floral Lush 2-piece grinder is 61mm and made from aluminum. It has incredibly sharp, diamond-cut teeth perfect for tearing and fluffing your herb and stays closed with the help of a magnet. A stunning colour combination of teal and gold has an applied floral design on the top and it comes inside a gift package adorned with the same floral design and gold accents.

variants.title: Famous Design Floral Lush Rolling Tray - Medium
variants.body_html: The Floral Lush rolling trays feature the same showstopping floral artwork as the rest of the line. A standard metal tray is taken to the next level with a luxurious botanical design so elegant you'll want multiples for every room in your house (Hello, key tray at the front door!). It has a rimmed edge to prevent spillage while rolling or stashing. Available in small and medium sizes.

variants.title: Famous Design Floral Lush Beaker Water Pipe - Teal - 12in
variants.body_html: The Floral Lush Beaker is made from thick, handblown borosilicate glass. Sitting 12 inches tall, it's a beautiful transparent teal with an intricate floral design and delicate gold accents. To make your hit extra smooth it features an ice pinch as well as a diffused downstem. It comes inside a beautifully designed box emblazoned with a custom gold accented floral design.

variants.title: Famous Design Floral Lush Rolling Tray - Small
variants.body_html: The Floral Lush rolling trays feature the same showstopping floral artwork as the rest of the line. It has a rimmed edge to prevent spillage while rolling or stashing. Available in small and medium sizes.

variants.title: Famous Design Floral Lush Crystal Hand Pipe - Teal - 5in
variants.body_html: The Floral Lush hand pipe is made from thick, handblown borosilicate glass. This transparent teal, crystal shaped pipe has a cool, dichromic edge (bubbles trapped at the end of the pipe) with the thoughtfully applied floral design and gold accents. A delightfully designed gift box, embellished with the same floral design, houses this phenomenal 5-inch pipe.

variants.title: Lakeside Kush
variants.body_html: If you love Kush you’ll love our Lakeside Kush. We carefully select only high potency buds of the best tasting Kush genetics. Lakeside Kush is hang dried and hand trimmed to preserve potency and deliver a smooth smoke every time.

variants.title: Indica PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Indica by Thumbs Up is a strain specific pre-roll pack featuring ever changing strains.

variants.title: Galactic Grape Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: The Spinach® Galactic Grape vape is gushing with sweet flavours. Inspired by the Galactic Grape strain with Grape Diamonds and Stardawg lineage.​ Our rich CO2 extract is cold filtered at sub-zero temperatures before it is distilled four times to ensure consistency and to deliver consistent quality, time and time again.

variants.title: Reaper OG PR 20 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: A tasty indica that hits harder than your favourite beats. Reaper OG boasts a potent blend of earthy, gassy flavours with a smooth smoke that'll have you vibing with every hit. Expertly filled in our unique straight shape for optimal airflow, taste and burn.

variants.title: Puffco Plus Dab Pen
variants.body_html: The Plus is where it all begins. This award-winning, all-in-one portable dab pen has been upgraded to make it easier than ever to enjoy concentrates everywhere. The mouthpiece houses the Dart, an extendable loading tool that inserts into the ceramic chamber to give you a seamless, discreet, and flavorful experience. The 510 battery has one button, offering standard hold-to-heat, Sesh Mode, and three precision heat settings. There’s no better way to start exploring the world of concentrates.

variants.title: Little Dipper Concentrate Vape Pen-White
variants.body_html: The little dipper is a super cool dab straw. Using Dip Device's signature technology, it makes it easier to directly consume your concentrates. You can even dip the tip right into your container! It heats up quickly and features three settings for perfect precision. You can preserve flavour or go right to big hits easily. The large 650mAh battery lasts a long time and is easily charged with a micro-USB charger. Each hit is super smooth from the epic air flow and the device is super simple to clean.

variants.title: Dip Devices Lunar Concentrate Vape Pen - Red
variants.body_html:
The Lunar dab pen is all about keeping things simple, smooth, and ready whenever you are. This sleek little device delivers full, satisfying hits that pack a punch. Designed with Dip Devices’ patented AirFlow Technology, you’ll get silky-smooth draws and maximum flavour every time.
With digital temperature controls, an easy-to-read LCD screen, and a super handy pack-and-go feature, the Lunar makes vaping on-the-go a breeze. Its 600 mAh battery lasts through extended sessions, and the fast-charging USB-C keeps downtime to a minimum. Affordable, convenient, and built to deliver—you can't go wrong with the Lunar for a no-fuss, full-flavour experience!

variants.title: Yocan Dyno Kit Black
variants.body_html:
Meet the Yocan Dyno, your new on-the-go nectar collector that balances powerful performance with chill vibes. From its compact design to the integrated glass bubbler, it's made for smooth, flavourful hits without the fuss. With a solid 1,000 mAh battery and USB-C charging, it’s always ready when you are. The precision OLED display and adjustable voltage let you dial in your preferred experience, while the magnetic ceramic tip and bubble glass mouthpiece make every session effortless and enjoyable.

Key Features & Benefits
Ceramic C‑Tube Heating Tip – Delivers clean, even heat and vibrant flavour with every dip—no harshness.

Adjustable Voltage (2.0–4.2 V) – Dial in the perfect balance of clouds and flavour using simple +/- buttons.

OLED Display & Puff Counter – Keep track of voltage, battery life, and session length at a glance.

1000 mAh Battery – Powers long sessions and recharges fast via USB-C.

Integrated Glass Bubbler – Cools and filters vapor for ultra-smooth draws wherever you go.

Magnetic Tip & Cover – Easy to swap tips and secure mouthpiece with no threading.

RGB Neon LED Lights – Set the mood with customizable colours or a stealth look.

Safety Cut-off (15–60 s) – Helps prevent overheating and preserves battery.

Ergonomic, Pocket-Friendly Build – Compact and sturdy—a perfect companion for daily adventures.

Colour Variants – Choose your vibe: Black, Blue, Red, Purple, or Yellow.

If you’re after a reliable nectar collector that’s easy to use, looks great, and delivers top-tier performance, the Yocan Dyno checks all the boxes—no fuss, all flavour.

Nachdem er mit 15 Jahren seine erste Gitarre erhielt, brachte er sich das Spielen selbst bei, indem er von erfahrenen Entertainern zusah und lernte. Er wurde von seinem ersten Auftritt gefeuert, weil er sich zu sehr in den Vordergrund drängte, wurde aber später einer der einflussreichsten Gitarristen und gefeierten Musiker der Geschichte. Er headlinete massive Musikfestivals wie Woodstock und Isle of Wright. 1970 erlag er tragischerweise dem berüchtigten 27 Club. Er hinterließ ein ewiges Erbe und sicherte sich seinen Platz als Rocklegende.

Das Love Rolling Tray ermöglicht es dir, ganz einfach zu rollen. Halte all deine Zubehörteile an einem Ort mit diesem Aluminium-Tablett. Das kleine Tablett misst 18x14cm/7x5.5” und das mittlere Maß 27x16cm/10.6x6.3”, sodass du es unterwegs mitnehmen oder zu Hause aufbewahren kannst. Love hat eine antihaftbeschichtete Oberfläche, sodass all deine Lieblingssachen nicht daran haften bleiben. Die Kanten sind abgerundet, um zu verhindern, dass Kräuter in den Ecken und Ritzen verloren gehen.

Love ist ein weißes Tablett mit atemberaubenden schwarz-weißen Bildern. Es zeigt ein großes Foto der Rocklegende mit dem Wort Love darüber, umgeben von einem sich windenden schwarzen Muster von Liebe und Frieden.

Apply to specific areas from head-to-toe (hello, foot rub) or use as an all-over deep-tissue/sports recovery massage oil. The product is a clear oil with a faint green tint. The very light, pleasing aroma is citrus/ lemongrass with a splash of peppermint. Try it once and be spoiled for anything else.

variants.title: Cabana Cannabis Co. Oceanic Water Pipe - Jade Green - 11in.
variants.body_html: Cabana Cannabis Co.'s sleek line of water pipes are stylish and sophisticated. Sitting 11 inches tall, Oceanic has a large bubble reservoir for ample amount of water. Made from handblown borosilicate glass it features an inline pendant percolator to keep your hit smooth and satisfying. The classic Cabana Cannabis Co. logo stands out against the pops of colour on the bong, and iconic imagery wraps around the tube for a minimalist yet modern look.

variants.title: Gorilla Breath
variants.body_html: Gorilla Breath is a cross of Original Glue and OGKB, originally bred by Humboldt Seed Company. This legacy strain is a hybrid with high resin production, a strong OG aroma and a delicious flavour profile. It's a strain with bold flavours. Gorilla Breath is everything they said it would be and more. It features lime green buds with purple hues, bright orange hairs, and diamond trichomes that sparkle in any light. With potent densely packed buds in every batch, this strain is for the cannabis lovers. Grown in Toronto, this strain was pheno-hunted in-house by our team. Where all strains are hang dried, hand trimmed and never irradiated! We take pride in flushing each crop for 10-14 days, ensuring a smooth taste and a clean burn every time.

variants.title: WTF (What the Fruit) Strawberry PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Introducing our latest addition to the cannabis world, the delectable WTF (What The Fruit) Strawberry. Created from a blend of Grandpa's Breath x Tangie, this sativa dominant strain is the result of 12 months of meticulous pheno-hunting by our expert master grower. The goal was to uncover a unique and potent characteristic that could be consistently replicated through clones, and boy did we succeed. With a potent profile, our WTF Strawberry boasts a luscious and creamy strawberry aroma paired with a citrus flavour. We take great pride in our careful cultivation process, ensuring that each batch is slowly hang dried for up to 14 days and hand trimmed to preserve the precious trichomes. Our minimum one-month curing process further maximizes the potency of this strain.

variants.title: Marshmallow Milk
variants.body_html: This new Californian strain was phenotype hunted by Capulator himself. Highly potent and strong terpenes. It encompasses a strong hint of the popular Lucky C Marshmallow Milk cereal.

variants.title: More Cowbell PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: More Cowbell delivers a balance between the traits of both hash plant and GSC. This cultivar provides large dense buds with a pointed silhouette, and contains above average resin content to provide a hashy, cookie flavour with undertones of gas.

variants.title: Hash Bullets
variants.body_html: Mini in size but big in flavour, our Hash Bullets are a unique hash only pre-roll that will change the way you experience hash. These mini pre-rolls are packed with our in-house hash inputs to create a flavourful and one-of-a-kind product.

variants.title: Gluerangutan Hash Infused PR 2 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: GOOD BUDS' Hash Infused Gluerangutan Pre-Rolls bring the ultimate potent and terpy island experience. They're Living Soil Organic (LSO), and infused exclusively with Gluerangutan LSO bubble hash to bring a pure and distinct terp and cannabinoid experience. A back-cross of the popular legacy strain Harambe (OG Kush x GG4 x Hash Plant), Gluerangutan hits like a truck with powerful diesel base aromas, followed by citrus zest overtones and a fresh mountain pine finish. The top cut from a 100,000+ pheno hunt, Gluerangutan is Ocean Grown exclusively on our Family Farm on Salt Spring Island BC. The plants are grown Living Soil Organic (LSO) under the island sun, and fed nothing but recaptured rainwater for a cleaner, smoother burn. Each batch is hand-harvested, hang dried in small batches and hand packed into Ecolite Dube Tubes.

variants.title: Watermelon Waterfall Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Premium Watermelon Gushers flower mixed with live resin, cultivar-specific inputs along with botanical terpenes and rolled into premium pre-roll cones, then covered in a layer of kief.

variants.title: Gluerangutan PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Gluerangutan is some sticky island dank with powerful diesel base aromas, followed by citrus zest overtones and a fresh mountain pine finish. The top cut from a 100,000+ pheno hunt, Gluerangutan is a GOOD BUDS exclusive back-cross of the popular legacy OG strain Harambe (OG Kush x GG4 x Hash Plant). It’s ocean grown in living organic soils, exclusively on their FVOPA-Certified Organic, Salt Spring Island Family Farm. Gluerangutan is harvested by hand, hang dried, and slow cured for the smoothest and terpy-est flavour experience. Rolled in unbleached cones and hand-finished.

variants.title: Gastropop PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: GastroPop is a modern strain from top-breeder Compound Genetics. Gastro Pop is a cross of Apples & Bananas and Grape Gas. Compound Genetics considered the parent Grape Gas as one of their 'Royal Families'—superb for making crosses. Gastro Pop has an elite, dramatic look and spicy, sugary grape, purple-fizzy aroma to match. These sweet tasting and potent pre-rolls are grown in small batches, hand harvested, hang dried, and hand trimmed.

variants.title: Snowman Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Snowman is an infused pre-roll created by mixing Tiger Cake flower, a sprinkle of tiger cake dry sift and Tiger Cake diamonds. These flavourful pre-rolls are then finished by being rolled in a fresh layer of kief. Dominant terpenes include Caryophyllene, Limonene, and Myrcene.

variants.title: CB Rotating Strains PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: These rotating single-strain, whole flower pre-rolls are the top-shelf of our pre-rolls. Made with premium flower, these delicious flavour-bombs are smooth ‘til the very last puff. The strains on rotation are Zoap, Lemon Cherry Gelato, Blockberry, Pina Grande, RS11 (Rainbow Sherbet #11), Bubblegum Runtz, Wifi CKS, Fire OG, Resin Crusher & CKS n Chem. All Cannabis Brothers flower is grown indoors in eco-conscious soil using the full line of APTUS nutrients and bio-stimulants. Hang dried at 16°C and 60% humidity for 14 days, the flowers are then popped off the vine (by hand) and cured for another 30-45 days. The flowers are then hand trimmed and hand packaged.

variants.title: Koko's Cake PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: This variety pack includes Koko's Cookies and our new Space Cake. These are strong indica pre-rolls, but a variety of flavours.

variants.title: CB Single Rotating Flower
variants.body_html: This rotating strain is our favourite because it gives our team the freedom to put down rooms of whichever strain we’re feeling at the time. For 2024 the strains on rotation are Zoap, Lemon Cherry Gelato, Blockberry, Pina Grande, RS11 (Rainbow Sherbet #11), Bubblegum Runtz, Wifi CKS, Fire OG, Resin Crusher & CKS n Chem. All Cannabis Brothers flower is grown indoors in eco-conscious soil using the full line of APTUS nutrients and bio-stimulants. Hang dried at 16°C and 60% humidity for 14 days, the flowers are then popped off the vine (by hand) and cured for another 30-45 days. The flowers are then hand trimmed and hand packaged.

variants.title: Lemon Cherry Gelato
variants.body_html: Lemon Cherry Gelato is a 60/40 indica-dominant hybrid of Sunset Sherbet x Thin Mint GSC. She's an absolute pleasure to smoke with sherbet, candy-cherry terps that coat the mouth. As with all CB products, this strain is grown indoors in eco-conscious soil using the full line of APTUS nutrients and bio-stimulants. Hang dried at 16°C and 60% humidity for 14 days, the flowers are then popped off the vine (by hand) and cured for a further 30-45 days. The flowers are then trimmed and packaged by hand.

variants.title: Flavours PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Indulge your senses with exquisite aromas that emanate from these carefully selected strains. From fruity, floral undertones to cakes, cookies, and breads, each cultivar presents a sensory journey that reflects the rich tapestry of BC's cannabis landscape.

variants.title: Rockstar PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Popular with BC growers in pre legal times, Rock Star is a cross of Sensi Star X Rockbud, Often chosen for its heavy Indica effects, resinous buds and strong skunk lineage, the sweetly pungent scent will grab your attention delivering a similar flavour with a gassy oily essence. The bouncy olive green nugs are medium in size with a generous covering of orange hair

variants.title: Death Bubba PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: A British Columbia classic bred back in the 90s, Death Bubba is known world wide as a heavy Indica. The spade shaped buds are dense and large, finished with a thick layer of frost - expect sticky fingers from this flower. Upon opening, a clean pine aroma greets the nose. The flavour is pungent, a spiced earthy gas leading to intense full body relaxation.

variants.title: Orange Tingz PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html:
This Indica leaning Hybrid is a cross between Slurricane and TMAC, bred by Sacred
Cut Genetics. Expect the buds to be heavily frosted and sticky to the touch while
the flavour leans sweet with subtle grape and berry undertones. The dominant
terpenes in this cultivar are Limonene, Trans-Caryopphyllene and Ocimene.
Reviewers say that Orange Tingz makes for a perfect after dinner, sweet dessert
cannabis experience.

variants.title: Dank Deal
variants.body_html: What can you expect in the bag? While the strain will rotate periodically, every lot will deliver on Dank Craft's signature loud aromas and crystal covered flower. Our products are non-irradiated, hang dried, hand trimmed, slow cured and packed by hand to ensure a consistent and quality product every time. Buy it blind for a pleasant surprise or ask your local retailer what strain they have on hand.

variants.title: Lemon Cherry Gelato PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: As the name suggests, expect sweet, sherbet-like flavours of lemon, blueberries, and cherries with great bag appeal. Lemon Cherry Gelato is an exotic cross of legendary strains; Sunset Sherbet x Thin Mint GSC x Lemon Haze, originally bred by BackPack Boyz. The densely frosted flowers show tones of light and dark green, accented by bright orange hairs. Craft designated milled whole flower, hand-rolled in hemp paper and packed into home compostable tubes.

variants.title: Milk & Cookies PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Milk & CKS never tasted so good. This delectable indica hits THC heights and each draw is like enjoying a warm glass of milk and freshly baked cookies with the sweetness of vanilla, a whisper of nutty earthiness and a subtle hint of gas. The thick buds are overwhelmed with deep orange hairs, dapples of purple, and thickly blanketed in milky trichomes. This potent and terpy indica is cultivated with meticulous care, ensuring each small batch meets the highest standards. Grown in a controlled indoor environment, the plants are nurtured in strain-specific conditions to optimize their potential. The buds are inspected for purity and carefully hand-trimmed.

variants.title: Pacific OG
variants.body_html: Pacific OG is a Sativa dominant hybrid, a Tantalus curation of Goji OG, bred from Nepali OG and Snow Lotus.

variants.title: Pink Goo PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: This strain’s name comes from its ultra sticky appearance. It consists of resinous droplets of dew on the sugary leaves of the often pink and purple fluorescent flower centres that leach over to the contrasting darker green buds. With the incredible tree like trait to ooze sap from seemingly out of nowhere, with a sweet and pleasantly rich and floral flavour of earth that creates a smooth smoke.

variants.title: BC's Finest
variants.body_html: Limited drops of the freshest and most immaculate small batch, craft flower. If its not grown in-house, its grown by one of our micro-cultivation partners in British Columbia.

variants.title: Flavours Variety Pack
variants.body_html: Limited drops of the freshest and most immaculate small batch, craft flower. If its not grown in-house, its grown by one of our micro-cultivation partners in British Columbia.

variants.title: Pink Goo
variants.body_html: Pink Goo is an indica-dominant hybrid cross of Burmese Kush x Florida Kush. This strain is rolled with whole flowers of pale orange and shocking pink pistils and a covering of trichomes that can appear pink in the right light. The nose is loud, floral and tangy grapefruit with light Chem notes. With flavours of earthen berries and Sour Chem, this bud possess a sweet strawberry flavour with a Chem exhale, a perfect addition to the Pistol and Paris lineup.

variants.title: Orange Tingz PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: This Indica-leaning hybrid is a cross between Slurricane and TMAC, bred by Mother Labs and grown by JBuds in Summerland. Expect the buds to be heavily frosted and dense to the touch while the flavour leans sweet with subtle grape and berry undertones. The dominant terpenes in this cultivar are Trans-Caryophyllene, Linalool, and Limonene. Grown in soil, hand-watered, hand-trimmed, hang dried with a 10-day cure.

Crafted from durable borosilicate glass and designed with simplicity in mind, it’s the kind of rig that fits seamlessly into any smoker’s rotation. Compact enough to travel, powerful enough for daily use—this is a true hybrid hero.

8-Inch Height – Perfectly sized for both portability and powerful filtration.

Compact 4” Design: Easily fits into pockets or bags for ultimate portability.

variants.title: Ethos Glue PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Countryside Cannabis's Ethos Glue pre-roll ten pack is made with our gorgeous Original Glue crossed with Black Fire F1. Expect a similar structure and aromas as Original Glue with pungent earthy, skunky, and sour notes. Countryside pre-rolls come in 10 packs, grown and packaged entirely in house in St. Thomas Ontario. Boveda hydration sachet included to keep everything at the optimal humidity for consumption 62%.RH.

variants.title: Elite Honeycomb & Dual Cyclone Bent Neck - Anodized Blue - 12.5"
variants.body_html: Elite's stemless straight tube is incredibly epic. This 12.5 inch piece features a bent neck and ultra thick, sturdy base. A honeycomb percolator is positioned between 2 turbine percs for a super smooth and fun to watch hit. Its iridescent, metallic finish is super stunning and sparkly. A magnetic collector's box is included for displaying or gifting.

variants.title: Dopezilla Cerberus Water Pipe - Milky Teal - 16in.
variants.body_html: Dopezilla's fantastical line of water pipes keeps it cool. Cerberus, the hound of Hades who guards the underworld is 16 inches tall and made from handblown borosilicate glass. This straight tube is equipped with 3 honeycomb percolators to break up the smoke and make your hit satisfyingly smooth. A bullet-hole ice pinch allows you to toss in a few cubes to keep things fantastically frosty. Mainly clear, you'll find coloured accents on the base, mouthpiece and bowl to add a little flair. A deliberately designed monster image is on the tube with the diabolical Dopezilla logo.

variants.title: Dab Rig Recycler w/Quartz-Clear-8 in
variants.body_html: Rip it with a recycler. This 8-inch dab rig is made from handblown borosilicate glass and is crystal clear so you can see what's going on inside. The recycler cycles water through to keep your hit smooth and fresh. Extra diffusion slits inside also add to a smoother smoke. Its bent neck is perfect for an ergonomic sesh and the sturdy base prevents it from tipping over. It comes equipped with a quartz banger for optimal heat retention and ultimate flavour.

C&C 40. Jubiläum 3-Stufen Grinder - Grün - 53mm
variants.body_html:
Der 4-teilige 3-Stufen Grinder verfügt über einen Aluminiumrahmen, präzise Zerkleinerungszähne, ein Sieb, ein Aufbewahrungselement und einen magnetischen Deckelverschluss.

Der Grinder lässt sich aufschrauben, um das Pollensieb und ein Kief-Sammelstück freizulegen, das Ihr kostbares Pollen für die spätere Verwendung sammelt und sicher aufbewahrt. Das Sammeln des Pollenstaubs wird durch den mitgelieferten Kunststoffschaber extrem einfach gemacht.

Ein Nylon-Reibungsring sorgt für ein reibungsloses, verschleißfreies Mahlen, und der Grinder hat einen magnetisierten Deckel für Sicherheit. Der Deckel ist mit dem Cheech & Chong’s Up in Smoke Aufkleber dekoriert, und der Grinder ist in den folgenden Farben erhältlich: schwarz, rot, aqua, lila, grün und gold. Dieser langlebige Grinder wird ein Leben lang halten, wenn er richtig gepflegt und gewartet wird.

variants.title: C&C Up in Smoke Dugout - Schwarz
variants.body_html:
Das praktischste Zubehör für jeden Kenner, der diskret sein möchte, ist ein Dugout. Klein und tragbar, bietet es einen Platz, um eine Pfeife und deinen Vorrat aufzubewahren! Dieses Dugout verfügt über einen Aluminiumrahmen, der super stark und langlebig ist. Es ist mit einem metallischen One-Hitter-Bat ausgestattet, der heimlich als Zigarette mit einer gezackten Kante getarnt ist, um eine perfekte Schüssel zu packen. Der Deckel des Dugouts hat einen drehbaren Deckel, sodass er nach dem Entnehmen, was du brauchst, wieder an seinen Platz zurückschnappt. Das Vorratsfach ist geräumig, sodass du mehr als genug für den Tag mahlen und packen kannst. Die bunte Außenseite ist mit ikonischen Up in Smoke-Bildern verziert.

Patented metal digger one hitter bat, swivel lid & stash compartment

Taschenformat & diskret

Drehbarer Deckel

Halten Sie all Ihr Rauchzubehör mit diesem praktischen Metall-Rolling Tray in Reichweite. Sie sind aus qualitativ hochwertigem Aluminium gefertigt und wurden so entworfen, dass sie einiges aushalten können.

Die kleine Größe ist perfekt, um sie mit Ihnen zu nehmen, um unterwegs leicht einen zu drehen, während die mittlere Größe das ideale Tray ist, um Ihr Rauchzubehör zusammen und in Reichweite zu halten, während Sie zu Hause sind. Das große Tray bietet Ihnen mehr als genug Platz, um all Ihre notwendigen Raucheraccessoires und sogar Ihre Bong oder Ihren Bubbler auf dem Tray zu platzieren. Jedes Tray hat eine antihaftbeschichtete Rollfläche und ist mit runden Kanten ausgestattet, die verhindern, dass Ihre Kräuter und Tabak in den Ecken stecken bleiben.

variants.title: Pie In The Sky
variants.body_html: If you're trying to find your way to cloud nine, order Pie in the Sky. Bake yourself with a slice of this indulgent sativa rich with fruity, berry and citrus aromas and 20-26% THC. Broken Coast blessed us with this exclusive genetic, so rest assured it's as nice as pie with the dominant caryophyllene, linalool and limonene terpenes. The splendidly round and dense buds are bright green like a key lime pie and have a generous dusting of trichomes that'd make powdered sugar jealous. With its heady and uplifting taste, we won't judge you for wanting pie for breakfast.

variants.body_html: An oral spray with balanced levels of THC and CBD. Start low and go slow: 0.1 = ~ 2.5 mg of THC and 1.5 - 2 mg of CBD.

variants.body_html: Pepe's Peach Tree is flavourful with great bag appeal. This sativa leaning flower is born out of a double Peach Ozz cross. variants.body_html: Tasty’s Peach THC Infused Pre-Rolls offer an unbeatable combination of THC and taste without breaking the bank. Each pack offers pre-rolls infused with ultra-powerful concentrate inputs for incredibly high THC. Gushing with sweet and succulent peach flavours enhanced by botanical terpenes, Peach THC Infused Pre-Rolls offer everything you crave at a price you’ll love.

variants.title: Peanut Butter Breath
variants.body_html: Grab a butter knife and spread this strain all over your next session. Spinach Peanut Butter Breath is pungent, nutty, and the perfect snack of a strain all rolled into one. Take a puff and let these flavours stick to the roof of your mouth thanks to terpenes like Humulene, Limonene, and Linalool. With inspiration from a strain with Do-si-do and Mendo Breath lineage, Spinach’s Peanut Butter Breath may be the treat you’ve always wanted...crusts cut off of course.
