variants.body_html: Mega Breath is a powerful Hybrid strain that delivers a balanced mix of mind and body effects. With a unique and potent blend of indica and sativa. Mega Breath is sure to impress even the most experienced cannabis connoisseurs. The aroma of Mega Breath is pungent and earthy, with hints of pine and slight sweetness that lingers in the air. Its taste is just as impressive, with a smooth and complex flavour profile that combines notes of spice, diesel and citrus. The effect of Mega Breath come on fast, starting with a rush of crebral euphoria that uplifts the mood and enhances creativity. This mental buzz is accompnied by a physical relaxation that soothes the muscles and releases tension.

variants.title: MAC 2
variants.body_html: Introducing 1Spliff's newest addition to its line of exceptional strains - MAC 2. This potent hybrid is the result of crossing two renowned strains, creating a masterpiece that will leave you craving more. One of MAC 2's most distinctive features is its smooth and delectable orange flavor, which is complemented by subtle floral accents. This tantalizing taste profile is perfectly balanced out by a sweet and earthy finish, leaving a delightful aftertaste on your palate. The nugs of MAC 2 are an absolute sight to behold. They are gorgeous, covered in a thick layer of resin that is a testament to the high-quality cultivation techniques employed.

variants.body_html: Introducing lil volos, the latest addition to our collection that offers an opportunity to try our rotating quads and exotic genetics in a more accessible format. Each package is a curated selection from our ever changing lineup of strains, ensuring a fresh and diverse product with each new lot. Cultivated with the same meticulous care and attention to detail that VOLO is known for, these small buds are hand selected for their quality and potency.

This well-known West Coast favourite has been growing for many years on Vancouver Island in British Columbia. These big buds are green and purple with a thick dusting of trichomes spread inside and outside the flower. This craft flower is hand harvested, hand processed, hang dried, cold cured and hand packed to ensure this premium flower holds its amazing profile.

The nose represents strong GMO terpenes with added pepper up front and sour finish.

variants.body_html: Gluerangutan is some sticky island dank. A back-cross of the popular legacy OG strain Harambe (OG Kush x GG4 x Afghani), Gluerangutan hits you like a truck with powerful diesel base aromas, followed by citrus zest overtones and a fresh mountain pine finish. The top cut from a 100,000+ pheno hunt, Gluerangutan is Ocean Grown next to the Salish Sea in Living Organic Soils, harvested by hand, and hang dried in small batches using artisanal slow-cure methods. Flower used in the extraction was fresh frozen and by freezing the freshly harvested cannabis flower before extraction, the terpenes and cannabinoids are better preserved, providing an authentic representation of the strain's full potential. The concentrate can be vaped using a dab rig, allowing consumers to experience the full flavour profile. Alternatively, it can be added to pre-rolls or sprinkled on top of bowls.

A sativa dominant hybrid between the ever-popular MK Ultra and Chemdawg 91, Cold Creek Kush, or CCK, is a globally recognized strain, known for its light green hues, amber hairs and trichrome-frosted flowers. CCK is a potent strain that tests with high THC levels. Cold Creek Kush is recognized for its dank smell, resembling a damp rainforest with notes of earth, wood, sour and pine, giving a strong but fresh aroma and a dank, spicy and herbal flavour, informed by high levels of beta-pinene, nerolidol, trans-caryophyllene and limonene. Just as with any Redecan Evergreen strain, CCK is carefully harvested and expertly cured to preserve its natural flavour and moisture, trimmed by hand and inspected.

variants.title: Atman 510 Battery 2.0-4.0V Adjustable Voltage-Black-380mAh
variants.body_html: These 510 threaded batteries are compatible with pre-filled or refillable cartridges. The Atman 380mAh battery, allows you to enjoy vaping all day before recharging. Adjust the voltage between 2.0 and 4.0V depending on the type of material you’re using in your cartridge. The 510-thread size is the most common, so it will fit with the majority of available carts. The USB provides a fast charge without requiring a wall block. For safety purposes and to prevent overheating the battery stops outputting power if the draw taken is too lengthy. To turn the device on, quickly press the button 5 times. Hold that same button down to draw. It’s personal preference whether you prefer to hold the button and heat up the material to get a massive hit or start drawing as soon as you press the button down for a more moderate hit. Preheat mode can be activated by rapidly clicking the button 2 times, this allows for the battery to continuously heat for 15 seconds. The device also has an auto-shutoff to prevent overheating. Variable voltage is achieved by simply twisting the bottom of the battery to desired temperature. The voltage range is between 2.0 and 4.0 volts. Remember, different viscosities will vaporize better at different temperatures. To charge the battery, screw on the charger the same way you would thread the cartridge. It is recommended to charge in a computer or a similar device. Sometimes using a wall adapter (especially a high powered one) can cause damage to the battery. The lights on the device and charger will be red while charging, and then turn off on the pen and change to green on the charger when complete.

variants.title: Wild Berry Blaze Gummies
variants.body_html: Take it easy with our Wild Berry Blaze soft chews. Each one contains 2.5mg THC and 10mg CBD, so you can SHRED'EM at your own pace. Can it get any better? Yup, they're pectin based and vegan friendly. We get it, not everyone likes to max out the THC.

variants.title: Mellow Melon 2:1 Gummies
variants.body_html: Monjour Mellow Melon CBD and CBG sugar-coated gummies, infused with 20mg of CBD and 10mg of CBG each for a soothing moment wherever you are in your day. A comforting and uplifting blend of melon, watermelon, and lemon balm, available in a pack of 4 for an easy addition to your ritual. Total cannabinoid potency of 120mg per pack.

variants.title: Sugar Free Raspberry Acai 1:1 Gummies
variants.body_html: Olli's Sugar Free Raspberry Acai 1:1 Chews blend together the delicious flavour of fresh raspberries with the richness of acai, forming a delightful combination to invigorate your tastebuds. Each pouch contains four 4.5g soft chews, infused with a balanced 2.5 mg THC combined with 2.5 mg CBD per chew for a total of 10 mg THC and 10 mg CBD per package. Each soft chew is vegan friendly, sugar free and made with natural flavours.

variants.title: Cookie Face PR 10 x 0.3 g
variants.body_html: Enjoy a real sticky treat with this cross of Girl Scout Cookies and Face Off rolled and ready in our 10x0.3g pre-rolls. This heavyweight indica classic is bursting with an herbaceous citrus aroma that ends with a tinge of spice. An ideal pick for those looking for a potent smoke with deep flavours. Sit back, relax, and enjoy the ride. Wildlife pre-rolls are rolled from whole buds, never shake. We remove sticks and stems by hand, and finish with a hand twist for quality assurance. Life is wild. Roll with it.

variants.title: Neon Rush Gummies
variants.body_html: Cruise a mountainous electric rush of bold citrus flavour and max THC! Versus Neon Rush Gummy packs a punch with 10 mg THC and 10 mg of naturally occurring caffeine. This single pectin-based gummy delivers a refreshing surge of sweet, fizzy flavour.

variants.title: Fifty Woods Triple Infused PR 1 x 0.75 g
variants.body_html: A potent nod to legacy cannabis culture, DEBUNK Fifty Woods hits heavy at 50%+ THC. Premium Han Solo GMO milled flower infused with liquid THCa diamond is enhanced with terps for smooth and creamy flavour with a nostalgic overtone. Wrapped in our signature chamomile blunt wrap with a glass filter tip and a bubble hash tip, this 0.75 g indica blunt is no joke.

variants.title: Crimson Toro Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Trailblazer brings you Crimson Toro Infused pre-rolls, expertly crafted with diamonds, distillate & terpenes for increased potency and a wildly aromatic burn. Crimson Toro is famous for it's complex aromas featuring a sweet and sour fusion of juicy cranberries and pomegranates that are taken to the next level with expert infusion. 5 x 0.5g pre-rolls per pack at 36 - 40%+ THC.

variants.title: Grape Galaxy & Sour Slapple Infused PR 2 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Don't sleep on this two-pack of 0.5 g infused hybrid pre-rolls, rolled to perfection and infused with mind-blowing flavours. Pairing tart green apple from Sour Slapple with a nostalgic wave of grape flavour from Grape Galaxy, each pack comes with two half-gram pre-rolls perfect for sharing or hit 'em both if you're feeling greedy.

variants.title: Milk Chocolate Live Rosin Waffle Cones
variants.body_html: The bottom of an ice cream cone filled with Belgian milk chocolate and full spectrum live rosin. Two delicious cones infused with 5 mg of THC each.

variants.title: Neon Rush Cali Blast Gummies
variants.body_html: Get ready for a surfside splash of tropical-lime flavour alongside max THC! Versus Neon Rush Cali Blast Gummy packs a punch with 10 mg THC and 10 mg of naturally occurring caffeine. This single pectin-based gummy delivers a refreshing surge of sweet, fizzy flavour.

variants.title: Cherry Limeade THC Gummies
variants.body_html: Pucker up and get perky with juicy Cherry Limeade THC Pearls. Tart cherry and lime flavours come together, pairing perfectly with 10 mg of THC per package. Bring them on the go, enjoy them with friends, or indulge in a night in by yourself because Pearls go with everything. 5 gummies per pack.

variants.title: Bubba Kush R.B.
variants.body_html: An all-time favorite sarsaparilla flavour made with pure cane sugar for the perfect amount of natural sweetness. Keef’s cannabis-infused carbonated beverages will surpass your flavour expectations. Each can contains 10 mg of THC per can and is made without caffeine.

variants.title: Peachy Pom Bellinii Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Step into an orchard of lush, sun-kissed flavors with Peachy Pom Bellini. Unlock the ripe sweetness of peach, elegantly balanced by the tart kick of pomegranate. It's a dance of summer's warmth and a splash of sophisticated celebration, evoking the essence of a sparkling Bellini. Our hand-selected cannabis, teeming with myrcene and caryophyllene, offers a fruity foundation punctuated by exotic whispers. Enveloped in our ultra-fine unbleached cones, each is infused with diamonds, elevated by a special terpene blend, and delicately dusted in a golden kief coating. Cheers to the taste of endless summer sunsets!

variants.title: Real Fruit Strawberry CBD Gummies
variants.body_html: Wyld Strawberry Hybrid Enhanced CBD:THC Soft Chews are a 20:1, CBD-dominant 10-pack made sustainably made using real fruit, botanical terpenes and natural flavours. Each Soft Chew contains 20mg CBD and 1mg THC, for a total of 200mg CBD and 10mg THC. All Wyld Soft Chews are packaged in an all-new compostable pouch, and our recipes are formulated by food scientists to provide consistent experiences that taste amazing. Wyld Soft Chews use sunflower lecithin to improve biovailability and onset time and are made to be thermostable up to 60 degrees celcius, with a firm texture that doesn't stick to your teeth. Each Wyld Strawberry Hybrid Enhanced Soft Chew contains 20mg CBD and 1mg THC combined with the terpenes limonene, linalool, alpha-pinene, and beta-pinene for a subtly uplifting experience. Wyld uses carbon neutral manufacturing to support a healthy planet.

variants.title: Root Beer Float Blunt PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Our high potency craft flower in blunts! Root Beer Float is a rare indica-dominant strain created through crossing XXX OG x Vanilla Kush, wrapped in a tea leaf blunt wrap. Enter into a sweet hazy, earthy flavour with hints of lemon and pine aroma. Enjoy the classic Root Beer flavour combined with frothy vanilla notes. BOLD Craft Cannabis is indoor grown, small batch, hang dried, slow cured and hand trimmed.

variants.title: Sungrown Traditional Hash
variants.body_html: Indulge in a smooth smoke that only nature can provide with Sungrown Traditional Hash. Crafted from living soil, every inhale is a delight to your senses. Experience the harmonious balance of nature's perfection in every puff.

variants.title: Spinach Blueberry Dynamite Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Hold on tight, friends! This vape is dynamite. Blueberry Dynamite draws inspiration from our legendary Blueberry and cultivar lineage of Thai and Purple Thai. Linalool and caryophyllene bring out the seriously sweet and fruity flavours. Our Spinach exclusive made with a proprietary cold-filtered extract distilled four times at sub-zero temperatures brings out consistency and bursts of flavour. Compatible with 510 thread devices. Device not included.

variants.title: G Sherb Infused PR 3 x 0.6 g
variants.body_html: Flavour seekers rejoice! We went to the lab and didn't return until we had something to sink our teeth into. Introducing G Sherb Infused Pre-Roll. Starting with our flagship Gelato Mint and Power Sherb strains, we first mill and blend whole buds to a precise consistency, then add in BHO resin produced from each strain and roll them up in a pre-roll.

variants.title: Neon Sunshine
variants.body_html: Like driving a classic Corvette down Hwy 101 from Malibu to Venace beach. Stereo up, roof down. Nothing but sand, surf, and some of that, Neon Sunshine! Introducing Tribal's Neon Sunshine. Created by legendary breeder Exotic Genetix, Neon Sunshine is Zkittles x Falcon 9. Sweet & tangy flavours meet vibrant & frosty flowers... the true California dream!

variants.title: Atomic GMO Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: The most electrifying cannabis experience at the tip of your fingers. Spinach Fully Charged Atomic GMO infused pre-rolls are hard hitting with the combination of knock-out strains and high potency, high quality cold-filtered cannabis extract. Enjoy a perfected blend of Spinach exclusive fan-favourite cultivars Atomic Sour Grapefruit and GMO Cookies. These pre-rolls are fully charged with explosive flavours inspired by our proprietary Atomic Sour Grapefruit strain that are dialed all the way up with natural terpenes for a sensory overload. Experience an infused pre-roll that's charged to the max.

variants.title: Roil Wedding Shatter
variants.body_html: Roilty Roil Wedding is 1G of our highest potency BHO concentrate. Thanks to the celebratory strain Wedding Cake this shatter has spectacular layers of flavour. This vape aroma has notes of sweet pepper, hints of berry and a pine undertone brought to you by the regal terpenes known as beta-caryophyllene, limonene and alpha-humulene. Kick off your shoes and lay back in your throne to enjoy this treat.

variants.title: Smooth Burners Hundo Hash Alien Glue Infused PR 2 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: 7ACRES Smooth Burners Hundo Hash Alien Glue pre-rolls are an easy to consume cannabis. Using solventless hash blended from bubble hash and dry sift hash that has been sourced from single strain inputs. Hand rolled, hand packed and hand finished, these patent pending pre-rolls are designed for a smooth and slow burn. The patent pending airflow design ensures the cannabis isn't acting as a filter, keeping the precious terpenes and cannabinoids from degrading as the pre-roll is consumed.

variants.title: Propulsion Cosmic Cherry Lime
variants.body_html: STAY ENGAGED with Deep Space Propulsion Cosmic Cherry Lime - a refreshingly delicious bold cherry soda with a lively punch of zesty lime. Cosmic Cherry Lime is fueled by 10 mg of THC, 10 mg of CBG and naturally occurring caffeine to ignite your discovery. THC effects may be felt within 30 minutes of consumption (individual results may vary). Made with natural flavours and colours.

variants.title: Jungle Fumes
variants.body_html: Stop and smell the Jungle Fumes! These dense Jungle-coloured buds are packed with diesel and chem flavours! The parent strains of Sour Diesel x Chemdawg x Lemon OG create a sativa that comes with a heavy diesel aroma upfront, chem undertones and notes of tropical fruits. Jungle Fumes will take you on a jungle cruise through your senses! FIGR dried flower products are hand selected to ensure dense, high-quality buds are in every package.

variants.title: Liquid Imagination PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Let your imagination run wild with Back Forty’s Liquid Imagination. A cross between Blue Zkittles and Jet Fuel Gelato, this potent hybrid comes in a 10-pack of 0.35g slim pre-roll. With a flavour profile that blends sweet and sour with a touch of gas, Liquid Imagination is a real treat for your senses with dominant terpenes of Pinene and Beta-Caryophyllene.

variants.title: Razzilicious Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Sourced from quality whole flower cultivars, infused with botanical terpenes and dusted in kief. Sour and sweet Razzilicious. Pucker up on the inhale because this pre-roll has lots of sour flavour but comes out sweet on the exhale.

variants.title: Bussn' Blackberry Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Get ready to elevate your smoking experience with litti’s Bussn’ Blackberry Infused Pre-Roll! This pre-roll is packed with primo bud, potent THCA diamonds and infused with our signature blackberry-lemon flavour blend. You’ll experience a burst of tangy fruitiness that’ll leave your taste buds Bussn' with excitement. The best part? It won't break the bank, so your taste buds and your wallet will thank you! Get ready to bust out the good vibes and puff on litti’s Bussn’ Blackberry Infused Pre-Rolls for a flavour-packed experience that's truly Bussn'!

variants.title: SMRF Infused PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Something totally unique – a true-blue blueberry infused pre-roll. Featuring a “berry” potent strain (Berry Blue / Blueberry) and mouth-watering blueberry flavour infused in every cone, this one will leave you asking for more.

variants.title: Cold Cured Rosin
variants.body_html: Astrolab's signature ice water extracted rosin is cold cured into the perfect wet badder consistency. Made by legacy hashishins, our rosin is made from live ice water hash isolating select spectrum trichomes. Experts dry, process, press, and package to the highest standard with no detail overlooked.

variants.title: White Blaze PR 10 x 0.3 g
variants.body_html: Wildlife White Blaze pre-rolls have a spicy, peppery aroma with notes of bold, rich stone fruit. Wildlife pre-rolls are rolled from whole buds, never shake. We remove sticks and stems by hand, and finish with a hand twist for quality assurance. Our processing rooms' environments are set to ensure minimal moisture loss. Expertly rolled for a smooth, even burn and packaged in a compact recyclable and reusable tin to keep things fresh and environmentally friendly.

variants.title: Wedding Pie PR 3 x 0.75 g
variants.body_html: This pack of straight-cuts offers the iconic Wedding Pie, a timeless indica with notes of grape and vanilla. Back Forty Wedding Pie pre-rolls deliver a full flower taste and a slow-burning smoke. This pack of straight-cuts offers the iconic Wedding Pie, a timeless indica with notes of grape and vanilla. Rolled in natural hemp papers and packed in a convenient pocket-sized carton, it's the perfect pack to explore the Back Forty.

variants.title: Traditional Hash
variants.body_html: Washed, extracted and pressed in house, our traditional hash is aromatic, sticky and malleable. Each release is made in small batches of rotating lots that are pressed and rolled by hand into a traditional temple ball. To finish, we cold cure our hash for at least three months and package it into a ceramic jar to ensure it’s perfectly preserved. Solventless and free of any added oils and botanical terpenes.

variants.title: TQ Sunrise Fat Boy Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: This TQ Sunrise Fat Boy 510 vape packs the maximum amount of THC (1000mg) in a cartridge. TQ Sunrise has a tropical, woodsy flavour with a bite of lime.

variants.title: Squish'D Berry Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: A sweet and fruity 510 vape cart with very strong potency, made with only distillate and botanical terpenes – no fillers!

variants.title: Reign Drops 30:0 Blend Oil
variants.body_html: With THC and no CBD, Reign Drops by Redecan is a blend of greenhouse-grown cannabis with a very strong THC potency. Formulated in Niagara, Ontario, this oil is put through a state-of-the-art extraction process and diluted to optimal concentration. All oil products sold at OCS.ca are meant for ingestion only. variants.title: Raw Perforated Wide Filter Tips - 50pk
variants.body_html: RAW Tips are made on an antique Fourdrinier paper machine. Whereas RAW papers are made in Alcoy Spain, we only have machines to produce thin paper in Alcoy. For the thick tipping paper we had to travel to an old paper mill in Northern China that was still using an original Fourdrinier. This was the only place we could find that still had one of these old machines in use, which we needed to make the special long-fiber paper for RAW tips. Want to know more? Modern paper mills use small-structure cellulose to make paper. The original paper mills used fiber instead. For tipping paper to perform best, it needs to be made from fiber – not just boiled cellulose. Fiber-based tips roll smooth AND have enough structural rigidity to both keep its shape in your mouth AND to not dissolve. There are precious few of the original Fourdrinier paper machines in use because they’re antiques and expensive to operate. We were lucky to find this old mill, it’s the only one in the world that can produce RAW tips to our specifications.

variants.title: Cabana Colada Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Get ready to surf waves of sweetness and sunshine with Cabana Colada. Pineapple, orange and coconut grab a hold of your taste buds and the exhale finishes on the sweet fragrance of an island breeze.

variants.title: Cali Kush PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Cali Kush is a true classic. The parent to many of today’s modern Kush genetics, it still holds its own in delivering a great bang for your buck. The earthy, grassy notes are backed up with anise and pine, and come together to create a smooth creamy smoke

variants.title: Sugar Cookies
variants.body_html: Sugar Cookies is an herbaceous indica featuring freshly baked aromas of sweet spice, citrus, and a hint of gas with a creamy brown sugar finish. A cross of popular strains Cake Crasher x Jet Fuel Gelato, Sugar Cookies is highly potent and boasts dense buds with a generous frosting of snow-white trichomes.

variants.title: 5 Loco THC 1.0 Gummies
variants.body_html: 5 Loco is at least one better than four. This fruity, cherry forward gummie sprinkled with sour crystals & packed with citrus lime flavor is sure to have taste buds dancing the night away. Safer than its predecessor beverage and a lot tastier, consumers are sure to love ALL the flavour with none of the holes in the drywall.

variants.title: Ice Cream Cake
variants.body_html: Ice Cream Cake is the ultimate form of cake. Just look at it: supremely frosty, dense, and delightful, ultimately potent. That’s right, this icy indica-dominant is 20-26% THC and hits harder than expected with creamy, lip-smacking flavour. Take a whiff of the sweet citrus and diesel notes from the dominant Caryophyllene, Humulene, and Limonene terpenes and try to tell us this Ice Cream Cake doesn’t slap. Remember to thank Wedding Cake x Gelato #33 for creating this decadent dream.

variants.title: El Bluntito 4-Pack Centrado PR 4 x 0.75 g

variants.title: El Bluntito Centrado PR 1 x 0.75 g
variants.body_html: Our Centrado El Bluntito is a hybrid that contains full flower buds, broken down by hand (never ground), hand rolled in tobacco-free natural hemp wraps, finished with custom glass filter tips and encased in a resealable glass jar.

variants.title: The Pink One
variants.body_html: Legend has it, Pink Lemonade was invented when a Chicago man accidentally dropped cinnamon candies into a batch of lemonade. You know what's weird about that story? What's that guy doing walking around with so many cinnamon candies? That's what we want to know. Anyway, this is 100% pink lemonade and 0% cinnamon candies, we swear.

variants.title: El Bluntito Viva PR 4 x 0.75 g

variants.title: Tangria Vape Cartridge

variants.title: Jungle Fumes PR 3 x 0.5 g

variants.title: Purple Punch Out + Ultra Jean G Holy PR 20 x 0.4 g
variants.body_html: Introducing Holy Smokes Dynamic Duos - a powerhouse package of two exceptional tube-style pre-rolls! Experience the knockout combo of Purple Punch-Out!!, an indica full of sweet grape and berry aromas and Ultra Jean-G, a sour sativa heavy on the gas and citrus. Each pre-roll boasts 20-26% THC. Embark on an exciting quest with two tube-style pre-rolls with elegant gold detailing. Crafted with 100% certified organic hemp paper, these pre-rolls (20 total) promise a smooth burn and awesome experience, every time.

variants.title: Mellow Man PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Chill out with the Mellow Man! With bright citrusy notes and a down-to-earth finish, this mellow man is bound to be your new best bud! variants.title: Organic Mint Chocolate Chip

Bred by Exotic Genetix, a cross of Mystery Cookies and Green Ribbon BX, the dense resin-laden buds are packed with a unique and herbaceous aroma that exude a certain skunkiness when broken open, and contains minty, herbal, sweet and sour notes with a hint of chocolate. variants.title: Alien Kush
variants.body_html: We've made first contact. Spinach Alien Kush has started its invasion and you're not gonna want to miss it. With pine, citrus and earthy aromas, this alien embodies all the beautiful things here on earth. But its powered-up THC potency will remind you that it is out-of-this world and travelling at full force. variants.title: Acai Blxst Live Resin Vape Cartridge

variants.title: Sunny Blaze PR 1 x 1 g

variants.title: Jungle Fumes

variants.title: Pacific OG PR 3 x 0.5 g

variants.title: ON (Jack Herer) + OFF (Dos Z Dos) PR 2 x 0.25 g

The unique 0.25g preroll size offers the right amount of flower to enjoy a fresh experience every time.

variants.title: Cherry Cheesecake PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Introducing Cherry Cheesecake, a legendary indica strain crossed between Kimbo Kush and Cherry Pie. Coming in between 25-31% THC, this strain hits all the right highs. Indoor grown in small batches on the West Coast, Broken Coast strives to push the limits on what craft flower can be. Experience notes of Cherry, Cheese, and Sour in a unique 5 x 0.5g format.

variants.title: Indica PR 10 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html:
You can have it all with * HIGH VALUE!
* HIGH VALUE delivers the perfect combination of price, potency and quality in every pack.
The * HIGH VALUE multi-pack contains 10 x 0.5g prerolls made from high-potency, single strain
whole flower and hand-finished in classic preroll cones.

variants.title: Sweet Island Skunk PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Sweet Island Skunk sativa dominant pre-rolls deliver sweet and skunky flavours with notes of grapefruit. Flawless grind and pack for a steady burn.

variants.title: Astrono PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Discover Ono Cannabis' Rainbow Pie pre-roll. Dive into a one-of-a-kind sativa blend from our Rainbow Pie whole dried flower. Our dedication ensures high quality cannabis without breaking the bank. Rainbow Pie emerges from the fusion of the luscious Grand Blueberry Pie and Zktlz strains. What distinguishes us? Our state-of-the-art aeroponic cultivation. Plants thrive in air and misted nutrients, resulting in consistent, top-notch harvests. Our vertical approach ensures each plant's unique care, presenting a verdant canopy vista. We're rigorous in our process: monitoring 1,200+ data points and refining 120 recipe elements to enhance cannabinoid, terpene and flavonoid profiles. Our plants are pre-rinsed for purity. After harvest, they're curated and dried for ten days, fine tuning the flavour and scent. Rainbow Pie's profile? Think creamy, nutty blueberries with spicy floral undertones. Its aroma recalls a freshly baked blueberry pie with earthy hints.

variants.title: Jungle Fumes PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Stop and smell the Jungle Fumes. These dense jungle coloured buds are packed with diesel and chem flavours. FIGR pre-rolls are expertly rolled with a paper filter and conical shape for a smooth and consistent smoke.

variants.title: Sage N' Sour PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: These all flower pre-rolls are crafted from Sage n’ Sour, a sativa-dominant cross between the pungent Sour Diesel x S.A.G.E. This strain takes its well-known Sour Diesel lineage to the next level through its unique terpenes. Sage n’ Sour is full of pungent, gassy diesel notes, with peppery, limey and cedar accents.

variants.title: Cherry Boat PR 2 x 1 g
variants.body_html: Cherry Boat is a sativa-dominant strain selected from our Cherry Boat worked line that blends the strong THC potency of an 11 week Pink Kush that was found in bag seed many years ago crossed with the delicious flavour of Top Dawg Cherry Chem. Our Cherry Boat was grown in sunny South Western Ontario in living soil, whole plant hung and offering high THC and terpenes. Cared by a talented team of legacy craft growers. Featuring strong THC potency potential with 3.5%+ terpenes the combination yields a sweet fruit with earthy chocolate undertones and a bit of funk. Bred by, selected by, and grown by 7 Farms Down.

variants.title: Trop Cherry PR 7 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: These tasty jams are made from hand-selected strains notable for their exceptional flavours. Filled with Trop Cherry, giving you a unique cross featuring Tropicanna CKS x Cherry CKS f3, producing a beautiful cherry/fruit aroma and a powerful sativa-dominant flower.

variants.title: Kush God PR 10 x 0.3 g
variants.body_html: A potent indica-dominant cultivar rolled and ready in a pack of 10. Each 0.3g pre-roll is packed with Kush God, a cross of Pink Kush x Pineapple God featuring notes of tropical fruit, grape, and dairy from dominant terpenes Myrcene, Limonene, and Humulene. variants.title: Mollo 10 Lime
variants.body_html: A crisp, lightly hopped non-alcoholic lager with a refreshing lime flavour. Each glass bottle contains 10 mg of nano-infused THC and 10 mg of CBD. Pour into a chilled glass and serve with a lime wedge.

variants.title: Andromeda
variants.body_html: 28g of Pure Indica Potential the 'Andromeda' doesn't hold back. With a generous 28g, it's the perfect choice for those who understand that a true Indica experience demands more than just a taste - it requires a feast. Share this extraordinary bag with friends or keep it as your secret weapon for when inspiration strikes.

variants.title: Pedro's Prima
variants.body_html: Unique to Color, Pedro’s Prima Sativa whole flower is a sativa-dominant hybrid, that is a descendant of the popular Pedro’s Sweet Sativa. Pedro’s Prima is earthy and gassy, with a delightfully fruity undertone. Our elevated growing practices, including full temperature and humidity control and hang-drying, guarantee a consistent and enjoyable smoking experience. Cultivated with care and nitrogen packaged for maximum freshness.

variants.title: Mango Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Tasty’s Mango Infused Pre-Rolls offer an unbeatable combination of THC and taste without breaking the bank. Each pack offers pre-rolls, infused with ultra-powerful concentrate inputs for an incredibly high THC. With a burst of tangy, sun-kissed mango flavours enhanced by botanical terpenes, Mango Infused Pre-Rolls offer everything you crave at a price you’ll love.

variants.title: Blueberry
variants.body_html: Straight from the Classic Strain Library, Divvy's got you with Blueberry strain in your flower bag. Blueberry is an indica-dominant strain with Afghani x Thai lineage that has a caryophyllene, myrcene & farnesene terpene profile in our grow. Juicy and potent, this fruity cultivar is your new go-to.

variants.title: G-Wagon PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: G-Wagon is a new drop from the flavour forward seed company, Umami Seeds. This cultivar was created by crossing Georgia Pie with the hash rosin phenotype of Zwish. The combination of its top three terpenes, limonene, caryophyllene and farnesene, produce an extremely unique savoury flavour reminiscent of buttered popcorn. VCC took this whole flower crop and made our signature pre-rolls with it. The numbers of discerning craft cannabis consumers have been increasingly calling for large format pre-rolls. Our pre-rolls have been touched by no fewer than three human beings before release. From the grind, hand sift, cycling times, pack rate to the hand sizing, twist and snip, we create some of the finest possible craft pre-rolls.

variants.title: Island Pink
variants.body_html: Island Pink is a striking and visually appealing strain. A potent Canadian indica with strong aromatics of sweet and tart citrus with undertones of earthy wood and is a cross between D Bubba and Pink Kush. The round, densely packed buds are a beautiful green with swirls of purple and pink. Orange and pink pistils weave in and out of the flowers and peek through the heavily coated frosting of sticky white trichomes.

variants.title: Bucketz Loosies PR 10 x 0.3 g
variants.body_html: Bucketz Loosies is a 10-pack of highly potent, Sativa dominant dog-walker style joints. These joints are packed with the supreme Gorilla Poison cultivar, made by crossing the beloved Mimosa x GG4 x Durban Poison. This certified craft cultivar is grown by Sugar Cane Cannabis, in beautiful British Columbia which is Canada’s first Indigenous micro cultivator licensed by Health Canada. Bucketz Loosies smell like tropical fruit, with hints of nutty vanilla and woody pine.

variants.title: White Freeze AIO Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Back Forty’s All-In-One vape hardware is designed to put Back Forty in the palm of your hand. With a 0.95g fill, compact design, and rechargeable battery, it's the perfect balance between function and format. White Freeze is a nostalgic sweet treat hitting notes of vanilla with an icy cool exhale.

variants.title: Venom OG Live Resin Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: You asked, and we delivered! Our infamous Venom OG you’ve all come to know and love is now available as a Live Resin 510 vape cart, bringing to life the full profile of this beloved strain. This high-potency and high-terpene extract is crafted from single-strain fresh-frozen flower that’s undergone an arctic extraction journey to lock in all the complex terpenes, flavonoids, and cannabinoids. This cart boasts a burst of skunky spice, subtle peppery notes, with a hint of zesty lemon that'll awaken your senses. Elevate your vaping experience with the full profile of Venom OG, all in one sleek 510 vape cart. Brought to you with love, from Scarborough.

variants.title: Taster Pack Juiced Up Js Infused PR 3 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Versus Distillate Infused Juiced up Js taster pack combine high terpene concentrate with indica dominant whole flower to create potent pre-rolls with a higher terpene content than traditional pre-rolls. The taster pack will feature three of our current Juiced Up Js flavours.

variants.title: Grilled Cheeeeez
variants.body_html: A cheesy funky delight. 7g of potent bud ground from whole indica nugs, with pungent aromas of creamy and peppery cheddar. Fluffy and fresh with no grinder needed so it's ready to smoke however you want. Super Toast. Always Ready.

variants.title: Pink Kush PR 10 x 0.3 g

The Pure Sunfarms cut of Pink Kush, originally from Vancouver Island, showcases gassy aromas of white pepper, orange, butterscotch, coffee, earth and grapefruit. Conveniently portioned for single-use sessions and presented in a reusable tin. Featuring natural paper, each pre-roll is finished with a twisted end, preventing spillage, and acting as a convenient wick.

variants.title: Sativa 420 PR 20 x 0.4 g
variants.body_html: Presenting Weed Me's strain-specific, 0.4g pre-rolls! This sativa-dominant strain boasts a very strong THC potency potential, is milled and then filled into light-weight paper cones with a paper mouth piece. Each pack contains 20 pre-rolls.

variants.title: GMO Cookies PR 10 x 0.35 g
variants.body_html: Don't let the name deceive you. GMO (Garlic, Mushroom, Onion) Cookies has an unmistakable sweet and savory taste and is one of the most sought-after and popular lndica strains out there. You can't make a soup out of it, but it sure goes nicely in a bowl.

variants.body_html: This unique cross has gas! Dark hued buds with hints of olive green, caked sugar leaves, contrasting orange pistils, and frosted with a healthy coat of trichomes. Imagine sweet apple, with a subtle hints of mint and pine.

variants.title: Fruitsplosion PR 10 x 0.4 g

Give your day a little boost of sweetness from four custom-curated strains that bring extraordinary aromas with 2% terpenes for an unforgettably fruity experience. Darts are so unbelievably bold, you'll need to experience them to believe their strong, consistent and unique effects.

variants.title: Glueberry Redees PR 10 x 0.4 g

variants.title: Neon Sunshine PR 5 x 0.6 g

variants.title: Donair Kush PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Straight from the East Coast. Donair Kush by Truro is a unique and potent indica dominant legacy cultivar of Platinum Kush (Platinum OG Kush X Kush Mints). Produced from whole flower craft cannabis, Donair Kush Pre-rolls have an earthy, sweet, and tangy flavour profile. Donair Kush is proudly grown on the East Coast in Truro, Nova Scotia in our state-of-the-art small batch production facility, where each bud is carefully cultivated, hang dried, hand trimmed, slow cured (21-28 days) and hand packaged in recyclable tubes.

variants.title: Organic Durban Gorilla
variants.body_html: Organic Durban Gorilla was raised in the jungle-like climate of the Highly Dutch Organic greenhouse where rainwater, sunlight, and living soil helped it grow up big, frosty, and potent. This indica-dominant cross between Ethos Glue and Mimosa may not have opposable thumbs but it does have fruity and floral flavour with notes of cereal. variants.title: Organic Fiestaz
variants.body_html: Fiestaz, a cross of Ripz (White Fire 43 x Wedding Cake x Purple Punch) with Rainbow Sherbet 11 (Sunset Sherbet x Pink Guava), bringing some colourful, backcountry funk stashed in its chunk. Those dense nugs fill the room with an intoxicating and complex aroma of ripe berries, bright citrus, and tropical fruits mingling with cinnamon spice, caramel notes, and ephemeral, floral perfume. The festive flavour profile translates into candied touches of sweet dough on the tongue with a subtle drop of gas and a hint of mint. Dominant terpenes include Limonene, Linalool, and Selinadienes. variants.title: Nana's Jam Vape Cartridge
variants.body_html: Smucker up to Nana's Jam for a lip-smacking strawberry banana taste, reminiscent of after-school fruity treats! Combined with potent THC extract in a high-grade 510 cartridge to provide novince and experienced consumers something new to explore.

variants.title: Melon Haze Live Resin & Diamond Infused PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Zest Cannabis Pre-Rolls are a combustion of flavour & potency, made from AAA+ grade flower, and high quality BHO/Isolate extracts. Our Melon Haze Live Resin & Diamond Infused Pre-Rolls are crafted with thoughtfully milled flower, blended with extracts for a juicy combo with high THC and aromatics.

variants.title: OG Citrus HopWater
variants.body_html: What is Hop Water? When aromatic hops meets carbonated water = OG Hopwater. Crisp, fresh, zesty lime & citrus, toasted cereal notes, balanced with a gentle hoppy finish. No sugar! NOT A SELTZER!

variants.title: Frozen Melonade Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Delicious chill energy is all you will be getting from this behemoth of flavour. Frozen Melonade is a 1.2g disposable sativa vape that tastes like a beach vacation 3 hours in to pool time, right as 2nd lunch is about to hit. We're serving up a tasty lemon slush flavours with a side of melon squares at just the right amount of THC to keep the good times rolling. All in a convenient portable format that you know the squad will want to get a taste of. But hey, this meal is big enough to be served family style. LUNCH - it's what's on the menu.

variants.title: Neon Sunshine Fresh Frozen Hash Rosin
variants.body_html: After a long day, just after sunset, you can catch the most perfect colours coming off the clouds. Relax, and take a moment to soak up some Neon Sunshine! Introducing Tribal's Neon Sunshine. (Zktlz x Falcon 9, Breeder; Exotic Genetix) Sweet & tangy lemon flavours meet deep dark gasoline. Our FFHR is made by sieving frozen premium grade Neon Sunshine flower through 159µm to 73µm wash bags in ice water to produce a bubble hash. We then gently heat and press the hash through a fine micron bag until a rosin is forced out. The resulting end product being a solventless, cannabinoid and terpene rich extract.

variants.title: Orange Crush & Blue Ice Raspberry Disposable Vape
variants.body_html: Introducing NERDS, the dual chamber cannabis vape. With two distinct chambers, you can effortlessly switch between two flavours, orange and blue raspberry. The orange flavour captures the essence of freshly squeezed oranges. On the other hand, the blue raspberry flavour offers a sweet and tangy twist. NERDS' hardware ensures a smooth and consistent vaping experience with its sleek and stylish design. The compact size of the vape makes it potable.

variants.title: Exotic Gas PR 5 x 0.5 g
variants.body_html: Lovers of The Loud Plug’s legendary Exotic Gas flower, behold! Your favourite flower is now available in a convenient pre-roll format! When you spark it up, you're in for a wild ride with tangy, sweet, and earthy flavours, plus that unmistakable gas twist. Its dominant terpenes include Pinene, Caryophyllene, and Farnesene. They slow cure and hang-dry Exotic Gas for that top-tier experience. None of that shake or trim nonsense, Loud Plug only uses whole flower milled to perfection before it’s rolled up. Taste the difference. With love from Scarborough.

variants.title: Pink Lemonade Vape Cartridge

With the finest cannabis extract and aerosol tested vape carts, we've leveled up our potency to sunshine level strength with up to 1000 mg per cart. Which means bigger hits and bigger flavour. variants.title: 8 Ball Kush Shatter Double Infused PR 1 x 1 g
variants.body_html:

variants.title: Raw Pre-Rolled Unbleached Slim Tip - 18mm x 5mm - 21pk
variants.body_html: RAW Tips are made on an antique Fourdrinier paper machine. Whereas RAW papers are made in Alcoy Spain, we only have machines to produce thin paper in Alcoy. For the thick tipping paper we had to travel to an old paper mill in Northern China that was still using an original Fourdrinier. This was the only place we could find that still had one of these old machines in use, which we needed to make the special long-fiber paper for RAW tips. Want to know more? Modern paper mills use small-structure cellulose to make paper. The original paper mills used fiber instead. For tipping paper to perform best, it needs to be made from fiber – not just boiled cellulose. Fiber-based tips roll smooth AND have enough structural rigidity to both keep its shape in your mouth AND to not dissolve. There are precious few of the original Fourdrinier paper machines in use because they’re antiques and expensive to operate. We were lucky to find this old mill, it’s the only one in the world that can produce RAW tips to our specifications.

variants.title: Raw Hemp Plastic Rolling Machine - 110mm

In the 1930’s a factory was established to supply the local factories with hand rolling machines. This factory is the oldest existing rolling machine factory in the world. We formed a relationship with them in the 1990’s and now we are their biggest customer – thanks to you! Our factory knows how to make high quality rollers that last for tens of thousands of rolls.
